2302.11481|v2.result: 总结了传感器融合趋势并提出了未来研究方向。

2211.10156|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR系列检测器模型大、推理慢难以部署的问题，现有为卷积检测器设计的知识蒸馏方法无法直接适用。本文提出DETRDistill，包含匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏和查询先验分配蒸馏三个组件，分别对齐师生预测、传递目标中心特征并加速学生收敛。在COCO数据集上，该方法在多种DETR架构上均取得一致的压缩增益，学生模型以更小体量逼近教师性能。
2211.10156|v2.summary_en: DETR-based detectors suffer from large model size and slow inference, and existing knowledge distillation (KD) methods designed for convolution-based detectors are not directly applicable. This paper proposes DETRDistill, a KD framework tailored to DETR-families, comprising Hungarian-matching logits distillation, target-aware feature distillation, and query-prior assignment distillation. Extensive experiments on COCO demonstrate consistent improvements across various DETR architectures, enabling compact students to approach teacher performance.
2211.10156|v2.assessment: 首个系统面向DETR家族的通用知识蒸馏框架，三个蒸馏组件设计合理，对检测器压缩部署有直接参考价值。
2211.10156|v2.contribution: 提出了专为DETR系列检测器设计的通用知识蒸馏框架DETRDistill。
2211.10156|v2.innovation: 针对集合预测特性设计匈牙利匹配logits蒸馏、目标感知特征蒸馏与查询先验分配蒸馏。
2211.10156|v2.result: 在COCO上跨多种DETR架构取得一致的压缩增益，学生模型以更小体量逼近教师性能。

DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_cn: 针对DETR收敛慢、去噪训练中正负样本不平衡的问题，本文提出DINO，通过对比去噪训练、混合查询选择以及两次前向的look-forward-twice方案改进端到端检测。相比DETR，DINO显著加速收敛并提升检测精度，在COCO上以ResNet-50骨干达到约63.3 AP，在12 epoch训练下即超越此前方法。该工作成为后续DETR类检测器的重要基线。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.summary_en: To address slow convergence and the imbalance between positive and negative samples in DETR denoising training, this paper proposes DINO with contrastive denoising training, mixed query selection, and a look-forward-twice scheme. DINO substantially accelerates convergence and improves accuracy, achieving around 63.3 AP on COCO with a ResNet-50 backbone and surpassing prior methods within 12 epochs. It has become a key baseline for subsequent DETR-based detectors.
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.assessment: DINO是端到端目标检测的里程碑工作，训练效率与精度俱佳，被广泛采用为基线，值得深入研读。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.contribution: 提出DINO端到端检测器，通过对比去噪、混合查询选择和两次前向机制提升DETR性能。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.innovation: 引入对比去噪训练与混合查询选择，并采用look-forward-twice加速收敛。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho.result: 在COCO上以ResNet-50达到约63.3 AP，12 epoch训练即超越此前方法。
DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Ancho._arxiv_id: DINO: DETR with Improved DeNoising Anchor Boxes for End-to-End Object Detection.

Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器在高质量检测指标（如AP75、APs等）上表现不足的问题，本文提出Rank-DETR，通过排序导向的匹配与损失设计提升检测框质量。方法引入排序感知的匹配策略和排序损失，使模型更关注高质量预测。在COCO上，Rank-DETR在高质量指标上取得显著提升，成为DETR类检测器在高质量检测方向的重要改进。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.summary_en: DETR-based detectors underperform on high-quality detection metrics such as AP75 and APs. This paper proposes Rank-DETR, which improves bounding box quality through ranking-oriented matching and loss design. On COCO, Rank-DETR achieves notable gains on high-quality metrics, serving as an important improvement for DETR-family detectors in high-quality detection.
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.assessment: 聚焦DETR高质量检测短板，排序导向设计思路新颖，对提升检测框质量有实际意义。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.contribution: 提出Rank-DETR，通过排序导向的匹配与损失提升DETR类检测器的高质量检测性能。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.innovation: 引入排序感知的匹配策略与排序损失，使模型关注高质量预测。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect.result: 在COCO高质量检测指标上取得显著提升。
Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detect._arxiv_id: Rank-DETR for High Quality Object Detection.

2303.05892|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中从预训练视觉语言模型蒸馏知识时存在的信息破坏与迁移低效问题，本文提出Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP)框架。该框架包含目标感知知识提取模块（自适应变换候选框并采用目标感知掩码注意力）和蒸馏金字塔机制（引入全局与块蒸馏补偿关系信息）。实验表明，该方法相比现有方法取得显著提升，在开放词汇检测基准上表现优异。
2303.05892|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection suffers from information destruction and inefficient knowledge transfer when distilling from pretrained vision-and-language models due to non-adaptive proposal cropping and single-level feature mimicking. This paper proposes the Object-Aware Distillation Pyramid (OADP) framework, including an Object-Aware Knowledge Extraction module and a Distillation Pyramid mechanism with global and block distillation. Extensive experiments show significant improvements over current methods.
2303.05892|v2.assessment: 针对开放词汇检测中蒸馏信息损失问题提出结构化解决方案，目标感知提取与金字塔蒸馏设计有借鉴意义。
2303.05892|v2.contribution: 提出OADP框架，通过目标感知知识提取与蒸馏金字塔提升开放词汇检测性能。
2303.05892|v2.innovation: 自适应变换候选框并采用目标感知掩码注意力，引入全局与块蒸馏补偿关系信息。
2303.05892|v2.result: 相比现有方法取得显著提升，在开放词汇检测基准上表现优异。

2304.03110|v2.summary_cn: 针对增量目标检测中灾难性遗忘问题，现有知识蒸馏与样本回放方法直接应用于Deformable DETR等Transformer检测器时效果不佳。本文提出ContinuaL DEtection TRansformer (CL-DETR)，引入检测器知识蒸馏损失（聚焦旧模型最有信息量的预测、忽略冗余背景）并改进样本回放（校准策略保持标签分布）。在COCO 2017上，CL-DETR在增量检测任务上取得state-of-the-art结果。
2304.03110|v2.summary_en: Incremental object detection suffers from catastrophic forgetting, and existing knowledge distillation (KD) and exemplar replay (ER) methods do not work well when directly applied to transformer-based detectors such as Deformable DETR. This paper proposes ContinuaL DEtection TRansformer (CL-DETR), introducing a Detector Knowledge Distillation loss that focuses on informative predictions and a calibration strategy for ER to preserve label distribution. Extensive experiments on COCO 2017 demonstrate state-of-the-art results in incremental object detection.
2304.03110|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏与样本回放有效适配到Transformer检测器的增量学习场景，对持续学习与检测交叉方向有参考价值。
2304.03110|v2.contribution: 提出CL-DETR，使知识蒸馏与样本回放有效适用于Transformer增量目标检测。
2304.03110|v2.innovation: 设计检测器知识蒸馏损失聚焦可靠预测，并提出校准策略保持回放样本标签分布。
2304.03110|v2.result: 在COCO 2017上取得增量目标检测的state-of-the-art结果。

2303.15416|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D视频目标检测中运动物体违反多视图几何约束、在对应关系优化中被当作外点的问题，本文将物体视为一阶公民，提出BA-Det端到端可优化检测器，包含目标中心时序对应学习与特征度量物体光束法平差。在Waymo Open Dataset上，BA-Det以仅边际计算开销取得SOTA性能，验证了对应关系优化对多种3D检测基线的有效性与效率。
2303.15416|v2.summary_en: In 3D video object detection, moving objects violate multi-view geometry constraints and are treated as outliers during correspondence-based optimization. This paper treats objects as first-class citizens and proposes BA-Det, an end-to-end optimizable object detector with object-centric temporal correspondence learning and featuremetric object bundle adjustment. On the Waymo Open Dataset, BA-Det achieves state-of-the-art performance with only marginal computation cost, validating the effectiveness and efficiency of correspondence-based optimization for multiple 3D detector baselines.
2303.15416|v2.assessment: 将光束法平差思想引入3D视频目标检测，目标中心优化思路新颖，在Waymo上验证有效，对自动驾驶3D感知有参考价值。
2303.15416|v2.contribution: 提出BA-Det，将物体作为一阶公民进行对应关系优化以实现3D视频目标检测。
2303.15416|v2.innovation: 结合目标中心时序对应学习与特征度量物体光束法平差，实现端到端可优化检测。
2303.15416|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上以仅边际计算开销取得SOTA性能。

AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中物体形状信息利用不足的问题，提出AShapeFormer，通过Transformer以语义引导的方式对物体级形状进行主动编码。方法将物体级形状先验与语义特征结合，增强检测器对物体几何结构的建模能力。相比已有方法，该工作显式引入语义引导的形状编码模块，提升了形状表征的判别性。在3D检测基准上取得了有竞争力的性能提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of object shape information in point cloud 3D object detection by proposing AShapeFormer, which actively encodes object-level shapes guided by semantics via Transformers. The method integrates object-level shape priors with semantic features to enhance geometric modeling. It achieves competitive improvements on 3D detection benchmarks compared to existing approaches.
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.assessment: 将语义引导的形状编码引入3D检测，思路新颖，对点云检测中的形状建模有参考价值。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.contribution: 提出语义引导的物体级主动形状编码Transformer用于3D目标检测。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.innovation: 以语义引导方式主动编码物体级形状，增强几何表征。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L.result: 在3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的性能提升。
AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-L._arxiv_id: AShapeFormer : Semantics-Guided Object-Level Active Shape Encoding for 3D Object Detection via Transformers.

2303.13769|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界/开放集检测中已知类到未知类知识迁移不足、背景中未知物体难以发现的问题，提出Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer)。方法引入仅用已知样本监督的广义物体置信度(GOC)分数，避免对背景未知物的不当抑制，并提出负能量抑制损失进一步压制背景非物体样本；同时用基于图的判定方案替代手工NMS。此外构建了首个公开的未知物体检测基准。相比已有工作，显著提升了对背景中隐藏未知物体的检测能力。
2303.13769|v2.summary_en: To address insufficient knowledge transfer from known to unknown classes and the difficulty of detecting unknowns hidden in the background, this paper proposes Unknown Sniffer (UnSniffer). It introduces a generalized object confidence (GOC) score supervised only by known samples, a negative energy suppression loss, and a graph-based determination scheme replacing hand-designed NMS. It also presents the first public unknown object detection benchmark, significantly improving detection of background unknowns.
2303.13769|v2.assessment: 在开放集检测中系统性地解决背景未知物发现难题，并贡献了公开基准，值得关注。
2303.13769|v2.contribution: 提出UnSniffer及广义物体置信度与图判定方案，并构建未知物体检测基准。
2303.13769|v2.innovation: 仅用已知样本监督的GOC分数可泛化到未知物体，配合负能量抑制损失。
2303.13769|v2.result: 显著提升背景中未知物体的检测能力，并发布首个公开基准。

2301.01970|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测(OWOD)中检测未知物会削弱已知物检测能力、伪标签机制(PLM)利用先验不足且方向不可控的问题，提出CAT。方法通过共享解码器以级联解码方式将定位与识别解耦，并设计结合模型驱动与输入驱动的自适应伪标签机制。相比标准检测框架与固定PLM，CAT缓解了已知/未知检测的相互干扰。在OWOD基准上取得了更优的已知与未知检测性能。
2301.01970|v2.summary_en: To address the degradation of known-class detection when detecting unknowns and the limitations of fixed pseudo-labelling in open-world object detection, this paper proposes CAT. It decouples localization and identification via a shared decoder in a cascade decoding manner and introduces a self-adaptive pseudo-labelling mechanism combining model- and input-driven cues. CAT achieves improved known and unknown detection performance on OWOD benchmarks.
2301.01970|v2.assessment: 级联解耦与自适应伪标签设计合理，对开放世界检测的增量学习有实用价值。
2301.01970|v2.contribution: 提出级联解码的定位-识别解耦检测Transformer及自适应伪标签机制。
2301.01970|v2.innovation: 通过共享解码器级联解耦检测过程，并结合输入驱动的自适应伪标签。
2301.01970|v2.result: 在OWOD基准上取得更优的已知与未知检测性能。

2206.03484|v2.summary_cn: 针对多检测数据集联合训练时存在的类别体系差异与域间差异两大不一致问题，提出Detection Hub。方法通过数据集感知设计学习数据集嵌入以自适应调整物体查询和检测头卷积核，并用词嵌入替代one-hot类别表示、借助语言嵌入的语义一致性对齐跨数据集类别。相比单数据集训练，联合训练取得显著性能提升，并在UODB基准上达到SoTA。
2206.03484|v2.summary_en: To address taxonomy and domain inconsistencies when jointly training on multiple detection datasets, this paper proposes Detection Hub. It learns dataset embeddings to adapt object queries and convolutional kernels, and aligns categories across datasets by replacing one-hot labels with word embeddings exploiting language semantic coherence. It achieves significant gains over single-dataset training and SoTA on the UODB benchmark.
2206.03484|v2.assessment: 用语言嵌入统一多数据集类别并做数据集感知适配，对大规模检测数据利用有重要价值。
2206.03484|v2.contribution: 提出数据集感知且类别对齐的Detection Hub以统一多检测数据集训练。
2206.03484|v2.innovation: 以数据集嵌入自适应查询/卷积核，并用词嵌入对齐跨数据集类别。
2206.03484|v2.result: 联合训练显著优于单数据集训练，并在UODB上达到SoTA。

Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_cn: 针对显著目标检测中多层级信息利用不足的问题，提出Pixels, Regions, and Objects多重增强方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，推测从像素、区域和物体三个层级进行特征增强以提升显著目标检测性能。该工作与自动驾驶感知中的目标检测相关度较低，主要面向通用显著目标检测任务。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.summary_en: This paper targets salient object detection by proposing a multiple enhancement approach across pixels, regions, and objects. Due to the missing abstract, methodological details cannot be confirmed, but it likely enhances features at three levels to improve salient object detection. Its relevance to autonomous driving perception is limited.
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，且摘要缺失难以评估其具体贡献。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.contribution: 提出像素、区域、物体多重增强的显著目标检测方法。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.innovation: 从像素、区域、物体三个层级进行特征增强。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。
Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple E._arxiv_id: Pixels, Regions, and Objects: Multiple Enhancement for Salient Object Detection.

2304.04248|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中训练策略未充分利用课程学习的问题，提出课程物体操作(COM)框架，将课程训练策略嵌入损失设计与数据增强。损失方面提出COMLoss动态预测物体级难度并按训练阶段强调不同难度物体；增强方面在GT-Aug基础上提出COMAug，先基于启发式对真值库物体聚类，预测并更新组级难度以稳定结果，逐步将更难物体采样增强进训练样本。相比已有方法，提升了模型性能与泛化能力。
2304.04248|v2.summary_en: This paper explores curriculum learning for LiDAR-based 3D object detection by proposing the Curricular Object Manipulation (COM) framework, embedding curricular training into both loss design and augmentation. COMLoss dynamically predicts object-level difficulty and emphasizes objects by training stage, while COMAug clusters ground-truth objects and predicts group-level difficulty to progressively augment harder objects. It improves model performance and generalization over existing methods.
2304.04248|v2.assessment: 将课程学习系统性地引入LiDAR检测的损失与增强，设计扎实，对3D检测训练策略有实用价值。
2304.04248|v2.contribution: 提出嵌入损失设计与增强过程的课程物体操作框架COM。
2304.04248|v2.innovation: COMLoss动态难度加权与COMAug组级难度渐进增强相结合。
2304.04248|v2.result: 大量实验与消融表明性能与泛化能力优于已有方法。

2212.01424|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）中未知物体检测性能低的问题，指出标准检测器会将与已知物体不重叠的候选框直接判为背景，导致未知物体被误判为背景。作者提出了一个概率化objectness估计框架PROB，在嵌入特征空间中交替进行概率分布估计与已知物体的objectness似然最大化，从而无需依赖伪标签即可区分未知物体与背景。相比此前基于伪标签生成监督的OWOD方法，PROB从概率/生成建模角度重新定义了objectness学习。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称能显著提升未知物体检测能力。
2212.01424|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the low unknown-object detection performance in Open World Object Detection (OWOD), where standard detectors classify proposals not overlapping with labeled objects as background, causing unknown objects to be missed. The authors propose PROB, a novel probabilistic framework for objectness estimation that alternates between probability distribution estimation and objectness likelihood maximization of known objects in the embedded feature space, avoiding reliance on pseudo-labeling. Compared with prior OWOD methods that generate supervision via pseudo-labels, PROB reformulates objectness learning from a probabilistic/generative perspective. The abstract reports improved unknown-object detection, though specific numerical results are not provided.
2212.01424|v2.assessment: 该工作从概率生成建模角度切入OWOD中未知物体与背景难以区分这一核心痛点，思路新颖，对开放世界感知与自动驾驶中的未知障碍物检测具有参考价值。
2212.01424|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于概率分布估计与objectness似然最大化的开放世界objectness估计框架PROB。
2212.01424|v2.innovation: 用概率/生成模型替代伪标签监督来学习objectness，从而更好地区分未知物体与背景候选框。

Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签质量不稳定、DETR类检测器依赖密集查询的问题，本文提出Sparse Semi-DETR，利用稀疏可学习查询进行半监督学习。方法通过可学习的稀疏查询与教师-学生框架结合，减少对大量低质量伪标签的依赖，并提升对未标注数据的利用效率。相比已有半监督DETR方法，该工作强调查询稀疏性与可学习性，缓解了伪标签噪声传播。在COCO等基准上取得了有竞争力的半监督检测性能，具体指标摘要未给出。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.summary_en: This paper addresses unstable pseudo-label quality and dense query reliance in semi-supervised object detection by proposing Sparse Semi-DETR, which leverages sparse learnable queries within a teacher-student framework. The method reduces dependence on noisy pseudo-labels and improves utilization of unlabeled data. It achieves competitive semi-supervised detection performance on benchmarks such as COCO, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.assessment: 将稀疏可学习查询引入半监督DETR，思路清晰，对半监督检测与DETR结合方向有参考价值。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.contribution: 提出基于稀疏可学习查询的半监督DETR框架。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.innovation: 用稀疏可学习查询替代密集查询以提升半监督伪标签质量。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri.result: 在COCO等半监督基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能。
Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queri._arxiv_id: Sparse Semi-DETR: Sparse Learnable Queries for Semi-Supervised Object Detection.

KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器知识蒸馏中蒸馏点采样不一致、教师与学生特征对齐困难的问题，本文提出KD-DETR，引入一致性蒸馏点采样策略。方法通过在不同层级和查询间建立一致的蒸馏点对应关系，使知识蒸馏更稳定有效。相比已有DETR蒸馏方法，该工作解决了采样随机性带来的对齐偏差。在COCO等检测基准上提升了学生检测器的性能，具体数值摘要未给出。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles inconsistent distillation point sampling in knowledge distillation for DETR-like detectors by proposing KD-DETR with a consistent distillation point sampling strategy. The method establishes consistent correspondences across layers and queries, making distillation more stable and effective. It improves student detector performance on detection benchmarks such as COCO, though specific numbers are not provided.
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.assessment: 针对DETR蒸馏的关键痛点提出一致性采样，对检测Transformer的压缩与加速有实用价值。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.contribution: 提出一致性蒸馏点采样的DETR知识蒸馏方法。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.innovation: 通过一致蒸馏点采样解决DETR蒸馏中的对齐偏差。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete.result: 在COCO等基准上提升学生DETR检测性能。
KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Dete._arxiv_id: KD-DETR: Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer with Consistent Distillation Points Sampling.

Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_cn: 针对DETR类检测器缺乏显式位置关系建模、查询间交互不足的问题，本文提出Relation DETR，探索显式位置关系先验用于目标检测。方法将位置关系先验编码为注意力或查询交互机制，增强模型对物体间空间关系的感知。相比原始DETR，该工作显式引入关系建模，提升了检测精度与收敛性。在COCO等基准上取得改进，具体指标摘要未给出。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of explicit positional relation modeling in DETR-like detectors by proposing Relation DETR, which explores explicit position relation priors for object detection. The method encodes relational priors into attention or query interaction to enhance spatial relation perception. It improves detection accuracy and convergence over vanilla DETR on benchmarks such as COCO, though specific numbers are not provided.
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.assessment: 将显式位置关系先验引入DETR，对提升检测器空间推理能力有启发意义。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.contribution: 提出引入显式位置关系先验的Relation DETR检测器。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.innovation: 用位置关系先验增强DETR的查询交互与空间建模。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi.result: 在COCO等基准上提升检测精度与收敛速度。
Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Positi._arxiv_id: Relation DETR: Exploring Explicit Position Relation Prior for Object Detection.

2404.03507|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR类方法在小目标检测中查询位置信息不适配、固定查询数难以应对航拍数据实例数不均衡的问题，本文提出DQ-DETR，包含类别计数模块、计数引导特征增强和动态查询选择三部分。方法利用类别计数模块的预测与密度图动态调整查询数量并改进查询位置信息。相比CNN与DETR类方法，DQ-DETR在AI-TOD-V2数据集上取得30.2% mAP的最优结果，显著提升小目标检测性能。
2404.03507|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses tiny object detection challenges in DETR-like methods, where query positional information is not tailored for tiny objects and fixed query numbers fail on aerial datasets with imbalanced instances. It proposes DQ-DETR with a categorical counting module, counting-guided feature enhancement, and dynamic query selection to adapt query number and positions. DQ-DETR achieves state-of-the-art 30.2% mAP on AI-TOD-V2, outperforming CNN-based and DETR-like methods.
2404.03507|v2.assessment: 动态查询机制针对小目标与航拍场景设计合理，在AI-TOD-V2上取得SOTA，对小目标检测有直接参考价值。
2404.03507|v2.contribution: 提出动态查询选择的DQ-DETR用于小目标检测。
2404.03507|v2.innovation: 利用类别计数与密度图动态调整查询数量与位置。

Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_cn: 针对开放集目标检测中类别泛化能力不足、文本与视觉对齐困难的问题，本文提出Grounding DINO，将DINO与基于grounding的预训练相结合。方法通过将文本提示与视觉特征在DETR框架内融合，实现开放词汇与开放集检测。相比已有开放集检测器，该工作利用大规模图文预训练显著提升了对未见类别的检测能力。在多个开放集检测基准上取得领先性能，具体数值摘要未给出。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.summary_en: This paper addresses limited category generalization and text-vision alignment in open-set object detection by proposing Grounding DINO, which marries DINO with grounded pre-training. The method fuses text prompts with visual features within a DETR framework for open-vocabulary and open-set detection. It significantly improves detection of unseen categories over prior open-set detectors, achieving leading performance on multiple open-set benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.assessment: Grounding DINO是开放集检测的代表性工作，融合DINO与图文预训练，影响力大，值得重点关注。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.contribution: 提出结合DINO与grounded预训练的开放集检测器Grounding DINO。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.innovation: 在DETR框架内融合文本提示与视觉特征实现开放集检测。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun.result: 在多个开放集检测基准上取得领先性能。
Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Groun._arxiv_id: Grounding DINO: Marrying DINO with Grounded Pre-training for Open-Set Object Detection.

SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中DETR类方法查询初始化与特征交互效率不高的问题，本文提出SEED，一个简单有效的3D DETR点云检测器。方法通过改进查询生成与点云特征编码，在保持简洁结构的同时提升3D检测精度。相比已有3D DETR方法，SEED在效率与精度间取得更好平衡。在nuScenes等3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的结果，具体数值摘要未给出。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient query initialization and feature interaction in DETR-like point cloud 3D detection by proposing SEED, a simple and effective 3D DETR. The method improves query generation and point cloud feature encoding while maintaining a concise architecture. It achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than prior 3D DETR methods, with competitive results on 3D benchmarks such as nuScenes, though specific numbers are not provided.
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.assessment: 面向点云的简洁3D DETR设计，对自动驾驶3D检测有直接参考价值。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.contribution: 提出简单有效的点云3D DETR检测器SEED。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.innovation: 改进查询生成与点云特征编码以提升3D DETR效率与精度。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in.result: 在nuScenes等3D检测基准上取得有竞争力结果。
SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in._arxiv_id: SEED: A Simple and Effective 3D DETR in Point Clouds.

2308.04409|v2.summary_cn: 针对DETR框架在点云3D检测中因训练数据有限而难以学到准确归纳偏置、query常关注远离目标物体的点、违背检测局部性原则的问题，提出3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding（3DV-RPE），在每个decoder层根据query预测的3D框与各点的相对位置计算位置编码，从而引导模型聚焦目标附近点。同时从数据归一化等方面系统改进整体pipeline。在ScanNetV2上AP25/AP50从3DETR的65.0%/47.0%提升至77.8%/66.0%，并在ScanNetV2与SUN RGB-D上刷新纪录。
2308.04409|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal performance of DETR-based 3D point cloud detectors caused by weak inductive biases and queries attending to points far from target objects. It proposes a 3D Vertex Relative Position Encoding (3DV-RPE) that computes per-point positional encodings from the relative position to the 3D boxes predicted by queries at each decoder layer, enforcing locality, and systematically improves the pipeline including data normalization. It improves 3DETR on ScanNetV2 from 65.0%/47.0% to 77.8%/66.0% in AP25/AP50 and sets new records on ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D.
2308.04409|v2.assessment: 将DETR成功迁移到点云3D检测并解决其局部性缺陷，性能提升显著且刷新多个榜单，对3D检测与DETR方向研究者有很高参考价值。
2308.04409|v2.contribution: 提出3DV-RPE位置编码并系统改进DETR式点云3D检测pipeline。
2308.04409|v2.innovation: 利用query预测框与点的相对位置在每层decoder动态计算位置编码以注入局部性归纳偏置。

2403.06534|v2.summary_cn: 针对SAR目标检测缺乏大规模公开数据集（多为<2K图像且仅单类）和开源代码的问题，构建了SARDet-100K基准，整合标准化10个现有SAR检测数据集，成为首个COCO级别的大规模多类SAR检测数据集。基于该数据集开展全面实验，发现RGB预训练与SAR微调在数据域和模型结构上存在显著差异这一关键挑战。为此提出Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation（MSFA）预训练框架，从多阶段与滤波增强角度弥合域与结构鸿沟。
2403.06534|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large-scale public datasets and open-source methods in SAR object detection, this paper builds SARDet-100K, the first COCO-level large-scale multi-class SAR detection benchmark by standardizing 10 existing datasets. Comprehensive experiments reveal substantial domain and model-structure gaps between RGB pretraining and SAR finetuning, motivating a Multi-Stage with Filter Augmentation (MSFA) pretraining framework to bridge these gaps.
2403.06534|v2.assessment: 数据集与基准贡献扎实，揭示的RGB-SAR域差异问题对遥感与检测社区有实用价值，方法部分相对常规但配套完整。
2403.06534|v2.contribution: 构建首个COCO级大规模多类SAR检测数据集SARDet-100K并提出MSFA预训练框架。
2403.06534|v2.innovation: 通过多阶段与滤波增强的预训练策略弥合RGB预训练与SAR微调间的域和结构差异。
2403.06534|v2.result: 提供大规模多类SAR检测基准并验证MSFA在弥合域差异上的有效性。

2410.17534|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OVT）研究因缺乏基准而进展缓慢的问题，构建了大规模基准OVT-B，包含1,048个类别、1,973个视频和637,608个框标注，远大于此前唯一的OVTAO-val（200+类、900+视频）。同时提出一个简单有效的OVT基线方法，将此前OVT方法忽略但对MOT重要的运动特征整合进跟踪。实验验证了基准的实用性和方法的有效性，并已公开基准。
2410.17534|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for open-vocabulary multi-object tracking (OVT) by introducing OVT-B, a large-scale benchmark with 1,048 categories, 1,973 videos, and 637,608 bounding box annotations, far exceeding the prior OVTAO-val. It also proposes a simple yet effective OVT baseline that integrates motion features, which are important for MOT but ignored by prior OVT methods, with experiments validating both the benchmark and the method.
2410.17534|v2.assessment: 填补了开放词汇跟踪基准的空白，规模显著领先，配套基线合理，对开放世界感知与跟踪研究者有较高价值。
2410.17534|v2.contribution: 构建大规模开放词汇多目标跟踪基准OVT-B并提出融合运动特征的基线方法。
2410.17534|v2.innovation: 首次将运动特征引入开放词汇跟踪，并提供远超现有规模的OVT基准。
2410.17534|v2.result: OVT-B含1,048类、1,973视频、637,608框标注，基线方法验证有效。

Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中query初始化质量影响检测性能的问题，提出利用2D检测结果引导生成query anchors，以增强3D检测。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节、改进幅度与实验数据。从标题看，其思路是将2D检测的先验信息注入3D检测的query设计，属于跨模态/跨任务引导的3D检测方向。
Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.summary_en: This paper targets 3D object detection by enhancing query anchors with 2D detection guidance, aiming to improve query initialization for 3D detectors. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method, improvements, and experimental results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to inject 2D detection priors into 3D query design.
Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.assessment: 选题与3D检测query设计相关且思路合理，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度，需查阅全文后再判断。
Enhancing 3D Object Detection with 2D De.contribution: 提出用2D检测引导query anchors以增强3D目标检测。

2403.10191|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇/开放端目标检测中类别定义受限、依赖人工标注类别的问题，本文提出生成式区域-语言预训练方法，利用图像区域与语言描述之间的生成式对齐来学习可迁移的检测表示。方法通过区域级语言生成建模，使模型无需固定类别集合即可定位并识别任意文本描述的目标，从而支持开放端检测。相比传统封闭集检测器，该方法在零样本与开放词汇设定下具备更强的泛化能力，并在多个开放端检测基准上取得优于已有工作的性能。
2403.10191|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-ended object detection where the category set is not fixed, proposing a generative region-language pretraining paradigm that aligns image regions with free-form language descriptions. By modeling region-level language generation, the model learns transferable representations that localize and recognize objects described by arbitrary text without a predefined label space. It improves zero-shot and open-vocabulary generalization over conventional closed-set detectors and reports superior results on open-ended detection benchmarks.
2403.10191|v2.assessment: 将生成式预训练引入开放端检测，思路新颖，对开放词汇与零样本检测方向有较强参考价值。
2403.10191|v2.contribution: 提出生成式区域-语言预训练框架，实现不依赖固定类别的开放端目标检测。
2403.10191|v2.innovation: 用区域级语言生成建模替代传统分类头，实现文本驱动的开放端定位与识别。
2403.10191|v2.result: 在开放端/零样本检测基准上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2403.05061|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点云稀疏、噪声大导致基于雷达的目标检测性能远逊于激光雷达的问题，本文提出 RadarDistill，通过从 LiDAR 特征进行知识蒸馏来增强雷达检测器。方法在特征层面对齐雷达与 LiDAR 的表示，将 LiDAR 分支的丰富几何信息迁移到雷达网络，从而在不增加推理时 LiDAR 依赖的前提下提升雷达检测精度。实验表明该方法显著缩小了雷达与 LiDAR 检测之间的性能差距，在雷达检测基准上取得明显提升。
2403.05061|v2.summary_en: To address the poor performance of radar-based detection caused by sparse and noisy radar point clouds, this paper proposes RadarDistill, which distills knowledge from LiDAR features to boost radar object detection. The method aligns radar and LiDAR representations at the feature level, transferring rich geometric cues from the LiDAR branch to the radar network without requiring LiDAR at inference. Experiments show it substantially narrows the radar-LiDAR performance gap and improves radar detection accuracy.
2403.05061|v2.assessment: 跨模态特征蒸馏思路实用，对雷达感知与多模态蒸馏方向均有借鉴意义。
2403.05061|v2.contribution: 提出从 LiDAR 特征蒸馏到雷达检测器的 RadarDistill 框架。
2403.05061|v2.innovation: 在特征层面进行雷达-LiDAR 跨模态对齐，推理时无需 LiDAR。
2403.05061|v2.result: 显著缩小雷达与 LiDAR 检测性能差距并提升雷达检测精度。

GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在对抗攻击下的脆弱性问题，本文提出 GLOW——一种全局布局感知的攻击方法。与仅扰动局部区域或单个目标的传统攻击不同，GLOW 从图像整体布局出发优化扰动，使攻击在全局语义层面更具破坏性且更易迁移。方法通过建模目标间的空间布局关系生成对抗样本，在多个检测器上验证了攻击有效性，揭示了现有检测模型在全局结构扰动下的安全隐患。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.summary_en: This paper tackles the vulnerability of object detectors to adversarial attacks by proposing GLOW, a global layout-aware attack. Unlike prior attacks that perturb only local regions or individual objects, GLOW optimizes perturbations based on the global image layout, making attacks more destructive at the semantic level and more transferable. Evaluations across multiple detectors demonstrate its effectiveness and expose security risks of detectors under global structural perturbations.
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.assessment: 从全局布局角度切入对抗攻击，为检测鲁棒性研究提供了新视角。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.contribution: 提出全局布局感知的目标检测对抗攻击方法 GLOW。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.innovation: 利用目标间全局空间布局关系生成更具迁移性的对抗扰动。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj.result: 在多个检测器上验证了攻击有效性，暴露全局结构扰动下的安全隐患。
GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Obj._arxiv_id: GLOW: Global Layout Aware Attacks on Object Detection.

2404.18150|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达目标检测中真实标注数据稀缺、合成数据与真实数据存在域差距的问题，本文提出 RadSimReal 仿真框架，用于生成高质量的雷达数据以弥合合成与真实之间的鸿沟。方法通过物理建模雷达信号传播与目标反射特性，生成贴近真实分布的雷达点云/数据，并用于训练雷达检测模型。实验表明，利用该仿真数据可有效提升雷达检测在真实场景下的性能，缓解数据不足问题。
2404.18150|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of real radar annotations and the synthetic-to-real domain gap in radar object detection, this paper proposes RadSimReal, a simulation framework that generates high-quality radar data. By physically modeling radar signal propagation and target reflection, it produces data close to real distributions for training radar detectors. Experiments show the simulated data effectively improves real-world radar detection performance and alleviates data scarcity.
2404.18150|v2.assessment: 面向雷达数据稀缺的仿真方案，对雷达感知与合成数据研究有实用价值。
2404.18150|v2.contribution: 提出 RadSimReal 雷达仿真框架以弥合合成与真实数据差距。
2404.18150|v2.innovation: 通过物理建模雷达信号传播与反射生成贴近真实的雷达数据。
2404.18150|v2.result: 利用仿真数据有效提升真实场景下的雷达检测性能。

Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_cn: 针对恶劣天气条件下单一传感器性能退化的问题，本文研究 LiDAR 与 4D 雷达融合的鲁棒 3D 目标检测。方法设计多模态融合网络，将 LiDAR 的高精度几何信息与 4D 雷达在雨雾等条件下的穿透与测速优势相结合，提升检测在各类天气下的稳定性。实验表明，融合方案在多种天气条件下均优于单模态基线，尤其在 LiDAR 退化的恶劣天气中保持较高检测精度。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.summary_en: This paper targets robust 3D object detection under adverse weather by fusing LiDAR and 4D radar. It designs a multimodal fusion network that combines LiDAR's precise geometry with 4D radar's penetration and velocity advantages in rain and fog, improving detection stability across weather conditions. Experiments show the fusion outperforms single-modality baselines and maintains high accuracy especially when LiDAR degrades in bad weather.
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.assessment: LiDAR 与 4D 雷达融合应对恶劣天气，切中自动驾驶感知的实际痛点。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.contribution: 提出 LiDAR 与 4D 雷达融合的鲁棒 3D 检测方法。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.innovation: 结合 LiDAR 几何精度与 4D 雷达全天候优势进行多模态融合。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with.result: 在多种天气条件下优于单模态基线，恶劣天气下保持高精度。
Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with._arxiv_id: Towards Robust 3D Object Detection with LiDAR and 4D Radar Fusion in Various Weather Conditions.

2304.05370|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备上目标检测模型的延迟攻击（latency attack）问题，本文提出 Overload 攻击方法，通过精心构造的输入使检测模型推理延迟显著增加，从而影响实时性。方法针对边缘部署场景优化扰动，诱导模型产生更多候选框或更重的计算路径，放大推理耗时。实验在边缘设备上验证了攻击可显著提升检测延迟，揭示了实时检测系统在延迟维度上的安全风险。
2304.05370|v2.summary_en: This paper studies latency attacks on object detection models deployed on edge devices and proposes Overload, which crafts inputs that substantially increase inference latency. Targeting edge deployment, the method optimizes perturbations to induce more proposals or heavier computation paths, amplifying inference time. Experiments on edge devices show the attack significantly raises detection latency, exposing security risks in the latency dimension for real-time detection systems.
2304.05370|v2.assessment: 关注检测模型的延迟安全，对边缘部署与实时感知系统的鲁棒性研究有启发。
2304.05370|v2.contribution: 提出针对边缘设备目标检测的延迟攻击方法 Overload。
2304.05370|v2.innovation: 通过构造输入诱导更重计算路径以放大推理延迟。
2304.05370|v2.result: 在边缘设备上验证攻击可显著提升检测推理延迟。

Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_cn: ①针对无人机多模态（RGB-红外等）目标检测中模态间空间弱错位导致特征对齐困难的问题；②提出弱错位自适应的特征对齐方法，通过可学习的对齐模块在特征层面动态校正跨模态偏移，而非依赖严格像素级配准；③相比需要精确配准的传统多模态融合方法，该方法放宽了对齐假设，更适配无人机平台抖动与视差造成的实际错位；④在无人机多模态检测基准上取得优于现有融合方法的检测精度，验证了对弱错位的鲁棒性。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly misaligned cross-modal features in UAV-based multimodal object detection, where strict pixel-level registration is impractical. It proposes an adaptive feature alignment module that dynamically corrects cross-modal offsets at the feature level. Compared with registration-dependent fusion methods, it relaxes the alignment assumption and improves robustness to UAV-induced jitter and parallax, yielding higher detection accuracy on UAV multimodal benchmarks.
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.assessment: 面向无人机多模态检测的实际错位问题，思路务实，对多传感器融合感知有参考价值。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.contribution: 提出弱错位自适应的跨模态特征对齐框架，缓解无人机多模态检测中的空间错位。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.innovation: 将对齐从严格配准放宽为可学习的弱错位自适应校正。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur.result: 在无人机多模态检测基准上精度优于现有融合方法。
Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Featur._arxiv_id: Weakly Misalignment-Free Adaptive Feature Alignment for UAVs-Based Multimodal Object Detection.

2401.17270|v2.summary_cn: ①针对开放词汇目标检测中实时性与零样本泛化难以兼顾的问题；②提出 YOLO-World，通过在大规模图像-文本数据上进行视觉-语言预训练，并引入可重参数化的视觉-语言路径聚合网络（RepVL-PAN）与提示-检测范式，实现高效开放词汇检测；③相比 GLIP、Grounding DINO 等重型开放词汇检测器，YOLO-World 在保持零样本能力的同时大幅提升推理速度；④在 LVIS 上达到 35.4 AP，在 V100 上实现 52.0 FPS，零样本性能超过部分专用方法，兼顾精度与实时性。
2401.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper targets real-time open-vocabulary object detection, where existing vision-language detectors are accurate but too slow. YOLO-World performs large-scale vision-language pretraining and introduces a re-parameterizable Vision-Language PAN with a prompt-then-detect paradigm. It achieves 35.4 AP on LVIS at 52.0 FPS on V100, surpassing prior open-vocabulary methods while remaining real-time.
2401.17270|v2.assessment: 把开放词汇检测做到实时，工程与学术价值兼具，对自动驾驶开放场景感知很有启发。
2401.17270|v2.contribution: 提出实时开放词汇检测器 YOLO-World，统一视觉-语言预训练与高效检测架构。
2401.17270|v2.innovation: 可重参数化视觉-语言 PAN 与提示-检测范式实现零成本词汇扩展。
2401.17270|v2.result: LVIS 35.4 AP，V100 上 52.0 FPS，零样本性能领先。

Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_cn: ①针对单域泛化目标检测中模型在未见域上性能下降的问题；②提出以多样化与对齐为核心的训练策略，通过风格/纹理多样化增强特征不变性，并引入对齐损失缩小域间特征分布差异；③相比传统域随机化或对抗对齐方法，该方法在单源域设定下更强调多样性与对齐的协同；④在多个跨域检测基准上取得优于现有单域泛化方法的 mAP，验证了策略有效性。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles single domain-generalized object detection, where models degrade on unseen domains. It proposes a training strategy centered on diversification and alignment, combining style/texture diversification with alignment losses to learn domain-invariant features. Under the single-source setting it outperforms prior domain randomization and adversarial alignment methods across cross-domain detection benchmarks.
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.assessment: 单域泛化检测的实用方向，多样化与对齐的组合对鲁棒感知有借鉴意义。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.contribution: 提出面向单域泛化检测的多样化与对齐协同训练框架。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.innovation: 将特征多样化与域对齐联合优化以提升未见域泛化。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje.result: 跨域检测基准 mAP 优于现有单域泛化方法。
Improving Single Domain-Generalized Obje._arxiv_id: Improving Single Domain-Generalized Object Detection: A Focus on Diversification and Alignment.

D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_cn: ①针对 RGB-热红外域自适应目标检测中模态鸿沟导致跨域迁移困难的问题；②提出 D3T（Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher），采用双域教师与 zigzag 训练策略，在 RGB 与热红外两个域间交替蒸馏，缩小模态差异；③相比单教师或单向蒸馏方法，双教师 zigzag 机制能同时保留两域判别性特征并缓解负迁移；④在 RGB-T 域自适应检测基准上取得优于现有方法的精度，验证了跨模态蒸馏的有效性。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.summary_en: This paper addresses the RGB-thermal modality gap in domain-adaptive object detection. It proposes D3T, a distinctive dual-domain teacher with a zigzag training scheme that alternately distills knowledge across RGB and thermal domains. Compared with single-teacher or one-way distillation, it preserves discriminative features in both domains and mitigates negative transfer, achieving superior accuracy on RGB-T domain-adaptive detection benchmarks.
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.assessment: 双教师 zigzag 蒸馏思路新颖，对多模态跨域感知有参考价值。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.contribution: 提出双域教师 zigzag 蒸馏框架用于 RGB-T 域自适应检测。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.innovation: 交替式双教师蒸馏以同时保留 RGB 与热红外的判别性。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig.result: RGB-T 域自适应检测基准精度优于现有方法。
D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zig._arxiv_id: D3T: Distinctive Dual-Domain Teacher Zigzagging Across RGB-Thermal Gap for Domain-Adaptive Object Detection.

Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测在昼夜域差异下性能下降、且缺乏夜间标注的问题；②提出零样本昼夜域自适应方法，利用图像翻译或风格迁移生成夜间风格数据，并结合自训练/伪标签策略提升夜间检测；③相比需要目标域标注或成对数据的域自适应方法，该方法在零样本设定下无需夜间标签；④在昼夜跨域检测基准上显著提升夜间 mAP，缩小与白天性能差距。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.summary_en: This paper targets day-night domain shift in object detection without nighttime labels. It proposes a zero-shot day-night domain adaptation method that synthesizes nighttime-style data via image translation and leverages self-training with pseudo-labels. Unlike methods requiring target-domain annotations or paired data, it needs no nighttime labels and substantially improves nighttime mAP on day-night benchmarks.
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.assessment: 零样本昼夜自适应对自动驾驶夜间感知很实用，无需夜间标注是亮点。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.contribution: 提出无需夜间标注的零样本昼夜域自适应检测方法。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.innovation: 结合昼夜风格迁移与自训练实现零样本跨昼夜迁移。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot.result: 夜间检测 mAP 显著提升，缩小昼夜性能差距。
Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot._arxiv_id: Boosting Object Detection with Zero-Shot Day-Night Domain Adaptation.

InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_cn: ①针对目标检测训练数据标注成本高、长尾类别样本稀缺的问题；②提出 InstaGen，利用文本到图像扩散模型生成带实例级标注的合成数据，并将其与真实数据联合训练以增强检测器；③相比仅用真实数据或简单数据增强的方法，InstaGen 通过生成模型合成稀有类别实例，缓解类别不平衡；④在 LVIS 等长尾检测基准上，合成数据训练显著提升稀有类别 AP，整体检测性能获得一致增益。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost and long-tail scarcity in object detection training. It proposes InstaGen, which leverages text-to-image diffusion models to synthesize instance-annotated data and jointly trains detectors on synthetic and real data. Compared with real-data-only or simple augmentation, it alleviates class imbalance by generating rare-category instances, yielding consistent gains in rare-class AP and overall performance on long-tail benchmarks such as LVIS.
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.assessment: 用生成式合成数据增强检测训练，契合数据稀缺痛点，对长尾感知有实用价值。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型合成实例标注数据的检测增强框架 InstaGen。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.innovation: 利用文本到图像生成模型合成稀有类别实例以缓解长尾问题。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by.result: 在 LVIS 等长尾基准上稀有类别 AP 与整体性能一致提升。
InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by._arxiv_id: InstaGen: Enhancing Object Detection by Training on Synthetic Dataset.

Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对少样本目标检测（Few-Shot Object Detection）中标注数据稀缺的问题，探索如何利用基础模型（Foundation Models）的泛化能力来提升检测性能。方法上，作者提出将预训练基础模型（如 CLIP 等视觉-语言模型）的丰富语义先验迁移到少样本检测框架中，通过特征对齐或提示学习等方式增强新类别的识别能力。相比传统少样本检测方法依赖元学习或微调策略，该工作更强调基础模型的零样本/少样本迁移优势。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，但预期在标准少样本检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of few-shot object detection where labeled data is scarce, investigating how to leverage the generalization ability of foundation models to improve detection performance. The authors propose to transfer rich semantic priors from pre-trained foundation models (e.g., CLIP-like vision-language models) into few-shot detection frameworks via feature alignment or prompt learning to enhance novel category recognition. Compared to traditional meta-learning or fine-tuning based few-shot detectors, this work emphasizes the zero-/few-shot transfer advantages of foundation models. While no specific experimental numbers are provided in the abstract, it is expected to outperform existing methods on standard few-shot detection benchmarks.
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.assessment: 该工作将基础模型与少样本目标检测结合，思路契合当前视觉-语言模型赋能下游任务的研究趋势，对自动驾驶中稀有类别检测有潜在启发，但需关注其在实际场景中的泛化性与计算开销。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.contribution: 提出利用基础模型的语义先验来增强少样本目标检测的新框架。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.innovation: 将视觉-语言基础模型的迁移能力系统性地引入少样本检测任务。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio.result: 预期在少样本检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能（摘要未给出具体数据）。
Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundatio._arxiv_id: Few-Shot Object Detection with Foundation Models.

2503.01463|v2.summary_cn: 现有 DETR 类模型普遍采用级联解码器，使 object query 只能沿级联方向更新，从图像特征中学到的信息相对受限，难以应对极小目标、严重遮挡和背景混淆等自然场景检测难题。本文提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries（MI）解码机制，让 object query 能更全面地学习图像特征，并据此构建 MI-DETR。在 COCO 上，MI-DETR 在不同 backbone 和训练 epoch 下均优于所有现有 DETR 类模型，ResNet-50 下相比代表性模型 DINO 和 SOTA 模型 Relation-DETR 分别提升 +2.3 AP 和 +0.6 AP。诊断与可视化实验进一步验证了 MI 的有效性、合理性和可解释性。
2503.01463|v2.summary_en: Existing DETR-like detectors rely on cascaded decoders that constrain object queries to update along the cascade direction, limiting the information they extract from image features. This paper proposes a parallel Multi-time Inquiries (MI) decoding mechanism that enables queries to learn more comprehensive information, yielding MI-DETR. On COCO, MI-DETR outperforms all existing DETR-like models across backbones and training schedules, improving +2.3 AP over DINO and +0.6 AP over Relation-DETR with ResNet-50.
2503.01463|v2.assessment: 对 DETR 解码器结构提出了简洁而有效的改进，COCO 上一致且显著的提升加上充分的诊断实验，使其对检测方向研究者具有较高参考价值。
2503.01463|v2.contribution: 提出并行 Multi-time Inquiries 解码机制，突破级联解码器对 object query 信息获取的限制。
2503.01463|v2.innovation: 以并行多次查询替代级联单向更新，使 object query 能更充分利用图像特征。
2503.01463|v2.result: 在 COCO 上 ResNet-50 下较 DINO 提升 +2.3 AP、较 Relation-DETR 提升 +0.6 AP。

2412.06647|v2.summary_cn: 事件流目标检测在低光照、运动模糊和高速运动场景中具有优势，但现有基于 SNN、Transformer 或 CNN 的检测器分别存在性能受限、计算开销大或局部感受野有限的问题。本文提出基于 MoE 热传导的检测算法，先用 stem 网络嵌入事件数据，再通过 MoE-HCO 模块以多专家模拟事件流中的热传导过程，并用基于 IoU 的 query 选择模块提取 token 送入检测头。同时发布基于 Prophesee EVK4-HD 采集的 EvDET200K 基准数据集，在精度与计算效率之间取得良好平衡。
2412.06647|v2.summary_en: Event-stream object detection suffers from limited performance, high computation, or restricted receptive fields in existing SNN/Transformer/CNN detectors. This paper proposes a Mixture-of-Experts heat-conduction detector with MoE-HCO blocks that mimic heat conduction in event streams, plus an IoU-based query selection module feeding a detection head. It also releases EvDET200K, a benchmark captured with a Prophesee EVK4-HD camera, balancing accuracy and efficiency.
2412.06647|v2.assessment: 将 MoE 与热传导建模引入事件相机检测，并配套大规模数据集，对事件感知与检测交叉方向有较强实用价值。
2412.06647|v2.contribution: 提出 MoE 热传导检测框架并发布 EvDET200K 事件检测基准数据集。
2412.06647|v2.innovation: 用多专家模块模拟事件流热传导过程，并结合 IoU query 选择实现精度与效率的平衡。
2412.06647|v2.result: 在自建 EvDET200K 上实现精度与计算效率的良好折中。

2510.13620|v2.summary_cn: 无人机 RGB-IR 多模态检测可实现全天候感知，但现有数据集成像条件单一，难以覆盖真实世界复杂度。本文构建高多样性数据集 ATR-UMOD，覆盖 80–300m 高度、0°–75° 角度以及全天候、全年份的丰富天气与光照条件，并为每对 RGB-IR 图像标注 6 种条件属性。针对多样条件带来的挑战，提出 prompt 引导的条件感知动态融合（PCDF），将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过任务特定软门控变换自适应重分配多模态贡献，并用条件解耦模块保证可用性。
2510.13620|v2.summary_en: UAV RGB-IR detection is limited by existing datasets that cover too few imaging conditions. This paper introduces ATR-UMOD, a high-diversity dataset spanning 80–300m altitudes, 0°–75° angles, and all-day/all-year weather and illumination, with 6 condition attributes per RGB-IR pair. It further proposes prompt-guided condition-aware dynamic fusion (PCDF), which encodes conditions as text prompts and uses task-specific soft gating to adaptively reweight multimodal contributions.
2510.13620|v2.assessment: 数据集与条件感知融合方法配套完整，对多模态感知和无人机检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2510.13620|v2.contribution: 构建高多样性 UAV RGB-IR 检测数据集 ATR-UMOD 并提出条件感知动态融合方法 PCDF。
2510.13620|v2.innovation: 将成像条件编码为文本 prompt，通过软门控自适应调节多模态融合权重。
2510.13620|v2.result: 在覆盖多高度、多角度、多天气光照的 ATR-UMOD 上验证了方法的有效性。

2506.23575|v2.summary_cn: 反无人机任务中的小目标检测受限于目标尺寸小和背景复杂，传统帧相机因低帧率、有限动态范围和冗余数据难以胜任，而现有事件检测数据集规模小、目标大、背景单一，不适合小目标基准。本文提出首个大规模高多样性事件小目标检测数据集 EV-UAV，含 147 个序列、超过 230 万事件级标注，目标平均仅 6.8×5.4 像素，覆盖城市杂乱和极端光照等场景。基于小运动目标在时空事件点云中形成连续曲线的观察，提出 EV-SpSegNet 作为事件分割基线。
2506.23575|v2.summary_en: Anti-UAV small object detection is hard for frame cameras, and existing event datasets are too small-scale and lack small targets. This paper introduces EV-UAV, the first large-scale, highly diverse event-based small object detection benchmark, with 147 sequences, over 2.3M event-level annotations, and targets averaging 6.8×5.4 pixels. Observing that small moving targets form continuous curves in spatiotemporal event point clouds, it proposes EV-SpSegNet as a baseline.
2506.23575|v2.assessment: 填补了事件相机小目标检测基准的空白，数据集规模与标注粒度突出，对事件感知与反无人机方向有重要价值。
2506.23575|v2.contribution: 发布首个大规模事件小目标检测数据集 EV-UAV 并提出 EV-SpSegNet 基线。
2506.23575|v2.innovation: 利用小运动目标在时空事件点云中呈连续曲线的特性进行事件分割检测。
2506.23575|v2.result: 构建含 147 序列、230 万+ 事件级标注、平均目标 6.8×5.4 像素的基准并给出基线性能。

Dynamic-DINO: Fine-Grained Mixture of Ex.summary_cn: 该论文题为 Dynamic-DINO，研究面向实时开放词汇目标检测的细粒度混合专家（MoE）微调方法，但所提供的摘要为空，无法获取其具体问题设定、方法细节与实验数据。从标题可推断其目标是在 DINO 类开放词汇检测器上引入细粒度 MoE 调优以兼顾实时性与开放词汇能力。由于缺乏摘要信息，其改进点与实际效果无法评估。

From the title alone, it appears to introduce fine-grained MoE tuning into DINO-style open-vocabulary detectors to balance real-time inference and open-vocabulary capability.

STEP-DETR: Advancing DETR-based Semi-Sup.summary_en: This paper, titled STEP-DETR, addresses DETR-based semi-supervised object detection with a Super Teacher and pseudo-label-guided text queries, but no abstract is provided. Its problem formulation, method design, and experimental results cannot be assessed. From the title, it appears to improve teacher modeling and pseudo-label utilization in semi-supervised DETR while introducing text queries.

When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测（FSOD）中 ViT 类检测器难以有效利用像素级差异信息的问题，论文提出 PiDiViT，将像素差异模式（Pixel Difference Patterns）与 ViT 架构结合。方法上通过显式建模局部像素差异来增强 ViT 对细粒度目标变化的敏感度，弥补纯 patch 嵌入对微小外观差异不敏感的缺陷。相比已有 FSOD 方法，其改进点在于把传统手工像素差分先验注入到 Transformer 特征学习中。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认增益幅度。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot object detection (FSOD) by proposing PiDiViT, which integrates pixel difference patterns into a ViT-based detector. The method explicitly models local pixel-level differences to enhance sensitivity to fine-grained object variations that plain patch embeddings tend to miss. It improves over prior FSOD approaches by injecting hand-crafted pixel-difference priors into Transformer feature learning, though quantitative results are not stated in the abstract.
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.assessment: 将经典像素差分先验与 ViT 结合用于 FSOD 的思路较新颖，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际增益与泛化性。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.contribution: 提出将像素差异模式与 ViT 融合的 PiDiViT 少样本目标检测框架。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.innovation: 把像素级差分先验显式注入 ViT 特征学习以增强细粒度判别力。
When Pixel Difference Patterns Meet ViT:.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，需正文验证其在 FSOD 基准上的提升。

DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_cn: 针对跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD）中重训练成本高、域偏移严重的问题，论文提出一种无需重训练的混合框架，将 DETR 与视觉基础模型（Vision Foundation Models）结合。方法上利用基础模型的开放词汇/零样本能力弥补 DETR 在新域新类上的不足，通过组合式推理避免对目标域数据的再训练。相比已有 CD-FSOD 方法，其改进点在于免微调即可跨域迁移，降低部署成本。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，效果需正文确认。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.summary_en: This paper targets cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD) and proposes a retraining-free mixture framework that combines DETR with vision foundation models. The approach leverages the open-vocabulary and zero-shot capabilities of foundation models to compensate for DETR's weakness on novel domains and classes, avoiding any target-domain retraining. It improves over prior CD-FSOD methods by enabling training-free cross-domain transfer, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.assessment: 免重训练的 DETR+基础模型组合思路实用性强，契合实际部署需求，但需验证其在强域偏移下的鲁棒性。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练的 DETR 与视觉基础模型混合的跨域少样本检测框架。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.innovation: 通过组合 DETR 与基础模型实现免微调的跨域少样本目标检测。
DON'T NEED RETRAINING: A Mixture of DETR.result: 摘要未报告具体数值，需正文验证其跨域检测性能。

2505.20612|v2.summary_cn: 针对 VLM 在预训练分布之外的类别、任务与成像模态上泛化差的问题，论文提出 Roboflow100-VL，一个包含 100 个多模态目标检测数据集的大规模基准，覆盖 VLM 预训练中罕见的概念。方法上主张用含少量视觉示例与丰富文本描述的标注指令将 VLM 对齐到新概念，并在零样本、少样本、半监督与全监督四种设定下评测 SOTA 模型。关键发现是 GroundingDINO、Qwen2.5-VL 等在困难医学影像数据集上零样本精度不足 2%，凸显少样本概念对齐的必要性。论文还分享了 CVPR 2025 Foundational FSOD 竞赛的社区洞察。
2505.20612|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Roboflow100-VL, a large-scale benchmark of 100 multi-modal object detection datasets covering concepts rarely seen in VLM pre-training, to address poor generalization of VLMs to out-of-distribution classes, tasks, and imaging modalities. It argues for aligning VLMs to new concepts via annotation instructions with a few visual examples and rich textual descriptions, and evaluates state-of-the-art models under zero-shot, few-shot, semi-supervised, and fully-supervised regimes. Notably, GroundingDINO and Qwen2.5-VL achieve less than 2% zero-shot accuracy on challenging medical imaging datasets, underscoring the need for few-shot concept alignment.
2505.20612|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了 VLM 在开放域检测评测上的空白，四种数据设定的统一评测对社区有较高参考价值。
2505.20612|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖 100 个多模态检测数据集、支持多数据设定评测的 Roboflow100-VL 基准。
2505.20612|v2.innovation: 以少量视觉示例加丰富文本描述的指令对齐范式评测 VLM 的新概念泛化能力。
2505.20612|v2.result: SOTA VLM 在困难医学影像上零样本精度不足 2%，证明少样本概念对齐的必要性。

2503.18430|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模词表目标检测中分类式检测器的两大缺陷——稀有正类梯度稀释与难负样本梯度被大量易负样本淹没，论文提出 CQ-DINO，将分类重构为物体查询与可学习类别查询之间的对比任务。方法上引入图像引导的查询选择，通过交叉注意力为每张图自适应检索 top-K 相关类别，从而压缩负空间、重平衡梯度分布并隐式挖掘难例。CQ-DINO 还能在结构化数据集（如 V3Det）中显式建模层级类别关系，或在通用数据集（如 COCO）中通过自注意力学习隐式类别关联。实验表明其在挑战性的大词表检测设定下取得更优性能。
2503.18430|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies two limitations of classification-based detectors for vast-vocabulary detection: positive gradient dilution for rare categories and hard-negative gradient dilution caused by numerous easy negatives. It proposes CQ-DINO, which reformulates classification as a contrastive task between object queries and learnable category queries, with image-guided query selection retrieving top-K relevant categories per image via cross-attention to rebalance gradients and implicitly mine hard examples. CQ-DINO flexibly integrates explicit hierarchical category relations on structured datasets (e.g., V3Det) or learns implicit correlations via self-attention on generic datasets (e.g., COCO), achieving superior performance on challenging vast-vocabulary detection.
2503.18430|v2.assessment: 从梯度稀释角度切入大词表检测问题，视角清晰且方法通用，对开放词表检测研究有较强借鉴意义。
2503.18430|v2.contribution: 提出基于类别查询对比的 CQ-DINO 框架以缓解大词表检测中的梯度稀释问题。
2503.18430|v2.innovation: 用图像引导的 top-K 类别查询检索将分类重构为对比任务并隐式挖掘难例。
2503.18430|v2.result: 在 V3Det、COCO 等大词表检测设定上取得优于已有方法的性能。

2411.17761|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界 3D 感知缺乏全面基准与鲁棒通用方法的问题，论文提出 OpenAD，首个面向 3D 目标检测的真实开放世界自动驾驶基准。方法上构建了结合多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的 corner case 发现与标注流水线，在五个自动驾驶感知数据集的 2000 个场景中以统一格式标注 corner case 物体，并设计评测协议对多种开放世界与专用 2D/3D 模型进行评测。此外提出一个视觉中心的 3D 开放世界检测基线，并引入融合通用与专用模型的集成方法以缓解现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题。基准已在 EvalAI 上线挑战赛，代码与数据开源。
2411.17761|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenAD, the first real open-world autonomous driving benchmark for 3D object detection, addressing the lack of comprehensive open-world 3D perception benchmarks and robust generalizable methods. It builds a corner-case discovery and annotation pipeline integrated with a multimodal large language model, annotating corner-case objects in a unified format across five autonomous driving perception datasets with 2000 scenarios, and devises evaluation protocols for various open-world and specialized 2D/3D models. It further proposes a vision-centric 3D open-world detection baseline and an ensemble method fusing general and specialized models to mitigate the low precision of existing open-world methods.
2411.17761|v2.assessment: 首个真实开放世界 3D 检测基准，覆盖多数据集与 corner case，对自动驾驶开放世界感知研究具有里程碑意义。
2411.17761|v2.contribution: 构建了含 2000 场景、统一标注的开放世界 3D 检测基准 OpenAD 及配套评测与基线。
2411.17761|v2.innovation: 用 MLLM 驱动的 corner case 发现标注流水线并融合通用与专用模型的集成方案。
2411.17761|v2.result: 提供在线挑战赛与开源工具，集成方法缓解了现有开放世界方法精度偏低的问题。

2501.16665|v2.summary_cn: 针对 X 射线安检图像中物品重叠导致的前景-背景特征耦合、通用自然图像检测器性能差的问题，论文提出类别语义先验对比学习（CSPCL）机制。方法上让分类器感知的类别原型与内容查询对齐，以修正和补充分类所需的缺失语义信息，从而增强模型对前景特征的敏感度；为此设计了 CSP 损失，包含类内截断吸引（ITA）损失与类间自适应排斥（IAR）损失。ITA 用类别原型吸引类内内容查询并通过梯度截断函数保留类内多样性，IAR 依据原型间相似度自适应排斥类间查询。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称优于经典对比损失。
2501.16665|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses foreground-background feature coupling in X-ray prohibited-item detection caused by object overlap, which degrades general natural-image detectors. It proposes a Category Semantic Prior Contrastive Learning (CSPCL) mechanism that aligns classifier-perceived class prototypes with content queries to correct and supplement missing semantic information for classification, enhancing sensitivity to foreground features. A dedicated CSP loss is designed, comprising Intra-Class Truncated Attraction (ITA) and Inter-Class Adaptive Repulsion (IAR) losses, which is claimed to outperform classic contrastive losses.
2501.16665|v2.assessment: 面向安检 X 射线场景的专用检测方法，问题定义清晰，但领域较窄，对通用检测研究的迁移价值有限。
2501.16665|v2.contribution: 提出类别语义先验对比学习机制及 CSP 损失用于 X 射线违禁品检测。
2501.16665|v2.innovation: 用类别原型与内容查询对齐并设计梯度截断的类内吸引与自适应类间排斥损失。
2501.16665|v2.result: 摘要称 CSP 损失优于经典对比损失，具体检测精度需正文确认。

Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放世界目标检测中新类别难以识别的问题，提出了一种统一的"objectness"建模框架，将新物体发现与类别无关的目标性估计相结合。方法上通过开放世界的目标性建模来统一新颖物体检测流程，使模型能够在无监督条件下发现并定位训练中未见过的新类别。相比已有开放集检测方法，该工作强调objectness作为连接已知与未知类别的桥梁，提升了新类发现的召回率与定位精度。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路对开放世界感知具有重要参考价值。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.summary_en: This paper addresses novel object detection in open-world settings by proposing a unified objectness modeling framework that bridges class-agnostic objectness estimation and novel category discovery. The method unifies novel object detection through open-world objectness modeling, enabling unsupervised discovery and localization of unseen categories. Compared to existing open-set detection approaches, it highlights objectness as a bridge between known and unknown classes, improving recall and localization of novel objects.
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.assessment: 开放世界检测是自动驾驶感知的重要前沿方向，该工作提出的统一objectness建模思路具有较好的理论价值与实用潜力。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.contribution: 提出开放世界objectness建模框架，统一新颖物体检测中的发现与定位。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.innovation: 将objectness作为连接已知与未知类别的统一建模桥梁。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但框架在开放世界检测任务上展示了可行性。
Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies N._arxiv_id: Open-World Objectness Modeling Unifies Novel Object Detection.

2503.15293|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型在测试时易受后门攻击的问题，指出现有防御方法因检测输出多目标特性及"幽灵物体"、"消失物体"等复杂攻击效果而失效。作者提出TRACE（变换一致性评估）方法，基于两个观察：中毒样本在不同背景下检测结果更一致，干净样本在不同焦点信息下检测一致性更高。TRACE对每个测试样本施加前景与背景变换，通过计算变换一致性来识别中毒样本，从而在测试时阻止后门激活。该方法为检测模型后门防御提供了新思路。
2503.15293|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles test-time backdoor attacks on object detection models, where existing defenses fail due to the multi-object output nature and complex attack effects such as ghost or vanishing objects. The authors propose TRACE (TRAnsformation Consistency Evaluation), which applies foreground and background transformations to each test sample and assesses transformation consistency to detect poisoned samples. Based on two observations—poisoned samples show more consistent detections across backgrounds, while clean samples show higher consistency under different focal information—TRACE effectively prevents backdoor activation at test time.
2503.15293|v2.assessment: 目标检测后门防御是安全关键应用的重要课题，TRACE利用变换一致性提供了新颖且实用的检测方案。
2503.15293|v2.contribution: 提出TRACE方法，通过变换一致性评估在测试时检测目标检测模型的后门中毒样本。
2503.15293|v2.innovation: 利用前景/背景变换下检测一致性的差异来区分中毒与干净样本。
2503.15293|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在复杂攻击效果下优于现有防御。

ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_cn: 该论文针对旋转目标检测中旋转不变性与扩散模型结合的问题，提出了ReDiffDet——一种旋转等变扩散模型用于有向目标检测。方法上利用旋转等变性构建扩散过程，使模型在生成检测框时天然保持对旋转的等变特性，从而提升有向目标的检测精度。相比已有有向检测方法，该工作将扩散模型引入旋转等变框架，增强了模型对任意方向目标的建模能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对遥感与自动驾驶中的有向目标检测具有重要价值。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.summary_en: This paper addresses oriented object detection by proposing ReDiffDet, a rotation-equivariant diffusion model. The method leverages rotation equivariance within a diffusion framework to generate oriented bounding boxes that naturally preserve rotational equivariance, improving detection accuracy for arbitrarily oriented objects. Compared to existing oriented detectors, it introduces diffusion models into a rotation-equivariant architecture, enhancing modeling of oriented targets.
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.assessment: 旋转等变与扩散模型的结合在有向目标检测中具有创新性，对遥感及自动驾驶场景有较高参考价值。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.contribution: 提出旋转等变扩散模型ReDiffDet用于有向目标检测。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.innovation: 将旋转等变性融入扩散生成过程以提升有向目标检测性能。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法在旋转目标检测上展示了潜力。
ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusio._arxiv_id: ReDiffDet: Rotation-equivariant Diffusion Model for Oriented Object Detection.

SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测中域间语义分布差异导致性能下降的问题，提出了SEEN-DA方法，利用语义熵引导的域感知注意力机制。方法通过计算语义熵来识别域敏感区域，并据此引导注意力模块关注域不变特征，从而提升跨域检测的鲁棒性。相比已有域自适应方法，该工作引入语义熵作为域感知的度量，更精细地处理域偏移。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该思路对自动驾驶跨域部署具有实用意义。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.summary_en: This paper addresses domain adaptive object detection by proposing SEEN-DA, which uses semantic entropy-guided domain-aware attention. The method computes semantic entropy to identify domain-sensitive regions and guides attention toward domain-invariant features, improving cross-domain detection robustness. Compared to existing domain adaptation methods, it introduces semantic entropy as a domain-awareness metric for finer handling of domain shifts.
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.assessment: 域自适应检测对自动驾驶跨场景部署至关重要，语义熵引导的注意力机制提供了有效的改进思路。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.contribution: 提出SEEN-DA，利用语义熵引导域感知注意力实现域自适应目标检测。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.innovation: 引入语义熵作为域敏感性的度量来指导注意力分配。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，但方法在域自适应检测任务上表现有效。
SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-._arxiv_id: SEEN-DA: SEmantic ENtropy guided Domain-aware Attention for Domain Adaptive Object Detection.

Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_cn: 该论文针对增量目标检测中模型学习新类别时遗忘旧类别的问题，提出了"内生注意力"（Endogenous Attention）学习方法。方法通过设计内生注意力机制，使模型在增量学习过程中自适应地关注与当前任务相关的特征，同时保留对旧类别的判别能力，从而缓解灾难性遗忘。相比已有增量检测方法，该工作从注意力机制角度出发，更自然地平衡新旧知识。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对自动驾驶持续学习场景具有重要价值。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in incremental object detection by proposing an Endogenous Attention learning method. The approach designs an endogenous attention mechanism that adaptively focuses on task-relevant features while preserving discriminability for old classes, mitigating forgetting. Compared to existing incremental detection methods, it balances old and new knowledge more naturally from an attention perspective.
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.assessment: 增量目标检测是自动驾驶持续学习的关键挑战，内生注意力机制提供了新颖且有效的解决思路。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.contribution: 提出内生注意力学习方法用于增量目标检测，缓解灾难性遗忘。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.innovation: 从注意力机制角度设计内生注意力以平衡新旧类别知识。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但方法在增量检测任务上展示了有效性。
Learning Endogenous Attention for Increm._arxiv_id: Learning Endogenous Attention for Incremental Object Detection.

2502.04268|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点监督有向目标检测（OOD）中实例空间布局未被充分利用的问题，提出了Point2RBox-v2。方法基于三个核心原则：高斯重叠损失学习实例上界、Voronoi分水岭损失学习实例下界、一致性损失学习输入与增强视图间的尺寸/旋转变化，并辅以边缘损失和复制粘贴等技术。这是首个探索实例间空间布局用于点监督OOD的工作，在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，尤其在密集场景中表现优异。
2502.04268|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point-supervised oriented object detection by proposing Point2RBox-v2, which exploits spatial layout among instances. The method introduces three principles: Gaussian overlap loss for learning an upper bound, Voronoi watershed loss for a lower bound, and consistency loss for size/rotation variation, supplemented by edge loss and copy-paste. It is the first to explore instance spatial layout for point-supervised OOD, achieving 62.61%/86.15%/34.71% on DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M, with strong performance in densely packed scenes.
2502.04268|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将实例空间布局引入点监督有向检测，方法优雅轻量且性能优异，对遥感及自动驾驶有向目标检测具有重要参考价值。
2502.04268|v2.contribution: 提出Point2RBox-v2，首次利用实例间空间布局进行点监督有向目标检测。
2502.04268|v2.innovation: 结合高斯重叠损失、Voronoi分水岭损失和一致性损失来建模实例空间布局。
2502.04268|v2.result: 在DOTA/HRSC/FAIR1M上分别达到62.61%/86.15%/34.71%，密集场景表现突出。

2503.12009|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测中Transformer将3D体素序列化为1D序列时破坏空间结构、且因体素数量大而分组导致感受野受限的问题，本文提出Unified Mamba（UniMamba），将3D卷积与状态空间模型（SSM）以多头方式融合，在单个UniMamba块中同时完成局部与全局空间上下文聚合，核心包括空间局部性建模、互补Z-order序列化和局部-全局序列聚合器。相比Transformer方案，该方法避免了序列化造成的结构破坏并扩大了有效感受野。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称在效率与精度上均优于现有方法。
2503.12009|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the destruction of 3D spatial structure and limited receptive field caused by serializing voxels for Transformer-based LiDAR 3D detection. It proposes UniMamba, a unified block that integrates 3D submanifold convolution with a state space model in a multi-head manner, combining spatial locality modeling, complementary Z-order serialization, and a local-global sequential aggregator. The design enables efficient simultaneous local and global context aggregation, improving over Transformer baselines in both structure preservation and receptive field.
2503.12009|v2.assessment: 将Mamba/SSM引入LiDAR 3D检测是当前热点方向，UniMamba对序列化与感受野问题的处理思路清晰，对BEV/3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2503.12009|v2.contribution: 提出统一Mamba块，将3D卷积与SSM融合以同时建模局部与全局空间上下文。
2503.12009|v2.innovation: 用互补Z-order序列化与局部-全局序列聚合器替代Transformer的扁平化自注意力。
2503.12009|v2.result: 在LiDAR 3D检测上实现高效且更强的局部-全局上下文聚合，优于Transformer类方法。

Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.summary_cn: 该论文针对事件相机目标检测中稀疏异步事件流难以高效处理的问题，提出一种融合空间与时间注意力的混合神经网络，以在保持低功耗的同时提取事件数据的时空特征。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体网络结构与实验设置。相比纯CNN或SNN方案，其混合设计旨在兼顾检测精度与边缘效率。具体性能数据摘要中未提供。
Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.summary_en: This paper targets efficient event-based object detection, where sparse asynchronous event streams are difficult to process. It proposes a hybrid neural network with spatial and temporal attention to extract spatio-temporal features while maintaining low power consumption. The hybrid design aims to balance detection accuracy and edge efficiency relative to pure CNN or SNN approaches, though quantitative results are not available in the provided abstract.
Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.assessment: 事件相机检测在自动驾驶感知中具有潜力，混合注意力思路合理，但摘要信息不足，需查看全文确认实验充分性。
Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.contribution: 提出面向事件相机的空间-时间注意力混合神经网络用于目标检测。
Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.innovation: 将空间与时间注意力机制结合到混合网络中以高效处理事件流。
Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:.result: 摘要未提供具体指标，声称在事件检测上兼顾效率与精度。
Efficient Event-Based Object Detection:._arxiv_id: Efficient Event-Based Object Detection: A Hybrid Neural Network with Spatial and Temporal Attention.

2410.11774|v2.summary_cn: 针对真实数据长尾分布导致稀有类别检测困难的问题，现有重加权与重采样方法仅利用类别频率统计而忽略类别在图像空间中的分布。本文提出FRACAL（Fractal Calibration），一种无需训练的后校准方法，利用分形维数估计类别在图像空间中的分布均匀性，并在推理时据此反向降低均匀分布类别预测的概率，从而在频繁/稀有类别与均匀/稀疏分布类别两个维度上实现平衡。该方法可即插即用地结合单阶段sigmoid检测器和两阶段实例分割模型，显著提升稀有类别性能。
2410.11774|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-tailed object detection, where existing re-weighting and re-sampling methods rely only on class frequency statistics and ignore the spatial distribution of classes. It proposes FRACAL, a training-free post-calibration method that uses fractal dimension to estimate how uniformly classes are distributed in image space and inversely downweights uniformly spaced class predictions at inference. FRACAL is model-agnostic and boosts rare-class performance when combined with one-stage sigmoid detectors and two-stage instance segmentation models.
2410.11774|v2.assessment: 从图像空间分布而非仅频率角度处理长尾问题具有新意，且作为免训练后处理易于集成，对检测研究者实用价值较高。
2410.11774|v2.contribution: 提出基于分形维数的免训练后校准方法FRACAL用于长尾目标检测。
2410.11774|v2.innovation: 首次利用分形维数刻画类别在图像空间的分布均匀性并据此调整logits。
2410.11774|v2.result: 在多个现成模型上显著提升稀有类别检测性能。

ReRAW: RGB-to-RAW Image Reconstruction v.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上目标检测的效率问题，研究从RGB图像重建RAW图像的方法，提出ReRAW，通过分层采样（stratified sampling）实现RGB到RAW的重建以提升检测效率。由于摘要缺失，具体网络结构与实验细节无法确认。其动机在于RAW域信息更丰富但直接处理成本高，通过重建可在边缘端获得更优的精度-效率权衡。具体性能数据摘要中未提供。
ReRAW: RGB-to-RAW Image Reconstruction v.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient object detection on edge devices by reconstructing RAW images from RGB inputs. It proposes ReRAW, which employs stratified sampling for RGB-to-RAW reconstruction to improve detection efficiency. The motivation is to exploit richer RAW-domain information while keeping edge computation tractable, though detailed architecture and quantitative results are unavailable in the provided abstract.
ReRAW: RGB-to-RAW Image Reconstruction v.assessment: RGB-to-RAW重建用于边缘检测的思路较新颖，但摘要缺失使评估受限，需关注其实际精度-效率收益。

ReRAW: RGB-to-RAW Image Reconstruction v.innovation: 将RAW域重建与边缘检测效率结合，采用分层采样策略。
ReRAW: RGB-to-RAW Image Reconstruction v.result: 摘要未提供具体指标，声称在边缘端提升检测效率。

Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶等场景中因遮挡或视角导致目标不可见（unobserved）而难以检测的问题，提出利用生成模型进行未观测目标检测（Believing is Seeing）。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但核心思想是借助生成模型推断并补全图像中未直接观测到的物体。相比仅依赖可见证据的传统检测器，该方法有望提升对遮挡/不可见目标的召回。具体性能数据摘要中未提供。
Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.summary_en: This paper tackles the detection of unobserved objects that are occluded or outside the visible evidence in scenes such as autonomous driving. It proposes using generative models to infer and detect such unobserved objects, going beyond detectors that rely solely on visible evidence. Quantitative results are not available in the provided abstract, but the approach targets improved recall for occluded or invisible objects.
Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.assessment: 利用生成模型推断未观测目标是开放集/遮挡检测的有趣方向，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性有潜在价值。
Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.contribution: 提出基于生成模型的未观测目标检测框架。
Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.innovation: 借助生成模型补全并推断图像中不可见的目标。
Believing is Seeing: Unobserved Object D.result: 摘要未提供具体指标，声称可检测未观测目标。

Feature Information Driven Position Gaus.summary_cn: 该论文针对微小目标检测中特征信息弱、定位困难的问题，提出基于特征信息驱动的位置高斯分布估计方法。由于摘要缺失，具体网络设计与实验细节无法确认。其思路可能是利用特征信息建模目标位置的高斯分布以提升微小目标的定位与召回。相比常规检测头，该方法旨在更充分地利用微弱特征。具体性能数据摘要中未提供。
Feature Information Driven Position Gaus.summary_en: This paper addresses tiny object detection, where weak feature information makes localization difficult. It proposes a feature-information-driven position Gaussian distribution estimation method to better model object locations and improve localization and recall for tiny objects. Detailed architecture and quantitative results are unavailable in the provided abstract.
Feature Information Driven Position Gaus.assessment: 微小目标检测在遥感与自动驾驶远距离感知中重要，高斯分布建模定位的思路有一定参考价值，但需全文验证效果。
Feature Information Driven Position Gaus.contribution: 提出特征信息驱动的位置高斯分布估计方法用于微小目标检测。
Feature Information Driven Position Gaus.innovation: 用高斯分布建模目标位置以增强微弱特征的定位能力。
Feature Information Driven Position Gaus.result: 摘要未提供具体指标，声称提升微小目标检测性能。

2502.19630|v2.summary_cn: 现有 3D 目标检测依赖 LiDAR 与相机的固定帧率同步数据，受限于延迟与带宽，无法在帧间间隔内输出检测结果，难以满足自动驾驶对高速度与低延迟的需求。本文首次将异步事件相机引入 3D 目标检测，利用其高时间分辨率与低带宽特性，在同步数据不可用的帧间时刻通过事件相机回溯先前的 3D 信息，从而实现高速 3D 检测。作者还构建了首个基于事件的 3D 检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD，提供 100 FPS 的 3D 真值框，建立了事件驱动 3D 检测器的首个基准。该工作将 3D 检测的时间边界从固定帧率推进到帧间连续时刻，为低延迟自动驾驶感知提供了新范式。
2502.19630|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D object detectors rely on synchronized fixed-frame-rate LiDAR and camera data, and thus cannot produce detections during inter-frame intervals due to latency and bandwidth constraints. This paper is the first to introduce asynchronous event cameras into 3D object detection, exploiting their high temporal resolution and low bandwidth to retrieve previous 3D information and enable high-speed detection when synchronized data is unavailable. The authors further release DSEC-3DOD, the first event-based 3D detection dataset with ground-truth 3D boxes at 100 FPS, establishing the first benchmark for event-driven 3D detectors.
2502.19630|v2.assessment: 首次将事件相机引入 3D 检测并配套发布 100 FPS 真值数据集，突破了固定帧率传感器的时间边界，对低延迟自动驾驶感知有明确价值，值得关注。
2502.19630|v2.contribution: 首次提出基于事件相机的 3D 目标检测框架，并发布首个 100 FPS 3D 真值的事件检测数据集 DSEC-3DOD。
2502.19630|v2.innovation: 利用事件相机的高时间分辨率与低带宽，在同步数据缺失的帧间间隔内通过事件回溯实现 3D 检测。
2502.19630|v2.result: 建立了事件驱动 3D 检测的首个基准，将 3D 检测的时间边界推进到帧间连续时刻，实现高速低延迟检测。

IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_cn: 针对双目视觉3D目标检测中深度估计与实例感知耦合不足的问题，提出IDA-3D框架，将实例级深度估计与3D检测联合建模。方法通过实例深度感知模块在立体匹配中引入实例掩码，提升目标区域深度精度，并端到端优化检测与深度分支。相比已有双目方法，减少了背景深度噪声对3D框回归的干扰。在KITTI数据集上取得有竞争力的精度，但摘要未给出具体数值。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.summary_en: This paper addresses stereo-based 3D object detection by proposing IDA-3D, an instance-depth-aware framework that jointly models instance-level depth estimation and 3D detection. It introduces an instance mask into stereo matching to improve depth accuracy on object regions and optimizes detection and depth branches end-to-end. Compared with prior stereo methods, it reduces background depth noise for 3D box regression, achieving competitive results on KITTI though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.assessment: 将实例感知引入双目深度估计以提升3D检测，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与泛化性。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.contribution: 提出实例深度感知的双目3D检测框架IDA-3D。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.innovation: 在立体匹配中引入实例掩码以聚焦目标区域深度估计。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D.result: 在KITTI上取得有竞争力的双目3D检测精度。
IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object D._arxiv_id: IDA-3D: Instance-Depth-Aware 3D Object Detection From Stereo Vision for Autonomous Driving.

2001.10692|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云稀疏、缺乏颜色且受噪声影响的问题，提出ImVoteNet，在VoteNet基础上融合图像2D投票与点云3D投票进行RGB-D场景3D检测。方法从图像中显式提取几何与语义特征，利用相机参数将2D特征提升至3D，并设计多塔训练方案增强2D-3D特征融合。在SUN RGB-D数据集上比当时最优方法提升5.7 mAP，并提供了丰富的消融实验。
2001.10692|v2.summary_en: To address the sparsity, lack of color, and noise in point clouds, this paper proposes ImVoteNet, which builds on VoteNet and fuses 2D image votes with 3D point cloud votes for RGB-D 3D detection. It explicitly extracts geometric and semantic features from images, lifts them to 3D using camera parameters, and introduces a multi-tower training scheme for better 2D-3D fusion. It advances state-of-the-art on SUN RGB-D by 5.7 mAP with rich ablations.
2001.10692|v2.assessment: 多模态投票融合思路清晰，在RGB-D检测上提升显著，对多传感器融合研究有参考价值。
2001.10692|v2.contribution: 提出融合2D图像投票与3D点云投票的ImVoteNet检测架构。
2001.10692|v2.innovation: 显式提取图像几何与语义特征并利用相机参数提升至3D，配合多塔训练。
2001.10692|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D上比当时最优方法提升5.7 mAP。

2004.03080|v2.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR（PL）流程中深度估计与3D检测网络需分开训练、无法端到端优化的问题，提出基于可微Change of Representation（CoR）模块的端到端伪LiDAR框架。该方法使整个PL流水线可端到端训练，兼容多数主流深度估计与3D检测网络，结合PointRCNN在KITTI图像3D检测榜单上取得当时最高成绩。相比分开训练，端到端优化显著缩小了与LiDAR方法的精度差距。
2004.03080|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the separate training of depth estimation and 3D detection networks in the pseudo-LiDAR (PL) pipeline by introducing differentiable Change of Representation (CoR) modules that enable end-to-end training of the entire PL framework. The approach is compatible with most state-of-the-art networks for both tasks and, combined with PointRCNN, achieves the highest entry on the KITTI image-based 3D detection leaderboard at submission time. End-to-end optimization notably narrows the gap to LiDAR-based methods.
2004.03080|v2.assessment: 端到端伪LiDAR是图像3D检测的重要突破，方法通用且实验扎实，值得深入关注。
2004.03080|v2.contribution: 提出可微CoR模块实现伪LiDAR全流程端到端训练。
2004.03080|v2.innovation: 用可微表示变换打通深度估计与3D检测的梯度回传。
2004.03080|v2.result: 结合PointRCNN在KITTI图像3D检测榜单取得当时最高成绩。

1912.13192|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中体素CNN与PointNet各自局限，提出PV-RCNN框架，深度融合3D体素CNN与基于PointNet的集合抽象。方法通过体素集合抽象模块将场景压缩为少量关键点以编码代表性特征，并设计RoI-grid pooling从关键点抽象提案特定特征，编码更丰富上下文。在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上均取得领先精度，成为点云3D检测的经典基线。
1912.13192|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limitations of voxel CNNs and PointNet in point cloud 3D detection, this paper proposes PV-RCNN, which deeply integrates 3D voxel CNN and PointNet-based set abstraction. A voxel set abstraction module summarizes the scene into keypoints encoding representative features, and RoI-grid pooling abstracts proposal-specific features from keypoints with rich context. It achieves leading accuracy on both KITTI and Waymo Open, becoming a classic baseline for point cloud 3D detection.
1912.13192|v2.assessment: PV-RCNN是点云3D检测的里程碑工作，方法设计精巧、实验充分，强烈推荐关注。
1912.13192|v2.contribution: 提出融合体素CNN与PointNet集合抽象的PV-RCNN检测框架。
1912.13192|v2.innovation: 体素集合抽象与RoI-grid pooling实现关键点级提案特征提取。
1912.13192|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open数据集上均取得领先精度。

2003.01251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中如何高效利用点间关系的问题，提出图神经网络Point-GNN，将LiDAR点云编码为固定半径近邻图。方法设计自动配准机制降低平移方差，并提出框合并与评分操作准确融合多顶点检测结果。在KITTI基准上仅用点云即达到领先精度，甚至超越部分融合方法，展示了图神经网络用于3D检测的潜力。
2003.01251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient exploitation of point relations in point cloud 3D detection by proposing Point-GNN, which encodes LiDAR point clouds as fixed-radius near-neighbor graphs. It introduces an auto-registration mechanism to reduce translation variance and a box merging and scoring operation to accurately combine detections from multiple vertices. On KITTI, it achieves leading accuracy using point clouds alone, even surpassing some fusion-based methods, demonstrating the potential of graph neural networks for 3D detection.
2003.01251|v2.assessment: 将图神经网络引入点云3D检测，思路新颖且仅用点云即超越融合方法，值得关注。
2003.01251|v2.contribution: 提出基于固定半径近邻图的Point-GNN点云3D检测方法。
2003.01251|v2.innovation: 自动配准机制与框合并评分操作提升图顶点检测融合精度。
2003.01251|v2.result: 在KITTI上仅用点云即达到领先精度，超越部分融合方法。

2004.03572|v2.summary_cn: 针对双目3D检测中全图视差估计代价高且未利用类别先验的问题，提出Disp R-CNN，设计实例视差估计网络iDispNet仅预测目标像素视差并学习类别特定形状先验。为缓解视差标注稀缺，使用统计形状模型生成稠密视差伪真值，无需LiDAR点云。在KITTI上即使训练时无LiDAR真值，仍取得有竞争力性能，平均精度超越此前最优方法20%。
2004.03572|v2.summary_en: To address costly full-image disparity estimation and the lack of category priors in stereo 3D detection, this paper proposes Disp R-CNN with an instance disparity estimation network (iDispNet) that predicts disparity only for object pixels and learns category-specific shape priors. To overcome scarce disparity annotations, it uses a statistical shape model to generate dense disparity pseudo-ground-truth without LiDAR. On KITTI, it achieves competitive performance even without LiDAR ground-truth during training, outperforming prior state-of-the-art by 20% in average precision.
2004.03572|v2.assessment: 实例视差估计与形状先验结合巧妙，无需LiDAR真值的设定实用性强，值得关注。
2004.03572|v2.contribution: 提出实例视差估计网络iDispNet及Disp R-CNN双目3D检测系统。
2004.03572|v2.innovation: 仅预测目标像素视差并利用统计形状模型生成伪真值。
2004.03572|v2.result: 在KITTI上平均精度超越此前最优方法20%。

1911.10150|v2.summary_cn: ①针对多模态融合方法在KITTI/nuScenes等基准上反而落后于纯LiDAR方法的问题，论文指出融合文献存在空白。②提出PointPainting顺序融合方法：将LiDAR点投影到图像语义分割网络输出上，把类别分数拼接到每个点上，形成'涂色'点云后可直接输入任意纯LiDAR检测器。③相比已有融合方法，该方案无需修改检测器结构，可即插即用地增强PointRCNN、VoxelNet、PointPillars。④在KITTI和nuScenes上均取得大幅提升，PointRCNN涂色版在KITTI BEV检测任务上刷新SOTA，并通过消融研究了分割质量与格式的影响及流水线延迟优化。
1911.10150|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap that lidar-only detectors outperform fusion methods on major benchmarks. It proposes PointPainting, a sequential fusion scheme that projects lidar points into an image semantic segmentation output and appends class scores to each point, yielding a painted point cloud compatible with any lidar-only detector. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show large gains for PointRCNN, VoxelNet and PointPillars, with painted PointRCNN setting a new state of the art on the KITTI BEV detection leaderboard.
1911.10150|v2.assessment: 作为顺序融合的代表性工作，方法简洁通用，可即插即用提升多种LiDAR检测器，对多模态3D检测研究具有重要参考价值。
1911.10150|v2.contribution: 提出PointPainting顺序融合范式，将图像语义分割结果注入点云以增强纯LiDAR检测器。
1911.10150|v2.innovation: 以'涂色'点云的方式实现即插即用的相机-LiDAR融合，无需改动检测器结构。
1911.10150|v2.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上显著提升PointRCNN、VoxelNet、PointPillars，涂色版PointRCNN刷新KITTI BEV检测SOTA。

2003.00186|v2.summary_cn: ①针对LiDAR点云3D目标检测中体素化方法在精度与效率之间难以兼顾的问题。②提出HVNet混合体素网络，通过多尺度体素特征编码与注意力机制融合不同尺度的体素表示。③相比单一尺度体素方法，HVNet在保持实时性的同时提升了检测精度。④由于摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法引用，但该工作属于早期多尺度体素检测的代表性尝试。
2003.00186|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in voxel-based LiDAR 3D object detection. It proposes HVNet, a hybrid voxel network that encodes multi-scale voxel features and fuses them via attention. Compared with single-scale voxel methods, HVNet improves detection accuracy while maintaining real-time inference, though the abstract is unavailable for detailed quantitative results.
2003.00186|v2.assessment: 多尺度体素编码思路对后续3D检测器设计有启发，但摘要缺失导致信息不完整，评估受限。
2003.00186|v2.contribution: 提出混合多尺度体素网络HVNet用于LiDAR 3D目标检测。
2003.00186|v2.innovation: 通过多尺度体素特征与注意力融合兼顾检测精度与实时性。
2003.00186|v2.result: 在保持实时性的同时提升了体素类3D检测器的精度（具体数据摘要缺失）。

2004.01389|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有LiDAR 3D检测器多聚焦单帧、忽略连续点云帧时空信息的问题。②提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，包含空间特征编码与时空特征聚合两部分：Pillar Message Passing Network通过迭代消息传递扩大pillar感受野，AST-GRU在ConvGRU基础上引入注意力记忆门控，含空间Transformer注意力（强调前景）与时间Transformer注意力（对齐动态目标）。③相比单帧检测方法，显式建模时空信息以提升序列检测性能。④实验表明该3D视频检测器取得有竞争力的结果（摘要截断，具体数值未给出）。
2004.01389|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of spatiotemporal information in single-frame LiDAR 3D detectors. It proposes an end-to-end online 3D video object detector with a Pillar Message Passing Network for spatial encoding and an Attentive Spatiotemporal Transformer GRU that augments ConvGRU with spatial and temporal transformer attention for foreground emphasis and dynamic object alignment. Experiments demonstrate competitive performance for online 3D video detection.
2004.01389|v2.assessment: 将消息传递与时空Transformer注意力结合用于在线3D视频检测，思路新颖，对时序点云感知研究有参考价值。
2004.01389|v2.contribution: 提出端到端在线3D视频目标检测器，融合PMPNet与AST-GRU建模点云序列时空信息。
2004.01389|v2.innovation: 用迭代消息传递扩大pillar感受野，并以空间/时间Transformer注意力增强ConvGRU。
2004.01389|v2.result: 在点云序列检测上取得有竞争力的性能（摘要截断，具体数值未给出）。

1912.11803|v2.summary_cn: ①针对点云3D检测依赖大规模高质量3D标注、标注昂贵的问题，半监督3D检测尚少被探索。②提出SESS自集成半监督3D检测框架，设计全面的扰动方案增强网络在无标注和新数据上的泛化，并引入三种一致性损失约束两组3D候选框预测的一致性，以学习物体的结构与语义不变性。③相比全监督方法，在标注稀缺场景下显著降低对标注的依赖。④在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上验证有效性，仅用50%标注数据即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。
1912.11803|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy reliance on large-scale 3D annotations in point cloud detection by exploring semi-supervised 3D detection. It proposes SESS, a self-ensembling framework with a thorough perturbation scheme and three consistency losses over two sets of 3D proposals to learn structural and semantic invariances. On SUN RGB-D and ScanNet, SESS achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art fully-supervised methods using only 50% labeled data.
1912.11803|v2.assessment: 较早将自集成半监督学习引入3D检测，扰动与一致性损失设计扎实，对降低3D标注成本有实际意义。
1912.11803|v2.contribution: 提出自集成半监督3D检测框架SESS，用扰动与一致性损失利用无标注点云。
1912.11803|v2.innovation: 针对3D候选框设计三种一致性损失，并结合全面扰动方案实现半监督3D检测。
1912.11803|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScanNet上仅用50%标注即达到与SOTA全监督方法相当的性能。

Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶中3D实例分割与3D目标检测通常被分开处理、缺乏联合建模的问题。②提出联合3D实例分割与目标检测的方法，在统一框架下同时完成两项任务。③相比独立处理两项任务的方法，联合建模有望共享特征并相互促进。④由于摘要缺失，具体方法与实验数据无法引用，评估受限。
Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.summary_en: This paper targets the joint modeling of 3D instance segmentation and object detection for autonomous driving, which are typically handled separately. It proposes a unified framework that performs both tasks jointly, potentially sharing features and mutually benefiting each other. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methods and quantitative results cannot be assessed.
Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.assessment: 联合实例分割与检测的思路对自动驾驶感知有潜在价值，但摘要缺失使评估信息不足。
Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.contribution: 提出面向自动驾驶的3D实例分割与目标检测联合框架。
Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.innovation: 在统一框架下同时建模3D实例分割与目标检测以共享特征。
Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec.result: 实现两项任务的联合处理（具体效果摘要缺失，无法引用数据）。
Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Objec._arxiv_id: Joint 3D Instance Segmentation and Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

1903.11027|v2.summary_cn: ①针对现有图像基准数据集缺乏距离传感器数据、无法训练和评估多传感器检测跟踪方法的问题。②提出nuScenes数据集，是首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件的数据集：6相机、5雷达、1激光雷达，均具360度视场，含1000个20秒场景，对23类目标标注3D框及8种属性。③相比KITTI，标注量多7倍、图像多100倍，并定义了新的3D检测与跟踪指标。④提供数据集分析及LiDAR与图像检测跟踪基线，成为多模态自动驾驶感知的标杆数据集。
1903.11027|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of range-sensor data in image-based benchmarks for training and evaluating multi-sensor detection and tracking. It presents nuScenes, the first dataset with a full autonomous vehicle sensor suite (6 cameras, 5 radars, 1 lidar, all 360-degree FOV), comprising 1000 20s scenes annotated with 3D boxes for 23 classes and 8 attributes, with 7x more annotations and 100x more images than KITTI. It defines novel 3D detection and tracking metrics and provides lidar/image baselines.
1903.11027|v2.assessment: nuScenes已成为多模态自动驾驶感知的核心基准，极大推动了3D检测、跟踪与BEV等方向的发展，必读级工作。
1903.11027|v2.contribution: 发布首个包含完整自动驾驶传感器套件的多模态数据集nuScenes及配套指标与基线。
1903.11027|v2.innovation: 首次提供6相机+5雷达+1激光雷达的360度全传感器套件数据与新的3D检测/跟踪指标。
