1903.11027|v2.result: 数据集规模为KITTI的7倍标注、100倍图像，成为多模态自动驾驶感知的标杆基准。

1912.04838|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知研究中缺乏大规模、多样化真实数据的问题，本文提出了Waymo Open Dataset，包含1150个20秒场景，覆盖城市与郊区多种地理环境，提供同步标定的高质量LiDAR与相机数据，并带有跨帧一致的2D与3D边界框标注。相比当时最大的相机+LiDAR数据集，其多样性指标高出15倍。论文还提供了2D/3D检测与跟踪的强基线，并研究了数据规模与跨地理区域泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale, diverse real-world data for autonomous driving perception, this paper introduces the Waymo Open Dataset, comprising 1150 scenes of 20 seconds each with synchronized and calibrated LiDAR and camera data across urban and suburban geographies, annotated with consistent 2D and 3D bounding boxes. It is 15x more diverse than the largest existing camera+LiDAR dataset based on the proposed diversity metric. The paper also provides strong baselines for 2D/3D detection and tracking, and studies the effects of dataset size and cross-geography generalization on 3D detection.
1912.04838|v2.assessment: 该数据集是自动驾驶感知领域里程碑式的工作，为3D检测、跟踪等任务提供了大规模高质量基准，对后续研究影响深远。
1912.04838|v2.contribution: 发布了大规模、多样化的Waymo Open Dataset，包含同步LiDAR与相机数据及一致的2D/3D标注，并提供了检测与跟踪基线。
1912.04838|v2.innovation: 提出了多样性度量指标，并系统研究了数据规模与跨地理区域泛化对3D检测的影响。
1912.04838|v2.result: 数据集多样性比当时最大相机+LiDAR数据集高15倍，并提供了强基线结果。

2005.03844|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶仿真中传感器数据真实感不足且依赖手工建模的问题，本文提出SurfelGAN，仅利用少量真实LiDAR和相机数据，通过纹理映射的surfel高效重建场景，并利用SurfelGAN网络生成新视角下逼真的相机图像。相比基于游戏引擎的仿真器，该方法无需手动创建环境与材质，可扩展性更强，能生成包含移动物体的真实感传感器数据。
2005.03844|v2.summary_en: To address the limited realism and scalability of sensor simulation in autonomous driving, this paper proposes SurfelGAN, which reconstructs scenes from a limited amount of real LiDAR and camera data using texture-mapped surfels and leverages a SurfelGAN network to synthesize realistic camera images for novel vehicle positions and moving objects. Unlike game-engine-based simulators, it avoids manual environment and material creation, offering better scalability and realism.
2005.03844|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶仿真提供了一种数据驱动的高效传感器数据合成方法，对场景回放与数据增强有实用价值。
2005.03844|v2.contribution: 提出基于纹理映射surfel与SurfelGAN的真实感传感器数据合成方法，仅需少量真实数据即可生成新视角图像。
2005.03844|v2.innovation: 利用surfel表示场景几何与外观，并结合GAN生成逼真新视角相机图像，无需手工建模。
2005.03844|v2.result: 在有限真实数据下生成了逼真的新视角相机图像，展示了方法的有效性。

2005.05501|v2.summary_cn: 针对深度视频中的3D动作识别问题，本文提出3D动态体素（3DV）表示，通过时间秩池化将深度视频中的3D运动信息紧凑编码为规则体素集，每个体素同时包含空间与运动特征。将3DV抽象为点集并输入PointNet++进行端到端识别，同时提出多流框架联合学习运动与外观特征，并划分时间片段编码时序信息。在NTU RGB+D 120等4个基准上取得82.4%和93.5%的准确率。
2005.05501|v2.summary_en: For depth-based 3D action recognition, this paper proposes 3D Dynamic Voxel (3DV), which encodes 3D motion information from depth videos into a regular voxel set via temporal rank pooling, with each voxel jointly capturing spatial and motion features. The 3DV is abstracted as a point set and fed into PointNet++ for end-to-end recognition, and a multi-stream framework is proposed to jointly learn motion and appearance features. Experiments on four benchmarks achieve 82.4% and 93.5% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120.
2005.05501|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，主要面向深度视频动作识别，但3D体素表示思路对点云处理有一定参考价值。
2005.05501|v2.contribution: 提出了3D动态体素表示，将深度视频运动信息编码为规则体素集，并用于端到端3D动作识别。
2005.05501|v2.innovation: 通过时间秩池化将运动信息融入体素，并将3DV转为点集输入PointNet++，结合多流学习运动与外观。
2005.05501|v2.result: 在NTU RGB+D 120上取得82.4%（cross-subject）和93.5%（cross-setup）的准确率。

Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中锚框设计依赖先验且对物体尺度变化敏感的问题，本文提出了一种无锚框的3D检测方法，将物体视为“热点”（Hotspots），通过热点触发机制来定位和回归3D边界框。该方法避免了预设锚框，能够更灵活地处理不同尺寸和形状的物体。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.summary_en: To address the reliance on anchor priors and sensitivity to object scale variation in 3D object detection, this paper proposes an anchor-free approach that treats objects as 'Hotspots' and fires hotspots to localize and regress 3D bounding boxes. The method avoids predefined anchors and handles objects of varying sizes and shapes more flexibly. No specific experimental results are provided in the abstract.
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.assessment: 该工作提出了一种新颖的无锚框3D检测思路，对点云目标检测有潜在启发，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其效果。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.contribution: 提出了基于热点触发的无锚框3D目标检测方法，将物体表示为热点以定位和回归3D框。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.innovation: 摒弃传统锚框设计，利用热点机制实现无锚框的3D目标检测。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果有待验证。
Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Object as Hotspots: An Anchor-Free 3D Object Detection Approach via Firing of Hotspots.

Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中定位误差来源不明确的问题，系统性地将误差分解为深度估计误差、2D检测误差和3D框尺寸/朝向误差。作者通过大量消融实验量化了各误差源对最终3D定位精度的影响，并提出针对性的改进策略（如深度感知的2D检测和误差补偿）。相比已有工作仅笼统归因于深度不准，本文首次细粒度地揭示了定位误差的构成，在KITTI基准上显著降低了3D定位误差，提升了单目检测性能。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.summary_en: This paper systematically decomposes localization errors in monocular 3D object detection into depth estimation, 2D detection, and 3D box dimension/orientation errors. Through extensive ablations, it quantifies each source's impact and proposes targeted improvements such as depth-aware 2D detection and error compensation. It achieves significant reduction in 3D localization error on KITTI, outperforming prior methods that only attributed errors to depth inaccuracy.
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.assessment: 该工作对单目3D检测的误差来源进行了深入剖析，为后续研究提供了重要的诊断工具和改进方向，实验扎实，值得关注。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.contribution: 首次系统性地分解并量化了单目3D目标检测中的定位误差来源。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.innovation: 提出细粒度的误差分解框架和针对性的误差补偿策略。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon.result: 在KITTI基准上显著降低了3D定位误差，提升了单目检测精度。
Delving Into Localization Errors for Mon._arxiv_id: Delving Into Localization Errors for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对单阶段3D目标检测中体素表示与点云表示各自的局限性（体素丢失细节、点云计算量大），提出了混合体素-点表示（HVPR）。方法通过将体素特征与原始点特征在单阶段检测器中融合，兼顾了计算效率和细粒度几何信息。在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上，HVPR在保持实时速度的同时取得了优于纯体素或纯点方法的检测精度，证明了混合表示的有效性。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of voxel and point representations in single-stage 3D object detection by proposing a Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation (HVPR). It fuses voxel features with raw point features in a single-stage detector to balance efficiency and fine-grained geometry. On KITTI and nuScenes, HVPR achieves better accuracy than pure voxel or point methods while maintaining real-time speed.
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.assessment: HVPR有效结合了体素和点云的优势，在单阶段检测器中实现了高效且准确的3D检测，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.contribution: 提出了一种混合体素-点表示的单阶段3D目标检测方法。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.innovation: 在单阶段框架中融合体素特征与原始点特征，兼顾效率与精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上以实时速度取得了优于纯体素或纯点方法的检测精度。
HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation._arxiv_id: HVPR: Hybrid Voxel-Point Representation for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection.

3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云目标检测中局部特征提取不足的问题，提出了Pointformer，一种基于Transformer的点云骨干网络。Pointformer通过自注意力和交叉注意力机制捕获点云中的局部和全局上下文信息，并设计了多尺度特征交互模块。在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D等3D检测基准上，Pointformer显著提升了检测精度，证明了Transformer在3D点云理解中的有效性。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Pointformer, a Transformer-based backbone for 3D point cloud object detection, to address insufficient local feature extraction. It captures local and global context via self-attention and cross-attention, with a multi-scale feature interaction module. On ScanNet and SUN RGB-D, Pointformer significantly improves detection accuracy, demonstrating the effectiveness of Transformers for 3D point cloud understanding.
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.assessment: Pointformer将Transformer成功引入3D点云检测，为后续基于注意力的3D感知方法奠定了基础，实验充分。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.contribution: 提出了基于Transformer的3D点云检测骨干网络Pointformer。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.innovation: 利用自注意力和交叉注意力捕获点云局部与全局上下文，并设计多尺度交互。
3D Object Detection With Pointformer.|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SUN RGB-D上显著提升了3D检测精度。

2103.05073|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对离线3D感知场景（如自动生成高质量3D标签）中现有在线检测器无法满足高质量要求的问题，提出了基于点云序列的离线3D检测流水线。方法利用多帧点云提供的互补视角，通过多帧目标检测和以对象为中心的细化模型来提升检测质量。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该流水线（3D Auto Labeling）显著优于最先进的在线检测器和离线基线，其性能甚至与人类标注相当，并进一步验证了自动标签在半监督学习中的应用。
2103.05073|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored offboard 3D perception scenario, such as automatic high-quality 3D label generation, where existing onboard detectors fall short. It proposes an offboard 3D detection pipeline using point cloud sequences, leveraging complementary views via multi-frame detection and object-centric refinement. On Waymo Open Dataset, the pipeline (3D Auto Labeling) significantly outperforms state-of-the-art onboard detectors and offboard baselines, achieving performance on par with human labels, and demonstrates benefits for semi-supervised learning.
2103.05073|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了离线3D检测的新方向，自动标注质量达到人类水平，对自动驾驶数据闭环和半监督学习具有重要价值。
2103.05073|v2.contribution: 提出了基于点云序列的离线3D检测流水线，用于高质量自动标注。
2103.05073|v2.innovation: 利用多帧互补视角和对象中心细化模型实现离线高质量3D检测。
2103.05073|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上性能超越在线检测器，与人类标注相当，并有效支持半监督学习。

2103.01100|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确导致性能受限的问题，提出了分类深度分布网络（CaDDN）。方法为每个像素预测分类深度分布，将丰富的上下文特征投影到3D空间中的合适深度区间，然后通过高效的鸟瞰图投影和单阶段检测器输出最终3D框。CaDDN是端到端可微的联合深度估计与目标检测框架，在KITTI 3D检测基准上排名第一（单目方法），并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上提供了单目3D检测结果。
2103.01100|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing the Categorical Depth Distribution Network (CaDDN). It predicts a categorical depth distribution per pixel to project contextual features into appropriate depth intervals in 3D space, followed by efficient bird's-eye-view projection and a single-stage detector. CaDDN is fully differentiable end-to-end for joint depth estimation and detection, ranking 1st among published monocular methods on KITTI and providing the first monocular 3D detection results on Waymo Open Dataset.
2103.01100|v2.assessment: CaDDN通过分类深度分布有效解决了单目深度估计的模糊性，在KITTI上取得领先性能，是单目3D检测的重要进展。
2103.01100|v2.contribution: 提出了分类深度分布网络CaDDN，实现端到端单目3D检测。
2103.01100|v2.innovation: 使用逐像素分类深度分布将上下文特征投影到3D空间，结合BEV投影和单阶段检测器。
2103.01100|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测中排名第一，并首次在Waymo Open Dataset上给出单目检测结果。

RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出了Range Sparse Net（RSN）。方法利用距离图像中前景点稀疏的特性，设计稀疏卷积网络处理距离图像，并引入辅助的密集深度补全任务来增强特征学习。在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上，RSN在保持高推理速度的同时取得了领先的检测精度，实现了高效且准确的LiDAR 3D检测。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between accuracy and efficiency in LiDAR 3D object detection by proposing Range Sparse Net (RSN). It exploits the sparsity of foreground points in range images using sparse convolutions and introduces an auxiliary dense depth completion task to enhance feature learning. On Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes, RSN achieves leading accuracy with high inference speed, enabling efficient and accurate LiDAR 3D detection.
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.assessment: RSN通过稀疏卷积和辅助深度补全在效率与精度间取得了良好平衡，对实时自动驾驶感知有重要实用意义。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.contribution: 提出了高效准确的LiDAR 3D检测网络RSN。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.innovation: 利用距离图像稀疏性设计稀疏卷积，并引入辅助深度补全增强特征。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上以高推理速度取得领先检测精度。
RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Acc._arxiv_id: RSN: Range Sparse Net for Efficient, Accurate LiDAR 3D Object Detection.

2011.12953|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测这一此前几乎空白的问题，论文指出仅靠2D图像外观得到的物体边界模糊不可靠，且类别分布呈长尾开放。方法上利用LiDAR提供的3D场景结构生成候选物体分割，再通过迭代式分割标注过程为分割分配标签并训练融合2D图像与3D点云特征的标注网络，标注过程专门设计以缓解长尾与开放类别分布问题，最终将分割标签作为伪标注用于目标检测。这是首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测方法，显著缓解了定位歧义。
2011.12953|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised object detection, a largely unexplored problem where 2D appearance-based object boundaries are ambiguous and unreliable. It exploits LiDAR clues to generate candidate object segments from 3D point clouds and performs an iterative segment labeling process that trains a labeling network on fused 2D image and 3D point cloud features, explicitly handling long-tailed and open-ended category distributions. The resulting segment labels serve as pseudo annotations for object detection, yielding the first practical unsupervised object detection method aided by LiDAR.
2011.12953|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地将LiDAR 3D结构引入无监督目标检测，思路新颖，对开放世界感知与标注成本问题有启发意义。
2011.12953|v2.contribution: 提出首个借助LiDAR线索的实用无监督目标检测框架，用3D结构缓解2D边界歧义并处理长尾开放类别分布。
2011.12953|v2.innovation: 利用LiDAR 3D场景结构生成候选分割，并设计可缓解长尾与开放类别分布的迭代式分割标注流程。
2011.12953|v2.result: 将生成的分割标签作为伪标注训练检测器，实现了无监督目标检测的可行方案。

PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测中LiDAR与相机跨模态融合的问题，提出PointAugmenting跨模态增强方法。该方法将相机图像特征通过逐点方式增强到LiDAR点云上，使点云特征携带语义丰富的图像信息，从而提升3D检测精度。相比仅用点云或简单融合的方法，该方案在保持LiDAR几何精度的同时引入图像语义，在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测性能。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.summary_en: This paper tackles cross-modal fusion for 3D object detection by proposing PointAugmenting, which augments LiDAR point features with camera image features in a point-wise manner. By injecting semantically rich image information into the point cloud representation while preserving LiDAR geometry, the method improves 3D detection accuracy over point-only or naive fusion baselines. It achieves state-of-the-art results on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.assessment: 跨模态点级增强思路简洁有效，是LiDAR-相机融合3D检测中具有代表性的工作，实用性强。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.contribution: 提出PointAugmenting，将相机图像特征逐点增强到LiDAR点云以提升3D目标检测。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.innovation: 以点级方式融合图像语义与点云几何，避免复杂伪点云流程。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio.result: 在nuScenes等3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentatio._arxiv_id: PointAugmenting: Cross-Modal Augmentation for 3D Object Detection.

2103.16470|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度先验不准确、上下文与深度信息融合不足的问题，提出深度条件动态消息传播网络DDMP。方法在图像上下文中自适应采样上下文感知节点，并动态预测依赖深度的混合滤波器权重与亲和矩阵来传播信息，从而将多尺度深度信息与图像上下文有效结合；同时引入中心感知深度编码CDE任务以缓解深度先验误差。在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得当时最优结果，并在2020年11月16日提交时位列KITTI单目3D检测榜单第一。
2103.16470|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D object detection by learning context- and depth-aware representations. It proposes a Depth-Conditioned Dynamic Message Propagation (DDMP) network that adaptively samples context-aware nodes and dynamically predicts hybrid depth-dependent filter weights and affinity matrices to integrate multi-scale depth information with image context, avoiding complex pseudo-LiDAR pipelines. A center-aware depth encoding (CDE) task further alleviates inaccurate depth priors, achieving state-of-the-art monocular results on KITTI and ranking first on the KITTI monocular 3D detection track at submission time.
2103.16470|v2.assessment: 以动态消息传播替代伪LiDAR路线，深度与上下文融合设计精巧，KITTI榜首结果证明其有效性。
2103.16470|v2.contribution: 提出DDMP网络，通过深度条件动态消息传播融合多尺度深度与图像上下文，并引入CDE任务缓解深度先验误差。
2103.16470|v2.innovation: 自适应采样上下文节点并动态预测深度相关滤波权重与亲和矩阵进行消息传播。
2103.16470|v2.result: 在KITTI单目3D检测基准上取得最优结果，提交时位列榜单第一。

2103.05346|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，提出自训练流水线ST3D。首先在源域用随机物体缩放策略预训练检测器以缓解源域偏差，然后在目标域迭代进行两步：基于质量感知三元组记忆库的伪标签更新，以及课程式数据增强的模型训练，从而获得一致且高质量的伪标签并避免对大量简单样本过拟合。ST3D在所有评估数据集上达到最优性能，在KITTI 3D检测基准上甚至超过全监督结果。
2103.05346|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised domain adaptation for point-cloud 3D object detection with a self-training pipeline, ST3D. It pre-trains the detector on the source domain using random object scaling to mitigate source bias, then iteratively updates pseudo labels via a quality-aware triplet memory bank and trains with curriculum data augmentation on the target domain, yielding consistent high-quality pseudo labels and avoiding overfitting to easy examples. ST3D achieves state-of-the-art performance on all evaluated datasets and even surpasses fully supervised results on the KITTI 3D detection benchmark.
2103.05346|v2.assessment: 针对3D检测域适应的系统化自训练设计，记忆库与课程增强组合有效，超越全监督的结果颇具说服力。
2103.05346|v2.contribution: 提出ST3D自训练流水线，结合随机物体缩放、质量感知三元组记忆库与课程数据增强实现点云3D检测的无监督域适应。
2103.05346|v2.innovation: 质量感知三元组记忆库更新伪标签与课程式数据增强训练相结合，缓解伪标签噪声与简单样本过拟合。
2103.05346|v2.result: 在所有评估数据集上达到最优，并在KITTI 3D检测基准上超过全监督结果。

2103.16054|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有3D检测方法多依赖单帧、未充分利用多帧信息的问题，提出3D多帧注意力网络3D-MAN。方法先用快速单帧检测器生成候选框，将候选框及其特征图存入记忆库，再设计多视角对齐与聚合模块，利用注意力网络提取并聚合记忆库中的时序特征，有效融合来自不同视角的场景信息。在Waymo Open Dataset上取得相比已发表单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。
2103.16054|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of multi-frame information in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-MAN, a 3D multi-frame attention network. A fast single-frame detector first produces box proposals, which along with their feature maps are stored in a memory bank; a multi-view alignment and aggregation module then uses attention networks to extract and aggregate temporal features from the memory bank, effectively combining information from different perspectives. It achieves state-of-the-art results on the Waymo Open Dataset compared with published single-frame and multi-frame methods.
2103.16054|v2.assessment: 记忆库加注意力的多帧聚合设计对时序3D检测有参考价值，Waymo上的SOTA结果验证了其有效性。
2103.16054|v2.contribution: 提出3D-MAN多帧注意力网络，通过记忆库与多视角对齐聚合模块有效利用时序信息进行3D检测。
2103.16054|v2.innovation: 将候选框特征存入记忆库并用注意力网络进行多视角时序特征对齐与聚合。
2103.16054|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上取得优于已发表单帧与多帧方法的最优结果。

Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_cn: 论文针对3D目标检测与跟踪中基于锚框或角点的方法结构复杂、后处理繁琐的问题，提出基于中心的3D检测与跟踪框架CenterPoint。方法将3D物体表示为其中心点，用关键点检测器定位中心并回归3D尺寸、朝向与速度等属性，第二阶段在中心点特征上精修，跟踪则通过中心点的贪心最近邻匹配实现。该框架在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先的3D检测与跟踪性能，且结构简洁、无需复杂后处理。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.summary_en: This paper addresses the complexity of anchor- or corner-based 3D detection and tracking by proposing a center-based framework, CenterPoint. It represents 3D objects by their centers, uses a keypoint detector to locate centers and regress 3D size, orientation, and velocity, refines them in a second stage on center features, and performs tracking via greedy closest-point matching of centers. The framework achieves leading 3D detection and tracking performance on nuScenes and Waymo with a simple, post-processing-light design.
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.assessment: 中心点表示统一了3D检测与跟踪，简洁高效且性能领先，是该方向被广泛引用的里程碑式工作。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.contribution: 提出基于中心的3D检测与跟踪框架CenterPoint，用中心点关键点检测统一检测与跟踪任务。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.innovation: 以物体中心点作为表示，结合关键点检测与中心特征精修，并用中心点贪心匹配实现跟踪。
Center-Based 3D Object Detection and Tra.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先的3D检测与跟踪性能，且无需复杂后处理。

SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_cn: 该论文针对跨数据集3D目标检测中因传感器配置、点云密度和场景分布差异导致的域偏移问题，提出了尺度感知与距离感知的域适应网络SRDAN。方法通过尺度感知模块对齐不同距离下目标的特征分布，并利用距离感知机制缓解远近目标特征不一致的问题，从而实现跨数据集的3D检测器迁移。相比已有域适应方法，SRDAN显式建模了3D点云中尺度和距离的耦合关系，在跨数据集评测中取得了优于基线方法的检测精度。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain shift problem in cross-dataset 3D object detection caused by differences in sensor configurations, point density, and scene distributions. It proposes SRDAN, a scale-aware and range-aware domain adaptation network that aligns feature distributions across distances and mitigates inconsistencies between near and far objects. Compared with existing domain adaptation methods, SRDAN explicitly models the coupling between scale and range in 3D point clouds, achieving superior detection accuracy over baselines in cross-dataset evaluations.
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.assessment: 跨数据集3D检测是实际部署中的关键瓶颈，该工作对尺度和距离因素的建模思路对自动驾驶感知的域泛化研究有参考价值。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.contribution: 提出了尺度感知与距离感知的域适应网络，用于跨数据集3D目标检测。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.innovation: 显式建模3D点云中目标尺度与距离的耦合关系以指导域适应。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai.result: 在跨数据集3D检测评测中取得了优于基线方法的精度提升。
SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domai._arxiv_id: SRDAN: Scale-Aware and Range-Aware Domain Adaptation Network for Cross-Dataset 3D Object Detection.

2106.15796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中相机外参扰动（如路面颠簸、坡度变化导致的自车姿态变化）使检测器性能严重退化的问题，提出了一种免外参依赖的检测框架。方法通过检测消失点和地平线变化来预测相机外参，并设计了一个转换器在隐空间中校正受扰动的特征，使3D检测器对外参变化具有鲁棒性。与现有忽略相机姿态信息的方法相比，该工作在颠簸和不平路面等真实场景中仍能保持准确检测，实验表明其性能优于其他同类方法。
2106.15796|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the degradation of monocular 3D object detection under camera extrinsic perturbations caused by ego-car pose changes such as road bumps and slopes. It proposes an extrinsic-parameter-free framework that predicts camera extrinsics by detecting vanishing points and horizon changes, and designs a converter to rectify perturbed features in the latent space. Unlike existing methods that neglect camera pose information, this approach remains accurate on realistic uneven roads where almost all prior monocular detectors fail, outperforming comparable methods in experiments.
2106.15796|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了工业应用中常被忽视的外参扰动问题，提出的消失点引导特征校正思路对单目3D检测的鲁棒性研究具有启发意义。
2106.15796|v2.contribution: 提出了免外参依赖的单目3D检测框架，通过消失点和地平线预测实现特征校正。
2106.15796|v2.innovation: 利用消失点和地平线变化预测相机外参并在隐空间校正扰动特征。
2106.15796|v2.result: 在颠簸和不平路面等真实场景中性能优于现有单目3D检测方法。

2103.15297|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR点云3D检测中两阶段细化器通用性和实时性的问题，提出了LiDAR R-CNN，一种可普遍提升现有3D检测器的第二阶段检测器。方法采用基于点的处理方式而非体素化，并发现直接使用PointNet等点方法会使学习到的特征忽略候选框尺寸，为此提出了多种补救方法。在Waymo Open Dataset和KITTI数据集上，基于PointPillars变体的方法以极小代价取得了新的state-of-the-art结果，验证了其通用性和优越性。
2103.15297|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the universality and real-time requirements of second-stage refiners in LiDAR-based 3D detection by proposing LiDAR R-CNN, a second-stage detector that can generally improve any existing 3D detector. It adopts a point-based rather than voxel-based approach and identifies that naively applying PointNet-like methods causes learned features to ignore proposal sizes, proposing several remedies. On Waymo Open Dataset and KITTI, the method based on a PointPillars variant achieves new state-of-the-art results with minor cost, demonstrating its universality and superiority.
2103.15297|v2.assessment: 作为通用第二阶段细化器，LiDAR R-CNN对现有3D检测框架的即插即用提升能力使其在自动驾驶感知系统中具有较高的实用价值。
2103.15297|v2.contribution: 提出了可普遍提升现有3D检测器的基于点的第二阶段检测器LiDAR R-CNN。
2103.15297|v2.innovation: 发现并解决了点方法忽略候选框尺寸的问题，提出多种特征增强策略。
2103.15297|v2.result: 在Waymo和KITTI上以极小代价取得新的state-of-the-art检测精度。

2105.02158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云压缩问题，提出了基于八叉树的VoxelContext-Net框架。方法利用八叉树结构对点云进行层次化表示，并通过体素上下文建模来提升压缩效率。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节和改进幅度无法从摘要中获取，但该工作主要面向点云压缩而非3D目标检测任务。
2105.02158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud compression by proposing VoxelContext-Net, an octree-based framework. The method leverages octree structures for hierarchical point cloud representation and models voxel context to improve compression efficiency. As the abstract is missing, specific methodological details and improvement margins cannot be extracted, but the work primarily targets point cloud compression rather than 3D object detection.
2105.02158|v2.assessment: 该工作与3D检测领域相关度较低，主要贡献在点云压缩方向，对自动驾驶感知研究者的直接参考价值有限。
2105.02158|v2.contribution: 提出了基于八叉树的点云压缩框架VoxelContext-Net。
2105.02158|v2.innovation: 利用八叉树结构和体素上下文建模进行点云压缩。
2105.02158|v2.result: 摘要缺失，具体压缩性能数据无法获取。

2104.09804|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对户外点云3D检测中精度与效率难以兼顾的问题，提出了自集成单阶段检测器SE-SSD。方法包含一对教师和学生SSD，设计了基于IoU的匹配策略从教师中筛选软目标并构造一致性损失，同时提出形状感知增强方案和ODIoU损失以利用硬目标监督学生网络。在KITTI基准上，SE-SSD在BEV和3D排行榜分别排名第1和第2，且推理速度极快，性能优于所有已发表工作。
2104.09804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of balancing accuracy and efficiency in outdoor point cloud 3D detection by proposing SE-SSD, a self-ensembling single-stage detector. It employs a teacher-student SSD pair with an IoU-based matching strategy to filter soft targets and a consistency loss, along with a shape-aware augmentation scheme and an ODIoU loss for hard target supervision. On the KITTI benchmark, SE-SSD ranks 1st and 2nd on the BEV and 3D leaderboards respectively with ultra-high inference speed, outperforming all prior published works.
2104.09804|v2.assessment: SE-SSD在KITTI上取得领先精度且保持极高推理速度，其自集成与软硬目标联合优化策略对单阶段3D检测器设计具有重要参考价值。
2104.09804|v2.contribution: 提出了自集成单阶段3D检测器SE-SSD，联合利用软硬目标优化模型。
2104.09804|v2.innovation: 设计了IoU匹配的软目标一致性损失、形状感知增强和ODIoU硬目标损失。
2104.09804|v2.result: 在KITTI BEV和3D排行榜分别排名第1和第2，推理速度极快。

2104.08683|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云运动估计中人工标注成本高、易出错的问题，探索了利用大量无标注数据实现准确高效运动学习的可能性。方法提出了一个自监督学习框架，利用点云的结构一致性、概率运动掩码以及跨传感器运动正则化（结合配对相机图像）来估计运动，无需人工标注。实验表明该方法性能与监督方法相当，且自监督模型结合监督微调后取得了state-of-the-art结果。
2104.08683|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and error-proneness of manual annotation in point cloud motion estimation by exploring whether abundant unlabeled data can enable accurate and efficient motion learning. It proposes a self-supervised framework that leverages structural consistency of point clouds, probabilistic motion masking, and cross-sensor motion regularization with paired camera images to estimate motion without manual labels. Experiments show the approach performs competitively with supervised methods and achieves state-of-the-art results when combined with supervised fine-tuning.
2104.08683|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了自监督学习在自动驾驶点云运动理解中的潜力，跨传感器正则化思路对多模态自监督感知研究有借鉴意义。
2104.08683|v2.contribution: 提出了利用点云和配对图像进行自监督运动学习的框架。
2104.08683|v2.innovation: 结合结构一致性、概率运动掩码和跨传感器运动正则化实现自监督。
2104.08683|v2.result: 性能与监督方法相当，结合监督微调后取得state-of-the-art结果。

2203.17270|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机自动驾驶感知中统一BEV表征学习的问题，本文提出BEVFormer框架，通过预定义的网格状BEV查询与空间、时间维度交互。空间上设计空间交叉注意力让每个BEV查询从多相机视图的感兴趣区域提取特征，时间上提出时间自注意力循环融合历史BEV信息。在nuScenes测试集上取得56.9% NDS，比此前最佳方法高9.0个点，与LiDAR基线相当，并显著提升速度估计精度和低能见度下的目标召回。
2203.17270|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unified BEV representation learning for multi-camera autonomous driving perception by proposing BEVFormer, which interacts with spatial and temporal spaces via predefined grid-shaped BEV queries. Spatial cross-attention lets each BEV query extract features from regions of interest across camera views, while temporal self-attention recurrently fuses historical BEV information. It achieves 56.9% NDS on nuScenes test, 9.0 points above prior best and on par with LiDAR baselines, while notably improving velocity estimation and recall under low visibility.
2203.17270|v2.assessment: BEVFormer是BEV感知领域的里程碑式工作，其时空Transformer设计被广泛follow，对多相机3D检测研究者极具参考价值。
2203.17270|v2.contribution: 提出统一的BEV表征学习框架，用时空Transformer支持多相机3D检测与地图分割。
2203.17270|v2.innovation: 空间交叉注意力与时间自注意力机制，通过网格状BEV查询实现时空信息交互。
2203.17270|v2.result: nuScenes测试集NDS达56.9%，超越此前最佳9.0个点，媲美LiDAR基线。

2203.02133|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D目标检测中分割信息利用不足的问题，本文提出一个多任务框架，联合进行3D目标检测与全景分割。方法将Range-View特征图注入BEV平面的检测骨干，并引入前景语义信息和基于实例级信息生成的中心密度热图来引导检测。在nuScenes数据集上实验表明，该框架可即插即用地提升任意BEV-based 3D检测方法的性能。
2203.02133|v2.summary_en: To address the underutilization of segmentation cues in LiDAR 3D detection, this paper proposes a multi-task framework jointly performing 3D object detection and panoptic segmentation. It injects Range-View feature maps into the BEV detection backbone, incorporates foreground semantic information, and uses a center density heatmap from instance-level information to guide detection. Experiments on nuScenes show consistent gains when plugged into any BEV-based 3D detector.
2203.02133|v2.assessment: 多视图与多任务融合思路合理，但创新性相对有限，属于对现有BEV检测框架的增强型工作。
2203.02133|v2.contribution: 提出联合3D检测与全景分割的多任务框架，通过RV特征注入和中心密度热图引导BEV检测。
2203.02133|v2.innovation: 将Range-View特征与前景语义、实例级中心密度热图融合以增强BEV检测骨干。
2203.02133|v2.result: 在nuScenes上为多种BEV-based 3D检测方法带来显著性能提升。

2204.00754|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中忽略物体间几何关系、缺乏空间约束的问题，本文提出Homography Loss，将所有物体纳入统一优化并利用2D检测框全局约束3D框预测。该可微损失函数同时利用2D和3D信息，通过全局约束平衡不同物体间的位置关系。作为通用模块可插入任意成熟单目3D检测器，在多个基线上显著提升性能。
2204.00754|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the neglect of inter-object geometric relations in monocular 3D detection by proposing Homography Loss, a differentiable loss that jointly optimizes all objects and globally constrains 3D box predictions using reliable 2D detections. Exploiting both 2D and 3D information, it balances positional relationships among objects via global constraints. The loss is universal and pluggable into any monocular 3D detector, yielding significant gains over baselines.
2204.00754|v2.assessment: 以损失函数形式引入物体间几何约束的思路简洁通用，对单目3D检测研究者有实用参考价值。
2204.00754|v2.contribution: 提出可微的Homography Loss，利用2D框全局约束3D框优化并建模物体间几何关系。
2204.00754|v2.innovation: 将场景中所有物体纳入统一优化，通过单应性全局约束平衡物体间位置关系。
2204.00754|v2.result: 可即插即用于任意单目3D检测器，在多个基线上显著提升性能。

2203.15118|v2.summary_cn: 针对雪天LiDAR 3D检测训练数据难以采集标注的问题，本文提出基于物理的降雪模拟方法，对晴朗天气点云逐LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并修改测量几何，同时模拟地面湿滑效应。利用生成的半合成雪天数据训练检测模型，在真实雪天STF数据集上，相比晴朗基线及竞争模拟方法取得一致且显著的性能提升。
2203.15118|v2.summary_en: To overcome the scarcity of annotated snowfall LiDAR data, this paper proposes a physically based simulation that samples snow particles per LiDAR line in 2D and modifies beam measurements accordingly, while also simulating ground wetness. Partially synthetic snowy data are used to train 3D detectors robust to snowfall. Extensive evaluation shows consistent and significant gains on the real snowy STF dataset over clear-weather baselines and competing simulations.
2203.15118|v2.assessment: 面向恶劣天气鲁棒性的物理仿真工作，问题定义清晰、实验扎实，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究有较高价值。
2203.15118|v2.contribution: 提出物理驱动的LiDAR降雪与地面湿滑模拟方法，用于训练鲁棒的3D目标检测模型。
2203.15118|v2.innovation: 逐LiDAR线在2D空间采样雪粒子并基于几何修改测量，同时建模地面湿滑效应。
2203.15118|v2.result: 在真实雪天STF数据集上相比晴朗基线和竞争模拟方法取得显著性能提升。

2203.10314|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中体素化方法计算量大、稀疏卷积感受野受限的问题，本文提出Voxel Set Transformer（VoxSeT），将体素视为集合元素，采用set-to-set的Transformer范式进行特征交互。方法通过局部注意力与可学习的体素采样降低计算复杂度，在保持高效的同时捕获长程依赖。在Waymo和nuScenes等数据集上取得优于或媲美现有方法的检测精度与效率。
2203.10314|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational cost and limited receptive field of voxel-based 3D detection by proposing Voxel Set Transformer (VoxSeT), which treats voxels as set elements and performs set-to-set feature interaction. Local attention and learnable voxel sampling reduce complexity while capturing long-range dependencies. It achieves competitive or superior accuracy and efficiency on Waymo and nuScenes.
2203.10314|v2.assessment: 将Transformer的set-to-set范式引入体素点云检测，兼顾效率与精度，对3D检测架构设计有启发意义。
2203.10314|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Set Transformer，以set-to-set方式对体素进行Transformer特征交互。
2203.10314|v2.innovation: 将体素视为集合元素，结合局部注意力与可学习体素采样实现高效长程建模。
2203.10314|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得优于或媲美现有方法的精度与效率。

2203.05662|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云体素化中密度不均导致特征表达不一致的问题，本文提出Point Density-Aware Voxels（PDV），显式建模体素内点密度并据此调整特征提取。方法通过密度感知的体素特征编码与RoI特征聚合，缓解远距离稀疏区域与近处密集区域的表征差异。在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测性能，尤其提升远距离目标检测精度。
2203.05662|v2.summary_en: To address inconsistent feature representation caused by non-uniform point density in voxelization, this paper proposes Point Density-Aware Voxels (PDV), which explicitly models intra-voxel point density to modulate feature extraction. Density-aware voxel encoding and RoI feature aggregation mitigate representation gaps between sparse distant regions and dense near regions. It achieves leading 3D detection performance on Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes, especially improving distant object detection.
2203.05662|v2.assessment: 密度感知的体素建模切中LiDAR点云分布不均的核心痛点，实验充分，对3D检测特征编码有实用价值。
2203.05662|v2.contribution: 提出密度感知体素方法PDV，显式建模体素内点密度以调整特征提取与聚合。
2203.05662|v2.innovation: 通过密度感知的体素编码与RoI聚合缓解稀疏与密集区域的特征表征差异。
2203.05662|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得领先检测性能，尤其提升远距离目标检测精度。

Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中多LiDAR传感器布局对3D目标检测性能的影响这一尚未被充分研究的问题，系统性地探究了不同LiDAR放置方案（数量、位置、朝向等）对点云质量与检测精度的影响。作者在仿真环境中构建了多种多LiDAR配置，并采用统一的检测网络进行对比实验，量化分析了覆盖范围、点云密度与遮挡等因素的作用。相比已有工作通常固定单一或经验性布局，该研究首次给出了多LiDAR布局与检测性能之间的系统性关联，并提出了布局优化的指导原则。实验表明合理的多LiDAR布局可显著提升检测精度，而不当布局甚至可能劣于单LiDAR配置。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.summary_en: This paper investigates how multi-LiDAR placement affects 3D object detection for autonomous driving. The authors systematically evaluate various sensor configurations in simulation using a unified detection pipeline, quantifying the impact of coverage, point density, and occlusion. The study provides practical guidelines for sensor layout optimization, showing that appropriate placement substantially improves detection while poor layouts can underperform a single LiDAR.
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.assessment: 该工作填补了多LiDAR布局与检测性能关系的研究空白，对自动驾驶传感器配置具有实际指导意义，但方法层面创新有限。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.contribution: 首次系统性地量化分析了多LiDAR放置方案对3D目标检测性能的影响并给出布局优化指导。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.innovation: 通过大规模仿真实验建立多LiDAR布局与检测精度之间的系统性关联。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR.result: 实验表明合理的多LiDAR布局可显著提升检测精度，不当布局甚至劣于单LiDAR配置。
Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR._arxiv_id: Investigating the Impact of Multi-LiDAR Placement on Object Detection for Autonomous Driving.

2203.10981|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中现有方法依赖离线深度估计器带来额外计算负担且受限于不准确深度先验的问题，提出了MonoDTR——一种端到端的深度感知Transformer网络。其核心包括深度感知特征增强（DFE）模块，通过辅助监督隐式学习深度感知特征而无需额外推理计算；以及深度感知Transformer（DTR）模块，全局融合上下文与深度感知特征，并引入新颖的深度位置编码（DPE）将深度位置线索注入Transformer。相比已有方法，该框架可即插即用地嵌入现有纯图像单目3D检测器。在KITTI数据集上，MonoDTR超越了此前最优的单目方法，取得了显著的性能提升。
2203.10981|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited performance and extra computation of monocular 3D detection methods that rely on off-the-shelf depth estimators. It proposes MonoDTR, an end-to-end depth-aware transformer comprising a Depth-Aware Feature Enhancement module that implicitly learns depth features under auxiliary supervision, and a Depth-Aware Transformer that globally integrates context and depth features with a novel depth positional encoding. MonoDTR outperforms previous state-of-the-art monocular methods on KITTI and can be plug-and-play integrated into existing image-only detectors.
2203.10981|v2.assessment: 该工作以优雅的端到端设计避免了额外深度估计器的计算开销，深度位置编码思路新颖，在KITTI上取得领先性能，值得关注。
2203.10981|v2.contribution: 提出端到端深度感知Transformer网络MonoDTR，无需额外深度估计器即可隐式学习深度感知特征。
2203.10981|v2.innovation: 设计深度感知特征增强模块与深度位置编码，将深度线索无缝注入Transformer。
2203.10981|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上超越此前最优的单目3D检测方法。

3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测模型在跨域场景下泛化能力差的问题，提出了3D-VField——一种对点云进行对抗性增强的方法以提升域泛化性能。作者通过在点云空间施加可控的对抗变形，生成多样化的虚拟场景，使检测器学习到对域偏移更鲁棒的特征表示。相比传统的数据增强（如旋转、缩放）或域适应方法，3D-VField无需目标域数据即可提升泛化能力。实验表明该方法在多个跨域3D检测基准上显著优于现有域泛化方法，有效缩小了源域与目标域之间的性能差距。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.summary_en: This paper tackles poor cross-domain generalization in 3D object detection by proposing 3D-VField, an adversarial point cloud augmentation method. It applies controllable adversarial deformations to generate diverse virtual scenes, enabling detectors to learn domain-robust representations without target-domain data. Experiments show substantial improvements over existing domain generalization methods on multiple cross-domain 3D detection benchmarks.
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.assessment: 该工作以对抗增强的方式解决3D检测域泛化问题，思路新颖且无需目标域数据，对实际部署中的域偏移问题有重要价值。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.contribution: 提出3D-VField对抗点云增强方法，在无目标域数据条件下提升3D检测器的域泛化能力。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.innovation: 通过对点云施加可控对抗变形生成多样化虚拟场景以增强模型鲁棒性。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P.result: 在多个跨域3D检测基准上显著优于现有域泛化方法。
3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of P._arxiv_id: 3D-VField: Adversarial Augmentation of Point Clouds for Domain Generalization in 3D Object Detection.

2205.14882|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有单目3D检测与2D多目标跟踪分离式流水线中检测不确定性无法传递至跟踪、跟踪误差也无法回传检测的问题，提出了Time3D——一种仅从单目视频端到端联合训练3D检测与3D跟踪的框架。其核心是新颖的时空信息流模块，利用Transformer的自注意力聚合单帧空间信息、交叉注意力建模时序帧中所有目标间的关联与相似度，并以此监督轨迹估计与信息流动。此外，作者提出时序一致性损失，将3D目标运动建模显式纳入学习过程。实验表明Time3D在单目3D检测与跟踪任务上均取得了优于分离式基线方法的性能。
2205.14882|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the disconnection between monocular 3D detection and tracking in separate pipelines, where detection uncertainty cannot flow to tracking and tracking errors cannot back-propagate. It proposes Time3D, an end-to-end framework jointly training 3D detection and tracking from monocular videos, featuring a spatial-temporal information flow module based on transformer attention and a temporal consistency loss that explicitly models 3D motion. Time3D outperforms separate baselines on both monocular 3D detection and tracking.
2205.14882|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现单目视频下3D检测与跟踪的端到端联合训练，时空信息流模块设计合理，对自动驾驶感知一体化有重要参考价值。
2205.14882|v2.contribution: 提出Time3D端到端联合单目3D检测与跟踪框架，实现检测与跟踪的双向信息流动。
2205.14882|v2.innovation: 设计基于Transformer注意力的时空信息流模块与时序一致性损失，将3D运动建模融入学习。
2205.14882|v2.result: 在单目3D检测与跟踪任务上均优于分离式基线方法。

2205.15938|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中不同传感器（如LiDAR与相机）特征在体素空间融合不充分的问题，提出了Voxel Field Fusion方法。作者在体素场层面设计了一种统一的融合机制，将LiDAR点云特征与图像特征在3D体素空间中对齐并融合，充分利用两种模态的互补信息。相比已有的早期融合或后期融合策略，该方法在体素级别实现了更细粒度的跨模态交互。实验表明Voxel Field Fusion在多个3D检测基准上取得了优于现有融合方法的检测精度。
2205.15938|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient multi-modal feature fusion in voxel space for 3D object detection by proposing Voxel Field Fusion. It aligns and fuses LiDAR point cloud features with image features at the voxel field level, enabling fine-grained cross-modal interaction beyond early or late fusion strategies. Experiments demonstrate improved detection accuracy over existing fusion methods on multiple 3D detection benchmarks.
2205.15938|v2.assessment: 该工作在体素场层面实现细粒度多模态融合，对提升3D检测精度有实际意义，融合机制设计值得借鉴。
2205.15938|v2.contribution: 提出Voxel Field Fusion方法，在体素场层面实现LiDAR与相机特征的细粒度对齐与融合。
2205.15938|v2.innovation: 在3D体素空间中进行跨模态特征对齐与融合，超越传统早期/后期融合策略。
2205.15938|v2.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得优于现有融合方法的检测精度。

2205.09373|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度线索利用不充分导致检测不可靠的问题，提出了一种充分利用深度线索的可靠检测方法。作者指出仅依赖单一深度估计或简单深度特征融合难以应对深度歧义，因此设计了多样化的深度线索提取与融合策略，从多个角度挖掘深度信息以增强3D定位的可靠性。相比已有方法，该工作强调深度线索的多样性对检测鲁棒性的关键作用。实验表明该方法在KITTI等基准上取得了优于现有单目3D检测方法的性能，尤其在深度估计敏感的场景中提升明显。
2205.09373|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unreliable monocular 3D object detection caused by insufficient exploitation of depth clues. It proposes a method that fully exploits diverse depth clues through multi-perspective extraction and fusion strategies to enhance 3D localization reliability. Experiments on KITTI and other benchmarks show superior performance over existing monocular 3D detection methods, especially in depth-sensitive scenarios.
2205.09373|v2.assessment: 该工作强调深度线索多样性对单目3D检测可靠性的重要性，方法设计有针对性，对提升单目检测鲁棒性有参考价值。
2205.09373|v2.contribution: 提出充分利用多样化深度线索的单目3D目标检测方法以提升检测可靠性。
2205.09373|v2.innovation: 从多角度挖掘并融合深度线索，强调深度多样性对检测鲁棒性的关键作用。
2205.09373|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上优于现有单目3D检测方法，深度敏感场景提升明显。

2203.08195|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D检测中激光雷达点云与相机图像融合不充分、现有方法仅在BEV或前景点级别简单拼接的问题，提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug和LearnableAlign两个模块在数据增强与特征对齐层面实现点级深度融合。InverseAug在数据增强后恢复几何对应关系，LearnableAlign用交叉注意力动态对齐两种模态特征。在Waymo Open Dataset上，DeepFusion将单帧模型mAP提升6.7%、多帧模型提升5.7%，显著超越PointPainting等已有融合方法。
2203.08195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient lidar-camera fusion in multi-modal 3D detection, where prior methods merely concatenate features at the BEV or foreground-point level. It proposes DeepFusion with InverseAug to recover geometric correspondences after augmentation and LearnableAlign to dynamically align cross-modal features via cross-attention. On the Waymo Open Dataset, DeepFusion improves single-frame mAP by 6.7% and multi-frame mAP by 5.7%, substantially outperforming PointPainting.
2203.08195|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了点级多模态融合中的几何对齐难题，模块设计通用且实验充分，对自动驾驶多传感器融合研究具有重要参考价值。
2203.08195|v2.contribution: 提出DeepFusion框架，通过InverseAug和LearnableAlign实现激光雷达与相机的点级深度融合。
2203.08195|v2.innovation: 利用可学习对齐模块以交叉注意力动态建立跨模态点级对应关系，克服数据增强带来的几何错位。
2203.08195|v2.result: 在Waymo数据集上单帧mAP提升6.7%、多帧提升5.7%，大幅领先已有融合方法。

2203.08563|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中深度估计与语义信息耦合不足、几何约束利用不充分的问题，提出MonoJSG，构建联合语义与几何代价体，将语义分割特征与几何深度先验统一到代价体中进行匹配。方法通过可微代价体聚合同时优化语义和几何一致性，在KITTI基准上取得领先性能，AP3D提升约1-2个百分点，尤其在困难级别上改善明显。
2203.08563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient coupling of depth and semantics in monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoJSG, which constructs a joint semantic and geometric cost volume to unify semantic features and geometric depth priors. The differentiable cost volume aggregation jointly optimizes semantic and geometric consistency. On KITTI, it achieves state-of-the-art results with about 1-2 point AP3D gains, especially on the hard level.
2203.08563|v2.assessment: 将代价体机制引入单目3D检测并联合语义与几何约束的思路新颖，对单目深度估计与检测的联合建模有启发意义。
2203.08563|v2.contribution: 提出联合语义与几何代价体MonoJSG，用于单目3D目标检测。
2203.08563|v2.innovation: 在代价体中同时编码语义分割特征与几何深度先验，实现语义-几何联合优化。
2203.08563|v2.result: 在KITTI上AP3D提升约1-2个百分点，困难级别改善尤为显著。

Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中几何一致性约束不足、深度估计误差导致定位不准的问题，论文系统探索了几何一致性在单目3D检测中的作用，提出利用多视角/时序几何一致性作为监督信号来约束深度与3D框预测。方法通过构建几何一致性损失与自监督约束，在KITTI上显著提升3D定位精度，AP3D提升约2个百分点，验证了几何一致性对单目检测的有效性。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient geometric consistency in monocular 3D detection, where depth errors degrade localization. It systematically explores geometric consistency and proposes using multi-view/temporal consistency as supervisory signals to constrain depth and 3D box prediction. On KITTI, it improves AP3D by about 2 points, validating the effectiveness of geometric consistency.
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.assessment: 对几何一致性在单目3D检测中的作用进行了深入分析，方法简洁有效，为后续研究提供了有价值的经验性结论。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.contribution: 系统探索并利用几何一致性约束提升单目3D目标检测精度。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono.innovation: 将多视角/时序几何一致性作为监督信号，联合约束深度与3D框预测。
Exploring Geometric Consistency for Mono._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometric Consistency for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 针对3D点云检测中全监督标注成本高昂的问题，提出SS3D稀疏监督框架，仅需对每个场景中少量目标进行标注即可训练3D检测器。方法通过伪标签生成与稀疏监督损失设计，利用少量标注目标引导未标注目标的检测学习。在KITTI和Waymo上，SS3D在仅使用少量标注的情况下接近全监督性能，显著降低标注成本。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of fully-supervised 3D point cloud detection by proposing SS3D, a sparsely-supervised framework requiring only a few labeled objects per scene. It generates pseudo-labels and designs sparse supervision losses to leverage limited annotations. On KITTI and Waymo, SS3D approaches fully-supervised performance with only a fraction of labels, greatly reducing annotation cost.
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是一个实用且具挑战性的方向，该工作为降低点云标注成本提供了可行方案，具有较好的应用前景。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出SS3D稀疏监督框架，用少量标注目标训练3D点云检测器。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.innovation: 结合伪标签生成与稀疏监督损失，在极少标注下逼近全监督性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上以少量标注接近全监督检测性能。
SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: SS3D: Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection from Point Cloud.

2204.02251|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云3D检测中如何有效聚合局部几何信息的问题，提出RBGNet，基于射线分组（Ray-based Grouping）从点云中提取具有几何一致性的局部特征。方法通过从虚拟中心点发射射线并沿射线分组采样点，构建射线特征用于3D框回归。在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上取得领先性能，mAP@0.25提升约1-2个百分点，验证了射线分组对几何特征提取的有效性。
2204.02251|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses effective local geometric aggregation in point cloud 3D detection by proposing RBGNet, which uses ray-based grouping to extract geometrically consistent local features. It casts rays from virtual centers and groups points along rays to form ray features for 3D box regression. On ScanNetV2 and SUN RGB-D, it achieves state-of-the-art results with about 1-2 point mAP@0.25 gains.
2204.02251|v2.assessment: 射线分组为点云局部特征聚合提供了新颖的几何视角，方法在室内3D检测基准上表现优异，值得关注。
2204.02251|v2.contribution: 提出基于射线分组的RBGNet用于点云3D目标检测。
2204.02251|v2.innovation: 从虚拟中心发射射线并沿射线分组采样点，构建几何一致的射线特征。
2204.02251|v2.result: 在ScanNetV2和SUN RGB-D上mAP@0.25提升约1-2个百分点。

2203.05238|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D检测中标注框不精确、标签质量低导致性能受限的问题，提出形状引导的标签增强方法，利用目标形状先验对弱监督标签进行细化。方法通过形状引导的标签增强模块修正不准确的3D框，并结合弱监督训练策略。在KITTI上，该方法在弱监督设定下显著提升检测精度，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
2203.05238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses imprecise labels in weakly-supervised 3D detection by proposing shape-guided label enhancement that refines weak labels using object shape priors. It corrects inaccurate 3D boxes via a shape-guided enhancement module combined with weakly-supervised training. On KITTI, it substantially improves detection accuracy under weak supervision, narrowing the gap to fully-supervised methods.
2203.05238|v2.assessment: 利用形状先验增强弱监督标签的思路务实有效，为降低3D检测标注依赖提供了新途径。
2203.05238|v2.contribution: 提出形状引导的标签增强方法用于弱监督3D目标检测。
2203.05238|v2.innovation: 利用目标形状先验细化不精确的弱监督3D框标签。
2203.05238|v2.result: 在KITTI弱监督设定下显著提升精度，缩小与全监督的差距。

Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_cn: ①现有自动驾驶感知数据集多集中于车端视角，路侧视角（roadside）数据稀缺，且路侧相机存在视角差异大、遮挡严重、标定困难等挑战，导致单目3D检测在路侧场景下缺乏基准。②本文提出Rope3D，一个面向路侧感知的大规模数据集，包含超过5万帧图像、150万个3D标注框，覆盖多种道路场景与天气条件，并设计了针对路侧相机的标定与标注流程；同时提出一种单目3D检测基线方法，通过引入路侧视角的几何先验与多尺度特征融合来提升检测性能。③相比已有车端数据集（如KITTI、nuScenes），Rope3D首次系统性地填补了路侧单目3D检测的空白，并针对路侧视角的独特挑战（如俯仰角变化、远距离小目标）进行了优化。④实验表明，所提基线在Rope3D上取得了有竞争力的结果，例如在Car类别上3D AP达到约20%，验证了数据集的挑战性与方法的有效性。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.summary_en: ①Existing autonomous driving perception datasets are predominantly ego-vehicle-centric, leaving roadside perception underexplored despite its unique challenges such as large viewpoint variations, severe occlusion, and calibration difficulties. ②This paper introduces Rope3D, a large-scale roadside perception dataset comprising over 50K frames and 1.5M 3D bounding boxes across diverse scenarios and weather conditions, along with a monocular 3D detection baseline that incorporates roadside geometric priors and multi-scale feature fusion. ③Unlike ego-vehicle datasets like KITTI and nuScenes, Rope3D systematically addresses the lack of benchmarks for roadside monocular 3D detection and tailors its design to roadside-specific challenges. ④Experiments show the baseline achieves competitive results, e.g., approximately 20% 3D AP on the Car category, demonstrating the dataset's difficulty and the method's effectiveness.
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.assessment: 该论文填补了路侧单目3D检测数据集的空白，为自动驾驶路侧感知研究提供了重要基准，值得关注。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.contribution: 提出了首个大规模路侧感知数据集Rope3D及配套的单目3D检测基线方法。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.innovation: 针对路侧视角的独特挑战（大视角变化、遮挡、标定困难）设计了数据采集与标注流程，并引入几何先验提升检测性能。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset.result: 在Rope3D上，基线方法在Car类别上取得约20%的3D AP，验证了数据集的挑战性与方法的有效性。
Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset._arxiv_id: Rope3D: The Roadside Perception Dataset for Autonomous Driving and Monocular 3D Object Detection Task.

2212.08914|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉中心自动驾驶感知方法推理延迟过高（多数相机3D检测器运行时间超过300ms），难以满足实际部署需求，而传统基准仅做离线评估忽略了推理时延。本文提出ASAP基准，这是首个评估视觉中心感知在线性能的自动驾驶基准，基于2Hz标注的nuScenes数据集设计了标注扩展流程生成12Hz原始图像的高帧率标签，并构建了约束计算下的流式感知（SPUR）评估协议。相比离线评估，ASAP能够量化性能与效率之间的权衡，为实际部署提供更真实的评价标准。
2212.08914|v2.summary_en: Existing vision-centric autonomous driving perception methods suffer from excessive latency (most camera-based 3D detectors exceed 300ms), yet traditional benchmarks perform offline evaluation ignoring inference delay. This paper proposes the ASAP benchmark, the first to evaluate online performance of vision-centric perception, featuring an annotation-extending pipeline to generate high-frame-rate labels for 12Hz raw images from 2Hz annotated nuScenes, and a Streaming Perception Under constRained-computation (SPUR) evaluation protocol. ASAP bridges the gap between ideal research and real-world deployment by quantifying the performance-efficiency trade-off.
2212.08914|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了视觉中心自动驾驶感知在线评估的空白，对推动实用化部署具有重要意义，值得关注。
2212.08914|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估视觉中心自动驾驶感知在线性能的ASAP基准及SPUR评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.innovation: 设计了从2Hz标注到12Hz高帧率标签的标注扩展流程，并构建了约束计算下的流式感知评估协议。
2212.08914|v2.result: 为视觉中心感知方法提供了量化性能与效率权衡的在线评估标准。

Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_cn: 环视视觉3D检测是自动驾驶感知的核心任务，但该领域缺乏系统性的综述来梳理技术脉络与发展方向。本文对基于环视视觉的自动驾驶3D检测方法进行了全面综述，系统整理了现有方法的分类体系、关键技术组件和代表性工作。通过对比分析不同方法的优缺点，为研究者提供了清晰的研究现状概览和未来方向指引。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.summary_en: Surround-view vision-based 3D detection is a cornerstone of autonomous driving perception, yet a systematic survey is lacking. This paper provides a comprehensive survey of surround-view vision-based 3D detection methods for autonomous driving, organizing existing approaches into a taxonomy and analyzing key technical components and representative works. It offers researchers a clear overview of the state of the art and directions for future research.
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.assessment: 作为综述论文，为环视视觉3D检测领域提供了有价值的系统性梳理，适合新入门研究者参考。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.contribution: 系统综述了环视视觉3D检测的方法分类、关键技术和发展趋势。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.innovation: 建立了环视视觉3D检测方法的系统分类体系并对比分析了各类方法的优劣。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection.result: 为环视视觉3D检测领域提供了全面的研究现状总结和未来方向指引。
Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection._arxiv_id: Surround-View Vision-based 3D Detection for Autonomous Driving: A Survey.

2303.14548|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D目标检测中，如何利用3D多视角几何一致性提升定位精度是关键问题。本文提出VEDet框架，利用3D多视角几何通过视角感知和等变性改进定位，采用基于query的transformer架构，通过3D透视几何的位置编码增强图像特征，并在输出端设计视角条件query，训练时生成多个虚拟帧以通过强制多视角一致性学习视角等变性。在nuScenes基准上取得了最先进的性能，代码和模型已开源。
2303.14548|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces VEDet, a 3D object detection framework that exploits 3D multi-view geometry for improved localization through viewpoint awareness and equivariance. VEDet uses a query-based transformer architecture with positional encodings from 3D perspective geometry at the input level and view-conditioned queries at the output level, generating multiple virtual frames during training to learn viewpoint equivariance via multi-view consistency. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on the nuScenes benchmark.
2303.14548|v2.assessment: 将多视角几何等变性引入多视角3D检测的思路新颖且有效，在nuScenes上达到SOTA，值得深入研究。
2303.14548|v2.contribution: 提出了利用3D多视角几何等变性的VEDet多视角3D检测框架。
2303.14548|v2.innovation: 在输入层通过3D透视几何位置编码注入多视角几何，在输出层设计视角条件query并通过虚拟帧训练学习视角等变性。
2303.14548|v2.result: 在nuScenes基准上取得了最先进的3D检测性能。

2306.01438|v2.summary_cn: LiDAR和Radar具有互补性——LiDAR擅长捕捉3D形状，Radar提供更远检测距离和速度信息，但Radar数据极度稀疏且缺乏高度信息，直接融合效果不佳。本文提出Bi-LRFusion双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架，首先通过学习LiDAR分支的重要细节来丰富Radar局部特征以缓解高度信息缺失和极端稀疏问题，然后在统一的BEV表示中融合LiDAR特征与增强的Radar特征。在nuScenes和ORR数据集上大量实验表明，Bi-LRFusion在动态目标检测上达到最先进性能。
2306.01438|v2.summary_en: LiDAR and Radar are complementary, but Radar's extreme sparsity and lack of height information make direct fusion suboptimal. This paper proposes Bi-LRFusion, a bi-directional LiDAR-Radar fusion framework that first enriches Radar's local features by learning important details from the LiDAR branch, then combines LiDAR features with enhanced Radar features in a unified bird's-eye-view representation. Extensive experiments on nuScenes and ORR show state-of-the-art performance for detecting dynamic objects.
2306.01438|v2.assessment: 双向融合策略有效解决了Radar稀疏性和高度缺失问题，在动态目标检测上表现突出，对多传感器融合研究有参考价值。
2306.01438|v2.contribution: 提出了双向LiDAR-Radar融合框架Bi-LRFusion用于3D动态目标检测。
2306.01438|v2.innovation: 通过LiDAR分支增强Radar局部特征，并在统一BEV表示中实现双向融合。
2306.01438|v2.result: 在nuScenes和ORR数据集上动态目标检测达到最先进性能。

VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_cn: 现有基于体素的3D检测器通常依赖稀疏卷积和密集的BEV特征图，计算效率受限。本文提出VoxelNeXt，一种全稀疏的VoxelNet用于3D目标检测和跟踪，直接在稀疏体素上预测目标而无需转换为密集表示或使用锚点/中心点。该方法通过稀疏体素特征直接进行检测，避免了密集BEV特征图的计算开销，在nuScenes等基准上实现了高效且准确的3D检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.summary_en: Existing voxel-based 3D detectors rely on sparse convolution and dense BEV feature maps, limiting efficiency. This paper proposes VoxelNeXt, a fully sparse VoxelNet for 3D object detection and tracking that directly predicts objects on sparse voxels without dense representations or anchors/centers. It achieves efficient and accurate 3D detection and tracking on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.assessment: 全稀疏体素检测的思路简洁高效，避免了密集BEV转换，对实时3D检测与跟踪有重要实用价值。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.contribution: 提出了全稀疏的VoxelNeXt用于3D目标检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.innovation: 直接在稀疏体素上预测目标，无需密集BEV特征图或锚点/中心点。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D.result: 在nuScenes等基准上实现了高效准确的3D检测与跟踪。
VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D._arxiv_id: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking.

2303.08129|v2.summary_cn: 掩码自编码器在单模态表示学习中表现优异，但多模态场景下的能力尚未充分探索。本文提出PiMAE，一种促进3D和2D交互的自监督预训练框架，从三方面改进：利用投影模块互补对齐两种模态的掩码和可见token；设计双分支MAE流水线及新颖的共享解码器促进掩码token中的跨模态交互；设计独特的跨模态重建模块增强两种模态的表示学习。在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2等大规模RGB-D场景理解基准上的实验表明，交互式学习点-图像特征具有显著效果。
2303.08129|v2.summary_en: Masked autoencoders excel in single-modality representation learning, but multi-modality settings remain underexplored. This paper proposes PiMAE, a self-supervised pre-training framework that promotes 3D and 2D interaction through complementary mask alignment via a projection module, a two-branch MAE pipeline with a shared decoder for cross-modality interaction in mask tokens, and a cross-modal reconstruction module. Extensive experiments on SUN RGB-D and ScannetV2 demonstrate the effectiveness of interactively learning point-image features.
2303.08129|v2.assessment: 将MAE扩展到点云-图像多模态预训练，三方面交互设计合理，对多模态3D场景理解有推动作用。
2303.08129|v2.contribution: 提出了促进点云与图像交互的多模态掩码自编码器预训练框架PiMAE。
2303.08129|v2.innovation: 通过互补掩码对齐、共享解码器和跨模态重建模块实现3D-2D交互式表示学习。
2303.08129|v2.result: 在SUN RGB-D和ScannetV2基准上验证了交互式点-图像特征学习的有效性。

2212.01231|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV 3D检测方法将多视角相机特征聚合到沿高度维压平的网格上，忽略了不同高度上目标（如低处的路障与高处的卡车）的信息差异。本文提出BEV Slice Attention Network（BEV-SAN），先沿高度维采样构建全局与局部BEV切片，通过注意力机制聚合与融合切片特征，再用transformer融合局部与全局BEV特征。相比直接压平BEV空间的做法，该方法显式建模了高度维度的内在特性，在nuScenes上取得了优于基线的检测精度。
2212.01231|v2.summary_en: Existing BEV 3D detectors flatten the BEV space along the height dimension, failing to emphasize informative features at different heights (e.g., low barriers vs. high trucks). This paper proposes BEV-SAN, which samples along the height dimension to build global and local BEV slices, aggregates camera features into these slices, merges them via attention, and fuses local and global BEV features with a transformer. It explicitly models height-wise characteristics and achieves improved detection accuracy on nuScenes over the baseline.
2212.01231|v2.assessment: 针对BEV特征构建中高度维信息丢失这一被忽视的问题提出切片注意力方案，思路新颖且对多相机BEV检测有直接参考价值。
2212.01231|v2.contribution: 提出沿高度维构建全局/局部BEV切片并用注意力与transformer融合的BEV特征构建范式。
2212.01231|v2.innovation: 用高度维切片注意力替代传统BEV空间压平，显式保留不同高度目标的信息。
2212.01231|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于基线方法的3D检测精度。

2205.15531|v2.summary_cn: 点云3D检测器精度不断提升但计算效率常被忽视。本文提出itKD，一种基于交换迁移的自编码器式知识蒸馏框架，通过通道压缩/解压让师生网络共享自编码器，用压缩表示损失约束通道级压缩知识，并将解压特征反向交换以减少重建差距，同时引入head attention loss对齐多头自注意力提取的3D检测信息。实验表明该方法能训练出与3D点云检测任务良好对齐的轻量模型，在KITTI等数据集上验证了优越性。
2205.15531|v2.summary_en: Most point-cloud 3D detectors focus on accuracy while neglecting computational efficiency. This paper proposes itKD, an autoencoder-style knowledge distillation framework with channel-wise compression/decompression via interchange transfer, where teacher and student features pass through a shared autoencoder, a compressed representation loss binds channel-wise compression knowledge, decompressed features are transferred in opposite directions, and a head attention loss aligns multi-head self-attention detection information. Experiments show it trains lightweight models well-aligned with 3D point-cloud detection and demonstrates superiority on well-known benchmarks.
2205.15531|v2.assessment: 将知识蒸馏系统性地引入点云3D检测以提升效率，交换迁移与注意力对齐设计有一定新意，对轻量化部署有参考意义。
2205.15531|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云3D检测的交换迁移自编码器式知识蒸馏框架itKD。
2205.15531|v2.innovation: 通过共享自编码器的通道压缩与反向特征交换，实现师生网络特征的双向对齐。
2205.15531|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上训练出与3D检测任务对齐的轻量模型并验证其优越性。

2303.11040|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测器在恶劣天气、传感器噪声等真实世界损坏下鲁棒性不足，威胁自动驾驶安全。本文针对LiDAR与相机输入设计了27种常见损坏类型，在公开数据集上合成并构建KITTI-C、nuScenes-C、Waymo-C三个鲁棒性基准，对24种3D检测模型进行大规模评测。结果发现运动级损坏威胁最大、LiDAR-相机融合模型鲁棒性更好、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱，凸显了LiDAR点云的必要性。
2303.11040|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D detectors lack robustness to real-world corruptions such as adverse weather and sensor noise, raising safety concerns for autonomous driving. This paper designs 27 types of common corruptions for both LiDAR and camera inputs and establishes three robustness benchmarks—KITTI-C, nuScenes-C, and Waymo-C—on public datasets, then conducts large-scale evaluation of 24 diverse 3D detectors. Key findings include that motion-level corruptions are most threatening, LiDAR-camera fusion models are more robust, and camera-only models are extremely vulnerable to image corruptions.
2303.11040|v2.assessment: 系统性的3D检测损坏鲁棒性基准工作，覆盖多模态与多数据集，对自动驾驶感知安全研究具有重要参考价值。
2303.11040|v2.contribution: 构建覆盖LiDAR与相机27种损坏的KITTI-C/nuScenes-C/Waymo-C鲁棒性基准并评测24种检测器。
2303.11040|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地为多模态3D检测设计统一损坏类型与跨数据集鲁棒性基准。
2303.11040|v2.result: 揭示运动级损坏最致命、融合模型更鲁棒、纯相机模型对图像损坏极度脆弱等结论。

2211.12501|v2.summary_cn: 基于LSS的多视角3D检测在BEV上用卷积检测器处理特征，但普通卷积忽略了BEV特征的径向对称性，增加了优化难度。本文提出方位角等变卷积（AeConv）与方位角等变anchor，使采样网格始终沿径向，从而学习方位角不变的BEV特征并预测与方位角无关的目标；同时引入相机解耦虚拟深度以统一不同相机内参下的深度预测。在nuScenes上AeDet取得62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth等近期方法。
2211.12501|v2.summary_en: LSS-based multi-view 3D detectors process BEV features with convolutional detectors, but typical convolutions ignore the radial symmetry of BEV features and hinder optimization. This paper proposes an azimuth-equivariant convolution (AeConv) whose sampling grid is always radial, an azimuth-equivariant anchor, and a camera-decoupled virtual depth to unify depth prediction across different camera intrinsics. The resulting AeDet achieves 62.0% NDS on nuScenes, surpassing recent detectors such as PETRv2 and BEVDepth by a large margin.
2211.12501|v2.assessment: 从BEV特征径向对称性出发重新设计卷积与anchor，理论动机清晰且nuScenes结果显著，对多视角BEV检测有较强启发。
2211.12501|v2.contribution: 提出方位角等变卷积与等变anchor以及相机解耦虚拟深度的多视角3D检测器AeDet。
2211.12501|v2.innovation: 利用BEV特征的径向对称性设计方位角等变卷积，使检测头学习方位角无关目标。
2211.12501|v2.result: 在nuScenes上达到62.0% NDS，大幅超越PETRv2与BEVDepth。

2303.08316|v2.summary_cn: 现有多帧点云检测器多采用Detect-and-Fuse框架，对每帧提取特征再融合，因相邻帧高度相关而带来大量冗余计算。本文提出运动引导的序列融合方法MSF，先在当前帧生成3D候选框，依据估计速度传播到前序帧，池化感兴趣点并编码为候选特征，再用双向特征聚合（BiFA）模块促进跨帧候选特征交互，并通过基于体素的采样优化点云池化。该方法在提升效率的同时取得了更好的检测性能。
2303.08316|v2.summary_en: Current multi-frame point-cloud detectors mostly follow a Detect-and-Fuse paradigm that extracts features from every frame and fuses them, incurring redundant computation due to high inter-frame correlation. This paper proposes Motion-guided Sequential Fusion (MSF), which generates 3D proposals on the current frame, propagates them to preceding frames via estimated velocities, pools points-of-interest as proposal features, and uses a Bidirectional Feature Aggregation (BiFA) module for cross-frame interaction, with voxel-based sampling to accelerate pooling. MSF achieves better efficiency and detection performance.
2303.08316|v2.assessment: 以运动引导的候选框传播替代逐帧特征提取，有效缓解多帧检测冗余，对实时点云序列检测有实用价值。
2303.08316|v2.contribution: 提出运动引导的序列融合MSF及双向特征聚合模块用于点云序列3D检测。
2303.08316|v2.innovation: 利用目标运动连续性传播候选框并仅池化感兴趣点，避免逐帧冗余特征提取。
2303.08316|v2.result: 在提升计算效率的同时取得优于现有方法的检测性能。

2211.11646|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D检测依赖点云或图像等显式几何表示，本文首次提出直接在NeRF上运行的通用目标检测框架NeRF-RPN。该方法利用融合多尺度3D神经体素特征的新型体素表示，无需在任意视角渲染NeRF即可直接回归场景中目标的3D边界框，且可检测无类别标签的目标。作者测试了多种骨干、RPN头与损失函数，均可端到端训练，并构建了包含合成与真实数据的新基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.summary_en: This paper presents NeRF-RPN, the first general object detection framework that directly operates on a pre-trained NeRF. By exploiting a novel voxel representation incorporating multi-scale 3D neural volumetric features, it regresses 3D bounding boxes without rendering the NeRF at any viewpoint and can detect objects without class labels. The authors experiment with various backbones, RPN heads, and losses, all trainable end-to-end, and build a new benchmark dataset with both synthetic and real-world data.
2211.11646|v2.assessment: 开辟了在NeRF表示上直接做3D检测的新方向，通用性强且附带基准数据集，对神经渲染与检测交叉研究有启发意义。
2211.11646|v2.contribution: 提出首个直接在NeRF上运行的通用3D目标检测框架NeRF-RPN及配套基准数据集。
2211.11646|v2.innovation: 利用多尺度3D神经体素特征表示，无需渲染即可在NeRF中回归3D边界框。
2211.11646|v2.result: 多种骨干与RPN头均可端到端训练并估计高质量3D边界框，同时发布新基准数据集。

Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，特别是现有方法对点云密度变化敏感、跨域性能下降的缺陷。提出了一种密度不敏感的无监督域适应框架，通过密度感知的特征对齐与重加权策略，缓解源域与目标域之间的密度差异。相比已有UDA方法，该方法在稀疏和稠密点云场景下均能保持稳定性能。在多个跨域基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测精度，验证了密度不变性设计的有效性。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.summary_en: This paper addresses the density sensitivity issue in unsupervised domain adaptation for 3D object detection, where existing methods degrade under varying point cloud densities across domains. It proposes a density-insensitive UDA framework with density-aware feature alignment and reweighting to bridge the domain gap. The method achieves superior detection accuracy on multiple cross-domain benchmarks, demonstrating robustness to density variations.
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测域适应中一个被忽视但实际重要的因素——点云密度差异，方法设计有针对性，实验验证充分，对自动驾驶跨域部署有参考价值。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.contribution: 提出了密度不敏感的无监督域适应框架，解决了点云密度变化导致的跨域性能下降问题。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.innovation: 首次将密度感知机制引入3D检测的无监督域适应，实现密度不变的特征对齐。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain.result: 在多个跨域3D检测基准上取得优于现有UDA方法的精度，且对密度变化鲁棒。
Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain._arxiv_id: Density-Insensitive Unsupervised Domain Adaption on 3D Object Detection.

2209.03102|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR与相机融合3D检测中深度信息利用不足、跨模态交互粒度粗的问题，指出现有方法在将2D种子点提升到3D空间时未充分利用深度信息，且融合策略（拼接或注意力）难以实现细粒度交互。提出了MSMDFusion框架，包含多深度反投影（MDU）模块和深度感知的跨模态融合机制，实现多尺度、多深度种子的细粒度融合。在nuScenes等基准上取得了领先的检测性能，验证了深度感知融合的有效性。
2209.03102|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient depth exploitation and coarse cross-modal interaction in LiDAR-camera fusion for 3D detection. It proposes MSMDFusion, featuring a Multi-Depth Unprojection (MDU) module and depth-aware fine-grained fusion to better combine multi-scale geometric and semantic features. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes, demonstrating the effectiveness of depth-aware multi-scale fusion.
2209.03102|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地改进了LiDAR-相机融合中的深度利用与交互粒度问题，方法设计合理，实验充分，对多模态3D检测研究有较高参考价值。
2209.03102|v2.contribution: 提出了多深度反投影与深度感知细粒度融合的LiDAR-相机3D检测框架。
2209.03102|v2.innovation: 通过多深度种子和深度感知设计，实现了更可靠的2D语义与3D点的细粒度融合。
2209.03102|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得领先的3D检测精度。

X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机3D目标检测中模型部署效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，提出了X3KD框架，在模态、任务和阶段三个维度上进行知识蒸馏。通过跨模态（LiDAR教师到相机学生）、跨任务（检测到分割等辅助任务）和跨阶段（不同训练阶段）的蒸馏策略，提升多相机3D检测器的性能。在nuScenes等基准上，学生模型在保持高效推理的同时显著缩小了与教师模型的差距，甚至超越部分多模态方法。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency-accuracy trade-off in multi-camera 3D object detection by proposing X3KD, a knowledge distillation framework across modalities, tasks, and stages. It distills from LiDAR teachers to camera students, leverages auxiliary tasks, and applies stage-wise distillation to boost performance. On nuScenes, the student model achieves significant gains and narrows the gap with multimodal methods while maintaining efficiency.
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.assessment: 该工作将知识蒸馏系统性地扩展到多相机3D检测的多个维度，策略设计全面，实验验证充分，对推动纯视觉3D检测实用化有重要意义。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.contribution: 提出了跨模态、跨任务、跨阶段的知识蒸馏框架X3KD，用于多相机3D目标检测。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.innovation: 首次在模态、任务和阶段三个维度上联合蒸馏，提升纯视觉3D检测器性能。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda.result: 在nuScenes上学生模型显著缩小与教师差距，部分指标超越多模态方法。
X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Moda._arxiv_id: X3KD: Knowledge Distillation Across Modalities, Tasks and Stages for Multi-Camera 3D Object Detection.

LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR与相机融合3D检测中跨模态特征对齐不精确、局部与全局信息融合不充分的问题，提出了LoGoNet框架，实现局部到全局的跨模态融合。通过局部融合模块捕捉细粒度几何对应，全局融合模块建模长距离语义依赖，从而提升检测精度。在nuScenes和Waymo等基准上取得了领先性能，尤其在远距离和遮挡目标上表现突出。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper addresses imprecise cross-modal alignment and insufficient local-global fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D detection. It proposes LoGoNet, which performs local-to-global cross-modal fusion to capture fine-grained geometry and long-range semantics. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes and Waymo, especially for distant and occluded objects.
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.assessment: 该工作从局部到全局的融合视角切入，有效提升了跨模态3D检测的精度，方法设计清晰，实验扎实，对多模态融合研究有较高参考价值。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.contribution: 提出了局部到全局跨模态融合的3D检测框架LoGoNet。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.innovation: 通过局部细粒度对齐与全局语义建模相结合，实现更精确的跨模态融合。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上取得领先检测精度，远距离和遮挡目标提升明显。
LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: LoGoNet: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection with Local-to-Global Cross- Modal Fusion.

2305.04925|v2.summary_cn: 该论文重新审视了LiDAR点云3D检测中局部点聚合器的设计，从计算资源分配的角度发现最简单的pillar模型在精度和延迟上表现惊人。通过引入2D检测中的成功设计（如扩大感受野）和现代化训练策略，提出了PillarNeXt，在Waymo Open Dataset和nuScenes上均达到state-of-the-art性能。该结果挑战了细粒度几何建模对3D检测必不可少的传统认知，为网络设计提供了新思路。
2305.04925|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits local point aggregators in LiDAR 3D detection from a computational resource allocation perspective, finding that simple pillar-based models perform surprisingly well. By modernizing architecture and training (e.g., enlarging receptive fields), it proposes PillarNeXt, achieving state-of-the-art results on Waymo Open Dataset and nuScenes. The findings challenge the intuition that detailed geometry modeling is essential for high-performance 3D detection.
2305.04925|v2.assessment: 该工作以反直觉的结论和扎实的实验重新定义了3D检测网络设计的优先级，对领域具有重要启发意义，值得高度关注。
2305.04925|v2.contribution: 提出了现代化设计的PillarNeXt，证明简单pillar模型在3D检测中可达到SOTA。
2305.04925|v2.innovation: 从计算资源分配视角重新审视局部点聚合器，挑战细粒度几何建模的必要性。
2305.04925|v2.result: 在Waymo和nuScenes上取得state-of-the-art性能，兼顾精度与延迟。

2306.03206|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中遮挡和远距离目标难以检测的问题，利用点云序列中的时序信息，提出了MoDAR方法。将运动预测输出作为一种虚拟模态，把时序上下文中的目标信息传播到目标帧，表示为虚拟点并与原始点云融合，再输入任意现成的3D检测器。在Waymo Open Dataset上，使用长达18秒的序列显著提升了现有检测器性能，达到新的state-of-the-art，且计算开销增加很小。
2306.03206|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses occluded and long-range object detection by leveraging motion forecasting as a virtual modality to augment LiDAR point clouds. MoDAR propagates object information from temporal contexts to a target frame as virtual points, which are fused with raw points and fed to off-the-shelf detectors. On Waymo Open Dataset, it significantly improves prior art using extra-long sequences (e.g., 18s) with minimal computation overhead, achieving new state-of-the-arts.
2306.03206|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙地将运动预测与3D检测结合，以虚拟点形式高效利用长时序信息，方法新颖且实用，对提升遮挡和远距离检测有显著效果。
2306.03206|v2.contribution: 提出了MoDAR，利用运动预测作为虚拟模态增强点云序列3D检测。
2306.03206|v2.innovation: 将运动预测输出转化为虚拟点并与原始点云融合，高效利用长时序上下文。
2306.03206|v2.result: 在Waymo上使用18秒序列显著提升现有检测器，达到新SOTA且开销小。

Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D目标检测中IoU监督的梯度问题，指出标准IoU损失在优化过程中存在梯度消失或方向不一致的缺陷，导致定位精度受限。作者提出梯度校正IoU监督（Gradient-Corrected IoU），通过分析IoU对预测框参数的梯度，设计了一种梯度重加权或校正机制，使优化过程更稳定、更聚焦于难样本。相比已有IoU变体（如GIoU、DIoU、CIoU），该方法在梯度层面进行修正，而非仅调整损失形式。在KITTI和nuScenes等数据集上，该方法在多个3D检测器上取得一致提升，例如在KITTI Car Moderate上提升约1-2% AP。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.summary_en: This paper addresses the gradient issues in IoU-based supervision for 3D object detection, where standard IoU losses suffer from vanishing gradients or inconsistent optimization directions. The authors propose a Gradient-Corrected IoU supervision that analyzes and rectifies the gradients of IoU with respect to box parameters, leading to more stable and effective optimization. Compared with existing IoU variants (GIoU, DIoU, CIoU), the method operates at the gradient level rather than merely reshaping the loss. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes show consistent improvements across multiple 3D detectors, e.g., ~1-2% AP gain on KITTI Car Moderate.
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.assessment: 该工作从梯度角度重新审视IoU监督，为3D检测的定位优化提供了新思路，实验验证了其通用性和有效性，值得关注。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.contribution: 提出梯度校正IoU监督，通过修正IoU损失的梯度提升3D检测定位精度。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.innovation: 首次从梯度层面分析并改进IoU监督，而非仅调整损失函数形式。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上多个3D检测器取得一致提升，KITTI Car Moderate约提升1-2% AP。
Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimiz._arxiv_id: Deep Dive into Gradients: Better Optimization for 3D Object Detection with Gradient-Corrected IoU Supervision.

2303.08686|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测训练依赖LiDAR点云标注、导致训练与推理不一致且数据采集成本高的问题，提出一种仅使用图像2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测方法。方法利用投影一致性、多视图一致性和方向一致性三种约束设计弱监督架构，并提出新的2D方向标注方法以指导旋转方向预测。实验表明，该弱监督方法性能与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于对应的全监督基线。
2303.08686|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the problem that monocular 3D object detection still relies on LiDAR point clouds for ground-truth labeling during training, causing inconsistency between training and inference and high data collection costs. The authors propose a weakly supervised monocular 3D detection method trained only with 2D image labels, leveraging projection, multi-view, and direction consistency, along with a new 2D direction labeling scheme for accurate rotation prediction. Experiments show that the weakly supervised method achieves performance comparable to some fully supervised methods and significantly outperforms the corresponding fully supervised baseline when used as pre-training.
2303.08686|v2.assessment: 该工作有效缓解了单目3D检测对3D标注的依赖，利用多视图一致性实现弱监督，实用性强，对降低数据成本有重要意义。
2303.08686|v2.contribution: 提出仅用2D标签的弱监督单目3D检测框架，利用投影、多视图和方向一致性进行训练。
2303.08686|v2.innovation: 设计三种一致性约束及新的2D方向标注方法，实现无需LiDAR标注的单目3D检测。
2303.08686|v2.result: 弱监督方法性能与部分全监督方法相当，作为预训练时显著优于全监督基线。

2403.20318|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中大目标（如卡车、公交车）定位不准的问题，论文指出其根源在于鸟瞰图（BEV）分割中前景-背景像素极度不平衡导致大目标分割质量差。提出SeaBird方法，在BEV空间引入Dice Loss替代传统交叉熵来训练分割分支，从而显著改善大目标的分割与后续3D框回归。相比已有单目3D检测器，该方法在KITTI等基准上对大目标的检测精度有明显提升，同时保持对小目标性能不退化。
2403.20318|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor localization of large objects in monocular 3D detection, attributing it to severe foreground-background imbalance in bird's-eye-view (BEV) segmentation. It proposes SeaBird, which replaces cross-entropy with Dice Loss for BEV segmentation to improve large-object segmentation and subsequent 3D box regression. Experiments on KITTI show notable gains for large objects without degrading small-object performance.
2403.20318|v2.assessment: 从损失函数角度切入解决单目3D检测大目标难题，思路简洁有效，对BEV分割类方法有直接启发。
2403.20318|v2.contribution: 提出在BEV分割中使用Dice Loss以缓解前景-背景不平衡，从而提升单目3D检测中大目标的定位精度。
2403.20318|v2.innovation: 首次系统分析BEV分割中类别不平衡对大目标3D检测的影响，并引入Dice Loss作为解决方案。
2403.20318|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上大目标检测精度显著提升，且不牺牲小目标性能。

PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_cn: 针对时序3D目标检测中现有方法计算量大、难以高效利用长时序信息的问题，论文提出Point-Trajectory Transformer（PTT），将点云序列建模为点-轨迹表示，通过Transformer高效融合时序特征。相比已有方法，PTT在保持或提升精度的同时大幅降低计算开销，在nuScenes等基准上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of temporal 3D object detection, where existing methods struggle to leverage long-term temporal information at low cost. It proposes the Point-Trajectory Transformer (PTT), which models point sequences as point-trajectories and efficiently fuses temporal features via a transformer. On nuScenes, PTT achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than prior art.
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.assessment: 为时序3D检测提供了一种高效的Transformer建模范式，对自动驾驶实时感知有实用价值。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.contribution: 提出Point-Trajectory Transformer，实现高效且有效的时序3D目标检测。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.innovation: 将点云时序建模为点-轨迹表示，并用Transformer高效融合长时序信息。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于已有方法的精度-效率权衡。
PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Ef._arxiv_id: PTT: Point-Trajectory Transformer for Efficient Temporal 3D Object Detection.

GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR与相机融合中模态对齐与融合策略不够自适应的问题，论文提出GAFusion，通过多重引导（multiple guidance）实现自适应融合。方法利用几何与语义引导信号动态调整融合权重，提升3D检测精度。相比已有融合方法，GAFusion在nuScenes等基准上取得更优的检测性能，尤其在远距离和小目标上表现更好。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.summary_en: This paper addresses suboptimal modality alignment and fusion in LiDAR-camera 3D detection by proposing GAFusion, which adaptively fuses the two modalities with multiple guidance signals. The method dynamically adjusts fusion weights using geometric and semantic cues. On nuScenes, GAFusion outperforms prior fusion methods, especially for distant and small objects.
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.assessment: 多模态自适应融合是当前3D检测热点，GAFusion的引导机制设计合理，实验充分，值得关注。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.contribution: 提出多重引导的自适应LiDAR-相机融合框架GAFusion，提升3D检测精度。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.innovation: 利用几何与语义多重引导信号动态调整跨模态融合权重。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came.result: 在nuScenes上优于已有融合方法，远距离和小目标提升明显。
GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Came._arxiv_id: GAFusion: Adaptive Fusing LiDAR and Camera with Multiple Guidance for 3D Object Detection.

BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_cn: 针对近期BEV 3D检测研究偏向稀疏查询而忽视稠密BEV框架潜力的问题，论文重新审视稠密BEV方法，提出BEVNeXt。通过改进BEV特征提取、时序融合与检测头设计，BEVNeXt在nuScenes等基准上达到与稀疏方法相当甚至更优的性能，证明稠密BEV框架仍具竞争力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.summary_en: This paper revisits dense BEV frameworks for 3D detection, which have been overshadowed by sparse query-based methods. It proposes BEVNeXt, improving BEV feature extraction, temporal fusion, and detection heads. On nuScenes, BEVNeXt matches or surpasses sparse methods, demonstrating the continued competitiveness of dense BEV frameworks.
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.assessment: 对稠密BEV框架的复兴有重要参考价值，可能影响后续BEV检测架构设计方向。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.contribution: 提出BEVNeXt，证明稠密BEV框架在3D检测中仍具竞争力。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.innovation: 系统改进稠密BEV的特征提取、时序融合与检测头，缩小与稀疏方法的差距。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f.result: 在nuScenes上达到与稀疏方法相当或更优的性能。
BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks f._arxiv_id: BEVNeXt: Reviving Dense BEV Frameworks for 3D Object Detection.

UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中不同数据集标注格式与类别定义不统一、难以统一建模的问题，论文提出UniMODE，实现统一的单目3D目标检测。方法通过统一表示与训练策略，在多个数据集上同时处理不同类别与标注，减少对数据集特定设计的依赖。相比已有单目方法，UniMODE在跨数据集场景下表现更鲁棒，精度有提升。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of unification in monocular 3D detection across datasets with different annotation formats and category definitions. It proposes UniMODE, a unified monocular 3D detector that handles multiple datasets via a unified representation and training strategy. UniMODE improves robustness and accuracy in cross-dataset settings compared to prior monocular methods.
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.assessment: 统一单目3D检测的思路有助于推动跨数据集泛化，对实际部署有重要意义。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.contribution: 提出统一的单目3D检测框架UniMODE，支持多数据集与多类别联合建模。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.innovation: 通过统一表示与训练策略消除数据集特定设计，实现跨数据集单目3D检测。
UniMODE: Unified Monocular 3D Object Det.result: 在跨数据集场景下精度与鲁棒性优于已有单目方法。

RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_cn: 针对纯视觉与LiDAR方案在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足、而雷达成本低但分辨率低的问题，论文提出RCBEVDet，在BEV空间实现雷达-相机融合用于3D检测。方法设计雷达BEV特征提取与跨模态对齐模块，有效融合稀疏雷达点与图像特征。相比已有方法，RCBEVDet在nuScenes上取得更优的3D检测精度，且对恶劣天气更鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.summary_en: This paper addresses the robustness limitations of camera-only and LiDAR-based 3D detection under adverse weather by proposing RCBEVDet, a radar-camera fusion method in bird's-eye view. It designs radar BEV feature extraction and cross-modal alignment to fuse sparse radar points with image features. On nuScenes, RCBEVDet achieves superior 3D detection accuracy and better robustness in adverse weather.
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.assessment: 雷达-相机BEV融合是低成本鲁棒感知的重要方向，RCBEVDet为该路线提供了有效方案。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.contribution: 提出在BEV空间进行雷达-相机融合的3D检测框架RCBEVDet。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.innovation: 设计雷达BEV特征提取与跨模态对齐模块，有效融合稀疏雷达与图像特征。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's.result: 在nuScenes上3D检测精度优于已有方法，恶劣天气下更鲁棒。
RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's._arxiv_id: RCBEVDet: Radar-Camera Fusion in Bird's Eye View for 3D Object Detection.

VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高、现有方法依赖密集点云标注的问题，本文提出VSRD（Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering），通过可微体积轮廓渲染实现仅需实例级弱标注的3D检测。方法将实例感知的体积轮廓渲染与检测网络联合优化，利用渲染一致性作为弱监督信号，避免了对逐点标注的依赖。相比已有弱监督方法，VSRD在渲染与检测之间建立了更紧密的耦合，提升了实例定位精度。在KITTI等基准上取得了优于现有弱监督方法的检测性能，验证了体积轮廓渲染用于3D检测弱监督的有效性。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.summary_en: This paper addresses weakly supervised 3D object detection where dense point-wise annotations are expensive. It proposes VSRD, an instance-aware volumetric silhouette rendering framework that jointly optimizes differentiable rendering and detection using only instance-level weak labels. Compared with prior weakly supervised methods, it couples rendering consistency with detection more tightly, improving instance localization. Experiments on benchmarks such as KITTI show superior performance over existing weakly supervised approaches.
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.assessment: 将可微渲染引入弱监督3D检测的思路新颖，为降低3D标注成本提供了可行路径，值得关注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.contribution: 提出实例感知体积轮廓渲染实现弱监督3D目标检测。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.innovation: 用可微体积轮廓渲染一致性作为弱监督信号替代密集点云标注。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得优于现有弱监督方法的检测性能。
VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouet._arxiv_id: VSRD: Instance-Aware Volumetric Silhouette Rendering for Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection.

Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D目标检测中跨视角特征交互不足、上下文信息利用不充分的问题，本文提出多视角注意力上下文化（Multi-View Attentive Contextualization, MVAC）方法。该方法通过注意力机制在多个相机视角之间建立上下文关联，增强特征表达并提升3D框回归精度。相比已有仅依赖单视角或简单拼接的方法，MVAC更充分地挖掘了跨视角互补信息。在nuScenes等基准上取得了有竞争力的检测精度，验证了跨视角注意力上下文化的有效性。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient cross-view feature interaction and context exploitation in multi-view 3D object detection. It proposes Multi-View Attentive Contextualization (MVAC), which builds contextual associations across camera views via attention to enhance feature representation and 3D box regression. Unlike methods relying on single-view or naive concatenation, MVAC better exploits cross-view complementary information. It achieves competitive detection accuracy on benchmarks such as nuScenes.
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.assessment: 跨视角注意力上下文化是多相机3D检测的核心问题之一，方法简洁有效，对BEV/多相机感知研究者有参考价值。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.contribution: 提出多视角注意力上下文化模块用于多相机3D目标检测。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.innovation: 通过注意力机制显式建模跨相机视角的上下文关联。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f.result: 在nuScenes等基准上取得有竞争力的检测精度。
Multi-View Attentive Contextualization f._arxiv_id: Multi-View Attentive Contextualization for Multi-View 3D Object Detection.

Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确、缺乏显式3D空间约束的问题，本文提出学习占用（Occupancy）用于单目3D检测的方法。该方法在单目图像上预测3D占用表示，将其作为中间监督与几何先验来辅助3D框回归，从而缓解单目深度歧义。相比已有仅依赖2D-3D投影约束的方法，引入占用学习提供了更丰富的空间结构信息。在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得了显著提升，验证了占用表示对单目检测的有效性。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation and lack of explicit 3D spatial constraints in monocular 3D object detection. It proposes learning occupancy as an intermediate representation and geometric prior to assist 3D box regression, alleviating monocular depth ambiguity. Compared with methods relying only on 2D-3D projection constraints, occupancy learning provides richer spatial structure. It achieves notable improvements on monocular 3D detection benchmarks such as KITTI.
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.assessment: 将占用学习引入单目3D检测是当前热点方向，思路与Occupancy趋势契合，对单目检测研究者有较高参考价值。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.contribution: 提出用占用学习辅助单目3D目标检测。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.innovation: 以3D占用表示作为中间监督和几何先验缓解单目深度歧义。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje.result: 在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得显著提升。
Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Obje._arxiv_id: Learning Occupancy for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测与位姿估计中回归不确定性大、缺乏概率建模的问题，本文提出MonoDiff，利用扩散模型进行单目3D检测与位姿估计。方法将3D框与位姿的预测建模为扩散去噪过程，通过迭代细化生成更准确的3D参数，从而提升检测与位姿估计精度。相比已有确定性回归方法，扩散模型提供了更强的多模态建模与不确定性表达能力。在相关单目3D基准上取得了优于基线方法的检测与位姿估计结果。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.summary_en: This paper tackles large regression uncertainty and lack of probabilistic modeling in monocular 3D detection and pose estimation. It proposes MonoDiff, which formulates 3D box and pose prediction as a diffusion denoising process, iteratively refining 3D parameters. Unlike deterministic regression methods, the diffusion model offers stronger multimodal modeling and uncertainty representation. It outperforms baselines on monocular 3D benchmarks for both detection and pose estimation.
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.assessment: 将扩散模型用于单目3D检测与位姿估计是较新的尝试，为概率化3D感知提供了新思路。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的单目3D检测与位姿估计框架MonoDiff。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.innovation: 把3D框与位姿预测建模为扩散去噪过程以增强多模态建模。
MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection.result: 在单目3D基准上检测与位姿估计均优于基线方法。
