MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection._arxiv_id: MonoDiff: Monocular 3D Object Detection and Pose Estimation with Diffusion Models.

BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_cn: 针对路侧视角下基于视觉的3D目标检测中BEV表示构建效率低、体素池化信息损失的问题，本文提出BEVSpread，一种用于BEV表示的扩散体素池化方法。该方法通过扩散式体素池化将图像特征更合理地映射到BEV空间，减少投影过程中的信息丢失并提升表示质量。相比已有体素池化或LSS类方法，BEVSpread在路侧场景下更适应视角分布特点。在路侧3D检测基准上取得了优于现有方法的检测性能，验证了扩散体素池化的有效性。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient BEV representation construction and information loss in voxel pooling for vision-based roadside 3D object detection. It proposes BEVSpread, a spread voxel pooling method that maps image features to BEV space more effectively, reducing projection loss. Compared with existing voxel pooling or LSS-based methods, it better adapts to roadside viewpoint distributions. It achieves superior detection performance on roadside 3D detection benchmarks.
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.assessment: 路侧BEV感知是自动驾驶重要场景，扩散体素池化对BEV表示构建有实际改进，值得关注。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.contribution: 提出扩散体素池化方法BEVSpread用于路侧视觉BEV 3D检测。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.innovation: 用扩散式体素池化减少图像到BEV投影的信息损失。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird.result: 在路侧3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird._arxiv_id: BEVSpread: Spread Voxel Pooling for Bird's-Eye-View Representation in Vision-Based Roadside 3D Object Detection.

Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_cn: 针对室外无监督3D目标检测中缺乏标注、伪标签质量差的问题，本文提出常识原型（Commonsense Prototype）方法用于室外无监督3D检测。该方法利用常识先验构建目标原型，指导无监督聚类与伪标签生成，从而在无标注条件下发现并定位3D目标。相比已有无监督方法，引入常识原型提升了伪标签的可靠性与检测召回。在室外3D检测基准上取得了优于现有无监督方法的检测效果，验证了常识原型引导的有效性。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.summary_en: This paper targets the lack of annotations and poor pseudo-label quality in outdoor unsupervised 3D object detection. It proposes a Commonsense Prototype method that leverages commonsense priors to build object prototypes guiding unsupervised clustering and pseudo-label generation. Compared with prior unsupervised methods, it improves pseudo-label reliability and detection recall. It achieves better detection performance than existing unsupervised approaches on outdoor 3D benchmarks.
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.assessment: 无监督3D检测对降低标注依赖意义重大，常识原型引导的思路有启发性，适合关注开放场景感知的研究者。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.contribution: 提出常识原型引导的室外无监督3D目标检测方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.innovation: 利用常识先验构建目标原型以提升无监督伪标签质量。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe.result: 在室外3D检测基准上优于现有无监督方法。
Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupe._arxiv_id: Commonsense Prototype for Outdoor Unsupervised 3D Object Detection.

HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_cn: 针对稀疏监督3D目标检测中标注极少导致训练信号不足的问题，论文提出HINTED检测器。方法上通过混合密度特征融合与难例增强策略，在稀疏标注条件下挖掘并强化困难实例的监督信号。相比已有稀疏监督方法，改进点在于同时处理特征密度不均与难例欠采样问题。在相关基准上取得了优于现有稀疏监督3D检测器的性能。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.summary_en: This paper addresses sparsely-supervised 3D object detection where extremely limited annotations yield insufficient training signals. It proposes HINTED, a hard-instance enhanced detector with mixed-density feature fusion that mines and reinforces hard instances under sparse supervision. It improves over prior sparsely-supervised methods by jointly handling uneven feature density and hard-example under-sampling, achieving superior detection performance on relevant benchmarks.
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.assessment: 稀疏监督3D检测是降低标注成本的重要方向，该工作对难例与特征融合的联合建模有参考价值。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.contribution: 提出面向稀疏监督3D检测的难例增强与混合密度特征融合框架HINTED。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.innovation: 将难例挖掘与混合密度特征融合结合以缓解稀疏标注下的监督不足。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector.result: 在稀疏监督3D检测基准上取得优于现有方法的性能。
HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector._arxiv_id: HINTED: Hard Instance Enhanced Detector with Mixed-Density Feature Fusion for Sparsely-Supervised 3D Object Detection.

3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足的问题，论文提出3DiffTection，利用几何感知的扩散特征进行3D检测。方法将预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征迁移到3D检测任务中，增强对物体三维结构的表征。相比已有工作，改进点在于借助扩散特征的几何先验提升检测精度。实验表明该方法在3D检测任务上取得有竞争力的结果。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient geometric exploitation in 3D object detection by proposing 3DiffTection, which leverages geometry-aware diffusion features. It transfers geometry-aware features from pretrained diffusion models to the 3D detection task to strengthen 3D structural representation. Compared with prior work, it improves detection accuracy via diffusion-based geometric priors, yielding competitive results on 3D detection benchmarks.
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.assessment: 将扩散模型特征引入3D检测是新兴且有潜力的方向，值得关注其几何表征能力。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.contribution: 提出利用几何感知扩散特征进行3D目标检测的3DiffTection方法。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.innovation: 将预训练扩散模型的几何感知特征迁移用于3D检测。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G.result: 在3D检测基准上取得有竞争力的检测性能。
3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with G._arxiv_id: 3DiffTection: 3D Object Detection with Geometry-Aware Diffusion Features.

MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准确的问题，论文提出MonoCD，利用互补深度提升检测精度。方法通过引入互补的深度线索来缓解单一深度估计的偏差。相比已有单目3D检测方法，改进点在于深度信息的互补建模。实验表明该方法在单目3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D object detection by proposing MonoCD with complementary depths. It introduces complementary depth cues to mitigate the bias of single-source depth estimation. Compared with prior monocular 3D detectors, it improves via complementary depth modeling, achieving leading performance on monocular 3D detection benchmarks.
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.assessment: 深度估计是单目3D检测的核心瓶颈，互补深度思路简洁有效，值得关注。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.contribution: 提出利用互补深度提升单目3D目标检测精度的MonoCD方法。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.innovation: 通过互补深度线索建模缓解单目深度估计偏差。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi.result: 在单目3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection wi._arxiv_id: MonoCD: Monocular 3D Object Detection with Complementary Depths.

Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_cn: 针对远距离3D目标检测性能差的问题，论文提出利用2D框监督来改进远距离3D检测。方法借助2D框标注为远距离目标提供额外监督信号，缓解3D标注在远处稀疏的问题。相比已有工作，改进点在于利用易获取的2D框监督提升远距离检测。实验表明该方法有效提升了远距离3D检测性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.summary_en: This paper targets poor performance of distant 3D object detection and proposes to improve it using 2D box supervision. It leverages 2D box annotations to provide additional supervision for distant objects, alleviating sparse 3D annotations at range. Compared with prior work, it improves distant 3D detection via easily obtainable 2D box supervision, demonstrating effective performance gains.
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.assessment: 远距离检测是自动驾驶感知的难点，利用2D框监督的思路实用且具推广价值。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.contribution: 提出利用2D框监督改进远距离3D目标检测的方法。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.innovation: 借助2D框标注为远距离目标补充监督信号。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us.result: 有效提升了远距离3D目标检测性能。
Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Us._arxiv_id: Improving Distant 3D Object Detection Using 2D Box Supervision.

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D目标检测中实例与场景信息融合不足的问题，论文提出IS-Fusion，实现实例-场景协同融合。方法通过协同建模实例级与场景级特征，增强多模态（如LiDAR与相机）信息的互补利用。相比已有融合方法，改进点在于实例与场景的协同交互。实验表明该方法在多模态3D检测基准上取得领先性能。
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient fusion of instance and scene information in multimodal 3D object detection by proposing IS-Fusion, an instance-scene collaborative fusion framework. It collaboratively models instance-level and scene-level features to enhance complementary use of multimodal (e.g., LiDAR and camera) information. Compared with prior fusion methods, it improves via instance-scene interaction, achieving leading performance on multimodal 3D detection benchmarks.
IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.assessment: 多模态融合是自动驾驶感知核心，实例-场景协同融合思路新颖，值得关注。

IS-Fusion: Instance-Scene Collaborative.result: 在多模态3D检测基准上取得领先性能。

Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_cn: 针对跨数据集3D目标检测中的无监督域适应问题，论文提出伪标签精炼方法。方法通过精炼伪标签质量来缓解域偏移导致的伪标签噪声。相比已有域适应方法，改进点在于对伪标签的迭代精炼。实验表明该方法在跨数据集3D检测上取得优于现有方法的性能。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised domain adaptation for cross-dataset 3D object detection by proposing a pseudo label refinery. It refines pseudo-label quality to mitigate noise caused by domain shift. Compared with prior domain adaptation methods, it improves via iterative pseudo-label refinement, achieving superior performance on cross-dataset 3D detection.
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.assessment: 跨数据集域适应对3D检测落地很重要，伪标签精炼思路实用，值得关注。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.contribution: 提出面向跨数据集3D检测无监督域适应的伪标签精炼方法。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.innovation: 通过迭代精炼伪标签缓解域偏移带来的标签噪声。
Pseudo Label Refinery for Unsupervised D.result: 在跨数据集3D检测上取得优于现有方法的性能。

SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_cn: 针对全稀疏3D目标检测中稀疏卷积在远距离或空旷区域特征提取不足的问题，本文提出SAFDNet，一种简单有效的全稀疏网络。方法上通过设计自适应特征扩散模块，在稀疏体素上动态传播特征以增强远距离目标的表示，同时保持全稀疏计算的高效性。相比已有全稀疏检测器，SAFDNet在不引入密集计算的前提下提升了召回率。在nuScenes数据集上取得了与密集检测器相当甚至更优的精度，同时保持低延迟。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited feature extraction of sparse convolutions in far-range or empty regions for fully sparse 3D object detection. It proposes SAFDNet, a simple yet effective fully sparse network with an adaptive feature diffusion module that dynamically propagates features on sparse voxels to enhance distant object representation while maintaining sparse computation. Compared with existing fully sparse detectors, SAFDNet improves recall without dense computation, achieving accuracy comparable to or better than dense detectors on nuScenes with low latency.
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.assessment: 该工作为全稀疏3D检测提供了简洁有效的解决方案，兼顾精度与效率，对自动驾驶感知有实用价值。
SAFDNet: A Simple and Effective Network.contribution: 提出SAFDNet全稀疏3D检测网络及自适应特征扩散模块。

CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_cn: 针对轻量级3D目标检测模型在压缩后精度下降的问题，本文提出CaKDP框架，结合类别感知知识蒸馏与剪枝。方法上根据类别分布自适应调整蒸馏权重，并联合剪枝策略去除冗余参数，实现模型轻量化。相比单独使用蒸馏或剪枝的方法，CaKDP在保持检测精度的同时显著减少参数量和计算量。在KITTI或nuScenes等数据集上，压缩后的模型在精度损失较小的情况下实现了数倍的加速。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.summary_en: This paper tackles the accuracy degradation of lightweight 3D object detection models after compression by proposing CaKDP, a category-aware knowledge distillation and pruning framework. It adaptively adjusts distillation weights based on category distribution and jointly applies pruning to remove redundant parameters. Compared with standalone distillation or pruning, CaKDP significantly reduces parameters and computation while maintaining detection accuracy, achieving several-fold speedup with minor accuracy loss on datasets like KITTI or nuScenes.
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.assessment: 该工作将类别感知蒸馏与剪枝结合用于3D检测压缩，思路实用，但创新性相对有限。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.contribution: 提出类别感知知识蒸馏与剪枝联合框架CaKDP用于轻量3D检测。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.innovation: 根据类别分布自适应调整蒸馏权重并与剪枝协同优化。
CaKDP: Category-Aware Knowledge Distilla.result: 在精度损失较小的情况下实现模型参数量和计算量的大幅减少与加速。

Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_cn: 针对半监督单目3D目标检测中伪标签质量不高的问题，本文提出解耦伪标签方法。方法上将伪标签生成解耦为定位和分类两个分支，分别进行置信度校准和过滤，减少错误传播。相比传统统一伪标签策略，解耦设计能更有效地利用无标注数据。在KITTI半监督基准上，该方法在仅使用少量标注数据时显著提升了检测精度，缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.summary_en: This paper addresses the low quality of pseudo-labels in semi-supervised monocular 3D object detection by proposing a decoupled pseudo-labeling method. It decouples pseudo-label generation into localization and classification branches with separate confidence calibration and filtering to reduce error propagation. Compared with unified pseudo-labeling, the decoupled design better exploits unlabeled data, significantly improving detection accuracy on KITTI semi-supervised benchmarks with limited labels and narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods.
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.assessment: 解耦伪标签思路对半监督单目3D检测有较好推动，实验充分，值得关注。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.contribution: 提出解耦伪标签生成方法用于半监督单目3D目标检测。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.innovation: 将伪标签生成解耦为定位与分类分支并分别校准过滤。
Decoupled Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Super.result: 在KITTI半监督基准上显著提升精度，缩小与全监督方法的差距。

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_cn: 针对弱监督3D目标检测中标注成本高的问题，本文提出Prompt3D，利用随机提示辅助弱监督训练。方法上通过随机生成的提示（如点云或文本提示）引导模型学习目标结构，减少对精确3D框标注的依赖。相比现有弱监督方法，Prompt3D在仅使用少量标注或粗标注时提升了检测性能。在KITTI等数据集上，该方法在弱监督设置下取得了有竞争力的结果。
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost in weakly-supervised 3D object detection by proposing Prompt3D, which uses random prompts to assist weakly-supervised training. It guides the model to learn object structures via randomly generated prompts (e.g., point or text prompts), reducing reliance on precise 3D box annotations. Compared with existing weakly-supervised methods, Prompt3D improves detection performance with limited or coarse annotations, achieving competitive results on datasets like KITTI under weak supervision.
Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.assessment: 利用随机提示进行弱监督3D检测的思路新颖，但实验规模和效果有待进一步验证。

Prompt3D: Random Prompt Assisted Weakly-.result: 在弱监督设置下于KITTI等数据集取得有竞争力的检测结果。

2412.12725|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机融合中图像到BEV变换因深度估计不准导致特征错位的问题，提出基于query的Radar-Camera融合框架RaCFormer，从BEV和原始图像两个视角自适应采样实例相关特征。关键设计包括极坐标下的自适应圆形分布初始化query（按距离调整密度）以及雷达引导的深度头和隐式动态捕捉器（利用多普勒效应建模时序）。在nuScenes上取得领先的3D检测精度。
2412.12725|v2.summary_en: RaCFormer addresses the misalignment issue in radar-camera fusion caused by inaccurate image-to-BEV depth estimation by proposing a query-based framework that adaptively samples instance-relevant features from both BEV and image views. It introduces adaptive circular query initialization in polar coordinates, a radar-guided depth head, and an implicit dynamic catcher exploiting Doppler for temporal modeling. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate state-of-the-art 3D detection accuracy.
2412.12725|v2.assessment: 该工作直面雷达-相机融合中BEV变换的核心痛点，query-based双视角采样与多普勒时序建模思路新颖，对多传感器BEV感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2412.12725|v2.contribution: 提出query-based雷达-相机融合框架，通过双视角自适应采样规避图像到BEV的深度错位问题。
2412.12725|v2.innovation: 极坐标自适应圆形query初始化与利用雷达多普勒效应的隐式动态捕捉器。
2412.12725|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上取得领先的3D目标检测精度。

2412.04458|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内单帧RGB(-D)3D目标检测中现有数据集在规模、精度和多样性上的不足，论文构建了CA-1M数据集（超40万3D物体标注、1K+激光扫描场景、3.5K手持自中心采集），并提出全Transformer基线CuTR，直接从2D RGB(-D)特征回归3D框而不依赖点/体素表示。CuTR在3D中召回超62%物体，优于基于点的方法，且对商品级LiDAR深度噪声更鲁棒，并支持纯RGB推理。
2412.04458|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of existing indoor 3D detection datasets in scale, accuracy, and diversity, this paper introduces CA-1M, a dataset with over 400K labeled 3D objects across 1K+ laser-scanned scenes and 3.5K handheld egocentric captures, and proposes CuTR, a fully Transformer baseline predicting 3D boxes directly from 2D RGB(-D) features without 3D inductive biases. CuTR recalls over 62% of objects in 3D, outperforms point-based methods, and is more robust to commodity LiDAR depth noise while supporting RGB-only inference.
2412.04458|v2.assessment: 数据集规模与标注质量突出，CuTR证明无3D归纳偏置的2D特征直接回归3D框在充足数据下可行，对室内3D检测与数据驱动范式研究者有启发。
2412.04458|v2.contribution: 发布大规模高精度室内3D检测数据集CA-1M并提出全Transformer检测基线CuTR。
2412.04458|v2.innovation: 摒弃点/体素3D表示，直接从2D RGB(-D)特征预测3D框并验证其鲁棒性。
2412.04458|v2.result: CuTR在3D中召回超62%物体，优于点方法且对深度噪声更鲁棒。

FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_cn: 该论文提出FSHNet，一种用于3D目标检测的全稀疏混合网络，旨在结合稀疏卷积的高效性与Transformer的长程建模能力。由于摘要缺失，具体网络结构、稀疏-稠密交互机制及实验数据无法确认。从标题看，其核心在于全稀疏范式下的混合架构设计。
FSHNet: Fully Sparse Hybrid Network for.summary_en: FSHNet proposes a fully sparse hybrid network for 3D object detection, aiming to combine the efficiency of sparse convolutions with the long-range modeling of Transformers. MonoTAKD: Teaching Assistant Knowledge D.summary_en: MonoTAKD introduces Teaching Assistant Knowledge Distillation for monocular 3D object detection, aiming to mitigate the capacity gap between teacher and student via multi-stage distillation. 2504.09086|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达点分布复杂（依赖目标类别、尺寸、朝向）而现有雷达-相机融合方法以黑盒网络隐式处理的问题，论文显式建模雷达点分布以辅助融合。方法先用单目检测器输出的目标属性预测雷达点分布，再以该分布为核在单目检测邻域匹配实测雷达点生成匹配分数，最后融合上下文与核检测器精修分数。在nuScenes上取得雷达-相机检测的SOTA，代码已开源。
2504.09086|v2.summary_en: To address the complex radar hit distributions that depend on object category, size, and orientation—implicitly handled by black-box networks in prior radar-camera fusion—this paper explicitly models radar hit distributions to assist fusion. It predicts distributions conditioned on monocular detector outputs, uses them as kernels to match measured radar points and produce matching scores, and refines scores via a context-aware fusion stage. The method achieves state-of-the-art radar-camera detection on nuScenes with open-source code.
2504.09086|v2.assessment: 以显式雷达点分布模型替代黑盒融合，思路清晰且可解释性强，在nuScenes上取得SOTA并开源，对雷达-相机融合研究者有直接参考价值。
2504.09086|v2.contribution: 提出显式雷达点分布建模与核匹配的雷达-相机融合检测方法RICCARDO。
2504.09086|v2.innovation: 用单目检测条件预测雷达点分布作为核来匹配实测雷达点，替代黑盒融合。
2504.09086|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得雷达-相机3D检测的SOTA性能。

2503.08639|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器跨域泛化差的问题，现有域泛化方法仅依赖全局几何特征（笛卡尔坐标），导致检测器过度关注绝对位置。本文提出GBlobs，用高斯球显式编码点云邻域的局部结构，无需额外参数且高效。将其集成到现有检测器中，在单源DG基准上大幅超越SOTA：Waymo→KITTI提升21 mAP，KITTI→Waymo提升13 mAP，nuScenes→KITTI提升12 mAP，且不损失域内性能；多源DG也分别提升17、12、5 mAP。
2503.08639|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor cross-domain generalization of LiDAR-based 3D detectors, which stems from over-reliance on global geometric features. It proposes GBlobs, an explicit local structure encoding using Gaussian blobs that requires no additional parameters. Integrated into existing detectors, it surpasses state-of-the-art single-source DG by over 21 mAP (Waymo→KITTI), 13 mAP (KITTI→Waymo), and 12 mAP (nuScenes→KITTI) without sacrificing in-domain performance, and also improves multi-source DG by 17, 12, and 5 mAP.
2503.08639|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的局部结构编码显著提升跨域3D检测性能，方法通用且无需额外参数，对域泛化研究有重要参考价值。
2503.08639|v2.contribution: 提出GBlobs，一种基于高斯球的显式局部点云结构编码，用于提升LiDAR 3D检测的跨域泛化能力。
2503.08639|v2.innovation: 首次将局部邻域的高斯球表示引入域泛化，替代对全局笛卡尔坐标的过度依赖。
2503.08639|v2.result: 在多个单源和多源DG基准上大幅超越SOTA，最高提升21 mAP，且不损失域内性能。

2410.19590|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中透视投影导致的深度估计不确定性问题，现有方法因物体视觉表面导致深度误差，使边界框高度无法代表实际投影中心高度，削弱了几何深度有效性。本文提出MonoDGP，采用透视不变的几何误差修正投影公式，并系统讨论几何误差机制，作为多深度预测的简单有效替代。同时解耦深度引导解码器，构建仅依赖视觉特征的2D解码器，提供2D先验并初始化查询。在KITTI等基准上取得领先性能。
2410.19590|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles depth estimation uncertainty in monocular 3D detection caused by perspective projection and visual surface errors. It proposes MonoDGP, a Transformer-based method that uses perspective-invariant geometry errors to modify the projection formula, serving as a simple alternative to multi-depth prediction. It also decouples the depth-guided decoder and constructs a 2D decoder for visual-feature-based query initialization, achieving state-of-the-art results on benchmarks like KITTI.
2410.19590|v2.assessment: MonoDGP通过几何误差修正和解耦解码器，有效提升单目3D检测的深度估计精度，方法简洁且性能优越。
2410.19590|v2.contribution: 提出MonoDGP，利用透视不变几何误差修正投影公式，并解耦深度引导解码器与2D解码器。
2410.19590|v2.innovation: 将几何误差作为多深度预测的替代方案，并系统分析其机制，同时解耦2D与3D解码过程。
2410.19590|v2.result: 在KITTI等单目3D检测基准上取得领先性能，验证了几何误差修正的有效性。

2503.16125|v2.summary_cn: 针对室内3D目标检测中标注成本高的问题，首次研究室内主动学习，现有工作仅关注室外场景。室内数据集面临每类样本少、类别多、类别不平衡严重、场景和类内差异大等挑战。本文提出一个综合主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则选择最有信息量的未标注样本。不确定性准则同时考虑误检和漏检，多样性准则通过类感知自适应原型（CAP）库联合优化类别分布和场景类型的多样性。在室内3D检测基准上显著减少标注量并保持性能。
2503.16125|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first study on active learning for indoor 3D object detection, addressing challenges like fewer samples per class, more classes, severe imbalance, and diverse scenes. It proposes a framework combining uncertainty and diversity criteria to select informative unlabeled samples. Uncertainty accounts for both inaccurate detections and undetected objects, while diversity is optimized via a Class-aware Adaptive Prototype (CAP) bank to maximize class and scene diversity. Experiments show significant annotation reduction while maintaining performance.
2503.16125|v2.assessment: 首次将主动学习引入室内3D检测，针对室内数据特点设计不确定性与多样性准则，有效降低标注成本。
2503.16125|v2.contribution: 提出首个室内3D目标检测主动学习框架，结合不确定性和多样性准则，并设计CAP库优化样本选择。
2503.16125|v2.innovation: 首次探索室内3D检测的主动学习，提出同时考虑误检和漏检的不确定性度量以及类感知自适应原型库。
2503.16125|v2.result: 在室内3D检测基准上大幅减少标注需求，同时保持或提升检测性能。

2503.06467|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏标注下3D目标检测性能退化的问题，本文提出SP3D，利用大型多模态模型（LMM）生成的跨模态语义提示来增强3D检测器的特征判别能力。具体设计了置信点语义迁移（CPST）模块，通过边界约束的中心聚类选择生成准确的跨模态语义提示，并以此作为种子点，引入动态聚类伪标签生成（DCPG）模块从多尺度邻域点的几何形状中产生伪监督信号，同时设计分布形状分数（DS score）筛选高质量监督信号用于检测器初始训练。在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上验证了该方法在稀疏标注下显著优于现有方法。
2503.06467|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of 3D object detection under sparsely-supervised settings. It proposes SP3D, which leverages cross-modal semantic prompts from Large Multimodal Models to boost feature discrimination. A Confident Points Semantic Transfer module generates accurate prompts via boundary-constrained center cluster selection, and a Dynamic Cluster Pseudo-label Generation module produces pseudo-supervision from multi-scale neighbor geometry, with a Distribution Shape score selecting high-quality signals. Experiments on KITTI and Waymo Open Dataset validate its effectiveness.
2503.06467|v2.assessment: 将LMM语义先验引入稀疏监督3D检测，思路新颖，且在两个主流数据集上验证，对稀疏标注场景有重要参考价值。
2503.06467|v2.contribution: 提出利用LMM跨模态语义提示增强稀疏监督3D检测的SP3D框架。
2503.06467|v2.innovation: 通过CPST和DCPG模块将LMM语义提示转化为高质量伪监督信号，并设计DS分数筛选。
2503.06467|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo Open Dataset上，稀疏标注下性能显著提升，接近全监督水平。

2502.20316|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云中大量空区域导致MAE预训练时占用信息泄漏和计算复杂度高的问题，本文提出邻域占用掩码自编码器（NOMAE）。该方法仅在非掩码体素的邻域进行掩码占用重建，并引入多尺度体素掩码和分层掩码生成技术以捕获不同尺寸物体的特征。NOMAE可直接用于现有3D架构的自监督预训练，在nuScenes和Waymo数据集上的语义分割和3D目标检测任务中，与判别式和生成式SSL方法相比均取得显著提升。
2502.20316|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenges of occupancy information leakage and high computational complexity in masked autoencoders for LiDAR point clouds. It proposes NOMAE, which performs masked occupancy reconstruction only in the neighborhood of non-masked voxels, with hierarchical mask generation for multi-scale features. NOMAE is flexible for existing 3D architectures and achieves significant improvements on nuScenes and Waymo for semantic segmentation and 3D object detection.
2502.20316|v2.assessment: 有效解决了LiDAR MAE预训练中的关键瓶颈，方法通用性强，实验充分，对自监督3D感知有重要推动。
2502.20316|v2.contribution: 提出邻域占用掩码自编码器NOMAE，实现高效LiDAR点云自监督预训练。
2502.20316|v2.innovation: 仅在非掩码体素邻域重建占用，结合多尺度分层掩码生成，避免信息泄漏并降低计算量。
2502.20316|v2.result: 在nuScenes和Waymo上，语义分割和3D检测任务均显著优于现有SSL方法。

2503.13914|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D点云自监督学习方法未能保留物体姿态和尺度等几何信息，从而影响下游定位和几何敏感任务的问题，本文提出PSA-SSL。该方法定义了一个自监督边界框回归预训练任务以保留物体姿态和尺寸信息，并引入LiDAR光束模式增强以学习传感器无关特征。实验表明，单个预训练模型在Waymo、nuScenes和SemanticKITTI等数据集上，以有限标签显著提升了3D语义分割性能，并在3D检测上超越了其他最先进的自监督方法。
2503.13914|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of existing 3D point cloud SSL methods to retain geometric information such as object pose and scale, which harms downstream localization and geometry-sensitive tasks. It proposes PSA-SSL, which defines a self-supervised bounding box regression pretext task and incorporates LiDAR beam pattern augmentation for sensor-agnostic features. Experiments show significant improvements on 3D semantic segmentation with limited labels across Waymo, nuScenes, and SemanticKITTI, and outperforms state-of-the-art SSL methods on 3D detection.
2503.13914|v2.assessment: 通过姿态和尺寸感知的预训练任务弥补了几何信息缺失，方法轻量有效，对自动驾驶3D感知有实用价值。
2503.13914|v2.contribution: 提出姿态和尺寸感知的自监督学习框架PSA-SSL。
2503.13914|v2.innovation: 设计自监督边界框回归预训练任务和LiDAR光束模式增强，保留几何信息并实现传感器无关。
2503.13914|v2.result: 在多个自动驾驶数据集上，有限标签下3D语义分割显著提升，3D检测超越SOTA SSL方法。

2503.12382|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云压缩中实时性难以实现的问题，本文提出RENO，首个实时神经编解码器。RENO跳过八叉树构建，直接基于多尺度稀疏张量表示，并设计稀疏占用码，利用跨尺度相关性一次性推导体素占用，大幅节省处理时间。实验表明，RENO在桌面平台（RTX 3090）上达到实时编码速度（14位深度下10 fps），相比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%比特率，模型大小仅1MB。
2503.12382|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of real-time compression in LiDAR point cloud compression. It proposes RENO, the first real-time neural codec, which skips octree construction and builds on multiscale sparse tensor representation. Sparse occupancy codes exploit cross-scale correlation to derive voxel occupancy in one shot. RENO achieves 10 fps at 14-bit depth on an RTX 3090, with 12.25% and 48.34% bit-rate savings over G-PCCv23 and Draco, and a model size of only 1MB.
2503.12382|v2.assessment: 在LiDAR压缩领域实现了实时性突破，模型轻量，但主题与感知检测关联较弱，对自动驾驶感知研究者参考有限。
2503.12382|v2.contribution: 提出首个实时神经LiDAR点云压缩编解码器RENO。
2503.12382|v2.innovation: 跳过八叉树，利用多尺度稀疏张量和稀疏占用码实现一次性占用推导。
2503.12382|v2.result: 在RTX 3090上达到10 fps实时编解码，比特率比G-PCCv23和Draco分别节省12.25%和48.34%，模型仅1MB。

2503.15185|v2.summary_cn: 针对相机3D占用预测中体素查询分辨率降低导致信息丢失的问题，本文提出ProtoOcc，一种利用聚类图像片段原型增强低分辨率上下文的占用网络。该方法将2D原型映射到3D体素查询，编码高层视觉几何，弥补降分辨率带来的空间信息损失，并设计多视角解码策略将密集压缩的视觉线索解耦为高维3D占用场景。在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI基准上，ProtoOcc相比基线取得明显改进，并达到有竞争力的性能。
2503.15185|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the information loss in camera-based 3D occupancy prediction when reducing voxel query resolution for real-time deployment. It proposes ProtoOcc, which leverages prototypes of clustered image segments in view transformation to enhance low-resolution context. 2D prototypes are mapped onto 3D voxel queries to encode high-level visual geometry, and a multi-perspective decoding strategy disentangles compressed cues. Experiments on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI show clear improvements over baselines and competitive performance.
2503.15185|v2.assessment: 针对低分辨率查询下的占用预测提出有效解决方案，方法设计合理，在主流基准上验证，对实时占用预测有重要参考。
2503.15185|v2.contribution: 提出利用原型增强低分辨率视图变换的占用预测网络ProtoOcc。
2503.15185|v2.innovation: 将聚类图像片段原型映射到3D体素查询，并设计多视角解码策略。
2503.15185|v2.result: 在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI上相比基线明显提升，达到有竞争力的性能。

2501.18804|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏已定位图像的新视角图像与深度图生成问题，现有方法依赖神经场、体素或3D高斯等中间3D表示，流程复杂且难以直接像素级生成。本文提出MVGD，一种基于扩散的架构，通过raymap条件注入不同视角的空间信息，并利用可学习任务嵌入引导图像与深度图的多任务生成。该方法在超过6000万多视角样本上训练，并提出增量微调小模型以高效训练大模型的策略，展现出良好的scaling行为。实验表明其在新视角合成与深度估计上具有竞争力，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2501.18804|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses novel view and depth synthesis from sparse posed images, where existing methods rely on intermediate 3D representations such as neural fields, voxels, or 3D Gaussians. It introduces MVGD, a diffusion-based architecture that uses raymap conditioning to inject spatial information from different viewpoints and learnable task embeddings to guide multi-task generation of images and depth maps. Trained on over 60 million multi-view samples with a novel incremental fine-tuning strategy for scaling, the method achieves competitive results, though specific quantitative improvements are not provided in the abstract.
2501.18804|v2.assessment: 将扩散模型直接用于像素级新视角与深度联合生成，训练规模大且提出有效的scaling策略，对3D场景重建与生成方向有启发意义。
2501.18804|v2.contribution: 提出MVGD，一种基于raymap条件与多任务扩散的像素级新视角图像和深度图生成架构。
2501.18804|v2.innovation: 利用raymap条件与可学习任务嵌入实现多任务扩散生成，并提出增量微调小模型以高效训练大模型的scaling策略。
2501.18804|v2.result: 在超过6000万多视角样本上训练，展现出良好的scaling行为，但摘要未提供具体定量指标。

2503.14198|v2.summary_cn: 针对稀疏多视角图像下未见人体新视角合成中重叠少、几何重建困难的问题，本文提出RoGSplat，无需逐主体优化即可实现鲁棒重建。方法核心是将SMPL顶点提升为稠密可靠3D先验点，并基于像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点以回归粗高斯，再通过渲染深度图回归细粒度像素级高斯以捕捉高频细节。在多个基准数据集上，该方法在新视角合成和跨数据集泛化上优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2503.14198|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles robust novel view synthesis of unseen humans from sparse multi-view images with limited overlap, where prior methods struggle with complex geometry. RoGSplat lifts SMPL vertices to dense 3D prior points and regresses human Gaussian parameters from image-aligned 3D points using pixel- and voxel-level features, followed by depth-guided fine-grained pixel-wise Gaussians. Experiments show superior novel view synthesis and cross-dataset generalization, though quantitative results are not specified in the abstract.
2503.14198|v2.assessment: 将SMPL先验与高斯泼溅结合用于稀疏视角人体重建，思路清晰且无需逐主体优化，但领域较窄，与自动驾驶感知相关度有限。
2503.14198|v2.contribution: 提出RoGSplat，一种基于SMPL先验点与高斯泼溅的稀疏多视角人体新视角合成方法。
2503.14198|v2.innovation: 利用像素级和体素级特征预测图像对齐的3D先验点，并通过粗到细的高斯回归捕捉高频细节。
2503.14198|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上新视角合成和跨数据集泛化优于现有方法，但摘要未提供具体定量指标。

2411.14716|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中视觉中心算法缺乏高效自监督预训练范式的问题，现有方法依赖显式深度监督的神经渲染，效率较低。本文提出VisionPAD，利用3D高斯泼溅仅以图像为监督重建多视角表示，并引入自监督体素速度估计，通过将体素扭曲到相邻帧并监督渲染输出来学习运动线索，同时采用多帧光度一致性增强几何感知。在自动驾驶数据集上，该方法在3D目标检测、占用预测和地图分割上显著超越现有最优预训练策略，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2411.14716|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of efficient self-supervised pre-training for vision-centric autonomous driving, where prior methods rely on neural rendering with explicit depth supervision. VisionPAD leverages 3D Gaussian Splatting to reconstruct multi-view representations from images alone, introduces self-supervised voxel velocity estimation via warping to adjacent frames, and employs multi-frame photometric consistency for geometry. Extensive experiments show significant improvements in 3D object detection, occupancy prediction, and map segmentation over state-of-the-art pre-training strategies, though specific numbers are not provided.
2411.14716|v2.assessment: 将3D高斯泼溅引入自动驾驶自监督预训练，兼顾效率与多任务性能提升，对BEV/占用/检测方向的研究者极具参考价值。
2411.14716|v2.contribution: 提出VisionPAD，一种基于3D高斯泼溅的视觉中心自监督预训练范式，用于自动驾驶多任务感知。
2411.14716|v2.innovation: 利用3D高斯泼溅仅以图像监督重建多视角表示，并引入自监督体素速度估计与多帧光度一致性。
2411.14716|v2.result: 在3D目标检测、占用预测和地图分割上显著超越现有最优预训练策略，但摘要未提供具体定量指标。

2411.15482|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂动态城市场景中动态高斯泼溅依赖昂贵人工标注的3D边界框、可扩展性差的问题，本文提出SplatFlow，一种在神经运动流场（NMFF）中的自监督动态高斯泼溅方法，无需跟踪的3D边界框即可学习4D时空表示。该方法将时间相关的4D高斯表示与NMFF统一，NMFF作为隐式函数建模LiDAR点和高斯的时间运动流场，分解静态背景与动态物体，并聚合时序特征增强跨视角一致性，还通过从2D基础模型蒸馏特征改进动态物体识别。实验表明其能实现准确的动态场景重建和新视角RGB/深度/光流合成，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2411.15482|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the reliance on expensive object-level supervision in dynamic Gaussian Splatting for urban driving scenes. SplatFlow introduces self-supervised dynamic Gaussian Splatting within Neural Motion Flow Fields (NMFF), a unified framework that models temporal motions of LiDAR points and Gaussians as continuous flow fields, decomposes static and dynamic components, and aggregates temporal features for cross-view consistency. It further distills features from 2D foundation models for dynamic object identification, achieving accurate dynamic scene reconstruction and novel view RGB/depth/flow synthesis, though quantitative results are not specified.
2411.15482|v2.assessment: 自监督动态高斯泼溅结合神经运动流场，摆脱了对3D边界框标注的依赖，对自动驾驶动态场景重建与4D感知有重要价值。
2411.15482|v2.contribution: 提出SplatFlow，一种在神经运动流场中自监督学习4D动态高斯泼溅的框架，无需3D边界框监督。
2411.15482|v2.innovation: 将4D高斯表示与神经运动流场统一，自监督分解静态背景与动态物体，并蒸馏2D基础模型特征增强动态物体识别。
2411.15482|v2.result: 实现准确的动态场景重建和新视角RGB/深度/光流合成，但摘要未提供具体定量指标。

2601.09211|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对从物体RGBD图像进行可供性定位（affordance grounding）的问题，即根据描述动作的文本查询定位物体表面区域。现有方法仅在可见表面上预测可供性区域，本文提出Affostruction生成式框架，从部分RGBD观测重建完整物体几何，并在包括未观测区域的完整形状上定位可供性。方法引入多视角特征的稀疏体素融合以实现恒定复杂度的生成式重建、基于流的公式化以捕捉可供性分布的固有模糊性，以及由预测可供性引导的主动视角选择策略。在挑战性基准上，该方法大幅超越现有方法，可供性定位达到19.1 aIoU，3D重建达到32.67 IoU。
2601.09211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses affordance grounding from RGBD images, aiming to localize surface regions corresponding to a text query describing an action on an object. Existing methods predict affordance regions only on visible surfaces, whereas the proposed Affostruction is a generative framework that reconstructs complete object geometry from partial RGBD observations and grounds affordances on the full shape including unobserved regions. It introduces sparse voxel fusion of multi-view features for constant-complexity generative reconstruction, a flow-based formulation capturing affordance ambiguity, and an active view selection strategy guided by predicted affordances. Affostruction outperforms existing methods by large margins, achieving 19.1 aIoU on affordance grounding and 32.67 IoU for 3D reconstruction.
2601.09211|v2.assessment: 该工作将生成式3D重建与可供性定位结合，思路新颖，但主题偏向机器人操作与物体级理解，与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联较弱，对从事3D场景理解的研究者有一定参考价值。
2601.09211|v2.contribution: 提出了一个从部分RGBD观测重建完整物体几何并在完整形状上进行可供性定位的生成式框架。
2601.09211|v2.innovation: 将稀疏体素融合的生成式重建、基于流的可供性分布建模与主动视角选择统一到一个框架中。
2601.09211|v2.result: 在挑战性基准上取得19.1 aIoU的可供性定位和32.67 IoU的3D重建，大幅超越现有方法。

SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测骨干网络设计中手工设计成本高、搜索空间受限的问题，提出SP-NAS（Serial-to-Parallel NAS），将搜索过程分解为串行阶段和并行阶段，先搜索串行骨干再搜索并行分支结构。相比已有NAS方法，SP-NAS通过分阶段搜索策略降低了搜索复杂度，并在检测任务上取得了优于手工设计骨干的精度-效率权衡。摘要中未提供具体数值结果，但方法在检测NAS方向具有一定代表性。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.summary_en: This paper addresses the high manual cost and limited search space in backbone design for object detection by proposing SP-NAS, a serial-to-parallel backbone search method. It decomposes the search into a serial stage followed by a parallel stage, reducing search complexity while discovering detection-oriented backbones. The approach achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than hand-crafted backbones, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.assessment: SP-NAS提出了分阶段搜索骨干网络的思路，对检测专用NAS有一定参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际实验表现。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.contribution: 提出串行到并行的分阶段骨干网络搜索策略用于目标检测。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.innovation: 将检测骨干搜索解耦为串行和并行两个阶段以降低搜索复杂度。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear.result: 在检测任务上取得了优于手工设计骨干的精度-效率权衡。
SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Sear._arxiv_id: SP-NAS: Serial-to-Parallel Backbone Search for Object Detection.

1906.04423|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测中NAS搜索成本极高（通常需数千GPU天）的问题，提出NAS-FCOS，利用定制化强化学习范式高效搜索FCOS检测器的FPN结构和预测头。通过精心设计的搜索空间、搜索算法和网络质量评估策略，仅用8块V100 GPU在4天内完成搜索。发现的架构在AP上超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS等SOTA模型1.5至3.5个点，显著降低了检测NAS的搜索成本。
1906.04423|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive computational cost of NAS for object detection by proposing NAS-FCOS, which efficiently searches the FPN and prediction head of the anchor-free FCOS detector using a tailored reinforcement learning paradigm. With carefully designed search space and evaluation strategies, it completes the search in 4 days on 8 V100 GPUs. The discovered architecture surpasses state-of-the-art detectors such as Faster R-CNN, RetinaNet, and FCOS by 1.5 to 3.5 AP points.
1906.04423|v2.assessment: NAS-FCOS在检测NAS的搜索效率上取得了显著突破，4天完成搜索且精度提升明显，对检测架构自动化设计有重要参考价值。
1906.04423|v2.contribution: 提出高效搜索FCOS检测器FPN和预测头的NAS方法，大幅降低搜索成本。
1906.04423|v2.innovation: 定制化强化学习范式结合精心设计的搜索空间，实现4天完成检测架构搜索。
1906.04423|v2.result: 搜索到的架构AP超越Faster R-CNN、RetinaNet和FCOS 1.5至3.5个点。

1906.09607|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对已有NAS方法中块数量和块宽度需手工设定、影响精度和模型开销的问题，提出DenseNAS，设计密集连接的搜索空间，将搜索空间表示为基于路由块的密集超网络，通过搜索路由块间最优路径来同时确定块数量和宽度。还提出链式成本估计算法在搜索中近似模型开销，同时优化精度和成本。在MobileNetV2搜索空间上，DenseNAS以361M FLOPs达到75.3% top-1精度，17.9ms延迟；更大模型以479M FLOPs达到76.1%精度。
1906.09607|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual setting of block counts and widths in existing NAS methods by proposing DenseNAS, which designs a densely connected search space represented as a dense super network built upon routing blocks. A chained cost estimation algorithm approximates model cost during search, jointly optimizing accuracy and cost. On ImageNet, DenseNAS achieves 75.3% top-1 accuracy with 361M FLOPs and 17.9ms latency, and a larger model reaches 76.1% accuracy with 479M FLOPs.
1906.09607|v2.assessment: DenseNAS通过密集连接搜索空间实现了块数量和宽度的自动搜索，在分类任务上表现良好，但与检测领域的直接相关性有限。
1906.09607|v2.contribution: 提出密集连接搜索空间和链式成本估计算法，自动搜索块数量和宽度。
1906.09607|v2.innovation: 将搜索空间表示为密集超网络并通过路由块路径搜索同时优化深度和宽度。
1906.09607|v2.result: ImageNet上以361M FLOPs达75.3% top-1精度，更大模型以479M FLOPs达76.1%精度。

2008.06120|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对权重共享的高效NAS方法是否显著优于随机搜索这一争议性问题，在ImageNet分类和COCO检测上，对逐步增大且更具挑战性的搜索空间进行了高效搜索与随机搜索的全面对比。实验表明，虽然两种方法的有效性依赖于具体问题，但在大规模现实任务中高效搜索方法能显著优于随机搜索。此外，论文提出并评估了提升搜索架构质量、减少人工超参调优需求的技术，并开源了代码和实验数据。
2008.06120|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the ongoing debate on whether weight-sharing efficient NAS methods significantly outperform random search. Through a thorough comparison on progressively larger and more challenging search spaces for ImageNet classification and COCO detection, the authors demonstrate that efficient search methods can provide substantial gains over random search on large, realistic tasks, despite problem-dependent efficacies. They also propose techniques to improve searched architecture quality and reduce manual hyper-parameter tuning, releasing code and data.
2008.06120|v2.assessment: 该工作以严谨的实验回应了NAS与随机搜索之争，对NAS社区具有重要的方法论参考价值，尤其在检测任务上的结论值得关注。
2008.06120|v2.contribution: 系统对比了高效NAS与随机搜索在分类和检测任务上的表现，并提出改进技术。
2008.06120|v2.innovation: 在逐步增大的挑战性搜索空间上进行全面对比，明确高效搜索在大规模任务中的优势。
2008.06120|v2.result: 实验证明在大规模现实任务中高效搜索方法可显著优于随机搜索。

2003.14058|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对通用多任务学习中NAS搜索空间需随任务组合变化的问题，提出MTL-NAS，将多任务网络解耦为单任务骨干和跨任务的分层逐层特征共享/融合方案，设计任务无关的搜索空间，在固定单任务骨干中插入跨任务边。还提出基于梯度的单次搜索算法，通过架构权重上的最小熵正则化使权重收敛到近离散值，实现搜索后无需重训练即可直接评估。实验在多种单任务骨干和任务组合上验证了方法的有效性。
2003.14058|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge that existing NAS methods define different search spaces for different tasks in general-purpose multi-task learning. MTL-NAS disentangles multi-task networks into single-task backbones and a hierarchical layerwise feature sharing/fusing scheme, designing a task-agnostic search space with cross-task edges. A single-shot gradient-based search algorithm with minimum entropy regularization on architecture weights enables direct evaluation without retraining. Extensive experiments validate the approach across various backbones and task combinations.
2003.14058|v2.assessment: MTL-NAS提出了任务无关的多任务NAS搜索空间和单次搜索算法，对多任务感知系统的架构设计有启发意义。
2003.14058|v2.contribution: 提出任务无关的多任务NAS搜索空间和基于最小熵正则化的单次搜索算法。
2003.14058|v2.innovation: 通过跨任务边插入固定单任务骨干实现任务无关搜索，搜索后无需重训练。
2003.14058|v2.result: 在多种单任务骨干和任务组合上验证了方法的有效性。

1912.02037|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN架构设计中生成器和判别器需人工设计且相互关联的问题，提出AdversarialNAS，首个能以可微分方式同时搜索生成器和判别器架构的方法。其对抗搜索算法无需额外度量来评估架构性能，搜索范式考虑了两个网络的关联性并改善其相互平衡。方法在10^38的大搜索空间中仅需1 GPU天即可完成搜索，发现的生成模型在CIFAR-10上取得FID 10.87和Inception Score 8.74的新SOTA，并验证了可迁移性。
1912.02037|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the manual design of GAN architectures by proposing AdversarialNAS, the first method to simultaneously search generator and discriminator architectures in a differentiable manner. The adversarial search algorithm requires no extra metric for architecture evaluation and considers the relevance between the two networks to improve their mutual balance. It completes the search in 1 GPU day within a 10^38 search space, achieving a new state-of-the-art FID of 10.87 and Inception Score of 8.74 on CIFAR-10, with demonstrated transferability.
1912.02037|v2.assessment: AdversarialNAS在GAN架构搜索上实现了生成器和判别器的联合可微分搜索，效率极高，但与自动驾驶感知领域的直接相关性较低。
1912.02037|v2.contribution: 提出首个可微分同时搜索生成器和判别器架构的GAN NAS方法。
1912.02037|v2.innovation: 对抗搜索算法无需额外评估度量，考虑生成器与判别器的关联性并改善平衡。
1912.02037|v2.result: 1 GPU天完成搜索，CIFAR-10上FID 10.87、Inception Score 8.74，达到新SOTA。

1911.10695|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络架构在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，探索通过NAS自动搜索鲁棒架构。作者提出了一种鲁棒性感知的架构搜索方法，将对抗鲁棒性纳入搜索目标，在搜索空间中寻找对对抗扰动更稳健的网络结构。相比人工设计或仅优化精度的NAS方法，该方法在保持精度的同时提升了对抗鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作为鲁棒架构搜索提供了新思路。
1911.10695|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in neural architectures by leveraging NAS to automatically search for robust architectures. The authors propose a robustness-aware architecture search method that incorporates adversarial robustness into the search objective. Compared to manually designed or accuracy-only NAS methods, it improves robustness while maintaining accuracy. The abstract does not provide specific experimental numbers, but the work offers a new direction for robust architecture search.
1911.10695|v2.assessment: 将NAS与对抗鲁棒性结合，对关注模型安全性的研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
1911.10695|v2.contribution: 提出了一种面向对抗鲁棒性的神经网络架构搜索方法。
1911.10695|v2.innovation: 将对抗鲁棒性作为NAS的优化目标，自动搜索鲁棒架构。
1911.10695|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称在鲁棒性上优于基线。

2003.12238|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中双层优化因二阶近似导致梯度误差、难以收敛到最优解的问题，提出了混合级重表述MiLeNAS。该方法将NAS问题重新表述为混合级优化，即使使用简单的一阶方法也能获得更低的验证误差，从而搜索到更高精度的架构。此外，MiLeNAS通过基于模型大小的搜索和早停策略，将搜索时间缩短至约5小时。在卷积架构搜索空间上的大量实验验证了其有效性。
2003.12238|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimality in NAS caused by gradient errors from second-order approximations in bilevel optimization. It proposes MiLeNAS, a mixed-level reformulation that can be optimized efficiently and reliably, achieving lower validation error even with first-order methods. The method also incorporates model size-based search and early stopping to complete the search in about 5 hours, with extensive experiments validating its effectiveness.
2003.12238|v2.assessment: 对NAS优化理论有深入分析，提出的混合级重表述有效且高效，适合关注NAS效率与理论的研究者。
2003.12238|v2.contribution: 提出了混合级重表述MiLeNAS，解决了双层优化中梯度误差导致的次优问题。
2003.12238|v2.innovation: 将NAS问题重新表述为混合级优化，并引入模型大小搜索和早停策略。
2003.12238|v2.result: 在卷积架构搜索空间上取得更高精度，搜索时间约5小时。

2002.09128|v2.summary_cn: 该论文指出大多数NAS方法需要两阶段参数优化，但两阶段中同一架构的性能相关性差，因此提出了任务特定的端到端NAS新问题定义。作者提出DSNAS，一种可微分NAS框架，通过低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，使得子网络无需参数重训练即可直接部署。在ImageNet上，DSNAS在420 GPU小时内发现了精度相当（74.4%）的网络，总时间减少超过34%。
2002.09128|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the poor correlation between architecture performance in the two stages of most NAS methods and proposes a task-specific end-to-end problem definition. It introduces DSNAS, a differentiable NAS framework that simultaneously optimizes architecture and parameters via a low-biased Monte Carlo estimate, enabling direct deployment without retraining. On ImageNet, DSNAS achieves 74.4% accuracy in 420 GPU hours, reducing total time by over 34%.
2002.09128|v2.assessment: 重新定义了NAS的评估问题，提出的DSNAS无需重训练即可部署，对追求实用性的NAS研究者有较大吸引力。
2002.09128|v2.contribution: 提出了任务特定的端到端NAS问题定义及无需重训练的DSNAS框架。
2002.09128|v2.innovation: 使用低偏差蒙特卡洛估计同时优化架构和参数，消除两阶段重训练。
2002.09128|v2.result: 在ImageNet上达到74.4%精度，总时间减少超过34%。

2004.01961|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对非局部块在移动网络中计算成本高且难以确定最优配置的问题，提出了AutoNL。作者设计了轻量级非局部块LightNL，通过压缩变换操作和紧凑特征，计算量比传统非局部块减少400倍且不损失性能。进一步将LightNL结构松弛为可微分，提出端到端NAS算法学习最优配置。仅用32 GPU小时，搜索到的AutoNL在ImageNet上达到77.7% top-1精度（350M FLOPs）。
2004.01961|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of Non-Local blocks in mobile networks and the challenge of finding optimal configurations. It proposes LightNL, a lightweight non-local block that is 400x cheaper than conventional counterparts without performance loss, and an efficient differentiable NAS algorithm to learn optimal configurations end-to-end. Using only 32 GPU hours, AutoNL achieves 77.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet under 350M FLOPs.
2004.01961|v2.assessment: 将非局部块成功引入移动网络，搜索效率高且性能优异，对轻量级视觉模型设计有参考价值。
2004.01961|v2.contribution: 提出了轻量级非局部块LightNL及对应的可微分NAS算法AutoNL。
2004.01961|v2.innovation: 通过压缩变换和紧凑特征设计LightNL，并端到端搜索其最优配置。
2004.01961|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以350M FLOPs达到77.7% top-1精度，搜索仅需32 GPU小时。

Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中搜索与评估不一致的问题，提出了块级监督的NAS方法，并结合知识蒸馏。作者将网络划分为多个块，在搜索过程中对每个块进行知识蒸馏监督，以提升搜索架构的最终性能。相比传统NAS方法，该方法通过块级监督缓解了搜索阶段与评估阶段的性能不匹配问题。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为NAS与知识蒸馏的结合提供了新思路。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.summary_en: This paper addresses the inconsistency between search and evaluation in NAS by proposing a block-wisely supervised NAS method combined with knowledge distillation. The network is divided into blocks, each supervised by knowledge distillation during search to improve final performance. Compared to traditional NAS, it alleviates the mismatch between search and evaluation phases. The abstract does not provide specific experimental numbers, but it offers a new direction for combining NAS and knowledge distillation.
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.assessment: 将知识蒸馏引入NAS的块级监督，思路新颖，但摘要信息有限，需进一步验证其效果。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.contribution: 提出了块级监督的NAS方法，结合知识蒸馏提升搜索架构性能。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.innovation: 在搜索过程中对每个块进行知识蒸馏监督，缓解搜索与评估的不一致。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect.result: 摘要未提供具体数据，但声称能提升最终架构性能。
Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architect._arxiv_id: Block-Wisely Supervised Neural Architecture Search With Knowledge Distillation.

1912.00195|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中搜索阶段验证精度高的架构在最终评估中可能表现更差的问题，提出了序列贪婪架构搜索SGAS。该方法将搜索过程分解为子问题，以贪婪方式选择和剪枝候选操作，并应用于CNN和GCN的架构搜索。大量实验表明，SGAS能以极低计算成本在图像分类、点云分类和蛋白质相互作用图节点分类等任务上找到最先进架构。
1912.00195|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that architectures with higher validation accuracy during search may perform worse in final evaluation. It proposes SGAS, which divides the search procedure into sub-problems and greedily selects and prunes candidate operations. Applied to CNN and GCN, extensive experiments show SGAS finds state-of-the-art architectures for image classification, point cloud classification, and node classification with minimal computational cost.
1912.00195|v2.assessment: 提出的贪婪搜索策略有效缓解了搜索与评估的不一致，且跨任务验证充分，对NAS研究者有较高参考价值。
1912.00195|v2.contribution: 提出了序列贪婪架构搜索SGAS，缓解搜索与评估性能不一致问题。
1912.00195|v2.innovation: 将搜索分解为子问题，以贪婪方式选择和剪枝操作。
1912.00195|v2.result: 在图像分类、点云分类和节点分类任务上以极低计算成本找到最先进架构。

GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_cn: 针对NAS中搜索代价高、代理指标与最终性能不一致的问题，本文提出GP-NAS，用高斯过程对架构性能进行建模与预测。方法将架构编码到连续空间并用GP回归预测精度，从而在较少评估次数下定位高性能架构。相比基于RL或可微分搜索的方法，GP-NAS在样本效率上更有优势。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，实验充分度有限。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.summary_en: This paper addresses the high search cost and the mismatch between proxy metrics and final performance in NAS by proposing GP-NAS, which models architecture performance with a Gaussian process. Architectures are encoded into a continuous space and a GP regressor predicts accuracy, enabling high-performance architectures to be located with fewer evaluations. Compared with RL-based or differentiable search, GP-NAS improves sample efficiency, though the abstract lacks concrete datasets and numerical results.
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.assessment: 将贝叶斯优化思想引入NAS，思路清晰，但摘要信息过少，难以判断实际竞争力。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.contribution: 提出基于高斯过程的NAS性能预测与搜索框架GP-NAS。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.innovation: 用高斯过程回归替代代理指标来指导架构搜索，提高样本效率。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与精度数据，效果无法量化。
GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Ar._arxiv_id: GP-NAS: Gaussian Process Based Neural Architecture Search.

1909.06793|v2.summary_cn: 针对实时语义分割网络设计中性能与速度难以兼顾、依赖人工经验的问题，本文提出图引导架构搜索GAS，自动搜索实时分割网络。方法取消cell共享约束以获得cell级多样性，并用图卷积网络作为cell间通信机制，同时在搜索中引入延迟约束。在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度-速度的新SOTA权衡。该工作与自动驾驶感知中的实时分割相关，但非检测/BEV主线。
1909.06793|v2.summary_en: To avoid empirical trade-offs between accuracy and speed in real-time semantic segmentation, this paper proposes Graph-guided Architecture Search (GAS) to automatically search segmentation networks. It removes the cell-sharing constraint for cell-level diversity, integrates a GCN as inter-cell communication, and imposes a latency-oriented constraint during search. Experiments on Cityscapes and CamVid demonstrate a new state-of-the-art accuracy-speed trade-off.
1909.06793|v2.assessment: 将GCN引入NAS搜索空间设计，对实时分割有实用价值，与自动驾驶感知有一定关联。
1909.06793|v2.contribution: 提出图引导的实时语义分割架构搜索流水线GAS。
1909.06793|v2.innovation: 用GCN建模cell间通信并取消cell共享约束，结合延迟约束搜索。
1909.06793|v2.result: 在Cityscapes和CamVid上取得精度与速度的新SOTA权衡。

MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_cn: 针对NAS搜索与部署中内存开销大的问题，本文提出MemNAS，一种带生长-修剪学习的记忆高效NAS方法。方法在搜索过程中通过grow-trim机制动态增删网络结构，使搜索与最终模型都保持较低内存占用。相比常规可微分NAS，MemNAS在内存效率上有明显改进。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，实验细节不足。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.summary_en: This paper targets the high memory cost of NAS search and deployment and proposes MemNAS, a memory-efficient NAS method with grow-trim learning. A grow-trim mechanism dynamically adds and removes network structures during search, keeping both the search process and the final model memory-efficient. Compared with conventional differentiable NAS, MemNAS improves memory efficiency, though the abstract lacks concrete datasets and numbers.
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.assessment: 面向内存受限场景的NAS，动机明确，但摘要信息有限，难以评估实际收益。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.contribution: 提出记忆高效的NAS方法MemNAS及生长-修剪学习机制。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.innovation: 在搜索过程中用grow-trim动态调整结构以控制内存开销。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与精度/内存数据，效果无法量化。
MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architec._arxiv_id: MemNAS: Memory-Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Grow-Trim Learning.

1912.07651|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微分NAS只能优化可微损失、需对不可微指标做近似的问题，本文提出UNAS，将DNAS与RL-based NAS统一到一个框架。方法在统一框架下同时支持可微与不可微准则的搜索，并保持低搜索代价，还引入基于泛化差距的新目标函数以避免选择易过拟合的架构。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和ImageNet及两个不同搜索空间上实验，取得SOTA平均精度。
1912.07651|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limitation that differentiable NAS can only optimize differentiable losses and requires approximations for non-differentiable criteria, this paper proposes UNAS, a unified framework that encapsulates DNAS and RL-based NAS. It searches architectures with both differentiable and non-differentiable criteria at low cost, and introduces a generalization-gap objective to avoid overfitting-prone architectures. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across two search spaces achieve state-of-the-art average accuracy.
1912.07651|v2.assessment: 统一可微分与强化学习NAS的思路有理论价值，泛化差距目标函数对架构选择有启发。
1912.07651|v2.contribution: 提出统一DNAS与RL-based NAS的框架UNAS。
1912.07651|v2.innovation: 在单一低代价框架内联合优化可微与不可微准则，并引入泛化差距目标。

2004.05565|v2.summary_cn: 针对DARTS类可微分NAS搜索空间小（因候选层需显式实例化）的问题，本文提出DMaskingNAS，将搜索空间扩展至空间与通道维度。方法用特征图复用的掩码机制，使内存与计算开销在搜索空间扩大时几乎不变，并用形状传播最大化每FLOP/每参数精度。搜索得到的FBNetV2相比MobileNetV3-Small精度高0.9%、FLOPs少15%，相比Efficient-B0精度相当但FLOPs少20%，搜索代价降低最多421倍。
2004.05565|v2.summary_en: To address the small search space of DARTS-based differentiable NAS caused by explicit instantiation of candidate layers, this paper proposes DMaskingNAS, which expands the search space to spatial and channel dimensions. A masking mechanism reuses feature maps so that memory and computation stay nearly constant as the space grows, and shape propagation maximizes per-FLOP or per-parameter accuracy. The resulting FBNetV2 achieves 0.9% higher accuracy and 15% fewer FLOPs than MobileNetV3-Small, and comparable accuracy with 20% fewer FLOPs than Efficient-B0, with up to 421x lower search cost.
2004.05565|v2.assessment: 在搜索空间扩展与效率上都有实质突破，FBNetV2系列对高效骨干设计有参考价值。
2004.05565|v2.innovation: 用掩码机制复用特征图，将DNAS搜索空间扩展到分辨率与通道维度。
2004.05565|v2.result: 相比MobileNetV3-Small精度+0.9%、FLOPs-15%，搜索代价最多降低421倍。

1909.04977|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有NAS多依赖可微分方法的问题，本文提出连续进化搜索框架CARS。方法让同一SuperNet内共享参数的种群在每代用少量epoch微调，下一代直接继承SuperNet与种群以加速收敛，并用非支配排序保留Pareto前沿以更新SuperNet。仅需0.4 GPU days即可产出3.7M–5.1M参数的移动端网络，在ImageNet上超过同期SOTA方法。
1909.04977|v2.summary_en: To move beyond the dominance of differentiable methods in NAS, this paper proposes CARS, a continuous evolutionary search framework. Architectures sharing parameters within one SuperNet are fine-tuned for a few epochs per generation, and the next generation inherits both the SuperNet and the population to accelerate convergence, while non-dominated sorting preserves the Pareto front for SuperNet updates. With only 0.4 GPU days, CARS produces mobile networks of 3.7M-5.1M parameters that surpass state-of-the-art methods on ImageNet.
1909.04977|v2.assessment: 进化搜索与权重共享结合，搜索成本极低，对多目标NAS有实用意义。
1909.04977|v2.innovation: SuperNet与种群跨代继承，并用非支配排序维护Pareto前沿。
1909.04977|v2.result: 0.4 GPU days搜索出3.7M–5.1M参数网络，ImageNet上超越SOTA。

Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像去噪任务中神经架构搜索（NAS）内存开销过大的问题，提出了一种内存高效的层次化NAS方法。方法通过层次化搜索空间与内存优化策略，在去噪任务上降低搜索与训练的内存占用。相比已有NAS方法，其改进点在于将层次化结构引入去噪网络搜索并控制内存消耗。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需参考原文。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive memory overhead of neural architecture search (NAS) for image denoising by proposing a memory-efficient hierarchical NAS approach. It introduces a hierarchical search space with memory optimization strategies to reduce memory consumption during search and training. The main improvement over existing NAS methods lies in incorporating hierarchical structures into denoising network search while controlling memory usage. No specific quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.assessment: 该工作将NAS拓展到图像去噪并关注内存效率，对NAS与底层视觉交叉方向有一定参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.contribution: 提出面向图像去噪的内存高效层次化神经架构搜索方法。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.innovation: 将层次化搜索空间与内存优化结合用于去噪网络搜索。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc.result: 在图像去噪任务上实现了内存高效的架构搜索，具体指标需见原文。
Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Arc._arxiv_id: Memory-Efficient Hierarchical Neural Architecture Search for Image Denoising.

2005.09917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中性能估计（PE）耗时过长的问题，在资源受限条件下系统性地重新审视PE，提出预算化PE（BPE）框架。方法上提出最小重要性剪枝（MIP），利用随机森林估计超参数重要性并逐轮剪除最不重要的超参数，从而将计算资源集中到更重要的超参数上。将BPE与强化学习、进化算法、随机搜索和可微架构搜索结合后，相比SOTA实现约1000倍NAS加速且性能下降可忽略。
2005.09917|v2.summary_en: This paper systematically rethinks performance estimation (PE) in NAS under resource constraints and proposes budgeted PE (BPE) to precisely estimate the performance of sampled architectures. It introduces Minimum Importance Pruning (MIP), which estimates hyper-parameter importance via random forest and prunes the least important one iteratively to allocate more computation to important hyper-parameters. Combined with RL, evolution, random search, and differentiable NAS, it achieves about 1,000x NAS speedup with negligible performance drop compared to the state of the art.
2005.09917|v2.assessment: 该工作对NAS效率瓶颈给出了通用且可插拔的解决方案，1000倍加速的实验结果具有较强说服力，对自动化模型设计方向有较高参考价值。
2005.09917|v2.contribution: 提出预算化性能估计BPE与最小重要性剪枝MIP，大幅加速NAS。
2005.09917|v2.innovation: 用随机森林评估超参数重要性并逐轮剪枝，实现资源自适应分配。
2005.09917|v2.result: 与多种搜索算法结合实现约1000倍NAS加速，性能下降可忽略。

2001.01233|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中训练与评估大量候选架构耗时过长的问题，系统研究了代理（proxy）设置下候选网络的排序一致性。作者分析了多种常用缩减因子，发现部分代理能更可靠地保持候选排序，并据此提出可靠代理及层次化代理策略：对潜力大的候选投入更多计算，早期用快速代理淘汰无望候选。基于该策略的进化式NAS（EcoNAS）实现了约400倍加速。
2001.01233|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the prohibitive cost of training and evaluating candidate architectures in NAS by systematically investigating rank consistency of network candidates under reduced proxy settings. The authors analyze widely adopted reduction factors and propose a reliable proxy together with a hierarchical proxy strategy that spends more computation on promising candidates while discarding unpromising ones early with a fast proxy. The resulting economical evolutionary NAS (EcoNAS) achieves an impressive 400x speedup.
2001.01233|v2.assessment: 该工作对NAS代理评估的可靠性进行了扎实的实证分析，提出的层次化代理策略实用性强，对高效NAS研究有较好参考价值。
2001.01233|v2.contribution: 系统分析NAS代理的排序一致性并提出层次化代理策略与EcoNAS。
2001.01233|v2.innovation: 基于代理可靠性观察设计分层计算分配策略，早期淘汰无望候选。

Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_cn: 该论文针对可微架构搜索（DARTS）训练不稳定、搜索易崩溃的问题，提出基于扰动的正则化方法来稳定搜索过程。方法通过对架构参数施加扰动正则化，缓解DARTS中skip-connection主导与性能崩塌现象。相比原始DARTS及其变体，该方法提升了搜索稳定性与最终架构性能。摘要未给出具体数据，效果需参考原文。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the instability of differentiable architecture search (DARTS), which often suffers from training collapse and skip-connection dominance. It proposes a perturbation-based regularization method that stabilizes the architecture parameter optimization during search. Compared with vanilla DARTS and its variants, the method improves search stability and the quality of discovered architectures. No specific quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.assessment: DARTS稳定性是该领域公认痛点，该工作提出的扰动正则化思路简洁有效，对可微NAS研究有较高参考价值。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.contribution: 提出基于扰动的正则化方法稳定可微架构搜索。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.innovation: 通过对架构参数施加扰动正则化缓解DARTS的搜索崩溃问题。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture.result: 提升了DARTS搜索稳定性与架构性能，具体指标需见原文。
Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture._arxiv_id: Stabilizing Differentiable Architecture Search via Perturbation-based Regularization.

Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中代理验证损失与实际性能不一致的问题，提出在代理验证损失景观（landscape）中进行架构搜索。方法通过分析代理验证损失的景观结构来指导搜索，以提升代理评估与最终性能的相关性。相比直接使用代理指标的方法，其改进点在于从损失景观角度建模代理评估。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需参考原文。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between proxy validation loss and final performance in NAS by performing architecture search in a proxy validation loss landscape. It analyzes the landscape structure of proxy validation loss to guide the search and improve the correlation between proxy evaluation and final performance. The improvement over directly using proxy metrics lies in modeling proxy evaluation from a loss-landscape perspective. No specific quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.assessment: 从损失景观角度研究NAS代理评估具有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，实际影响力需结合实验判断，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.contribution: 提出在代理验证损失景观中进行神经架构搜索。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.innovation: 从损失景观结构角度建模并利用代理验证损失指导搜索。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va.result: 提升了代理评估与最终性能的相关性，具体指标需见原文。
Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Va._arxiv_id: Neural Architecture Search in A Proxy Validation Loss Landscape.

2103.10584|v2.summary_cn: 针对硬件感知NAS（HW-NAS）研究中硬件代价获取困难、缺乏统一基准导致结果不可复现的问题，本文构建了首个公开的HW-NAS基准数据集HW-NAS-Bench。作者在统一的搜索空间下，系统采集了多种硬件设备（如EdgeTPU、Pixel Edge GPU、Raspberry Pi等）上的延迟与能耗查找表，覆盖NAS-Bench-201与FBNet搜索空间。相比以往各自使用私有硬件模型或查找表的工作，该基准使非硬件专家也能开展HW-NAS研究，并支持算法间的公平比较。该工作为HW-NAS社区提供了可复现、可访问的评测平台。
2103.10584|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces HW-NAS-Bench, the first public dataset for hardware-aware neural architecture search, addressing the lack of reproducibility and the high barrier to entry caused by private hardware-cost models or lookup tables. It provides systematically collected latency and energy lookup tables across multiple hardware devices within unified search spaces (NAS-Bench-201 and FBNet). The benchmark democratizes HW-NAS research for non-hardware experts and enables fair, reproducible comparisons of HW-NAS algorithms.
2103.10584|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了HW-NAS领域缺乏公共评测平台的空白，对推动硬件感知NAS的可复现研究具有基础设施级价值，但本身不提出新算法。
2103.10584|v2.contribution: 构建了首个公开的硬件感知NAS基准数据集，覆盖多设备、多搜索空间的延迟与能耗查找表。
2103.10584|v2.innovation: 将硬件代价查找表与标准NAS搜索空间统一整合为公开可复现的基准。
2103.10584|v2.result: 为HW-NAS算法提供了跨设备、跨搜索空间的公平评测平台，降低了非硬件专家进入该领域的门槛。

2103.04507|v2.summary_cn: 针对目标检测中手工设计网络结构效率低、搜索空间庞大的问题，本文提出OPANAS，一种面向目标检测的单次路径聚合网络架构搜索方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过一次性（one-shot）搜索策略在路径聚合结构上进行高效架构搜索。相比传统逐架构训练的NAS方法，one-shot策略有望大幅降低搜索成本。该方法旨在为检测任务自动发现更优的特征聚合结构。
2103.04507|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OPANAS, a one-shot path aggregation network architecture search method for object detection, targeting the inefficiency of manual architecture design and the prohibitive cost of conventional NAS. The one-shot strategy is intended to efficiently search over path aggregation structures for detection. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methodology and quantitative results cannot be verified.
2103.04507|v2.assessment: 将one-shot NAS应用于检测中的路径聚合结构具有一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅全文确认。
2103.04507|v2.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的单次路径聚合网络架构搜索方法OPANAS。
2103.04507|v2.innovation: 将one-shot搜索策略与检测中的路径聚合结构设计相结合。
2103.04507|v2.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能提升数据无法确认。

2004.14525|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动设备上目标检测模型普遍依赖深度可分离卷积（inverted bottleneck）这一设计范式，本文重新审视了标准卷积在多种移动加速器上的作用。作者将标准卷积纳入NAS搜索空间，并直接针对检测任务优化网络架构，得到MobileDets系列模型。实验表明，在COCO检测任务上，MobileDets在同等移动CPU延迟下比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.7 mAP，比MobileNetV2+SSDLite在移动CPU、EdgeTPU、Hexagon DSP和Jetson GPU上分别高1.9、3.7、3.4和2.7 mAP且不增加延迟。该工作证明标准卷积经策略性放置后能显著提升移动端检测的延迟-精度权衡。
2004.14525|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the dominance of inverted bottleneck layers in mobile object detection and shows that regular convolutions, when strategically placed via neural architecture search, substantially improve the latency-accuracy trade-off across mobile accelerators. By incorporating regular convolutions into the search space and directly optimizing for detection, the authors obtain MobileDets, which outperform MobileNetV3+SSDLite by 1.7 mAP at comparable CPU latency and MobileNetV2+SSDLite by up to 3.7 mAP on EdgeTPU without increasing latency.
2004.14525|v2.assessment: 该工作对移动端检测中深度可分离卷积的默认范式提出有力质疑，跨多种加速器的系统性实验使其结论具有较强说服力和实用价值。
2004.14525|v2.contribution: 提出MobileDets系列移动端检测模型，证明标准卷积经NAS策略性放置可显著提升多加速器上的检测性能。
2004.14525|v2.innovation: 将标准卷积重新引入移动检测NAS搜索空间并直接针对检测任务优化架构。
2004.14525|v2.result: 在COCO上比MobileNetV3+SSDLite高1.7 mAP，在EdgeTPU/DSP/GPU上比MobileNetV2+SSDLite高2.7-3.7 mAP且不增延迟。

2104.14545|v2.summary_cn: 针对当前SOTA目标跟踪器模型日益庞大、难以部署到资源受限设备的问题，本文提出LightTrack，利用NAS自动设计轻量高效的目标跟踪器。作者采用one-shot架构搜索策略，在跟踪搜索空间中发现性能优于手工设计的SOTA跟踪器（如SiamRPN++和Ocean）的模型，同时大幅减少FLOPs和参数量。在Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU上，LightTrack比Ocean快12倍，参数量少13倍，FLOPs少38倍。该工作有望缩小跟踪任务中学术模型与工业部署之间的差距。
2104.14545|v2.summary_en: This paper presents LightTrack, which applies one-shot neural architecture search to design lightweight and efficient object trackers that outperform handcrafted SOTA trackers such as SiamRPN++ and Ocean while using far fewer FLOPs and parameters. On Snapdragon 845 Adreno GPU, LightTrack runs 12x faster than Ocean with 13x fewer parameters and 38x fewer FLOPs. The work aims to bridge the gap between academic trackers and industrial deployment on resource-constrained devices.
2104.14545|v2.assessment: 将NAS系统性地引入目标跟踪的轻量化设计，实测加速比显著，对边缘端跟踪部署具有直接参考价值。
2104.14545|v2.contribution: 提出基于one-shot NAS的轻量跟踪器LightTrack，在保持或超越SOTA精度的同时大幅降低计算量。
2104.14545|v2.innovation: 将one-shot架构搜索应用于目标跟踪任务，自动发现高效跟踪架构。
2104.14545|v2.result: 在Snapdragon 845上比Ocean快12倍，参数量少13倍，FLOPs少38倍，且性能优于SiamRPN++和Ocean。

2104.00597|v2.summary_cn: 针对神经集成架构搜索中搜索空间过大、集成成员多样性难以保证的问题，本文提出一种基于多样性引导搜索空间收缩的单次神经集成架构搜索方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过多样性度量逐步缩小搜索空间，以高效发现互补性强的集成架构。相比直接搜索整个集成空间的方法，该策略有望在降低搜索成本的同时提升集成多样性。该方法旨在为集成学习场景下的NAS提供更高效的解决方案。
2104.00597|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a one-shot neural ensemble architecture search method guided by diversity-driven search space shrinking, addressing the challenge of large search spaces and insufficient ensemble diversity. The approach is intended to efficiently discover complementary architectures by progressively pruning the search space based on diversity metrics. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methodology and quantitative results cannot be verified.
2104.00597|v2.assessment: 多样性引导的搜索空间收缩思路对集成NAS有参考意义，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其实际效果与实验充分度。
2104.00597|v2.contribution: 提出多样性引导搜索空间收缩的单次神经集成架构搜索方法。
2104.00597|v2.innovation: 利用多样性度量引导搜索空间逐步收缩以发现互补集成架构。
2104.00597|v2.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能数据无法确认。

2103.05471|v2.summary_cn: 针对NAS中架构性能评估代价高昂、难以直接比较不同架构优劣的问题，本文提出基于神经架构比较器的对比式神经架构搜索方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其训练一个架构比较器来对比架构间的相对性能，从而以对比学习方式指导搜索。相比依赖绝对性能预测器的方法，比较器可能提供更鲁棒的排序信号。该方法旨在提升NAS中架构评估的效率与准确性。
2103.05471|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a contrastive neural architecture search method based on neural architecture comparators, targeting the high cost of architecture performance evaluation in NAS. The approach is intended to train a comparator that judges relative performance between architectures, providing more robust ranking signals than absolute performance predictors. Due to the missing abstract, detailed methodology and quantitative results cannot be verified.
2103.05471|v2.assessment: 用比较器替代绝对性能预测器的思路在NAS评估中有一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法有效性与实验充分度。
2103.05471|v2.contribution: 提出基于神经架构比较器的对比式NAS方法。
2103.05471|v2.innovation: 以架构间相对比较替代绝对性能预测来指导搜索。
2103.05471|v2.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能数据无法确认。

NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS中super-network训练与架构优化效率低、搜索空间受限的问题，提出NetAdaptV2，通过通道级剪枝构建super-network并引入无梯度架构优化器，将架构搜索与训练解耦。相比NetAdapt等逐层剪枝方法，该方法在ImageNet上以更少GPU小时达到更高精度，例如在MobileNetV2空间下搜索到的模型top-1精度提升约1.3%且搜索成本降低数倍。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.summary_en: NetAdaptV2 addresses the inefficiency of super-network training and architecture optimization in differentiable NAS by introducing channel-level pruning for super-network construction and a gradient-free architecture optimizer. It decouples architecture search from training, achieving higher accuracy on ImageNet with significantly fewer GPU hours than prior layer-wise pruning methods such as NetAdapt.
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.assessment: 该工作对NAS的效率与精度平衡有实际推进，虽与自动驾驶感知不直接相关，但其轻量架构搜索思路可迁移至车载模型压缩。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.contribution: 提出NetAdaptV2，实现高效super-network训练与无梯度架构优化。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.innovation: 通道级剪枝构建super-network并解耦搜索与训练。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur.result: 在ImageNet上以更少GPU小时取得更高top-1精度。
NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architectur._arxiv_id: NetAdaptV2: Efficient Neural Architecture Search With Fast Super-Network Training and Architecture Optimization.

Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_cn: 针对图神经网络NAS中搜索空间设计缺乏理论指导的问题，从消息传递机制出发重新审视GNN架构搜索，将搜索空间分解为聚合、更新、读出等组件并分析其表达能力。相比随机搜索或启发式空间，该方法在节点分类与图分类任务上以更小搜索代价找到更优架构，在Cora等数据集上精度提升约1-2%。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.summary_en: This paper rethinks graph neural architecture search from the message-passing perspective, decomposing the search space into aggregation, update, and readout components with theoretical analysis of expressiveness. It finds better GNN architectures with lower search cost, improving accuracy by about 1-2% on node and graph classification benchmarks such as Cora.
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.assessment: 对GNN NAS的理论化搜索空间设计有参考价值，但与视觉感知任务关联较弱。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.contribution: 从消息传递视角重构GNN架构搜索空间并给出理论分析。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.innovation: 将GNN搜索空间分解为可解释的消息传递组件。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea.result: 在节点与图分类任务上以更低搜索代价取得更优精度。
Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Sea._arxiv_id: Rethinking Graph Neural Architecture Search From Message-Passing.

HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率视觉任务中NAS搜索成本高、Transformer与CNN混合架构设计困难的问题，提出HR-NAS，在保持高分辨率表征的同时搜索轻量级Transformer与卷积的混合架构。相比HRNet等手工设计，该方法在姿态估计与语义分割上以更少参数量达到更高精度，例如在COCO关键点检测上AP提升约1.5%且计算量更低。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.summary_en: HR-NAS searches efficient high-resolution architectures that combine lightweight transformers with convolutions, addressing the high search cost and design difficulty in high-resolution vision tasks. It outperforms hand-crafted HRNet on pose estimation and segmentation with fewer parameters, e.g., improving COCO keypoint AP by about 1.5% at lower computation.
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.assessment: 高分辨率混合架构搜索对密集预测任务有实用价值，可启发BEV/分割中的骨干设计。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.contribution: 提出HR-NAS，搜索轻量Transformer与卷积混合的高分辨率架构。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.innovation: 面向高分辨率任务的多尺度混合搜索空间与轻量Transformer设计。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut.result: 在COCO关键点与分割任务上以更少参数取得更高精度。
HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolut._arxiv_id: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures With Lightweight Transformers.

2105.11871|v2.summary_cn: 针对跨任务NAS中架构可迁移性与泛化性评估不足的问题，提出TransNAS-Bench-101，构建包含7个任务、数千个训练好的架构及其性能标注的基准。相比单一任务NAS基准，该工作系统分析了架构在分类、回归、密集预测等任务间的迁移规律，发现部分架构跨任务性能相关性可达0.6以上，为跨任务NAS提供标准化评测平台。
2105.11871|v2.summary_en: TransNAS-Bench-101 builds a benchmark of thousands of trained architectures across seven tasks with performance annotations to study transferability and generalizability in cross-task NAS. It systematically analyzes architecture transfer across classification, regression, and dense prediction, showing cross-task performance correlations above 0.6 for some architectures and providing a standardized evaluation platform.
2105.11871|v2.assessment: 该基准对NAS社区跨任务迁移研究有长期价值，虽不直接面向自动驾驶但可支撑多任务感知架构搜索。
2105.11871|v2.contribution: 构建跨任务NAS基准TransNAS-Bench-101及迁移性分析。
2105.11871|v2.innovation: 大规模多任务架构性能标注与跨任务迁移规律量化。
2105.11871|v2.result: 揭示部分架构跨任务性能相关性超0.6，提供标准评测平台。

2010.00969|v2.summary_cn: 针对可微NAS中操作与拓扑耦合导致搜索不稳定、易过拟合验证集的问题，提出DOTS，将操作选择与拓扑连接解耦，先确定拓扑再优化操作。相比DARTS等方法，该解耦策略在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上显著提升搜索稳定性，例如在ImageNet上top-1精度提升约0.5-1.0%且搜索方差更小。
2010.00969|v2.summary_en: DOTS decouples operation selection from topology in differentiable architecture search to address instability and overfitting to the validation set. By determining topology first and then optimizing operations, it improves search stability and achieves about 0.5-1.0% higher top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with lower variance than DARTS.
2010.00969|v2.assessment: 解耦思想对可微NAS的稳定性问题有清晰贡献，可间接用于感知模型的结构搜索。
2010.00969|v2.contribution: 提出DOTS，将可微NAS中的操作与拓扑解耦。
2010.00969|v2.innovation: 先拓扑后操作的解耦搜索策略。
2010.00969|v2.result: 在ImageNet上top-1精度提升约0.5-1.0%且方差更小。

2103.07289|v2.summary_cn: 针对one-shot NAS中架构生成依赖离散采样、搜索效率低的问题，提出基于生成器的one-shot NAS，用架构生成器直接产生候选架构并联合训练。相比随机采样或进化搜索，该方法在NAS-Bench-201和ImageNet上以更少搜索时间找到更优架构，例如在NAS-Bench-201上搜索时间减少约一个数量级且精度相当或更优。
2103.07289|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a one-shot NAS method with an architecture generator that directly produces candidate architectures and trains them jointly, addressing inefficient discrete sampling in one-shot NAS. It finds better architectures with about an order of magnitude less search time on NAS-Bench-201 and ImageNet compared to random or evolutionary search.
2103.07289|v2.assessment: 生成式架构搜索思路新颖，对提升NAS效率有参考意义，但与视觉感知应用距离较远。
2103.07289|v2.contribution: 提出基于生成器的one-shot NAS框架。
2103.07289|v2.innovation: 用架构生成器替代离散采样实现高效搜索。
2103.07289|v2.result: 在NAS-Bench-201上搜索时间减少约一个数量级且精度不降。

Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_cn: 针对行人重识别（Re-ID）中网络结构设计依赖人工经验、深度特征表达不足的问题，本文提出基于组合深度空间的架构搜索方法。方法将深度空间分解为多个子空间并联合搜索，以自动发现适合Re-ID的轻量网络结构。相比手工设计的Re-ID网络，该方法在搜索效率和精度上均有改进。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on manual architecture engineering in person re-identification by proposing a combined depth space based architecture search method. It decomposes the depth space into sub-spaces and jointly searches for Re-ID-specific networks. The approach improves over hand-crafted Re-ID backbones in both search efficiency and accuracy, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.assessment: 将NAS引入行人重识别是一个合理方向，但摘要信息有限，难以判断其实际影响力。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.contribution: 提出组合深度空间的NAS方法用于行人重识别网络自动设计。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.innovation: 将深度空间分解为多个子空间进行联合搜索以适配Re-ID任务。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集上的定量结果。
Combined Depth Space Based Architecture._arxiv_id: Combined Depth Space Based Architecture Search for Person Re-Identification.

NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_cn: 针对移动端超实时推理需求下网络剪枝与架构搜索割裂的问题，本文提出NPAS——一个编译器感知的统一网络剪枝与架构搜索框架。方法将剪枝与NAS联合优化，并考虑编译器层面的实际加速效果，从而在移动设备上实现超越实时的推理。相比已有剪枝或NAS方法，NPAS在真实移动端延迟与精度权衡上更优。摘要未提供具体数值。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.summary_en: This paper targets beyond real-time mobile acceleration by proposing NPAS, a compiler-aware framework that unifies network pruning and architecture search. It jointly optimizes pruning and NAS while accounting for compiler-level speedup, achieving beyond real-time inference on mobile devices. NPAS improves the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior pruning or NAS methods, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.assessment: 编译器感知的剪枝与NAS统一框架对移动端部署有实用价值，但摘要缺少实验数据。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.contribution: 提出编译器感知的统一网络剪枝与架构搜索框架NPAS。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.innovation: 将剪枝与NAS联合优化并纳入编译器实际加速约束。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif.result: 摘要未给出具体加速比或精度数值。
NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unif._arxiv_id: NPAS: A Compiler-Aware Framework of Unified Network Pruning and Architecture Search for Beyond Real-Time Mobile Acceleration.

2012.05609|v2.summary_cn: 针对低光照图像增强中深度模型依赖大量架构工程且计算负担高的问题，本文提出RUAS方法。RUAS基于Retinex规则建立刻画低光图像内在欠曝结构的模型，展开其优化过程构建整体传播结构，并设计无参考协同学习策略从紧凑搜索空间中搜索低光先验架构。相比已有方法，RUAS获得更快速度、更少计算资源且性能更优的增强网络。大量实验验证其优于近期SOTA方法。
2012.05609|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy architecture engineering and high computational cost in low-light image enhancement by proposing RUAS, which builds models based on the Retinex rule to characterize the intrinsic underexposed structure and unrolls their optimization to form a holistic propagation structure. A cooperative reference-free learning strategy searches low-light prior architectures from a compact space. Extensive experiments verify RUAS outperforms recent state-of-the-art methods with fast speed and low computational cost.
2012.05609|v2.assessment: 将Retinex展开与NAS结合思路新颖，实验较充分，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关度较低。
2012.05609|v2.contribution: 提出Retinex启发展开与协同先验架构搜索的RUAS低光增强框架。
2012.05609|v2.innovation: 将Retinex优化展开与无参考协同架构搜索结合构建轻量增强网络。
2012.05609|v2.result: 实验验证其优于近期SOTA方法，速度快且计算资源需求低。

2011.09011|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段NAS中均匀采样忽略性能Pareto前沿、限制模型精度提升的问题，本文提出AttentiveNAS，改进采样策略以获得更好的性能Pareto。方法提出在训练中高效识别Pareto前沿网络的算法，无需额外重训练或后处理即可同时获得覆盖广泛FLOPs的大量网络。发现的AttentiveNAS模型族在ImageNet上取得77.3%至80.7%的top-1精度，超越BigNAS和Once-for-All等SOTA模型。
2011.09011|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of uniform sampling in two-stage NAS, which is agnostic to the performance Pareto front and misses accuracy improvement opportunities. AttentiveNAS improves the sampling strategy and proposes algorithms to efficiently identify Pareto-front networks during training, yielding many networks across a wide FLOPs range without extra retraining. Its model family achieves 77.3%–80.7% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet, outperforming BigNAS and Once-for-All.
2011.09011|v2.assessment: 采样策略改进对两阶段NAS有实质贡献，实验充分且结果有竞争力，值得关注。
2011.09011|v2.contribution: 提出面向Pareto前沿的注意力采样策略AttentiveNAS。
2011.09011|v2.innovation: 在训练中高效识别Pareto前沿网络以改进采样。

ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_cn: 针对NAS中架构性能评估不准确的问题，本文提出ReNAS，对神经架构搜索进行相对化评估。方法通过相对比较而非绝对预测来评估架构性能，以提升搜索排序的可靠性。相比已有评估方法，ReNAS在架构排序上更准确。摘要未提供具体实验数值。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate architecture evaluation in NAS by proposing ReNAS, a relativistic evaluation method. It evaluates architectures through relative comparison rather than absolute prediction to improve ranking reliability. ReNAS achieves more accurate architecture ranking than prior evaluation methods, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.assessment: 相对化评估思路对NAS排序问题有参考价值，但摘要信息不足。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.contribution: 提出相对化评估方法ReNAS用于神经架构搜索。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.innovation: 以相对比较替代绝对预测来评估架构性能。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值。
ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural._arxiv_id: ReNAS: Relativistic Evaluation of Neural Architecture Search.

2105.10154|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频人体姿态估计中复杂模型忽视实时效率的问题，本文提出ViPNAS，在空间和时间两个层面搜索网络以实现快速在线视频姿态估计。空间层面设计包含深度、宽度、卷积核、分组数和注意力五个维度的搜索空间；时间层面从多种时序特征融合中搜索以优化多帧精度与速度。这是首个搜索时序特征融合与视频自动计算分配的工作。在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上，S-ViPNAS和T-ViPNAS在不牺牲精度下实现显著更高的CPU实时推理速度。
2105.10154|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of real-time efficiency in video human pose estimation by proposing ViPNAS, which searches networks at both spatial and temporal levels. The spatial search space spans depth, width, kernel size, group number, and attention, while the temporal level searches over feature fusions to optimize accuracy and speed across frames. It is the first to search temporal feature fusion and automatic computation allocation in videos. On COCO2017 and PoseTrack2018, S-ViPNAS and T-ViPNAS achieve significantly higher CPU real-time inference speed without sacrificing accuracy.
2105.10154|v2.assessment: 时空联合NAS用于视频姿态估计思路清晰，实验充分，对视频感知任务有借鉴意义。
2105.10154|v2.contribution: 提出时空两级搜索的ViPNAS用于快速在线视频姿态估计。
2105.10154|v2.innovation: 首次搜索时序特征融合与视频自动计算分配。
2105.10154|v2.result: 在COCO2017和PoseTrack2018上实现CPU实时速度且不牺牲精度。

2011.10949|v2.summary_cn: 针对概率型 NAS（如 PARSEC）在大搜索空间中需采样大量架构、计算开销高的问题，本文提出 FP-NAS。方法上采用自适应分布熵的采样策略（初期多采样鼓励探索、后期减少采样）以及基于因子化分布的粗到细搜索策略，将架构参数量减少一个数量级以上。相比 PARSEC 采样架构数减少 64%、搜索速度提升 2.1 倍；相比 FBNetV2 搜索快 1.9-3.5 倍，且在 ImageNet 上搜索到的模型优于 FBNetV2。
2011.10949|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of probabilistic NAS methods such as PARSEC, which require sampling many architectures in large search spaces. FP-NAS introduces an entropy-adaptive sampling scheme that draws more samples early for exploration and fewer later, together with a coarse-to-fine factorized distribution that reduces architecture parameters by over an order of magnitude. It samples 64% fewer architectures and searches 2.1x faster than PARSEC, and is 1.9x-3.5x faster than FBNetV2 while producing better ImageNet models.
2011.10949|v2.assessment: 在概率型 NAS 的效率优化上有实际改进，但属于通用 NAS 方法，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2011.10949|v2.contribution: 提出熵自适应采样与因子化粗到细搜索的快速概率型 NAS 框架 FP-NAS。
2011.10949|v2.innovation: 利用分布熵动态调节采样数量，并用因子化分布大幅压缩架构参数量。
2011.10949|v2.result: 相比 PARSEC 采样减少 64%、搜索快 2.1 倍，相比 FBNetV2 快 1.9-3.5 倍且精度更优。

2005.14446|v2.summary_cn: 针对 NAS 搜索耗时过长的问题，本文受沙漏结构启发提出 HourNAS，认为网络中少数关键 block 决定精度、大量非关键 block 决定复杂度。方法上优先搜索关键 block，并将非关键 block 的搜索空间收缩到计算资源约束下可负担的候选。在 ImageNet 上仅用单 GPU 3 小时即可搜索到 Top-1 77.0% 的架构，优于当时最先进方法。
2005.14446|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the prohibitive search cost of NAS and proposes HourNAS, inspired by the hourglass structure: a few vital blocks govern accuracy while the bulk of blocks determine complexity. It prioritizes searching vital blocks and shrinks the search space of non-vital blocks to resource-affordable candidates. On ImageNet, it finds an architecture with 77.0% Top-1 accuracy in only 3 hours on a single GPU, outperforming state-of-the-art methods.
2005.14446|v2.assessment: 搜索效率提升显著，思路直观有效，但属通用 NAS 工作，与视觉感知下游任务结合有限。
2005.14446|v2.contribution: 提出基于沙漏视角、优先搜索关键 block 的极速 NAS 方法 HourNAS。
2005.14446|v2.innovation: 将网络划分为关键与非关键 block 并差异化分配搜索预算与空间。
2005.14446|v2.result: 单 GPU 3 小时搜索到 ImageNet Top-1 77.0% 的架构，超越同期 SOTA。

2105.12971|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标检测模型部署时架构搜索、剪枝与知识蒸馏通常被简单串行组合、难以联合优化的问题，提出统一的 Joint-DetNAS 框架，将 NAS、剪枝和动态蒸馏三者联合优化。其核心包括 student morphism（通过权重继承在更新学生架构的同时复用前代权重，并移除冗余参数）和 dynamic distillation（用渐进收缩策略训练弹性教师池，搜索时无需额外代价采样最优教师）。相比朴素串行流水线，该方法能直接输出高性能学生检测器而无需额外训练，以 R101-FPN 为基检测器时显著优于串行方案。
2105.12971|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that NAS, pruning, and knowledge distillation are typically pipelined naively for object detection, making joint optimization difficult. It proposes Joint-DetNAS, a unified framework that jointly optimizes student morphism (architecture update with weight inheritance and redundancy removal) and dynamic distillation (an elastic teacher pool trained via progressive shrinking for cost-free teacher sampling). Given a base detector such as R101-FPN, it directly outputs a high-performance student detector without additional training and substantially outperforms the naive pipelining baseline.
2105.12971|v2.assessment: 将 NAS、剪枝与蒸馏从串行流水线改为联合优化，思路清晰且工程价值明确，对检测模型压缩与部署的研究者有参考意义。
2105.12971|v2.contribution: 提出统一联合优化 NAS、剪枝与动态蒸馏的目标检测框架 Joint-DetNAS。
2105.12971|v2.innovation: 用权重继承的 student morphism 与基于渐进收缩弹性教师池的动态蒸馏实现三者联合搜索。
2105.12971|v2.result: 以 R101-FPN 为基检测器时，无需额外训练即可直接输出高性能学生检测器，并大幅超越朴素串行流水线方案。

BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_cn: 针对NAS领域缺乏统一、可复现的宏搜索空间基准的问题，本文提出了BLOX——一个宏神经架构搜索基准与算法集合。作者构建了标准化的宏搜索空间、评估协议与基线算法，使不同NAS方法可在同一平台上公平比较。相比以往各自为政的评测方式，BLOX提升了NAS研究的可复现性与可比性。该工作为NAS社区提供了基础设施，但摘要信息有限，具体实验数据未给出。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.summary_en: This paper introduces BLOX, a macro neural architecture search benchmark and algorithm suite addressing the lack of standardized, reproducible macro search-space evaluation in NAS. It provides a unified search space, evaluation protocol, and baseline algorithms for fair comparison across NAS methods. The work improves reproducibility and comparability in NAS research, though specific empirical results are not detailed in the abstract.
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.assessment: 为NAS社区提供标准化宏搜索空间基准，对可复现研究有基础设施价值，但与视觉感知任务关联较弱。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.contribution: 提出BLOX宏NAS基准与算法集合，统一宏搜索空间的评估协议。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.innovation: 构建标准化宏搜索空间与可复现评测平台，支持跨方法公平比较。
BLOX: Macro Neural Architecture Search B.result: 为NAS研究提供统一基准，提升可复现性与可比性（摘要未给出具体数值）。
