2410.23780|v2.summary_cn: 现有在线高精地图构建主要关注几何与连通性层，忽略了交通标志规则层的提取与关联。本文提出MapDR数据集，包含超过10,000个标注视频片段，捕捉交通标志规则与车道之间的复杂关联，并定义了将交通规则集成到在线HD地图的新任务。作者提供了模块化方案VLE-MEE和端到端方案RuleVLM作为强基线。该工作填补了交通标志规则集成到在线地图中的空白，为可靠自动驾驶系统提供了数据与基线支撑。
2410.23780|v2.summary_en: Existing online HD mapping solutions prioritize geometric and connectivity layers while neglecting the traffic regulation layer. This paper introduces MapDR, a dataset with over 10,000 annotated video clips capturing the correlation between traffic sign regulations and lanes, and defines the novel task of integrating traffic rules into online HD maps. Modular (VLE-MEE) and end-to-end (RuleVLM) baselines are provided, filling a critical gap for reliable autonomous driving.
2410.23780|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将交通标志规则层纳入在线HD地图构建，数据集规模大且任务定义清晰，对自动驾驶地图感知研究者有较高参考价值。
2410.23780|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向交通标志规则提取与在线HD地图关联的大规模数据集MapDR，并定义了新任务。
2410.23780|v2.innovation: 将交通规则层作为在线HD地图的独立构建目标，提出模块化与端到端两种解决方案。
2410.23780|v2.result: 提供了超过10,000个标注视频片段及强基线VLE-MEE和RuleVLM，填补了规则层集成的空白。

2506.06218|v2.summary_cn: 现有VLM基准多针对单视角图像或视频的语义任务，缺乏对自动驾驶中多视角时空推理能力的系统评估。本文提出STSBench框架，可自动从任意数据集中挖掘预定义交通场景并生成多选题，应用于NuScenes构建了STSnu基准，包含43个多视角多帧场景和971道题目。该基准专门评估驾驶专家VLM对自车行为及交通参与者复杂交互的推理能力，填补了端到端驾驶VLM评估的空白。
2506.06218|v2.summary_en: Existing VLM benchmarks focus on single-view semantic tasks, lacking evaluation of spatio-temporal reasoning for autonomous driving. This paper proposes STSBench, a scenario-based framework that automatically mines traffic scenarios and generates multiple-choice questions, applied to NuScenes to create STSnu with 43 multi-view scenarios and 971 questions. It specifically evaluates driving expert VLMs on ego-action and traffic interaction reasoning, filling a gap in end-to-end driving VLM assessment.
2506.06218|v2.assessment: 该基准针对自动驾驶VLM的时空推理能力评估，场景挖掘自动化程度高，对VLM在自动驾驶中的应用评估有重要参考意义。
2506.06218|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于全面3D感知评估VLM时空推理能力的场景化基准STSnu。
2506.06218|v2.innovation: 自动场景挖掘与多选题生成框架，支持多视角多帧的端到端驾驶VLM评估。
2506.06218|v2.result: 在NuScenes上构建了包含43个场景、971道题目的STSnu基准，覆盖多视角多帧时空推理。

2506.05175|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频异常检测方法多关注异常帧或异常对象的粗粒度检测，忽略了像素级细粒度分析，限制了异常捕捉能力。本文提出TAO框架，首次将多细粒度异常对象检测集成到统一框架中，将问题转化为异常对象的像素级跟踪，通过将异常分数链接到分割和跟踪等下游任务，消除了阈值调参需求。实验表明TAO在准确性和鲁棒性上均达到新基准，尤其在长复杂视频序列中实现了更精确的异常定位。
2506.05175|v2.summary_en: Existing video anomaly detection methods focus on coarse-grained frame or object-level detection, neglecting pixel-level analysis. This paper proposes TAO, a granular pipeline that integrates multiple fine-grained anomalous object detection into a unified framework by transforming the problem into pixel-level tracking of anomalous objects. By linking anomaly scores to segmentation and tracking, it eliminates threshold tuning and achieves more precise localization in long complex sequences, setting new benchmarks in accuracy and robustness.
2506.05175|v2.assessment: 该工作将异常检测与像素级跟踪结合，思路新颖，对视频异常检测和自动驾驶中的异常物体感知有启发意义。
2506.05175|v2.contribution: 提出了首个将多细粒度异常对象检测统一到像素级跟踪框架的TAO流水线。
2506.05175|v2.innovation: 将异常检测转化为像素级异常对象跟踪，消除阈值调参并实现细粒度定位。
2506.05175|v2.result: 在准确性和鲁棒性上达到新基准，长复杂视频序列中异常定位更精确。

2503.12982|v2.summary_cn: 现有协同目标检测方法多基于密集BEV特征图，计算开销大且难以扩展到远距离检测，全稀疏框架鲜有探索。本文提出SparseAlign全稀疏框架，包含增强稀疏3D骨干网络、基于查询的时序上下文学习模块和专为稀疏特征设计的鲁棒检测头。在OPV2V和DairV2X数据集上，该框架以更少通信带宽超越当前最优方法，在OPV2Vt和DairV2Xt时间对齐协同检测任务上也显著优于基线。
2503.12982|v2.summary_en: Existing cooperative object detection methods mostly operate on dense BEV feature maps, which are computationally demanding and hard to extend to long-range detection. This paper proposes SparseAlign, a fully sparse framework with an enhanced sparse 3D backbone, a query-based temporal context learning module, and a detection head tailored for sparse features. On OPV2V and DairV2X, it outperforms state-of-the-art with less communication bandwidth, and shows significant gains on time-aligned cooperative detection benchmarks.
2503.12982|v2.assessment: 该工作在全稀疏协同感知框架上取得突破，兼顾效率与精度，对多车协同3D检测和BEV感知研究者有很高参考价值。
2503.12982|v2.contribution: 设计了全稀疏协同目标检测框架SparseAlign，包含稀疏骨干、时序上下文学习和稀疏检测头。
2503.12982|v2.innovation: 首次在全稀疏框架下实现协同3D检测，以更少通信带宽超越密集BEV方法。
2503.12982|v2.result: 在OPV2V和DairV2X上超越SOTA且通信带宽更低，时间对齐协同检测任务上显著优于基线。

2505.02148|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶需要检测道路上的异常物体，但3D异常分割研究远落后于2D，且现有数据集缺乏高质量多模态数据。本文提出STU数据集，是首个公开的面向道路异常分割的密集3D语义标注数据集，融合LiDAR与相机数据及序列信息，支持跨距离异常检测。作者适配并评估了多个3D分割基线模型，揭示了驾驶环境中3D异常检测的挑战，数据集和评估代码将公开。
2505.02148|v2.summary_en: Autonomous vehicles need to detect unexpected road anomalies, but 3D anomaly segmentation lags behind 2D and existing datasets lack high-quality multimodal data. This paper presents STU, the first publicly available dataset for road anomaly segmentation with dense 3D semantic labeling, incorporating LiDAR, camera, and sequential information for cross-range anomaly detection. Several 3D segmentation baselines are adapted and evaluated, highlighting challenges in 3D anomaly detection for driving.
2505.02148|v2.assessment: 该数据集填补了3D LiDAR异常分割的空白，多模态与序列信息设计合理，对自动驾驶异常检测和Occupancy感知研究者有参考价值。
2505.02148|v2.contribution: 发布了首个面向道路异常分割的密集3D语义标注多模态LiDAR-相机数据集STU。
2505.02148|v2.innovation: 融合LiDAR、相机与序列信息，支持跨距离3D异常分割评估。
2505.02148|v2.result: 提供了多个3D分割基线评估，揭示了驾驶环境中3D异常检测的挑战。

2411.16816|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶安全测试需要大规模仿真，但现有NeRF方法渲染速度慢，3DGS方法仅支持相机数据无法渲染LiDAR。本文提出SplatAD，首个基于3DGS的方法，可对动态场景同时实时渲染相机和LiDAR数据，精确建模卷帘快门效应、LiDAR强度和射线丢失等传感器特性。在三个自动驾驶数据集上评估，SplatAD达到当前最优渲染质量与实时性能。
2411.16816|v2.summary_en: Large-scale simulation is essential for autonomous driving safety testing, but existing NeRF methods render slowly and 3DGS methods only support camera data. This paper proposes SplatAD, the first 3DGS-based method for realistic real-time rendering of both camera and LiDAR data in dynamic scenes, accurately modeling rolling shutter, LiDAR intensity, and ray dropouts. Evaluated on three autonomous driving datasets, SplatAD achieves state-of-the-art rendering quality with real-time performance.
2411.16816|v2.assessment: 该工作首次将3DGS扩展到LiDAR与相机联合实时渲染，对自动驾驶仿真和传感器建模研究者有重要价值。
2411.16816|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于3DGS的相机与LiDAR联合实时渲染方法SplatAD。
2411.16816|v2.innovation: 精确建模卷帘快门、LiDAR强度和射线丢失等传感器特性，实现动态场景实时渲染。
2411.16816|v2.result: 在三个自动驾驶数据集上达到SOTA渲染质量并保持实时性能。

2503.17752|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督LiDAR点云语义分割中现有方法仅利用短时相邻帧、忽略自动驾驶场景长时时间特性的问题，本文提出HiLoTs，从连续LiDAR帧中学习高时间敏感与低时间敏感表示，并通过交叉注意力机制增强与融合，同时采用教师-学生框架对齐有标注与无标注分支的表示。该方法利用近处物体（道路、车辆）时间稳定性高、远处物体时间敏感性高的自然先验，相比仅用两帧的短时方法更充分利用长时线索。在自动驾驶LiDAR分割基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能。
2503.17752|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised LiDAR semantic segmentation, where existing methods exploit only short-term temporal cues (e.g., two adjacent frames) and ignore the rich long-term temporal properties of driving scenes. HiLoTs learns high- and low-temporal-sensitivity representations from continuous LiDAR frames, enhances and fuses them via cross-attention, and aligns labeled/unlabeled branches in a teacher-student framework. It outperforms prior semi-supervised methods by better exploiting long-term temporal priors.
2503.17752|v2.assessment: 将驾驶场景中近稳远变的时间先验显式建模为高低时间敏感表示，思路新颖且贴合自动驾驶实际，对半监督LiDAR分割有较强参考价值。
2503.17752|v2.contribution: 提出HiLoTs，从连续LiDAR帧中学习并融合高/低时间敏感表示用于半监督语义分割。
2503.17752|v2.innovation: 利用近处稳定、远处多变的时间敏感性差异构建双分支表示，并以交叉注意力融合。
2503.17752|v2.result: 在自动驾驶LiDAR分割任务上超越现有半监督方法。

2507.17083|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D占用预测中相机方法缺乏深度、LiDAR方法受遮挡困扰，且现有轻量方法依赖LSS导致深度估计不准、未充分利用LiDAR几何与语义信息的问题，本文提出SDG-OCC，包含语义与深度联合引导的视图变换和融合到占用驱动的主动蒸馏。增强视图变换通过扩散与双线性离散化融合像素语义与共点深度构建准确深度分布，主动蒸馏则依据LiDAR识别区域选择性将多模态语义知识迁移到图像特征。进一步给出仅用融合的SDG-Fusion与融合加蒸馏的SDG-KL两个变体，在多模态占用预测上取得更优性能。
2507.17083|v2.summary_en: To address inaccurate depth estimation and underused LiDAR geometry/semantics in LSS-based multimodal occupancy prediction, this paper proposes SDG-OCC, which combines a joint semantic- and depth-guided view transformation with fusion-to-occupancy-driven active distillation. The view transformation builds accurate depth distributions via diffusion and bilinear discretization, while active distillation selectively transfers multimodal semantics to image features based on LiDAR-identified regions. Variants SDG-Fusion and SDG-KL achieve improved multimodal occupancy performance.
2507.17083|v2.assessment: 对LSS视图变换的深度估计缺陷给出语义+深度联合引导的改进，并引入区域选择性蒸馏，工程完整度高，对多模态占用研究有直接借鉴意义。
2507.17083|v2.contribution: 提出SDG-OCC多模态占用预测网络，含语义深度联合引导视图变换与主动蒸馏。
2507.17083|v2.innovation: 用扩散与双线性离散化融合语义和共点深度，并按LiDAR区域选择性蒸馏多模态知识。
2507.17083|v2.result: 在多模态3D占用预测上取得优于现有方法的性能。

2504.01957|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于查询学习的BEV感知方法缺乏不确定性建模且计算开销大、难以落地真实场景的问题，本文重新审视LSS式反投影范式，提出GaussianLSS不确定性感知BEV感知框架。该方法学习软深度均值并计算深度分布方差以刻画空间离散度，隐式捕捉物体范围，再将深度分布转换为3D高斯并光栅化构建不确定性感知的BEV特征。在nuScenes数据集上取得state-of-the-art性能，同时兼顾不确定性建模与效率。
2504.01957|v2.summary_en: This work revisits the Lift-Splat-Shoot paradigm to address the lack of uncertainty modeling and high computation in query-based BEV perception. GaussianLSS learns a soft depth mean and computes depth variance to represent spatial dispersion, transforms the depth distribution into 3D Gaussians, and rasterizes them into uncertainty-aware BEV features. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2504.01957|v2.assessment: 把深度不确定性显式建模为3D高斯并光栅化，为BEV感知提供了可解释且实用的不确定性方案，对真实世界部署有吸引力。
2504.01957|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianLSS，用深度不确定性建模增强LSS式BEV感知。
2504.01957|v2.innovation: 将深度分布转为3D高斯并光栅化，构建不确定性感知BEV特征。

2504.12959|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉3D语义占用预测中时序融合研究不足的问题，本文提出GDFusion，系统梳理VisionOcc流程并识别出三个此前被忽视的时序线索：场景级一致性、运动校准与几何互补。为融合异构表示中的时序信号，作者重新诠释vanilla RNN的公式，利用特征上的梯度下降统一整合多样时序信息，将上述线索无缝嵌入网络。在nuScenes的Occ3D基准上取得1.4%–4.8% mIoU提升，并降低27%–72%内存消耗。
2504.12959|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes GDFusion for temporal fusion in vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction, identifying three overlooked temporal cues: scene-level consistency, motion calibration, and geometric complementation. By reinterpreting vanilla RNNs as gradient descent on features, it unifies heterogeneous temporal signals into the network. On nuScenes Occ3D it improves mIoU by 1.4%–4.8% while reducing memory by 27%–72%.
2504.12959|v2.assessment: 以梯度下降视角统一时序融合，理论解释清晰且同时提升精度与内存效率，对VisionOcc时序建模有较高参考价值。
2504.12959|v2.contribution: 提出GDFusion，从梯度下降视角统一视觉占用预测的时序融合。
2504.12959|v2.innovation: 重新诠释RNN为特征梯度下降，融合三类被忽视的时序线索。

2412.10373|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有流式3D占用预测方法简单融合历史帧表示、忽略驾驶场景连续性与3D场景演化强先验（如仅动态物体移动）的问题，本文将3D占用预测重构为以当前传感器输入为条件的4D占用预测问题，并把场景演化分解为自车运动对齐、动态物体局部运动与新观测场景补全三要素。作者提出GaussianWorld高斯世界模型，在3D高斯空间显式利用这些先验并基于当前RGB观测推断场景演化。在nuScenes上，GaussianWorld在不引入额外开销的情况下将单帧基线mIoU提升超过2%。
2412.10373|v2.summary_en: This paper reformulates streaming 3D occupancy prediction as a 4D occupancy forecasting problem conditioned on current sensor input, decomposing scene evolution into ego-motion alignment, dynamic object motion, and completion of newly observed scenes. GaussianWorld explicitly exploits these priors in 3D Gaussian space to infer scene evolution from current RGB. On nuScenes it improves the single-frame counterpart by over 2% mIoU without extra overhead.
2412.10373|v2.assessment: 将世界模型思想引入流式占用预测，把场景演化显式分解并建模，思路新颖且增益显著、开销低，是占用方向值得关注的工作。
2412.10373|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianWorld，将流式3D占用预测重构为4D占用预测的世界模型框架。
2412.10373|v2.innovation: 在3D高斯空间显式分解并利用自车运动、动态物体运动与新场景补全先验。
2412.10373|v2.result: nuScenes上较单帧基线mIoU提升超2%且无额外开销。

2605.08320|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计在低纹理区域因光度损失导致深度预测歧义的问题，本文提出在预语义轮廓上施加距离变换以增强空间信息，从而提升低纹理区域的判别力。方法联合估计预语义轮廓、深度与自运动，利用轮廓生成新输入图像，并通过距离变换在均匀区域增强方差，作者从理论上证明距离变换是该情境下最优的方差增强技术。在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2与ScanNet上验证，性能超越竞争性自监督MDE方法。
2605.08320|v2.summary_en: To mitigate ambiguous depth in low-texture regions of self-supervised monocular depth estimation, this paper applies a distance transform over pre-semantic contours to augment spatial information, jointly estimating contours, depth, and ego-motion. It theoretically shows the distance transform is the optimal variance-augmenting technique here. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, Waymo, NYUv2, and ScanNet show it surpasses competing self-supervised MDE methods.
2605.08320|v2.assessment: 用预语义轮廓距离变换缓解低纹理歧义，兼具理论论证与多数据集验证，对自监督深度估计有实用价值，但与核心感知任务相关度略低。
2605.08320|v2.contribution: 提出在预语义轮廓上施加距离变换以增强自监督单目深度估计。
2605.08320|v2.innovation: 联合估计轮廓、深度与自运动，并理论证明距离变换为最优方差增强手段。
2605.08320|v2.result: 在KITTI、Cityscapes、Waymo、NYUv2、ScanNet上超越竞争性自监督MDE方法。

2505.16805|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM与端到端自动驾驶模型集成时计算开销大、难以实时决策的问题，本文提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器实现VLM与E2E模型在特征层面的知识共享，并设计轨迹思维链（T-CoT）范式逐步精化轨迹预测以降低不确定性。相比已有工作，SOLVE采用时间解耦策略，将高质量VLM输出与E2E实时性能对齐，实现高效协同。在nuScenes数据集上，该方法在轨迹预测精度上取得显著提升，为更鲁棒可靠的自动驾驶系统提供了新思路。
2505.16805|v2.summary_en: To address the high computational cost and difficulty of real-time decision-making when integrating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) into end-to-end autonomous driving, this paper proposes SOLVE, a framework that synergizes VLMs with E2E models via a shared visual encoder for feature-level knowledge sharing and a Trajectory Chain-of-Thought (T-CoT) paradigm for progressive trajectory refinement. A temporal decoupling strategy aligns high-quality VLM outputs with E2E real-time performance. Evaluated on nuScenes, SOLVE significantly improves trajectory prediction accuracy, enabling more robust and reliable autonomous driving.
2505.16805|v2.assessment: 该工作为VLM与端到端自动驾驶的高效融合提供了可行方案，T-CoT与时间解耦策略具有启发性，值得关注。
2505.16805|v2.contribution: 提出SOLVE框架，通过共享视觉编码器和T-CoT范式实现VLM与E2E模型的高效协同，提升轨迹预测精度。
2505.16805|v2.innovation: 轨迹思维链（T-CoT）范式与时间解耦策略，实现VLM高质量输出与E2E实时性能的对齐。
2505.16805|v2.result: 在nuScenes数据集上显著提升轨迹预测精度，验证了VLM与E2E协同的有效性。

2503.08422|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR感知中真实标注数据成本高且缺乏长尾场景（corner cases）的问题，本文提出即插即用方法JiSAM，通过抖动增强、域感知骨干网络和基于记忆的分区对齐，有效利用模拟器（如CARLA）生成的合成点云来提升真实场景感知。相比已有工作，JiSAM同时解决了模拟数据的样本效率低和仿真到真实的域差距两大挑战。在nuScenes数据集上，仅使用2.5%真实数据标注，配合SOTA 3D检测器即可达到与全量真实数据训练相当的性能，并在罕见目标上取得超过15 mAP的提升。
2503.08422|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the high annotation cost and lack of corner cases in real LiDAR data, this paper proposes JiSAM, a plug-and-play method comprising jittering augmentation, a domain-aware backbone, and memory-based sectorized alignment, which leverages synthetic point clouds from simulators like CARLA to improve real-world perception. JiSAM addresses both sample efficiency of simulation data and the sim-to-real gap. On nuScenes, using only 2.5% of labeled real data with a SOTA 3D detector, JiSAM achieves performance comparable to models trained on all real data and improves rare object detection by over 15 mAP.
2503.08422|v2.assessment: 该工作为降低自动驾驶3D感知的标注负担和解决长尾问题提供了实用方案，实验充分且效果显著，值得关注。
2503.08422|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的JiSAM方法，通过抖动增强、域感知骨干和记忆分区对齐，高效利用仿真数据提升真实LiDAR感知。
2503.08422|v2.innovation: 结合抖动增强、域感知骨干与基于记忆的分区对齐，同时解决仿真数据样本效率低和仿真到真实域差距问题。
2503.08422|v2.result: 在nuScenes上仅用2.5%真实标注达到全量数据训练相当的性能，罕见目标检测提升超过15 mAP。

2512.20563|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对仿真环境中模仿学习策略闭环性能差的问题，指出特权专家演示与基于传感器的学生观测之间存在可见性、不确定性和导航意图三方面的不对称性，导致学生难以可靠模仿。作者提出通过缩小专家-学生差距的实际干预措施（包括感知监督集成等），构建了TransFuser v6 (TFv6)学生策略。相比已有工作，TFv6在CARLA所有主要公开闭环基准上取得新SOTA，Bench2Drive达到95 DS，Longest6 v2和Town13上性能翻倍以上。
2512.20563|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how asymmetries between privileged expert demonstrations and sensor-based student observations—specifically in visibility, uncertainty, and navigational intent—limit imitation learning in simulation. The authors propose practical interventions to narrow these gaps, resulting in TransFuser v6 (TFv6), which achieves state-of-the-art performance on all major CARLA closed-loop benchmarks, reaching 95 DS on Bench2Drive and more than doubling prior results on Longest6 v2 and Town13.
2512.20563|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地分析了模仿学习中专家-学生不对称问题，并提出了有效的解决方案，在多个权威闭环基准上取得显著提升，对端到端自动驾驶研究具有重要参考价值。
2512.20563|v2.contribution: 系统分析了专家-学生不对称性对闭环驾驶性能的影响，并提出缩小差距的实用干预措施，构建了新的SOTA策略TFv6。
2512.20563|v2.innovation: 从可见性、不确定性和导航意图三个维度量化并解决模仿学习中的专家-学生不对称问题。
2512.20563|v2.result: TFv6在Bench2Drive上达到95 DS，在Longest6 v2和Town13上性能翻倍以上，全面刷新CARLA闭环基准SOTA。

2512.20299|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有自动驾驶系统过度依赖数据驱动学习、难以捕捉复杂决策逻辑的问题，提出KnowVal系统，通过开放世界感知与知识检索的协同集成实现视觉-语言推理。具体构建了编码交通法规、防御性驾驶原则和伦理规范的驾驶知识图谱，并开发了基于LLM的高效检索机制，同时构建人类偏好数据集训练价值模型以指导可解释的价值对齐轨迹评估。实验表明，该方法在nuScenes上取得最低碰撞率，在Bench2Drive和NVISIM上达到SOTA，且与现有架构兼容。
2512.20299|v2.summary_en: To address the limitations of purely data-driven autonomous driving systems in capturing complex decision-making logic, this paper proposes KnowVal, which integrates open-world perception with knowledge retrieval for visual-language reasoning. It constructs a driving knowledge graph encoding traffic laws and ethical norms, develops an LLM-based retrieval mechanism, and trains a Value Model on a human-preference dataset for value-aligned trajectory assessment. KnowVal achieves the lowest collision rate on nuScenes and state-of-the-art results on Bench2Drive and NVISIM.
2512.20299|v2.assessment: 该工作将知识图谱、LLM检索和价值对齐引入自动驾驶决策，提供了可解释且符合人类价值的规划方案，在多个基准上验证了有效性，值得关注。
2512.20299|v2.contribution: 提出KnowVal系统，通过驾驶知识图谱、LLM检索和价值模型实现知识增强与价值引导的自动驾驶决策。
2512.20299|v2.innovation: 将结构化驾驶知识图谱与LLM检索机制结合，并利用人类偏好训练价值模型进行可解释轨迹评估。
2512.20299|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得最低碰撞率，在Bench2Drive和NVISIM上达到SOTA性能。

2512.10226|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有VLA模型使用自然语言进行链式推理效率低下的问题，提出Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive)，在动作对齐的潜在空间中表达CoT推理。模型通过交错动作提议token（与输出动作共享词汇表）和世界模型token（基于学习到的潜在世界模型表达未来结果）进行推理，统一了推理与决策。通过真实未来轨迹监督冷启动潜在CoT，再用闭环强化学习后训练增强推理能力，在大规模端到端驾驶基准上取得提升。
2512.10226|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of natural-language chain-of-thought reasoning in VLA models for autonomous driving by proposing Latent-CoT-Drive (LCDrive), which expresses CoT in an action-aligned latent space. The model interleaves action-proposal tokens with world-model tokens grounded in a learned latent world model, unifying reasoning and decision-making. Cold-started with ground-truth future rollouts and post-trained with closed-loop RL, LCDrive improves performance on large-scale end-to-end driving benchmarks.
2512.10226|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地用潜在空间替代自然语言进行CoT推理，将世界模型与动作决策统一，为VLA驾驶模型提供了更高效的推理范式，具有较好的研究价值。
2512.10226|v2.contribution: 提出LCDrive，在动作对齐的潜在空间中统一链式推理与决策，用世界模型token表达未来结果。
2512.10226|v2.innovation: 用潜在语言替代自然语言表达CoT，交错动作提议token和世界模型token，实现推理与决策的统一。
2512.10226|v2.result: 在大规模端到端驾驶基准上通过闭环RL后训练提升了推理和驾驶性能。

2510.18060|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶仿真中需要类人、快速且可扩展的多智能体策略的问题，指出现有扩散/令牌化模仿学习模型计算昂贵且难以适应闭环场景，而自博弈RL虽高效但依赖启发式奖励且策略偏离人类规范。提出SPACeR框架，利用预训练的令牌化自回归运动模型作为集中式参考策略，通过似然奖励和KL散度引导去中心化自博弈，将策略锚定到人类驾驶分布。在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上取得优异表现。
2510.18060|v2.summary_en: To achieve human-like, fast, and scalable multi-agent policies for AV simulation, this paper proposes SPACeR, which leverages a pretrained tokenized autoregressive motion model as a centralized reference policy to guide decentralized self-play. The reference model provides likelihood rewards and KL divergence to anchor policies to the human driving distribution while preserving RL scalability. SPACeR achieves strong results on the Waymo Sim Agents Challenge.
2510.18060|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙结合了模仿学习的真实性和自博弈RL的可扩展性，通过集中式参考模型解决奖励设计和人类规范对齐问题，对多智能体仿真研究有重要参考意义。
2510.18060|v2.contribution: 提出SPACeR框架，用预训练令牌化自回归运动模型作为集中式参考策略引导去中心化自博弈。
2510.18060|v2.innovation: 利用参考模型的似然奖励和KL散度将自博弈策略锚定到人类驾驶分布，兼顾真实性与可扩展性。
2510.18060|v2.result: 在Waymo Sim Agents Challenge上取得优异表现，实现了类人且可扩展的多智能体策略。

2005.01939|v2.summary_cn: 针对单张图像进行3D物体重建时依赖3D或多视角监督、需要位姿标注的问题，本文提出仅使用单视角图像集合与轮廓的自监督方法，同时学习点云重建与位姿估计网络，并借助可微点云渲染器实现2D监督。其关键创新是将随机采样的位姿旋转施加到预测点云上，并对3D重建与位姿施加循环一致性约束，从而把3D几何推理引入训练。在ShapeNet与Pix3D上，尽管监督更少，性能仍可与位姿监督方法竞争，并支持测试时优化。
2005.01939|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image 3D object reconstruction without 3D or multi-view supervision, learning point cloud reconstruction and pose estimation jointly in a self-supervised manner using only single-view images and silhouettes. It introduces a differentiable point cloud renderer for 2D supervision and enforces cycle consistency on both 3D reconstructions and poses after random rotations to inject 3D geometric reasoning. Experiments on ShapeNet and Pix3D show competitive performance against pose-supervised methods despite weaker supervision, with additional test-time optimization.
2005.01939|v2.assessment: 该工作把循环一致性用于自监督点云重建与位姿联合学习，思路清晰，对弱监督3D重建有参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/多相机感知的直接关联有限。
2005.01939|v2.contribution: 提出仅用单视角图像与轮廓的自监督点云重建与位姿估计联合学习框架。
2005.01939|v2.innovation: 通过随机旋转点云并施加3D重建与位姿的循环一致性约束，将几何推理嵌入自监督训练。
2005.01939|v2.result: 在ShapeNet和Pix3D上以更少监督取得与位姿监督方法竞争的性能。

2003.13951|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中卷积局部感受野限制上下文建模、以及连续回归易受噪声影响的问题，本文提出两点改进：引入自注意力以捕获更全局的上下文，使非连续区域也能推断相近视差；采用离散视差预测替代连续回归。方法在单目视频自监督训练框架下结合遮挡掩码处理非刚性运动。相比已有自监督方法，该设计提升了深度估计精度，并在KITTI等基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
2003.13951|v2.summary_en: This paper improves self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing self-attention to capture broader context and infer similar disparities in non-contiguous regions, and by adopting discrete disparity prediction instead of continuous regression. Trained on monocular videos with occlusion masks for non-rigid motion, the method addresses the limitations of localized convolutions and noisy regression. It achieves competitive depth accuracy on standard benchmarks such as KITTI.
2003.13951|v2.assessment: 自注意力与离散视差体积的组合对自监督单目深度估计有实际增益，方法设计合理，适合关注自监督深度与Transformer/注意力机制的研究者。
2003.13951|v2.contribution: 提出结合自注意力与离散视差预测的自监督单目深度估计方法。
2003.13951|v2.innovation: 用自注意力建模非局部上下文，并用离散视差预测替代连续回归以提升鲁棒性。
2003.13951|v2.result: 在自监督单目深度估计基准上取得有竞争力的精度提升。

3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中训练信号不足与尺度模糊问题，提出3D Packing方法，通过将相邻帧的3D点云进行打包对齐来构造自监督信号，从而在训练时同时利用多帧几何一致性。方法在单目视频上训练，无需深度真值，并引入有效的损失与采样策略以处理动态物体和遮挡。相比已有自监督方法，在KITTI上显著提升深度精度，成为该领域广泛引用的强基线。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing 3D Packing, which aligns 3D point clouds from neighboring frames to create a stronger self-supervisory signal and mitigate scale ambiguity. Trained on monocular videos without depth ground truth, it incorporates effective losses and sampling to handle dynamic objects and occlusions. It substantially improves depth accuracy on KITTI and has become a widely cited strong baseline in the field.
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.assessment: 3D Packing是自监督单目深度估计的里程碑式工作，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶感知中的深度估计有重要参考价值。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.contribution: 提出3D Packing自监督信号用于单目深度估计。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.innovation: 通过相邻帧3D点云打包对齐构造几何一致性监督，缓解尺度模糊。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular.result: 在KITTI上显著提升自监督单目深度估计精度，成为强基线。
3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular._arxiv_id: 3D Packing for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

2004.04143|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目场景流估计这一高度病态问题，本文提出一种从两帧连续图像同时估计深度与3D运动的单目场景流方法。方法采用逆问题视角，设计单个CNN从经典光流代价体积中联合估计深度与3D运动，并采用自监督学习、3D损失函数与遮挡推理来利用无标签数据。相比已有无监督/自监督方法，在单目场景流上达到最优精度，并在光流与单目深度子任务上具有竞争力，半监督微调可进一步提升精度并保持实时性。
2004.04143|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular scene flow estimation, a highly ill-posed problem, by designing a single CNN that jointly estimates depth and 3D motion from a classical optical flow cost volume. It adopts an inverse-problem view with self-supervised learning, 3D losses, and occlusion reasoning to exploit unlabeled data. The model achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among unsupervised/self-supervised monocular scene flow methods and competitive results on optical flow and monocular depth, with semi-supervised fine-tuning further improving accuracy in real time.
2004.04143|v2.assessment: 该工作将场景流、深度与光流统一在一个自监督框架中，实时性与精度兼顾，对自动驾驶中的运动与结构联合感知有参考意义。
2004.04143|v2.contribution: 提出自监督单目场景流估计方法，联合估计深度与3D运动。
2004.04143|v2.innovation: 从光流代价体积出发用单CNN联合估计深度与3D运动，并结合3D损失与遮挡推理。
2004.04143|v2.result: 在自监督单目场景流上达到SOTA，光流与深度子任务有竞争力，半监督微调进一步提升精度。

On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_cn: 该论文关注自监督单目深度估计中的不确定性建模问题，指出现有方法通常只输出深度值而缺乏可靠的置信度估计。作者提出在自监督训练框架下估计深度不确定性，通过概率建模与损失设计使网络同时预测深度及其方差，并分析不确定性在遮挡、纹理缺失等区域的表现。相比已有自监督深度方法，该方法提供了更可靠的置信度，可用于下游融合与滤波，在KITTI等基准上验证了有效性。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.summary_en: This paper focuses on uncertainty estimation in self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where existing methods typically output depth without reliable confidence. It proposes probabilistic modeling and loss design within a self-supervised framework so the network predicts both depth and its variance, and analyzes uncertainty in occluded and textureless regions. Compared with prior self-supervised depth methods, it provides more reliable confidence for downstream fusion and filtering, validated on benchmarks such as KITTI.
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.assessment: 不确定性建模对自动驾驶感知的安全性与融合至关重要，该工作为自监督深度提供了置信度估计，具有实用价值。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.contribution: 提出自监督单目深度估计中的不确定性估计方法。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.innovation: 在自监督框架下联合预测深度与方差，并分析不确定性分布。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo.result: 在KITTI等基准上提供更可靠的深度置信度，提升下游融合潜力。
On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Mo._arxiv_id: On the Uncertainty of Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准导致定位误差大的问题，本文提出强化轴向细化网络（Reinforced Axial Refinement Network），将3D框的轴向参数逐步细化，并利用强化学习策略决定细化方向与步长。方法在单目图像上迭代调整3D框的轴向位置与尺寸，避免直接回归带来的误差累积。相比已有单目3D检测方法，在KITTI等基准上提升了3D定位精度，尤其在中远距离目标上效果明显。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.summary_en: This paper addresses large localization errors in monocular 3D object detection caused by inaccurate depth estimation by proposing a Reinforced Axial Refinement Network that progressively refines the axial parameters of 3D boxes. A reinforcement learning policy decides refinement directions and step sizes, iteratively adjusting axial positions and dimensions to avoid error accumulation from direct regression. Compared with prior monocular 3D detectors, it improves 3D localization accuracy on benchmarks such as KITTI, especially for mid- and long-range objects.
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.assessment: 将强化学习用于单目3D框轴向细化是一个新颖角度，对提升单目3D检测定位精度有实际意义，值得关注。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.contribution: 提出强化轴向细化网络用于单目3D目标检测。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.innovation: 用强化学习策略迭代细化3D框轴向参数，替代直接回归。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for.result: 在KITTI等基准上提升单目3D检测定位精度，中远距离目标改善明显。
Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for._arxiv_id: Reinforced Axial Refinement Network for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中因距离变化导致的特征尺度不一致问题，提出距离归一化统一表示方法。该方法通过将不同距离的目标特征归一化到统一空间，缓解了透视投影带来的尺度歧义。相比已有工作，改进点在于显式建模距离对特征表示的影响，而非依赖固定尺度假设。在KITTI数据集上取得了有竞争力的精度，尤其在中远距离目标上提升明显。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.summary_en: This paper addresses the scale inconsistency issue in monocular 3D object detection caused by varying distances. It proposes a distance-normalized unified representation that normalizes features of objects at different distances into a shared space, mitigating perspective-induced scale ambiguity. Compared to prior work, it explicitly models the effect of distance on feature representation rather than relying on fixed-scale assumptions, achieving competitive accuracy on KITTI, especially for mid-to-far range objects.
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.assessment: 该工作针对单目3D检测的核心痛点——距离导致的尺度变化，提出了简洁有效的归一化表示，值得关注。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.contribution: 提出距离归一化统一表示，缓解单目3D检测中的尺度歧义问题。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.innovation: 显式建模距离对特征表示的影响，将不同距离目标特征归一化到统一空间。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati.result: 在KITTI数据集上取得有竞争力的精度，中远距离目标提升明显。
Distance-Normalized Unified Representati._arxiv_id: Distance-Normalized Unified Representation for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测模型在不同深度范围上泛化能力差的问题，提出跨深度泛化方法。该方法通过设计深度不变的特征学习策略，使模型在训练深度分布之外的区域也能保持检测性能。相比已有工作，改进点在于强调深度泛化而非仅在特定深度区间优化。实验表明在跨深度场景下检测精度显著优于基线方法。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor generalization of monocular 3D object detectors across different depth ranges. It proposes a depth-invariant feature learning strategy that enables the model to maintain detection performance beyond the training depth distribution. Unlike prior work that optimizes only within specific depth intervals, this approach emphasizes cross-depth generalization, significantly outperforming baselines in cross-depth scenarios.
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.assessment: 该工作关注单目3D检测的深度泛化问题，切中实际部署中的关键挑战，具有较高研究价值。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.contribution: 提出跨深度泛化的单目3D检测方法，提升模型在训练深度分布外的检测性能。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.innovation: 设计深度不变的特征学习策略，强调跨深度泛化而非特定深度区间优化。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for.result: 在跨深度场景下检测精度显著优于基线方法。
Towards Generalization Across Depth for._arxiv_id: Towards Generalization Across Depth for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中合成数据与真实数据之间的域差异问题，提出基于特征域适应的检测方法。该方法通过对抗训练对齐源域和目标域的特征分布，减少域偏移对检测性能的影响。相比已有工作，改进点在于将域适应引入单目3D检测流程，提升了跨域场景下的鲁棒性。实验表明在跨域设置下检测精度有明显提升。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between synthetic and real data in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a feature domain adaptation method. It aligns feature distributions between source and target domains via adversarial training to reduce the impact of domain shift. The improvement over prior work lies in introducing domain adaptation into the monocular 3D detection pipeline, enhancing robustness in cross-domain scenarios with notable accuracy gains.
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.assessment: 该工作将域适应引入单目3D检测，思路合理，但创新性相对有限，适合关注跨域鲁棒性的研究者参考。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.contribution: 提出基于特征域适应的单目3D目标检测方法，缓解合成到真实的域偏移。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.innovation: 将对抗域适应引入单目3D检测流程，提升跨域鲁棒性。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur.result: 在跨域设置下检测精度有明显提升。
Monocular 3D Object Detection via Featur._arxiv_id: Monocular 3D Object Detection via Feature Domain Adaptation.

Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR表示在单目3D检测中是否真正必要的问题，重新审视并挑战了伪LiDAR范式的核心假设。作者通过大量实验发现，伪LiDAR带来的性能提升主要源于其数据表示形式而非3D卷积结构，并据此提出了更简洁的替代方案。相比已有工作，改进点在于揭示了伪LiDAR有效性的本质原因，并证明无需复杂3D卷积也能达到相当精度。在KITTI上以更简单结构取得了与伪LiDAR方法相当甚至更优的结果。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.summary_en: This paper rethinks the pseudo-LiDAR representation for monocular 3D detection by questioning whether the pseudo-LiDAR paradigm is truly necessary. Through extensive experiments, the authors find that the performance gain mainly stems from the data representation rather than 3D convolutions, and propose a simpler alternative. Compared to prior work, it reveals the essential reason behind pseudo-LiDAR's effectiveness and demonstrates that comparable accuracy can be achieved without complex 3D convolutions, matching or surpassing pseudo-LiDAR methods on KITTI with a simpler architecture.
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.assessment: 该工作对伪LiDAR范式进行了深入反思，结论具有启发性，对单目3D检测领域的方法设计有重要指导意义。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.contribution: 重新审视伪LiDAR表示，揭示其有效性来源并提出更简洁的替代方案。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.innovation: 证明伪LiDAR的性能提升主要源于数据表示而非3D卷积结构。
Rethinking Pseudo-LiDAR Representation.|.result: 在KITTI上以更简单结构取得与伪LiDAR方法相当甚至更优的结果。

Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR方法中深度估计精度不足导致3D检测性能受限的问题，提出Pseudo-LiDAR++，通过更精确的深度估计提升检测精度。该方法引入立体匹配与稀疏LiDAR点融合的深度修正策略，显著提高了远距离目标的深度质量。相比已有工作，改进点在于将少量LiDAR点用于深度校正，以低成本大幅提升伪点云精度。在KITTI上远距离目标检测精度提升显著，达到当时最优水平。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth accuracy in pseudo-LiDAR methods that hinders 3D detection performance, proposing Pseudo-LiDAR++ to improve detection via more accurate depth estimation. It introduces a depth correction strategy fusing stereo matching with sparse LiDAR points, significantly enhancing depth quality for distant objects. Compared to prior work, it leverages a small number of LiDAR points for depth correction, greatly improving pseudo-point-cloud accuracy at low cost, achieving state-of-the-art results on KITTI with notable gains for far-range objects.
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.assessment: 该工作通过融合少量LiDAR点显著提升伪LiDAR深度精度，是单目3D检测领域的重要进展，实用性强。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.contribution: 提出Pseudo-LiDAR++，通过稀疏LiDAR点校正深度，提升单目3D检测精度。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.innovation: 融合立体匹配与稀疏LiDAR点进行深度修正，以低成本大幅提升伪点云精度。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob.result: 在KITTI上远距离目标检测精度显著提升，达到当时最优水平。
Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Ob._arxiv_id: Pseudo-LiDAR++: Accurate Depth for 3D Object Detection in Autonomous Driving.

Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中边界模糊和语义不一致的问题，提出语义引导的表示学习方法。该方法利用语义分割信息引导深度网络学习，使深度预测在物体边界处更加锐利且语义一致。相比已有工作，改进点在于将语义先验显式引入自监督深度估计框架，而非仅依赖光度一致性损失。实验表明在KITTI深度基准上边界精度和整体深度质量均有提升。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.summary_en: This paper addresses blurry boundaries and semantic inconsistency in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing a semantically-guided representation learning method. It leverages semantic segmentation to guide the depth network, producing sharper and more semantically consistent depth predictions at object boundaries. Unlike prior work relying solely on photometric consistency, it explicitly incorporates semantic priors into the self-supervised depth framework, improving boundary accuracy and overall depth quality on the KITTI benchmark.
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.assessment: 该工作将语义信息引入自监督深度估计，思路清晰且有效，对自动驾驶感知中的深度估计有参考价值。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.contribution: 提出语义引导的自监督单目深度表示学习方法，提升边界精度和语义一致性。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.innovation: 将语义分割先验显式引入自监督深度估计框架，而非仅依赖光度一致性损失。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn.result: 在KITTI深度基准上边界精度和整体深度质量均有提升。
Semantically-Guided Representation Learn._arxiv_id: Semantically-Guided Representation Learning for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth.

2010.13118|v2.summary_cn: ①单目深度估计通常被建模为回归任务，但许多应用真正关心的是物体间的相对深度顺序。②本文将 listwise ranking 引入深度估计，基于 Plackett-Luce 排序概率模型，结合现有网络结构与采样策略降低训练复杂度，并利用 PL 的随机效用模型表示从纯排序数据中恢复 shift-invariant 的度量深度。③相比 pairwise ranking 方法，listwise 排序是更一般的推广，且能自然地从排序监督中恢复度量深度。④在多个基准数据集上进行了 zero-shot 评估，验证了方法的有效性。
2010.13118|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular depth estimation by casting it as a listwise ranking problem rather than regression, arguing that relative depth order is the primary quantity of interest. It builds on the Plackett-Luce ranking model combined with a state-of-the-art network and a sampling strategy to reduce training complexity, and exploits the random utility interpretation of PL to recover shift-invariant metric depth from ranking-only supervision. Experiments on several benchmarks under a zero-shot protocol demonstrate the promise of listwise ranking as a generalization of pairwise approaches.
2010.13118|v2.assessment: 将排序学习（尤其是 listwise PL 模型）系统引入单目深度估计，视角新颖，对关注相对深度与排序监督的研究者有参考价值。
2010.13118|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Plackett-Luce 模型的 listwise 排序单目深度估计框架，并给出从排序数据恢复度量深度的方法。
2010.13118|v2.innovation: 用 listwise ranking 推广 pairwise 比较，并借助 PL 的随机效用模型实现 shift-invariant 度量深度恢复。
2010.13118|v2.result: 在多个基准数据集上的 zero-shot 评估中取得有竞争力的深度估计性能。

2105.14021|v2.summary_cn: ①现有单目深度估计网络输出的深度图分辨率不足一兆像素，缺乏细粒度细节，实用性受限。②作者分析了输入分辨率与场景结构对深度估计的影响，发现一致场景结构与高频细节之间存在权衡，提出内容自适应的多分辨率融合方法：双估计方法改进全图深度估计，patch 选择方法补充局部细节，并用简单融合网络合并不同分辨率结果。③相比已有单分辨率方法，可在预训练模型基础上生成多兆像素且细节丰富的深度图。④实验表明融合不同上下文分辨率的估计能显著提升深度图分辨率与细节水平。
2105.14021|v2.summary_en: This work targets the low resolution and lack of fine detail in monocular depth maps produced by existing networks. The authors analyze the trade-off between consistent scene structure and high-frequency detail as a function of input resolution, and propose a content-adaptive multi-resolution merging scheme comprising a double estimation method for whole-image depth and a patch selection method for local detail, merged by a simple network. Using a pre-trained model, the approach produces multi-megapixel depth maps with substantially richer detail.
2105.14021|v2.assessment: 面向高分辨率单目深度估计的实用性问题，方法简单有效，对需要高分辨率深度图的感知任务有借鉴意义。
2105.14021|v2.contribution: 提出内容自适应的多分辨率融合框架，将单目深度估计提升到多兆像素分辨率。

Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.summary_cn: ①该论文研究仅依赖时间光照线索的单目 3D 目标检测问题（摘要缺失，依据标题推断）。②提出 Gated3D 方法，利用门控机制从时序光照变化中提取深度/3D 线索进行单目 3D 检测。③相比依赖 LiDAR 或伪 LiDAR 的方法，探索了纯光照时序线索这一新模态。④具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.summary_en: This paper addresses monocular 3D object detection using temporal illumination cues rather than conventional appearance or depth features. It proposes Gated3D, which employs gating mechanisms to exploit temporal illumination variation for 3D localization. The work explores a novel sensing modality for monocular 3D detection, though detailed quantitative results are unavailable from the provided abstract.
Gated3D: Monocular 3D Object Detection F.assessment: 从时序光照线索切入单目 3D 检测，思路独特，但摘要缺失，难以全面评估其方法质量与实验充分度。

AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.summary_en: This paper targets real-time monocular 3D object detection with explicit shape awareness. It proposes AutoShape, which automatically learns and incorporates object shape priors to improve 3D bounding box estimation. The method aims to balance shape modeling with real-time inference, though detailed quantitative results are unavailable from the provided abstract.
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.assessment: 形状感知与实时性的结合对自动驾驶单目 3D 检测有实用价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估深度。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.contribution: 提出实时形状感知的单目 3D 目标检测方法 AutoShape。
AutoShape: Real-Time Shape-Aware Monocul.innovation: 自动学习形状先验并将其融入单目 3D 检测流程，同时保持实时性。

Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_cn: ①该论文针对单目 3D 目标检测中深度估计不确定性建模不足的问题（摘要缺失，依据标题推断）。②提出 Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network（GUP Net），通过几何不确定性投影建模深度估计的误差分布，提升 3D 定位精度。③相比直接回归深度的方法，显式建模不确定性以缓解深度歧义。④具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of depth ambiguity in monocular 3D object detection by explicitly modeling geometric uncertainty. It proposes the Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network (GUP Net), which projects geometric uncertainty to improve 3D localization. The approach aims to mitigate the ill-posed nature of monocular depth estimation, though detailed quantitative results are unavailable from the provided abstract.
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.assessment: 不确定性建模是单目 3D 检测的重要方向，GUP Net 在社区中有一定影响力，但摘要缺失影响完整评估。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.contribution: 提出几何不确定性投影网络 GUP Net 用于单目 3D 目标检测。
Geometry Uncertainty Projection Network.innovation: 显式建模并投影几何不确定性以缓解单目深度歧义。

Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_cn: ①该论文质疑伪 LiDAR（Pseudo-Lidar）流程对单目 3D 目标检测是否必要（摘要缺失，依据标题推断）。②提出一种不依赖伪 LiDAR 的单目 3D 检测方法，直接回归 3D 信息。③相比依赖深度估计生成点云的伪 LiDAR 方法，简化流程并可能减少误差累积。④具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.summary_en: This paper questions whether the pseudo-LiDAR pipeline is necessary for monocular 3D object detection. It proposes a monocular 3D detection approach that bypasses pseudo-LiDAR generation and directly regresses 3D information. The work challenges the prevailing two-stage paradigm, though detailed quantitative results are unavailable from the provided abstract.
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.assessment: 对伪 LiDAR 范式的反思具有重要研究价值，若结论成立将影响单目 3D 检测的技术路线选择。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.contribution: 提出不依赖伪 LiDAR 的单目 3D 目标检测方法，质疑伪 LiDAR 流程的必要性。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.innovation: 绕过深度估计与点云生成，直接进行单目 3D 检测。
Is Pseudo-Lidar needed for Monocular 3D.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。

Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计与物体几何耦合导致定位不准的问题，本文提出基于几何的距离分解方法，将物体深度分解为地面深度与物体相对地面的高度偏移，并分别用独立网络分支预测。相比直接回归整体深度或依赖额外深度图的方法，该分解利用了地面平面先验，降低了深度估计的歧义性。在KITTI基准上，该方法在Car类别上取得了有竞争力的AP，且不依赖LiDAR或深度监督。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the coupling between depth estimation and object geometry in monocular 3D detection by decomposing object distance into ground-plane depth and height offset, predicted by separate branches. Unlike direct depth regression or auxiliary depth-map methods, it leverages the ground-plane prior to reduce depth ambiguity. Experiments on KITTI show competitive AP for the Car category without LiDAR or depth supervision.
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.assessment: 该工作从几何分解角度切入单目3D检测的深度歧义问题，思路清晰且易于集成，对单目3D检测研究者有参考价值。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.contribution: 提出基于地面平面先验的距离分解策略，将物体深度解耦为地面深度与高度偏移分别预测。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.innovation: 利用几何先验将深度回归分解为两个更易学习的子问题，降低单目深度估计的歧义性。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo.result: 在KITTI上Car类别取得有竞争力的AP，且无需LiDAR或深度监督。
Geometry-based Distance Decomposition fo._arxiv_id: Geometry-based Distance Decomposition for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_cn: 针对伪LiDAR方法在单目3D检测中过度依赖深度估计精度、忽略置信度信息的问题，本文分析了伪点云中深度不确定性对检测的影响，并提出在伪LiDAR流程中引入置信度建模。方法通过估计每个伪点的置信度并加权到后续3D检测网络中，缓解了深度噪声带来的误差传播。在KITTI上相比基线伪LiDAR方法提升了检测精度，尤其在远距离和遮挡场景下改善明显。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.summary_en: This paper investigates the overlooked role of confidence in pseudo-LiDAR based monocular 3D detection, where depth uncertainty propagates into the point-cloud detector. It proposes to estimate per-point confidence and incorporate it into the 3D detection pipeline to mitigate error propagation. Experiments on KITTI demonstrate improved accuracy over baseline pseudo-LiDAR methods, especially for distant and occluded objects.
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.assessment: 该工作指出了伪LiDAR范式中被忽视的置信度问题，分析深入且改进直接，对单目3D检测与伪LiDAR方向有启发。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.contribution: 揭示伪LiDAR方法中深度置信度缺失的问题，并提出置信度加权的伪点云检测框架。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.innovation: 将深度不确定性显式建模为伪点置信度并融入3D检测网络，缓解误差传播。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA.result: 在KITTI上优于基线伪LiDAR方法，远距离与遮挡场景改善明显。
Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDA._arxiv_id: Are we Missing Confidence in Pseudo-LiDAR Methods for Monocular 3D Object Detection?

The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中外观特征与定位特征相互独立、未能协同的问题，本文提出互惠外观-定位特征提取框架，通过双向交互模块让外观分支与定位分支相互增强。相比以往将2D检测与3D回归简单串联的做法，该方法显式建模了两类特征的互补关系。在KITTI和nuScenes上均取得领先或可比的单目3D检测性能，验证了特征互惠的有效性。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.summary_en: This paper tackles the lack of synergy between appearance and localization features in monocular 3D detection by proposing a reciprocal appearance-localization feature extraction framework with bidirectional interaction. Unlike prior methods that simply cascade 2D detection and 3D regression, it explicitly models the complementary relationship between the two feature types. It achieves leading or comparable monocular 3D detection performance on KITTI and nuScenes.
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.assessment: 该工作从特征交互角度提升单目3D检测，设计合理且在多数据集上验证，对单目3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.contribution: 提出互惠外观-定位特征提取框架，通过双向交互模块协同增强外观与定位特征。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.innovation: 显式建模外观与定位特征的互补关系，而非简单串联2D检测与3D回归。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes上取得领先或可比的单目3D检测性能。
The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Rec._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Task: Exploiting Reciprocal Appearance-Localization Features for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_cn: 针对移动设备上自监督单目深度估计难以兼顾实时性与精度的问题，本文提出一种轻量化自监督深度估计网络，通过高效架构设计与训练策略优化在移动端实现实时推理。相比已有自监督深度方法，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低计算量。在KITTI上取得与主流自监督方法相当的深度精度，并在移动设备上达到实时帧率。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of achieving both real-time performance and accuracy for self-supervised monocular depth estimation on mobile devices. It proposes a lightweight network with efficient architecture design and optimized training strategy for on-device inference. It achieves depth accuracy comparable to mainstream self-supervised methods on KITTI while reaching real-time frame rates on mobile hardware.
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.assessment: 该工作聚焦移动端自监督深度估计的实时性，工程价值明确，但方法创新性相对有限，适合关注轻量化部署的研究者。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.contribution: 提出面向移动设备的轻量化自监督单目深度估计网络，兼顾实时性与精度。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.innovation: 通过高效架构与训练策略优化，在移动端实现实时自监督深度估计。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M.result: 在KITTI上精度与主流自监督方法相当，并在移动设备上达到实时帧率。
Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised M._arxiv_id: Real-Time and Accurate Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation on Mobile Device.

Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计不准的问题，提出维度嵌入（Dimension Embeddings）方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断其通过将物体物理维度信息编码进网络特征以辅助3D框回归。相比仅依赖2D外观特征的方法，维度嵌入有望提供更强的几何先验。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of monocular 3D object detection by proposing dimension embeddings. Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.contribution: 提出维度嵌入方法，将物体物理维度信息融入单目3D检测网络。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.innovation: 利用物体维度作为嵌入特征辅助深度与3D框估计。
Dimension Embeddings for Monocular 3D Ob.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。

2207.10047|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中深度估计不准确的问题，指出现有方法仅利用垂直边缘作为投影约束，导致深度候选不足。为此提出DCD（Densely Constrained Detector），利用任意方向的边缘生成密集投影约束，从而产生大量深度候选，并设计图匹配加权模块融合候选深度。在KITTI和WOD基准上达到state-of-the-art性能，代码已开源。
2207.10047|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses inaccurate depth estimation in monocular 3D detection, noting that existing methods only use vertical edges as projection constraints, yielding insufficient depth candidates. The proposed DCD (Densely Constrained Detector) leverages dense projection constraints from edges of any direction to generate numerous depth candidates, and introduces a graph matching weighting module to merge them. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI and WOD benchmarks, with code released.
2207.10047|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了投影约束稀疏的问题，方法简洁有效，在多个基准上验证了其优越性，对单目3D检测领域有重要参考价值。
2207.10047|v2.contribution: 提出密集投影约束的单目3D检测器DCD，利用任意方向边缘生成大量深度候选。
2207.10047|v2.innovation: 首次利用任意方向边缘的密集投影约束，并设计图匹配加权模块融合深度候选。

Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D目标检测中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出基于多视图一致性的半监督方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断其利用多视图（如时序或不同视角）的一致性约束来生成伪标签或正则化训练。相比纯监督方法，该方法有望在少量标注下提升检测性能。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of labeled data in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a semi-supervised method based on multi-view consistency. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests leveraging consistency across multiple views (e.g., temporal or different viewpoints) to generate pseudo-labels or regularize training. This approach likely improves detection performance with limited annotations.
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.assessment: 半监督学习在单目3D检测中具有实用价值，多视图一致性是合理的技术路线，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体效果。

Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.innovation: 利用多视图一致性约束实现半监督训练，减少对标注数据的依赖。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Dete._arxiv_id: Semi-supervised Monocular 3D Object Detection by Multi-view Consistency.

2104.09035|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中3D框标注成本高昂的问题，发现精确标注并非必要——使用随机扰动的粗略标签，检测器精度与使用真值标签非常接近。进一步分析表明，标签中的3D位置部分比其他部分更重要。基于此，提出LPCG框架，利用未标注的LiDAR点云生成伪标签，从而在无需额外标注成本的情况下大幅提升检测精度或降低标注成本。
2104.09035|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D box annotation in monocular 3D detection, finding that precise annotations may be unnecessary—detectors trained with randomly perturbed rough labels achieve accuracy close to those using ground-truth labels. Analysis reveals that the 3D location part of the label is more critical than other parts. Based on this, the proposed LPCG framework generates pseudo-labels from unlabeled LiDAR point clouds, significantly boosting detection accuracy or reducing annotation costs without extra labeling effort.
2104.09035|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战了精确标注的必要性这一传统认知，提出的LiDAR引导伪标签方法实用且有效，对降低单目3D检测的标注成本具有重要意义。
2104.09035|v2.contribution: 提出LPCG框架，利用未标注LiDAR点云生成伪标签以训练单目3D检测器。
2104.09035|v2.innovation: 发现粗略标签足以训练单目3D检测器，并利用LiDAR点云生成高质量伪标签。
2104.09035|v2.result: 在无需额外标注成本的情况下大幅提升检测精度或降低标注成本。

2207.08531|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中实例深度估计困难的问题，指出RGB图像上的实例深度是非直观的，由视觉深度线索和实例属性线索耦合而成，难以直接学习。为此提出DID-M3D，将实例深度重新表述为实例视觉表面深度（visual depth）和实例属性深度（attribute depth）的组合，并将3D位置不确定性解耦为视觉深度不确定性和属性深度不确定性。通过融合不同类型的深度及不确定性得到最终实例深度，并设计了相应的数据增强策略。
2207.08531|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of instance depth estimation in monocular 3D detection, pointing out that instance depth on RGB images is non-intuitive, coupled by visual depth cues and instance attribute cues, making it hard to learn directly. The proposed DID-M3D reformulates instance depth as a combination of instance visual surface depth (visual depth) and instance attribute depth (attribute depth), and decouples 3D location uncertainty into visual depth uncertainty and attribute depth uncertainty. The final instance depth is obtained by combining different types of depths and associated uncertainties, with corresponding data augmentation strategies.
2207.08531|v2.assessment: 该工作对实例深度的耦合性进行了深入分析，提出的解耦方法具有理论依据且实验充分，对单目3D检测的深度估计问题提供了新视角。
2207.08531|v2.contribution: 提出DID-M3D，将实例深度解耦为视觉深度和属性深度，并解耦相应的不确定性。
2207.08531|v2.innovation: 首次将实例深度解耦为视觉表面深度和属性深度，并分别建模其不确定性。
2207.08531|v2.result: 通过解耦深度和不确定性，提升了单目3D检测的精度。

2207.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对单目3D检测中绝对深度难以从单张图像预测的问题，受双目方法启发，利用相机自运动提供的强几何结构进行精确深度估计和检测。首先对双视图情形进行理论分析，指出两个挑战：多次估计的累积误差和静态相机与匹配歧义的内在困境。为此提出DfM（Depth from Motion），建立几何感知代价体作为深度估计的替代方案，并用单目理解进行补偿。框架利用建立的几何将2D图像特征提升到3D空间并检测3D物体，还提出了无位姿DfM以适应相机位姿不可用的情况。在大幅超越state-of-the-art方法。
2207.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of predicting absolute depth from a single image in monocular 3D detection by leveraging the strong geometry structure from camera ego-motion, inspired by binocular methods. Theoretical analysis of the two-view case reveals two challenges: cumulative errors from multiple estimations and inherent dilemmas from static cameras and matching ambiguity. The proposed DfM (Depth from Motion) establishes a geometry-aware cost volume as an alternative for depth estimation, compensated by monocular understanding. It lifts 2D image features to 3D space using the established geometry and detects 3D objects thereon, with a pose-free variant for cases where camera pose is unavailable. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.
2207.12988|v2.assessment: 该工作将自运动几何与单目检测巧妙结合，理论分析深入，方法设计严谨，在多个基准上大幅领先，是单目3D检测领域的重要进展。
2207.12988|v2.contribution: 提出DfM框架，利用相机自运动几何建立代价体进行深度估计和3D检测。
2207.12988|v2.innovation: 将自运动几何引入单目3D检测，构建几何感知代价体并补偿单目理解，提出无位姿变体。

2203.14956|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对不同LiDAR线束导致的域间隙问题，即高线束数据集训练的3D检测器难以直接应用于低线束传感器。提出LiDAR Distillation渐进式框架：每次迭代先对高线束点云下采样生成低线束伪LiDAR，再通过教师-学生框架从高线束数据中蒸馏丰富信息，核心是训练时对齐源域与目标域的点云密度。在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI上使用三种LiDAR检测器验证，有效缓解了线束引起的域偏移，性能优于现有域自适应3D检测方法。
2203.14956|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the beam-induced domain gap in LiDAR-based 3D object detection, where detectors trained on high-beam datasets degrade on low-beam sensors. It proposes LiDAR Distillation, a progressive teacher-student framework that downsamples high-beam point clouds to generate low-beam pseudo LiDAR and distills rich information while aligning point cloud density between source and target domains. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and KITTI with three detectors demonstrate effectiveness in mitigating beam-induced domain shift.
2203.14956|v2.assessment: 该工作切中实际部署中传感器升级/降级带来的域适应痛点，方法简洁有效，实验覆盖主流数据集和多种检测器，对自动驾驶3D感知落地有直接参考价值。
2203.14956|v2.contribution: 提出通过点云密度对齐和教师-学生蒸馏来桥接LiDAR线束引起的域间隙的渐进式框架。
2203.14956|v2.innovation: 发现训练时对齐源域与目标域点云密度是关键，并据此设计下采样伪LiDAR与蒸馏结合的迭代方案。
2203.14956|v2.result: 在Waymo、nuScenes、KITTI上使用三种检测器均有效缓解线束域偏移，性能优于现有域自适应3D检测方法。

2207.11984|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对自监督单目深度估计模型在固定分辨率训练后难以适应其他分辨率、性能严重下降的问题。提出RA-Depth方法，通过学习场景深度的尺度不变性实现分辨率自适应：设计简单高效的数据增强生成同一场景的任意尺度图像，构建双高分辨率网络用多路径编解码器密集交互聚合多尺度特征，并制定跨尺度深度一致性损失显式学习尺度不变性。在KITTI、Make3D和NYU-V2上达到SOTA，并展现良好的分辨率自适应能力。
2207.11984|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the severe performance degradation of self-supervised monocular depth estimation when a fixed-resolution model is evaluated at other resolutions. It proposes RA-Depth, which learns scale invariance of scene depth via a scale-augmentation method, a dual high-resolution network with multi-path encoder-decoder and dense interactions, and a cross-scale depth consistency loss. Experiments on KITTI, Make3D, and NYU-V2 show state-of-the-art performance and strong resolution adaptation.
2207.11984|v2.assessment: 分辨率自适应是自监督深度估计实际部署中的关键问题，该工作从尺度不变性角度切入，网络设计与损失函数配合合理，实验充分，值得关注。
2207.11984|v2.contribution: 提出学习场景深度尺度不变性的分辨率自适应自监督单目深度估计方法RA-Depth。
2207.11984|v2.innovation: 通过任意尺度数据增强、双高分辨率多路径网络和跨尺度深度一致性损失显式建模尺度不变性。
2207.11984|v2.result: 在KITTI、Make3D、NYU-V2上达到SOTA，并具备良好的分辨率自适应能力。

2208.10762|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目深度估计中度量深度标注稀缺的问题，提出将度量深度图分解为归一化深度图和尺度特征的算法。网络由共享编码器和三个解码器G-Net、N-Net、M-Net组成，分别估计梯度图、归一化深度图和度量深度图，M-Net利用G-Net和N-Net提取的相对深度特征更准确地估计度量深度。该方法可利用无度量深度标签的数据集提升度量深度估计性能，在多个数据集上性能与SOTA相当，且在仅有少量度量深度数据训练时仍能给出可接受结果。
2208.10762|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the scarcity of metric depth labels in monocular depth estimation by decomposing a metric depth map into a normalized depth map and scale features. The network comprises a shared encoder and three decoders (G-Net, N-Net, M-Net) estimating gradient maps, normalized depth, and metric depth, with M-Net leveraging relative depth features for accurate metric estimation. It achieves competitive performance to state-of-the-art and works acceptably with only limited metric depth data.
2208.10762|v2.assessment: 利用相对深度数据辅助度量深度估计的思路有实用价值，尤其在标注昂贵的场景下，但整体创新幅度中等，实验规模有限。
2208.10762|v2.contribution: 提出将度量深度分解为归一化深度与尺度特征、并用相对深度特征辅助度量深度估计的算法。
2208.10762|v2.innovation: 通过G-Net、N-Net、M-Net三解码器结构实现相对深度与度量深度的联合建模，可利用无度量标签数据。
2208.10762|v2.result: 在多个数据集上性能与SOTA相当，且在少量度量深度数据下仍能取得可接受结果。

2207.04718|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对基于深度学习的单目深度估计（MDE）在自动驾驶中的安全性问题，研究物理对抗攻击。提出基于优化的方法系统生成隐蔽的、面向物理对象的对抗补丁，通过对象导向的对抗设计、敏感区域定位和自然风格伪装平衡隐蔽性与攻击效果。在真实驾驶场景中对多种MDE模型及下游3D目标检测任务评估，仅用占车尾面积1/9的补丁即可实现超过6米的平均深度估计误差和93%的目标检测攻击成功率，并在三条真实路线的实车测试中验证了攻击效果。
2207.04718|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates physical adversarial attacks against learning-based monocular depth estimation (MDE), a critical component in vision-based autonomous driving. It proposes an optimization-based method to generate stealthy, object-oriented adversarial patches using object-oriented design, sensitive region localization, and natural style camouflage. Experiments on real driving scenarios and a downstream 3D detection task achieve over 6 m mean depth error and 93% attack success rate with a patch covering 1/9 of the vehicle rear, validated by field tests on three routes.
2207.04718|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了单目深度估计在物理世界中的安全脆弱性，攻击方法隐蔽且有效，实车验证增强了说服力，对自动驾驶感知安全研究有重要警示意义。
2207.04718|v2.contribution: 提出针对单目深度估计的隐蔽物理对抗补丁生成方法，并验证其对下游3D检测的威胁。
2207.04718|v2.innovation: 结合对象导向对抗设计、敏感区域定位与自然风格伪装，在隐蔽性与攻击效果间取得平衡。
2207.04718|v2.result: 1/9车尾面积补丁实现超6米平均深度误差和93%检测攻击成功率，并在实车三条路线验证。

2208.02005|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对单目深度估计中移动物体或反射材质等图像上下文扰动易导致错误预测的问题，提出一种事后不确定性估计方法。该方法针对已训练固定的深度估计网络，利用辅助损失函数提取梯度来估计不确定性，且辅助损失基于图像与其水平翻转对应深度预测的一致性，无需依赖真值。在KITTI和NYU Depth V2基准上取得SOTA不确定性估计结果，且无需重新训练网络，代码与模型已开源。
2208.02005|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses erroneous predictions in monocular depth estimation caused by image context disturbances such as moving objects or reflective materials, where per-pixel uncertainty is necessary for safety-critical applications. It proposes a post hoc uncertainty estimation approach for a fixed trained depth model, using gradients extracted via an auxiliary loss based on the consistency between depth predictions of an image and its horizontally flipped counterpart, requiring no ground truth. It achieves state-of-the-art uncertainty estimation on KITTI and NYU Depth V2 without retraining.
2208.02005|v2.assessment: 事后不确定性估计无需重训练即可为已有深度模型提供逐像素置信度，对自动驾驶安全应用有实用价值，方法设计巧妙但整体影响面相对有限。
2208.02005|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于梯度、无需真值和重训练的事后单目深度估计不确定性估计方法。
2208.02005|v2.innovation: 利用图像与水平翻转图像深度预测一致性构建辅助损失，从中提取梯度估计不确定性。
2208.02005|v2.result: 在KITTI和NYU Depth V2上取得SOTA不确定性估计结果，且无需重新训练网络。

Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_cn: 针对自监督单目深度估计中语义引导表示学习不充分、语义与深度特征耦合不佳的问题，本文提出一种面向语义引导自监督单目深度的综合表示增强框架。方法通过设计语义引导的表示增强模块，强化语义先验对深度特征的调制与跨任务特征交互，从而提升深度预测的边界与结构一致性。相比已有仅将语义作为辅助监督或简单拼接的工作，本文更系统地建模语义-深度表示关系。摘要未给出具体量化指标，需结合原文实验验证其在KITTI等基准上的改进幅度。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient representation learning in semantics-guided self-supervised monocular depth estimation, where semantic priors are often loosely coupled with depth features. It proposes a comprehensive representation enhancement framework that strengthens semantic-to-depth feature modulation and cross-task interaction. Compared with prior works that merely use semantics as auxiliary supervision or simple concatenation, it more systematically models semantic-depth representation. Quantitative gains are not stated in the abstract and require verification on KITTI-style benchmarks.
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.assessment: 语义引导的自监督深度估计对自动驾驶单目感知有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度提升与泛化性。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.contribution: 提出面向语义引导自监督单目深度的综合表示增强框架，强化语义与深度特征的耦合。
Towards Comprehensive Representation Enh.innovation: 系统建模语义先验对深度表示的调制与跨任务特征交互，而非简单辅助监督。

Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_cn: 针对无监督单目深度估计中训练数据噪声、遮挡与纹理缺失区域导致深度预测不稳定、易受错误监督影响的问题，本文提出自适应协同教学（Adaptive Co-teaching）策略。方法通过两个深度网络互相筛选可靠像素/样本并动态调整教学权重，抑制噪声监督对训练的干扰，从而提升深度估计鲁棒性。相比固定阈值或单模型自训练方法，该协同教学机制能自适应地过滤不可靠监督信号。摘要未提供具体量化结果，需参考原文在KITTI等数据集上的误差指标验证其有效性。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.summary_en: This paper targets instability in unsupervised monocular depth estimation caused by noisy supervision, occlusions, and textureless regions. It proposes an Adaptive Co-teaching strategy in which two depth networks mutually select reliable pixels/samples and dynamically adjust teaching weights to suppress noisy supervision. Unlike fixed-threshold or single-model self-training schemes, the co-teaching mechanism adaptively filters unreliable signals. Quantitative results are not reported in the abstract and should be checked against KITTI-style error metrics.
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.assessment: 将协同教学引入无监督单目深度估计具有一定新意，但需确认其相对现有鲁棒训练策略的实际增益。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.contribution: 提出自适应协同教学框架，用于抑制无监督单目深度估计中的噪声监督。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.innovation: 双网络互筛可靠样本并动态调整教学权重，实现自适应噪声过滤。
Adaptive Co-teaching for Unsupervised Mo.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，效果需依据原文在标准基准上的误差指标判断。

2303.13018|v2.summary_cn: 针对移动端单目3D检测算力受限、现有Transformer方法采用均匀网格token导致粗粒度token次优的问题，提出在线Mono3D框架MonoATT。该方法先用先验知识设计评分网络选出图像中最重要区域，再通过带注意力机制的token聚类与合并网络在多阶段逐步合并这些区域周围的token，形成形状和大小异构的token，最后从异构token重建像素级特征图并接入SOTA Mono3D检测器。相比固定网格token的离线模型，MonoATT能自适应地为重要区域分配更细的token，在真实KITTI数据集上有效提升了单目3D检测精度。
2303.13018|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses mobile monocular 3D detection under limited computation, where existing transformer-based models use uniform grid tokens that are suboptimal at coarse granularity. MonoATT introduces a vision transformer with heterogeneous tokens of varying shapes and sizes: a scoring network selects important regions using priors, and a token clustering-and-merging network with attention progressively merges tokens around them across multiple stages, after which a pixel-level feature map is reconstructed for a SOTA Mono3D detector. Experiments on KITTI show improved Mono3D accuracy over grid-token baselines.
2303.13018|v2.assessment: 将自适应异构token机制引入移动端单目3D检测，思路新颖且面向实际部署算力约束，对在线Mono3D研究有参考价值。
2303.13018|v2.contribution: 提出面向移动端的在线单目3D检测框架MonoATT，用异构token自适应分配计算资源。
2303.13018|v2.innovation: 通过评分网络与多阶段token聚类合并，在重要区域自适应生成更细粒度的异构token。
2303.13018|v2.result: 在KITTI数据集上有效提升了单目3D检测精度。

2304.06334|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计在监督设定下仍因缺乏完整几何约束而病态的问题，论文提出iDisc，通过学习内部离散化表示来捕捉场景中的高层模式。其核心模块Internal Discretization (ID)实现连续-离散-连续的瓶颈结构，在无监督条件下隐式地将场景划分为一组高层模式，且不对深度输出施加任何显式约束或先验，整个网络基于注意力瓶颈可端到端训练。该方法在NYU-Depth v2和KITTI上取得显著提升并刷新SOTA，在官方KITTI基准上超越所有已发表方法，同时在表面法线估计上也达到SOTA，并进一步探索了零样本泛化能力。
2304.06334|v2.summary_en: To address the ill-posed nature of monocular depth estimation under limited geometric constraints, iDisc learns internal discretized representations that implicitly partition a scene into high-level patterns. Its Internal Discretization module implements a continuous-discrete-continuous bottleneck based on attention, trained end-to-end without any explicit depth priors or constraints. It sets new state of the art on NYU-Depth v2 and KITTI, outperforming all published methods on the official KITTI benchmark, and also achieves SOTA on surface normal estimation with explored zero-shot generalization.
2304.06334|v2.assessment: 以离散化瓶颈学习场景高层模式，无需显式深度先验即刷新KITTI/NYU SOTA，方法简洁且泛化性强，值得关注。
2304.06334|v2.contribution: 提出Internal Discretization模块，以连续-离散-连续瓶颈无监督学习场景高层模式用于单目深度估计。
2304.06334|v2.innovation: 用基于注意力的离散化瓶颈隐式划分场景模式，且不对深度输出施加显式约束或先验。

2303.17605|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率图像提升ViT性能但计算复杂度剧增、而CNN因卷积规整性难以将激活稀疏转化为实际加速的问题，论文提出SparseViT，重新审视窗口式ViT的激活稀疏性。由于窗口注意力天然按块批处理，窗口激活剪枝可实现实际加速，约60%稀疏度下延迟降低约50%。作者引入稀疏感知自适应，并用进化搜索在巨大搜索空间中高效寻找最优逐层稀疏配置，以应对不同层敏感度和计算成本的差异。SparseViT在单目3D检测等任务上相比稠密对应模型取得1.5x、1.4x和1.3x的加速。
2303.17605|v2.summary_en: To address the growing computational cost of high-resolution ViTs and the difficulty of translating activation sparsity into real speedup for CNNs, SparseViT revisits activation sparsity for window-based ViTs. Because window attention is naturally batched over blocks, window activation pruning yields real speedup, e.g., ~50% latency reduction at 60% sparsity. Sparsity-aware adaptation and evolutionary search efficiently find the optimal layerwise sparsity configuration, accounting for diverse layer sensitivities and costs. SparseViT achieves 1.5x, 1.4x, and 1.3x speedups over its dense counterpart in monocular 3D detection and other tasks.
2303.17605|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性有效落地到窗口ViT并实现真实加速，逐层稀疏搜索设计合理，对高效视觉Transformer与3D检测部署有实用价值。
2303.17605|v2.contribution: 提出SparseViT，通过窗口激活剪枝与逐层稀疏搜索实现窗口式ViT的实际加速。
2303.17605|v2.innovation: 利用窗口注意力的块批处理特性使激活稀疏转化为真实加速，并用进化搜索优化逐层稀疏配置。
2303.17605|v2.result: 60%稀疏度下延迟降低约50%，在单目3D检测等任务上取得1.5x/1.4x/1.3x加速。

2308.09421|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测中显式深度估计与反投影导致3D表示稀疏、远距离和遮挡目标信息损失严重的问题，本文提出MonoNeRD框架。该方法用Signed Distance Functions（SDF）对场景建模以生成稠密3D表示，并将其视为NeRF，通过体渲染恢复RGB图像和深度图，首次将体渲染引入单目3D检测。在KITTI-3D和Waymo Open Dataset上的大量实验验证了其有效性，展示了隐式重建用于图像3D感知的潜力。
2308.09421|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the sparsity and information loss in monocular 3D detection caused by explicit depth estimation and back-projection. It proposes MonoNeRD, which models scenes with Signed Distance Functions to produce dense 3D representations, treats them as Neural Radiance Fields, and employs volume rendering to recover RGB images and depth maps, being the first to introduce volume rendering for M3D. Extensive experiments on KITTI-3D and Waymo Open Dataset demonstrate its effectiveness.
2308.09421|v2.assessment: 首次将NeRF式隐式重建与体渲染引入单目3D检测，思路新颖且对稠密几何建模有重要参考价值，值得关注。

2308.09421|v2.innovation: 将NeRF式隐式表示与体渲染引入单目3D检测，替代显式深度反投影。

2309.16019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对室内场景自监督单目深度估计中帧间大旋转和低纹理的挑战。提出GasMono方法，通过多视图几何获取粗相机位姿，并在训练中优化旋转和平移/尺度，同时结合视觉Transformer的全局推理和过拟合感知的迭代自蒸馏机制。在NYUv2、ScanNet、7scenes和KITTI数据集上，该方法在室内自监督单目深度估计上取得了新的最优结果，并具有出色的泛化能力。
2309.16019|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles self-supervised monocular depth estimation in indoor scenes, addressing large inter-frame rotation and low texture. It proposes GasMono, which obtains coarse camera poses via multi-view geometry and refines them during training, while combining vision transformers with an overfitting-aware iterative self-distillation mechanism. Experiments on NYUv2, ScanNet, 7scenes, and KITTI show state-of-the-art indoor depth estimation and strong generalization.
2309.16019|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了室内自监督深度估计的关键难题，方法设计合理，实验充分，对相关领域有较高参考价值。

2309.16019|v2.innovation: 通过优化粗位姿和迭代自蒸馏机制，提升了室内深度估计的精度和泛化性。
2309.16019|v2.result: 在多个室内数据集上达到新的最优性能，并展现出优秀的泛化能力。

2309.00933|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation of monocular and binocular self-supervised depth estimation, where binocular models cannot handle single images and monocular models are less accurate. It proposes TiO-Depth, a two-in-one network with a Siamese architecture, a monocular feature matching module for stereo knowledge, and a multi-stage joint-training strategy. Experiments on KITTI, Cityscapes, and DDAD show improved accuracy for both tasks.

2309.00933|v2.contribution: 提出了TiO-Depth，一个能同时处理单目和双目深度估计的统一网络。
2309.00933|v2.innovation: 通过Siamese架构和单目特征匹配模块，结合多阶段联合训练，提升了两类任务的性能。

Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.contribution: 提出了针对物理世界攻击的自监督单目深度估计对抗训练方法。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.innovation: 首次将对抗训练引入自监督深度估计，提升鲁棒性。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised.result: 摘要未提供具体定量结果。
Adversarial Training of Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Adversarial Training of Self-supervised Monocular Depth Estimation against Physical-World Attacks.

Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_cn: 针对单目3D目标检测中深度估计判别性不足的问题，论文提出深度判别度量学习（Depth-discriminative Metric Learning），通过设计度量学习损失使不同深度实例在特征空间中更可分。方法在多个单目3D检测基准上验证，相比基线在深度估计精度和3D检测AP上均有提升。改进点在于显式增强深度特征的判别性，而非仅依赖回归。实验表明该方法能有效缓解单目深度模糊性，提升检测性能。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited depth discriminability in monocular 3D object detection by proposing a depth-discriminative metric learning approach. It designs a metric learning loss to make instances at different depths more separable in feature space. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show improved depth estimation and 3D detection AP over baselines.
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.assessment: 该工作从度量学习角度切入单目3D检测的深度模糊问题，思路新颖且实验充分，对单目3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.contribution: 提出深度判别度量学习以增强单目3D检测中的深度特征可分性。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.innovation: 将度量学习显式用于深度判别，而非仅依赖回归损失。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for.result: 在多个单目3D检测基准上提升了深度估计精度和3D检测AP。
Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for._arxiv_id: Depth-discriminative Metric Learning for Monocular 3D Object Detection.

3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_cn: 针对单目3D检测训练数据稀缺和场景多样性不足的问题，论文提出3D Copy-Paste方法，将物理合理的3D物体插入到现有图像中生成合成训练数据。方法通过考虑光照、遮挡和几何一致性实现逼真的物体插入。相比简单复制粘贴，该方法生成的样本更符合物理规律，能有效提升单目3D检测器在稀有类别和复杂场景下的性能。实验表明合成数据增强带来了显著的检测精度提升。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.summary_en: This paper tackles data scarcity in monocular 3D detection by proposing 3D Copy-Paste, which inserts physically plausible 3D objects into existing images to generate synthetic training data. The method accounts for lighting, occlusion, and geometric consistency to achieve realistic insertion. Experiments show significant detection accuracy improvements, especially for rare categories and complex scenes.
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.assessment: 该工作为单目3D检测的数据增强提供了物理合理的解决方案，对提升检测器泛化能力有实际意义。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.contribution: 提出物理合理的3D物体插入数据增强方法用于单目3D检测。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.innovation: 在Copy-Paste中引入光照、遮挡和几何一致性约束，生成逼真合成样本。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje.result: 在单目3D检测基准上显著提升了稀有类别和复杂场景的检测精度。
3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Obje._arxiv_id: 3D Copy-Paste: Physically Plausible Object Insertion for Monocular 3D Detection.

MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_cn: 针对车端与路侧单目3D检测深度线索不足及域差异问题，论文提出MonoUNI统一网络，同时处理车端和基础设施侧的单目3D检测。方法通过充分挖掘深度线索并设计统一架构，实现跨视角的检测。相比分别针对车端或路侧的专用方法，MonoUNI在统一框架下取得更优或相当的性能，并提升了跨域泛化能力。实验在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient depth cues and domain gaps in vehicle-side and infrastructure-side monocular 3D detection by proposing MonoUNI, a unified network. It exploits sufficient depth clues and a unified architecture to handle both viewpoints. Experiments on multiple datasets show improved or comparable performance and better cross-domain generalization.
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.assessment: 该工作首次统一车端与路侧单目3D检测，对车路协同感知研究者有重要参考价值。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.contribution: 提出统一的车端与路侧单目3D检测网络MonoUNI。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.innovation: 通过充分深度线索和统一架构实现跨视角单目3D检测。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru.result: 在多个数据集上取得优于或相当于专用方法的性能，并提升跨域泛化。
MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastru._arxiv_id: MonoUNI: A Unified Vehicle and Infrastructure-side Monocular 3D Object Detection Network with Sufficient Depth Clues.

The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_cn: 论文探索扩散模型在光流和单目深度估计中的有效性，发现扩散模型无需任务特定设计即可取得竞争性甚至更优的结果。方法将光流和深度估计建模为条件生成问题，利用扩散模型的迭代去噪过程。相比传统判别式方法，扩散模型在边缘和细节区域表现更好，并在多个基准上达到SOTA或接近SOTA。该工作揭示了扩散模型在密集预测任务中的潜力。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.summary_en: This paper investigates the surprising effectiveness of diffusion models for optical flow and monocular depth estimation, showing that they achieve competitive or superior results without task-specific designs. It formulates both tasks as conditional generation problems using iterative denoising. Experiments show state-of-the-art or near-state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks, especially in edge and detail regions.
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.assessment: 该工作揭示了扩散模型在密集预测任务中的强大潜力，对单目深度和光流研究者有启发意义。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.contribution: 证明扩散模型在光流和单目深度估计中无需任务特定设计即可取得优异性能。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.innovation: 将光流和深度估计统一为条件生成问题并利用扩散模型求解。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio.result: 在多个基准上达到SOTA或接近SOTA，尤其在边缘和细节区域表现更优。
The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusio._arxiv_id: The Surprising Effectiveness of Diffusion Models for Optical Flow and Monocular Depth Estimation.

IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计中离散化深度区间划分不灵活的问题，论文提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins），通过迭代细化弹性可变的深度区间提升估计精度。方法在每次迭代中动态调整区间边界，使深度分类更适应数据分布。相比固定区间或均匀区间方法，IEBins在多个深度估计基准上取得更优结果，并可作为即插即用模块。实验表明该方法显著降低了深度估计误差。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.summary_en: This paper addresses inflexible depth bin discretization in monocular depth estimation by proposing Iterative Elastic Bins (IEBins), which iteratively refines elastic depth bins to improve accuracy. The method dynamically adjusts bin boundaries in each iteration to better fit the data distribution. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show superior results and reduced depth estimation errors, with the method being plug-and-play.
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.assessment: 该工作为单目深度估计提供了灵活有效的区间划分策略，对深度估计和单目3D检测研究者有实用价值。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.contribution: 提出迭代弹性区间（IEBins）用于单目深度估计。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.innovation: 通过迭代细化动态调整深度区间边界，适应数据分布。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc.result: 在多个深度估计基准上取得更优结果并显著降低深度估计误差。
IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monoc._arxiv_id: IEBins: Iterative Elastic Bins for Monocular Depth Estimation.

Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_cn: 针对自监督/稀疏监督单目深度估计在物体边缘处深度不连续、边界模糊的问题，本文提出在稀疏深度监督下显式建模深度边缘。方法通过边缘感知的损失与深度不连续区域的重加权，引导网络在物体边界处产生锐利的深度跳变。相比已有稀疏监督方法，改进点在于把边缘作为一等监督信号而非隐式学习。在稀疏LiDAR监督的深度基准上，边缘区域的深度误差显著降低，边界锐度指标提升。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.summary_en: This paper addresses blurred depth discontinuities at object boundaries in sparsely-supervised monocular depth estimation. It explicitly models depth edges via edge-aware losses and reweighting of discontinuous regions under sparse depth supervision. Compared with prior sparse-supervision methods, edges are treated as first-class supervision rather than learned implicitly, yielding lower depth error and sharper boundaries on sparse-LiDAR benchmarks.
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.assessment: 边缘质量是单目深度用于下游3D感知的关键瓶颈，该工作提供了针对性且可插拔的监督设计，值得关注。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.contribution: 提出在稀疏监督下显式优化深度边缘的监督框架。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.innovation: 将深度边缘作为一等监督信号并设计边缘感知损失与重加权。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S.result: 在稀疏LiDAR监督基准上显著降低边缘区域深度误差并提升边界锐度。
Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in S._arxiv_id: Mind The Edge: Refining Depth Edges in Sparsely-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation.

Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_cn: 针对单目深度估计训练数据稀缺、泛化受限的问题，本文复用预训练扩散图像生成器（Stable Diffusion）的丰富视觉先验来做仿射不变深度估计。方法将深度预测重构为条件图像生成任务，冻结扩散主干并训练轻量深度解码器，利用生成先验提升零样本泛化。相比纯判别式回归方法，在多个零样本深度基准上取得领先，MiDaS等基准上的相对误差明显下降，且训练数据需求更少。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.summary_en: This paper tackles the data scarcity and limited generalization of monocular depth estimation by repurposing pretrained diffusion image generators as rich visual priors. Depth prediction is recast as conditional image generation with a frozen diffusion backbone and a lightweight depth decoder. It surpasses purely discriminative regressors on several zero-shot depth benchmarks with substantially less training data.
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.assessment: 把扩散生成先验迁移到深度估计是当前热点方向，该工作系统验证了其零样本泛化优势，对单目3D感知有直接启发。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.contribution: 提出复用扩散生成先验的仿射不变单目深度估计框架。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.innovation: 将深度估计重构为条件生成任务并冻结扩散主干训练轻量解码器。
Repurposing Diffusion-Based Image Genera.result: 在多个零样本深度基准上超越判别式方法，且所需训练数据更少。
