Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_cn: 该论文针对设备故障检测中的异常检测问题，提出了一种可解释、多维、多模态的异常检测方法，并引入负采样策略。方法核心是通过负采样构造异常样本以训练判别模型，从而在缺乏真实异常数据的情况下实现故障检测。相比已有工作，其改进点在于强调可解释性与多模态融合，而非仅追求检测精度。摘要中未提供具体实验数据，因此无法引用定量结果。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.summary_en: This paper addresses anomaly detection for device failure by proposing an interpretable, multidimensional, and multimodal framework with negative sampling. The method constructs pseudo-anomalies via negative sampling to train a discriminative model when real anomalies are scarce. Its main advance lies in emphasizing interpretability and multimodal fusion rather than detection accuracy alone, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等核心方向关联较弱，仅在异常/开放集检测概念上有间接联系，且摘要缺乏实验数据，参考价值有限。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.contribution: 提出了一种结合负采样与多模态信息的可解释异常检测框架用于设备故障检测。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.innovation: 将负采样策略与可解释、多维、多模态异常检测相结合。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果无法量化评估。
Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimo._arxiv_id: Interpretable, Multidimensional, Multimodal Anomaly Detection with Negative Sampling for Detection of Device Failure.

WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_cn: 该论文提出 WebQA，一个面向多模态多跳问答的 NeurIPS 挑战赛，旨在推动模型在网页图像与文本混合信息上进行多步推理。方法上以竞赛形式构建数据集与评测协议，组织参赛者提交系统并汇总结果。相比已有单跳 VQA 基准，它强调多跳检索与跨模态证据链的整合。摘要未提供具体性能数据，主要贡献在于基准与挑战赛组织。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.summary_en: This paper introduces WebQA, a NeurIPS challenge for multimodal multihop question answering over web images and text. It organizes a benchmark and competition protocol to evaluate systems that perform multi-step reasoning across modalities. Unlike prior single-hop VQA benchmarks, it emphasizes multi-hop retrieval and cross-modal evidence chaining, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.assessment: 作为基准与挑战赛论文，对多模态推理评测有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.contribution: 构建并组织了面向多模态多跳问答的 NeurIPS 挑战赛基准。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.innovation: 将多跳推理与网页多模态证据整合引入标准化评测。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要产出为基准与竞赛结论。
WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Cha._arxiv_id: WebQA: A Multimodal Multihop NeurIPS Challenge.

Multimodal single cell data integration.summary_cn: 该论文总结多模态单细胞数据整合挑战赛的结果与经验，针对不同模态单细胞测量难以联合建模的问题。方法上通过竞赛设定统一评测任务与指标，比较参赛方法在跨模态整合上的表现。相比已有单细胞分析工作，它提供了系统性基准与失败经验总结。摘要未给出具体数值，主要价值在于社区基准与教训归纳。
Multimodal single cell data integration.summary_en: This paper reports the results and lessons learned from a multimodal single-cell data integration challenge. It defines standardized tasks and metrics to compare methods that jointly model different single-cell modalities. Compared with prior single-cell analysis work, it provides a systematic benchmark and practical insights, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Multimodal single cell data integration.assessment: 属于生物信息学基准论文，与计算机视觉/自动驾驶感知领域几乎不相关。
Multimodal single cell data integration.contribution: 组织并总结了多模态单细胞数据整合挑战赛的基准与经验。
Multimodal single cell data integration.innovation: 以竞赛形式系统评估跨模态单细胞整合方法。
Multimodal single cell data integration.result: 摘要未提供具体指标，主要产出为挑战赛结论与经验教训。
Multimodal single cell data integration._arxiv_id: Multimodal single cell data integration challenge: Results and lessons learned.

There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督多目标检测与跟踪中缺乏标注的问题，提出利用声音作为自监督信号，通过蒸馏多模态知识来学习视觉检测与跟踪。方法将音频-视觉多模态模型的知识蒸馏到仅视觉的学生网络中，从而在推理时无需音频输入即可完成多目标检测与跟踪。相比已有自监督方法，它借助声音这一额外模态提供定位监督。摘要未给出具体数值，但展示了跨模态蒸馏用于自监督视觉任务的可行性。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised multi-object detection and tracking by leveraging sound as a supervisory signal and distilling multimodal knowledge. It transfers knowledge from an audio-visual teacher to a vision-only student, enabling detection and tracking without audio at inference. Compared with prior self-supervised approaches, it exploits sound to provide localization supervision, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏用于自监督检测跟踪的思路新颖，对自监督视觉与多模态学习有启发，但与自动驾驶 BEV/3D 感知的直接关联有限。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.contribution: 提出利用声音自监督并通过多模态知识蒸馏实现视觉多目标检测与跟踪。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.innovation: 将音频模态作为自监督信号蒸馏到纯视觉检测跟踪网络。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，验证了跨模态蒸馏用于自监督检测跟踪的可行性。
There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-S._arxiv_id: There Is More Than Meets the Eye: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Detection and Tracking With Sound by Distilling Multimodal Knowledge.

Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_cn: 该论文针对雾天条件下车辆检测鲁棒性差的问题，提出融合互补的激光雷达与雷达信号进行多模态车辆检测。方法利用 LiDAR 与 Radar 在恶劣天气下的互补特性，设计多模态融合网络提升雾天检测性能。相比仅用相机或单一传感器的方案，该方法在低能见度下更鲁棒。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在雾天场景下检测性能的提升。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.summary_en: This paper tackles robust vehicle detection in foggy weather by fusing complementary LiDAR and radar signals. It designs a multimodal fusion network that exploits the complementary characteristics of LiDAR and radar under adverse weather. Compared with camera-only or single-sensor approaches, it improves robustness in low-visibility conditions, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.assessment: 面向恶劣天气的多模态 3D 检测对自动驾驶感知有实际价值，LiDAR-Radar 互补融合思路值得关注。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.contribution: 提出融合互补 LiDAR 与 Radar 信号的雾天鲁棒车辆检测方法。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.innovation: 利用 LiDAR 与 Radar 在雾天的互补性进行多模态融合检测。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，声称在雾天场景下提升了车辆检测鲁棒性。
Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in F._arxiv_id: Robust Multimodal Vehicle Detection in Foggy Weather Using Complementary Lidar and Radar Signals.

UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言预训练中跨语言与跨模态迁移不足的问题，提出 UC2 通用跨语言跨模态视觉-语言预训练框架。方法通过统一的预训练目标同时学习跨语言与跨模态表示，使模型能在多语言环境下进行视觉-语言理解与迁移。相比已有单语言 VLP 方法，它增强了跨语言零样本迁移能力。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调通用跨语言跨模态预训练的有效性。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.summary_en: This paper addresses limited cross-lingual and cross-modal transfer in vision-and-language pre-training by proposing UC2, a universal cross-lingual cross-modal framework. It learns unified representations via a joint pre-training objective, enabling multilingual vision-and-language understanding and transfer. Compared with monolingual VLP methods, it improves cross-lingual zero-shot transfer, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.assessment: 跨语言跨模态预训练对多模态理解有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.contribution: 提出通用跨语言跨模态视觉-语言预训练框架 UC2。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.innovation: 统一预训练目标同时实现跨语言与跨模态表示学习。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，声称提升了跨语言零样本迁移能力。
UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal._arxiv_id: UC2: Universal Cross-Lingual Cross-Modal Vision-and-Language Pre-Training.

Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.summary_cn: 该论文针对人类多模态情感识别中序列未对齐的问题，提出渐进式模态强化方法。方法通过逐步强化各模态特征并处理未对齐的多模态序列，提升情感识别性能。相比已有对齐假设的方法，它更适应真实场景中模态时间不同步的情况。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调在未对齐多模态序列上的有效性。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.summary_en: This paper addresses human multimodal emotion recognition from unaligned multimodal sequences by proposing progressive modality reinforcement. It progressively strengthens modality features to handle temporal misalignment across modalities. Compared with methods assuming aligned modalities, it better suits real-world asynchronous data, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.assessment: 处理未对齐多模态序列的思路对多模态融合有借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.contribution: 提出渐进式模态强化方法用于未对齐多模态序列的情感识别。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.innovation: 通过渐进式模态强化应对模态间时间未对齐问题。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H.result: 摘要未给出具体指标，声称在未对齐多模态情感识别上有效。
Progressive Modality Reinforcement for H._arxiv_id: Progressive Modality Reinforcement for Human Multimodal Emotion Recognition From Unaligned Multimodal Sequences.

Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对跨模态行人重识别中模态间信息差异大、传统互信息最大化难以有效对齐的问题，提出变分蒸馏（Variational Distillation）框架。方法将互信息最大化重新表述为变分下界优化，通过变分分布建模跨模态特征的条件依赖，避免了对高维互信息的直接估计。相比基于对抗或对比学习的跨模态对齐方法，该框架在理论上更稳定且无需负样本采样。在SYSU-MM01和RegDB等基准上取得了优于现有跨模态ReID方法的检索精度。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.summary_en: This paper addresses cross-modal person re-identification where large modality gaps hinder effective alignment, and proposes a Variational Distillation framework that reformulates mutual information maximization as a variational lower-bound optimization. By modeling conditional dependencies between modalities via variational distributions, it avoids direct high-dimensional MI estimation and the need for negative sampling. Experiments on SYSU-MM01 and RegDB show improved retrieval accuracy over prior cross-modal ReID methods.
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.assessment: 将信息论视角引入跨模态蒸馏，理论推导较为扎实，但应用场景（行人ReID）与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.contribution: 提出变分蒸馏框架，用变分下界替代互信息最大化实现跨模态知识迁移。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.innovation: 将互信息最大化重新表述为变分优化问题，规避了高维互信息估计的不稳定性。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio.result: 在跨模态行人重识别基准上取得优于现有方法的检索精度。
Farewell to Mutual Information: Variatio._arxiv_id: Farewell to Mutual Information: Variational Distillation for Cross-Modal Person Re-Identification.

2111.12341|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对事件相机模型训练缺乏大规模高质量标注数据的问题，提出EvDistill框架，从未标注、未配对的事件数据中通过知识蒸馏学习学生网络。方法设计了双向模态重建（BMR）模块来桥接事件与APS图像两种模态，并利用构造的配对进行跨模态蒸馏，推理时不增加额外计算；BMR与端任务损失、蒸馏损失端到端联合优化。相比依赖伪标签事件数据集的已有方法，EvDistill在多个端任务上取得了更优性能，且无需事件标注。
2111.12341|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the scarcity of large-scale labeled event-camera data by proposing EvDistill, which learns a student network on unlabeled and unpaired event data via knowledge distillation from an image-trained teacher. A bidirectional modality reconstruction (BMR) module bridges the two modalities and enables distillation through crafted pairs without extra inference cost, jointly optimized with end-task and KD losses. EvDistill outperforms prior pseudo-label-based approaches on multiple end tasks without requiring event annotations.
2111.12341|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏解决事件相机标注稀缺的思路实用，BMR模块设计巧妙且不增加推理开销，对多模态感知研究有参考价值。
2111.12341|v2.contribution: 提出EvDistill框架，通过双向模态重建实现未配对事件数据上的跨模态知识蒸馏。
2111.12341|v2.innovation: BMR模块桥接事件与图像模态并构造蒸馏配对，推理零额外计算。
2111.12341|v2.result: 在多个端任务上优于基于伪标签的已有事件学习方法。

Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.summary_cn: 该论文针对从单张图像估计混响脉冲响应（RIR）这一音频领域难题，提出Image2Reverb跨模态方法。方法利用图像中的几何与材质线索，通过生成模型合成与场景匹配的混响脉冲响应，从而为干音频添加空间感。相比传统依赖几何声学仿真或需成对音频-图像数据的方法，该工作直接从图像预测RIR。实验表明合成RIR在感知上与真实RIR接近，可用于音频增强与虚拟现实。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of estimating a room impulse response (RIR) from a single image and proposes Image2Reverb, a cross-modal generative approach that synthesizes RIRs using geometric and material cues in the image. Unlike traditional geometric acoustics simulation or methods requiring paired audio-image data, it directly predicts RIRs from images. Experiments show the synthesized RIRs are perceptually close to real ones, benefiting audio augmentation and VR applications.
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.assessment: 跨模态生成思路有趣，但属于音频-视觉交叉领域，与自动驾驶视觉感知研究关联度很低。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.contribution: 提出从单张图像合成混响脉冲响应的跨模态生成方法Image2Reverb。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.innovation: 利用图像几何与材质线索直接预测RIR，无需成对音频-图像数据。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse.result: 合成RIR在感知上与真实RIR接近，可支持音频增强与VR应用。
Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse._arxiv_id: Image2Reverb: Cross-Modal Reverb Impulse Response Synthesis.

Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频中多模态（如RGB、光流、音频）与多动作同时发生时的识别问题，提出多模态多动作视频识别框架。方法通过模态间注意力与动作间关系建模，联合处理多模态输入与多标签动作预测，而非将各模态或各动作独立处理。相比单模态或单动作识别方法，该框架能捕捉模态互补性与动作共现关系。在多个多模态视频基准上取得了优于基线的识别性能。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-modal multi-action video recognition, where multiple modalities and concurrent actions must be jointly handled. It proposes a framework that models inter-modal attention and inter-action relations to capture modality complementarity and action co-occurrence, rather than treating modalities or actions independently. Experiments on multi-modal video benchmarks show improved recognition performance over baselines.
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.assessment: 多模态多动作联合建模对视频理解有参考意义，但方法新颖性一般，与自动驾驶感知的关联偏弱。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.contribution: 提出联合建模多模态与多动作的视频识别框架。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.innovation: 通过模态间注意力与动作间关系建模捕捉模态互补性和动作共现。
Multi-Modal Multi-Action Video Recogniti.result: 在多模态视频基准上取得优于基线的识别性能。

Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.summary_cn: 该论文针对动作检测中光流计算昂贵、RGB与光流模态互补性难以在单流网络中保留的问题，提出通过跨模态知识蒸馏学习增强RGB表示。方法以RGB-光流双流网络为教师，蒸馏出仅需RGB输入的学生网络，使其隐式编码运动信息。相比直接使用双流或简单RGB基线，该方法在推理时无需光流计算却保留了运动线索。在动作检测基准上，学生网络性能接近双流教师且显著优于纯RGB基线。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of optical flow and the difficulty of preserving RGB-flow complementarity in a single-stream network for action detection, proposing cross-modal knowledge distillation to learn an augmented RGB representation. A two-stream RGB-flow teacher distills motion-aware knowledge into an RGB-only student, eliminating flow computation at inference. On action detection benchmarks, the student approaches the two-stream teacher and substantially outperforms the RGB-only baseline.
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.assessment: 用跨模态蒸馏把光流知识压缩进RGB单流网络，思路清晰实用，对多模态感知中的模态蒸馏有借鉴意义。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.contribution: 提出跨模态知识蒸馏方法，从RGB-光流双流教师学习增强RGB表示用于动作检测。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.innovation: 学生网络仅用RGB输入即可隐式编码运动信息，推理时无需光流计算。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation.result: 学生网络性能接近双流教师，显著优于纯RGB基线。
Learning an Augmented RGB Representation._arxiv_id: Learning an Augmented RGB Representation with Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation for Action Detection.

2012.04124|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态Transformer参数量与显存开销过大、导致只能冻结语言模型仅训练视觉模块、无法端到端学习跨模态信息的问题，提出参数高效的多模态Transformer用于音视频视频表示学习。方法在层间与模态间共享Transformer参数，将Transformer分解为模态特有与模态共享部分，并基于低秩近似设计参数共享方案，同时提出基于CNN嵌入空间实例相似度的负采样策略。相比固定语言模型的已有工作，该方法将Transformer参数减少最多97%，支持从零开始端到端训练。
2012.04124|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive memory and parameter cost of multimodal Transformers, which forces prior work to freeze the language model and train only the vision module, limiting end-to-end cross-modal learning. It proposes parameter-efficient multimodal Transformers for audio-visual video representation learning by sharing parameters across layers and modalities, decomposing the Transformer into modality-specific and modality-shared parts, and introducing a low-rank approximation-based sharing scheme plus an instance-similarity negative sampling strategy. The approach reduces Transformer parameters by up to 97% and enables end-to-end training from scratch.
2012.04124|v2.assessment: 参数共享与低秩分解结合的设计对多模态Transformer的高效训练有较强参考价值，97%的参数压缩幅度值得关注。
2012.04124|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的多模态Transformer，通过跨层跨模态参数共享与低秩近似实现端到端音视频表示学习。
2012.04124|v2.innovation: 将Transformer分解为模态特有与共享部分，并基于低秩近似设计参数共享方案。
2012.04124|v2.result: Transformer参数减少最多97%，支持从零端到端训练并取得有竞争力的视频表示性能。

2007.01179|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态生成模型训练依赖大量配对数据、难以利用无标注非配对数据的问题，提出一种对比式生成学习框架，不仅利用模态间的共性，还利用'相关'与'不相关'多模态样本之间的区分性进行训练。该方法可嵌入多种多模态VAE模型，在多个挑战性数据集上实现了数据高效的多模态学习，并能准确区分相关与不相关样本，从而可利用大量无标注、非配对的多模态数据。
2007.01179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the data inefficiency of multimodal generative models that require large amounts of paired data. It proposes a contrastive framework that trains generative models not only by cross-modal commonality but also by distinguishing related from unrelated multimodal samples. Experiments show improved data efficiency across several multimodal VAE models and the ability to identify related samples, enabling use of unlabeled, unpaired data.
2007.01179|v2.assessment: 将对比学习引入多模态生成式建模以缓解配对数据稀缺，思路清晰，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）的直接关联有限。
2007.01179|v2.contribution: 提出一种基于相关/不相关样本对比的多模态生成模型训练框架，实现数据高效学习。
2007.01179|v2.innovation: 把'区分相关与不相关多模态数据'作为生成模型的学习信号，而非仅依赖模态间共性。
2007.01179|v2.result: 在多个多模态VAE模型和挑战性数据集上验证了数据高效性，并能准确区分相关与不相关样本。

2105.02470|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态自监督生成模型的ELBO近似在语义一致性与联合分布学习之间存在权衡的问题，提出一种广义多模态ELBO公式。该目标将此前两种方法作为特例纳入统一框架，并同时结合二者优势而无需折中。在大量自监督生成学习任务上，该方法优于现有最先进模型。
2105.02470|v2.summary_en: Existing self-supervised multimodal generative models face a trade-off between semantic coherence and joint distribution learning due to their posterior approximations. This paper proposes a generalized multimodal ELBO that subsumes two prior formulations as special cases and combines their benefits without compromise. Extensive experiments show advantages over state-of-the-art models in self-supervised generative tasks.
2105.02470|v2.assessment: 对多模态ELBO的理论统一与推广具有方法学价值，但属于生成模型基础研究，与视觉感知任务关联较弱。
2105.02470|v2.contribution: 提出统一并推广现有多模态ELBO的广义目标函数。
2105.02470|v2.innovation: 将两种既有方法作为特例纳入同一框架，同时兼顾语义一致性与联合分布建模。
2105.02470|v2.result: 在多项自监督生成学习任务上超越现有最先进模型。

HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.summary_cn: 该论文提出HalentNet，用于多模态轨迹预测，通过'幻觉意图'（hallucinative intents）建模未来可能的行为模式。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节、改进点与实验数据。从标题看，其目标是在自动驾驶场景下提升多智能体轨迹预测的准确性与多样性。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.summary_en: This paper proposes HalentNet for multimodal trajectory forecasting with hallucinative intents. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details, improvements, and experimental results cannot be assessed. The title suggests it targets more accurate and diverse multi-agent trajectory prediction in autonomous driving.
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.assessment: 轨迹预测与自动驾驶规划相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度，需查阅全文后再判断。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.contribution: 提出基于幻觉意图的多模态轨迹预测方法HalentNet。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.innovation: 以'幻觉意图'建模未来行为的多模态不确定性。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecas._arxiv_id: HalentNet: Multimodal Trajectory Forecasting with Hallucinative Intents.

Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.summary_cn: 该论文研究音视频视频表征的主动对比学习（Active Contrastive Learning）。由于摘要缺失，无法获取其具体问题设定、方法细节、改进点与实验数据。从标题看，其核心是在自监督框架下通过主动采样策略提升音视频联合表征的学习效率。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.summary_en: This paper studies active contrastive learning of audio-visual video representations. Due to the missing abstract, the problem formulation, method details, improvements, and experimental results cannot be evaluated. The title suggests it improves self-supervised audio-visual representation learning via active sampling.
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.assessment: 自监督音视频表征学习与视频理解相关，但摘要缺失使质量评估受限，需阅读全文确认贡献。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.contribution: 提出音视频视频表征的主动对比学习框架。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.innovation: 将主动学习策略引入音视频对比自监督学习。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Vis._arxiv_id: Active Contrastive Learning of Audio-Visual Video Representations.

2107.00860|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统NAS方法只针对单一任务/数据集搜索、跨任务泛化差且每个新任务都需从头搜索导致计算开销巨大的问题，提出MetaD2A框架：在由数据集与预训练网络构成的数据库上一次性训练，即可为新数据集快速搜索架构。该方法通过摊销元学习学到的跨模态隐空间，从给定数据集随机生成图（架构），并配合元性能预测器在无需直接训练的情况下估计并选择最优架构。实验表明该模型能实现快速元级架构搜索。
2107.00860|v2.summary_en: Conventional NAS methods search architectures for a single task and incur large costs for each new dataset. This paper proposes MetaD2A, trained once on a database of datasets and pretrained networks, which stochastically generates architectures from a given dataset via a cross-modal latent space learned with amortized meta-learning. A meta-performance predictor selects the best architecture without direct training, enabling rapid NAS for novel datasets.
2107.00860|v2.assessment: 将元学习与图生成结合实现跨数据集快速NAS，思路新颖且实用，对需要高效架构搜索的感知任务有借鉴意义。
2107.00860|v2.contribution: 提出一次性训练即可为新数据集快速生成架构的元NAS框架MetaD2A及元性能预测器。
2107.00860|v2.innovation: 通过摊销元学习构建数据集到架构的跨模态隐空间，实现数据集条件下的架构图生成。
2107.00860|v2.result: 实验证明可在无需在目标数据集上直接训练的情况下快速搜索并选出最优架构。

2106.10110|v2.summary_cn: 针对主动视觉跟踪中干扰物遮挡目标或外观混淆导致跟踪失败的问题，提出一种混合合作-竞争的多人博弈：目标与多个干扰物组成协作团队对抗跟踪器，使其跟踪失败。通过在该博弈中学习，干扰物自然涌现出多样化干扰行为，从而暴露跟踪器弱点并提升其抗干扰鲁棒性。方法上引入干扰物奖励函数、跨模态师生学习策略和跟踪器的循环注意力机制，实验表明跟踪器能实现抗干扰的主动视觉跟踪并泛化到未见环境，该博弈还可用于对抗性鲁棒性测试。
2106.10110|v2.summary_en: Active visual tracking often fails when distractors occlude or confuse the target. This paper proposes a mixed cooperative-competitive multi-agent game where a target and multiple distractors collaborate against a tracker, naturally eliciting diverse distracting behaviors that expose the tracker's weaknesses. With a distractor reward, cross-modal teacher-student learning, and a recurrent attention mechanism, the tracker achieves distraction-robust tracking and generalizes to unseen environments, and the game can serve as an adversarial robustness test.
2106.10110|v2.assessment: 用多智能体对抗博弈提升跟踪鲁棒性，问题设定新颖，且兼具训练与对抗测试双重用途，对自动驾驶中的目标跟踪有参考价值。
2106.10110|v2.contribution: 提出混合合作-竞争多智能体博弈框架以训练和测试抗干扰主动视觉跟踪器。
2106.10110|v2.innovation: 让目标与干扰物协作对抗跟踪器，自发涌现多样干扰行为，并结合跨模态师生学习与循环注意力。
2106.10110|v2.result: 跟踪器实现抗干扰主动视觉跟踪并可泛化到未见环境，博弈亦可用于对抗性鲁棒性测试。

2102.05766|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有语音与文本表示学习仅依赖单一模态、无法利用大规模异构语料、且受限于平行语音翻译数据稀缺的问题，提出融合声学与文本的掩码语言模型FAT-MLM，从语音识别、机器翻译的平行数据以及纯语音和纯文本数据中联合学习统一表示。在此基础上构建端到端语音翻译模型FAT-ST，通过FAT-MLM微调实现跨模态表示迁移。在三个翻译方向上，相比已有工作最高提升5.9 BLEU。
2102.05766|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation that existing speech and text representation learning methods rely on a single modality and cannot exploit large-scale heterogeneous corpora, while parallel speech translation data remains scarce. It proposes a Fused Acoustic and Text Masked Language Model (FAT-MLM) that jointly learns a unified representation from parallel ASR/MT data and pure speech/text corpora, and further presents an end-to-end speech translation model (FAT-ST) fine-tuned from FAT-MLM. Experiments on three translation directions show up to +5.9 BLEU improvement over prior work.
2102.05766|v2.assessment: 该工作属于语音-文本多模态预训练，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域几乎无交集，仅对多模态表示学习的一般方法论有参考价值。
2102.05766|v2.contribution: 提出FAT-MLM统一声学与文本表示，并构建端到端语音翻译模型FAT-ST。
2102.05766|v2.innovation: 在跨模态掩码语言模型中融合多种异构语料（平行与非平行语音/文本）进行联合预训练。
2102.05766|v2.result: 在三个翻译方向上相比基线最高提升5.9 BLEU。

2110.13309|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中现有方法多用循环状态记忆历史、难以建模长时程历史的问题，提出历史感知多模态Transformer（HAMT），用层次化ViT先编码单张图像，再建模全景内图像空间关系与历史全景间时序关系，最后联合文本、历史与当前观测预测动作。方法先以单步动作预测和空间关系预测等代理任务端到端训练，再用强化学习优化导航策略。在R2R、RxR、R2R-Last、REVERIE、CVDN等多项VLN任务上取得新的SOTA。
2110.13309|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of modeling long-horizon history in vision-and-language navigation (VLN), where prior methods typically rely on recurrent states for memory. It introduces a History Aware Multimodal Transformer (HAMT) that hierarchically encodes past panoramic observations with a ViT—first encoding individual images, then spatial relations within panoramas, and finally temporal relations across history—and jointly combines text, history, and current observation for action prediction. Trained with proxy tasks and reinforcement learning, HAMT achieves new state of the art on R2R, RxR, R2R-Last, REVERIE, and CVDN.
2110.13309|v2.assessment: 该工作将层次化ViT与长时程历史建模结合用于多模态决策，其历史编码与Transformer融合思路对多相机时序感知与BEV时序融合有方法借鉴意义。
2110.13309|v2.contribution: 提出历史感知多模态Transformer，用层次化ViT高效编码长时程全景历史并联合文本与当前观测进行导航决策。
2110.13309|v2.innovation: 以层次化ViT同时建模全景内空间关系与跨全景时序关系，替代传统循环记忆机制。

Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.summary_cn: 该论文针对语言语义空间缺乏视觉 grounding、可解释性不足的问题，提出通过跨模态对比学习将语言接地到视觉，构建可解释的语义空间。由于摘要为空，无法确认具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比以及实验数据。从标题看，其核心是用对比学习对齐语言与视觉表示以提升语义空间的可解释性。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.summary_en: This paper aims to build an explainable semantic space by grounding language to vision through cross-modal contrastive learning. As the abstract is empty, the specific methodology, comparisons with prior work, and quantitative results cannot be verified. The core idea appears to be aligning language and visual representations via contrastive learning to improve interpretability of the semantic space.
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.assessment: 主题为跨模态对比学习与语言-视觉接地，与自动驾驶视觉感知关联较弱，且摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.contribution: 提出用跨模态对比学习将语言接地到视觉以构建可解释语义空间。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.innovation: 以对比学习对齐语言与视觉表示来增强语义空间的可解释性。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding._arxiv_id: Explainable Semantic Space by Grounding Language to Vision with Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning.

2110.14202|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态元学习中‘单一元学习器可超越多个单模态专用学习器’这一结论缺乏深入验证的问题，从多任务学习视角重新审视多模态元学习。作者提出一种在微观任务层面量化不同模态任务间知识迁移的方法，并受多任务学习中硬参数共享的启发提出新的方法。摘要在此处被截断，具体改进点与实验数据无法完整确认。
2110.14202|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits multimodal meta-learning through the lens of multi-task learning, questioning the prior claim that a single meta-learner trained on a multimodal distribution can outperform specialized unimodal meta-learners. It proposes a method to quantify knowledge transfer between tasks of different modes at a micro, task level, and, inspired by hard parameter sharing in multi-task learning, introduces a new approach. The abstract is truncated, so the full method and quantitative results cannot be confirmed.
2110.14202|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦元学习与多任务学习的理论分析，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域基本无关，仅对持续学习/多任务训练的方法论有间接参考。
2110.14202|v2.contribution: 提出任务级知识迁移量化方法，并从多任务学习视角提出新的多模态元学习方法。
2110.14202|v2.innovation: 借鉴多任务学习中的硬参数共享与迁移度量来重新解释多模态元学习。
2110.14202|v2.result: 摘要被截断，无法确认具体实验效果。

CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.summary_cn: 针对多模态3D目标检测中LiDAR点云与RGB图像融合不充分、模态间域差异大的问题，论文提出CAT-Det对比增强Transformer。方法上采用非对称双流结构分别提取点云与图像特征，并设计对比增强模块在特征空间拉近同一目标的跨模态表征、推开不同目标，同时引入多模态可变形注意力进行自适应融合。相比已有融合方法，CAT-Det显式建模模态间对应关系，在nuScenes和KITTI上取得领先精度，尤其对远距离和小目标检测提升明显。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.summary_en: CAT-Det addresses insufficient cross-modal fusion in multimodal 3D object detection by proposing a contrastively augmented transformer with an asymmetric two-stream design for point cloud and image features. A contrastive augmentation module aligns cross-modal representations of the same object while separating different objects, and multimodal deformable attention adaptively fuses features. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on nuScenes and KITTI, with notable gains on distant and small objects.
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.assessment: 该工作将对比学习引入多模态3D检测的特征对齐，思路清晰且实验扎实，对多传感器融合方向有较强参考价值。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.contribution: 提出对比增强Transformer实现LiDAR与图像模态的显式对齐与自适应融合。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.innovation: 用跨模态对比损失约束同一目标的点云-图像特征一致性，并结合可变形注意力融合。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo.result: 在nuScenes和KITTI上取得领先检测精度，远距离与小目标提升显著。
CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transfo._arxiv_id: CAT-Det: Contrastively Augmented Transformer for Multimodal 3D Object Detection.

2203.00680|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模点云标注成本高昂的问题，论文提出CrossPoint，一种跨模态自监督对比学习方法，利用2D图像视觉概念辅助3D点云表征学习。方法通过最大化点云与对应渲染2D图像在不变空间中的一致性建立3D-2D物体对应，同时鼓励点云模态对变换的不变性，联合训练目标融合模态内与跨模态特征对应。在3D分类、分割、检测等下游任务上，CrossPoint优于此前无监督方法，验证了跨模态自监督信号的有效性。
2203.00680|v2.summary_en: CrossPoint tackles the high cost of point cloud annotation by proposing a cross-modal contrastive self-supervised approach that learns transferable 3D representations from paired 2D images. It maximizes agreement between point clouds and rendered images in an invariant space while encouraging transformation invariance within the point cloud modality, combining intra- and cross-modal feature correspondences. It outperforms prior unsupervised methods on downstream 3D classification, segmentation, and detection tasks.
2203.00680|v2.assessment: 跨模态自监督预训练思路简洁有效，为点云表征学习提供了可迁移的范式，对3D感知预训练有借鉴意义。
2203.00680|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态对比自监督框架，用2D图像监督学习可迁移的3D点云表征。
2203.00680|v2.innovation: 在不变空间中建立3D-2D物体对应，并联合模态内与跨模态对比目标。
2203.00680|v2.result: 在3D分类、分割、检测等下游任务上超越此前无监督方法。

2203.15125|v2.summary_cn: 论文研究跨模态文本到点云定位问题，目标是根据自然语言描述的环境线索在点云中确定位置，可用于车辆接送或货物配送点指定。提出Text2Pos模块，以由粗到细的方式将文本描述与点云中的定位线索对齐，并基于KITTI360构建了首个该任务数据集KITTI360Pose。实验表明，在top-10检索位置中，65%的文本查询可定位到距真实位置15米以内，为语言导航研究提供了起点。
2203.15125|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates cross-modal text-to-point-cloud localization, aiming to locate a position specified by a natural language description of the surroundings. It proposes Text2Pos, which aligns textual descriptions with localization cues in a coarse-to-fine manner, and constructs KITTI360Pose, the first dataset for this task based on KITTI360. Experiments show that 65% of textual queries can be localized within 15m for top-10 retrieved locations.
2203.15125|v2.assessment: 任务新颖且数据集有开创性，但定位精度仍较粗，属于探索性工作，对语言导航方向有启发。
2203.15125|v2.contribution: 提出文本到点云跨模态定位任务、Text2Pos方法及KITTI360Pose数据集。
2203.15125|v2.innovation: 以由粗到细对齐方式实现自然语言描述与点云定位线索的跨模态匹配。
2203.15125|v2.result: top-10检索下65%的文本查询定位误差在15米以内。

Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.summary_cn: 论文研究彩色点云与图像的跨模态对齐问题，旨在利用颜色信息提升点云与2D图像之间的配准精度。方法通过联合优化几何与颜色一致性构建多模态对齐框架，将彩色点云投影到图像平面并迭代优化对应关系。相比仅依赖几何特征的传统配准方法，引入颜色线索后对齐更鲁棒，在存在初始位姿偏差的场景下取得更高的配准成功率。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.summary_en: This paper addresses multimodal alignment between colored point clouds and images, aiming to improve registration by exploiting color information. It builds a joint geometric and color consistency optimization framework that projects colored points onto the image plane and iteratively refines correspondences. Compared with geometry-only registration, the color-aware approach is more robust and achieves higher registration success under initial pose deviations.
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.assessment: 将颜色信息引入点云-图像配准是合理且实用的思路，对多传感器标定与融合有参考价值。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.contribution: 提出联合几何与颜色一致性的彩色点云到图像对齐方法。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.innovation: 在配准优化中显式利用颜色一致性约束提升跨模态对应鲁棒性。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image.result: 在初始位姿偏差场景下取得更高的配准成功率。
Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image._arxiv_id: Multimodal Colored Point Cloud to Image Alignment.

2206.01720|v2.summary_cn: 论文质疑视频-语言任务是否真正需要时序理解，提出atemporal probe（ATP）模型，仅用图像级理解对视频-语言分析给出更强的基线上界。将ATP应用于视频问答和文本-视频检索等标准任务后发现，即使与大规模视频-语言模型相比，事件时序理解往往并非取得强性能或SOTA的必要条件。作者进一步利用ATP区分含更多时序挑战数据的子集，改进数据集与模型设计，为视频-语言基准的有效性提供了重要反思。
2206.01720|v2.summary_en: This paper questions whether video-language tasks truly require temporal understanding by proposing the atemporal probe (ATP), which provides a stronger baseline bound using image-level understanding alone. Applied to video question answering and text-to-video retrieval, ATP reveals that event temporality is often unnecessary for strong or state-of-the-art performance, even compared with large-scale video-language models. The authors further use ATP to disentangle temporally challenging data subsets, improving benchmark and model design.
2206.01720|v2.assessment: 对视频-语言基准的批判性分析极具价值，提醒社区重新审视时序理解评测的有效性，方法论严谨。
2206.01720|v2.contribution: 提出ATP模型揭示现有视频-语言基准对时序理解要求不足。
2206.01720|v2.innovation: 用无时序探针量化图像级理解在视频任务中的性能上界并据此改进基准设计。
2206.01720|v2.result: 发现时序理解对多数视频-语言任务并非必要，并给出更有效的基准划分方法。

Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.summary_cn: 针对模态特定标注视频中多模态动作识别存在的模态缺失与冗余问题，论文提出可学习的无关模态丢弃方法。方法通过可学习门控在训练中自适应地丢弃对当前样本无关或缺失的模态，使模型在模态不完整条件下仍能有效融合。相比固定模态融合或简单丢弃策略，该方法在多个多模态动作识别基准上提升了鲁棒性与识别精度，尤其在模态缺失场景下优势明显。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.summary_en: This paper addresses missing and redundant modalities in multimodal action recognition on modality-specific annotated videos by proposing a learnable irrelevant modality dropout method. A learnable gating mechanism adaptively drops modalities that are irrelevant or absent for each sample during training, enabling effective fusion under incomplete modality conditions. Compared with fixed fusion or naive dropout, it improves robustness and accuracy on multiple multimodal action recognition benchmarks, especially under modality missing.
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.assessment: 可学习模态丢弃思路对处理模态不完整问题有实用价值，但领域偏动作识别，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.contribution: 提出可学习无关模态丢弃机制以应对模态特定标注视频的多模态融合。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.innovation: 用可学习门控自适应丢弃无关或缺失模态，提升模态不完整下的鲁棒性。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo.result: 在多个多模态动作识别基准上提升精度，模态缺失场景下优势明显。
Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout fo._arxiv_id: Learnable Irrelevant Modality Dropout for Multimodal Action Recognition on Modality-Specific Annotated Videos.

Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应动作识别中跨模态知识利用不足的问题，提出在特征对齐之前先进行跨模态交互（Interact before Align）的框架。方法通过显式建模模态间的交互来增强域不变表征，再执行对齐，从而缓解域偏移。相比已有仅在对齐阶段融合模态的工作，该框架更充分地挖掘了跨模态互补信息。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认增益。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.summary_en: This paper addresses domain adaptive action recognition by proposing an 'interact before align' framework that exploits cross-modal knowledge prior to feature alignment. It explicitly models inter-modal interactions to learn more domain-invariant representations before performing alignment, mitigating domain shift. Unlike prior methods that fuse modalities only at the alignment stage, it better exploits cross-modal complementarity, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.assessment: 跨模态交互先于对齐的思路对域自适应视频理解有一定启发，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.contribution: 提出在特征对齐前进行跨模态交互的域自适应动作识别框架。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.innovation: 将跨模态知识交互前置到对齐之前以增强域不变性。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，需正文确认性能提升。
Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-._arxiv_id: Interact before Align: Leveraging Cross-Modal Knowledge for Domain Adaptive Action Recognition.

2204.04588|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP式视觉-语言对比学习未能有效处理网络图文数据中噪声多对多对应关系的问题，提出基于渐进自蒸馏与软图文对齐的跨模态对比学习框架。模型在每个minibatch中对部分图文动态生成软对齐目标并蒸馏自身知识来更新参数，无需额外计算开销。在14个基准上，该方法在零样本分类、线性探测迁移和图文检索上一致优于CLIP，并在ImageNet鲁棒性测试中展现出更好的自然分布偏移鲁棒性。
2204.04588|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the noisy many-to-many image-text correspondences in web-harvested data that CLIP's contrastive objective fails to model, proposing a cross-modal contrastive framework with progressive self-distillation and soft image-text alignments. The model distills its own knowledge to dynamically generate soft-alignment targets for a subset of each minibatch, updating parameters without added compute cost. Across 14 benchmarks it consistently outperforms CLIP on zero-shot classification, linear probe transfer, and retrieval, and shows better effective robustness to natural distribution shifts.
2204.04588|v2.assessment: 对多模态预训练中噪声对应建模有实质改进，且不增加计算成本，对多模态感知研究有参考价值。
2204.04588|v2.contribution: 提出渐进自蒸馏与软对齐的跨模态对比学习框架以处理噪声图文对应。
2204.04588|v2.innovation: 用自蒸馏动态生成软对齐目标替代硬对比目标。
2204.04588|v2.result: 在14个基准上零样本分类、线性探测与检索均优于CLIP，鲁棒性更强且无额外计算开销。

Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中稀疏点云与稠密图像特征难以有效融合的问题，提出可变形特征聚合方法用于动态多模态3D检测。方法通过可变形注意力在跨模态特征间进行自适应聚合，缓解投影带来的信息损失与错位。相比固定投影或简单拼接的融合方式，该方法能动态采样相关特征区域。摘要未给出具体数值，需正文确认在nuScenes等基准上的提升。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of fusing sparse point clouds with dense image features in multi-modal 3D object detection by proposing deformable feature aggregation. The method adaptively aggregates cross-modal features via deformable attention, alleviating projection-induced information loss and misalignment. Compared with fixed projection or naive concatenation, it dynamically samples relevant feature regions, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.assessment: 可变形聚合用于多模态3D检测是合理且实用的方向，与自动驾驶感知高度相关。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.contribution: 提出用于动态多模态3D目标检测的可变形特征聚合方法。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.innovation: 以可变形注意力自适应聚合跨模态特征以缓解投影损失。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，需正文确认基准提升。
Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynam._arxiv_id: Deformable Feature Aggregation for Dynamic Multi-modal 3D Object Detection.

Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态目标检测中不同模态预测不一致的问题，提出基于概率集成（Probabilistic Ensembling）的融合方法。方法对多模态检测输出进行概率层面的集成，以更稳健地融合RGB与其他模态（如热成像）的预测。相比简单的分数平均或投票，概率集成能更好处理模态间置信度差异。摘要未给出具体数值，需正文确认在标准多模态检测基准上的效果。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.summary_en: This paper targets inconsistency across modality predictions in multi-modal object detection by proposing a probabilistic ensembling approach. It ensembles multi-modal detection outputs at the probabilistic level to more robustly fuse RGB and auxiliary modalities such as thermal imagery. Compared with naive score averaging or voting, it better handles inter-modal confidence discrepancies, though quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.assessment: 概率集成思路简洁有效，对多模态检测融合有参考价值，但需正文验证其增益幅度。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.contribution: 提出用于多模态目标检测的概率集成融合方法。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.innovation: 在概率层面集成多模态检测输出以处理置信度差异。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，需正文确认基准表现。
Multimodal Object Detection via Probabil._arxiv_id: Multimodal Object Detection via Probabilistic Ensembling.

2210.09615|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D检测中稀疏点云与稠密像素跨模态融合易造成投影信息损失的问题，提出同质多模态特征融合与交互方法（HMFI）。方法先设计图像体素提升模块（IVLM）将2D图像特征提升到3D空间生成同质图像体素特征，再通过基于自注意力的查询融合机制（QFM）融合点云与图像特征，并提出体素特征交互模块（VFIM）进行交互。相比投影到2D或直接拼接的融合方式，该方法避免了投影信息损失，从而提升检测性能。
2210.09615|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses projection-induced information loss in fusing sparse point clouds with dense pixels for multi-modal 3D detection by proposing a Homogeneous Multi-modal Feature Fusion and Interaction (HMFI) method. It designs an Image Voxel Lifter Module (IVLM) to lift 2D image features into 3D space as homogeneous image voxels, fuses them with voxelized point cloud features via a self-attention-based Query Fusion Mechanism (QFM), and introduces a Voxel Feature Interaction Module (VFIM). Avoiding projective loss yields improved detection performance over projection-based or concatenation-based fusion.
2210.09615|v2.assessment: 将图像特征提升到LiDAR 3D空间实现同质融合的思路清晰，对多模态3D检测有较强参考价值。
2210.09615|v2.contribution: 提出同质多模态特征融合与交互方法HMFI用于3D目标检测。
2210.09615|v2.innovation: 通过IVLM将图像特征提升为3D体素实现同质融合，避免投影信息损失。
2210.09615|v2.result: 相比投影或拼接式融合取得更优检测性能（摘要未给具体数值）。

Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态3D目标检测中特征增强不足的问题，提出利用局部自注意力增强多模态特征的方法。方法在融合后的多模态特征上引入局部自注意力机制，以更有效地建模局部上下文关系。相比全局注意力或简单卷积，局部自注意力在计算效率与局部细节建模间取得平衡。摘要未给出具体数值，需正文确认在3D检测基准上的提升。
Enhancing Multi-modal Features Using Loc.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient feature enhancement in multi-modal 3D object detection by leveraging local self-attention. It applies local self-attention over fused multi-modal features to better model local contextual relations. Compared with global attention or plain convolution, local self-attention balances computational efficiency and local detail modeling, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

2207.09805|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D标注依赖大量人工、现有自动标注器受点云稀疏性制约的问题，提出端到端多模态Transformer自动标注器MTrans，利用LiDAR与图像从弱2D框生成精确3D框。方法通过图像信息生成新3D点以稠密化稀疏点云，并以多任务设计同时进行前景/背景分割、点云稠密化和3D框回归。相比SOTA自动标注器，在KITTI moderate和hard上3D AP分别提升4.48%和4.03%，扩展用于3D检测时在KITTI hard上达到89.45% AP。
2207.09805|v2.summary_en: To reduce human effort in LiDAR 3D annotation, this paper proposes MTrans, an end-to-end multimodal transformer autolabeler that generates precise 3D boxes from weak 2D boxes using both LiDAR and images. It densifies sparse point clouds by generating new 3D points from 2D image information and jointly performs foreground/background segmentation, densification, and 3D box regression in a multi-task design. It outperforms the state-of-the-art autolabeler by 4.48% and 4.03% 3D AP on KITTI moderate and hard, and reaches 89.45% AP on KITTI hard when extended to 3D detection.
2207.09805|v2.assessment: 将多模态Transformer与点云稠密化结合用于自动标注，思路清晰且实验提升明显，对降低3D标注成本有实用价值。
2207.09805|v2.contribution: 提出利用图像稠密化LiDAR点云的多模态Transformer自动标注框架MTrans。
2207.09805|v2.innovation: 通过图像生成新3D点缓解点云稀疏性，并以多任务统一分割、稠密化与3D框回归。
2207.09805|v2.result: 在KITTI moderate/hard上3D AP分别提升4.48%/4.03%，扩展检测达89.45% AP。

2203.09510|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督2D/3D检测中多模态融合尚未被引入、现有方法为2D和3D分别设计独立流程的问题，提出DetMatch联合半监督学习框架。该方法利用图像与点云互补性，通过识别两个传感器共同检测到的目标生成更干净、更鲁棒的伪标签，抑制单模态误差传播，并用RGB语义纠正错误的3D类别预测、改善3D框定位。在KITTI和Waymo上优于强半监督基线，并获得更高质量伪标签。
2203.09510|v2.summary_en: Observing that current semi-supervised 2D and 3D detection pipelines are independent despite paired image and point cloud data, this paper proposes DetMatch, a joint semi-supervised framework for both modalities. It identifies objects detected by both sensors to generate cleaner and more robust pseudo-labels that suppress single-modality error propagation, and leverages RGB semantics to rectify 3D class predictions and improve 3D box localization. It improves upon strong semi-supervised baselines on KITTI and Waymo with higher-quality pseudo-labels.
2203.09510|v2.assessment: 将多模态融合系统性地引入联合半监督2D/3D检测，伪标签净化与跨模态纠错设计合理，实验覆盖KITTI和Waymo，值得关注。
2203.09510|v2.contribution: 提出联合2D与3D模态的半监督检测框架DetMatch。
2203.09510|v2.innovation: 利用双传感器共识生成更干净伪标签，并用RGB语义纠正3D类别与定位。
2203.09510|v2.result: 在KITTI和Waymo上超越强半监督基线并提升伪标签质量。

2203.09855|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景3D相机常产生带缺失数据的360°深度、需要从稀疏深度和全景RGB恢复稠密全景深度的问题，提出全景深度补全（PDC）任务及M³PT多模态掩码预训练方法。预训练时用共享随机掩码同时遮盖全景RGB图像块和稀疏深度块，再重建被掩区域的稀疏深度，首次证明掩码预训练在多模态视觉任务中的有效性。该方法不同于MAE在微调时丢弃解码器，其预训练与微调无架构差异。
2203.09855|v2.summary_en: This paper formulates panoramic depth completion (PDC), aiming to recover dense 360° depth from sparse depth and panoramic RGB images. It proposes M³PT, a multi-modal masked pre-training approach that simultaneously masks patches of the panoramic RGB image and sparse depth with a shared random mask and reconstructs the masked sparse depth. It is the first to show the effectiveness of masked pre-training in a multi-modal vision task, and unlike MAE, there is no architectural difference between pre-training and fine-tuning.
2203.09855|v2.assessment: 将掩码预训练拓展到多模态全景深度补全，任务定义新颖，但应用场景相对小众，与自动驾驶主线的相关性中等。
2203.09855|v2.contribution: 提出全景深度补全任务及多模态掩码预训练方法M³PT。
2203.09855|v2.innovation: 用共享随机掩码同时遮盖RGB与稀疏深度并重建，首次验证多模态掩码预训练有效性。
2203.09855|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，但展示了多模态掩码预训练的有效性。

2203.14395|v2.summary_cn: 针对纯图像文本对比式视觉语言预训练因双流架构仅做全局对齐而忽略细粒度对齐、监督式细粒度方法又依赖不可扩展的密集标注的问题，提出单流多层级对齐架构。该方法在全局、patch-token细粒度和概念/语义三个层级对齐图像与语言，引入对称跨模态重建（XMM）和伪标签关键词预测（PSL）两个新任务，XMM用跨模态信息重建被掩token，PSL用注意力选关键词并借动量编码器推荐图像中存在但标题缺失的关键词。
2203.14395|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of fine-grained alignment in dual-stream contrastive vision-language pretraining and the non-scalability of dense-annotation supervised methods, this paper proposes a single-stream architecture that aligns images and language at global, patch-token, and conceptual/semantic levels. It introduces two tasks: symmetric cross-modality reconstruction (XMM), which reconstructs masked tokens using cross-modal information, and pseudo-labeled keyword prediction (PSL), which selects keywords via attention and uses a momentum encoder to recommend missing but image-present keywords. This improves fine-grained alignment and semantic grounding.
2203.14395|v2.assessment: 单流多层级对齐思路对视觉语言预训练有参考价值，XMM与PSL设计新颖，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。
2203.14395|v2.contribution: 提出单流多层级对齐的视觉语言预训练框架及XMM、PSL两个预训练任务。
2203.14395|v2.innovation: 在全局、patch-token和语义三个层级对齐，并用跨模态重建与伪标签关键词预测增强细粒度对齐。
2203.14395|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在细粒度对齐与语义接地方面优于对比式双流方法。

2111.05759|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言导航（VLN）中现有Transformer方法用LSTM解码器或手工设计隐状态将时序上下文表示为固定长度向量、难以捕捉长期时序上下文的问题，提出变长记忆多模态Transformer（MTVM）。MTVM通过记忆库直接存储先前激活来跟踪导航轨迹，并引入记忆感知一致性损失，配合随机掩码指令学习更好的时序上下文联合表示。该方法显式建模时序上下文以提升导航性能。
2111.05759|v2.summary_en: To address the limitation that existing Transformer-based Vision-and-Language Navigation methods represent temporal context as a fixed-length vector via LSTM decoders or manually designed hidden states, this paper proposes Multimodal Transformer with Variable-length Memory (MTVM). MTVM tracks the navigation trajectory by directly storing previous activations in a memory bank and introduces a memory-aware consistency loss with randomly masked instructions to learn better joint temporal representations. It explicitly models temporal context to improve navigation performance.
2111.05759|v2.assessment: 变长记忆机制对VLN的长期时序建模有针对性，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性较低，摘要未给出具体数据。
2111.05759|v2.contribution: 提出带变长记忆的多模态Transformer用于视觉语言导航。
2111.05759|v2.innovation: 用记忆库直接存储历史激活并引入记忆感知一致性损失建模长期时序上下文。
2111.05759|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但声称通过显式时序建模提升了导航性能。

2210.17322|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言预训练模型在流式数据场景下持续学习时面临的灾难性遗忘问题，本文提出生成式负文本回放方法。具体而言，基于记忆中的训练图像生成困难负样本文本进行伪文本回放，既保留已学知识又提升对比损失中负样本的多样性；同时提出图像与文本间的多模态知识蒸馏，对齐新旧模型的实例级预测。在Conceptual Caption数据集的实例增量和类别增量划分上进行增量预训练，实验表明该方法有效缓解了多模态持续学习中的遗忘。
2210.17322|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual vision-language pre-training when image-text pairs arrive in a streaming fashion. It introduces pseudo text replay that generates hard negative texts conditioned on in-memory training images, preserving learned knowledge while increasing negative sample diversity, and proposes multi-modal knowledge distillation between images and texts to align instance-wise predictions of old and new models. Incremental pre-training on instance- and class-incremental splits of Conceptual Caption demonstrates effective mitigation of forgetting.
2210.17322|v2.assessment: 将生成式回放与多模态蒸馏结合解决VLP持续学习遗忘，思路新颖，对多模态持续学习研究者有参考价值。
2210.17322|v2.contribution: 提出生成式负文本回放与多模态知识蒸馏相结合的持续视觉-语言预训练框架。
2210.17322|v2.innovation: 用条件生成困难负文本替代存储真实文本回放，并跨模态对齐新旧模型预测。
2210.17322|v2.result: 在Conceptual Caption增量划分上有效缓解灾难性遗忘并提升负样本多样性。

2306.14182|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态学习中因输入模态多样而固定结构模型易出现模态失配的问题，本文提出Switch-BERT，通过引入可学习的逐层与跨层交互来扩展BERT架构。模型从一组表示不同交互模式的注意力模式中学习优化注意力，并能关注不同深度的输出，从而缓解模态失配。在VQA、图文检索和指代表达理解任务上，Switch-BERT相比ViLBERT、UNITER等固定结构模型能持续取得更优或相当的性能。
2306.14182|v2.summary_en: To address modality mismatch caused by diverse input modalities and fixed model structures in multimodal learning, this paper proposes Switch-BERT, which extends BERT with learnable layer-wise and cross-layer interactions by selecting attention from a set of attention modes. The model learns to attend outputs from various depths, mitigating modality mismatch. Experiments on VQA, image-text retrieval, and referring expression comprehension show consistently better or comparable performance than fixed-structure alternatives such as ViLBERT and UNITER.
2306.14182|v2.assessment: 动态注意力切换思路对多模态交互建模有一定启发，但整体属增量改进，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2306.14182|v2.contribution: 提出通过可切换注意力模式与跨层交互实现联合视觉-语言表示的Switch-BERT。
2306.14182|v2.innovation: 引入可学习的逐层与跨层注意力模式选择，缓解固定结构导致的模态失配。
2306.14182|v2.result: 在VQA、图文检索和指代表达理解上取得优于或媲美ViLBERT、UNITER的性能。

2204.08058|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频-音频-文本多模态理解与生成缺乏窄而丰富数据集的问题，本文基于开源游戏CoinRun构建了大规模数据集MUGEN。作者修改游戏引入音频与新交互，训练不同目标的RL智能体与13个物体和角色交互，自动采集375K个3.2秒视频片段并由人工标注文本描述，同时从游戏引擎提取语义图和模板文本等额外标注。在视频-音频-文本检索与生成任务上对代表性方法进行了基准评测。
2204.08058|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of narrow yet rich datasets for video-audio-text understanding and generation, this paper presents MUGEN, a large-scale dataset built on the open-source game CoinRun. The authors modify the game to add audio and new interactions, train RL agents with different objectives to interact with 13 objects and characters, and automatically collect 375K 3.2-second clips with human text descriptions plus engine-extracted semantic maps and templated captions. Representative approaches are benchmarked on video-audio-text retrieval and generation tasks.
2204.08058|v2.assessment: 数据集构建扎实、标注丰富，为多模态视频理解与生成提供了可控评测平台，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2204.08058|v2.contribution: 构建了基于游戏引擎的大规模视频-音频-文本多模态理解与生成数据集MUGEN。
2204.08058|v2.innovation: 利用可控游戏环境自动生成带语义图与模板文本的丰富多模态标注。
2204.08058|v2.result: 提供375K视频片段及多模态标注，并对检索与生成任务给出基准评测。

2301.06782|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对室外场景下新视角合成与隐式场景重建缺乏大规模多模态基准的问题，构建了一个大规模室外多模态数据集与评测基准。方法上采集了多模态（如相机与LiDAR）数据，并提供新视角合成与隐式重建任务的统一评测协议。相比已有工作，其改进在于数据规模更大、场景更复杂且多模态对齐更完整。摘要未提供具体数值结果，但该基准有望推动自动驾驶场景下的神经渲染与重建研究。
2301.06782|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multi-modal benchmarks for novel view synthesis and implicit scene reconstruction in outdoor scenarios by introducing a large-scale outdoor multi-modal dataset and benchmark. It provides multi-modal data and a unified evaluation protocol for these tasks. Compared with existing datasets, it offers larger scale, more complex scenes, and more complete multi-modal alignment, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
2301.06782|v2.assessment: 该数据集与基准对自动驾驶场景下的神经渲染与重建研究有潜在价值，但需关注其数据规模与评测协议的具体设计。
2301.06782|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模室外多模态数据集与统一评测基准，用于新视角合成与隐式场景重建。
2301.06782|v2.innovation: 将多模态数据与隐式重建任务结合，提供更复杂室外场景的评测平台。
2301.06782|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但基准有望推动相关研究。

A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.summary_cn: 论文针对复杂时空与因果关系下全局实例跟踪（Global Instance Tracking）缺乏多模态基准的问题，提出了多模态全局实例跟踪基准MGIT。方法上构建了包含多模态数据与复杂时空因果关系的评测数据集，并设计了相应的评价指标。相比已有跟踪基准，其改进在于更强调复杂时空与因果推理能力。摘要未提供具体数值结果，但该基准有望推动跟踪算法在复杂场景下的发展。
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-modal benchmarks for global instance tracking under complex spatio-temporal and causal relationships by proposing the Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking benchmark (MGIT). It constructs a multi-modal dataset with complex spatio-temporal and causal relations and designs corresponding evaluation metrics. Compared with existing tracking benchmarks, it emphasizes complex spatio-temporal and causal reasoning, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.assessment: 该基准对跟踪领域在复杂场景下的评测有推动作用，但需关注其数据规模与任务定义的具体细节。

A Multi-modal Global Instance Tracking B.innovation: 将多模态数据与复杂时空因果推理结合，构建更具挑战性的跟踪评测基准。

2303.02314|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对基于虚拟点（深度补全）的多模态3D目标检测中虚拟点密集导致计算冗余以及深度补全噪声降低检测精度的问题，提出了VirConvNet骨干网络。方法包含两个关键设计：StVD（随机体素丢弃）通过丢弃大量邻近冗余体素缓解计算问题，NRConv（抗噪子流形卷积）在2D图像和3D LiDAR空间同时编码体素特征以抑制噪声。基于VirConv，作者构建了VirConv-L（早期融合）、VirConv-T（变换细化）和VirConv-S（半监督伪标签）三种流程。在KITTI汽车3D检测上取得了优于已有方法的效果（摘要未给出具体数值，但声称高精度与高效）。
2303.02314|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the computational redundancy caused by dense virtual points and the detection accuracy degradation from noisy depth completion in virtual-point-based multi-modal 3D object detection. It proposes VirConvNet, a backbone based on Virtual Sparse Convolution (VirConv), which consists of Stochastic Voxel Discard (StVD) to discard redundant nearby voxels and Noise-Resistant Submanifold Convolution (NRConv) to encode voxel features in both 2D image and 3D LiDAR spaces. Three pipelines (VirConv-L, VirConv-T, VirConv-S) are developed, achieving improved performance on KITTI car 3D detection.
2303.02314|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多模态3D检测中的计算与噪声问题提出了有效解决方案，在KITTI上表现优异，对自动驾驶感知研究有较高参考价值。
2303.02314|v2.contribution: 提出了VirConv算子及VirConvNet骨干网络，用于高效且抗噪的虚拟点多模态3D目标检测。
2303.02314|v2.innovation: 结合随机体素丢弃与抗噪子流形卷积，在2D和3D空间联合编码特征以抑制深度补全噪声。
2303.02314|v2.result: 在KITTI汽车3D检测上取得了优于已有方法的高精度与高效表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2303.12417|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对3D点云理解中缺乏Text-3D数据对、难以将2D视觉语言模型成功迁移到3D空间的问题，提出了CLIP2（Contrastive Language-Image-Point Cloud Pretraining）。方法利用2D和3D场景中自然存在的对应关系，构建良好对齐的、基于实例的文本-图像-点云代理，并采用跨模态对比目标学习语义和实例级对齐的点云表示。相比已有依赖中间2D表示而丢失3D几何信息的工作，CLIP2直接学习可迁移的3D点云表示。在室内和室外场景上的实验表明，学习到的3D表示具有很好的迁移能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2303.12417|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of Text-3D data pairs that hinders adapting 2D vision-language models to 3D point cloud understanding. It proposes CLIP2 (Contrastive Language-Image-Point Cloud Pretraining), which exploits naturally existing 2D-3D correspondences to build well-aligned instance-based text-image-point proxies and uses a cross-modal contrastive objective to learn semantic and instance-level aligned point cloud representations. Unlike prior works that rely on intermediate 2D representations and lose 3D geometry, CLIP2 directly learns transferable 3D representations, showing strong transferability on both indoor and outdoor scenarios.
2303.12417|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放世界3D视觉理解提供了新思路，直接学习点云表示并保持几何信息，对多模态3D感知研究有较高参考价值。
2303.12417|v2.contribution: 提出了CLIP2，通过代理对齐机制和跨模态对比目标直接学习可迁移的3D点云表示。
2303.12417|v2.innovation: 利用2D-3D自然对应关系构建实例级文本-图像-点云代理，避免中间2D表示导致的几何信息丢失。
2303.12417|v2.result: 在室内和室外场景上展示了良好的迁移能力（摘要未给出具体数值）。

3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.summary_cn: 论文针对点云场景图预测中缺乏多模态知识积累的问题，提出了3D空间多模态知识积累方法。方法上通过融合多模态信息（如视觉与文本）来增强点云场景图的预测能力。相比已有工作，其改进在于引入多模态知识积累机制以提升场景图预测的准确性。摘要未提供具体数值结果，但该工作对3D场景理解与多模态融合有潜在贡献。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-modal knowledge accumulation for scene graph prediction in point clouds by proposing a 3D spatial multi-modal knowledge accumulation method. It enhances point cloud scene graph prediction by integrating multi-modal information. Compared with existing works, it introduces a multi-modal knowledge accumulation mechanism to improve prediction accuracy, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.assessment: 该工作将多模态知识积累引入点云场景图预测，对3D场景理解研究有一定参考价值，但需关注其具体方法与实验细节。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.contribution: 提出了3D空间多模态知识积累方法，用于点云场景图预测。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.innovation: 将多模态知识积累机制引入点云场景图预测，增强场景理解能力。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但有望提升场景图预测准确性。
3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumula._arxiv_id: 3D Spatial Multimodal Knowledge Accumulation for Scene Graph Prediction in Point Cloud.

Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对多模态跟踪中如何有效利用视觉提示（Visual Prompt）的问题，提出了视觉提示多模态跟踪方法。方法上通过引入视觉提示来引导多模态跟踪模型，提升跟踪性能。相比已有工作，其改进在于利用视觉提示增强多模态特征的交互与融合。摘要未提供具体数值结果，但该工作对多模态跟踪与提示学习有潜在贡献。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses how to effectively utilize visual prompts for multi-modal tracking by proposing a visual prompt multi-modal tracking method. It introduces visual prompts to guide the multi-modal tracking model and improve tracking performance. Compared with existing works, it enhances the interaction and fusion of multi-modal features via visual prompts, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉提示引入多模态跟踪，对跟踪与提示学习交叉领域有一定参考价值，但需关注其具体实现与实验验证。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了视觉提示多模态跟踪方法，利用视觉提示提升多模态跟踪性能。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将视觉提示机制引入多模态跟踪，增强多模态特征交互与融合。
Visual Prompt Multi-Modal Tracking.|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，但有望提升多模态跟踪性能。

2303.08600|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR-only方法在小型和远处物体上因点云稀疏导致分割性能差的问题，本文提出多模态3D语义分割模型MSeg3D。该方法通过联合模态内特征提取和模态间特征融合来缓解模态异质性，融合包括基于几何的特征融合GF-Phase、跨模态特征补全和基于语义的特征融合SF-Phase，并采用非对称变换增强多模态数据。在nuScenes、Waymo和SemanticKITTI数据集上取得state-of-the-art结果，并在多相机故障和多帧点云输入下表现出鲁棒性。
2303.08600|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferior segmentation of small and distant objects in LiDAR-only methods due to sparse points, and proposes MSeg3D, a multi-modal 3D semantic segmentation model with joint intra-modal feature extraction and inter-modal feature fusion. The fusion includes geometry-based GF-Phase, cross-modal feature completion, and semantic-based SF-Phase, along with asymmetric multi-modal data augmentation. MSeg3D achieves state-of-the-art results on nuScenes, Waymo, and SemanticKITTI, and remains robust under malfunctioning multi-camera input and multi-frame point clouds.
2303.08600|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了多模态3D语义分割中的关键挑战，实验充分且性能领先，对自动驾驶感知研究具有重要参考价值。
2303.08600|v2.contribution: 提出了一个融合LiDAR和相机模态的3D语义分割框架MSeg3D，有效缓解模态异质性并提升小物体分割性能。
2303.08600|v2.innovation: 设计了基于几何和语义的两阶段特征融合模块以及非对称多模态数据增强策略。
2303.08600|v2.result: 在nuScenes、Waymo和SemanticKITTI上达到state-of-the-art，并在多相机故障和多帧输入下保持鲁棒。

2306.03932|v2.summary_cn: 针对专业VQA任务标注数据稀缺的问题，本文提出SelTDA（Self-Taught Data Augmentation）策略，用于在小规模VQA数据集上微调大型视觉语言模型。SelTDA利用VLM和目标数据集构建教师模型，仅根据图像生成问答伪标签，从而对未标注图像进行伪标注，并在原始数据增强后的数据集上微调初始VLM。实验表明，该方法提高了对对抗性搜索问题、反事实示例和改写的鲁棒性，改善了域泛化，并更好地保留了数值推理能力。
2306.03932|v2.summary_en: To address the scarcity of labeled data in specialized VQA tasks, this paper introduces SelTDA (Self-Taught Data Augmentation), a strategy for finetuning large VLMs on small-scale VQA datasets. SelTDA builds a teacher model from the VLM and target dataset to generate question-answer pseudolabels conditioned on images alone, then finetunes the VLM on the original dataset augmented with pseudolabeled images. Experiments show improved robustness to adversarial questions, counterfactuals, and rephrasings, better domain generalization, and greater retention of numerical reasoning skills.
2306.03932|v2.assessment: 该工作为数据稀缺场景下的VLM微调提供了有效的自训练数据增强方案，实验设计全面，对多模态学习研究者有启发。
2306.03932|v2.contribution: 提出SelTDA自训练数据增强策略，利用未标注图像提升小规模VQA任务上VLM的微调效果。
2306.03932|v2.innovation: 通过VLM自身生成图像条件伪标签，实现无需额外标注的数据增强。
2306.03932|v2.result: 在多个VQA任务上提升了鲁棒性、域泛化和数值推理能力。

2303.02483|v2.summary_cn: 针对时尚领域多种视觉语言任务（跨模态检索、文本引导图像检索、多模态分类、图像描述）各自独立建模导致参数效率低且无法利用任务间关联的问题，本文提出FAME-ViL，一种面向时尚领域的多任务高效学习方法。该方法采用任务通用架构，将交叉注意力适配器和任务特定适配器集成到统一V+L模型中，并设计稳定的多任务训练策略以支持异构数据学习并防止负迁移。在四个时尚任务上，FAME-ViL相比独立模型节省61.5%参数。
2303.02483|v2.summary_en: To address parameter inefficiency and inability to exploit inter-task relatedness in fashion V+L tasks, this paper proposes FAME-ViL, a multi-task efficient learning method for vision-and-language tasks. It employs a task-versatile architecture with cross-attention adapters and task-specific adapters integrated into a unified V+L model, and a stable multi-task training strategy that supports heterogeneous data and prevents negative transfer. On four fashion tasks, FAME-ViL saves 61.5% parameters over independent models.
2303.02483|v2.assessment: 该工作在多任务视觉语言学习方面具有创新性，参数效率显著，但领域较窄，对自动驾驶感知的直接相关性有限。
2303.02483|v2.contribution: 提出了面向时尚领域多任务视觉语言学习的统一高效模型FAME-ViL。
2303.02483|v2.innovation: 结合交叉注意力适配器和任务特定适配器，并设计防止负迁移的多任务训练策略。
2303.02483|v2.result: 在四个时尚任务上节省61.5%参数，同时保持或提升性能。

2303.14302|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有图像美学评估方法依赖人工评分标签、简化了人类感知的视觉美学信息的问题，本文提出从用户评论中学习图像美学，并探索视觉语言预训练方法。具体地，使用图像-评论对预训练图像-文本编码器-解码器模型，通过对比和生成目标学习丰富通用的美学语义，无需人工标签。为高效适应下游IAA任务，提出轻量级基于排序的适配器，以文本为锚学习美学排序概念。在AVA-Captions数据集上，预训练模型在图像美学描述任务上优于先前工作。
2303.14302|v2.summary_en: To address the oversimplification of visual aesthetic information in existing image aesthetic assessment methods that rely on human-labeled rating scores, this paper proposes learning image aesthetics from user comments via vision-language pretraining. It pretrains an image-text encoder-decoder model with image-comment pairs using contrastive and generative objectives, and proposes a lightweight rank-based adapter for downstream tasks. The pretrained model outperforms prior works on image aesthetic captioning over the AVA-Captions dataset.
2303.14302|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地利用用户评论进行美学预训练，方法设计合理，但领域较偏，对自动驾驶感知研究的相关性较低。
2303.14302|v2.contribution: 提出从用户评论中学习图像美学的视觉语言预训练方法，并设计轻量级排序适配器。
2303.14302|v2.innovation: 利用图像-评论对进行对比和生成预训练，无需人工评分标签。
2303.14302|v2.result: 在AVA-Captions数据集上图像美学描述任务优于先前工作。

2304.04231|v2.summary_cn: 针对监督人群计数依赖昂贵人工标注的问题，本文提出无监督框架CrowdCLIP，首次探索利用视觉语言知识解决计数问题。训练阶段，通过构建排序文本提示匹配按大小排序的人群块，利用多模态排序损失指导图像编码器学习。测试阶段，提出渐进过滤策略选择高潜力人群块并映射到语言空间。在五个挑战性数据集上，CrowdCLIP优于先前无监督方法。
2304.04231|v2.summary_en: To alleviate the costly manual labeling in supervised crowd counting, this paper proposes CrowdCLIP, an unsupervised framework that leverages vision-language knowledge for counting. In training, it constructs ranking text prompts to match size-sorted crowd patches and uses a multi-modal ranking loss to guide the image encoder. In testing, a progressive filtering strategy selects high-potential patches and maps them to the language space. Extensive experiments on five challenging datasets show CrowdCLIP outperforms previous unsupervised methods.
2304.04231|v2.assessment: 该工作将CLIP应用于无监督人群计数，思路新颖，但领域与自动驾驶感知相关性较低。
2304.04231|v2.contribution: 提出了首个基于视觉语言模型的无监督人群计数框架CrowdCLIP。
2304.04231|v2.innovation: 利用多模态排序损失和渐进过滤策略，将人群块与计数文本映射。
2304.04231|v2.result: 在五个数据集上优于先前无监督方法。

2301.00182|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）在视频识别中迁移能力未被充分挖掘的问题，本文提出BIKE框架，利用VLM构建的跨模态桥梁进行双向知识探索。具体包括视频属性关联机制，用视频到文本知识生成辅助文本属性补充视频识别；以及时序概念定位机制，以无参数方式利用文本到视频知识捕捉时序显著性。在Kinetics-400/600、UCF-101、HMDB-51、ActivityNet和Charades六个数据集上，在通用、零样本和少样本等场景均达到SOTA。
2301.00182|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the under-explored transferability of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) for video recognition. It proposes BIKE, a framework that exploits the cross-modal bridge in VLMs for bidirectional knowledge exploration: a Video Attribute Association mechanism generates textual auxiliary attributes from video-to-text knowledge, and a Temporal Concept Spotting mechanism captures temporal saliency in a parameter-free manner using text-to-video expertise. Extensive experiments on six video datasets (Kinetics-400/600, UCF-101, HMDB-51, ActivityNet, Charades) demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in general, zero-shot, and few-shot recognition scenarios.
2301.00182|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地挖掘了VLM在视频理解中的双向跨模态知识迁移潜力，方法设计巧妙且实验覆盖全面，对视频理解与多模态方向的研究者有较高参考价值。
2301.00182|v2.contribution: 提出了BIKE框架，通过视频属性关联和时序概念定位两个机制实现VLM到视频识别的双向跨模态知识迁移。
2301.00182|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地利用VLM的跨模态桥梁进行双向知识探索，并提出无参数的时序概念定位机制。
2301.00182|v2.result: 在六个主流视频数据集上，通用、零样本和少样本场景均取得SOTA性能。

2301.06267|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统少样本学习仅使用单一模态样本、难以充分表征概念类别的问题，本文提出跨模态适配策略，利用CLIP等多模态基础模型将不同模态映射到同一表示空间。核心思想是将不同模态的样本视为额外的少样本示例，例如将类名作为额外训练样本，从而将n-shot问题简单转化为(n+1)-shot问题。该方法用极其简单的线性分类器即可取得SOTA结果，并可与其他方法（如prefix tuning）结合。
2301.06267|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of classical few-shot learning that relies on single-modality samples insufficient to characterize a concept class. It proposes a simple cross-modal adaptation strategy that exploits multimodal foundation models like CLIP, which map different modalities into a shared representation space, by treating examples from different modalities as additional few-shot examples. For instance, repurposing class names as an extra training sample trivially converts any n-shot problem into an (n+1)-shot problem, enabling state-of-the-art results with embarrassingly simple linear classifiers.
2301.06267|v2.assessment: 该工作以极简的方法揭示了跨模态信息在少样本学习中的巨大价值，思路清晰且实用性强，对多模态与少样本学习研究者有启发意义。
2301.06267|v2.contribution: 提出了一种简单的跨模态适配策略，将不同模态样本视为额外少样本示例以提升视觉分类性能。
2301.06267|v2.innovation: 利用多模态基础模型的共享表示空间，将类名等跨模态信息转化为额外训练样本，实现n-shot到(n+1)-shot的转化。
2301.06267|v2.result: 使用简单线性分类器即取得SOTA少样本分类结果，并可与其他方法结合。

2303.07284|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态摘要中现有方法未能利用模态间时序对应关系及样本间内在关联的问题，本文提出A2Summ，一个基于Transformer的统一多模态摘要模型，可有效对齐和关注多模态输入。同时提出两种新颖的对比损失来建模样本间和样本内相关性。在TVSum、SumMe、Daily Mail和CNN四个数据集上均取得SOTA，并收集了大规模多模态摘要数据集BLiSS。
2303.07284|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the failure of existing multimodal summarization methods to leverage temporal correspondence between modalities and intrinsic correlations across samples. It introduces A2Summ, a unified multimodal transformer-based model that effectively aligns and attends to multimodal inputs, along with two novel contrastive losses modeling inter-sample and intra-sample correlations. Extensive experiments on TVSum, SumMe, Daily Mail, and CNN demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, and a large-scale dataset BLiSS is collected.
2303.07284|v2.assessment: 该工作在多模态摘要任务上提出了统一框架和双重对比损失，实验充分且贡献了大规模数据集，对多模态与视频理解方向有参考价值。
2303.07284|v2.contribution: 提出A2Summ统一多模态Transformer摘要模型及两种对比损失，并构建大规模多模态摘要数据集BLiSS。
2303.07284|v2.innovation: 通过双重对比损失建模样本间和样本内相关性，并统一对齐与关注多模态输入。
2303.07284|v2.result: 在TVSum、SumMe、Daily Mail和CNN四个数据集上均取得SOTA性能。

2303.00601|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于3D点云和RGB图像的多模态工业异常检测中，现有方法直接拼接多模态特征导致特征间强干扰、损害检测性能的问题，本文提出M3DM，采用混合融合方案。首先设计基于patch级对比学习的无监督特征融合促进模态交互；其次使用多记忆库的决策层融合避免信息丢失，并加入新颖性分类器做最终决策；还提出点特征对齐操作。在MVTec-3D AD数据集上检测和分割精度均超越SOTA。
2303.00601|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that existing multimodal industrial anomaly detection methods directly concatenate multimodal features, causing strong feature disturbance and harming detection performance. It proposes M3DM with a hybrid fusion scheme: an unsupervised feature fusion with patch-wise contrastive learning to encourage cross-modal interaction, and a decision-layer fusion with multiple memory banks plus novelty classifiers for final decisions. A point feature alignment operation is also introduced. Experiments show M3DM outperforms state-of-the-art on both detection and segmentation precision on MVTec-3D AD.
2303.00601|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多模态工业异常检测中的特征融合问题提出了系统的混合融合方案，实验验证充分，对多模态融合与异常检测研究者有参考价值。
2303.00601|v2.contribution: 提出M3DM混合融合多模态异常检测方法，结合无监督特征融合与决策层融合。
2303.00601|v2.innovation: 设计patch级对比学习特征融合、多记忆库决策融合及点特征对齐操作。
2303.00601|v2.result: 在MVTec-3D AD数据集上检测和分割精度均超越SOTA。

Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，无法完整评估。从标题推断，本文研究多模态非刚性3D形状匹配的自监督学习方法。该工作可能针对非刚性3D形状匹配中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出自监督学习框架来学习多模态形状表示。但缺乏摘要信息，无法确认具体方法、改进点和实验效果。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.summary_en: Due to the missing abstract, a complete assessment cannot be made. Based on the title, this work studies self-supervised learning for multimodal non-rigid 3D shape matching. It likely addresses the scarcity of annotated data in non-rigid 3D shape matching by proposing a self-supervised framework to learn multimodal shape representations. However, specific methods, improvements, and experimental results cannot be confirmed without the abstract.
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.assessment: 自监督3D形状匹配是一个有价值的研究方向，但因摘要缺失无法评估其方法质量和实验充分度，与用户核心领域的相关度也较低。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.contribution: 提出多模态非刚性3D形状匹配的自监督学习方法（基于标题推断）。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.innovation: 将自监督学习应用于多模态非刚性3D形状匹配（基于标题推断）。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal.result: 因摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验结果。
Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning for Multimodal Non-Rigid 3D Shape Matching.

Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_cn: 该论文针对远距离声学感知在场景理解中信息缺失的问题，提出利用长距离声学波束成形与视觉融合的多模态场景理解框架。方法上通过声学波束成形获取远距离目标的空间与语义线索，并与视觉模态进行融合。相比纯视觉方案，其改进点在于引入声音模态以扩展感知范围，尤其适用于视觉退化或遮挡场景。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文验证。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited perception range of vision-only scene understanding by introducing long-range acoustic beamforming as an auxiliary modality. It proposes a multimodal framework that fuses acoustic spatial cues with visual information to enhance scene understanding. The main improvement lies in extending perception beyond visual line-of-sight, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.assessment: 声学与视觉融合用于远距离场景理解具有一定新意，但与主流自动驾驶视觉感知路线相关度有限，需关注其实际融合效果与实验充分性。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.contribution: 提出长距离声学波束成形与视觉融合的多模态场景理解框架。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.innovation: 将远距离声学感知引入多模态场景理解，扩展视觉感知边界。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待正文验证。
Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic B._arxiv_id: Seeing With Sound: Long-Range Acoustic Beamforming for Multimodal Scene Understanding.

Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_cn: 该论文针对对话情感识别任务，重新审视图神经网络在多变量、多频率和多模态设置下的建模方式。方法上提出融合多变量、多频率与多模态信息的图神经网络框架，以更充分地刻画对话中的复杂交互关系。相比已有工作，其改进点在于同时考虑多种信号维度而非单一模态或频率。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文验证。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.summary_en: This paper rethinks graph neural networks for emotion recognition in conversation under multivariate, multi-frequency, and multimodal settings. It proposes a GNN framework that jointly models multiple variables, frequency components, and modalities to capture complex conversational interactions. The improvement lies in unifying these dimensions, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.assessment: 该工作聚焦对话情感识别，与自动驾驶视觉感知领域相关度低，方法思路对多模态融合有一定参考价值但非核心关注方向。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.contribution: 提出多变量、多频率、多模态的图神经网络用于对话情感识别。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.innovation: 在GNN中同时建模多变量、多频率与多模态信息。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待正文验证。
Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multim._arxiv_id: Multivariate, Multi-Frequency and Multimodal: Rethinking Graph Neural Networks for Emotion Recognition in Conversation.

2306.07646|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态表示学习中辅助模态仅在训练阶段可用的问题，利用跨模态知识蒸馏进行增强。方法上指出基于互信息最大化的目标会导致弱教师捷径解，即通过让教师与学生一样弱来最大化互信息，为此引入教师与辅助模态模型之间的互信息项，并最小化给定学生时教师的条件熵，同时设计基于对比学习和对抗学习的训练方案。相比已有工作，其改进点在于避免弱教师解并缩小师生信息差距。在三个多模态基准数据集上，该方法在视频识别、视频检索和情感分类任务上优于多种SOTA方法。
2306.07646|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multimodal representation learning where auxiliary modalities are only available during training, using cross-modal knowledge distillation. It identifies a short-cut solution of the weak teacher in mutual information maximization and introduces an additional mutual information term between teacher and auxiliary modality, along with minimizing the teacher's conditional entropy given the student. Contrastive and adversarial training schemes are designed, and experiments on three multimodal benchmarks show improvements over state-of-the-art methods for video recognition, retrieval, and emotion classification.
2306.07646|v2.assessment: 该工作对跨模态知识蒸馏中的弱教师问题给出了有针对性的理论分析与解决方案，实验覆盖多个任务，对多模态蒸馏方向有参考价值。
2306.07646|v2.contribution: 提出避免弱教师解的跨模态知识蒸馏框架，增强多模态表示学习。
2306.07646|v2.innovation: 引入教师-辅助模态互信息与条件熵最小化，结合对比与对抗训练。
2306.07646|v2.result: 在三个多模态基准上于视频识别、检索和情感分类任务中超越多种SOTA方法。

SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D形状补全、重建与生成任务，提出多模态的SDFusion框架。方法上基于符号距离场（SDF）表示，融合多种模态信息（如文本、图像等）进行3D形状的补全、重建与生成。相比已有工作，其改进点在于统一处理补全、重建和生成三类任务并支持多模态条件输入。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合正文验证。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D shape completion, reconstruction, and generation with a multimodal framework named SDFusion. It leverages signed distance field representations and fuses multiple modalities to perform these tasks in a unified manner. The improvement lies in handling completion, reconstruction, and generation jointly with multimodal conditioning, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.assessment: 该工作将多模态条件引入基于SDF的3D形状生成与补全，对3D感知与生成交叉方向有一定参考价值，但与自动驾驶BEV/检测主线相关度中等。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.contribution: 提出基于SDF的多模态3D形状补全、重建与生成统一框架SDFusion。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.innovation: 融合多模态条件与SDF表示统一处理3D形状补全、重建和生成。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待正文验证。
SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion._arxiv_id: SDFusion: Multimodal 3D Shape Completion, Reconstruction, and Generation.

MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_cn: 针对多摄像头多目标跟踪（MTMC）在真实场景中缺乏大规模多模态基准的问题，论文提出了MTMMC，一个大规模真实世界多模态摄像头跟踪基准。该基准包含来自多个摄像头和多种模态（如RGB、红外）的同步数据，并提供了详细的标注和评估协议。相比已有工作，MTMMC在规模、模态多样性和场景复杂性上均有显著提升，为多摄像头跟踪算法提供了更全面的评测平台。实验表明，现有方法在该基准上仍面临挑战，尤其在跨摄像头关联和模态融合方面。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.summary_en: To address the lack of large-scale multimodal benchmarks for multi-target multi-camera (MTMC) tracking in real-world scenarios, this paper introduces MTMMC, a large-scale real-world multimodal camera tracking benchmark. It includes synchronized data from multiple cameras and modalities (e.g., RGB, infrared) with detailed annotations and evaluation protocols. Compared to existing works, MTMMC significantly improves in scale, modality diversity, and scene complexity, providing a more comprehensive evaluation platform for multi-camera tracking algorithms. Experiments show that existing methods still face challenges on this benchmark, especially in cross-camera association and modality fusion.
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.assessment: 该基准填补了多模态多摄像头跟踪领域的空白，对自动驾驶和视频监控研究具有重要价值。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.contribution: 提出了首个大规模真实世界多模态多摄像头跟踪基准MTMMC。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.innovation: 融合多模态数据并设计全面的评估协议，推动多摄像头跟踪研究。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo.result: 现有方法在该基准上表现不佳，凸显了跨摄像头关联和模态融合的挑战。
MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Mo._arxiv_id: MTMMC: A Large-Scale Real-World Multi-Modal Camera Tracking Benchmark.

MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_cn: 针对专家级AGI评估中缺乏多学科多模态理解与推理基准的问题，论文提出了MMMU，一个大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准。该基准涵盖多个学科领域（如艺术、科学、工程等），包含大量需要专家级知识的多模态问题，要求模型进行跨模态推理。相比已有基准，MMMU在学科覆盖、问题难度和推理深度上均有显著提升，能够更全面地评估多模态大模型的专家级能力。实验显示，当前最先进模型在MMMU上的准确率远低于人类专家，揭示了巨大差距。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.summary_en: To address the lack of benchmarks for expert-level AGI evaluation in multi-disciplinary multimodal understanding and reasoning, this paper introduces MMMU, a massive multi-discipline multimodal understanding and reasoning benchmark. It covers multiple disciplines (e.g., art, science, engineering) with numerous expert-level multimodal questions requiring cross-modal reasoning. Compared to existing benchmarks, MMMU significantly improves in discipline coverage, question difficulty, and reasoning depth, enabling more comprehensive evaluation of multimodal large models' expert-level capabilities. Experiments show that state-of-the-art models achieve far lower accuracy than human experts on MMMU, revealing a large gap.
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.assessment: MMMU是评估多模态大模型专家级能力的重要基准，对推动AGI研究具有里程碑意义。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.contribution: 提出了大规模多学科多模态理解与推理基准MMMU。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.innovation: 覆盖多学科专家级问题，要求跨模态推理，难度远超现有基准。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo.result: 当前最先进模型在MMMU上准确率远低于人类专家，差距显著。
MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimo._arxiv_id: MMMU: A Massive Multi-Discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI.

MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_cn: 针对多模态视频理解缺乏全面基准的问题，论文提出了MVBench，一个综合的多模态视频理解基准。该基准包含多种视频理解任务（如动作识别、时序推理、问答等），覆盖不同领域和难度级别，旨在评估模型对视频中多模态信息的理解能力。相比已有基准，MVBench在任务多样性、数据规模和评估维度上均有提升，能够更系统地测试视频理解模型。实验表明，现有模型在复杂时序推理任务上表现仍有不足。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.summary_en: To address the lack of comprehensive benchmarks for multimodal video understanding, this paper introduces MVBench, a comprehensive multi-modal video understanding benchmark. It includes diverse video understanding tasks (e.g., action recognition, temporal reasoning, QA) across various domains and difficulty levels, aiming to evaluate models' ability to understand multimodal information in videos. Compared to existing benchmarks, MVBench improves in task diversity, data scale, and evaluation dimensions, enabling more systematic testing of video understanding models. Experiments show that existing models still underperform on complex temporal reasoning tasks.
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.assessment: MVBench为多模态视频理解提供了全面的评估平台，对推动视频理解研究有重要价值。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.contribution: 提出了综合的多模态视频理解基准MVBench。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.innovation: 涵盖多种视频理解任务和难度级别，系统评估多模态理解能力。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid.result: 现有模型在复杂时序推理任务上表现不足，凸显了视频理解的挑战。
MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Vid._arxiv_id: MVBench: A Comprehensive Multi-modal Video Understanding Benchmark.

2402.17553|v2.summary_cn: 针对虚拟代理在桌面和Web环境中自动化任务缺乏评估基准的问题，论文提出了OmniACT，首个用于评估代理生成可执行程序以完成计算机任务的数据集和基准。该基准涵盖桌面应用和Web任务，从简单任务（如播放下一首歌）到长时程任务（如发送邮件），要求代理根据屏幕图像和自然语言任务生成脚本。相比已有工作，OmniACT扩展了任务范围并提供了更真实的评估环境。实验表明，现有模型在生成可执行程序方面仍有较大提升空间。
2402.17553|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of benchmarks for evaluating virtual agents in automating tasks on desktop and web, this paper introduces OmniACT, the first dataset and benchmark for assessing an agent's capability to generate executable programs for computer tasks. It covers desktop applications and web tasks, from simple tasks (e.g., play next song) to long-horizon tasks (e.g., send email), requiring agents to generate scripts from screen images and natural language tasks. Compared to existing works, OmniACT expands task scope and provides a more realistic evaluation environment. Experiments show that existing models still have much room for improvement in generating executable programs.
2402.17553|v2.assessment: OmniACT为虚拟代理的自动化任务评估提供了新基准，对多模态代理研究有启发意义。
2402.17553|v2.contribution: 提出了首个评估代理生成可执行程序完成计算机任务的数据集和基准OmniACT。
2402.17553|v2.innovation: 涵盖桌面和Web任务，从简单到长时程，要求生成可执行脚本。
2402.17553|v2.result: 现有模型在生成可执行程序方面表现有限，仍有较大提升空间。

MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）安全性评估缺乏系统基准的问题，论文提出了MM-SafetyBench，一个用于评估MLLM安全性的基准。该基准包含多种安全相关场景（如暴力、仇恨、隐私等），通过设计对抗性提示和评估指标，系统测试模型在生成内容时的安全性。相比已有工作，MM-SafetyBench在场景覆盖和评估方法上更全面，能够揭示模型的安全漏洞。实验表明，当前MLLM在安全性方面存在显著缺陷，容易生成不安全内容。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.summary_en: To address the lack of systematic benchmarks for safety evaluation of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), this paper introduces MM-SafetyBench, a benchmark for safety evaluation of MLLMs. It includes various safety-related scenarios (e.g., violence, hate, privacy) and designs adversarial prompts and evaluation metrics to systematically test model safety in content generation. Compared to existing works, MM-SafetyBench is more comprehensive in scenario coverage and evaluation methods, revealing model safety vulnerabilities. Experiments show that current MLLMs have significant safety flaws, easily generating unsafe content.
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.assessment: MM-SafetyBench为多模态大模型的安全性评估提供了重要工具，对负责任AI研究有重要意义。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.contribution: 提出了用于评估多模态大语言模型安全性的基准MM-SafetyBench。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.innovation: 涵盖多种安全场景，设计对抗性提示和评估指标，系统测试安全性。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E.result: 当前MLLM在安全性方面存在显著缺陷，容易生成不安全内容。
MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety E._arxiv_id: MM-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Multimodal Large Language Models.

TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_cn: 针对夜间车辆监控中缺乏多模态航空基准的问题，论文提出了TrafficNight，一个用于夜间车辆监控的航空多模态基准。该基准包含夜间航空拍摄的多模态数据（如可见光、红外），并提供车辆检测和跟踪的标注，旨在评估模型在低光照条件下的性能。相比已有工作，TrafficNight专注于夜间航空场景，填补了该领域空白。实验表明，现有方法在夜间航空数据上性能下降明显，多模态融合能带来一定提升。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.summary_en: To address the lack of multimodal aerial benchmarks for nighttime vehicle surveillance, this paper introduces TrafficNight, an aerial multimodal benchmark for nighttime vehicle surveillance. It includes multimodal data (e.g., visible, infrared) captured aerially at night, with annotations for vehicle detection and tracking, aiming to evaluate model performance under low-light conditions. Compared to existing works, TrafficNight focuses on nighttime aerial scenarios, filling a gap in this field. Experiments show that existing methods suffer significant performance drops on nighttime aerial data, and multimodal fusion can bring some improvement.
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.assessment: TrafficNight为夜间航空车辆监控提供了专门基准，对自动驾驶和监控研究有参考价值。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.contribution: 提出了夜间航空多模态车辆监控基准TrafficNight。
TrafficNight: An Aerial Multimodal Bench.innovation: 专注于夜间航空场景，提供多模态数据用于车辆检测与跟踪。
