2403.10943|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态意图识别中现有基准数据集规模小、难以处理多轮对话中出现的域外（out-of-scope）样本的问题，本文提出了 MIntRec2.0 大规模基准数据集。该数据集包含 1,245 段对话、15,040 个样本，采用 30 类细粒度意图分类体系，其中 9,304 个域内样本和 5,736 个多轮场景下自然出现的域外样本，并提供了说话人信息。作者还建立了支持单轮/多轮数据组织、模态特征提取、多模态融合以及域内分类与域外检测的通用框架，并使用经典多模态融合方法和 ChatGPT 等进行了评测。相比已有基准，该数据集在规模、意图粒度和域外检测能力上均有显著提升。
2403.10943|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MIntRec2.0, a large-scale benchmark dataset for multimodal intent recognition in multi-party conversations, addressing the limited scale and poor out-of-scope handling of existing benchmarks. It contains 1,245 dialogues with 15,040 samples across 30 fine-grained intent classes, including 9,304 in-scope and 5,736 out-of-scope samples, along with speaker information. A general framework supporting single/multi-turn data organization, modality fusion, and out-of-scope detection is established, with evaluations using classic fusion methods and ChatGPT.
2403.10943|v2.assessment: 该工作为多模态对话意图识别与域外检测提供了大规模基准，对多模态理解与开放集识别研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2403.10943|v2.contribution: 构建了大规模多轮多模态意图识别与域外检测基准数据集 MIntRec2.0 及配套评测框架。
2403.10943|v2.innovation: 首次在多轮对话场景中系统性地引入自然出现的域外样本并支持细粒度意图分类。
2403.10943|v2.result: 数据集包含 15,040 个样本、30 类意图，并提供了经典融合方法与 ChatGPT 的评测基线。

2402.04788|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）评估缺乏与人类偏好对齐的基准的问题，本文提出了 MLLM-as-a-Judge 基准，用于评估 MLLM 在评分评估、成对比较和批量排序三类任务中的评判能力。研究发现，MLLM 在成对比较中展现出接近人类的判别力，但在评分评估和批量排序中与人类偏好存在显著偏差，即使 GPT-4V 等先进模型也表现出偏见、幻觉响应和判断不一致等问题。这些发现表明 MLLM 尚不能作为完全可靠的评估者，需要进一步改进与研究。
2402.04788|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MLLM-as-a-Judge, a benchmark to assess multimodal LLMs' judging capabilities across Scoring Evaluation, Pair Comparison, and Batch Ranking tasks. While MLLMs show human-like discernment in Pair Comparison, they diverge significantly from human preferences in Scoring and Ranking, exhibiting biases, hallucinations, and inconsistencies even in GPT-4V. The findings highlight the need for further research before MLLMs can serve as reliable evaluators.
2402.04788|v2.assessment: 该工作系统揭示了 MLLM 作为评判者的能力边界与偏差，对多模态评估与 VLM 可靠性研究有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2402.04788|v2.contribution: 提出了评估 MLLM 评判能力的多任务基准 MLLM-as-a-Judge。
2402.04788|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地从评分、成对比较和批量排序三个维度评估 MLLM 作为评判者的能力与偏差。
2402.04788|v2.result: 发现 MLLM 在成对比较中接近人类水平，但在评分和排序任务中与人类偏好显著偏离，且存在偏见与幻觉。

2406.05862|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）高阶感知能力缺乏系统评测的问题，论文提出 II-Bench 图像隐含意义理解基准，覆盖抽象与复杂图像的高层语义理解。通过在多款 MLLM 上开展实验并与人类对照，发现模型最高准确率仅 74.8%，而人类平均 90%、峰值 98%，差距显著。模型在抽象、复杂图像上表现更差，说明其高层语义理解与细节捕捉能力不足；此外，加入图像情感极性提示后多数模型准确率提升，揭示其依赖提示线索的缺陷。
2406.05862|v2.summary_en: The paper introduces II-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating higher-order perceptual capabilities of multimodal large language models on image implication understanding. Extensive experiments show MLLMs peak at 74.8% accuracy versus 90% average and 98% peak for humans, with larger gaps on abstract and complex images. Most models improve when image sentiment polarity hints are added, exposing reliance on prompt cues.
2406.05862|v2.assessment: 该基准揭示了 MLLM 在图像隐含语义理解上与人类的显著差距，对多模态评测方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2406.05862|v2.contribution: 提出面向图像隐含意义理解的高阶感知评测基准 II-Bench。
2406.05862|v2.innovation: 首次系统评测 MLLM 对图像隐含意义的高阶感知能力并引入人类对照与情感提示分析。
2406.05862|v2.result: MLLM 最高准确率 74.8%，显著低于人类平均 90%、峰值 98%。

2406.10215|v2.summary_cn: 论文关注视觉-语言模型与儿童语言学习轨迹的相似性问题，指出现有模型虽用较少数据训练，却常在成人级基准上评测，缺乏与行为数据的直接对比。为此提出 DevBench，包含词汇、句法、语义三大领域共七项语言评测任务，并配有儿童与成人的行为数据。实验发现模型与人类响应模式的接近程度因任务而异，任务表现越好的模型其响应模式越接近人类；对 OpenCLIP 训练轨迹的分析显示训练越充分越接近成人响应模式。
2406.10215|v2.summary_en: The paper introduces DevBench, a multimodal benchmark with seven language tasks spanning lexical, syntactic, and semantic abilities, paired with child and adult behavioral data, to compare vision-language models with human learning trajectories. Results show models' closeness to human response patterns varies by task and correlates with task accuracy, and OpenCLIP increasingly approximates adult patterns with more training.
2406.10215|v2.assessment: 该工作为模型与人类语言习得的对比提供了行为学基准，但偏认知科学方向，与自动驾驶视觉感知研究基本无关。
2406.10215|v2.contribution: 构建含儿童与成人行为数据的多模态语言发展评测基准 DevBench。
2406.10215|v2.innovation: 将模型评测从准确率扩展到与人类响应模式的一致性比较。
2406.10215|v2.result: 模型任务表现越好越接近人类响应模式，OpenCLIP 训练越充分越接近成人模式。

2410.08593|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视频语料时刻检索（VCMR）仅支持粗粒度理解、难以在细粒度查询下精确定位的问题，论文提出更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准，要求从语料中定位最佳匹配时刻并区分部分匹配候选。为高效构建高质量标注，提出 VERIFIED 自动视频-文本标注流水线，利用 LLM 与 LMM 结合静态与动态增强描述模块生成细粒度描述，并用细粒度感知噪声评估器微调视频基础模型以过滤幻觉标注。基于该流水线构建了更具挑战性的细粒度 VCMR 基准。

2406.14515|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统 VideoQA 基准难以覆盖完整视频内容、无法充分评估模型时序理解能力的问题，论文提出 MMBench-Video，一个面向长视频、多镜头、整体视频理解的定量基准。该基准采用 YouTube 长视频与自由形式问题，贴近实际使用场景，所有问题按精心构建的能力分类体系人工标注，并采用 GPT-4 进行自动评估，相比早期基于 LLM 的评估更准确稳健。基于该基准对专有与开源图像/视频 LVLM 进行了全面评测。

2406.14515|v2.assessment: 该基准针对长视频整体理解与时序推理评测，对视频理解方向有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2406.14515|v2.contribution: 提出面向长视频多镜头整体理解的定量评测基准 MMBench-Video。

2407.15754|v2.summary_cn: 针对长视频多模态理解缺乏公开评测基准的问题，论文提出 LongVideoBench，包含 3,763 段网络视频及其字幕、最长可达一小时的交错视频-语言输入。作者将核心挑战定义为从长输入中检索并推理细粒度多模态信息，并提出 referring reasoning 任务：问题中包含指向相关视频片段的 referring query，模型需在该片段上推理。基于此范式人工标注了 6,678 道多选题、覆盖 17 个细粒度类别，成为目前较全面的长视频理解基准之一。
2407.15754|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of public benchmarks for long-context multimodal understanding, the paper introduces LongVideoBench, comprising 3,763 web-collected videos with subtitles and interleaved video-language inputs up to one hour long. It formulates a referring reasoning task, where a referring query in the question points to relevant video context over which the model must reason, and curates 6,678 human-annotated multiple-choice questions across 17 fine-grained categories, establishing one of the most comprehensive long-form video understanding benchmarks.
2407.15754|v2.assessment: 为长视频多模态理解提供了规模较大、任务设计有区分度的评测基准，对 VLM/视频理解方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2407.15754|v2.contribution: 提出 LongVideoBench 长上下文交错视频-语言理解基准及 referring reasoning 任务范式。
2407.15754|v2.innovation: 以 referring query 显式定位相关视频片段，将长视频理解拆解为检索加细粒度推理。

2503.15024|v2.summary_cn: 针对AIGC时代伪造媒体多样化、缺乏系统评估LVLM取证能力的基准这一问题，作者提出Forensics-Bench，包含63,292道多选视觉问题，覆盖112种伪造检测类型，从伪造语义、模态、任务、类型和生成模型5个视角组织。相比已有工作，该基准首次大规模、多维度地评估LVLM的伪造识别、定位与推理能力。对22个开源LVLM及GPT-4o、Gemini 1.5 Pro、Claude等3个闭源模型进行了评测，揭示了现有模型在复杂伪造检测上的不足。
2503.15024|v2.summary_en: To address the lack of a comprehensive benchmark for assessing LVLMs' forgery detection capabilities amid increasingly diverse AIGC-generated fake media, the authors present Forensics-Bench, comprising 63,292 multi-choice visual questions covering 112 forgery detection types across five perspectives: forgery semantics, modalities, tasks, types, and models. It is the first large-scale, multi-dimensional benchmark requiring recognition, localization, and reasoning on diverse forgeries. Thorough evaluations on 22 open-source LVLMs and 3 proprietary models (GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude) reveal substantial limitations of current models.
2503.15024|v2.assessment: 作为伪造检测领域的综合性LVLM评测基准，覆盖面广、评测规模大，对多模态取证研究方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2503.15024|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖112种伪造类型、63,292道问题的LVLM伪造检测综合评测基准Forensics-Bench。
2503.15024|v2.innovation: 首次从伪造语义、模态、任务、类型和生成模型五个维度系统评估LVLM的伪造识别、定位与推理能力。
2503.15024|v2.result: 对22个开源和3个闭源LVLM的评测揭示了现有模型在复杂伪造检测任务上的显著不足。

2506.21549|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对工业制造中单实例3D异常检测与分割（ADS）问题，现有基准缺乏多视角多模态信息融合以及从合成数据到真实数据泛化的评估。作者提出了SiM3D基准，包含多视角高分辨率图像（12 Mpx）和点云（7M点）数据集，覆盖8类物体共333个实例，并提供CAD模型和人工标注的3D分割真值。相比已有单视角方法，SiM3D首次整合多视角多模态信息并关注合成到真实的泛化，同时提出了基于异常体积的新评估指标。实验通过适配主流单视角方法建立基线，为后续研究提供了标准化评测平台。
2506.21549|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single-instance 3D anomaly detection and segmentation (ADS) in manufacturing, where existing benchmarks lack multiview multimodal integration and synthetic-to-real generalization. The authors introduce SiM3D, the first benchmark with a novel multiview multimodal dataset (12 Mpx images, 7M point clouds, 333 instances, 8 object types) and manually annotated 3D segmentation ground truth. They adapt prominent singleview methods and propose novel metrics operating on Anomaly Volumes, establishing reference baselines for the multiview 3D ADS task.
2506.21549|v2.assessment: 该基准填补了多视角多模态3D异常检测的空白，对工业视觉检测领域有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的核心任务关联较弱。
2506.21549|v2.contribution: 提出了首个整合多视角多模态信息的单实例3D异常检测与分割基准SiM3D。
2506.21549|v2.innovation: 首次在3D ADS中同时考虑多视角多模态融合与合成到真实的泛化挑战，并引入基于异常体积的新评估指标。
2506.21549|v2.result: 构建了包含333个实例、8类物体的多视角多模态数据集，并建立了单视角方法的适配基线。

2408.11817|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient headroom of existing benchmarks for large multimodal models (LMMs) by introducing GRAB, a challenging graph analysis benchmark. Ablations investigate model strengths and weaknesses, and GRAB-Lite is released for lightweight evaluation.

2406.08035|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在长视频理解（数小时级别）上的能力不足，提出了LVBench长视频理解基准。现有评测数据集多聚焦于短视频（通常少于一分钟），无法满足具身智能长期决策、电影深度评论和体育直播解说等实际应用需求。LVBench包含公开来源的视频，涵盖多样化任务，旨在挑战模型的长时记忆和扩展理解能力。实验表明当前多模态模型在这些长视频任务上表现仍然不佳，作者呼吁通过LVBench推动更先进模型的发展。
2406.08035|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the gap in long video understanding (spanning several hours) for multimodal large language models, as existing benchmarks focus on short videos under one minute. The authors introduce LVBench, a benchmark comprising publicly sourced videos with diverse tasks designed to challenge long-term memory and extended comprehension. Extensive evaluations reveal that current multimodal models still underperform on these demanding tasks, motivating further model development.
2406.08035|v2.assessment: 长视频理解对自动驾驶中的长时序场景理解和决策有参考价值，该基准填补了长视频评测的空白。
2406.08035|v2.contribution: 提出了专门面向数小时级长视频理解的多模态评测基准LVBench。
2406.08035|v2.innovation: 针对现有基准仅覆盖短视频的不足，设计了挑战长时记忆和扩展理解能力的多样化任务。
2406.08035|v2.result: 实验表明当前多模态模型在长视频理解任务上表现仍不理想，具体数据未在摘要中给出。

2410.10139|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对交错多模态理解与生成（模型按任意顺序产生和解读图像与文本）的评测不足问题，提出了MMIE大规模知识密集型基准。现有基准在数据规模、覆盖范围和评测深度上存在局限，且评测指标成本高或有偏差。MMIE包含20K精心策划的多模态查询，覆盖3个类别、12个领域和102个子领域（含数学、编程、物理、文学、健康、艺术等），支持交错输入输出，提供选择题和开放式问题两种格式。作者还提出了基于人工标注数据微调评分模型的可靠自动评测指标，以降低偏差。
2410.10139|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the insufficient evaluation of interleaved multimodal comprehension and generation in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs). The authors introduce MMIE, a large-scale knowledge-intensive benchmark comprising 20K curated multimodal queries spanning 3 categories, 12 fields, and 102 subfields, supporting both interleaved inputs and outputs with multiple-choice and open-ended formats. They also propose a reliable automated evaluation metric leveraging a scoring model fine-tuned with human-annotated data to reduce bias.
2410.10139|v2.assessment: 该基准为交错多模态理解与生成提供了大规模评测方案，对多模态模型发展有推动作用，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较间接。
2410.10139|v2.contribution: 提出了包含20K查询、覆盖102个子领域的大规模交错多模态理解与生成基准MMIE。
2410.10139|v2.innovation: 支持交错输入输出格式，并提出基于微调评分模型的可靠自动评测指标以降低评估偏差。
2410.10139|v2.result: 构建了覆盖3类12领域102子领域的20K多模态查询基准，并提供了降低偏差的自动评测方案。

2502.19870|v2.summary_cn: 现有的大模型知识编辑基准主要针对以简单三元组表示的实体级知识，无法刻画真实世界多模态信息的复杂性。作者提出MMKE-Bench，包含视觉实体编辑、视觉语义编辑和用户特定编辑三类任务，并用自由形式的自然语言表示和编辑知识。基准涵盖33个大类、2940条知识和8363张图像，评估问题自动生成并经人工校验。作者在三种主流LMM上评测了五种最先进的知识编辑方法，揭示了现有方法在复杂视觉知识编辑上的不足。
2502.19870|v2.summary_en: Existing multimodal knowledge editing benchmarks focus on entity-level triplets and fail to capture real-world multimodal complexity. The authors introduce MMKE-Bench, covering visual entity editing, visual semantic editing, and user-specific editing, with free-form natural language knowledge representation. It contains 2,940 knowledge items and 8,363 images across 33 categories, and evaluates five state-of-the-art editing methods on three LMMs, exposing limitations of current approaches.
2502.19870|v2.assessment: 为多模态知识编辑提供了更贴近真实场景的评测基准，对关注LMM知识更新与多模态理解的研究者有参考价值。
2502.19870|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖三类编辑任务、规模达2940条知识与8363张图像的MMKE-Bench多模态知识编辑基准。
2502.19870|v2.innovation: 用自由形式自然语言替代三元组表示知识，并引入用户特定编辑任务以贴近真实应用。
2502.19870|v2.result: 在三种LMM上评测五种编辑方法，表明现有方法在复杂视觉知识编辑上仍有明显差距。

2408.13257|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM基准存在数据规模小、依赖模型标注、任务难度不足（尤其受限于图像分辨率）等问题，难以衡量真实世界的挑战。作者提出MME-RealWorld，从公开数据集和互联网收集超30万张图像，筛选出13366张高质量图像，由25名标注员和7名MLLM专家标注，生成29429个问答对，覆盖5个真实场景下的43个子任务。这是目前最大的人工标注基准，具有最高分辨率并聚焦真实应用，作者对28个主流MLLM进行了系统评测。
2408.13257|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLM benchmarks suffer from small scale, model-based annotations, and insufficient difficulty, especially due to limited image resolution. The authors propose MME-RealWorld, curating 13,366 high-quality images from over 300K candidates and producing 29,429 QA pairs across 43 subtasks in 5 real-world scenarios via 25 annotators and 7 experts. It is the largest manually annotated benchmark to date with the highest resolution, and 28 prominent MLLMs are thoroughly evaluated.
2408.13257|v2.assessment: 面向高分辨率真实场景的大规模人工标注基准，对评估和推动MLLM在复杂视觉任务上的能力很有价值。
2408.13257|v2.contribution: 构建了迄今最大、分辨率最高、聚焦真实应用的人工标注MLLM基准MME-RealWorld。
2408.13257|v2.innovation: 通过大规模人工标注与高分辨率图像设计，显著提升基准的任务难度与评测可靠性。
2408.13257|v2.result: 对28个主流MLLM的评测显示，即使最强模型在该基准上也面临巨大挑战。

2410.08474|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型在体育场景推理能力缺乏系统评测的问题，作者提出了SPORTU基准，包含900道人工标注解释的文本选择题（SPORTU-text）和覆盖7种运动、1701个慢动作视频片段与12048个QA对的视频评测集（SPORTU-video），用于从简单识别到犯规判定与规则应用的多层次推理评估。在SPORTU-text上以few-shot与CoT提示评测四个LLM，GPT-4o取得最高71%准确率但仍低于人类水平。该工作主要贡献在于构建了体育领域多层级多模态推理基准，但方法与自动驾驶感知研究关联较弱。
2410.08474|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces SPORTU, a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on multi-level sports reasoning, comprising 900 text-based multiple-choice questions with human-annotated explanations and 1,701 slow-motion video clips with 12,048 QA pairs across 7 sports. Evaluating four LLMs with few-shot and chain-of-thought prompting, GPT-4o reaches 71% accuracy on the text subset but remains below human performance. The contribution is a domain-specific benchmark for sports understanding rather than a new perception method.
2410.08474|v2.assessment: 属于体育领域多模态推理基准，与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等方向基本无关，仅对多模态评测方法学有间接参考价值。
2410.08474|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖文本与视频、多层级推理的体育理解多模态基准SPORTU。
2410.08474|v2.innovation: 将体育规则理解、犯规判定等复杂推理任务系统化为可量化评测的多模态QA基准。
2410.08474|v2.result: GPT-4o在SPORTU-text上达到71%准确率，仍低于人类水平。

2410.09732|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成内容泛滥导致真实与合成多模态数据难以区分的问题，作者提出LOKI基准，覆盖视频、图像、3D、文本与音频五种模态，包含26个子类别、约18K道难度分级的题目，并设计粗粒度判断、多选以及细粒度异常选择与解释任务。该基准用于系统评估LMM在合成数据检测中的感知、知识与推理能力，并评测了22个开源LMM。其价值在于提供跨模态合成数据检测的统一评测框架，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限。
2410.09732|v2.summary_en: To address the growing difficulty of distinguishing authentic from AI-generated multimodal content, this paper presents LOKI, a benchmark spanning video, image, 3D, text, and audio modalities with 18K curated questions across 26 subcategories and graded difficulty levels. It includes coarse-grained judgment, multiple-choice, and fine-grained anomaly selection and explanation tasks, and evaluates 22 open-source LMMs. The work provides a unified evaluation framework for synthetic data detection rather than advancing autonomous driving perception.
2410.09732|v2.assessment: 跨模态合成数据检测基准，方法学上有一定参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知/3D检测方向相关度低。
2410.09732|v2.contribution: 提出了覆盖五种模态、多难度层级的合成数据检测基准LOKI。
2410.09732|v2.innovation: 将合成数据检测细化为粗粒度判断与细粒度异常解释任务，并系统评测22个开源LMM。
2410.09732|v2.result: 构建了18K题、26个子类别的跨模态合成数据检测评测集并完成大规模LMM评测。

2601.10744|v2.summary_cn: 现有具身智能任务多为一次性任务，只关注任务完成结果，忽视了探索过程与长期记忆利用，难以支撑长时程终身学习。作者提出Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration (LMEE)设定，构建了包含多目标导航与基于记忆问答的LMEE-Bench基准，并设计了MemoryExplorer方法，通过强化学习微调多模态大语言模型以鼓励主动记忆查询，配合多任务奖励函数。相比已有工作，该框架统一了探索认知与决策行为，并同时评估过程与结果。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但为具身探索与记忆利用提供了系统性评测方案。
2601.10744|v2.summary_en: Existing embodied tasks are largely one-shot and focus only on task completion, neglecting the exploration process and long-term memory utilization needed for lifelong learning. The authors introduce Long-term Memory Embodied Exploration (LMEE), build the LMEE-Bench benchmark covering multi-goal navigation and memory-based QA, and propose MemoryExplorer, which fine-tunes a multimodal LLM via reinforcement learning with a multi-task reward to encourage active memory querying. This unifies exploratory cognition and decision-making and evaluates both process and outcome, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2601.10744|v2.assessment: 该工作将长期记忆与主动探索引入具身智能评测，基准设计有参考价值，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知/3D检测）关联较弱。
2601.10744|v2.contribution: 提出LMEE设定、LMEE-Bench基准及基于强化学习的MemoryExplorer方法，统一评估具身探索的过程与结果。
2601.10744|v2.innovation: 用强化学习微调多模态LLM实现主动记忆查询，并构建兼顾过程与结果的长期记忆探索基准。
2601.10744|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，主要贡献为基准与方法框架。

2601.06874|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D指代分割方法依赖稠密高质量点云，而机器人和手机等真实智能体仅有少量稀疏RGB视图且受严格时延约束。作者提出Multi-view 3D Referring Expression Segmentation (MV-3DRES)新任务，并设计MVGGT端到端框架，通过双分支设计将语言信息融入稀疏视图几何推理。针对稀疏3D信号导致的Foreground Gradient Dilution (FGD)优化障碍，提出Per-view No-target Suppression Optimization (PVSO)以提供更强更均衡的跨视图梯度。相比先重建点云再分割的两阶段流程，该方法避免了低质量几何与粗粒度目标区域，且速度更快。
2601.06874|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D referring expression segmentation relies on dense, high-quality point clouds, whereas real agents such as robots and phones only have sparse RGB views under strict latency constraints. The authors introduce Multi-view 3D Referring Expression Segmentation (MV-3DRES) and propose MVGGT, an end-to-end dual-branch framework that injects language into sparse-view geometric reasoning. To overcome Foreground Gradient Dilution (FGD) caused by sparse 3D signals, they introduce Per-view No-target Suppression Optimization (PVSO) for stronger, more balanced cross-view gradients, avoiding the low-quality geometry and coarse regions of two-stage pipelines while being faster.
2601.06874|v2.assessment: 面向稀疏多视图的3D指代分割新设定贴近真实部署，双分支设计与梯度优化思路对多相机3D感知有借鉴意义。
2601.06874|v2.contribution: 提出MV-3DRES任务与MVGGT端到端框架，并设计PVSO解决稀疏视图下的前景梯度稀释问题。
2601.06874|v2.innovation: 将语言融入稀疏视图几何推理的双分支设计，以及针对FGD的逐视图无目标抑制优化策略。
2601.06874|v2.result: 相比两阶段流程避免了低质量几何与粗粒度区域，并显著提升运行速度（摘要未给出具体数值）。

2601.05175|v2.summary_cn: 链式思维（CoT）推理在多模态大模型的视频理解中被广泛使用，但其相对直接回答的必要性与优势尚不明确。作者首先证明对RL训练的视频模型而言，直接回答常能匹配甚至超越CoT，尽管CoT计算成本更高。据此提出VideoAuto-R1，采用reason-when-necessary策略，训练时遵循Thinking Once, Answering Twice范式：先生成初始答案，再推理，最后输出复核答案，两个答案均通过可验证奖励监督；推理时依据初始答案置信度决定是否继续推理。在视频QA与grounding基准上取得SOTA精度，同时平均响应长度减少约3.3倍（如从149降至44 token），且在感知类任务上思考模式激活率很低。
2601.05175|v2.summary_en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely used in multimodal LLMs for video understanding, yet its necessity over direct answering is underexplored. The authors show that for RL-trained video models, direct answering often matches or surpasses CoT despite its higher cost, and propose VideoAuto-R1 with a reason-when-necessary strategy. Training follows a Thinking Once, Answering Twice paradigm where an initial answer, reasoning, and a reviewed answer are supervised by verifiable rewards, while inference uses the initial answer's confidence to decide whether to reason. It achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on video QA and grounding benchmarks while cutting average response length by ~3.3x (e.g., 149 to 44 tokens).
2601.05175|v2.assessment: 对CoT在视频理解中必要性的实证反思很有价值，自适应推理策略在效率与精度间取得良好平衡。
2601.05175|v2.contribution: 提出VideoAuto-R1自适应推理框架，通过Thinking Once, Answering Twice范式与置信度门控实现按需推理。
2601.05175|v2.innovation: 用可验证奖励同时监督初始答案与复核答案，并以初始答案置信度动态决定是否触发推理。
2601.05175|v2.result: 在视频QA与grounding基准上达到SOTA精度，平均响应长度减少约3.3倍（149→44 token）。

2601.01593|v2.summary_cn: 少样本字体生成（FFG）需从有限参考中同时保持结构完整性与风格保真度，但现有自回归模型受限于传统patch级tokenization，忽视全局依赖，且停留在图像到图像范式，忽略语言对风格意图的表达。作者提出GAR-Font多模态自回归框架，包含可同时捕捉局部结构与全局风格模式的全局感知tokenizer、通过轻量语言-风格适配器实现灵活风格控制的多模态风格编码器（无需大规模多模态预训练），以及进一步提升结构保真度的后精修流程。该工作将语言引入字体设计并改善全局一致性，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联很弱。
2601.01593|v2.summary_en: Few-shot font generation (FFG) must preserve both structural integrity and stylistic fidelity from limited references, but autoregressive models are constrained by patch-level tokenization that ignores global dependencies and by an image-to-image paradigm that overlooks language in conveying style. The authors propose GAR-Font, a multimodal AR framework with a global-aware tokenizer capturing local structures and global style patterns, a multimodal style encoder with a lightweight language-style adapter for flexible control without intensive pretraining, and a post-refinement pipeline. It improves global coherence and introduces language into font design, but is largely unrelated to autonomous driving perception.
2601.01593|v2.assessment: 在字体生成任务上引入全局感知tokenizer与语言风格控制有一定新意，但与本领域研究方向基本无关。
2601.01593|v2.contribution: 提出GAR-Font多模态自回归框架，用全局感知tokenizer与语言-风格适配器改进少样本字体生成。
2601.01593|v2.innovation: 将全局依赖建模与轻量语言风格控制引入自回归字体生成，摆脱纯图像到图像范式。
2601.01593|v2.result: 通过后精修流程提升结构保真度（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

2505.09484|v2.summary_cn: 多模态人脸防伪（FAS）在支付与监控等场景中至关重要，但现有方法受模态特定偏差与域偏移影响，泛化能力不足。作者提出多模态去噪与对齐（MMDA）框架，借助CLIP的零样本泛化能力，通过去噪与对齐机制抑制多模态数据噪声，增强跨模态对齐泛化性。其中Modality-Domain Joint Differential Attention (MD2A)模块基于提取的共性噪声特征精炼注意力，同时缓解域与模态噪声；Representation Space Soft (RS2) Alignment策略利用预训练CLIP将多域多模态数据柔性对齐到泛化表示空间。该工作提升了跨域跨模态泛化，但与人脸防伪之外的感知任务关联有限。
2505.09484|v2.summary_en: Multimodal face anti-spoofing (FAS) is critical for secure face recognition but suffers from modality-specific biases and domain shifts that hurt generalization. The authors propose the Multimodal Denoising and Alignment (MMDA) framework, leveraging CLIP's zero-shot generalization to suppress multimodal noise via denoising and alignment. Its Modality-Domain Joint Differential Attention (MD2A) refines attention based on common noise features to mitigate domain and modality noise, while the Representation Space Soft (RS2) Alignment strategy flexibly aligns multi-domain multimodal data into a generalized space using pretrained CLIP. It improves cross-domain and cross-modal generalization but has limited relevance beyond FAS.
2505.09484|v2.assessment: 利用CLIP零样本能力做去噪与对齐以提升多模态FAS泛化，思路清晰，但与本领域感知任务关联有限。
2505.09484|v2.contribution: 提出MMDA框架，通过MD2A与RS2对齐策略提升多模态人脸防伪的跨域泛化能力。
2505.09484|v2.innovation: 基于共性噪声特征的模态-域联合差分注意力，以及利用CLIP的柔性表示空间对齐策略。
2505.09484|v2.result: 显著增强跨模态对齐的泛化性能（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。

2511.07222|v2.summary_cn: 该文将统一多模态理解与生成扩展到基于多视图图像的3D场景，探索'生成促进理解'的原理。作者提出Omni-View，由理解模型、纹理模块与几何模块组成，联合建模场景理解、新视角合成与几何估计，利用纹理模块的时空建模能力与几何模块的显式几何约束相互增强，从而丰富对3D场景的整体理解。采用两阶段训练策略，在VSI-Bench基准上取得55.4的SOTA分数，超越现有专用3D理解模型，同时在新视角合成与3D场景生成上表现强劲，代码与预训练模型已开源。
2511.07222|v2.summary_en: This paper extends unified multimodal understanding and generation to 3D scenes from multiview images, exploring the principle that generation facilitates understanding. Omni-View jointly models scene understanding, novel view synthesis, and geometry estimation via an understanding model plus texture and geometry modules, where the texture module's spatiotemporal modeling and the geometry module's explicit constraints mutually reinforce holistic 3D understanding. Trained with a two-stage strategy, it achieves a state-of-the-art 55.4 on VSI-Bench, surpassing specialized 3D understanding models while also performing strongly on novel view synthesis and 3D scene generation, with code and pretrained models open-sourced.
2511.07222|v2.assessment: 统一理解与生成的多视图3D框架思路新颖，VSI-Bench SOTA与开源对多相机3D感知研究有参考价值。
2511.07222|v2.contribution: 提出Omni-View统一框架，联合建模多视图3D场景理解、新视角合成与几何估计。
2511.07222|v2.innovation: 通过纹理模块时空建模与几何模块显式约束的协同，实现'生成促进理解'的3D统一建模。
2511.07222|v2.result: 在VSI-Bench上取得55.4的SOTA分数，超越专用3D理解模型，并具备强新视角合成与3D生成能力。

2511.05271|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态模型在真实场景中需要主动调用外部工具（如代码执行、网络搜索）并整合到推理过程中的问题，提出了DeepEyesV2智能体多模态模型。方法上采用两阶段训练流程：先通过冷启动阶段建立工具使用模式，再用强化学习阶段精炼工具调用，并构建了包含工具使用有益样本的多样化训练数据集。相比直接强化学习无法诱导稳健工具使用行为的已有做法，该两阶段策略显著提升了工具调用的有效性。作者还提出了RealX-Bench基准，用于评估需要感知、搜索和推理多能力整合的真实世界多模态推理，并在该基准及多个代表性基准上验证了模型在真实理解、数学推理和搜索密集型任务上的有效性。
2511.05271|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of building agentic multimodal models that actively invoke external tools (e.g., code execution, web search) and integrate them into reasoning. It proposes DeepEyesV2 with a two-stage training pipeline—cold-start to establish tool-use patterns followed by reinforcement learning to refine invocation—along with a curated dataset containing tool-beneficial examples. The authors also introduce RealX-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for real-world multimodal reasoning requiring perception, search, and reasoning, and demonstrate effectiveness across real-world understanding, mathematical reasoning, and search-intensive tasks.
2511.05271|v2.assessment: 该工作探索了智能体多模态模型的两阶段训练范式，并提出了面向真实世界推理的基准，对多模态智能体研究有一定参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的核心方向关联较弱。
2511.05271|v2.contribution: 提出了DeepEyesV2智能体多模态模型及两阶段训练流程，并构建了RealX-Bench真实世界多模态推理基准。
2511.05271|v2.innovation: 通过冷启动加强化学习的两阶段训练解决直接强化学习无法诱导稳健工具使用行为的问题。
2511.05271|v2.result: 在RealX-Bench及多个代表性基准上验证了模型在真实理解、数学推理和搜索密集型任务上的有效性。

FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bir.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中基于环视单目相机的未来实例预测问题，即如何在鸟瞰图（BEV）中同时预测动态实例的未来位置与运动。作者提出了FIERY，一种概率性、时序性的BEV实例预测模型，利用环视单目图像直接预测BEV下的未来实例分割与运动流，并引入时序融合与概率建模以处理未来不确定性。相比已有工作，FIERY无需激光雷达或高精地图，且能输出多模态未来预测，在nuScenes数据集上取得了当时最优的BEV未来实例预测性能，显著优于基于单帧或确定性预测的基线方法。
FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bir.summary_en: This paper addresses future instance prediction in bird's-eye view (BEV) from surround monocular cameras for autonomous driving. It proposes FIERY, a probabilistic and temporal BEV prediction model that forecasts future instance segmentation and motion flow directly from multi-camera images, incorporating temporal fusion and probabilistic modeling to handle future uncertainty. Compared with prior work, FIERY requires neither LiDAR nor HD maps and produces multimodal future predictions, achieving state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes for BEV future instance prediction and substantially outperforming single-frame or deterministic baselines.
FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bir.assessment: 该工作将BEV感知从当前帧扩展到未来预测，是自动驾驶预测与BEV感知交叉方向的重要进展，对多相机BEV时序建模有较强参考价值。
FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bir.contribution: 提出了首个基于环视单目相机的概率性BEV未来实例预测框架FIERY。
FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bir.innovation: 将时序融合与概率未来建模统一到BEV实例预测中，无需LiDAR或高精地图即可输出多模态未来。
FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bir.result: 在nuScenes上取得当时最优的BEV未来实例预测性能，显著优于单帧与确定性基线。
FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bir._arxiv_id: FIERY: Future Instance Prediction in Bird's-Eye View from Surround Monocular Cameras.

BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Com.summary_cn: 该论文针对公共场所社交距离合规性评估问题，提出通过联合行人定位与几何推理来自动判断人与人之间是否保持安全距离。作者构建了BEV-Net，将行人检测与基于几何关系的距离推理结合，在鸟瞰视角下评估社交距离违规情况。相比仅做行人检测或简单距离阈值判断的已有方法，BEV-Net通过联合建模定位与几何关系提升了违规判定的准确性，并在相关数据集上验证了有效性。
BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Com.summary_en: This paper addresses social distancing compliance assessment in public spaces by jointly performing people localization and geometric reasoning. It proposes BEV-Net, which combines pedestrian detection with geometry-based distance reasoning in a bird's-eye view to evaluate social distancing violations. Compared with methods that only detect people or apply simple distance thresholds, BEV-Net improves violation determination through joint modeling of localization and geometric relations, and validates effectiveness on relevant datasets.
BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Com.assessment: 该工作属于行人检测与几何推理的应用型研究，与自动驾驶BEV感知在视角上有交集，但问题设定偏公共安全监控，对自动驾驶核心感知研究的相关性有限。
BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Com.contribution: 提出了联合行人定位与几何推理的BEV-Net用于社交距离合规评估。
BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Com.innovation: 将行人检测与鸟瞰视角下的几何距离推理联合建模以判定社交距离违规。
BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Com.result: 在相关数据集上验证了联合定位与几何推理对社交距离违规判定的有效性。
BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Com._arxiv_id: BEV-Net: Assessing Social Distancing Compliance by Joint People Localization and Geometric Reasoning.

2208.03624|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段3D检测器在稀疏且分布不均的室外点云上RoI特征提取效率低的问题，本文提出Graph R-CNN。方法包括：动态点聚合（patch search快速搜索局部点，动态最远体素采样按距离调整体素尺寸均匀采样）、RoI图池化（在采样点上构建局部图，通过迭代消息传递建模上下文和点关系）、视觉特征增强（融合图像语义补偿稀疏LiDAR点）。作为第二阶段可即插即用地提升现有单阶段检测器性能，在KITTI等数据集上取得了持续改进。
2208.03624|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency of RoI feature extraction from sparse and unevenly distributed outdoor point clouds in two-stage 3D detectors. It proposes Graph R-CNN with dynamic point aggregation (patch search and distance-adaptive farthest voxel sampling), RoI-graph pooling for contextual modeling via iterative message passing, and visual feature augmentation to compensate for sparse LiDAR points. As a second stage, it consistently improves existing one-stage detectors and achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks.
2208.03624|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了两阶段3D检测中稀疏点云RoI特征提取的关键瓶颈，图神经网络与动态采样的结合具有启发性，且可作为通用模块提升多种单阶段检测器。
2208.03624|v2.contribution: 提出Graph R-CNN两阶段3D检测框架，通过动态点聚合、RoI图池化和视觉特征增强实现高效准确的RoI特征提取。
2208.03624|v2.innovation: 将局部图构建与迭代消息传递引入RoI特征提取，并结合距离自适应体素采样和图像语义补偿。
2208.03624|v2.result: 在KITTI等3D检测基准上持续提升现有单阶段检测器性能，达到领先水平。

2207.07601|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有自动驾驶多阶段离散流水线难以联合优化的问题，本文提出可解释的纯视觉端到端框架ST-P3。方法包括：自车对齐累积技术在BEV变换前保留3D几何信息用于感知；双路径建模考虑历史运动变化用于预测；基于时间的细化单元补偿视觉元素识别用于规划。这是首个系统研究可解释端到端视觉自动驾驶各组成部分的工作，在nuScenes等基准上验证了有效性。
2207.07601|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitations of multi-stage discrete pipelines in autonomous driving by proposing ST-P3, an interpretable end-to-end vision-based framework with joint spatial-temporal feature learning. It introduces egocentric-aligned accumulation for perception, dual-pathway modeling for prediction, and a temporal-based refinement unit for planning. As the first systematic study of each component in an interpretable end-to-end vision-based system, it benchmarks favorably against prior methods.
2207.07601|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地拆解并优化了可解释端到端视觉自动驾驶的感知、预测和规划模块，时空特征学习方案对后续研究具有参考价值。
2207.07601|v2.contribution: 提出ST-P3端到端视觉自动驾驶框架，通过时空特征学习同时优化感知、预测和规划任务。
2207.07601|v2.innovation: 自车对齐累积、双路径预测建模和基于时间的规划细化单元，实现可解释的端到端联合学习。
2207.07601|v2.result: 在nuScenes等基准上验证了各模块的有效性，性能优于已有端到端方法。

2205.13764|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流BEV方法依赖复杂体素化和稀疏卷积的问题，本文提出FCOS-LiDAR，一种在LiDAR距离视图（RV）上直接使用标准2D卷积的全卷积单阶段3D检测器。首次证明仅用2D卷积的RV检测器可达到与SOTA BEV检测器相当的性能，且更快更简单。此外，提出新颖的距离视图投影机制解决多帧点云融合难题，首次展示多帧RV检测的增益。
2205.13764|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes FCOS-LiDAR, a fully convolutional one-stage 3D detector that operates on LiDAR range images using only standard 2D convolutions, avoiding complex voxelization and sparse convolutions of BEV methods. It is the first to show that an RV-based detector with 2D convolutions alone achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art BEV detectors while being significantly faster and simpler. A novel range view projection mechanism enables multi-frame point cloud fusion, demonstrating benefits for the first time.
2205.13764|v2.assessment: 该工作挑战了BEV主导范式，证明距离视图结合标准2D卷积的简洁方案可达到竞争性性能，多帧融合机制对实际部署有重要价值。
2205.13764|v2.contribution: 提出FCOS-LiDAR，首个在LiDAR距离视图上仅用2D卷积达到SOTA性能的全卷积单阶段3D检测器。
2205.13764|v2.innovation: 距离视图投影机制实现多帧点云融合，摒弃体素化和稀疏卷积，大幅简化检测流程。
2205.13764|v2.result: 性能与SOTA BEV检测器相当，速度显著更快，且多帧融合带来额外增益。

2210.07681|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目多目标跟踪中长时遮挡难以桥接的问题（现有SOTA对超过3秒的遮挡桥接率不足10%），本文提出通过未来轨迹预测来缩小关联搜索空间。方法在鸟瞰图空间中进行推理，生成少量但多样的轨迹预测并考虑定位不确定性。在MOTChallenge数据集上显著提升了SOTA跟踪器的长期跟踪性能。
2210.07681|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of bridging long occlusion gaps in monocular multi-object tracking, where state-of-the-art trackers bridge less than 10% of occlusions longer than three seconds. It proposes reasoning about future trajectories in bird's-eye view space, generating a small yet diverse set of forecasts while accounting for localization uncertainty. Experiments on MOTChallenge show significant improvements in long-term tracking performance.
2210.07681|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了轨迹预测对长时跟踪的关键作用，BEV空间推理和不确定性建模的思路对跟踪领域有启发，但整体贡献相对聚焦。
2210.07681|v2.contribution: 提出利用未来轨迹预测缩小长时遮挡下的关联搜索空间，提升多目标跟踪的长期鲁棒性。
2210.07681|v2.innovation: 在鸟瞰图空间生成少量多样且考虑定位不确定性的轨迹预测，用于长时遮挡关联。
2210.07681|v2.result: 在MOTChallenge上显著提升SOTA跟踪器的长期跟踪性能，桥接更多长时遮挡。

BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Inte.summary_cn: 针对BEV语义分割中现有Transformer方法多为单向或晚期交互、跨视角与跨尺度信息融合不充分的问题，本文提出BAEFormer，采用双向（BEV到图像、图像到BEV）与早期交互的Transformer结构，在特征提取阶段即进行视角间信息交换。相比已有单向或晚期融合方案，该方法增强了视角间与尺度间的表征交互。在nuScenes等BEV分割基准上取得了优于同期Transformer方法的精度。
BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Inte.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-view and cross-scale interaction in existing Transformer-based BEV semantic segmentation, which typically relies on unidirectional or late interaction. BAEFormer introduces bi-directional (BEV-to-image and image-to-BEV) and early-interaction Transformers that exchange information across views during feature extraction. It achieves improved accuracy over contemporary Transformer-based methods on BEV segmentation benchmarks such as nuScenes.
BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Inte.assessment: BEV分割中视角交互设计的改进工作，思路清晰，对多相机感知研究者有参考价值。
BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Inte.contribution: 提出双向且早期交互的Transformer架构用于BEV语义分割。
BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Inte.innovation: 在特征提取早期即实现BEV与图像视角的双向信息交换。
BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Inte.result: 在BEV分割基准上取得优于同期Transformer方法的精度。
BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Inte._arxiv_id: BAEFormer: Bi-Directional and Early Interaction Transformers for Bird's Eye View Semantic Segmentation.

BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Trainin.summary_cn: 针对深度补全任务中稀疏LiDAR与图像融合不充分、深度估计精度受限的问题，本文提出BEV@DC，利用鸟瞰图（BEV）表示辅助训练深度补全网络，将点云投影到BEV空间以提供全局几何先验，并与图像特征进行融合。相比仅在透视视角做融合的方法，BEV辅助训练提供了更结构化的空间监督。在KITTI深度补全基准上取得了有竞争力的精度提升。
BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Trainin.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient fusion between sparse LiDAR and images in depth completion by proposing BEV@DC, which leverages bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations to assist training. Point clouds are projected into BEV space to provide global geometric priors that are fused with image features, offering more structured spatial supervision than perspective-view-only fusion. It achieves competitive accuracy improvements on the KITTI depth completion benchmark.
BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Trainin.assessment: 将BEV表示引入深度补全训练的思路新颖，对自动驾驶感知中的几何先验利用有启发。
BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Trainin.contribution: 提出BEV辅助训练的深度补全框架BEV@DC。
BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Trainin.innovation: 利用BEV空间投影为深度补全提供全局几何先验并与图像融合。
BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Trainin.result: 在KITTI深度补全基准上取得有竞争力的精度提升。
BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Trainin._arxiv_id: BEV@DC: Bird's-Eye View Assisted Training for Depth Completion.

BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Dri.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶感知中多模态（相机、LiDAR、雷达等）融合效率低、模态间对齐困难的问题，本文提出BEV引导的多模态融合方法，利用BEV表示作为统一空间对多种传感器特征进行对齐与融合。相比在透视或点云空间分别融合的方案，BEV引导提供了统一的几何参考系。在自动驾驶感知基准上验证了融合带来的检测/分割性能提升。
BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Dri.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient multi-modality fusion and cross-modal misalignment in driving perception by proposing a BEV-guided fusion approach that uses BEV representations as a unified space to align and fuse features from multiple sensors. Compared with fusion in perspective or point-cloud spaces, the BEV guidance provides a consistent geometric reference frame. Experiments on driving perception benchmarks demonstrate improved detection/segmentation performance.
BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Dri.assessment: BEV作为多模态统一对齐空间的思路契合当前趋势，对多传感器融合研究者有参考意义。
BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Dri.contribution: 提出以BEV为统一空间的引导式多模态融合框架。
BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Dri.innovation: 利用BEV表示对齐并融合多种传感器特征。
BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Dri.result: 在自动驾驶感知基准上验证了融合带来的性能提升。
BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Dri._arxiv_id: BEV-Guided Multi-Modality Fusion for Driving Perception.

BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detect.summary_cn: 针对3D车道线检测中透视畸变导致的车道几何建模困难与效率问题，本文提出BEV-LaneDet，通过虚拟相机将图像转换到统一的BEV空间，并基于关键点表示进行车道线检测。相比直接在透视视图或依赖复杂3D先验的方法，虚拟相机与关键点表示简化了几何建模并提升了效率。在OpenLane等3D车道检测基准上取得了有竞争力的精度与速度。
BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detect.summary_en: This paper tackles perspective distortion and inefficiency in 3D lane detection by proposing BEV-LaneDet, which uses a virtual camera to transform images into a unified BEV space and detects lanes via key-point representations. Compared with perspective-view methods or those relying on complex 3D priors, the virtual camera and key-point design simplify geometric modeling and improve efficiency. It achieves competitive accuracy and speed on 3D lane benchmarks such as OpenLane.
BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detect.assessment: 虚拟相机+关键点的3D车道检测方案简洁高效，对BEV感知与车道检测研究者有实用价值。
BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detect.contribution: 提出基于虚拟相机与关键点的高效3D车道检测方法BEV-LaneDet。
BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detect.innovation: 用虚拟相机统一BEV空间并以关键点表示车道线。
BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detect.result: 在3D车道检测基准上取得有竞争力的精度与效率。
BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detect._arxiv_id: BEV-LaneDet: An Efficient 3D Lane Detection Based on Virtual Camera via Key-Points.

2309.15109|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机BEV 3D检测与LiDAR检测之间因深度与几何信息缺失而存在的显著性能差距，本文提出DistillBEV，通过跨模态知识蒸馏让多相机BEV学生检测器模仿训练良好的LiDAR教师检测器的特征。方法引入有效的平衡策略使学生聚焦于教师的关键特征，并将知识迁移扩展到多尺度层与时间融合。在nuScenes上对多种代表性多相机BEV模型均带来显著提升，达到当时的最优性能。
2309.15109|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance gap between multi-camera BEV and LiDAR-based 3D detection caused by missing depth and geometric cues, proposing DistillBEV, a cross-modal knowledge distillation framework where a multi-camera BEV student imitates features of a well-trained LiDAR teacher. It introduces an effective balancing strategy to focus the student on crucial teacher features and generalizes knowledge transfer to multi-scale layers with temporal fusion. Extensive experiments on nuScenes show significant improvements across representative multi-camera BEV models, achieving state-of-the-art performance.
2309.15109|v2.assessment: 跨模态蒸馏提升纯视觉BEV检测的思路实用且效果显著，对多相机3D检测研究者高度相关。
2309.15109|v2.contribution: 提出跨模态知识蒸馏框架DistillBEV以提升多相机BEV 3D检测。
2309.15109|v2.innovation: 用LiDAR教师特征蒸馏多相机BEV学生，并引入平衡策略与多尺度时间融合迁移。
2309.15109|v2.result: 在nuScenes上对多种BEV模型显著提升并达到当时SOTA。

2306.08528|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于序列图像的相机3D检测方法多采用朴素融合（如拼接）或局限于静态场景、忽视物体运动线索的问题，本文提出P2D（Predict to Detect），将预测机制融入检测框架以显式提取并利用运动特征。P2D仅用过去帧预测当前帧的物体信息以学习时序运动特征，并基于预测的物体信息对BEV特征进行注意力式时序聚合。实验表明P2D相比序列图像基线在mAP和NDS上分别提升3.0%和3.7%。
2306.08528|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of sequential-image camera-based 3D detection, where prior works rely on naive fusion (e.g., concatenation) or are restricted to static scenes, neglecting object motion cues. It proposes P2D (Predict to Detect), which integrates a prediction scheme into the detection framework to explicitly extract and leverage motion features: it predicts current-frame object information solely from past frames and then attentively aggregates BEV features based on these predictions. Experiments show P2D improves mAP and NDS by 3.0% and 3.7% over the sequential-image baseline.
2306.08528|v2.assessment: 显式建模物体运动并用于BEV时序聚合的思路新颖，对时序多相机3D检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2306.08528|v2.contribution: 提出融合预测机制的时序3D检测框架P2D。
2306.08528|v2.innovation: 仅用过去帧预测当前物体信息并据此注意力聚合BEV特征以利用运动线索。
2306.08528|v2.result: 相比序列图像基线mAP提升3.0%、NDS提升3.7%。

2308.08140|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR 3D检测器在跨域部署时因域间特征分布差异导致性能严重下降的问题，现有域自适应方法未充分考虑特征空间的分布对齐。本文提出GPA-3D框架，利用点云目标的内在几何关系，为不同几何结构的点云目标分配可学习的定制原型，在BEV特征空间中对齐源域与目标域对应目标的特征，从而减小分布差异。在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI等多个基准上的实验验证了方法的有效性，提升了跨域迁移性能。
2308.08140|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance degradation of LiDAR-based 3D detectors when deployed in unseen domains due to feature-space distribution discrepancy. It proposes GPA-3D, a geometry-aware prototype alignment framework that assigns learnable prototypes to point cloud objects with distinct geometric structures and aligns their BEV features across source and target domains. Evaluations on Waymo, nuScenes, and KITTI demonstrate improved cross-domain transferability.
2308.08140|v2.assessment: 将几何先验引入原型对齐以解决3D域自适应问题，思路清晰且在多数据集上验证，对LiDAR跨域检测研究者有参考价值。
2308.08140|v2.contribution: 提出几何感知原型对齐框架GPA-3D，通过可学习原型在BEV空间对齐源域与目标域点云目标特征。
2308.08140|v2.innovation: 利用点云目标的几何结构差异分配定制原型，显式建模并缩小跨域特征分布差异。
2308.08140|v2.result: 在Waymo、nuScenes和KITTI等基准上验证了跨域3D检测性能的提升。

2308.09244|v2.summary_cn: 针对纯视觉BEV 3D检测中稠密方法依赖复杂视角变换和高计算成本、而稀疏query方法性能落后于稠密方法的问题，本文指出性能差距的关键在于检测器在BEV与图像空间的适应性。提出全稀疏检测器SparseBEV，包含尺度自适应自注意力、自适应时空采样和自适应混合三个关键设计。在nuScenes测试集上达到67.5 NDS的SOTA性能，超越稠密方法。
2308.09244|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance gap between sparse query-based and dense BEV 3D detectors, attributing it to limited adaptability in both BEV and image space. It proposes SparseBEV, a fully sparse detector with scale-adaptive self-attention, adaptive spatio-temporal sampling, and adaptive mixing. SparseBEV achieves state-of-the-art 67.5 NDS on the nuScenes test split, surpassing dense counterparts.
2308.09244|v2.assessment: 全稀疏多相机3D检测的强基线工作，性能超越稠密方法且设计简洁，对BEV与稀疏检测方向研究者高度相关。
2308.09244|v2.contribution: 提出全稀疏多相机3D检测器SparseBEV，通过三项自适应设计弥合稀疏与稠密方法的性能差距。
2308.09244|v2.innovation: 尺度自适应自注意力与查询引导的自适应时空采样和动态权重混合，实现BEV与图像空间的双重适应性。
2308.09244|v2.result: 在nuScenes测试集上取得67.5 NDS的SOTA性能，超越稠密检测方法。

Parametric Depth Based Feature Represent.summary_cn: 该论文标题涉及基于参数化深度的特征表示学习，用于BEV视角下的目标检测与分割。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法、改进点和实验数据。从标题推测，工作可能围绕利用参数化深度分布构建BEV特征以提升检测与分割性能。建议获取全文后进一步评估。
Parametric Depth Based Feature Represent.summary_en: This paper concerns parametric depth based feature representation learning for object detection and segmentation in bird's-eye view. As the abstract is unavailable, the specific method, improvements, and quantitative results cannot be assessed. The work likely leverages parametric depth distributions to construct BEV features for detection and segmentation.
Parametric Depth Based Feature Represent.assessment: 摘要缺失导致无法充分评估，仅从标题看与BEV感知相关，需获取全文后再判断其价值。
Parametric Depth Based Feature Represent.contribution: 提出基于参数化深度的BEV特征表示学习方法用于检测与分割（信息不完整）。
Parametric Depth Based Feature Represent.innovation: 可能在于利用参数化深度建模提升BEV特征质量（待确认）。
Parametric Depth Based Feature Represent.result: 因摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Parametric Depth Based Feature Represent._arxiv_id: Parametric Depth Based Feature Representation Learning for Object Detection and Segmentation in Bird's-Eye View.

2308.10515|v2.summary_cn: 针对BEV多视图3D检测模型内存消耗大、延迟高难以部署，而直接量化会导致训练不稳定和性能严重下降的问题，本文提出QD-BEV，引入视图引导蒸馏（VGD）目标，利用图像特征和BEV特征稳定量化感知训练并提升性能。在nuScenes上，4-bit权重6-bit激活的QD-BEV-Tiny仅15.8MB即达37.2% NDS，比BevFormer-Tiny高1.8%且模型压缩8倍；Small和Base变体分别达47.9% NDS。
2308.10515|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of BEV multi-view 3D detectors caused by high memory and latency, showing that naive quantization leads to unstable training and severe degradation. It proposes QD-BEV with a view-guided distillation objective leveraging both image and BEV features to stabilize QAT and boost performance. On nuScenes, the 4-bit weight/6-bit activation QD-BEV-Tiny achieves 37.2% NDS with only 15.8 MB, outperforming BevFormer-Tiny by 1.8% with 8x compression.
2308.10515|v2.assessment: 面向BEV检测模型部署的量化与蒸馏结合方案，效率提升显著且精度不降，对车载部署研究者有实用价值。
2308.10515|v2.contribution: 提出QD-BEV量化感知框架，通过视图引导蒸馏实现BEV多视图3D检测的高效压缩部署。
2308.10515|v2.innovation: 利用图像与BEV双空间特征的视图引导蒸馏稳定量化训练并补偿量化精度损失。
2308.10515|v2.result: QD-BEV-Tiny以15.8MB达37.2% NDS，压缩8倍且超BevFormer-Tiny 1.8%，Small/Base达47.9% NDS。

2307.11477|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有BEV多视图3D检测器将所有图像特征变换到BEV时，大量背景信息淹没目标信息的问题，本文提出语义感知BEV池化SA-BEVPool，依据图像特征语义分割过滤背景并生成语义感知BEV特征；同时提出BEV-Paste数据增强策略和多尺度跨任务MSCT头以更准确预测深度分布与语义分割。在nuScenes上取得SOTA性能。
2307.11477|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing BEV multi-view 3D detectors transform all image features into BEV, letting abundant background information submerge object features. It proposes Semantic-Aware BEV Pooling (SA-BEVPool) to filter background via semantic segmentation, along with the BEV-Paste augmentation and a Multi-Scale Cross-Task head. SA-BEV achieves state-of-the-art performance on nuScenes.
2307.11477|v2.assessment: 从背景抑制角度改进BEV特征质量，模块设计合理且配套增强与跨任务头，对多视图BEV检测研究者有借鉴意义。
2307.11477|v2.contribution: 提出SA-BEV框架，通过语义感知BEV池化、BEV-Paste增强和多尺度跨任务头提升多视图3D检测。
2307.11477|v2.innovation: 利用语义分割过滤背景生成语义感知BEV特征，并设计与之匹配的数据增强和跨任务预测头。

2307.08209|v2.summary_cn: 针对体素法3D检测计算与内存开销大、LiDAR点云中大量冗余背景点导致3D体素和稠密BEV表示存在空间冗余的问题，本文提出自适应推理框架Ada3D，利用轻量重要性预测器和LiDAR点云特性自适应过滤冗余输入，并通过稀疏保持批归一化利用BEV特征内在稀疏性。在不损失精度的情况下减少40%的3D体素，将2D BEV特征图密度从100%降至20%，计算与内存成本降低5倍，端到端GPU延迟优化1.52x/1.45x，峰值内存优化1.5x/4.5x。
2307.08209|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the high computation and memory cost of voxel-based 3D detectors caused by spatial redundancy from abundant background points in LiDAR point clouds. It proposes Ada3D, an adaptive inference framework that filters redundant input via a lightweight importance predictor and exploits BEV feature sparsity with Sparsity Preserving Batch Normalization. Ada3D reduces 3D voxels by 40% and BEV map density from 100% to 20% without accuracy loss, cutting cost by 5x with 1.52x/1.45x latency and 1.5x/4.5x peak memory improvements.
2307.08209|v2.assessment: 从输入级空间冗余入手做自适应推理，精度无损且加速与省内存效果显著，对车载高效3D检测部署很有价值。
2307.08209|v2.contribution: 提出自适应推理框架Ada3D，通过过滤冗余输入和保持BEV稀疏性实现高效3D目标检测。
2307.08209|v2.innovation: 结合轻量重要性预测器与LiDAR点云特性自适应过滤输入，并引入稀疏保持批归一化利用BEV内在稀疏性。
2307.08209|v2.result: 精度无损下减少40%体素、BEV密度降至20%，成本降5倍，延迟优化1.52x/1.45x，峰值内存优化1.5x/4.5x。

2302.14325|v2.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR地点识别在视角变化和场景变化下性能退化的问题，本文提出利用鸟瞰图（BEV）图像作为新的表示形式。作者发现BEV图像的结构内容受点云旋转和平移影响较小，设计了一个旋转不变网络BEVPlace，使用群卷积提取旋转等变局部特征，并用NetVLAD进行全局特征聚合。此外，观察到BEV特征距离与点云几何距离相关，据此开发了位置估计方法。实验表明，简单的VGGNet在BEV图像上训练即可达到与最先进方法相当的性能，而BEVPlace在鲁棒性上更优。
2302.14325|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance degradation of LiDAR-based place recognition under viewpoint and scene changes by exploring bird's eye view (BEV) images as a representation. It proposes BEVPlace, a rotation-invariant network using group convolution for rotation-equivariant local features and NetVLAD for global aggregation, and leverages the correlation between BEV feature distance and geometric distance for position estimation. A simple VGGNet on BEV images achieves comparable performance to state-of-the-art methods, while BEVPlace improves robustness.
2302.14325|v2.assessment: 该工作为LiDAR地点识别提供了新视角，利用BEV图像的旋转不变性，方法简洁有效，且展示了位置估计的潜力，值得关注。
2302.14325|v2.contribution: 提出基于BEV图像的旋转不变地点识别网络BEVPlace，并利用特征距离进行位置估计。
2302.14325|v2.innovation: 首次探索BEV图像在LiDAR地点识别中的潜力，并设计群卷积与NetVLAD结合的旋转不变网络。
2302.14325|v2.result: 简单VGGNet在BEV图像上达到与SOTA相当的性能，BEVPlace在视角变化下更鲁棒。

2309.05192|v2.summary_cn: 自动驾驶感知模型需要适应不同相机视角，但现有模型对视角变化敏感，且为每种车型重新采集标注数据成本高昂。本文以BEV分割为任务，通过大量实验发现，当训练和推理时相机俯仰角、偏航角、深度或高度发生微小变化，性能会大幅下降。为此，作者提出一种新视角合成技术，将采集的数据变换到目标相机配置的视角，从而无需额外数据即可训练适应不同车型的BEV分割模型。实验表明该方法能有效提升跨视角的泛化能力。
2309.05192|v2.summary_en: This paper studies the sensitivity of BEV segmentation models to camera viewpoint changes and proposes a novel view synthesis technique to transform data to target rig viewpoints, enabling training for diverse camera configurations without additional data collection. Extensive experiments show that existing models suffer large performance drops under small changes in pitch, yaw, depth, or height, while the proposed method improves cross-viewpoint robustness.
2309.05192|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了BEV感知模型对相机视角的脆弱性，并提出实用的数据增强方案，对自动驾驶跨车型部署有重要价值。
2309.05192|v2.contribution: 提出一种新视角合成技术，使BEV分割模型能适应不同相机配置而无需重复采集数据。
2309.05192|v2.innovation: 首次系统研究相机视角变化对BEV分割的影响，并利用视角合成实现跨车型泛化。
2309.05192|v2.result: 现有模型在视角微小变化下性能大幅下降，所提方法有效提升了跨视角的BEV分割性能。

2308.12963|v2.summary_cn: 现有BEV感知模型生成的语义地图布局不够真实连贯，且无法处理传感器部分信息（如遮挡或有限覆盖）带来的不确定性。本文提出MapPrior，将传统判别式BEV感知模型与学习到的生成模型相结合，用于语义地图布局估计。该框架能输出更准确、更真实且具有不确定性感知的预测。在nuScenes基准上，MapPrior在相机和LiDAR-based BEV感知中均优于最强竞争方法，显著提升了MMD和ECE分数。
2308.12963|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MapPrior, a BEV perception framework that combines a discriminative model with a generative model for semantic map layout estimation, addressing unrealistic layouts and uncertainty from partial sensor information. On nuScenes, MapPrior outperforms the strongest competing method with significantly improved MMD and ECE scores in both camera- and LiDAR-based BEV perception.
2308.12963|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地将生成模型引入BEV感知，提升了地图布局的真实性和不确定性建模能力，对下游规划有重要意义。
2308.12963|v2.contribution: 提出结合判别式与生成式模型的BEV感知框架MapPrior，实现更真实且不确定性感知的语义地图布局估计。
2308.12963|v2.innovation: 首次将生成模型用于BEV语义地图布局估计，以处理部分观测下的不确定性。
2308.12963|v2.result: 在nuScenes上，MMD和ECE分数显著优于最强竞争方法。

2308.04758|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言导航（VLN）中，现有智能体基于全景观测，难以感知3D场景几何且易导致视角选择模糊。本文提出BEV场景图（BSG），利用多步BEV表示在3D检测监督下编码室内环境的场景布局和几何线索。导航过程中，BSG每步构建局部BEV表示并维护全局BEV场景地图，基于此预测局部BEV网格级和全局图级决策分数，并结合子视图选择分数进行动作预测。在REVERIE、R2R和R4R数据集上显著优于现有方法。
2308.04758|v2.summary_en: This paper presents a BEV Scene Graph (BSG) for vision-language navigation (VLN), which encodes scene layouts and geometric cues using multi-step BEV representations under 3D detection supervision. The agent builds local BEV representations and maintains a global BEV-based scene map, predicting local grid-level and global graph-level decision scores combined with sub-view selection scores. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on REVERIE, R2R, and R4R.
2308.04758|v2.assessment: 该工作将BEV感知引入VLN，通过场景图增强几何理解，在多个基准上取得显著提升，展示了BEV在导航任务中的潜力。
2308.04758|v2.contribution: 提出BEV场景图（BSG），利用多步BEV表示和全局地图提升视觉语言导航的决策准确性。
2308.04758|v2.innovation: 首次将BEV表示与场景图结合用于VLN，实现局部与全局决策融合。
2308.04758|v2.result: 在REVERIE、R2R和R4R上显著超越现有方法。

From a Bird's Eye View to See: Joint Cam.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机系统中相机与目标联合配准依赖相机标定、标定误差会导致配准失败的问题，提出了一种无需相机标定的联合相机与目标配准方法。方法从鸟瞰图（BEV）视角出发，通过联合优化相机参数与目标位置，在无标定条件下实现相机与目标的对应关系估计。相比依赖精确标定的传统方法，该工作降低了对标定精度的依赖，提升了在标定不准或缺失场景下的鲁棒性。摘要未提供具体量化结果，需结合正文实验验证其有效性。
From a Bird's Eye View to See: Joint Cam.summary_en: This paper addresses joint camera and subject registration in multi-camera systems without relying on camera calibration, which is prone to errors in practice. It proposes a bird's-eye-view-based approach that jointly estimates camera parameters and subject locations, reducing dependence on accurate calibration. The method improves robustness in scenarios with missing or inaccurate calibration, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
From a Bird's Eye View to See: Joint Cam.assessment: 该工作切中多相机感知中标定依赖这一实际痛点，思路有价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与泛化性。
From a Bird's Eye View to See: Joint Cam.contribution: 提出一种无需相机标定的联合相机与目标配准框架。
From a Bird's Eye View to See: Joint Cam.innovation: 从BEV视角联合优化相机参数与目标位置，摆脱对标定的依赖。
From a Bird's Eye View to See: Joint Cam.result: 在无标定条件下实现相机与目标配准，具体指标需见正文。

Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segme.summary_cn: 该论文针对BEV语义分割中任务耦合导致性能受限的问题，提出通过任务分解来改进BEV语义分割。方法将BEV语义分割分解为多个子任务分别处理，以降低任务间的干扰并提升各子任务的学习效率。相比直接端到端预测的整体式方法，任务分解有助于更精细地建模不同语义类别与空间结构。摘要未给出具体量化结果，需结合实验验证其提升幅度。
Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segme.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance bottleneck in bird's-eye-view (BEV) semantic segmentation caused by entangled task objectives. It proposes a task decomposition strategy that splits BEV segmentation into sub-tasks to reduce interference and improve learning efficiency. Compared with monolithic end-to-end approaches, the decomposition enables finer modeling of semantic categories and spatial structures, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segme.assessment: 任务分解思路在BEV分割中具有一定新意，若实验充分可对BEV感知研究有参考价值。
Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segme.contribution: 提出基于任务分解的BEV语义分割改进方法。
Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segme.innovation: 将BEV语义分割解耦为多个子任务以降低任务间干扰。
Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segme.result: 通过任务分解提升BEV语义分割性能，具体指标需见正文。
Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segme._arxiv_id: Improving Bird's Eye View Semantic Segmentation by Task Decomposition.

2407.10135|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图BEV 3D目标检测中跨模态蒸馏因数据模态与网络结构差异导致特征分布不一致、知识迁移困难的问题，提出了前景自蒸馏（FSD）方案。FSD无需预训练教师模型或复杂蒸馏策略，通过自蒸馏避免分布差异问题；同时设计两种点云增强（PCI）策略，通过帧组合与伪点分配补偿点云稀疏性，并开发多尺度前景增强（MSFE）模块提取融合多尺度前景特征。相比依赖跨模态教师的蒸馏方法，FSD在无需教师模型的情况下保持显著蒸馏效果，提升了多视图3D检测性能。
2407.10135|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of cross-modal distillation in multi-view BEV 3D object detection, where feature distribution discrepancies between modalities and network structures hinder knowledge transfer. It proposes a Foreground Self-Distillation (FSD) scheme that avoids distribution discrepancies without pre-trained teachers or complex strategies, along with two Point Cloud Intensification (PCI) strategies to compensate for point cloud sparsity and a Multi-Scale Foreground Enhancement (MSFE) module for multi-scale foreground feature fusion. FSD achieves remarkable distillation effects without teacher models, improving multi-view 3D detection performance.
2407.10135|v2.assessment: 自蒸馏思路巧妙规避了跨模态蒸馏的分布差异难题，且无需教师模型，实用性强，值得BEV检测研究者关注。
2407.10135|v2.contribution: 提出无需教师模型的前景自蒸馏方案及点云增强与多尺度前景增强模块。
2407.10135|v2.innovation: 以前景自蒸馏替代跨模态蒸馏，避免模态与结构差异导致的分布不一致。
2407.10135|v2.result: 在无需预训练教师的情况下取得显著蒸馏效果，提升多视图3D检测性能。

Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor.summary_cn: 该论文针对多传感器融合在3D目标检测与BEV分割中鲁棒性不足的问题，提出基于扩散模型的鲁棒多传感器融合方法。方法利用扩散模型对多模态特征进行融合与去噪，以应对传感器失效或噪声干扰等不确定输入。相比传统融合方法，扩散模型能够建模多模态特征的不确定性并生成更鲁棒的融合表示。摘要未提供具体量化结果，需结合实验验证其在3D检测与BEV分割上的提升。
Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor.summary_en: This paper targets robust multi-sensor fusion for 3D object detection and BEV segmentation, where sensor failures or noise degrade performance. It proposes a diffusion-model-based fusion approach that leverages the generative and denoising capabilities of diffusion models to handle uncertain multimodal inputs. Compared with conventional fusion methods, it better models uncertainty and produces more robust fused representations, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor.assessment: 将扩散模型引入多传感器融合是新颖尝试，若实验充分可对鲁棒3D感知研究有启发。
Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor.contribution: 提出基于扩散模型的鲁棒多传感器融合框架用于3D检测与BEV分割。
Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor.innovation: 利用扩散模型建模多模态特征不确定性以实现鲁棒融合。
Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor.result: 在3D检测与BEV分割任务上提升鲁棒性，具体指标需见正文。
Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor._arxiv_id: Diffusion Model for Robust Multi-sensor Fusion in 3D Object Detection and BEV Segmentation.

2508.16408|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对恶劣天气（如大雾、雪、遮挡）下多模态传感器融合性能下降的问题，提出了SAMFusion——一种面向恶劣天气的传感器自适应多模态融合3D目标检测方法。方法除融合RGB与LiDAR外，还引入NIR门控相机与雷达模态以应对低光照与恶劣天气，通过基于注意力的深度混合方案在BEV平面上融合图像与距离特征，并由Transformer解码器根据距离与可见度对模态加权预测检测结果。相比现有融合方法在正常条件下表现良好但在恶劣天气失效，SAMFusion提升了自动驾驶在挑战性天气下的融合可靠性，弥合了理想条件与真实边缘场景之间的差距。
2508.16408|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of multimodal sensor fusion under adverse weather such as heavy fog, snow, and obstructions. It introduces SAMFusion, a sensor-adaptive fusion approach that integrates RGB, LiDAR, NIR gated camera, and radar modalities, fusing them via attentive depth-based blending with learned refinement on the BEV plane. A transformer decoder weights modalities by distance and visibility, improving fusion reliability in challenging weather and bridging the gap between ideal conditions and real-world edge cases.
2508.16408|v2.assessment: 针对恶劣天气这一实际痛点，引入NIR与雷达模态并设计自适应融合，实验场景贴近真实部署，值得关注。
2508.16408|v2.contribution: 提出面向恶劣天气的传感器自适应多模态融合3D检测框架SAMFusion。
2508.16408|v2.innovation: 融合NIR门控相机与雷达模态，并通过注意力深度混合与Transformer解码器实现模态自适应加权。
2508.16408|v2.result: 在恶劣天气下提升多模态融合可靠性，弥合理想与真实边缘场景差距。

2403.11848|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR与相机BEV特征融合中因标定不准导致深度估计误差、进而造成特征错位的问题，提出了鲁棒融合框架GraphBEV。方法引入Local Align模块，通过图匹配利用邻域感知深度特征修正点云投影误差；并提出Global Align模块校正LiDAR与相机BEV特征间的错位。在nuScenes验证集上，GraphBEV取得70.1% mAP，超越BEV Fusion 1.6%；在存在错位噪声条件下，超越BEV Fusion达8.3%，显著提升了融合鲁棒性。
2403.11848|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses feature misalignment in LiDAR-camera BEV fusion caused by inaccurate calibration and resulting depth estimation errors. It proposes GraphBEV, a robust fusion framework with a Local Align module that uses neighbor-aware depth features via graph matching to correct point cloud projection errors, and a Global Align module to rectify BEV feature misalignment. GraphBEV achieves 70.1% mAP on nuScenes validation, surpassing BEV Fusion by 1.6%, and by 8.3% under misalignment noise.
2403.11848|v2.assessment: 针对标定误差这一实际且关键的问题，图匹配对齐思路清晰，且在噪声条件下提升显著，实验扎实，值得BEV融合研究者关注。
2403.11848|v2.contribution: 提出鲁棒的LiDAR-相机BEV融合框架GraphBEV，含Local Align与Global Align模块。
2403.11848|v2.innovation: 通过图匹配的邻域感知深度特征与全局对齐模块校正标定误差导致的特征错位。
2403.11848|v2.result: nuScenes验证集mAP达70.1%，超BEV Fusion 1.6%，错位噪声下超8.3%。

2403.10353|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机BEV 3D检测中2D与3D检测器分离、2D结果仅用于token选择或query初始化的两阶段局限，提出单模型SimPB，用混合解码器（多视角2D解码层+3D解码层）同时输出透视图2D框与BEV 3D框。通过Dynamic Query Allocation与Adaptive Query Aggregation以3D-2D-3D循环方式持续更新2D/3D交互，并用Query-group Attention强化单相机组内2D query交互。在nuScenes上验证了单模型联合检测的有效性，避免了独立2D检测器的额外开销。
2403.10353|v2.summary_en: SimPB addresses the two-stage limitation of prior multi-camera 3D detectors where 2D detection results are used only once for token selection or query initialization. It proposes a single model with a hybrid decoder of multi-view 2D layers and 3D layers, plus Dynamic Query Allocation and Adaptive Query Aggregation that cyclically refine 2D-3D interaction in a 3D-2D-3D manner, and Query-group Attention for intra-camera 2D query interaction. Experiments on nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of jointly detecting 2D and 3D objects in one model.
2403.10353|v2.assessment: 把2D与3D检测真正统一进一个模型并做循环交互，思路清晰且工程价值高，对多相机BEV感知研究者有直接参考意义。
2403.10353|v2.contribution: 提出单模型SimPB，用混合解码器与循环3D-2D-3D query交互同时完成多相机2D与BEV 3D检测。
2403.10353|v2.innovation: Dynamic Query Allocation、Adaptive Query Aggregation与Query-group Attention实现2D/3D结果的持续双向精炼。
2403.10353|v2.result: 在nuScenes上以单一模型取得优于两阶段方案的2D与3D联合检测性能。

2407.08569|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督3D检测中LiDAR点云稀疏导致远处/小目标性能差的问题，提出LiDAR-2D Self-paced Learning（LiSe），早期尝试将LiDAR与2D图像结合用于无监督3D检测。方法利用RGB图像提供精确2D定位线索补充稀疏LiDAR，设计自适应采样动态调整伪标签分布以抑制对近处大目标的过拟合，并采用弱模型聚合策略。该自步学习流程在无监督设定下改善了跨尺度与跨距离目标的均衡学习。
2407.08569|v2.summary_en: LiSe targets unsupervised 3D object detection where sparse LiDAR points degrade detection of distant and small objects. It integrates RGB images with LiDAR and devises a self-paced learning pipeline with adaptive sampling that dynamically tunes pseudo-label distributions to avoid overfitting to easily detected near/large objects, plus a weak model aggregation strategy. This balances learning across object scales and distances without explicit supervision.
2407.08569|v2.assessment: 将2D图像线索引入无监督3D检测并用自步学习平衡伪标签分布，问题定位准确，对无监督/自监督3D感知方向有启发。
2407.08569|v2.contribution: 提出LiSe，首个将LiDAR与2D图像结合的自步学习无监督3D检测框架。
2407.08569|v2.innovation: 自适应采样动态调节伪标签分布，配合弱模型聚合缓解尺度与距离偏差。
2407.08569|v2.result: 在无监督设定下改善了远处与小目标的检测表现，实现跨尺度均衡学习。

2407.13517|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线矢量化HD地图构建，提出端到端方法Mask2Map，预测BEV空间内地图实例的类别与有序点集。方法由IMPNet（生成Mask-Aware Queries与BEV分割掩码以捕获全局语义）和MMPNet（通过PQG嵌入BEV位置信息生成实例级位置query、GFE利用分割掩码生成点级几何特征）组成。针对IMPNet与MMPNet因GT匹配不一致导致的网络间不一致问题，提出Inter-network Denoising Training。在nuScenes上取得优于已有矢量化地图构建方法的效果。
2407.13517|v2.summary_en: Mask2Map is an end-to-end online HD map construction method that predicts class and ordered point sets of map instances in BEV. It combines IMPNet, which produces Mask-Aware Queries and BEV segmentation masks for global semantics, with MMPNet, which refines queries via a Positional Query Generator and a Geometric Feature Extractor. To address inter-network inconsistency from differing GT matching, it introduces Inter-network Denoising Training, achieving strong results on nuScenes.
2407.13517|v2.assessment: 用BEV分割掩码驱动矢量化地图预测并显式处理网络间不一致，设计完整、实验扎实，对BEV地图构建方向有参考价值。
2407.13517|v2.contribution: 提出Mask2Map端到端矢量化HD地图构建框架，由IMPNet与MMPNet协同预测地图实例类别与有序点集。
2407.13517|v2.innovation: 以BEV分割掩码生成Mask-Aware Queries与点级几何特征，并用Inter-network Denoising Training缓解网络间GT匹配不一致。
2407.13517|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得优于现有矢量化地图构建方法的性能。

2401.08687|v2.summary_cn: 针对纯视觉BEV感知在监督设定下难以扩展到新数据的问题，提出首个域自适应纯相机BEV框架DA-BEV，利用图像视角特征与BEV特征的互补性进行无监督域适应。方法将query思想引入域适应，包含query-based adversarial learning（QAL）与query-based self-training（QST）两个设计，分别用图像视角特征或BEV特征去正则化另一侧的适应过程。在多个数据集与3D目标检测、3D场景分割任务上一致取得优越的域自适应BEV感知性能。
2401.08687|v2.summary_en: DA-BEV is the first domain-adaptive camera-only BEV framework, addressing the underexplored problem of unsupervised domain adaptive BEV perception by exploiting the complementarity of image-view and BEV features. It introduces query-based adversarial learning and query-based self-training, each using one feature space to regularize adaptation of the other. Extensive experiments show consistent gains across multiple datasets and tasks including 3D object detection and 3D scene segmentation.
2401.08687|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地定义并解决纯视觉BEV域自适应问题，query驱动的对抗与自训练设计合理，对BEV落地泛化有重要价值。
2401.08687|v2.contribution: 提出首个域自适应纯相机BEV框架DA-BEV，用query机制桥接图像视角与BEV特征的互补适应。
2401.08687|v2.innovation: query-based adversarial learning与query-based self-training双向正则化图像视角与BEV特征空间。
2401.08687|v2.result: 在多个数据集及3D检测、3D场景分割任务上一致取得优越的域自适应BEV性能。

2306.00349|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态BEV感知缺乏统一预训练框架、2D/3D标注昂贵的问题，提出CALICO，对LiDAR与相机骨干同时施加对比目标的自监督预训练框架。方法包含两阶段：point-region contrast（PRC）在LiDAR模态上更好平衡区域级与场景级表示学习，region-aware distillation（RAD）对自训练教师模型进行对比蒸馏。在3D目标检测与BEV地图分割任务上均取得显著提升，性能超过基线方法。
2306.00349|v2.summary_en: CALICO addresses the lack of a unified pretraining framework for multimodal BEV perception by applying contrastive objectives to both LiDAR and camera backbones. It comprises point-region contrast, which balances region- and scene-level representation learning on LiDAR, and region-aware distillation, which performs contrastive distillation from a self-trained teacher. Extensive evaluations on 3D object detection and BEV map segmentation show significant improvements over baselines.
2306.00349|v2.assessment: 填补了多模态BEV统一自监督预训练的空白，PRC与RAD设计针对性强，对降低标注依赖、提升BEV下游任务有实用价值。
2306.00349|v2.contribution: 提出CALICO，面向多模态BEV感知的统一自监督对比预训练框架。
2306.00349|v2.innovation: point-region contrast平衡LiDAR区域/场景级表示，region-aware distillation实现自训练教师的对比蒸馏。
2306.00349|v2.result: 在3D目标检测与BEV地图分割上显著超越基线，验证统一预训练的有效性。

2406.16072|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目3D车道检测受深度缺失与光照变化影响、精度不足的问题，提出端到端多模态双视角3D车道检测框架DV-3DLane，融合图像与LiDAR点云。方法在透视视角（PV）与BEV两个空间学习多模态特征，包含三项设计：双向特征融合策略将多模态特征整合进各视角空间；统一query生成方法利用PV与BEV的车道感知知识生成query；3D双视角可变形注意力机制从PV与BEV空间聚合判别性特征。在OpenLane基准上验证了有效性与效率。
2406.16072|v2.summary_en: DV-3DLane is an end-to-end dual-view multi-modal 3D lane detection framework that fuses images and LiDAR to overcome depth loss and lighting sensitivity of monocular methods. It learns multi-modal features in both perspective view and BEV via bidirectional feature fusion, a unified lane-aware query generation scheme drawing on both views, and a 3D dual-view deformable attention that aggregates discriminative features into queries. Extensive experiments on OpenLane demonstrate its efficacy and efficiency.
2406.16072|v2.assessment: 把多模态融合与双视角表示结合到3D车道检测，三项设计针对性强，对多模态BEV/车道感知研究者有参考价值。
2406.16072|v2.contribution: 提出DV-3DLane端到端多模态双视角3D车道检测框架，融合图像与LiDAR的PV与BEV特征。
2406.16072|v2.innovation: 双向特征融合、统一车道感知query生成与3D双视角可变形注意力协同聚合跨视角多模态特征。
2406.16072|v2.result: 在OpenLane基准上验证了方法的有效性与效率，提升3D车道检测精度。

2411.03013|v2.summary_cn: 针对雷达-相机BEV融合方法难以有效捕捉动态物体运动、导致真实场景性能受限的问题，本文提出CRT-Fusion框架，将时序信息引入雷达-相机融合。方法包含三个模块：多视角融合（MVF）在相机视角和BEV下融合雷达与图像特征生成更精确的统一BEV表示；运动特征估计器（MFE）同时估计逐像素速度与BEV分割；运动引导时序融合（MGTF）基于速度与占据得分图以循环方式对齐并融合多帧特征。相比已有工作，其改进在于显式建模动态物体运动以对齐跨时间戳特征，从而生成更鲁棒的BEV特征图。
2411.03013|v2.summary_en: To address the limited ability of radar-camera BEV fusion methods in capturing dynamic object motion, this paper proposes CRT-Fusion, a framework that integrates temporal information into radar-camera fusion. It comprises a Multi-View Fusion module that fuses radar and image features in both camera and bird's-eye views, a Motion Feature Estimator that jointly predicts pixel-wise velocity and BEV segmentation, and a Motion Guided Temporal Fusion module that recurrently aligns and fuses multi-timestamp features using velocity and occupancy scores. By explicitly modeling motion, it produces more robust BEV feature maps than prior fusion approaches.
2411.03013|v2.assessment: 该工作将运动估计与时序融合结合到雷达-相机BEV框架中，思路清晰且模块设计合理，对多模态时序3D检测有较强参考价值。
2411.03013|v2.contribution: 提出融合运动信息的雷达-相机时序融合框架CRT-Fusion，用于鲁棒的3D目标检测。
2411.03013|v2.innovation: 通过逐像素速度估计与BEV占据得分引导的循环时序特征对齐与融合。
2411.03013|v2.result: 在真实场景下生成更鲁棒的BEV特征图，提升动态物体检测性能。
