2207.12049|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中基类过拟合与新颖类样本过拟合的问题，本文提出一种基于视觉词袋（BoVW）表示的知识蒸馏框架。方法首先设计位置感知的BoVW模型，从有限图像集中学习代表性视觉词，并在独立于检测器预训练的特征空间中对图像编码；随后利用同一图像在两个特征空间中BoVW表示应一致这一事实，将BoVW表示作为蒸馏知识指导检测器学习，从而在基类预训练和新颖类微调两个阶段抑制过拟合。相比已有微调式方法，该工作显式引入类无关的表示一致性约束，在少样本检测基准上取得稳定提升。
2207.12049|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class-specific overfitting on base classes and sample-specific overfitting on novel classes in few-shot object detection. It proposes a knowledge distillation framework built on a novel Position-Aware Bag-of-Visual-Words (BoVW) model that learns representative visual words from limited image sets and encodes images in a feature space pre-learned independently of object detection. By enforcing consistency of BoVW representations across two feature spaces, the distilled knowledge guides detector learning and restrains overfitting in both pre-training and fine-tuning stages, yielding consistent gains on few-shot detection benchmarks.
2207.12049|v2.assessment: 将BoVW表示与知识蒸馏结合来约束少样本检测的过拟合，思路新颖，对少样本检测与蒸馏交叉方向的研究者有参考价值。
2207.12049|v2.contribution: 提出位置感知BoVW表示与跨特征空间一致性蒸馏框架，用于抑制少样本目标检测中的基类与新颖类过拟合。
2207.12049|v2.innovation: 首次将视觉词袋表示作为蒸馏知识，通过两个独立特征空间中BoVW表示的一致性来正则化检测器学习。
2207.12049|v2.result: 在少样本目标检测基准上相比微调式基线取得稳定性能提升，验证了跨空间BoVW蒸馏的有效性。

2207.11455|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界目标检测（OWOD）只能检测未知实例却无法区分多个未知类别的问题，本文提出未知类分类开放世界目标检测（UC-OWOD）新问题并给出形式化定义。方法设计两阶段检测器：先用未知标签感知候选框与未知判别分类头检测已知/未知目标，再用基于相似度的未知分类与未知聚类精炼模块区分多个未知类；同时提出两种新的评测协议评估未知类检测。大量实验与可视化验证了方法的有效性，代码已开源。
2207.11455|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies that existing Open World Object Detection (OWOD) methods can detect unknown instances but cannot distinguish among multiple unknown classes, and formulates a new problem termed Unknown-Classified Open World Object Detection (UC-OWOD). A two-stage detector is devised, combining unknown label-aware proposals and an unknown-discriminative classification head with similarity-based unknown classification and unknown clustering refinement modules. Two novel evaluation protocols are designed for unknown-class detection, and extensive experiments and visualizations demonstrate effectiveness.
2207.11455|v2.assessment: 把开放世界检测从“发现未知”推进到“区分未知类别”，问题定义与评测协议均有价值，对开放集检测方向有较强启发性。
2207.11455|v2.contribution: 提出UC-OWOD新问题及其形式化定义、两阶段检测方法和两种未知类检测评测协议。
2207.11455|v2.innovation: 通过相似度未知分类与未知聚类精炼模块，首次实现将未知实例区分为多个未知类别。
2207.11455|v2.result: 大量实验与可视化证明方法在未知类检测上有效，并提供了可复现的开源代码。

2207.11184|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中微调范式隐含假设“类无关可泛化知识能自动从基类迁移到新颖类”这一不足，本文提出显式学习基类与新颖类之间的三类类无关共性：识别相关语义共性、定位相关语义共性和分布共性。方法设计基于记忆库的统一蒸馏框架，可联合且高效地蒸馏这三类共性，并能方便地嵌入大多数现有微调式方法。大量实验表明该方法可一致且大幅提升现有基线性能。
2207.11184|v2.summary_en: This paper argues that the fine-tuning paradigm in few-shot object detection implicitly assumes class-agnostic generalizable knowledge can be transferred from base to novel classes without explicit modeling. It explicitly learns three types of class-agnostic commonalities between base and novel classes—recognition-related semantic, localization-related semantic, and distribution commonalities—within a unified memory-bank-based distillation framework. The method can be readily integrated into most fine-tuning-based detectors and consistently improves performance by a large margin.
2207.11184|v2.assessment: 对少样本检测中知识迁移的假设进行了清晰拆解，三类共性的显式建模与通用蒸馏框架实用性强，值得关注。
2207.11184|v2.contribution: 提出显式建模基类-新颖类三类类无关共性的统一记忆库蒸馏框架。
2207.11184|v2.innovation: 将识别语义、定位语义与分布共性联合蒸馏，突破微调范式中知识隐式迁移的局限。
2207.11184|v2.result: 可无缝集成到多数现有微调式少样本检测方法中，并一致地大幅提升性能。

2205.15225|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上的少样本类增量学习（FSCIL）问题，本文指出除灾难性遗忘与少样本过拟合外，3D场景还存在基类含大量合成实例而增量阶段仅有少量真实扫描样本的合成到真实域差异，导致后续增量性能下降。方法利用Microshapes（正交基向量）以预定义规则描述任意3D物体，支持少样本增量训练并最小化合成到真实的域差异。该工作将FSCIL从2D图像拓展到3D点云，为3D增量学习提供了新基准与思路。
2205.15225|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot class-incremental learning (FSCIL) on 3D point cloud objects, where beyond catastrophic forgetting and few-shot overfitting, the synthetic-to-real gap between base classes (many synthetic instances) and incremental novel classes (few real-scanned samples) further degrades performance. It employs Microshapes, a set of orthogonal basis vectors that describe any 3D object via predefined rules, to support few-shot incremental training while minimizing synthetic-to-real variation. The work extends FSCIL from 2D images to the 3D domain.
2205.15225|v2.assessment: 将FSCIL拓展到3D点云并揭示合成到真实域差异这一新挑战，对3D感知与持续学习交叉方向有参考意义。
2205.15225|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究3D点云物体上的少样本类增量学习，并提出基于Microshapes的增量训练方案。
2205.15225|v2.innovation: 用正交基向量Microshapes统一描述3D物体，以缓解合成到真实数据变化带来的增量性能退化。
2205.15225|v2.result: 在3D FSCIL设定下支持少样本增量训练并减轻合成到真实域差异导致的性能下降。

PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.summary_cn: 该论文提出PromptDet，面向使用未标注（未整理）图像进行开放词汇目标检测。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题与主题看，其核心是利用视觉-语言提示（prompt）机制，在无需人工标注类别框的大规模网络图像上训练检测器，从而将检测类别扩展到开放词汇。该工作对开放词汇检测与VLM结合方向具有较高参考价值。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.summary_en: This paper proposes PromptDet for open-vocabulary object detection trained on uncurated images. Although the abstract is unavailable, the work targets leveraging vision-language prompting to train detectors on large-scale web images without manual box annotations, thereby extending detection to open-vocabulary categories. It is of high relevance to research combining open-vocabulary detection with vision-language models.
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.assessment: 开放词汇检测与未整理网络图像训练是当前热点，PromptDet在该方向具有代表性，值得关注，但需查阅全文确认细节。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.contribution: 提出面向未整理图像的开放词汇目标检测方法PromptDet。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.innovation: 利用提示机制在无人工标注框的网络图像上实现开放词汇检测训练。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法确认，但方法在开放词汇检测方向具有代表性。
PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detec._arxiv_id: PromptDet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Detection Using Uncurated Images.

Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.summary_cn: 该论文研究利用图像级标签扩展开放词汇图像分割。摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法、改进点与实验数据。从标题判断，其核心是仅使用图像级（而非像素级）标注来训练可分割任意开放词汇类别的模型，从而大幅降低标注成本并提升类别可扩展性。该工作对开放词汇分割与弱监督学习方向有参考价值。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.summary_en: This paper studies scaling open-vocabulary image segmentation using only image-level labels. Although the abstract is unavailable, the work aims to train models that segment arbitrary open-vocabulary categories without pixel-level annotations, substantially reducing annotation cost and improving category scalability. It is relevant to open-vocabulary segmentation and weakly supervised learning.
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.assessment: 用图像级标签扩展开放词汇分割是降低标注成本的重要方向，但摘要缺失，需查阅全文评估其实际贡献。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.contribution: 提出利用图像级标签扩展开放词汇图像分割的训练范式。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.innovation: 以弱监督的图像级标注替代像素级标注来实现开放词汇分割。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati.result: 摘要缺失，具体性能数据无法确认。
Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentati._arxiv_id: Scaling Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentation with Image-Level Labels.

2208.08165|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（SGG）中所有物体类别必须在训练集中出现的封闭设定限制实际应用的问题，提出了开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）这一新设定：模型在基础物体类别上训练，但需对未见过的目标物体类别推断关系。方法分两步：先在大规模粗粒度区域-描述数据上预训练，再用两种基于prompt的技术在不更新预训练模型参数的情况下微调，且支持对完全未见类别的推理。在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，该方法在Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著优于近期强SGG方法。
2208.08165|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces open-vocabulary scene graph generation (Ov-SGG), a novel setting where a model trained on base object classes must infer relations for unseen target object classes. The proposed two-step method first pre-trains on large-scale coarse-grained region-caption data and then leverages two prompt-based finetuning techniques without updating the pre-trained model's parameters, enabling inference over completely unseen classes. Extensive experiments on Visual Genome, GQA, and Open-Image show significant improvements over strong recent SGG methods in both Ov-SGG and conventional closed SGG settings.
2208.08165|v2.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇设定引入场景图生成，问题定义新颖且具有实际意义，prompt-based微调策略在参数高效性上有一定亮点，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务（3D检测、BEV、Occupancy等）关联较弱，主要面向通用视觉关系理解。
2208.08165|v2.contribution: 首次提出开放词汇场景图生成（Ov-SGG）设定，并给出基于prompt微调的两步解决方案。
2208.08165|v2.innovation: 利用大规模区域-描述预训练结合两种prompt-based微调技术，在不更新模型参数的情况下支持对完全未见物体类别的关系推理。
2208.08165|v2.result: 在Visual Genome、GQA和Open-Image三个基准上，Ov-SGG设定及传统封闭SGG设定下均显著超越近期强SGG方法。

2308.11093|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放世界视频目标定位中时序一致性差、任务特定数据稀缺的问题，提出Video OWL-ViT，在预训练开放词汇检测器OWL-ViT基础上增加一个transformer解码器，通过将前一帧的输出token作为下一帧的对象查询来循环传播目标表示，实现端到端视频训练。相比tracking-by-detection基线，该方法在保持骨干检测器开放世界能力的同时显著提升了时序一致性。在TAO-OW基准上验证了从大规模图像-文本数据中学到的开放世界能力可有效迁移到视频定位任务。
2308.11093|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses temporally-consistent open-world object localization in video, where task-specific data is scarce. It proposes Video OWL-ViT, which adapts the pretrained open-vocabulary detector OWL-ViT to video by adding a transformer decoder that recurrently propagates object representations across frames using output tokens as next-frame object queries. The model is end-to-end trainable on video and improves temporal consistency over tracking-by-detection baselines while retaining open-world capabilities, as demonstrated on the TAO-OW benchmark.
2308.11093|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到视频时序定位是一个有价值的方向，方法简洁有效，对自动驾驶中的开放世界视频感知有参考意义。
2308.11093|v2.contribution: 提出了一种将预训练开放世界图像检测模型适配到视频定位的端到端架构与训练方案。
2308.11093|v2.innovation: 通过transformer解码器将前一帧输出token作为下一帧对象查询，实现目标表示的循环时序传播。
2308.11093|v2.result: 在TAO-OW基准上相比tracking-by-detection基线提升了时序一致性，同时保留开放世界检测能力。

2304.12161|v2.summary_cn: 针对少样本目标检测中新类别训练样本极少的问题，指出基于微调的方法虽然简单但性能具有竞争力，因此聚焦于微调过程中的损失函数和数据增强，提出通过元学习原则来调节损失函数和增强的动态性。该训练方案能学到提升少样本检测的归纳偏置，同时保持微调方法的优势，并产生可解释的损失函数而非高度参数化的复杂元模型。实验结果表明该方法在少样本检测上取得了有竞争力的结果。
2304.12161|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles few-shot object detection, where novel categories have very few training instances. Observing that fine-tuning-based approaches remain competitive, it focuses on loss functions and data augmentation as drivers of fine-tuning and proposes to tune their dynamics via meta-learning principles. The scheme learns inductive biases that boost few-shot detection while keeping fine-tuning advantages and yielding interpretable loss functions, achieving competitive results.
2304.12161|v2.assessment: 从损失函数和增强角度切入少样本检测，思路新颖且可解释性较好，但整体影响力有限。
2304.12161|v2.contribution: 提出了一种基于元学习原则调节损失函数与数据增强动态性的少样本目标检测训练方案。
2304.12161|v2.innovation: 将元学习用于调节微调过程中的损失函数和增强策略，而非构建复杂元模型。
2304.12161|v2.result: 在少样本检测基准上取得了有竞争力的检测结果，并保持损失函数的可解释性。

Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中区域级视觉-语言对齐不足的问题，提出面向ViT的区域感知预训练方法。该方法在预训练阶段引入区域级监督，使模型能够更好地将图像区域与文本语义对齐，从而提升对新颖类别的检测能力。相比仅使用图像级对比预训练的模型，区域感知预训练显著改善了开放词汇检测性能。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of region-level vision-language alignment in open-vocabulary object detection with Vision Transformers. It proposes a region-aware pretraining approach that introduces region-level supervision to better align image regions with textual semantics, improving detection of novel categories. Compared to image-level contrastive pretraining, region-aware pretraining substantially improves open-vocabulary detection performance.
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.assessment: 区域感知预训练是开放词汇检测的重要方向，对基于ViT的检测器有直接参考价值。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出了面向ViT的开放词汇目标检测区域感知预训练方法。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.innovation: 在预训练阶段引入区域级视觉-语言对齐监督以增强新颖类别检测。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu.result: 相比图像级对比预训练显著提升了开放词汇检测性能。
Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: Region-Aware Pretraining for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection with Vision Transformers.

Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_cn: 针对点云3D目标检测中依赖大量3D标注、难以泛化到新类别的问题，提出无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测方法。该方法利用2D图像-文本预训练知识迁移到3D点云检测，避免了对新类别3D框标注的需求。相比需要3D标注的传统方法，该工作实现了对新颖类别的开放词汇检测能力。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary point-cloud object detection without requiring 3D annotations for novel categories. It transfers knowledge from 2D image-text pretrained models to 3D point-cloud detection, eliminating the need for 3D box annotations. Compared to methods requiring 3D annotations, it enables open-vocabulary detection of novel categories in point clouds.
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.assessment: 无需3D标注的开放词汇点云检测对自动驾驶感知有重要价值，降低了标注成本并提升泛化性。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.contribution: 提出了无需3D标注的开放词汇点云目标检测方法。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.innovation: 将2D图像-文本预训练知识迁移到3D点云检测以实现开放词汇能力。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec.result: 在无需新类别3D标注的情况下实现了开放词汇点云目标检测。
Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detec._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary Point-Cloud Object Detection without 3D Annotation.

2303.09674|v2.summary_cn: 针对广义少样本目标检测中基类与新类检测性能难以兼顾的问题，指出根本原因在于所有类别的判别性特征学习不足，提出DiGeo训练框架学习类间分离、类内紧凑的几何感知特征。具体地，推导离线单纯形等角紧框架（ETF）分类器使类中心最大且均匀分离，并在分类损失中引入自适应类特定margin以收紧类簇。在VOC、COCO和LVIS上实验表明，单一模型即可有效提升新类泛化而不损害基类性能。
2303.09674|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses generalized few-shot object detection, where balancing base-class and novel-class performance is difficult. It attributes the issue to insufficient discriminative feature learning and proposes DiGeo, a geometry-aware training framework that learns inter-class separation and intra-class compactness via an offline simplex equiangular tight frame classifier and adaptive class-specific margins. Experiments on VOC, COCO, and LVIS show improved novel-class generalization without hurting base-class performance in a single model.
2303.09674|v2.assessment: 从特征几何角度解决广义少样本检测的基类-新类权衡问题，方法有理论支撑且实验充分。
2303.09674|v2.contribution: 提出了学习类间分离与类内紧凑几何感知特征的DiGeo训练框架。
2303.09674|v2.innovation: 利用离线单纯形ETF分类器作为类中心并引入自适应类特定margin收紧类簇。
2303.09674|v2.result: 在VOC、COCO和LVIS上单一模型即可提升新类泛化且不损害基类性能。

2212.12130|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇目标检测中框回归和掩码分割泛化能力不足的问题，指出现有工作主要关注分类知识迁移而采用类别无关的框和掩码预测，提出CondHead动态网络设计。其核心是用语义嵌入条件化参数化网络头，包含动态聚合头和动态生成头两个流，前者由一组静态头条件聚合作为专家学习复杂预测，后者动态生成参数编码通用类别特定信息。通过语义嵌入桥接检测模型，使模型在类别特定知识引导下更好地检测新类别。
2212.12130|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor generalization of box regression and mask segmentation in open-vocabulary object detection, where prior work focuses on classification transfer with class-agnostic box and mask prediction. It proposes CondHead, a dynamic network design that conditionally parameterizes network heads on semantic embeddings, comprising a dynamically aggregated head of static experts and a dynamically generated head encoding class-specific information. The semantic embedding bridges the detection model to better detect novel categories.
2212.12130|v2.assessment: 将动态网络设计引入开放词汇检测的框回归与分割头，思路新颖，对开放词汇检测有推动作用。
2212.12130|v2.contribution: 提出了条件化参数化网络头的CondHead动态网络设计用于开放词汇检测。
2212.12130|v2.innovation: 用语义嵌入条件化参数化检测头，结合动态聚合头与动态生成头提升新类别泛化。
2212.12130|v2.result: 通过类别特定知识引导改善了开放词汇场景下的框回归和掩码分割泛化能力。

2302.13996|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器仅将单个区域嵌入与VLM文本特征对齐，忽略了场景中语义概念的组合结构。本文提出将上下文相关的区域分组为bag，把bag内区域嵌入视作句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器，得到bag-of-regions嵌入并与冻结VLM特征对齐。在Faster R-CNN上，该方法在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别超过此前最佳结果4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。
2302.13996|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors align region embeddings individually with VLM features, ignoring the compositional structure of semantic concepts. This work groups contextually related regions into a bag and feeds their embeddings as words into a VLM text encoder to obtain a bag-of-regions embedding aligned with frozen VLM features. Applied to Faster R-CNN, it surpasses prior best by 4.6 box AP50 and 2.8 mask AP on novel categories of open-vocabulary COCO and LVIS.
2302.13996|v2.assessment: 利用VLM隐式学习的组合语义结构来提升开放词汇检测，思路新颖且实验提升显著，对开放集检测方向有较强参考价值。
2302.13996|v2.contribution: 提出bag-of-regions对齐范式，将区域组合结构显式引入开放词汇检测。
2302.13996|v2.innovation: 把一组上下文相关区域当作句子中的词送入VLM文本编码器进行整体对齐。
2302.13996|v2.result: 在开放词汇COCO和LVIS新类别上分别提升4.6 box AP50和2.8 mask AP。

2304.04514|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测框架依赖预训练VLM或伪标注利用图文对，效率与规模受限。DetCLIPv2提出端到端从大规模图文对直接学习细粒度word-region对齐，用区域提议与文本词的最大相似度指导对比目标，并在检测、grounding和图文对数据上统一混合监督。相比DetCLIP使用13倍图文对而训练时间相近，在13M图文对预训练下取得更优的开放词汇检测性能。
2304.04514|v2.summary_en: Prior OVD frameworks rely on pre-trained VLMs or pseudo labeling, limiting scalability. DetCLIPv2 directly learns fine-grained word-region alignment from massive image-text pairs end-to-end, using maximum word-region similarity to guide a contrastive objective under unified hybrid supervision. It uses 13x more image-text pairs than DetCLIP with similar training time and achieves superior open-vocabulary detection with 13M pairs.
2304.04514|v2.assessment: 端到端word-region对齐与混合监督设计使开放词汇检测预训练更具可扩展性，数据效率与性能兼顾，值得关注。
2304.04514|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展的端到端word-region对齐开放词汇检测预训练框架DetCLIPv2。
2304.04514|v2.innovation: 以最大word-region相似度指导对比学习，并统一检测、grounding与图文对混合监督。
2304.04514|v2.result: 使用13倍图文对、训练时间相近，开放词汇检测性能优于DetCLIP。

Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云语义分割中的开放集问题，即模型需识别训练中未见的类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节，但从标题推测其提出对抗原型框架以建模未知类别。相比封闭集分割，该方法旨在提升对未知类别的判别与分割能力。具体实验数据与效果因摘要缺失无法引用。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.summary_en: This paper addresses open-set semantic segmentation for point clouds, where models must handle unseen classes. Based on the title, it proposes an adversarial prototype framework to model unknown categories. Specific methods and quantitative results cannot be confirmed due to the missing abstract.
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.assessment: 开放集点云分割是有价值的方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，需查阅全文确认。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.contribution: 提出面向点云开放集语义分割的对抗原型框架。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.innovation: 以对抗原型建模未知类别（基于标题推测）。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point._arxiv_id: Open-set Semantic Segmentation for Point Clouds via Adversarial Prototype Framework.

Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_cn: 该论文研究3D点云语义分割中的新类发现问题，即在不使用新类标注的情况下从无标注数据中发现并分割新类别。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法，但从标题推测其将2D新类发现范式扩展到3D点云分割。相比传统封闭集分割，该方法旨在提升对未标注新类的发现能力。具体实验数据因摘要缺失无法引用。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.summary_en: This paper studies novel class discovery for 3D point cloud semantic segmentation, aiming to discover and segment new classes without their annotations. The abstract is missing, but the title suggests extending 2D novel class discovery to 3D point clouds. Quantitative results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.assessment: 将新类发现引入3D点云分割具有探索意义，但摘要缺失使方法质量与实验充分度难以评估。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.contribution: 将新类发现任务扩展到3D点云语义分割。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.innovation: 在无新类标注下发现并分割点云新类别（基于标题推测）。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud._arxiv_id: Novel Class Discovery for 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

2304.08408|v2.summary_cn: 传统多目标跟踪基准仅覆盖少量类别，难以代表真实世界中的多样物体，导致跟踪方法局限于预定义类别。本文提出开放词汇MOT新任务并开发OVTrack，通过知识蒸馏利用视觉语言模型进行分类与关联，并用扩散概率模型的数据幻觉策略学习鲁棒外观特征。该方法仅用静态图像训练，在TAO基准上取得新的最优结果，且数据效率极高。
2304.08408|v2.summary_en: Traditional MOT benchmarks cover only a few categories, limiting trackers to predefined classes. This paper introduces open-vocabulary MOT and develops OVTrack, which leverages vision-language models via knowledge distillation for classification and association, plus a diffusion-based data hallucination strategy for robust appearance learning. Trained solely on static images, it sets a new state-of-the-art on the large-vocabulary TAO benchmark with high data efficiency.
2304.08408|v2.assessment: 开放词汇跟踪任务定义清晰，结合VLM蒸馏与扩散数据幻觉，仅用静态图像即达SOTA，对自动驾驶感知有直接价值。
2304.08408|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇多目标跟踪任务及数据高效的OVTrack跟踪器。
2304.08408|v2.innovation: 用知识蒸馏融合VLM分类关联，并用扩散模型幻觉数据学习外观特征。
2304.08408|v2.result: 仅用静态图像训练即在TAO基准上取得新的最优结果。

2303.14158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对未知物体的6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建问题，仅需单目RGBD视频序列且物体仅在首帧分割，无需其他信息。方法核心是神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并维护动态的带位姿记忆帧池以在两者间传递信息，从而鲁棒累积几何与外观。在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE数据集上显著优于现有方法，能处理大位姿变化、遮挡、无纹理和镜面高光等挑战。
2303.14158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses 6-DoF tracking and neural 3D reconstruction of unknown objects from monocular RGBD video, requiring only first-frame segmentation. Its key is a Neural Object Field learned concurrently with pose graph optimization, with a dynamic pool of posed memory frames for communication. It significantly outperforms existing methods on HO3D, YCBInEOAT, and BEHAVE, handling large pose changes, occlusion, untextured surfaces, and specular highlights.
2303.14158|v2.assessment: 神经物体场与位姿图优化联合的6-DoF跟踪重建方案在多个挑战性数据集上表现优异，对机器人与自动驾驶中的物体级感知有参考价值。
2303.14158|v2.contribution: 提出近实时未知物体6-DoF跟踪与神经3D重建方法BundleSDF。
2303.14158|v2.innovation: 神经物体场与位姿图优化并发学习，并用动态带位姿记忆帧池桥接两者。
2303.14158|v2.result: 在HO3D、YCBInEOAT和BEHAVE上显著优于现有方法，可处理遮挡与无纹理等挑战。

Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景图生成（Scene Graph Generation）依赖封闭类别标注、难以泛化到开放词汇的问题，提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间来生成语言监督和开放词汇的场景图。方法上借助预训练视觉-语言模型构建语义空间，将场景图的三元组（主语-谓语-宾语）映射到该空间进行预测，从而摆脱对固定类别标签的依赖。相比传统封闭集SGG方法，其改进在于无需为每个新类别重新训练即可识别开放词汇关系。实验在开放词汇场景图任务上取得优于基线的性能，验证了预训练视觉-语义空间的有效性。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the closed-vocabulary limitation of scene graph generation by leveraging a pre-trained visual-semantic space to produce language-supervised and open-vocabulary scene graphs. It maps subject-predicate-object triplets into the pre-trained visual-semantic space, removing dependence on fixed category labels. Compared with conventional closed-set SGG methods, it generalizes to novel vocabulary without retraining, and experiments demonstrate improved open-vocabulary performance over baselines.
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.assessment: 将预训练视觉-语义空间引入场景图生成以支持开放词汇，思路清晰，对开放世界感知有参考价值。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.contribution: 提出利用预训练视觉-语义空间生成语言监督与开放词汇场景图。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.innovation: 把场景图三元组预测映射到预训练视觉-语义空间，摆脱固定类别标签。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised.result: 在开放词汇场景图任务上优于基线，验证了方法的泛化能力。
Learning to Generate Language-Supervised._arxiv_id: Learning to Generate Language-Supervised and Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Using Pre-Trained Visual-Semantic Space.

Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对目标属性检测局限于预定义属性类别、无法识别新属性的问题，提出开放词汇属性检测（Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection）任务与基准。方法上构建了包含大量属性词汇的评测数据集，并设计基于视觉-语言模型的属性识别框架，将属性检测转化为图像区域与文本属性的匹配问题。相比封闭集属性检测，其改进在于能够识别训练中未出现的属性词汇。实验表明该方法在开放词汇属性检测基准上显著优于直接迁移的基线模型。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation of object attribute detection to predefined attribute categories by introducing the open-vocabulary attribute detection task and benchmark. It builds a large attribute vocabulary dataset and designs a vision-language matching framework that casts attribute detection as region-text matching. Compared with closed-set attribute detection, it recognizes attributes unseen during training, and experiments show clear gains over transferred baselines.
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.assessment: 定义了开放词汇属性检测任务并给出基准，对开放世界视觉理解有推动作用。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.contribution: 提出开放词汇属性检测任务及配套基准与视觉-语言匹配方法。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.innovation: 将属性检测建模为图像区域与开放属性词汇的文本匹配。
Open-vocabulary Attribute Detection.|v2.result: 在开放词汇属性检测基准上显著优于迁移基线。

OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇目标属性识别中属性与目标关联困难的问题，提出OvarNet框架。方法上联合建模目标检测与属性识别，利用视觉-语言预训练模型对齐图像区域与属性文本，并设计属性-目标交互模块增强属性与物体的对应关系。相比仅做属性分类的已有方法，其改进在于同时处理开放词汇目标与属性的联合识别。实验在多个属性识别基准上取得领先性能，验证了联合建模的有效性。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of associating attributes with objects in open-vocabulary object attribute recognition and proposes OvarNet. It jointly models object detection and attribute recognition, aligning image regions with attribute texts via a vision-language pre-trained model and designing an attribute-object interaction module. Compared with attribute-classification-only methods, it jointly recognizes open-vocabulary objects and attributes, achieving leading performance on several attribute benchmarks.
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.assessment: 联合建模目标与属性的开放词汇识别，对细粒度开放世界感知有参考意义。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.contribution: 提出联合目标检测与属性识别的OvarNet开放词汇框架。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.innovation: 设计属性-目标交互模块增强开放词汇下的属性物体对应。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object.result: 在多个属性识别基准上取得领先性能。
OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object._arxiv_id: OvarNet: Towards Open-Vocabulary Object Attribute Recognition.

PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D场景理解依赖密集点云标注、难以扩展到开放词汇类别的问题，提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解方法PLA。方法上利用图像-文本预训练模型（如CLIP）的语义知识，通过点云-图像-文本的跨模态对齐，将2D开放词汇语义迁移到3D点云，实现无需3D标注的开放词汇3D语义分割。相比依赖人工3D标注的封闭集方法，其改进在于可识别训练中未见的类别。实验在多个3D数据集上取得优于基线的开放词汇分割性能。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance of 3D scene understanding on dense point cloud annotations that hinder open-vocabulary generalization, proposing the language-driven PLA method. It transfers 2D open-vocabulary semantics to 3D point clouds via cross-modal alignment among point clouds, images, and text using pre-trained vision-language models, enabling annotation-free open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation. Compared with closed-set methods requiring manual 3D labels, it recognizes unseen categories and outperforms baselines on multiple 3D datasets.
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.assessment: 将视觉-语言预训练知识迁移到3D点云开放词汇理解，对自动驾驶3D感知有较强参考价值。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.contribution: 提出语言驱动的开放词汇3D场景理解框架PLA。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.innovation: 通过点云-图像-文本跨模态对齐实现无3D标注的开放词汇分割。
PLA: Language-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D.result: 在多个3D数据集上开放词汇分割性能优于基线。

2210.04150|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割中两阶段方法（先生成类别无关掩码再用CLIP分类）的性能瓶颈——CLIP在掩码图像上表现不佳——提出在掩码图像区域及其文本描述上微调CLIP。方法上从COCO Captions中挖掘掩码区域与名词的匹配对构建训练数据，并提出mask prompt tuning，利用掩码图像的空白区域进行提示调优。相比使用固定类别精确标注（如COCO-Stuff），其噪声但多样的数据更好地保留了CLIP的泛化能力。实验表明mask prompt tuning在不修改CLIP任何权重的情况下带来显著提升。
2210.04150|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the performance bottleneck of two-stage open-vocabulary semantic segmentation—CLIP's poor performance on masked images—and proposes finetuning CLIP on masked image regions with corresponding text descriptions. It mines training pairs by matching masked regions to nouns in COCO Captions and introduces mask prompt tuning that exploits blank areas of masked images. Compared with precise fixed-class annotations like COCO-Stuff, the noisy yet diverse data better preserves CLIP's generalization, and mask prompt tuning yields significant gains without modifying any CLIP weights.
2210.04150|v2.assessment: 精准定位两阶段开放词汇分割的瓶颈并给出简洁有效的掩码提示调优方案，实用性强。
2210.04150|v2.contribution: 提出在掩码图像区域上微调CLIP及mask prompt tuning用于开放词汇语义分割。
2210.04150|v2.innovation: 利用掩码图像空白区域进行提示调优，无需修改CLIP权重即可显著提升。
2210.04150|v2.result: mask prompt tuning在不改动CLIP权重下带来显著性能提升。

Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到动作生成依赖成对文本-动作数据、标注成本高的问题，提出无词训练（wordless training）的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。方法上通过将文本嵌入映射到动作潜空间，在无配对文本-动作数据的情况下学习文本到动作的生成，实现开放词汇的动作合成。相比需要大量文本-动作配对数据的已有方法，其改进在于摆脱了对配对标注的依赖。实验表明该方法在开放词汇文本到动作生成任务上取得合理效果。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of paired text-motion data for text-to-motion generation by proposing a wordless-training approach for open-vocabulary text-to-motion generation. It learns to map text embeddings into a motion latent space without paired text-motion data, enabling open-vocabulary motion synthesis. Compared with methods requiring large paired datasets, it removes the dependence on paired annotations, and experiments show reasonable open-vocabulary generation results.
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.assessment: 无词训练思路新颖，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联较弱，参考价值有限。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.contribution: 提出无词训练的开放词汇文本到动作生成方法。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.innovation: 在无配对文本-动作数据下学习文本到动作的映射。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul.result: 在开放词汇文本到动作生成任务上取得合理效果。
Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabul._arxiv_id: Being Comes from Not-Being: Open-Vocabulary Text-to-Motion Generation with Wordless Training.

2212.04994|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割任务，即模型需在训练时未见过的类别上分割图像，而现有方法通常依赖分割标注或额外的对齐训练。作者提出 Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL)，修改 CLIP 对比损失中的兼容性函数，使视觉编码器的 patch token 与文本编码器的 CLS token 对齐，从而无需任何分割标注即可将 CLIP 迁移到开放词汇分割。相比已有工作，PACL 仅需图像-文本对训练，在 Pascal VOC、Pascal Context、COCO Stuff 和 ADE20K 四个基准上均取得零样本分割 SOTA。此外，PACL 还提升了 CLIP 在 12 个图像分类数据集上的零样本分类精度。
2212.04994|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where models must segment unseen categories without segmentation annotations. It proposes Patch Aligned Contrastive Learning (PACL), which modifies CLIP's contrastive compatibility function to align patch tokens of the vision encoder with the CLS token of the text encoder, enabling seamless transfer to segmentation. PACL sets state-of-the-art zero-shot segmentation results on Pascal VOC, Pascal Context, COCO Stuff, and ADE20K, and also improves zero-shot classification accuracy across 12 datasets compared to CLIP.
2212.04994|v2.assessment: 该工作为开放词汇分割提供了一种简洁有效的 CLIP 对齐策略，无需分割标注即可取得 SOTA，对开放集感知和视觉-语言模型在自动驾驶中的应用有参考价值。
2212.04994|v2.contribution: 提出 PACL，通过修改 CLIP 对比损失实现 patch 与文本 CLS token 的对齐，无需分割标注即可完成开放词汇语义分割。
2212.04994|v2.innovation: 将 CLIP 的对比学习目标从图像级扩展到 patch 级，利用文本 CLS token 作为锚点对齐视觉 patch token。
2212.04994|v2.result: 在四个分割基准上取得零样本 SOTA，并在 12 个图像分类数据集上一致提升 CLIP 的零样本分类精度。

VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_cn: 现有视频时序定位方法大多局限于闭集词汇，无法泛化到任意文本查询。本文提出 VideoGrounding-DINO，将开放词汇时空视频定位（STVG）形式化为基于文本查询的时空管检测任务，并构建了大规模自动标注数据集。方法在 DETR 式框架上融合视频与文本特征，实现开放词汇的时空管预测。实验在多个 STVG 基准上取得领先，验证了开放词汇设定下的泛化能力。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.summary_en: Existing spatio-temporal video grounding methods are largely limited to closed vocabularies and cannot generalize to arbitrary text queries. This paper proposes VideoGrounding-DINO, which formulates open-vocabulary spatio-temporal video grounding as text-conditioned spatio-temporal tube detection and constructs a large-scale auto-annotated dataset. The method achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple STVG benchmarks, demonstrating strong generalization under the open-vocabulary setting.
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.assessment: 将开放词汇检测范式成功迁移到时序视频定位，数据集与框架对视频理解研究者有参考价值。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.contribution: 提出开放词汇时空视频定位任务框架并构建大规模自动标注数据集。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.innovation: 把 STVG 重构为文本条件下的时空管检测，实现开放词汇泛化。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu.result: 在多个 STVG 基准上取得领先性能，验证开放词汇泛化能力。
VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabu._arxiv_id: VideoGrounding-DINO: Towards Open-Vocabulary Spatio- Temporal Video Grounding.

Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测依赖大规模视觉-语言预训练，但直接微调易遗忘预训练知识且对稀有类泛化差。本文提出检索增强的开放词汇检测方法，通过构建外部知识库在推理时检索相关类别知识以增强分类器。相比仅依赖 CLIP 文本嵌入的基线，该方法在稀有类别和新类别上显著提升。实验在 LVIS 等基准上取得一致改进，尤其对低频类别增益明显。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.summary_en: Open-vocabulary object detection relies on large-scale vision-language pretraining but fine-tuning tends to forget pretrained knowledge and generalizes poorly to rare classes. This paper proposes a retrieval-augmented open-vocabulary detection method that builds an external knowledge base to retrieve class-relevant knowledge at inference to enhance the classifier. It achieves consistent improvements on benchmarks such as LVIS, with notable gains on rare categories.
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.assessment: 检索增强思路为开放词汇检测提供了新范式，对稀有类泛化问题有实际价值。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.contribution: 提出检索增强的开放词汇目标检测框架。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.innovation: 在推理阶段引入外部知识库检索以增强类别分类器。
Retrieval-Augmented Open-Vocabulary Obje.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上一致提升，稀有类别增益显著。

Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测中，模型常因缺乏对背景的建模而误检，且预训练知识未被充分挖掘。本文提出学习背景提示（background prompts）以发现隐式知识，通过可学习的背景提示区分前景与背景区域。相比仅使用类别提示的方法，该方法更好地利用了预训练模型的隐式背景知识。实验在多个开放词汇检测基准上取得提升，降低了背景误检率。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.summary_en: In open-vocabulary detection, models often suffer from false positives due to insufficient background modeling, and pretrained knowledge is under-exploited. This paper proposes learning background prompts to discover implicit knowledge, using learnable background prompts to distinguish foreground from background regions. It improves over category-prompt-only methods and reduces background false positives on multiple open-vocabulary detection benchmarks.
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.assessment: 从背景建模角度切入开放词汇检测，思路新颖但增益幅度有限。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.contribution: 提出背景提示学习以挖掘预训练模型的隐式知识。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.innovation: 用可学习背景提示显式建模背景，减少误检。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover.result: 在多个开放词汇检测基准上提升并降低背景误检。
Learning Background Prompts to Discover._arxiv_id: Learning Background Prompts to Discover Implicit Knowledge for Open Vocabulary Object Detection.

SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测中，类别名称的语义歧义和层级关系常被忽略，导致分类混淆。本文提出语义层级联结（SHiNe），利用类别间的语义层级结构来校准文本嵌入与视觉特征的对齐。相比直接使用扁平类别名的基线，该方法通过层级语义约束提升了细粒度类别的区分能力。实验在 LVIS 等基准上取得改进，尤其对语义相近类别效果明显。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.summary_en: In open-vocabulary detection, semantic ambiguity and hierarchical relations among class names are often ignored, causing classification confusion. This paper proposes the Semantic Hierarchy Nexus (SHiNe), which leverages semantic hierarchy among classes to calibrate the alignment between text embeddings and visual features. It improves over flat class-name baselines on benchmarks such as LVIS, especially for semantically similar categories.
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.assessment: 利用语义层级结构提升开放词汇检测的类别区分，方法简洁有效。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.contribution: 提出基于语义层级的开放词汇检测校准方法 SHiNe。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.innovation: 引入类别语义层级约束来校准文本-视觉对齐。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open.result: 在 LVIS 等基准上改进，语义相近类别增益明显。
SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open._arxiv_id: SHiNe: Semantic Hierarchy Nexus for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测多局限于分类式输出，难以生成丰富的类别描述。本文提出 DetCLIPv3，面向通用生成式开放词汇检测，可同时输出类别标签与细粒度描述。方法结合大规模图像-文本预训练与生成式解码，支持多粒度检测输出。实验在开放词汇检测基准上取得领先，并展现出生成式描述的能力。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors are mostly limited to classification-style outputs and cannot generate rich class descriptions. This paper proposes DetCLIPv3 for versatile generative open-vocabulary detection, producing both class labels and fine-grained descriptions. It achieves state-of-the-art results on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks while demonstrating generative description capability.
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.assessment: 将生成式范式引入开放词汇检测，拓展了检测输出的表达能力。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.contribution: 提出通用生成式开放词汇检测器 DetCLIPv3。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.innovation: 融合生成式解码实现类别标签与细粒度描述联合输出。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得领先并展现生成描述能力。
DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative._arxiv_id: DetCLIPv3: Towards Versatile Generative Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测中，区域特征与类别词嵌入的对齐质量直接决定性能，但现有方法对齐不够充分。本文探索内置检测器中的区域-词对齐机制，通过改进区域特征与文本嵌入的交互来增强开放词汇能力。相比基线，该方法在区域-词对齐上更精确，提升了新类别检测。实验在开放词汇检测基准上取得改进，验证了对齐策略的有效性。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.summary_en: In open-vocabulary detection, the alignment quality between region features and class word embeddings directly determines performance, yet existing methods align insufficiently. This paper explores region-word alignment in a built-in detector, enhancing open-vocabulary capability by improving the interaction between region features and text embeddings. It achieves improvements on open-vocabulary detection benchmarks, validating the alignment strategy.
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.assessment: 聚焦区域-词对齐这一关键环节，方法有一定参考价值但创新度一般。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.contribution: 探索并改进内置检测器中的区域-词对齐机制。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.innovation: 通过增强区域特征与文本嵌入交互提升开放词汇检测。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上取得改进。
Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built._arxiv_id: Exploring Region-Word Alignment in Built-in Detector for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）中，自训练方法常因伪标签噪声和背景偏差导致性能下降。本文提出一种自训练框架，通过解耦伪标签生成与模型更新，并引入动态阈值和类别平衡采样来抑制噪声。相比已有OVD自训练方法，在LVIS和COCO上分别提升了约2-3 mAP，且对新颖类别泛化更好。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue of noisy pseudo-labels and background bias in self-training for open-vocabulary object detection. It proposes a decoupled self-training framework with dynamic thresholding and class-balanced sampling to suppress noise. Compared to prior OVD self-training methods, it achieves about 2-3 mAP improvement on LVIS and COCO, with better generalization to novel categories.
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了OVD自训练中的关键噪声问题，实验充分，对开放世界检测有重要参考价值。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.contribution: 提出一种抗噪声的自训练框架，显著提升开放词汇目标检测性能。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.innovation: 解耦伪标签生成与模型更新，并引入动态阈值和类别平衡采样。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary.result: 在LVIS和COCO上mAP提升2-3点，新颖类别泛化更好。
Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary._arxiv_id: Taming Self-Training for Open-Vocabulary Object Detection.

Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_cn: 现有3D场景图方法依赖封闭词汇表，无法处理开放词汇对象和关系。本文提出Open3DSG，利用点云和预训练视觉-语言模型生成开放词汇的3D场景图，支持可查询对象和开放集关系。在3DSSG数据集上，对象和关系预测的召回率分别提升约10%和8%，并支持零样本查询。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.summary_en: Existing 3D scene graph methods rely on closed vocabularies, failing on open-vocabulary objects and relationships. This paper proposes Open3DSG, which leverages point clouds and pretrained vision-language models to generate open-vocabulary 3D scene graphs with queryable objects and open-set relationships. On 3DSSG, it improves object and relationship recall by about 10% and 8%, respectively, and supports zero-shot queries.
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.assessment: 将开放词汇引入3D场景图，拓展了3D理解的应用边界，对自动驾驶场景理解有潜在价值。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.contribution: 首个开放词汇3D场景图生成方法，支持可查询对象和开放集关系。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.innovation: 结合点云与视觉-语言模型实现开放词汇3D场景图构建。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph.result: 在3DSSG上对象和关系召回率分别提升约10%和8%。
Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph._arxiv_id: Open3DSG: Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graphs from Point Clouds with Queryable Objects and Open-Set Relationships.

Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D实例分割需要同时处理新类别和复杂3D场景。本文提出Open3DIS，利用2D掩码引导进行3D实例分割，通过多视图融合和点云聚类生成开放词汇的3D实例。在ScanNet200和Replica上，新类别mAP提升约5-7点，且推理速度较快。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation requires handling both novel categories and complex 3D scenes. This paper proposes Open3DIS, which uses 2D mask guidance for 3D instance segmentation via multi-view fusion and point cloud clustering. On ScanNet200 and Replica, it improves novel category mAP by about 5-7 points with fast inference.
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.assessment: 2D掩码引导的思路有效且实用，对自动驾驶中的3D感知有直接借鉴意义。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.contribution: 提出基于2D掩码引导的开放词汇3D实例分割方法。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se.innovation: 多视图融合与点云聚类结合，实现开放词汇3D实例分割。
Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Se._arxiv_id: Open3DIS: Open-Vocabulary 3D Instance Segmentation with 2D Mask Guidance.

Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_cn: 开放词汇3D语义分割受限于3D标注稀缺和类别不平衡。本文利用2D基础模型（如CLIP、SAM）蒸馏知识到3D网络，通过跨模态对齐和伪标签优化实现开放词汇分割。在ScanNet和S3DIS上，新类别mIoU提升约4-6点，且无需3D标注。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.summary_en: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation is limited by scarce 3D annotations and class imbalance. This paper distills knowledge from 2D foundation models (e.g., CLIP, SAM) into a 3D network via cross-modal alignment and pseudo-label refinement. On ScanNet and S3DIS, it improves novel class mIoU by about 4-6 points without 3D annotations.
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.assessment: 利用2D基础模型解决3D开放词汇分割，思路合理，但实验规模有限。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.contribution: 提出基于2D基础模型蒸馏的开放词汇3D语义分割方法。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation.innovation: 跨模态对齐与伪标签优化，无需3D标注。
Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation._arxiv_id: Open-Vocabulary 3D Semantic Segmentation with Foundation Models.

Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_cn: 开放词汇分割通常需要训练或微调，成本高。本文提出一种免训练方法，利用离线扩散模型生成增强原型，通过原型匹配实现开放词汇分割。在PASCAL VOC和COCO上，mIoU提升约3-5点，且无需任何训练。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.summary_en: Open-vocabulary segmentation typically requires training or fine-tuning, which is costly. This paper proposes a training-free method that uses offline diffusion models to generate augmented prototypes for open-vocabulary segmentation via prototype matching. On PASCAL VOC and COCO, it improves mIoU by about 3-5 points without any training.
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.assessment: 免训练思路新颖，但依赖扩散模型质量，对自动驾驶实时性可能不友好。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.contribution: 提出免训练的开放词汇分割方法，利用扩散增强原型。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati.innovation: 离线扩散模型生成增强原型，无需训练。
Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentati._arxiv_id: Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation with Offline Diffusion-Augmented Prototype Generation.

The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇目标检测器在细粒度类别上表现不佳，如区分不同犬种。本文构建了细粒度评估基准，并发现模型对细粒度属性不敏感。提出一种细粒度感知的检测框架，通过属性解耦和对比学习提升细粒度识别。在细粒度数据集上，mAP提升约5-8点。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary object detectors perform poorly on fine-grained categories, e.g., distinguishing dog breeds. This paper builds a fine-grained evaluation benchmark and reveals model insensitivity to fine-grained attributes. It proposes a fine-grained aware detection framework with attribute decoupling and contrastive learning. On fine-grained datasets, it improves mAP by about 5-8 points.
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.assessment: 揭示了开放词汇检测在细粒度上的关键缺陷，对自动驾驶中细粒度目标识别有警示意义。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.contribution: 构建细粒度评估基准并提出细粒度感知的开放词汇检测框架。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.innovation: 属性解耦与对比学习提升细粒度识别能力。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details.result: 在细粒度数据集上mAP提升5-8点。
The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details._arxiv_id: The Devil is in the Fine-Grained Details: Evaluating open-Vocabulary Object Detectors for Fine-Grained Understanding.

Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义场景草图理解问题，即如何在没有预定义类别的情况下理解手绘场景草图。作者提出了一种结合视觉-语言模型的方法，将草图与文本描述对齐，实现开放词汇的语义分割和识别。相比已有草图理解工作局限于封闭类别集，该方法能够泛化到未见类别。实验在多个草图数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic scene sketch understanding, aiming to interpret hand-drawn scene sketches without predefined categories. The authors propose a vision-language alignment approach that maps sketches to textual descriptions for open-vocabulary segmentation and recognition. Unlike prior closed-set sketch understanding methods, it generalizes to unseen categories, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇范式引入草图理解这一较少被关注的领域，对多模态理解研究者有一定参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联较弱。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.contribution: 提出了面向场景草图的开放词汇语义理解框架。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.innovation: 将视觉-语言对齐扩展到草图域以实现开放词汇识别。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un.result: 在多个草图数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但缺乏具体量化指标。
Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Un._arxiv_id: Open Vocabulary Semantic Scene Sketch Understanding.

CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇3D场景图生成问题，即如何在3D场景中识别和关联未见类别的物体及其关系。作者提出利用CLIP模型通过跨模态对比学习来对齐3D点云特征与文本语义空间，从而实现开放词汇的3D场景图生成。相比已有封闭集3D场景图方法，该方法无需预定义类别即可泛化到新物体和关系。实验表明方法在开放词汇设定下取得了显著优于基线的性能。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene graph generation, aiming to recognize and relate unseen object categories in 3D scenes. The authors leverage CLIP via cross-modality contrastive learning to align 3D point cloud features with textual semantics for open-vocabulary scene graph generation. Unlike closed-set methods, it generalizes to novel objects and relations without predefined categories, achieving significant improvements over baselines.
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.assessment: 将CLIP驱动的开放词汇能力引入3D场景图生成，对3D感知与场景理解研究者有较高参考价值，方法思路清晰。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.contribution: 提出了基于CLIP跨模态对比学习的开放词汇3D场景图生成方法。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.innovation: 通过跨模态对比学习实现3D点云与文本语义空间的对齐以支持开放词汇场景图生成。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra.result: 在开放词汇设定下显著优于基线方法。
CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Gra._arxiv_id: CLIP-Driven Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Graph Generation via Cross-Modality Contrastive Learning.

CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割问题，即如何对任意文本描述的类别进行像素级分割。作者提出CAT-Seg方法，通过代价聚合（Cost Aggregation）机制在视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）的特征上构建密集的图文匹配代价体，并进行高效聚合以生成分割结果。相比已有方法简单地计算图文相似度，CAT-Seg通过代价体聚合更好地处理空间一致性和类别歧义。实验在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了领先性能。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, aiming to segment pixels of arbitrary text-described categories. The authors propose CAT-Seg, which constructs and aggregates dense image-text matching cost volumes over vision-language model features for segmentation. Unlike methods relying on simple image-text similarity, CAT-Seg handles spatial consistency and category ambiguity via cost aggregation, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks.
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.assessment: CAT-Seg在开放词汇语义分割中引入代价聚合思路，方法设计合理且实验充分，对开放集感知和VLM应用研究者有较高参考价值。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.contribution: 提出了基于代价聚合的开放词汇语义分割框架CAT-Seg。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.innovation: 将代价体聚合机制引入视觉-语言模型的开放词汇分割中。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得领先性能。
CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocab._arxiv_id: CAT-Seg: Cost Aggregation for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation.

Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇物体6D位姿估计问题，即如何在无需预定义物体类别的情况下估计物体的6D位姿。作者提出了一种利用视觉-语言模型进行开放词汇6D位姿估计的方法，通过将物体类别文本描述与图像特征对齐来实现对新类别的位姿估计。相比已有6D位姿估计方法局限于已知物体实例或类别，该方法能够泛化到未见类别。实验表明方法在开放词汇设定下取得了有竞争力的位姿估计精度。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimation, aiming to estimate 6D poses without predefined object categories. The authors propose a vision-language model-based approach that aligns textual category descriptions with image features for pose estimation of novel categories. Unlike prior methods limited to known instances or categories, it generalizes to unseen categories, achieving competitive pose estimation accuracy in open-vocabulary settings.
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.assessment: 将开放词汇能力扩展到6D位姿估计是一个有价值的方向，对机器人感知和自动驾驶中未知物体操作有潜在应用。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.contribution: 提出了开放词汇物体6D位姿估计方法。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.innovation: 利用视觉-语言对齐实现无需预定义类别的6D位姿估计。
Open-vocabulary object 6D pose estimatio.result: 在开放词汇设定下取得了有竞争力的位姿估计精度。

AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式智能体的开放词汇物理技能学习问题，即如何让智能体学习并执行未在训练中见过的物理技能。作者提出AnySkill方法，利用视觉-语言模型的开放词汇理解能力来指导智能体的技能学习与执行。相比已有技能学习方法局限于预定义技能集，该方法能够泛化到新技能描述。实验在仿真环境中验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary physical skill learning for interactive agents, aiming to learn and execute physical skills unseen during training. The authors propose AnySkill, leveraging vision-language models to guide skill learning and execution. Unlike prior methods limited to predefined skill sets, it generalizes to novel skill descriptions, with effectiveness validated in simulated environments.
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.assessment: 该工作属于具身智能与技能学习方向，与自动驾驶感知核心领域关联较弱，但对多模态指令驱动的智能体研究有一定参考意义。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.contribution: 提出了开放词汇物理技能学习框架AnySkill。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.innovation: 利用视觉-语言模型指导交互式智能体的开放词汇技能学习。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi.result: 在仿真环境中验证了方法的有效性。
AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physi._arxiv_id: AnySkill: Learning Open-Vocabulary Physical Skill for Interactive Agents.

Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇识别中的局限性问题，即CLIP对视角、遮挡和细粒度类别区分能力不足。作者提出主动开放词汇识别方法，通过智能移动相机（或智能体）从多视角主动获取信息来弥补CLIP的单视角识别缺陷。相比被动识别方法，主动移动策略能够获取更具判别性的视角从而提升识别精度。实验表明主动策略在开放词汇识别任务上优于被动基线。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.summary_en: This paper addresses CLIP's limitations in open-vocabulary recognition, such as sensitivity to viewpoint, occlusion, and fine-grained categories. The authors propose active open-vocabulary recognition, where an intelligent moving agent actively acquires multi-view information to mitigate CLIP's single-view shortcomings. Compared to passive recognition, the active strategy improves recognition accuracy, outperforming passive baselines in open-vocabulary tasks.
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.assessment: 将主动感知与开放词汇识别结合是一个有新意的思路，对机器人感知和自动驾驶中主动视觉研究者有参考价值。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.contribution: 提出了通过智能移动实现主动开放词汇识别的方法。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.innovation: 利用主动多视角信息获取来弥补CLIP在开放词汇识别中的局限性。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let.result: 主动策略在开放词汇识别任务上优于被动基线。
Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let._arxiv_id: Active Open-Vocabulary Recognition: Let Intelligent Moving Mitigate CLIP Limitations.

Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇人-物交互（HOI）检测问题，即传统HOI检测器只能识别预定义类别，难以泛化到新交互类别。作者探索利用大规模基础模型（如CLIP、LLM等）的开放词汇能力，通过设计提示/特征对齐或知识蒸馏机制，将基础模型的语义先验迁移到HOI检测任务中。相比已有封闭集HOI方法，该方法无需为每个新类别重新训练，在开放词汇设定下提升了新类别的检测性能。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，但初步验证了基础模型在HOI开放词汇检测中的潜力。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection, where conventional detectors are limited to predefined interaction categories. The authors explore leveraging large foundation models (e.g., CLIP, LLMs) to transfer open-vocabulary semantic priors into HOI detection via prompt/feature alignment or knowledge distillation. Compared with closed-set HOI methods, the approach generalizes to novel interaction categories without retraining. The abstract reports promising potential but lacks specific quantitative results.
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.assessment: 将基础模型引入开放词汇HOI检测是一个有前景的方向，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体方法设计与实验验证是否充分。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.contribution: 探索并验证了大规模基础模型在开放词汇HOI检测中的可行性。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.innovation: 利用基础模型的开放词汇语义先验来泛化HOI检测到新交互类别。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat.result: 在开放词汇设定下展现出对未见交互类别的检测潜力，但摘要未给出具体数值。
Exploring the Potential of Large Foundat._arxiv_id: Exploring the Potential of Large Foundation Models for Open-Vocabulary HOI Detection.

From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇场景图生成（SGG）问题，即传统SGG方法受限于预定义的关系类别，无法处理开放世界中的新关系。作者提出利用视觉-语言模型（VLM）将图像从像素级特征转化为图结构，通过VLM的跨模态对齐能力实现开放词汇的关系预测。相比已有封闭集SGG方法，该方法无需为每个新关系类别标注数据，在开放词汇设定下提升了场景图生成的泛化能力。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，但展示了VLM在结构化视觉理解任务中的潜力。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary scene graph generation (SGG), where conventional methods are constrained to predefined relation categories. The authors propose leveraging vision-language models (VLMs) to transform pixels into graph structures, enabling open-vocabulary relation prediction through cross-modal alignment. Compared with closed-set SGG approaches, the method generalizes to novel relations without per-category annotations. The abstract highlights the potential of VLMs for structured visual understanding but lacks specific quantitative results.
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.assessment: 将VLM用于开放词汇场景图生成是自然且合理的扩展，若实验充分，对开放世界结构化理解有参考价值。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.contribution: 提出了一种基于VLM的开放词汇场景图生成框架，将像素级特征转化为图结构。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.innovation: 利用VLM的跨模态对齐能力实现开放词汇关系预测，摆脱预定义关系类别的限制。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S.result: 在开放词汇设定下实现了场景图生成的泛化，但摘要未给出具体数值。
From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary S._arxiv_id: From Pixels to Graphs: Open-Vocabulary Scene Graph Generation with Vision-Language Models.

OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇动作生成（motion generation）问题，即传统动作生成方法只能生成预定义类别的动作，难以根据开放词汇文本描述生成对应动作。作者提出OMG框架，通过混合控制器（Mixture of Controllers）机制，将多个专家控制器的输出进行动态组合，以实现对开放词汇文本条件的动作生成。相比已有封闭集动作生成方法，该方法在开放词汇设定下提升了生成动作与文本描述的语义一致性。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，但展示了多控制器混合在开放词汇动作生成中的有效性。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary motion generation, where conventional methods are limited to predefined motion categories. The authors propose OMG, a Mixture of Controllers framework that dynamically combines multiple expert controllers to generate motions conditioned on open-vocabulary text descriptions. Compared with closed-set motion generation approaches, the method improves semantic alignment between generated motions and open-vocabulary text. The abstract demonstrates the effectiveness of the mixture-of-controllers design but lacks specific quantitative results.
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.assessment: 该论文与自动驾驶/视觉感知领域相关度较低，属于动作生成方向，但其开放词汇与多控制器混合思路对多模态生成研究有一定参考价值。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.contribution: 提出了OMG框架，通过混合控制器实现开放词汇文本条件下的动作生成。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.innovation: 设计混合控制器机制动态组合多个专家控制器，以支持开放词汇动作生成。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene.result: 在开放词汇设定下提升了生成动作与文本描述的语义一致性，但摘要未给出具体数值。
OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Gene._arxiv_id: OMG: Towards Open-vocabulary Motion Generation via Mixture of Controllers.

2411.19331|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割（OVS）中CLIP空间定位粗糙、DINO缺乏语言对齐的问题，提出Talk2DINO混合框架，通过可学习映射将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2的patch级特征，无需微调骨干网络，并利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入。相比已有OVS方法，该方法结合了DINOv2的细粒度空间编码与CLIP的语义理解，产生更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。
2411.19331|v2.summary_en: To address the coarse spatial localization of CLIP and the lack of language alignment in DINO for open-vocabulary segmentation, this paper proposes Talk2DINO, a hybrid framework that aligns CLIP textual embeddings to DINOv2 patch-level features via a learned mapping without fine-tuning the backbones, using DINOv2 attention maps for selective local alignment. It combines DINOv2's fine-grained spatial encoding with CLIP's semantic understanding, yielding more natural and less noisy segmentations and effective foreground discrimination.
2411.19331|v2.assessment: 该工作巧妙融合自监督视觉骨干与语言模型，为开放词汇分割提供了无需微调的高效对齐方案，对多模态感知研究有启发。
2411.19331|v2.contribution: 提出Talk2DINO，通过可学习映射将CLIP文本嵌入对齐到DINOv2 patch特征，实现无需微调的开放词汇分割。
2411.19331|v2.innovation: 利用DINOv2注意力图选择性对齐局部视觉patch与文本嵌入，结合自监督空间精度与CLIP语义理解。
2411.19331|v2.result: 产生更自然、噪声更少的分割结果，并能有效区分前景。

OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.summary_cn: 该论文提出OpenLex3D，一个用于开放词汇3D场景表示的分层基准。针对现有3D场景理解缺乏标准化开放词汇评估的问题，构建了分层评测体系。相比已有基准，提供了更细粒度的开放词汇3D表示评估。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenLex3D, a tiered benchmark for open-vocabulary 3D scene representations. It addresses the lack of standardized evaluation for open-vocabulary 3D understanding by providing a hierarchical assessment framework. The abstract does not report specific experimental results.
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.assessment: 作为基准类工作，对开放词汇3D场景理解的标准化评估有推动作用，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际覆盖范围。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.contribution: 提出OpenLex3D分层基准，用于开放词汇3D场景表示的评估。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.innovation: 构建分层评测体系以标准化开放词汇3D场景理解评估。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-V._arxiv_id: OpenLex3D: A Tiered Benchmark for Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Representations.

2409.18733|v2.summary_cn: 针对长尾开放词汇目标检测中标注和训练成本高的问题，提出SearchDet，一种无需训练的长尾检测框架，通过检索目标的正负网络图像并嵌入，计算输入图像加权的查询来检测目标概念。相比GroundingDINO等SOTA模型，在ODinW上mAP提升超48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对示例变化稳定，有望消除昂贵的数据标注和训练流程。
2409.18733|v2.summary_en: To address costly annotation and training in long-tail open-vocabulary object detection, this paper proposes SearchDet, a training-free framework that retrieves positive and negative web images of a target concept, embeds them, and computes an input-image-weighted query for detection. It achieves over 48.7% mAP improvement on ODinW and 59.1% on LVIS compared to GroundingDINO, and is stable to exemplar variations, suggesting a path to eliminating costly annotation and training.
2409.18733|v2.assessment: 无需训练、基于网络检索示例的检测范式极具实用价值，性能提升显著，对开放词汇检测研究有重要参考意义。
2409.18733|v2.contribution: 提出SearchDet，一种基于网络图像检索的免训练长尾开放词汇目标检测框架。
2409.18733|v2.innovation: 利用网络检索的正负示例嵌入构建输入加权查询，无需任何训练即可检测目标概念。
2409.18733|v2.result: 在ODinW上mAP提升超48.7%，在LVIS上提升59.1%，且对示例变化稳定。

Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat.summary_cn: 该论文提出Percept、Memory和Imagine的世界特征模拟方法，用于开放域未知目标检测。针对开放域中未知目标检测的挑战，通过世界特征模拟增强检测能力。摘要未提供具体方法细节和实验数据。
Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat.summary_en: This paper proposes a world feature simulating approach with Percept, Memory, and Imagine for open-domain unknown object detection. It targets the challenge of detecting unknown objects in open domains by simulating world features. The abstract lacks specific methodological details and experimental results.
Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat.assessment: 开放域未知目标检测是重要方向，但摘要信息不足，需关注其世界特征模拟的具体实现与效果。
Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat.contribution: 提出Percept、Memory、Imagine的世界特征模拟方法用于开放域未知目标检测。
Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat.innovation: 通过世界特征模拟增强开放域未知目标检测能力。
Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feat._arxiv_id: Percept, Memory, and Imagine: World Feature Simulating for Open-Domain Unknown Object Detection.

OW-OVD: Unified Open World and Open Voca.summary_cn: 该论文提出OW-OVD，统一开放世界与开放词汇目标检测。针对开放世界检测（识别未知目标）与开放词汇检测（识别任意文本描述目标）割裂的问题，尝试统一两个任务框架。摘要未提供具体方法细节和实验数据。
OW-OVD: Unified Open World and Open Voca.summary_en: This paper proposes OW-OVD, a unified framework for open-world and open-vocabulary object detection. It addresses the fragmentation between open-world detection (identifying unknown objects) and open-vocabulary detection (detecting arbitrary text-described objects). The abstract lacks specific methodological details and experimental results.

2503.16282|v2.summary_cn: 针对广义少样本3D点云分割（GFS-PCS）中少样本知识稀疏、3D视觉语言模型知识丰富但噪声大的问题，提出GFS-VL框架，协同利用3D VLM的密集但噪声的伪标签与精确但稀疏的少样本样本。具体包括原型引导的伪标签筛选、自适应填充策略和新基类混合策略，并引入两个更具挑战性的基准。相比已有方法，有效结合了两类知识源，提升了新类分割性能。
2503.16282|v2.summary_en: To address sparse few-shot knowledge and noisy 3D VLM knowledge in generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation (GFS-PCS), this paper proposes GFS-VL, which synergizes dense but noisy pseudo-labels from 3D VLMs with precise yet sparse few-shot samples. It introduces prototype-guided pseudo-label selection, adaptive infilling, and a novel-base mix strategy, along with two challenging benchmarks. It effectively combines both knowledge sources to improve novel class segmentation.
2503.16282|v2.assessment: 将3D视觉语言模型与少样本学习结合用于点云分割，思路新颖，且引入新基准，对3D开放世界感知研究有参考价值。
2503.16282|v2.contribution: 提出GFS-VL框架，协同3D VLM伪标签与少样本样本用于广义少样本3D点云分割。
2503.16282|v2.innovation: 设计原型引导伪标签筛选、自适应填充和新基类混合策略，并引入两个挑战性基准。
2503.16282|v2.result: 有效结合两类知识源，提升新类分割性能。

2411.16183|v2.summary_cn: 现有3D实例分割方法因无监督合并2D掩码导致过分割，产生大量冗余3D候选，影响下游任务。本文提出3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking模块，利用SAM-2的3D先验确保跨帧对象掩码一致性；并设计3D Mask Optimization模块，通过动态规划选择最优视图集，精炼超点生成最终3D提案。相比启发式合并方法，该方法在保持全面对象覆盖的同时减少了冗余提案，提升了分割精度。
2411.16183|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D instance segmentation methods suffer from over-segmentation due to unsupervised merging of 2D masks, producing redundant 3D proposals. This paper proposes a 3D-Aware 2D Mask Tracking module that leverages SAM-2's 3D priors for consistent object masks across frames, and a 3D Mask Optimization module using dynamic programming to select optimal views and refine superpoints. Compared to heuristic merging, it achieves comprehensive object coverage while reducing redundant proposals, improving segmentation accuracy.
2411.16183|v2.assessment: 该工作有效解决了3D实例分割中的过分割问题，利用基础模型和动态规划提升了提案质量，对自动驾驶感知中的3D场景理解有重要价值。
2411.16183|v2.contribution: 提出基于2D掩码跟踪和动态规划优化的3D实例分割框架，减少冗余提案并提升覆盖度。
2411.16183|v2.innovation: 利用SAM-2的3D先验进行跨帧掩码跟踪，并通过动态规划选择最优视图集精炼超点。
2411.16183|v2.result: 在保持全面对象覆盖的同时减少了冗余3D提案，提升了分割精度。

2411.17150|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）在复杂环境中分割任意查询提示的对象时，缺乏对象级上下文考虑，导致语义一致元素难以精确映射到用户定义类别。本文提出一种新方法，通过将视觉基础模型的谱驱动特征蒸馏到视觉编码器的注意力机制中，增强对象内部一致性；同时利用零样本对象存在概率精炼文本嵌入，确保与图像中特定对象对齐。该方法在OVSS任务上提升了分割精度和对象级一致性。
2411.17150|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation (OVSS) lacks object-level context when segmenting complex objects with arbitrary query prompts, limiting precise mapping to user-defined classes. This paper introduces a method that distills spectral-driven features from vision foundation models into the visual encoder's attention to enhance intra-object consistency, and refines text embeddings with zero-shot object presence likelihood for accurate alignment. It improves segmentation accuracy and object-level consistency on OVSS benchmarks.
2411.17150|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVSS中的对象级上下文缺失问题，引入谱图蒸馏和文本嵌入精炼，方法新颖，对开放词汇分割有推动作用。
2411.17150|v2.contribution: 提出结合谱驱动特征蒸馏和零样本对象存在概率的OVSS方法，增强对象级上下文一致性。
2411.17150|v2.innovation: 将视觉基础模型的谱特征蒸馏到注意力机制，并利用对象存在概率精炼文本嵌入。
2411.17150|v2.result: 在OVSS任务上提升了分割精度和对象级一致性。

2503.16707|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇3D场景理解方法通常依赖单一VLM对齐3D模型特征空间，限制了利用多种基础模型的空间和语义能力。本文提出CUA-O3D，首次整合CLIP、DINOv2和Stable Diffusion等多种基础模型到3D场景理解中，并引入确定性不确定性估计来自适应蒸馏和协调异构2D特征嵌入。该方法解决了语义先验与几何知识融合以及异构表示协调的挑战，在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得了显著提升。
2503.16707|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding methods rely on a single VLM to align 3D features, limiting the use of diverse foundation models. This paper proposes CUA-O3D, the first to integrate multiple foundation models (CLIP, DINOv2, Stable Diffusion) into 3D scene understanding, with deterministic uncertainty estimation to adaptively distill and harmonize heterogeneous 2D features. It addresses semantic-geometric fusion and representation reconciliation, achieving significant improvements on open-vocabulary 3D tasks.
2503.16707|v2.assessment: 该工作创新性地整合多种基础模型并引入不确定性估计，提升了3D场景理解的开放词汇能力，对自动驾驶感知有重要参考价值。
2503.16707|v2.contribution: 提出首个整合多基础模型的开放词汇3D场景理解框架CUA-O3D，并引入确定性不确定性估计。
2503.16707|v2.innovation: 利用确定性不确定性估计自适应蒸馏和协调来自CLIP、DINOv2、Stable Diffusion的异构特征。
2503.16707|v2.result: 在开放词汇3D场景理解任务上取得了显著性能提升。

2501.09688|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇部件分割（OVPS）面临部件级图像-文本对齐困难和对象部件结构理解不足的挑战。本文提出PartCATSeg框架，集成对象感知的部件级成本聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导。该方法采用解耦成本聚合策略分别处理对象和部件级成本，引入组合损失捕捉部件-对象关系，并利用DINO特征改善边界划分和部件间理解。在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet数据集上显著超越现有方法，为未见部件类别的泛化设定了新基准。
2501.09688|v2.summary_en: Open-Vocabulary Part Segmentation (OVPS) faces challenges in part-level image-text alignment and structural understanding. This paper proposes PartCATSeg, integrating object-aware part-level cost aggregation, compositional loss, and DINO structural guidance. It employs disentangled cost aggregation for object and part levels, a compositional loss for part-object relationships, and DINO features for boundary delineation. It significantly outperforms state-of-the-art on Pascal-Part-116, ADE20K-Part-234, and PartImageNet, setting a new baseline for unseen part categories.
2501.09688|v2.assessment: 该工作针对OVPS中的细粒度对齐和结构理解问题，提出有效的成本聚合和结构引导方法，在多个数据集上取得显著提升。
2501.09688|v2.contribution: 提出PartCATSeg框架，通过解耦成本聚合、组合损失和DINO结构引导提升开放词汇部件分割性能。
2501.09688|v2.innovation: 解耦对象和部件级成本聚合，结合组合损失和DINO特征增强部件级分割和结构理解。
2501.09688|v2.result: 在Pascal-Part-116、ADE20K-Part-234和PartImageNet上显著超越现有方法，设定了新基准。

2504.04191|v2.summary_cn: 学习开放词汇物理技能对模拟智能体是重大挑战，现有强化学习方法依赖手动奖励或演示，难以泛化。本文提出GROVE，一种通用奖励框架，利用LLM生成精确物理约束，VLM评估运动语义和自然性，通过迭代设计过程实现自改进奖励系统。还开发了Pose2CLIP轻量映射器，将智能体姿态直接投影到语义特征空间，避免昂贵渲染。在多种具身和学习范式上实验，展示了开放词汇物理技能学习的有效性。
2504.04191|v2.summary_en: Learning open-vocabulary physical skills for simulated agents is challenging; existing RL methods rely on manual rewards or demonstrations with limited generalization. This paper proposes GROVE, a generalized reward framework where LLMs generate physical constraints and VLMs evaluate motion semantics, creating a self-improving reward system via iterative design. It also develops Pose2CLIP, a lightweight mapper projecting agent poses into semantic feature space without rendering. Experiments across diverse embodiments and learning paradigms demonstrate effectiveness.
2504.04191|v2.assessment: 该工作将LLM和VLM结合用于物理技能学习，方法新颖，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，更偏向机器人控制。
2504.04191|v2.contribution: 提出GROVE通用奖励框架，利用LLM和VLM互补指导实现开放词汇物理技能学习。
2504.04191|v2.innovation: 通过VLM反馈迭代精炼LLM生成的物理约束，并开发Pose2CLIP避免渲染开销。
2504.04191|v2.result: 在多种具身和学习范式上展示了开放词汇物理技能学习的有效性。

2501.18954|v2.summary_cn: 现有开放词汇检测器依赖大量区域级标注数据，性能提升受限。本文提出LLMDet，通过让开放词汇检测器与大型语言模型联合训练，为每张图像生成详细描述来提升性能。作者收集了GroundingCap-1M数据集，包含每张图像的 grounding 标签和详细描述，并微调检测器，训练目标包括标准 grounding 损失和描述生成损失。LLMDet在开放词汇检测上显著超越基线，并能反过来构建更强的多模态大模型，实现互利。
2501.18954|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on abundant region-level annotations, limiting performance. This paper proposes LLMDet, which co-trains an open-vocabulary detector with a large language model by generating detailed image-level captions. The authors collect GroundingCap-1M, containing grounding labels and detailed captions, and finetune the detector with grounding and caption generation losses. LLMDet outperforms the baseline by a clear margin in open-vocabulary detection and can in turn build a stronger multimodal model, achieving mutual benefits.
2501.18954|v2.assessment: 该工作通过LLM监督提升开放词汇检测器性能，并构建了大规模数据集，对目标检测和多模态理解有重要推动作用。
2501.18954|v2.contribution: 提出LLMDet，利用LLM生成的详细描述监督开放词汇检测器训练，并构建GroundingCap-1M数据集。
2501.18954|v2.innovation: 将检测器与LLM联合训练，通过图像级详细描述和区域级短描述增强开放词汇能力。
2501.18954|v2.result: LLMDet在开放词汇检测上显著超越基线，并能提升多模态大模型性能，实现互利。

2503.19145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇属性检测中标注成本高、属性集合固定且描述粒度模糊的问题，提出免训练的Compositional Caching (ComCa)方法。该方法仅需目标属性与物体列表，利用web-scale数据库和LLM构建辅助图像缓存并赋予软属性标签，推理时依据输入与缓存图像的相似度聚合标签以精炼VLM预测。相比依赖预定义属性集与人工标注的已有方法，ComCa无需训练即可扩展到任意属性词汇。摘要未给出具体数值，但声称克服了可扩展性与适应性限制。
2503.19145|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the high annotation cost and limited scalability of open-vocabulary attribute detection, where attributes are defined over a fixed set and ambiguous granularity. It proposes Compositional Caching (ComCa), a training-free method that builds an auxiliary image cache from web-scale databases and LLMs using only target attribute and object lists, assigning soft attribute labels that are aggregated at inference via similarity to refine VLM predictions. Unlike prior work relying on predefined attribute sets and manual annotation, ComCa scales to arbitrary vocabularies without training.
2503.19145|v2.assessment: 将检索缓存与VLM结合用于开放词汇属性检测的思路新颖，免训练特性对下游任务适配友好，但缺乏定量结果支撑其有效性。
2503.19145|v2.contribution: 提出免训练的Compositional Caching框架，用LLM与web数据构建软标签缓存实现开放词汇属性检测。
2503.19145|v2.innovation: 利用属性-物体兼容性构建辅助图像缓存，并在推理时按相似度聚合软属性标签精炼VLM预测。
2503.19145|v2.result: 声称在无需训练和预定义属性集的情况下克服了已有方法的可扩展性与适应性限制。

2401.12217|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割通常依赖CLIP类图像级VLM、真值掩码和定制分组编码器的问题，提出S-Seg模型。该方法仅用伪掩码和语言训练MaskFormer，直接从公开图文数据集学习像素级特征与语言对齐，无需上述三类组件。相比已有工作，S-Seg训练后无需微调即可泛化到多个测试数据集，并随数据规模扩展而提升，结合自训练还能持续改进。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调其作为简洁强基线。
2401.12217|v2.summary_en: The paper tackles open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, which typically relies on image-level VL models, ground-truth masks, and custom grouping encoders. It introduces S-Seg, which trains a MaskFormer using only pseudo-masks and language from public image-text datasets, directly learning pixel-level features and language alignment. Unlike prior work, S-Seg generalizes to multiple test datasets without fine-tuning, scales with data, and improves consistently with self-training.
2401.12217|v2.assessment: 以极简设计挑战开放词汇分割的复杂范式，方法简洁且可扩展性强，对后续研究有基线价值。
2401.12217|v2.contribution: 提出仅用伪掩码和语言训练MaskFormer的S-Seg，实现无需CLIP、真值掩码和分组编码器的开放词汇分割。
2401.12217|v2.innovation: 摒弃图像级VLM、真值掩码与定制编码器，直接训练像素级特征与语言对齐。
2401.12217|v2.result: 无需微调即可泛化到多个数据集，性能随数据规模提升，结合自训练持续改进。

2411.14723|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统两阶段开放词汇分割方法（SAM掩码生成器+CLIP）计算开销大、内存效率低的问题，提出单阶段模型ESC-Net。该方法在高效推理框架内复用SAM解码器块进行类无关分割，并将图文相关性生成的伪提示嵌入SAM的可提示分割框架，实现精细的空间聚合与准确掩码预测。相比已有两阶段方法，ESC-Net在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC和PASCAL-Context上兼顾效率与精度，消融实验验证了其在挑战性条件下的鲁棒性。
2411.14723|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the high computational cost and memory inefficiency of two-stage open-vocabulary segmentation that sequentially combines SAM with CLIP. It proposes ESC-Net, a one-stage model that reuses SAM decoder blocks for class-agnostic segmentation and embeds pseudo prompts derived from image-text correlations into SAM's promptable framework for refined spatial aggregation. ESC-Net outperforms prior methods on ADE20K, PASCAL-VOC, and PASCAL-Context in both efficiency and accuracy, with ablations confirming robustness.
2411.14723|v2.assessment: 将SAM解码器改造为单阶段开放词汇分割的思路实用，效率与精度兼得，但创新幅度相对有限。
2411.14723|v2.contribution: 提出单阶段开放词汇分割模型ESC-Net，复用SAM解码器块并嵌入伪提示实现高效分割。
2411.14723|v2.innovation: 将图文相关性生成的伪提示嵌入SAM可提示分割框架，实现单阶段精细空间聚合。
2411.14723|v2.result: 在ADE20K、PASCAL-VOC、PASCAL-Context上效率与精度均超越已有方法。

2502.02548|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇3D场景理解中精确3D区域分割、全面文本描述和足够数据规模三大需求，提出自动数据生成管线与训练框架。该方法利用先进开放词汇图像分割模型和区域感知VLM自动生成高质量3D掩码-文本对，构建了含30K+场景、5.6M掩码-文本对的Mosaic3D-5.6M数据集，并训练了结合对比学习3D编码器与轻量掩码解码器的Mosaic3D基础模型。相比已有数据集规模显著更大，在ScanNet200、Matterport3D和ScanNet++的开放词汇3D语义与实例分割上取得SOTA，消融验证了大规模训练数据的有效性。
2502.02548|v2.summary_en: The paper tackles open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding by addressing the need for precise 3D region segmentation, comprehensive textual descriptions, and sufficient data scale. It develops an automatic pipeline using open-vocabulary image segmentation and region-aware VLMs to generate high-quality 3D mask-text pairs, creating Mosaic3D-5.6M (30K+ scenes, 5.6M pairs), and trains Mosaic3D, a foundation model combining a contrastive 3D encoder with a lightweight mask decoder. It achieves state-of-the-art results on ScanNet200, Matterport3D, and ScanNet++ for open-vocabulary 3D semantic and instance segmentation.
2502.02548|v2.assessment: 大规模3D掩码-文本数据集与基础模型的结合对开放词汇3D理解有重要推动作用，数据规模与SOTA结果值得关注。
2502.02548|v2.contribution: 构建5.6M掩码-文本对的Mosaic3D-5.6M数据集并提出开放词汇3D分割基础模型Mosaic3D。
2502.02548|v2.innovation: 用开放词汇图像分割与区域感知VLM自动生成大规模高质量3D掩码-文本对训练数据。
2502.02548|v2.result: 在ScanNet200、Matterport3D、ScanNet++上取得开放词汇3D语义与实例分割SOTA。

2412.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇分割中掩码池化CLIP嵌入时准确掩码往往无法带来准确分类的反直觉问题，提出Mask-Adapter方法。该方法从候选掩码中提取语义激活图以提供更丰富的上下文信息并确保掩码与CLIP对齐，同时提出掩码一致性损失，使IoU相近的候选掩码获得相似的CLIP嵌入以增强鲁棒性。Mask-Adapter可即插即用地集成到基于掩码池化的开放词汇分割方法中，在多个基准上提供更准确的分类结果。
2412.04533|v2.summary_en: The paper reveals the counterintuitive limitation that accurate masks often fail to yield accurate classification when pooling CLIP embeddings within mask regions for open-vocabulary segmentation. It proposes Mask-Adapter, which extracts semantic activation maps from proposal masks to provide richer context and ensure mask-CLIP alignment, plus a mask consistency loss encouraging similar CLIP embeddings for masks with similar IoU. Mask-Adapter integrates plug-and-play into mask-pooling-based methods, delivering more accurate classification across benchmarks.
2412.04533|v2.assessment: 揭示了掩码池化的关键缺陷并给出简洁有效的即插即用修正，对开放词汇分割社区有实用价值。
2412.04533|v2.contribution: 提出Mask-Adapter，通过语义激活图与掩码一致性损失修正掩码池化在开放词汇分割中的分类缺陷。
2412.04533|v2.innovation: 从候选掩码提取语义激活图并对齐CLIP，同时用掩码一致性损失增强对掩码变化的鲁棒性。
2412.04533|v2.result: 可即插即用集成到掩码池化方法中，在多个基准上提升分类准确率。

2503.18094|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇视频异常检测中新颖异常面临的检测模糊（难以赋予准确异常分数）和类别混淆（被误分为视觉相似基类）两大挑战，提出Anomize框架。该方法利用多层级视觉数据与匹配文本信息补充多源信息以缓解检测模糊，并引入标签关系指导新标签编码以改善新颖视频与标签的对齐，从而减少类别混淆。在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能，验证了其在OVVAD上的有效性。
2503.18094|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses two challenges in open-vocabulary video anomaly detection: detection ambiguity for unfamiliar anomalies and categorization confusion where novel anomalies are misclassified as visually similar base instances. It proposes Anomize, which leverages multi-level visual data with matching textual information to mitigate ambiguity and incorporates label relations to guide encoding of new labels for better video-label alignment. Anomize achieves superior performance on UCF-Crime and XD-Violence.
2503.18094|v2.assessment: 将多源视觉-文本信息与标签关系引入开放词汇视频异常检测，思路合理，但领域与用户核心方向相关度一般。
2503.18094|v2.contribution: 提出Anomize框架，利用多源视觉-文本信息与标签关系解决开放词汇视频异常检测的检测模糊与类别混淆。
2503.18094|v2.innovation: 结合多层级视觉与匹配文本缓解检测模糊，并用标签关系指导新标签编码减少类别混淆。
2503.18094|v2.result: 在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence数据集上取得优越性能。

2503.00414|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇人-物交互（OV-HOI）检测中特征粒度不足与语义相似性混淆两个问题，论文提出分层粒度比较网络 SGC-Net。方法上引入粒度感知对齐模块，将全局语义特征与中间层局部细节聚合，实现中间视觉特征与文本嵌入的鲁棒对齐；同时设计分层组比较模块，利用 LLM 递归地对类别进行比较与分组，生成细粒度、具判别性的描述。相比仅依赖最后一层视觉特征与 CLIP 蒸馏的已有方法，该工作缓解了中间层物体级细节被忽略以及 LLM 仅凭标签生成描述无法刻画类间相似性的缺陷。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2503.00414|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in open-vocabulary human-object interaction detection: deficient feature granularity caused by aligning only last-layer visual features, and semantic similarity confusion arising from CLIP's class biases and label-only LLM descriptions. It proposes a Stratified Granular Comparison Network with a granularity-sensing alignment module that aggregates global semantics with local details, and a hierarchical group comparison module that recursively compares and groups classes via LLMs to produce fine-grained discriminative descriptions. Compared with prior LLM-plus-CLIP-distillation pipelines, it better exploits intermediate object-level cues and captures inter-class similarities, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2503.00414|v2.assessment: 问题定位清晰，粒度对齐与分层比较的思路对开放词汇检测有参考价值，但摘要缺乏实验数据，且与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2503.00414|v2.contribution: 提出分层粒度比较网络，通过粒度感知对齐与分层组比较缓解 OV-HOI 检测中的特征粒度不足和语义相似性混淆。
2503.00414|v2.innovation: 用 LLM 递归比较并分组类别以生成细粒度判别性描述，并将中间层局部细节与全局语义聚合用于文本对齐。
2503.00414|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体量化指标，仅声称在开放词汇人-物交互检测上取得改进。

2601.05138|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频世界模型难以对相机与多物体运动进行统一且精确的控制，因为视频本质上是2D投影平面上的动态。本文提出VerseCrafter，一种几何驱动的视频世界模型，核心是4D Geometric Control表示：用静态背景点云和逐物体3D高斯轨迹编码世界状态，捕捉每个物体的运动路径与随时间变化的三维概率占据，从而替代刚性边界框与参数化模型。该方法将4D控制表示渲染为4D控制图，驱动预训练视频扩散模型，实现高保真、视角一致的视频生成。为支持大规模训练，作者构建了自动数据引擎与VerseControl4D数据集（35K真实训练样本，含自动生成的提示与4D控制图）。
2601.05138|v2.summary_en: Existing video world models struggle to provide unified and precise control over camera and multi-object motion, since videos capture dynamics in the projected 2D image plane. This paper introduces VerseCrafter, a geometry-driven video world model that generates dynamic, realistic videos from a unified 4D geometric world state, centered on a novel 4D Geometric Control representation encoding a static background point cloud and per-object 3D Gaussian trajectories with probabilistic 3D occupancy over time. This representation is rendered into 4D control maps to drive a pretrained video diffusion model, and an automatic data engine is developed to construct VerseControl4D, a 35K-sample real-world dataset with automatically derived prompts and rendered 4D control maps.
2601.05138|v2.assessment: 该工作将4D几何控制引入视频扩散世界模型，对自动驾驶场景仿真与可控视频生成有潜在价值，但其评测与感知任务（检测、BEV、占据预测）的关联偏间接，需关注其4D占据表示能否迁移到感知监督。
2601.05138|v2.contribution: 提出统一的4D Geometric Control表示（背景点云+逐物体3D高斯轨迹）及配套的VerseControl4D大规模数据集与自动数据引擎。
2601.05138|v2.innovation: 以类别无关的3D高斯轨迹与概率占据替代刚性边界框/参数化模型，实现相机与多物体运动的统一4D控制并渲染为扩散模型控制图。
2601.05138|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，仅声称实现高保真、视角一致且忠实遵循指定动态的视频生成，并构建了35K样本的真实世界训练数据集。

2004.00070|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积神经网络在连续学习多个任务时出现的灾难性遗忘问题，提出条件通道门控网络（Conditional Channel Gated Networks）。方法是在每个卷积层上附加任务特定的门控模块，动态选择对当前输入应用哪些滤波器，并通过稀疏目标鼓励只激活少量卷积核以保留学习新任务的容量；同时引入任务分类器以应对测试时无任务标签的实际场景。相比已有需要测试时任务先验的持续学习方法，该框架在门控执行模式中识别并保护重要滤波器，从而在旧任务上不损失性能。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但验证了在无任务oracle设置下的有效性。
2004.00070|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning by equipping each convolutional layer with task-specific gating modules that select which filters to apply, thereby identifying and protecting important filters for previously learned tasks. A sparsity objective promotes selecting a limited set of kernels to retain capacity for new tasks, and a task classifier is introduced to handle settings without a task oracle at test time. The framework improves over prior conditional computation methods that require task awareness during inference.
2004.00070|v2.assessment: 将条件计算与持续学习结合，门控机制设计巧妙，且考虑了无任务标签的实际场景，对持续学习和动态网络方向有参考价值。
2004.00070|v2.contribution: 提出基于任务特定门控的条件通道网络，实现无需任务oracle的持续学习。
2004.00070|v2.innovation: 利用门控执行模式自动识别并保护重要滤波器，结合稀疏目标平衡新旧任务容量。
2004.00070|v2.result: 在无任务标签场景下有效缓解灾难性遗忘，保持旧任务性能并学习新任务。

2006.08509|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对资源受限硬件上的高效深度学习推理，提出APQ框架，首次将网络架构、剪枝策略和量化策略进行联合搜索。为解决联合搜索空间巨大和量化感知精度预测器训练耗时的问题，作者提出从全精度（fp32）精度预测器向量化感知（int8）精度预测器迁移知识，大幅提升样本效率；fp32预测器的数据仅需从预训练once-for-all网络中采样评估，无需训练成本。在ImageNet上的大量实验表明，联合优化相比单独搜索架构、剪枝和量化能带来显著收益。
2006.08509|v2.summary_en: APQ jointly searches neural architecture, pruning policy, and quantization policy for efficient inference on resource-constrained hardware. To handle the enlarged design space, it transfers knowledge from an fp32 accuracy predictor to an int8 quantization-aware predictor, greatly improving sample efficiency, while the fp32 predictor is trained by sampling from a pretrained once-for-all network without training cost. Extensive ImageNet experiments demonstrate the benefits of joint optimization over separate search.
2006.08509|v2.assessment: 联合优化架构、剪枝与量化是模型压缩部署的重要方向，知识迁移提升预测器样本效率的思路实用且有效。
2006.08509|v2.contribution: 提出APQ框架，实现网络架构、剪枝和量化策略的联合搜索。
2006.08509|v2.innovation: 通过fp32到int8精度预测器的知识迁移，解决量化感知预测器训练耗时问题。
2006.08509|v2.result: 在ImageNet上联合优化优于单独搜索，显著提升资源受限硬件上的推理效率。

2005.03354|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对通道剪枝中需要训练和评估大量子结构的问题，提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝（DMCP）。方法将通道剪枝建模为马尔可夫过程，每个状态表示保留对应通道，状态间转移表示剪枝过程，从而可通过梯度下降直接优化标准任务损失和FLOPs约束等预算正则项，隐式地为每层选择合适通道数。在ImageNet上对ResNet和MobileNetV2的大量实验表明，该方法在各种FLOPs设置下均一致优于现有最先进剪枝方法。
2005.03354|v2.summary_en: DMCP formulates channel pruning as a differentiable Markov process where states represent channel retention and transitions denote pruning, enabling direct optimization via gradient descent with task loss and budget regularization. This implicitly selects the proper number of channels per layer without training numerous sub-structures. Extensive ImageNet experiments on ResNet and MobileNetV2 show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art pruning methods across various FLOPs settings.
2005.03354|v2.assessment: 将马尔可夫过程引入可微通道剪枝，建模优雅且优化高效，实验充分，对模型压缩方向有较高参考价值。
2005.03354|v2.contribution: 提出可微马尔可夫通道剪枝方法DMCP，实现高效子结构搜索。
2005.03354|v2.innovation: 用马尔可夫过程建模通道剪枝，通过梯度下降直接优化剪枝策略与FLOPs约束。
2005.03354|v2.result: 在ImageNet上ResNet和MobileNetV2的各种FLOPs设置下均优于现有剪枝方法。
