2003.08935|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对网络压缩中滤波剪枝与低秩分解两种主流技术各自为政、难以统一的问题，提出从稀疏正则化施加方式的统一视角推导出二者，从而可按需灵活选择互补方案。方法上还提出对整个网络进行联合压缩而非逐层压缩，以处理ResNet等带shortcut结构中剪枝无法覆盖的最后一层卷积。相比已有工作，该统一框架在多个基准上优于当时的最优方法，验证了联合压缩的潜力。
2003.08935|v2.summary_en: This paper unifies filter pruning and low-rank decomposition by showing that both can be derived from different ways of enforcing sparsity regularization, offering a flexible complementary choice for network compression. It further proposes to compress the whole network jointly rather than layer-wise, which handles the last convolutional layer in ResBlocks that filter pruning alone cannot address. The approach compares favorably against state-of-the-art methods on several benchmarks.
2003.08935|v2.assessment: 为剪枝与分解提供了统一理论视角，对网络压缩方向的研究者有方法论参考价值。
2003.08935|v2.contribution: 提出统一稀疏正则化视角下推导滤波剪枝与低秩分解，并实现全网联合压缩。
2003.08935|v2.innovation: 用稀疏约束的施加方式统一解释两类压缩技术，并解决ResBlock末层剪枝难题。
2003.08935|v2.result: 在多个基准上优于当时的最优压缩方法。

2002.10179|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对现有滤波剪枝方法缺乏理论指导、训练低效且设计成本高的问题，提出基于特征图高秩（HRank）的剪枝准则。作者发现单个滤波器生成的多张特征图的平均秩恒定，与输入batch数量无关，据此将低秩特征图对应的滤波器判定为信息量少而予以剪枝。该方法无需额外约束即可在多个基准上显著超越当时最优方法，并表明高秩特征图对应的权重更重要，即使部分不更新也几乎不损害性能。
2002.10179|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of theoretical guidance and high design cost in filter pruning by proposing HRank, a criterion based on the observation that the average rank of feature maps from a single filter is invariant to the number of input batches. Filters producing low-rank feature maps are pruned as they carry less information and are easily reproducible. Without additional constraints, HRank significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods on multiple benchmarks.
2002.10179|v2.assessment: 以特征图秩作为剪枝依据，理论动机清晰且实验扎实，是剪枝方向值得关注的工作。
2002.10179|v2.contribution: 提出基于特征图平均秩恒定性假设的HRank滤波剪枝准则。
2002.10179|v2.innovation: 发现单滤波器特征图平均秩与batch数无关，并据此设计低秩剪枝判据。
2002.10179|v2.result: 在多个基准上显著优于当时最优剪枝方法。

1911.08114|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对滤波剪枝中残差连接难以剪枝和小数据场景下剪枝效果差两个开放问题，提出CURL方法。方法上用基于KL散度的准则同时剪枝残差连接内外的通道，并针对有限数据提出标签精炼以缓解教师logits噪声带来的标签噪声，结合知识蒸馏补偿数据不足。实验表明CURL在ImageNet上显著超越此前最优方法，且在小数据集上剪枝后性能可媲美甚至优于直接微调预训练小模型。
1911.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles two open issues in filter pruning: pruning residual connections and pruning with limited data. It proposes CURL, which prunes channels both inside and outside residual connections via a KL-divergence criterion, and introduces label refinement to mitigate noisy teacher logits in knowledge distillation for limited-data settings. CURL significantly outperforms prior state-of-the-art on ImageNet and achieves comparable or better performance than fine-tuning a pretrained small model when pruning on small datasets.
1911.08114|v2.assessment: 同时解决残差剪枝与有限数据剪枝两个实际问题，方法组合合理且实验有说服力。
1911.08114|v2.contribution: 提出CURL，用KL散度准则剪枝残差连接内外通道并结合标签精炼的知识蒸馏。
1911.08114|v2.innovation: 将残差连接内外通道统一剪枝，并用标签精炼缓解教师logits噪声。
1911.08114|v2.result: ImageNet上显著超越此前最优，小数据集剪枝性能媲美微调预训练小模型。

Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_cn: 针对深度网络压缩中知识蒸馏依赖大量训练数据的问题，本文提出少样本知识蒸馏（FSKD）框架，在仅有少量样本的条件下压缩网络。方法通过为每个类别合成伪数据并利用教师模型的多层中间特征进行蒸馏，从而在数据稀缺时仍能有效迁移知识。相比需要完整训练集的传统蒸馏方法，FSKD 显著降低了对数据的依赖。实验表明在 CIFAR 和 ImageNet 上，仅用少量样本即可达到接近全数据蒸馏的压缩精度。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that knowledge distillation for network compression typically requires the full training set. It proposes Few Sample Knowledge Distillation (FSKD), which synthesizes pseudo data per class and distills multi-layer intermediate features from the teacher. Compared with conventional distillation requiring complete data, FSKD greatly reduces data dependence and achieves compression accuracy close to full-data distillation on CIFAR and ImageNet.
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.assessment: 为数据受限场景下的模型压缩提供了实用方案，对边缘部署有参考价值。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.contribution: 提出少样本知识蒸馏框架，在极少数据下实现高效网络压缩。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.innovation: 利用类别伪数据合成与多层特征蒸馏降低对训练数据的依赖。
Few Sample Knowledge Distillation for Ef.result: 在 CIFAR/ImageNet 上仅用少量样本即接近全数据蒸馏的压缩精度。

DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 针对现有稀疏化方法中稀疏度量不可微或尺度敏感的问题，本文提出 DeepHoyer，引入可微且尺度不变的稀疏度量用于神经网络剪枝。方法将 Hoyer 度量平滑化并嵌入训练目标，使网络在训练中自适应地学习更稀疏的结构。相比 L1/L2 等传统正则，DeepHoyer 在保持精度的同时获得更高稀疏度。实验在多个基准上实现了更优的稀疏-精度权衡。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the non-differentiability and scale sensitivity of existing sparsity measures in network pruning. It proposes DeepHoyer, a differentiable and scale-invariant sparsity measure embedded into training to learn sparser networks. Compared with L1/L2 regularization, DeepHoyer achieves higher sparsity at comparable accuracy, yielding better sparsity-accuracy trade-offs on multiple benchmarks.
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.assessment: 稀疏度量设计有理论深度，对结构化/非结构化剪枝研究有借鉴意义。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出可微尺度不变的 DeepHoyer 稀疏度量用于网络剪枝。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.innovation: 将平滑化的 Hoyer 度量嵌入训练目标实现自适应稀疏化。
DeepHoyer: Learning Sparser Neural Netwo.result: 在多个基准上取得优于 L1/L2 的稀疏-精度权衡。

Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_cn: 针对训练数据中缺失值用零填充会引入稀疏偏差、损害神经网络训练的问题，本文分析了零填充导致的分布偏移。提出对稀疏偏差进行校正的方法，通过调整训练目标或数据表示来缓解零填充带来的负面影响。相比直接零填充的常规做法，该方法在含缺失值的数据上提升了模型性能。实验验证了校正稀疏偏差能有效改善训练效果。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.summary_en: This paper studies how zero imputation of missing values introduces sparsity bias that harms neural network training. It analyzes the resulting distribution shift and proposes to correct the sparsity bias via adjusted training objectives or representations. Compared with naive zero imputation, the method improves model performance on data with missing values.
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.assessment: 问题视角独特，对处理缺失数据的训练实践有启发，但与视觉检测主线关联较弱。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.contribution: 揭示并校正零填充导致的稀疏偏差问题。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.innovation: 从分布偏移角度分析零填充对训练的影响并提出校正方法。
Why Not to Use Zero Imputation? Correcti.result: 在含缺失值数据上改善了模型训练性能。

Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_cn: 针对通道剪枝中如何感知算子类型并保持精度的问题，本文提出基于可微掩码的算子感知软通道剪枝方法。方法为不同算子（如卷积、深度卷积）设计可微掩码，在训练中软性地选择通道，并考虑算子特性进行剪枝。相比统一处理的剪枝方法，该方法更好地保留了关键算子结构。实验在多个网络上实现了更高的压缩率与精度保持。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.summary_en: This paper addresses operator-aware channel pruning to preserve accuracy. It proposes soft channel pruning with differentiable masks that account for different operator types during training. Compared with uniform pruning, it better preserves critical operator structures, achieving higher compression with maintained accuracy across networks.
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.assessment: 算子感知的可微剪枝思路实用，对高效网络设计有参考价值。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.contribution: 提出算子感知的可微掩码软通道剪枝方法。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.innovation: 针对不同算子设计可微掩码以保留关键结构。
Operation-Aware Soft Channel Pruning usi.result: 在多个网络上实现更高压缩率与精度保持。

Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_cn: 针对剪枝后网络对对抗样本更脆弱的问题，本文提出对抗神经剪枝（ANP）并引入潜在脆弱性抑制。方法在剪枝过程中同时抑制隐藏层特征对扰动的敏感性，从而在压缩的同时提升鲁棒性。相比仅关注精度的剪枝方法，ANP 兼顾了压缩率与对抗鲁棒性。实验表明在保持精度的同时显著降低了对抗攻击成功率。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.summary_en: This paper addresses the increased adversarial vulnerability of pruned networks. It proposes Adversarial Neural Pruning (ANP) with latent vulnerability suppression, which suppresses hidden-layer sensitivity to perturbations during pruning. Compared with accuracy-only pruning, ANP jointly improves compression and adversarial robustness, reducing attack success rates while maintaining accuracy.
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.assessment: 将剪枝与鲁棒性结合，对安全敏感的部署场景有实际意义。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.contribution: 提出兼顾压缩与对抗鲁棒性的对抗神经剪枝方法。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.innovation: 在剪枝中引入潜在脆弱性抑制以提升鲁棒性。
Adversarial Neural Pruning with Latent V.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低对抗攻击成功率。

Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_cn: 针对彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）缺乏理论证明的问题，本文从理论上证明剪枝是充分必要的，即存在一个稀疏子网络可达到与原网络相当的性能。作者构造性地证明了在合理条件下，通过剪枝可得到与原始网络等价表达能力的子网络。相比以往仅靠实验观察的工作，本文给出了严格的数学证明。该结果为剪枝与稀疏网络的理论基础提供了重要支撑。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.summary_en: This paper provides a theoretical proof of the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, showing that pruning is all you need—there exists a sparse subnetwork matching the original network's performance. It constructively proves that under reasonable conditions pruning yields a subnetwork with equivalent expressive power. Unlike prior empirical observations, this work offers a rigorous mathematical foundation for pruning and sparse networks.
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.assessment: 理论贡献突出，为剪枝研究提供了坚实的数学依据，值得关注。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.contribution: 从理论上证明剪枝足以获得与原网络等价的稀疏子网络。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.innovation: 给出彩票假设的构造性严格数学证明。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P.result: 证明存在性能等价的稀疏子网络，奠定剪枝理论基础。
Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: P._arxiv_id: Proving the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis: Pruning is All You Need.

DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络参数量大、推理成本高的问题，提出DropNet——一种迭代式剪枝方法，通过逐轮移除对损失影响最小的神经元/连接来降低网络复杂度。与一次性剪枝或基于重要性的静态剪枝不同，DropNet在每轮剪枝后重新评估剩余参数的重要性，从而避免过早删除后续可能变重要的权重。摘要未给出具体数据集与压缩率/精度数据，但方法属于经典迭代剪枝范式，对模型压缩与加速有参考价值。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter count and inference cost of deep neural networks by proposing DropNet, an iterative pruning method that progressively removes neurons or connections with minimal impact on the loss. Unlike one-shot or static importance-based pruning, DropNet re-evaluates the importance of remaining parameters after each pruning round, avoiding premature removal of weights that may become important later. The abstract does not report specific datasets or compression/accuracy numbers, but the method follows the classical iterative pruning paradigm and is relevant to model compression and acceleration.
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.assessment: 迭代剪枝是模型压缩中的实用方向，DropNet的思路清晰，但摘要缺乏实验细节，需查看正文验证其相对现有迭代剪枝方法的实际增益。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.contribution: 提出一种迭代式剪枝框架DropNet，通过多轮重新评估参数重要性来降低网络复杂度。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.innovation: 在每轮剪枝后重新评估剩余参数重要性，缓解一次性剪枝的过早删除问题。
DropNet: Reducing Neural Network Complex.result: 摘要未提供具体压缩率与精度数据，效果需参考正文实验。

Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中'好子网络是否存在'这一理论问题，提出通过贪心前向选择（Greedy Forward Selection）进行剪枝，并证明在适当条件下可证明地存在性能良好的稀疏子网络。与依赖启发式重要性评分的剪枝方法不同，该方法从理论角度给出子网络存在性与选择算法的保证，将剪枝与稀疏化理论联系起来。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但理论贡献对理解剪枝的可行性边界有重要价值。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.summary_en: This paper tackles the theoretical question of whether good subnetworks exist in neural network pruning, proposing a pruning method based on greedy forward selection and proving that, under suitable conditions, well-performing sparse subnetworks provably exist. Unlike heuristic importance-based pruning, this work provides theoretical guarantees on subnetwork existence and the selection algorithm, linking pruning to sparsification theory. The abstract does not report specific experimental numbers, but the theoretical contribution is valuable for understanding the feasibility limits of pruning.
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.assessment: 为剪枝提供了可证明的子网络存在性保证，理论意义突出，适合关注剪枝理论基础的研究者。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.contribution: 提出基于贪心前向选择的剪枝方法，并证明好子网络的可证明存在性。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.innovation: 从理论层面给出稀疏子网络存在性与贪心选择算法的保证，超越纯启发式剪枝。
Good Subnetworks Provably Exist: Pruning.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，理论保证为主要成果。

Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_cn: 该论文针对离散数据（如图、图像等）上的鲁棒性认证问题，提出一种稀疏感知的随机平滑方法，为离散结构数据提供高效的鲁棒性证书。与面向连续输入的经典随机平滑不同，该方法利用离散数据的稀疏性来降低认证的计算成本，适用于图、图像等多种离散域。摘要未给出具体数据集与认证半径数据，但方法对鲁棒性认证与离散数据安全有参考价值，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Efficient Robustness Certificates for Di.summary_en: This paper addresses robustness certification for discrete data such as graphs and images, proposing a sparsity-aware randomized smoothing method that provides efficient robustness certificates for discrete structured data. Unlike classical randomized smoothing for continuous inputs, the method exploits sparsity in discrete data to reduce certification cost, applicable to graphs, images, and other discrete domains. The abstract does not report specific datasets or certified radii, but the method is relevant to robustness certification and discrete-data security, with weaker direct connection to autonomous driving perception.

Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_cn: 该论文针对矩阵流（matrix streams）中的Schatten范数计算问题，提出利用稀疏性来突破维度限制的算法，实现'你好稀疏性，再见维度'的高效估计。与依赖完整矩阵或高维存储的传统方法不同，该方法在流式设置下利用稀疏结构降低空间与时间复杂度。摘要未给出具体误差界或实验数据，属于理论算法方向，与计算机视觉/自动驾驶感知领域关联很弱。
Schatten Norms in Matrix Streams: Hello.summary_en: This paper addresses the computation of Schatten norms in matrix streams, proposing algorithms that exploit sparsity to overcome dimensionality constraints, achieving efficient estimation with 'hello sparsity, goodbye dimension.' Unlike traditional methods requiring full matrices or high-dimensional storage, the approach leverages sparse structure in the streaming setting to reduce space and time complexity. The abstract does not report specific error bounds or experiments; it is a theoretical algorithms work with very weak connection to computer vision or autonomous driving perception.

2103.16788|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对类别增量学习（class incremental learning）中有限内存条件下的稳定性-可塑性权衡问题，提出了一种基于动态可扩展表示的两阶段学习方法。在每个增量步骤中，冻结已学到的表示，并通过新的可学习特征提取器扩展特征维度，同时引入通道级掩码剪枝策略根据新概念复杂度动态扩展表示，并设计辅助损失鼓励学习多样且具判别性的特征。在三个类别增量学习基准上，该方法以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。
2103.16788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses class incremental learning under limited memory, aiming for a better stability-plasticity trade-off. It proposes a two-stage approach with dynamically expandable representations: at each incremental step, the previously learned representation is frozen and augmented with new feature dimensions from a learnable extractor, with channel-level mask-based pruning to adapt expansion to concept complexity and an auxiliary loss for diverse discriminative features. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks show consistent and large-margin improvements over prior methods.
2103.16788|v2.assessment: 该工作为增量学习中的稳定性-可塑性权衡提供了简洁有效的动态扩展方案，实验充分且提升显著，对持续学习与视觉感知系统长期部署有参考价值。
2103.16788|v2.contribution: 提出基于动态可扩展表示的两阶段类别增量学习框架，结合通道级掩码剪枝与辅助损失。
2103.16788|v2.innovation: 利用通道级掩码剪枝按新概念复杂度动态扩展表示，并引入辅助损失增强新概念特征的多样性与判别性。
2103.16788|v2.result: 在三个类别增量学习基准上以较大幅度持续超越现有方法。

2011.14563|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对稀疏且分布不均的候选对应点中运动一致性建模困难的问题，提出拉普拉斯运动一致性网络（LMCNet）用于对应点剪枝。作者将一致运动拟合表述为对应点图上的平滑函数，并证明该表述可通过图拉普拉斯获得闭式解，从而设计可微分层从候选对应点中捕获全局运动一致性，再与局部层提取的局部一致性结合以鲁棒检测内点。实验表明LMCNet在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上优于现有最优方法。
2011.14563|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles motion coherence modeling on sparse, unevenly distributed putative correspondences for correspondence pruning. It proposes the Laplacian Motion Coherence Network (LMCNet), formulating coherent motion fitting as a smooth function on a correspondence graph with a closed-form solution via graph Laplacian, enabling a differentiable layer for global motion coherence that is combined with a local layer for robust inlier detection. Experiments show superior performance over state of the art in relative camera pose estimation and correspondence pruning of dynamic scenes.
2011.14563|v2.assessment: 该工作将图拉普拉斯闭式解引入可微分学习框架，为运动一致性建模提供了新思路，对SLAM、位姿估计等几何视觉任务有参考价值。
2011.14563|v2.contribution: 提出LMCNet，通过图拉普拉斯闭式解的可微分层学习全局运动一致性用于对应点剪枝。
2011.14563|v2.innovation: 将一致运动拟合表述为对应点图上的平滑函数并获得闭式解，从而构建可微分全局运动一致性层。
2011.14563|v2.result: 在相对相机位姿估计和动态场景对应点剪枝上优于现有最优方法。

Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像超分辨率（SR）模型计算量大、难以高效推理的问题，提出在SR网络中引入稀疏化机制以减少冗余计算。方法上通过分析SR网络中不同层和通道对重建质量的贡献差异，设计了稀疏感知的训练与推理流程，使网络在保持重建精度的同时跳过大量无效计算。相比已有SR加速方法（如轻量网络设计或通道剪枝），该工作更细粒度地利用了特征稀疏性。实验在多个基准数据集和SR网络上验证了推理效率的提升，同时PSNR下降控制在较小范围内。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of image super-resolution (SR) networks by exploring sparsity for efficient inference. It analyzes the contribution of different layers and channels to reconstruction quality and introduces a sparsity-aware training and inference pipeline that skips redundant computations. Compared with prior SR acceleration methods such as lightweight architecture design or channel pruning, it exploits feature-level sparsity at a finer granularity, achieving improved inference efficiency with only marginal PSNR degradation on standard benchmarks.
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.assessment: 该工作将稀疏化思想引入SR推理加速，思路清晰，但领域与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱，主要价值在于通用模型加速技术。
Exploring Sparsity in Image Super-Resolu.contribution: 提出了一种面向图像超分辨率的稀疏化推理方法，在保持重建质量的同时显著减少计算量。

Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中全局稀疏度约束难以有效实现的问题，提出了一种全局稀疏约束下的有效稀疏化方法。方法通过将全局稀疏约束转化为可优化的正则化形式，使得各层的稀疏度能够自适应分配，而非依赖人工设定的逐层稀疏比例。相比传统的逐层剪枝策略，该方法在相同全局稀疏度下能更好地保留模型容量。实验在CIFAR和ImageNet等基准上验证了其在多种网络结构上的有效性，精度优于或持平于现有剪枝方法。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of enforcing global sparsity constraints in neural network pruning by proposing an effective sparsification method under a global sparsity budget. It formulates the global constraint as an optimizable regularization that allows layer-wise sparsity to be allocated adaptively rather than manually specified. Compared with conventional layer-wise pruning, it better preserves model capacity at the same global sparsity, achieving competitive or superior accuracy on CIFAR and ImageNet across various architectures.
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.assessment: 该工作为全局稀疏约束下的剪枝提供了有效的优化方案，方法通用性强，对模型压缩领域有参考价值。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.contribution: 提出了一种在全局稀疏约束下自适应分配各层稀疏度的网络剪枝方法。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.innovation: 将全局稀疏约束转化为可优化正则化，实现层间稀疏度的自动分配。
Effective Sparsification of Neural Netwo.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上，相同全局稀疏度下精度优于或持平于现有剪枝方法。

Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_cn: 该论文针对移动端实时超分辨率需求，提出了联合神经架构搜索与剪枝搜索的方法。方法将网络架构搜索空间与剪枝策略搜索空间联合优化，在满足移动端延迟约束的前提下自动寻找高精度、低延迟的SR网络。相比单独进行架构搜索或剪枝，联合搜索能更好地平衡精度与效率。实验在移动设备上实现了实时超分辨率推理，并在基准数据集上取得了优于现有轻量SR方法的精度-延迟折中。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.summary_en: This paper targets on-mobile real-time super-resolution by jointly searching neural architectures and pruning strategies. It unifies the architecture search space with the pruning search space and optimizes them under mobile latency constraints to automatically discover accurate and fast SR networks. Compared with separate architecture search or pruning, the joint search achieves a better accuracy-latency trade-off, enabling real-time SR inference on mobile devices with superior performance over existing lightweight SR methods.
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.assessment: 该工作将NAS与剪枝搜索结合用于移动端SR，工程价值较高，但其技术路线与自动驾驶感知的关联为间接的模型加速层面。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.contribution: 提出了联合神经架构与剪枝搜索的方法，实现移动端实时超分辨率。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.innovation: 将架构搜索空间与剪枝策略搜索空间联合优化，在延迟约束下自动寻找最优SR网络。
Achieving on-Mobile Real-Time Super-Reso.result: 在移动设备上实现实时SR推理，精度-延迟折中优于现有轻量SR方法。

ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN结构化剪枝中精度损失难以避免的问题，提出了ResRep方法，通过解耦'记忆'与'遗忘'过程实现无损剪枝。方法将卷积核分解为记忆部分和遗忘部分，在训练中逐步将遗忘部分压缩为零，从而在剪枝后无需微调即可保持原始精度。相比传统剪枝需依赖微调恢复精度，ResRep在ResNet等结构上实现了无损甚至略有提升的剪枝效果。实验在ImageNet上验证了其在不同剪枝率下的有效性，且方法可即插即用地应用于现有网络。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.summary_en: This paper addresses the accuracy loss in structured CNN pruning by proposing ResRep, which decouples the remembering and forgetting processes for lossless pruning. It decomposes convolution kernels into remembering and forgetting parts and progressively compresses the forgetting part to zero, so that the pruned model retains original accuracy without fine-tuning. Compared with conventional pruning that relies on fine-tuning, ResRep achieves lossless or even slightly improved accuracy on ResNet and other architectures, validated on ImageNet across various pruning ratios.
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.assessment: ResRep思路新颖且实用性强，无损剪枝特性对部署友好，是模型压缩领域值得关注的工作。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.contribution: 提出了通过解耦记忆与遗忘过程实现CNN无损结构化剪枝的ResRep方法。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.innovation: 将卷积核分解为记忆与遗忘部分并逐步压缩遗忘部分，实现无需微调的无损剪枝。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl.result: 在ImageNet上多种剪枝率下实现无损甚至略有提升的精度，且可即插即用。
ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupl._arxiv_id: ResRep: Lossless CNN Pruning via Decoupling Remembering and Forgetting.

GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于门控的神经网络剪枝中训练不稳定的问题，提出了GDP方法，通过可微极化机制稳定门控训练。方法设计了可微极化函数，使门控值在训练过程中逐渐向0或1极化，从而在保持可微性的同时获得稳定的稀疏结构。相比传统软门控剪枝，GDP缓解了训练震荡和收敛困难的问题。实验在CIFAR和ImageNet上验证了其在不同网络和稀疏度下的稳定性和精度优势。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.summary_en: This paper addresses training instability in gate-based neural network pruning by proposing GDP, which stabilizes gating via differentiable polarization. It introduces a differentiable polarization function that gradually pushes gate values toward 0 or 1, yielding stable sparse structures while preserving differentiability. Compared with conventional soft-gating pruning, GDP alleviates training oscillation and convergence difficulties, demonstrating stable and accurate pruning across networks and sparsity levels on CIFAR and ImageNet.
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.assessment: 该工作针对门控剪枝的训练稳定性问题提出了有效方案，方法简洁，对剪枝实践有参考意义。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.contribution: 提出了基于可微极化门控的稳定神经网络剪枝方法GDP。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.innovation: 设计可微极化函数使门控值稳定趋向0/1，缓解门控剪枝的训练震荡问题。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上不同网络与稀疏度下均表现出稳定性和精度优势。
GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning v._arxiv_id: GDP: Stabilized Neural Network Pruning via Gates with Differentiable Polarization.

Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_cn: 该论文针对神经网络剪枝中如何自动确定各层稀疏结构的问题，提出了基于自动图编码器-解码器的剪枝方法。方法将网络结构建模为图，利用图编码器-解码器自动学习各层的最优剪枝配置，避免了人工设计剪枝策略。相比启发式或逐层独立剪枝方法，该方法能捕捉层间依赖关系。实验在多个基准网络上验证了其在压缩率和精度上的有效性。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.summary_en: This paper addresses automatic determination of layer-wise sparsity structures in neural network pruning by proposing an auto graph encoder-decoder approach. It models the network as a graph and employs a graph encoder-decoder to automatically learn optimal pruning configurations, avoiding manual pruning strategy design. Compared with heuristic or layer-independent pruning, it captures inter-layer dependencies, achieving effective compression and accuracy on multiple benchmark networks.
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.assessment: 该工作将图学习引入剪枝策略搜索，思路有一定新意，但整体影响力和实验规模相对有限。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.contribution: 提出了基于自动图编码器-解码器的神经网络剪枝方法，自动学习各层剪枝配置。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.innovation: 将网络建模为图并利用图编码器-解码器捕捉层间依赖来自动确定剪枝结构。
Auto Graph Encoder-Decoder for Neural Ne.result: 在多个基准网络上实现了有效的压缩率与精度折中。

Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对特征匹配中大量错误对应关系导致估计不准确的问题，提出了一种基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝方法。方法通过迭代地学习局部共识并逐步剔除离群点，从而在匹配集合中保留高质量的内点。相比已有的RANSAC类方法或单次剪枝策略，该方法在多个匹配基准上取得了更高的匹配精度和鲁棒性。实验表明，在户外和室内匹配数据集上，该方法显著提升了内点率和位姿估计精度。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of numerous outliers in feature correspondence that degrade matching accuracy. It proposes a progressive correspondence pruning method based on consensus learning, which iteratively learns local consensus and removes outliers. Compared to existing RANSAC-like or one-shot pruning methods, it achieves higher inlier ratios and pose estimation accuracy on multiple matching benchmarks.
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.assessment: 该工作为特征匹配中的离群点剔除提供了新思路，对自动驾驶中的SLAM和视觉定位有潜在价值，但整体创新性中等。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.contribution: 提出基于共识学习的渐进式对应关系剪枝框架，有效提升匹配内点率。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.innovation: 将共识学习与渐进剪枝结合，迭代优化匹配集合。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co.result: 在多个匹配数据集上取得优于现有方法的匹配精度和位姿估计效果。
Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Co._arxiv_id: Progressive Correspondence Pruning by Consensus Learning.

Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（Cryo-ET）体积图像去噪问题，提出了一种仅需单张噪声体积的自监督图像恢复方法，并引入稀疏性约束。方法利用噪声体积自身的统计特性进行自监督训练，无需干净标签，同时通过稀疏约束保留生物结构细节。相比已有的监督或需要多帧平均的方法，该方法在单噪声体积上实现了更好的去噪和结构恢复效果。实验表明，该方法在模拟和真实Cryo-ET数据上均能有效提升信噪比并保持亚细胞结构。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.summary_en: This paper tackles volumetric image restoration for cryo-electron tomography from a single noisy volume. It proposes a self-supervised method with sparsity constraints, requiring no clean labels. Compared to supervised or multi-frame averaging approaches, it achieves better denoising and structure preservation on both simulated and real Cryo-ET data.
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习应用于Cryo-ET去噪，方法新颖但领域较窄，对自动驾驶视觉的直接相关性较低。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.contribution: 提出单噪声体积自监督Cryo-ET图像恢复方法，引入稀疏性约束。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.innovation: 无需干净标签，利用稀疏约束实现单体积自监督去噪。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography.result: 在模拟和真实Cryo-ET数据上有效提升信噪比并保留亚细胞结构。
Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Cryo-Electron Tomography Volumetric Image Restoration from Single Noisy Volume with Sparsity Constraint.

Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中知识蒸馏效率低下的问题，提出了一种在线多粒度蒸馏方法。方法在训练过程中同时从多个粒度（如像素级、特征级、判别器级）进行知识迁移，并采用在线蒸馏策略动态更新教师模型。相比已有的两阶段或单粒度蒸馏方法，该方法在压缩GAN的同时更好地保持了生成质量。实验表明，在多个GAN压缩基准上，该方法在相同压缩率下取得了更优的FID和IS指标。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.summary_en: This paper addresses inefficient knowledge distillation in GAN compression by proposing an online multi-granularity distillation method. It transfers knowledge at multiple granularities (pixel, feature, discriminator levels) during training with an online teacher update. Compared to two-stage or single-granularity methods, it better preserves generation quality under compression, achieving improved FID and IS on multiple benchmarks.
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.assessment: 该工作为GAN压缩提供了高效的多粒度在线蒸馏方案，对模型轻量化部署有参考价值，实验充分。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.contribution: 提出在线多粒度蒸馏框架，实现高效GAN压缩。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.innovation: 多粒度知识迁移与在线教师更新相结合，提升压缩后生成质量。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo.result: 在多个GAN压缩基准上，相同压缩率下FID和IS指标优于现有方法。
Online Multi-Granularity Distillation fo._arxiv_id: Online Multi-Granularity Distillation for GAN Compression.

2102.11535|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对NAS中训练超网或评估架构带来的巨大计算开销和搜索偏差问题，提出了无需训练的TE-NAS框架。方法通过分析神经正切核（NTK）的谱和输入空间中线性区域的数量来评估架构的可训练性和表达性，并设计基于剪枝的搜索机制在两者间取得平衡。相比需要训练超网的方法，TE-NAS在NAS-Bench-201和DARTS搜索空间上仅需4个GPU小时即可找到高性能架构，且搜索偏差更小。实验表明，TE-NAS在ImageNet上达到了与训练型NAS相当甚至更好的精度。
2102.11535|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation and search bias in NAS caused by supernet training or architecture evaluation. It proposes TE-NAS, a training-free framework that ranks architectures by analyzing the NTK spectrum and the number of linear regions, which indicate trainability and expressivity. A pruning-based search balances the two. On NAS-Bench-201 and DARTS, TE-NAS finds top-performing architectures in four GPU hours with less bias, achieving competitive accuracy on ImageNet.
2102.11535|v2.assessment: 该工作从理论角度出发，实现了高效且无偏的NAS，对自动化模型设计有重要启发，实验扎实。
2102.11535|v2.contribution: 提出基于NTK谱和线性区域数的无训练NAS框架TE-NAS。
2102.11535|v2.innovation: 利用理论指标评估架构可训练性与表达性，无需任何训练即可搜索。
2102.11535|v2.result: 在4个GPU小时内于NAS-Bench-201和DARTS上找到高性能架构，ImageNet精度与训练型NAS相当。

2103.09377|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对二值神经网络训练困难且精度损失大的问题，提出了多奖彩票假说（MPT）。该假说证明充分过参数化的随机权重网络包含多个子网络，这些子网络无需进一步训练即可达到与训练后稠密网络相当的精度，并且对极端量化（二值权重/激活）具有鲁棒性。作者提出了寻找MPT的算法，并在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上验证了其有效性。实验表明，随着模型加深加宽，MPT能够以极低的计算成本获得高精度的二值网络。
2103.09377|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty and accuracy loss in training binary neural networks by proposing the Multi-Prize Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (MPT). It proves that a sufficiently over-parameterized random-weight network contains subnetworks that achieve comparable accuracy to a trained dense network without further training, and are robust to extreme quantization. An algorithm for finding MPTs is proposed and validated on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet, showing that deeper and wider models yield accurate binary networks at low cost.
2103.09377|v2.assessment: 该工作为二值神经网络和彩票假说提供了新视角，理论证明与实验结合，对模型压缩有推动作用。
2103.09377|v2.contribution: 提出并证明多奖彩票假说，实现无需训练的高精度二值神经网络。
2103.09377|v2.innovation: 将彩票假说扩展到多奖设定，结合剪枝与量化从随机权重中直接获得二值网络。
2103.09377|v2.result: 在CIFAR-10和ImageNet上，MPT子网络无需训练即达到与稠密网络相当的精度，且对二值量化鲁棒。

2009.08576|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对初始化时剪枝方法（如SNIP、GraSP、SynFlow）性能不及训练后剪枝的问题，进行了深入分析。作者发现，随机打乱这些方法在每层内剪枝的权重或重新采样初始值，反而能保持或提升精度，表明这些方法的逐权重剪枝决策可被逐层剪枝比例选择替代。这一发现揭示了初始化剪枝启发式方法的内在挑战。实验在多个数据集和架构上验证了该现象，并指出初始化剪枝与训练后剪枝之间的本质差异。
2009.08576|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why pruning-at-initialization methods (SNIP, GraSP, SynFlow) underperform magnitude pruning after training. It shows that randomly shuffling the pruned weights within each layer or resampling initial values preserves or improves accuracy, suggesting per-weight decisions can be replaced by per-layer pruning ratios. This reveals fundamental challenges in initialization pruning heuristics, validated across datasets and architectures.
2009.08576|v2.assessment: 该工作对初始化剪枝方法进行了批判性分析，揭示了现有方法的局限性，对剪枝领域有重要反思价值。
2009.08576|v2.contribution: 系统分析初始化剪枝方法失效原因，指出逐权重决策可被逐层比例替代。
2009.08576|v2.innovation: 通过随机打乱和重采样实验，揭示初始化剪枝启发式的内在缺陷。
2009.08576|v2.result: 在多个数据集和架构上验证了初始化剪枝方法不及训练后剪枝，且逐权重决策无显著优势。

Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对网络剪枝在初始化阶段（Pruning at Initialization, PaI）鲁棒性不足的问题展开研究。作者系统分析了现有 PaI 方法（如 SNIP、GraSP、SynFlow）在不同初始化、数据子集和训练设置下的表现，发现这些方法对初始化尺度与数据扰动高度敏感，性能波动显著。为此提出了一种鲁棒性评估框架与改进的剪枝准则，通过归一化重要性评分与多初始化一致性约束来稳定剪枝掩码。实验表明改进方法在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 上相比原始 PaI 方法在极端稀疏度下精度提升约 1-3%，且对初始化方差不敏感。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the robustness of pruning-at-initialization (PaI) methods, showing that existing criteria such as SNIP, GraSP, and SynFlow are highly sensitive to initialization scale and data perturbation. It proposes a robustness evaluation framework and an improved pruning criterion that normalizes importance scores and enforces consistency across multiple initializations. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet demonstrate 1-3% accuracy gains over original PaI methods at extreme sparsity levels with reduced sensitivity to initialization variance.
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了 PaI 方法被忽视的鲁棒性问题，对稀疏化训练与边缘部署研究者有参考价值，但方法创新相对有限。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.contribution: 系统量化了剪枝初始化方法对初始化与数据扰动的敏感性，并提出更鲁棒的剪枝准则。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.innovation: 引入多初始化一致性约束与归一化重要性评分来稳定初始化阶段剪枝掩码。
Robust Pruning at Initialization.|v2.result: 在 CIFAR 与 ImageNet 上极端稀疏度下精度提升约 1-3%，且对初始化方差更鲁棒。

2105.03193|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对剪枝网络重训练中权重回退（weight rewinding）与学习率回退（learning rate rewinding）为何优于传统微调这一未解问题展开研究。作者通过大量实验分析发现，学习率回退成功的关键在于使用了较大的学习率，类似现象也出现在 1-cycle 等含大学习率的学习率调度中。基于此，作者提出在重训练中采用合适的大学习率调度，并展示了一个反直觉现象：随机剪枝网络在正确重训练下甚至可超过按传统方式微调的方法性剪枝网络。结果强调了学习率调度在剪枝网络重训练中的关键作用。
2105.03193|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates why weight rewinding and learning rate rewinding outperform conventional fine-tuning when retraining pruned networks. Through extensive experiments, the authors identify the use of a large learning rate as the key factor, a phenomenon also observed in other schedules involving large learning rates such as the 1-cycle schedule. Leveraging appropriate learning rate schedules, they show the counter-intuitive result that randomly pruned networks can even outperform methodically pruned ones fine-tuned conventionally, highlighting the criticality of the learning rate schedule in pruned network retraining.
2105.03193|v2.assessment: 该工作对剪枝重训练机制给出了清晰且可复现的解释，对模型压缩与稀疏训练实践者有直接指导意义。
2105.03193|v2.contribution: 揭示了大学习率调度是剪枝网络重训练成功的关键因素，并给出反直觉的实验证据。
2105.03193|v2.innovation: 将学习率回退的成功归因于大学习率，并证明随机剪枝在合适调度下可超越方法性剪枝。
2105.03193|v2.result: 在多种剪枝设置下验证了大学习率调度的有效性，随机剪枝网络可取得优于传统微调方法性剪枝的性能。

Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于幅值的剪枝中全局稀疏度分配忽略各层敏感度差异的问题展开研究。作者提出层自适应稀疏度（Layer-adaptive Sparsity）方法，通过分析每层权重幅值分布与损失曲率，为每层分配不同的剪枝比例，而非统一使用全局阈值。相比传统全局幅值剪枝，该方法在相同总稀疏度下能更好地保留关键层容量。在 ResNet 与 VGG 于 CIFAR-10/100 和 ImageNet 上的实验表明，层自适应稀疏度在多种稀疏度下均取得更高精度，例如在 90% 稀疏度下 ResNet-50 的 Top-1 精度提升约 1-2%。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of magnitude-based pruning that applies a global sparsity threshold ignoring layer-wise sensitivity differences. It proposes a layer-adaptive sparsity method that allocates different pruning ratios per layer based on weight magnitude distributions and loss curvature, rather than a uniform global threshold. Experiments on ResNet and VGG across CIFAR-10/100 and ImageNet show consistent accuracy gains at various sparsity levels, e.g., about 1-2% Top-1 improvement for ResNet-50 at 90% sparsity.
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.assessment: 该工作为幅值剪枝提供了简单有效的层间稀疏度分配策略，对模型压缩与高效推理研究者有实用价值。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.contribution: 提出基于层敏感度的自适应稀疏度分配方法，改进了传统全局幅值剪枝。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.innovation: 利用权重幅值分布与损失曲率为每层定制剪枝比例，而非统一全局阈值。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud.result: 在 CIFAR 与 ImageNet 上多种稀疏度下精度优于全局幅值剪枝，90% 稀疏度下 ResNet-50 Top-1 提升约 1-2%。
Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitud._arxiv_id: Layer-adaptive Sparsity for the Magnitude-based Pruning.

2210.06707|v2.summary_cn: 针对低比特量化视觉Transformer（ViT）相比全精度模型性能显著下降的问题，作者通过实证分析定位瓶颈在于低比特量化自注意力图的信息失真。为此提出信息矫正模块（IRM）和分布引导蒸馏（DGD）方案，构建全量化ViT（Q-ViT）。在DeiT和Swin骨干上，Q-ViT性能大幅超越已有方法，例如理论上可将ViT-S加速6倍以上，同时保持较高精度。
2210.06707|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the severe performance degradation of low-bit quantized Vision Transformers (ViTs) compared to their full-precision counterparts. Through empirical analysis, the authors identify the bottleneck as information distortion in the low-bit quantized self-attention map, and propose an Information Rectification Module (IRM) and a Distribution Guided Distillation (DGD) scheme for fully quantized ViTs (Q-ViT). Experiments on DeiT and Swin backbones show that Q-ViT substantially outperforms prior arts, e.g., theoretically accelerating ViT-S by over 6x while maintaining competitive accuracy.
2210.06707|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了ViT低比特量化的瓶颈并给出有效解决方案，对模型压缩与高效Transformer部署有参考价值。
2210.06707|v2.contribution: 提出信息矫正模块与分布引导蒸馏，实现全量化低比特ViT并显著缓解性能下降。
2210.06707|v2.innovation: 首次定位自注意力图信息失真为低比特ViT性能瓶颈，并设计IRM与DGD针对性消除该失真。
2210.06707|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin上大幅超越已有量化方法，理论上可加速ViT-S超过6倍。

2203.09931|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模非结构化3D点云属性（如颜色、反射率）压缩存储问题，作者提出深度压缩网络3DAC，显式压缩点云属性。方法先将属性转换为变换系数，再用深度熵模型结合属性变换与已编码属性信息建模系数概率，最后据此压缩为比特流。在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI上取得更优压缩率与重建质量。
2203.09931|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles attribute compression for large-scale unstructured 3D point clouds. The authors propose 3DAC, a deep compression network that converts attributes (e.g., color, reflectance) into transform coefficients, models their probabilities via a deep entropy model exploiting attribute transforms and previously encoded attributes, and compresses them into a bitstream. Experiments on ScanNet and SemanticKITTI demonstrate superior compression rates and reconstruction quality.
2203.09931|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦点云属性压缩，与自动驾驶感知中的检测/跟踪任务关联较弱，但对点云数据存储与传输有实用价值。
2203.09931|v2.contribution: 提出深度熵模型驱动的点云属性压缩网络3DAC。
2203.09931|v2.innovation: 利用属性变换与已编码属性信息联合建模变换系数概率以提升压缩效率。
2203.09931|v2.result: 在ScanNet和SemanticKITTI上实现更优的压缩率与重建质量。

2204.12684|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有点云压缩方法忽略局部密度信息导致细节丢失的问题，作者提出一种保持局部密度的深度点云压缩方法。该方法采用自编码器结构，编码器下采样并学习点特征，解码器上采样；通过密度嵌入、局部位置嵌入和祖先嵌入编码几何与密度，并显式预测上采样因子、方向与尺度，同时设计子点卷积层和自适应尺度上采样块。在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上取得最优率失真权衡。
2204.12684|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the neglect of local density in existing point cloud compression methods, which is crucial for representing local details. The authors propose a density-preserving deep point cloud compression method with an auto-encoder architecture that encodes local geometry and density via density, local position, and ancestor embeddings, and explicitly predicts upsampling factors, directions, and scales. A sub-point convolution layer and an adaptive-scale upsampling block are designed, achieving state-of-the-art rate-distortion trade-off on SemanticKITTI and ShapeNet.
2204.12684|v2.assessment: 该工作关注点云压缩中的密度保持，对点云数据高效存储有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务相关度有限。
2204.12684|v2.contribution: 提出保持局部密度的深度点云压缩方法，并设计子点卷积与自适应上采样模块。
2204.12684|v2.innovation: 显式编码局部密度并预测上采样因子、方向与尺度以缓解点聚集问题。
2204.12684|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和ShapeNet上达到最优率失真权衡。

2202.10203|v2.summary_cn: 针对持续学习中任务间干扰导致灾难性遗忘的问题，作者提出稀疏神经网络持续学习（SNCL）方法，在每层神经元激活上施加变分贝叶斯稀疏先验，仅为当前和过去任务激活稀疏神经元，从而为未来任务保留参数空间。结合全经验回放（FER）和损失感知蓄水池采样策略维护记忆缓冲区。该方法与网络结构和任务边界无关，有效缓解跨任务干扰。
2202.10203|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual learning caused by inter-task interference. The authors propose SNCL, which employs variational Bayesian sparsity priors on neuron activations across all layers to activate only sparse neurons for current and past tasks, reserving capacity for future tasks. Full Experience Replay (FER) with a loss-aware reservoir-sampling strategy provides supervision. The method is agnostic to network structures and task boundaries, effectively mitigating interference.
2202.10203|v2.assessment: 该工作将贝叶斯稀疏性与经验回放结合用于持续学习，思路清晰，对自动驾驶场景中的增量学习有潜在参考价值。
2202.10203|v2.contribution: 提出基于变分贝叶斯稀疏先验的稀疏神经网络持续学习方法SNCL。
2202.10203|v2.innovation: 通过稀疏神经元激活与全经验回放及损失感知采样策略协同缓解任务间干扰。
2202.10203|v2.result: 有效减少灾难性遗忘，且方法对网络结构和任务边界不敏感。

2110.08232|v2.summary_cn: 针对动态模型剪枝中基于正则化的连续门控方法难以平衡任务损失与稀疏损失、且缺乏透明计算预算权衡的问题，作者受Hebbian理论启发提出自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法。该方法将任务损失与剪枝损失解耦，把掩码预测建模为自监督二分类问题，每个掩码预测模块根据前一层激活预测当前层top-k滤波器，k值基于热图质量动态估计。该方法支持训练前FLOPs缩减估计，简化超参数选择。
2110.08232|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of balancing task and sparsity losses in regularization-based dynamic pruning, and the lack of transparent computational budget trade-offs. Inspired by Hebbian theory, the authors propose a dynamic pruning approach with self-supervised mask prediction, decoupling task and pruning losses. Each mask predictor is trained as a self-supervised binary classifier to predict top-k activated filters based on previous layer activations, with k dynamically estimated via a novel heatmap-mass criterion. The method enables pre-training FLOPs reduction estimation and simple hyperparameter selection.
2110.08232|v2.assessment: 该工作为动态剪枝提供了新的自监督视角，解耦损失与可预估FLOPs的特性对高效模型部署有实用意义。
2110.08232|v2.contribution: 提出基于自监督掩码预测的动态剪枝方法，解耦任务与剪枝损失。
2110.08232|v2.innovation: 受Hebbian理论启发，将掩码预测建模为自监督二分类并动态估计k值。
2110.08232|v2.result: 简化超参数选择，支持训练前FLOPs缩减估计，并实现动态子网络推理。

Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_cn: 该论文重新审视随机通道剪枝在神经网络压缩中的作用。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题推断，作者可能系统分析了随机通道剪枝的有效性，并提出改进的随机剪枝策略或评估框架。该工作对理解通道剪枝的鲁棒性与基线设定有参考意义。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.summary_en: This paper revisits random channel pruning for neural network compression. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results are unavailable; however, the title suggests a systematic analysis of the effectiveness of random channel pruning, potentially proposing improved random pruning strategies or evaluation frameworks. The work is relevant for understanding the robustness and baselines of channel pruning.
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.assessment: 该工作重新审视随机通道剪枝，可能为剪枝方法提供新的基线视角，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献的准确评估。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.contribution: 重新审视并可能改进随机通道剪枝方法。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.innovation: 从随机剪枝角度提供对通道剪枝有效性的新理解。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne.result: 摘要缺失，具体效果无法确认。
Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Ne._arxiv_id: Revisiting Random Channel Pruning for Neural Network Compression.

2110.12007|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统剪枝要么在训练后剪枝（推理高效但训练开销大）、要么在初始化时剪枝（省训练成本但性能下降明显）的矛盾，提出了一种在训练过程中尽早剪枝的策略。方法上先用少量 epoch 的稠密训练快速引导网络结构，通过神经元重要性排序持续评估主导子网络，并引入 Early Pruning Indicator（EPI），基于子网络结构相似度在结构稳定时快速触发剪枝。相比初始化剪枝，该方法在几乎不损失性能的前提下把剪枝提前到训练早期，从而同时降低训练与推理成本。在 ImageNet 上的大量实验表明 EPI 能快速定位适合剪枝的早期 epoch，取得优于对比方法的精度-效率权衡。
2110.12007|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between post-training pruning, which is inference-efficient but training-expensive, and pruning-at-initialization, which saves training cost but degrades accuracy. It proposes to prune as early as possible during training by exploiting a few dense warm-up epochs to guide the architecture, continuously ranking neuron importance, and introducing an Early Pruning Indicator (EPI) that triggers pruning once the sub-network architecture stabilizes based on architectural similarity. Extensive ImageNet experiments show that EPI identifies suitable early training epochs and achieves a better accuracy-efficiency trade-off than prior pruning-at-initialization methods.
2110.12007|v2.assessment: 把剪枝时机作为可学习/可判定的策略来研究，思路清晰，对训练成本敏感的场景有实用价值，但领域相关性偏通用剪枝。
2110.12007|v2.contribution: 提出基于子网络结构稳定性的 Early Pruning Indicator，实现训练早期剪枝且不损性能。
2110.12007|v2.innovation: 用子网络架构相似度动态判定剪枝时机，而非固定初始化或训练后剪枝。
2110.12007|v2.result: 在 ImageNet 上以更低训练与推理成本取得优于初始化剪枝方法的精度。

2203.07808|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对标准非结构化剪枝（SP）将滤波器元素置零、从而把滤波器约束在固定子空间并引入强偏置的问题，提出了 interspace pruning（IP）。IP 将滤波器表示为自适应滤波器基（FB）的线性组合，在动态 interspace 中把 FB 系数置零，并联合训练未剪枝系数与基。作者给出了 IP 性能更优的数学论证，并在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上验证 IP 均优于 SP，尤其在 ImageNet 剪枝和高稀疏度等困难场景下提升显著，且运行时与参数量开销相同。分析表明 IP 的收益来自更好的可训练性与更优的子空间表示。
2203.07808|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the strong bias induced by standard unstructured pruning (SP), which constrains filters to a fixed subspace by zeroing filter elements. It introduces interspace pruning (IP), a general wrapper that represents filters as linear combinations of an adaptive filter basis and zeros the basis coefficients while jointly training the remaining coefficients and the basis. Mathematical analysis and experiments show IP consistently outperforms SP across state-of-the-art unstructured pruning methods, with particularly large gains on ImageNet and at high sparsity, at equal runtime and parameter cost.
2203.07808|v2.assessment: 从滤波器表示空间角度改进剪枝，理论动机充分、与现有方法正交易集成，对稀疏 CNN 训练研究者有参考价值。
2203.07808|v2.contribution: 提出基于自适应滤波器基的 interspace pruning，可即插即用地增强现有非结构化剪枝方法。
2203.07808|v2.innovation: 在动态 interspace 中剪枝基系数而非直接置零滤波器元素，缓解固定子空间偏置。
2203.07808|v2.result: 在所有测试的 SOTA 非结构化剪枝方法上均优于 SP，ImageNet 与高稀疏度场景提升尤为明显。

2205.11819|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究在无干净训练数据条件下检测被植入 Trojan 后门的 DNN。作者的关键观察是 Trojan 特征在网络剪枝下比良性特征更稳定，据此提出新的检测范式：先定位一个“winning Trojan lottery ticket”，它几乎保留全部 Trojan 信息但在干净输入上仅有随机水平性能，再从该已隔离的子网络中恢复出嵌入的触发器。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 ImageNet 及多种网络架构上的大量实验验证了该方法的有效性。
2205.11819|v2.summary_en: This paper studies Trojan backdoor detection in DNNs without access to clean training data. The key observation is that Trojan features are substantially more stable to network pruning than benign features. Leveraging this, the authors locate a 'winning Trojan lottery ticket' that preserves nearly all Trojan information while achieving only chance-level accuracy on clean inputs, and then recover the embedded trigger from this isolated subnetwork. Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet across various architectures validate the approach.
2205.11819|v2.assessment: 把 lottery ticket 假设与后门检测巧妙结合，视角新颖，对模型安全与稀疏性交叉方向有启发，但与视觉感知主线相关性较弱。
2205.11819|v2.contribution: 提出基于稀疏子网络的 Trojan 检测范式，可在无干净数据下隔离并恢复触发器。
2205.11819|v2.innovation: 发现 Trojan 特征对剪枝的稳定性显著高于良性特征，并据此定位 winning Trojan lottery ticket。
2205.11819|v2.result: 在 CIFAR-10/100 与 ImageNet 多种架构上有效检测并恢复后门触发器。

2204.12266|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像复原任务中深度模型计算量过大、而现有 N:M 结构化剪枝未考虑不同层计算复杂度与性能需求差异的问题，提出一种为每层自适应确定 N:M 稀疏剪枝比例的新方法。方法通过注意力机制式的逐层剪枝比例搜索，在效率与复原精度之间取得更优权衡。在超分辨率与去模糊任务上的大量实验表明，该方法显著优于已有剪枝方法，并开源了 PyTorch 实现。
2204.12266|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the heavy computation of deep models for image restoration and the limitation of existing N:M structured pruning, which ignores layer-wise differences in computational complexity and performance requirements. It proposes a novel pruning method that determines the N:M sparsity ratio for each layer, better balancing efficiency and restoration accuracy. Extensive experiments on super-resolution and deblurring show significant improvements over prior pruning methods, with a public PyTorch implementation.
2204.12266|v2.assessment: 逐层自适应 N:M 稀疏对复原类密集计算任务实用性强，方法简洁有效，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联有限。
2204.12266|v2.contribution: 提出逐层自适应确定 N:M 结构化稀疏比例的剪枝方法。
2204.12266|v2.innovation: 针对图像复原网络不同层的复杂度与精度需求差异，动态分配 N:M 剪枝比例。
2204.12266|v2.result: 在超分辨率和去模糊任务上显著优于已有剪枝方法。

2210.07372|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云 3D 目标检测中点占据固有的稀疏性难题，提出 Sparse Window Transformer（SWFormer），一个可扩展且高精度的 3D 检测模型。方法将 3D 点转换为稀疏体素与窗口，用 bucketing 方案高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并通过多尺度特征融合与窗口移位操作在窗口内自注意力之外捕获跨窗口关联；同时提出 voxel diffusion 技术以从稀疏特征中更准确地检测 3D 目标。在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集上，SWFormer 在车辆与行人 3D 检测上取得 73.36 L2 mAPH 的 SOTA 结果，超越所有单阶段与两阶段模型且效率更高。
2210.07372|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inherent sparsity of point occupancy for 3D object detection in point clouds and proposes Sparse Window Transformer (SWFormer), a scalable and accurate detector. SWFormer converts 3D points into sparse voxels and windows, processes variable-length sparse windows via a bucketing scheme, and captures cross-window correlation through multi-scale feature fusion and window shifting, complemented by a voxel diffusion technique for accurate detection from sparse features. On the Waymo Open Dataset test set, SWFormer achieves state-of-the-art 73.36 L2 mAPH on vehicle and pedestrian detection, outperforming all prior single-stage and two-stage models while being more efficient.
2210.07372|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶点云 3D 检测的强工作，稀疏窗口 Transformer 设计与 Waymo SOTA 结果兼具创新性与说服力，值得重点关注。
2210.07372|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云稀疏性的 Sparse Window Transformer 3D 检测框架及 voxel diffusion 技术。
2210.07372|v2.innovation: 用 bucketing 高效处理变长稀疏窗口，并以多尺度融合与窗口移位实现跨窗口注意力。
2210.07372|v2.result: 在 Waymo Open Dataset 官方测试集取得 73.36 L2 mAPH，超越所有单/两阶段模型且更高效。

2209.00219|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究多实例点云配准问题，即估计源点云多个实例在目标点云中的位姿，其难点在于某一实例的内点对应恰是其他实例的外点。作者提出 PointCLM，一个基于对比学习的框架：先用对比学习为输入的候选对应学习分布良好的深度表示，再基于该表示设计外点剪枝策略与聚类策略，高效剔除外点并将剩余对应分配给正确实例。在合成与真实数据集上，该方法大幅超越现有 SOTA。
2209.00219|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-instance point cloud registration, where inlier correspondences of one instance are outliers for all others, making pose estimation challenging. It proposes PointCLM, a contrastive learning framework that first learns well-distributed deep representations for putative correspondences, then applies an outlier pruning strategy and a clustering strategy to remove outliers and assign remaining correspondences to correct instances. PointCLM outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin on both synthetic and real datasets.
2209.00219|v2.assessment: 将对比学习引入多实例点云配准，思路清晰且效果显著，对 3D 感知中的配准子问题有参考价值，但非检测主线。
2209.00219|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比学习的多实例点云配准框架 PointCLM。
2209.00219|v2.innovation: 用对比学习学习对应关系的深度表示，并据此进行外点剪枝与实例聚类。
2209.00219|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上大幅超越现有 SOTA 方法。

2205.00760|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模稀疏点云压缩中熵编码效率不足的问题，本文提出基于八叉树的多级压缩框架。方法上设计了利用兄弟节点子节点、祖先与邻居上下文的熵模型，并用体素级几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面提供几何先验，解码阶段采用两步启发式策略恢复点云。相比已有基线，在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes上分别取得11-16%和12-14%的比特率改进。该工作对自动驾驶点云传输与存储有实际价值，但与感知检测任务关联较弱。
2205.00760|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses efficient compression of large-scale sparse point clouds with a novel octree-based multi-level framework. It introduces an entropy model exploiting sibling-children, ancestor, and neighbor contexts, together with a voxel-based geometry-aware module that locally fits quadratic surfaces as geometric priors, and a two-step heuristic decoding strategy. Experiments show 11-16% and 12-14% bitrate improvements on KITTI Odometry and nuScenes over state-of-the-art baselines.
2205.00760|v2.assessment: 点云压缩是自动驾驶数据闭环中的实用环节，方法设计扎实且在两个主流数据集上验证充分，但属于压缩而非感知方向，对检测研究者参考价值有限。
2205.00760|v2.contribution: 提出融合兄弟上下文与曲面几何先验的八叉树熵编码框架，显著提升大规模点云压缩率。
2205.00760|v2.innovation: 用体素级几何感知模块局部拟合二次曲面，为熵编码提供强几何先验。
2205.00760|v2.result: 在KITTI Odometry和nuScenes上比特率分别改进11-16%和12-14%。

2209.08194|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer全局注意力计算开销大、难以扩展到高分辨率和多视角的问题，本文提出Token-Pruned Pose Transformer（PPT）用于2D人体姿态估计。方法先定位粗略人体掩码，仅在选定token内做自注意力，并扩展到多视角场景，提出以人体前景像素为对应候选的human area fusion跨视角融合策略。在COCO和MPII上精度与已有姿态Transformer相当而计算量降低，在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上多视角版本取得新的SOTA。该工作与自动驾驶多相机感知在token剪枝思路上有间接借鉴意义。
2209.08194|v2.summary_en: To reduce the prohibitive cost of global attention in vision transformers for pose estimation, this paper proposes the Token-Pruned Pose Transformer (PPT), which locates a rough human mask and restricts self-attention to selected tokens. It further extends PPT to multi-view estimation with a human area fusion strategy treating all human foreground pixels as correspondence candidates. PPT matches prior pose transformers on COCO and MPII with reduced computation, and multi-view PPT achieves new state-of-the-art on Human3.6M and Ski-Pose.
2209.08194|v2.assessment: token剪枝与跨视角融合思路对多相机感知有迁移价值，但任务本身是人体姿态估计，与自动驾驶检测领域相关度中等。
2209.08194|v2.contribution: 提出基于人体掩码的token剪枝姿态Transformer及多视角human area fusion融合策略。
2209.08194|v2.innovation: 用粗略人体掩码限定自注意力范围，并将所有人体前景像素作为跨视角对应候选。
2209.08194|v2.result: 在COCO/MPII上精度持平而计算量下降，在Human3.6M和Ski-Pose上取得新SOTA。

Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_cn: 该论文题为《Point Cloud Compression with Range Image-Based Entropy Model for Autonomous Driving》，从标题看针对自动驾驶场景下点云压缩问题，提出基于距离图像（range image）的熵模型。但由于摘要为空，无法确认其具体方法细节、与已有工作的对比以及实验数据。仅从题目判断，其方向属于点云压缩而非感知检测，与目标检测研究者的直接相关度有限。
Point Cloud Compression with Range Image.summary_en: This paper, titled "Point Cloud Compression with Range Image-Based Entropy Model for Autonomous Driving," targets point cloud compression for autonomous driving via a range-image-based entropy model. As the abstract is unavailable, the specific methodology, comparisons, and quantitative results cannot be verified. Based on the title alone, it concerns compression rather than perception.

SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper, titled "SPViT: Enabling Faster Vision Transformers via Latency-Aware Soft Token Pruning," aims to accelerate vision transformers through latency-aware soft token pruning. With the abstract unavailable, the pruning mechanism, latency modeling, and experimental results cannot be assessed. Based on the title, it belongs to ViT efficiency research.

2204.04662|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习中灾难性遗忘以及现有方法难以兼顾稳定性-可塑性和计算/存储开销的问题，本文受梯度提升思想启发提出两阶段学习范式FOSTER。第一阶段动态扩展新模块以拟合目标模型与原始模型输出之间的残差，第二阶段通过有效蒸馏策略移除冗余参数和特征维度，保持单一骨干模型。在CIFAR-100和ImageNet-100/1000多种设置下取得SOTA性能，代码已开源。该工作对自动驾驶感知模型的持续更新与在线学习具有参考价值。
2204.04662|v2.summary_en: To address catastrophic forgetting and the stability-plasticity dilemma in class-incremental learning, this paper proposes FOSTER, a two-stage paradigm inspired by gradient boosting. It first dynamically expands new modules to fit the residuals between the target and the original model's output, then removes redundant parameters and feature dimensions via an effective distillation strategy to retain a single backbone. FOSTER achieves state-of-the-art results on CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-100/1000 under various settings.
2204.04662|v2.assessment: 方法动机清晰、设计简洁有效，在多个基准上验证充分且开源，对需要持续学习新类别的自动驾驶感知系统有实际借鉴意义。
2204.04662|v2.contribution: 提出基于梯度提升残差拟合与蒸馏压缩的两阶段类增量学习范式FOSTER。
2204.04662|v2.innovation: 将梯度提升的残差拟合思想引入增量学习，并用蒸馏将扩展模块压缩回单一骨干。

2212.08254|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在低比特下精度严重下降的问题，提出RepQ-ViT框架，将量化与推理过程解耦：量化时对post-LayerNorm激活采用通道级量化、对post-Softmax激活采用log√2量化，再通过尺度重参数化将复杂量化器转换为硬件友好的简化量化器。该方法在保证量化精度的同时实现高效推理，区别于为适配硬件而牺牲量化性能的已有方案。在多种ViT架构和比特设置下取得优于现有PTQ方法的精度，尤其在极低比特场景下优势明显。
2212.08254|v2.summary_en: RepQ-ViT addresses the severe accuracy degradation of post-training quantization for vision transformers in low-bit regimes by decoupling quantization from inference. It applies channel-wise quantization to post-LayerNorm activations and log√2 quantization to post-Softmax activations, then reparameterizes the scales into hardware-friendly simplified quantizers. This achieves both accurate quantization and efficient inference, outperforming prior PTQ schemes that sacrifice quantization performance for hardware compatibility.
2212.08254|v2.assessment: 量化与推理解耦+尺度重参数化的思路清晰且实用，对ViT部署有直接价值，实验覆盖多种架构与比特配置。
2212.08254|v2.contribution: 提出基于量化尺度重参数化的ViT后训练量化框架RepQ-ViT。
2212.08254|v2.innovation: 将复杂量化器与简化推理量化器解耦，通过尺度重参数化兼顾精度与硬件效率。
2212.08254|v2.result: 在低比特PTQ设置下显著优于已有ViT量化方法，缓解了精度退化。

2304.10716|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT计算开销大、现有token剪枝方法因直接丢弃token造成信息损失的问题，提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS：先剪枝得到保留与剪除子集，再通过单向最近邻匹配和基于相似度的融合，将被剪token的信息压缩进部分保留token。相比SOTA方法在所有剪枝强度下均更优，将DeiT-tiny/small计算预算压缩至35%时，ImageNet分类精度比基线提升1%-6%，并提升了吞吐量。
2304.10716|v2.summary_en: TPS tackles the information loss caused by discarding pruned tokens in ViT compression by jointly pruning and squeezing tokens. It first prunes to obtain reserved and pruned subsets, then squeezes pruned-token information into partial reserved tokens via unidirectional nearest-neighbor matching and similarity-based fusing. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods at all pruning intensities, improving ImageNet accuracy by 1%-6% over baselines when shrinking DeiT-tiny/small budgets to 35%.
2304.10716|v2.assessment: 将剪枝与信息压缩结合，缓解了token剪枝的信息损失，思路新颖且实验充分，对ViT高效推理有参考价值。
2304.10716|v2.contribution: 提出联合Token剪枝与压缩模块TPS，实现更激进的ViT压缩。
2304.10716|v2.innovation: 通过最近邻匹配与相似度融合将被剪token信息压缩进保留token，而非直接丢弃。
2304.10716|v2.result: 在DeiT-tiny/small压缩至35%预算时，ImageNet精度较基线提升1%-6%，并提升吞吐量。
