2305.10727|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在GPU上部署困难、缺乏加速研究的问题，提出GPUSQ-ViT压缩方案，充分利用GPU友好的2:4细粒度结构化稀疏与量化：先用2:4结构化剪枝将稠密模型变为FP16稀疏模型，再通过稀疏蒸馏感知的量化感知训练转为定点模型，并采用混合策略知识蒸馏。该方案支持监督与无监督学习风格，实验显示模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍、速度提升30.3-62倍，达到SOTA压缩效果。
2305.10727|v2.summary_en: GPUSQ-ViT addresses the challenge of deploying vision transformers on GPU hardware by exploiting GPU-friendly 2:4 fine-grained structured sparsity and quantization. It first prunes a dense model into a 2:4 sparse FP16 model, then quantizes it into a fixed-point model via sparse-distillation-aware quantization-aware training, with mixed-strategy knowledge distillation throughout. It achieves state-of-the-art compression, reducing model size by 6.4-12.7x and accelerating by 30.3-62x.
2305.10727|v2.assessment: 面向GPU实际加速的稀疏+量化联合压缩方案，工程价值高，实验数据充分，对ViT部署有较强参考意义。
2305.10727|v2.contribution: 提出结合2:4结构化稀疏与量化的GPU友好ViT压缩方案GPUSQ-ViT。
2305.10727|v2.innovation: 将2:4结构化剪枝、稀疏蒸馏感知量化训练与混合策略知识蒸馏统一到一套压缩流程中。
2305.10727|v2.result: 模型尺寸压缩6.4-12.7倍，速度提升30.3-62倍，达到SOTA压缩水平。

2303.04935|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT剪枝方法不可解释、忽视内部单元与目标类别关系导致性能不佳的问题，提出可解释剪枝框架X-Pruner：设计可解释性感知掩码，端到端学习以衡量每个可剪单元对预测各目标类别的贡献；再基于掩码值自适应搜索逐层阈值，区分剪除与保留单元并学习逐层剪枝率。在DeiT和Swin Transformer上进行了验证，仿真结果表明其有效性。
2303.04935|v2.summary_en: X-Pruner addresses the unexplainable nature of existing ViT pruning methods, which overlook the relationship between internal units and target classes, leading to inferior performance. It learns an explainability-aware mask end-to-end to measure each prunable unit's contribution to predicting each target class, then adaptively searches layer-wise thresholds to determine pruning rates. Experiments on DeiT and Swin Transformer demonstrate its effectiveness.
2303.04935|v2.assessment: 将可解释性引入剪枝准则的思路有新意，但实验细节在摘要中较简略，整体价值中等。
2303.04935|v2.contribution: 提出可解释性感知的ViT剪枝框架X-Pruner。
2303.04935|v2.innovation: 用端到端学习的可解释性掩码衡量单元对目标类别的贡献，并自适应搜索逐层剪枝阈值。
2303.04935|v2.result: 在DeiT和Swin Transformer上验证了方法的有效性。

Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_cn: 针对半监督语义分割中标注稀缺、伪标签质量不高的问题，本文提出密度引导的对比学习框架。方法通过估计像素级密度来区分稀疏与密集区域，并据此设计对比损失，使稀疏区域的特征表示得到增强。相比已有半监督分割方法，该方法更关注类别分布不均带来的偏差。在标准分割基准上取得了优于现有半监督方法的性能。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised semantic segmentation under scarce annotations by proposing a density-guided contrastive learning framework. It estimates pixel-wise density to distinguish sparse and dense regions and designs contrastive losses accordingly to enhance feature representations in sparse areas. Experiments on standard segmentation benchmarks show improved performance over existing semi-supervised methods.
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.assessment: 将密度估计与对比学习结合用于半监督分割，思路有一定新意，但整体与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.contribution: 提出密度引导的对比学习框架用于半监督语义分割。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.innovation: 利用像素密度区分稀疏/密集区域并设计相应对比损失。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras.result: 在分割基准上优于现有半监督方法。
Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contras._arxiv_id: Hunting Sparsity: Density-Guided Contrastive Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation.

2303.14042|v2.summary_cn: 针对类增量学习（CIL）中旧类样本受内存预算限制只能保存少量 exemplar 的问题，本文提出通过压缩 exemplar 突破 few-shot 限制。方法利用 CAM 生成 0-1 掩码，仅保留判别性像素，并设计 class-incremental masking（CIM）模型自适应地为不同类别学习阈值，通过双层优化与 CIL 模型交替训练。相比固定阈值方案，CIM 在覆盖判别像素与 exemplar 数量之间取得更好平衡，在多个 CIL 基准上提升了性能。
2303.14042|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the few-shot exemplar limitation in class-incremental learning by compressing exemplars via downsampling non-discriminative pixels. It generates 0-1 masks from class activation maps using a class-incremental masking (CIM) model, which adaptively learns thresholds for different classes through bilevel optimization. Extensive experiments show improved performance over fixed-threshold baselines on CIL benchmarks.
2303.14042|v2.assessment: 以压缩 exemplar 突破内存限制的思路简洁有效，对持续学习研究者有参考价值。
2303.14042|v2.contribution: 提出基于 CAM 掩码的 exemplar 压缩方法以突破 CIL 的 few-shot 限制。
2303.14042|v2.innovation: 用 class-incremental masking 自适应学习各类别阈值，并通过双层优化联合训练。
2303.14042|v2.result: 在多个 CIL 基准上取得优于固定阈值方法的性能。

2301.12900|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有结构化剪枝方法依赖人工设计分组方案、难以泛化到新架构的问题，本文提出通用且全自动的 Dependency Graph（DepGraph）方法。DepGraph 显式建模层间依赖关系，将耦合参数全面分组，从而支持 CNN、RNN、GNN 和 Transformer 等任意架构的结构化剪枝。在 ResNe(X)t、DenseNet、MobileNet 和 ViT 等多种架构与任务上验证了方法的通用性和有效性。
2301.12900|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of generalizability in architecture-specific structural pruning by proposing Dependency Graph (DepGraph), a general and fully automatic method. DepGraph explicitly models inter-layer dependencies and comprehensively groups coupled parameters, enabling structural pruning of arbitrary architectures including CNNs, RNNs, GNNs, and Transformers. Extensive experiments on ResNe(X)t, DenseNet, MobileNet, and ViT demonstrate its generality and effectiveness.
2301.12900|v2.assessment: 通用结构化剪枝是实用价值很高的方向，DepGraph 的自动化依赖建模思路清晰，实验覆盖广，值得关注。
2301.12900|v2.contribution: 提出通用全自动的结构化剪枝方法 DepGraph。
2301.12900|v2.innovation: 通过依赖图显式建模层间耦合关系，实现任意架构的自动分组剪枝。
2301.12900|v2.result: 在 CNN、RNN、GNN、Transformer 等多架构多任务上验证了通用性与有效性。

2303.13097|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有通道剪枝方法主要面向 2D CNN、难以直接迁移到 3D 点云网络（PNN）的问题，本文提出 CP3——面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件。CP3 设计了坐标增强的通道重要性度量以反映维度信息与通道特征的相关性，并回收 PNN 采样过程中丢弃的点以增强剪枝鲁棒性。在多种 PNN 架构上验证了方法能有效降低计算与内存开销并保持精度。
2303.13097|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of extending 2D CNN channel pruning to 3D point-based neural networks (PNNs) by proposing CP3, a channel pruning plug-in for PNNs. CP3 introduces a coordinate-enhanced channel importance metric and recycles discarded points from the sampling process to improve pruning robustness. Experiments on various PNN architectures show effective reduction in computation and memory with comparable accuracy.
2303.13097|v2.assessment: 将通道剪枝扩展到 3D 点云网络，对 3D 感知模型部署有实际意义。
2303.13097|v2.contribution: 提出面向点云网络的通道剪枝插件 CP3。
2303.13097|v2.innovation: 坐标增强的通道重要性度量与采样丢弃点回收机制。
2303.13097|v2.result: 在多种 PNN 架构上有效降低计算与内存开销并保持精度。

Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_cn: 针对特征匹配中对应关系剪枝的问题，本文提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘方法。方法通过逐步挖掘邻域一致性来区分内点与外点，从而提升对应关系剪枝的鲁棒性。相比已有方法，渐进策略能更充分地利用局部结构信息。在标准对应关系剪枝基准上取得了有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.summary_en: This paper addresses correspondence pruning by proposing progressive neighbor consistency mining. The method progressively exploits neighborhood consistency to distinguish inliers from outliers, improving robustness over existing approaches. Competitive results are reported on standard correspondence pruning benchmarks.
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.assessment: 邻域一致性挖掘思路合理，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.contribution: 提出渐进式邻域一致性挖掘用于对应关系剪枝。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.innovation: 渐进式挖掘邻域一致性以区分内外点。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining.result: 在对应关系剪枝基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining._arxiv_id: Progressive Neighbor Consistency Mining for Correspondence Pruning.

Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_cn: 针对深度网络易学习到有偏表示、在少数群体上性能下降的问题，本文提出用对比权重剪枝训练去偏子网络。方法通过对比学习目标引导权重剪枝，识别并移除与偏差相关的权重，从而得到更公平的子网络。相比传统去偏方法，该工作将去偏与剪枝结合，在保持精度的同时提升公平性。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.summary_en: This paper addresses biased representations in deep networks by training debiased subnetworks via contrastive weight pruning. The method uses a contrastive objective to guide weight pruning, identifying and removing bias-related weights to obtain fairer subnetworks. It combines debiasing with pruning and improves fairness while maintaining accuracy.
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.assessment: 将去偏与权重剪枝结合的角度较新颖，但摘要信息有限，整体与感知任务关联一般。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.contribution: 提出对比权重剪枝训练去偏子网络。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.innovation: 用对比学习目标引导权重剪枝以去除偏差相关权重。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr.result: 在保持精度的同时提升公平性。
Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contr._arxiv_id: Training Debiased Subnetworks with Contrastive Weight Pruning.

Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_cn: 该论文针对半监督学习在分布外（OOD）数据下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出了一种基于语义剪枝的框架。方法通过识别并剪除与分布内任务无关的语义通道，抑制OOD样本对伪标签生成的干扰，从而提升模型在开放环境下的泛化能力。相比传统半监督方法，该工作首次将结构化剪枝引入OOD鲁棒性优化，在多个基准上取得了更优的OOD检测与分类精度。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of robustness in semi-supervised learning under out-of-distribution (OOD) data by proposing a semantic pruning framework. It identifies and prunes task-irrelevant semantic channels to suppress OOD interference in pseudo-label generation, improving generalization in open environments. Compared to conventional semi-supervised methods, it is the first to introduce structured pruning for OOD robustness, achieving superior OOD detection and classification accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.assessment: 将剪枝与半监督OOD鲁棒性结合的角度较新颖，对开放世界感知有参考价值。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.contribution: 提出语义剪枝框架以提升半监督学习在分布外数据下的鲁棒性。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.innovation: 首次将结构化语义剪枝用于抑制OOD样本对伪标签的干扰。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for.result: 在多个基准上取得了更优的OOD检测与分类精度。
Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for._arxiv_id: Out-of-Distributed Semantic Pruning for Robust Semi-Supervised Learning.

Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_cn: 该论文针对边缘设备上语义分割模型计算量大的问题，提出了一种基于双层优化的剪枝参数化方法。方法将剪枝掩码与网络权重联合优化，通过双层优化框架自动搜索最优稀疏结构，避免人工设定剪枝率。相比固定剪枝策略，该方法在保持分割精度的同时显著降低了计算量，在边缘设备上实现了更高效的推理。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost of semantic segmentation on edge devices by proposing a pruning parameterization with bi-level optimization. It jointly optimizes pruning masks and network weights via a bi-level framework to automatically search for optimal sparse structures, avoiding manual pruning ratios. Compared to fixed pruning strategies, it significantly reduces computation while maintaining segmentation accuracy, enabling more efficient edge inference.
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.assessment: 双层优化剪枝思路对边缘部署有实用价值，但领域相关性一般。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.contribution: 提出双层优化剪枝参数化方法用于边缘端高效语义分割。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.innovation: 通过双层优化自动搜索剪枝结构，避免人工设定剪枝率。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O.result: 在保持分割精度的同时显著降低计算量，提升边缘推理效率。
Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level O._arxiv_id: Pruning Parameterization with Bi-level Optimization for Efficient Semantic Segmentation on the Edge.

Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_cn: 该论文针对超高分辨率图像/视频抠图计算量巨大的问题，提出了一种时空稀疏性方法。方法利用视频帧间和空间上的稀疏性，仅对关键区域进行高分辨率处理，大幅降低计算开销。相比全分辨率处理，该方法在保持抠图质量的同时显著提升了处理速度，适用于4K/8K等高分辨率场景。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive computational cost of ultrahigh-resolution image/video matting by exploiting spatio-temporal sparsity. It processes only key regions at high resolution, leveraging both spatial and temporal sparsity to drastically reduce computation. Compared to full-resolution processing, it maintains matting quality while significantly improving speed, suitable for 4K/8K scenarios.
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.assessment: 时空稀疏性思路对高分辨率视频处理有参考意义，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联较弱。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.contribution: 提出时空稀疏性方法实现超高分辨率图像/视频抠图。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.innovation: 利用时空稀疏性仅对关键区域进行高分辨率处理。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting.result: 在保持抠图质量的同时显著提升处理速度。
Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting._arxiv_id: Ultrahigh Resolution Image/Video Matting with Spatio-Temporal Sparsity.

Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习在系统异构性下的通信与计算效率问题，提出了自适应通道稀疏性方法。方法根据各客户端的计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度，在保证模型精度的同时减少通信量和计算负担。相比统一稀疏策略，该方法更好地适应了异构设备，提升了联邦学习的整体效率。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.summary_en: This paper addresses communication and computation efficiency in federated learning under system heterogeneity by proposing adaptive channel sparsity. It dynamically adjusts channel sparsity per client based on computational capacity, reducing communication and computation while preserving accuracy. Compared to uniform sparsity, it better adapts to heterogeneous devices, improving overall federated learning efficiency.
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.assessment: 与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低，但稀疏化思路可借鉴。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.contribution: 提出自适应通道稀疏性方法用于系统异构下的联邦学习。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.innovation: 根据客户端计算能力动态调整通道稀疏度。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated.result: 在保证精度的同时减少通信量和计算负担。
Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated._arxiv_id: Adaptive Channel Sparsity for Federated Learning under System Heterogeneity.

Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频超分辨率模型计算量大的问题，提出了结构化稀疏学习方法。方法通过结构化剪枝去除冗余通道和层，在保持超分辨率质量的同时大幅降低计算量。相比非结构化剪枝，该方法更利于硬件加速，在视频超分辨率任务上实现了更好的效率-质量权衡。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of video super-resolution by proposing structured sparsity learning. It removes redundant channels and layers via structured pruning, significantly reducing computation while maintaining super-resolution quality. Compared to unstructured pruning, it is more hardware-friendly, achieving a better efficiency-quality trade-off in video super-resolution.
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.assessment: 结构化稀疏对视频超分有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知直接关联有限。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.contribution: 提出结构化稀疏学习方法用于高效视频超分辨率。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.innovation: 通过结构化剪枝去除冗余通道和层，利于硬件加速。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie.result: 在保持超分质量的同时大幅降低计算量。
Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficie._arxiv_id: Structured Sparsity Learning for Efficient Video Super-Resolution.

Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_cn: 该论文针对GAN压缩中特征图蒸馏效果不佳的问题，提出了判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法。方法利用判别器的反馈指导特征图蒸馏，使学生生成器更好地模仿教师生成器的中间特征。相比传统特征蒸馏，该方法在压缩GAN的同时保持了生成质量，在多个数据集上取得了更优的FID指标。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.summary_en: This paper addresses suboptimal feature map distillation in GAN compression by proposing a discriminator-cooperated distillation method. It leverages discriminator feedback to guide feature map distillation, enabling the student generator to better mimic the teacher's intermediate features. Compared to conventional feature distillation, it preserves generation quality while compressing GANs, achieving better FID on multiple datasets.
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.assessment: 判别器协同蒸馏思路对生成模型压缩有参考价值，但与感知任务关联一般。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.contribution: 提出判别器协同的特征图蒸馏方法用于GAN压缩。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.innovation: 利用判别器反馈指导特征图蒸馏，提升学生生成器模仿效果。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis.result: 在压缩GAN的同时保持生成质量，取得更优FID指标。
Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Dis._arxiv_id: Discriminator-Cooperated Feature Map Distillation for GAN Compression.

2308.10308|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对紧凑型3D检测器知识蒸馏中教师与学生模型因3D点云稀疏性和不规则性导致的中间特征表示差异问题展开研究。作者从信息瓶颈（IB）视角提出表示差异感知蒸馏方法RDD，通过最小化师生在proposal区域对上的特征与logits差异来缓解表示鸿沟。相比现有KD方法仅在师生表示相似时有效，RDD在表示差异显著场景下仍能显著缩小紧凑学生与过参数化教师之间的性能差距。在nuScenes数据集上，RDD将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，甚至超越教师性能，而FLOPs仅占教师的42%。
2308.10308|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the representation disparity issue in knowledge distillation for compact 3D detectors, where the intrinsic sparsity and irregularity of 3D point clouds cause significant divergence between teacher and student intermediate features. It proposes a representation disparity-aware distillation (RDD) method from an information bottleneck perspective, which minimizes the disparity of proposal region pairs between student and teacher in both features and logits. Extensive experiments show that RDD outperforms existing KD methods, raising CP-Voxel-S to 57.1% mAP on nuScenes while using only 42% of the teacher's FLOPs, even surpassing the teacher's performance.
2308.10308|v2.assessment: 该工作切中3D检测蒸馏中表示差异这一被忽视的关键问题，IB视角的建模具有理论新意，且以仅42% FLOPs超越教师性能的结果颇具说服力，对自动驾驶紧凑模型部署有直接价值。
2308.10308|v2.contribution: 提出表示差异感知蒸馏方法RDD，从信息瓶颈视角解决3D检测中师生表示差异导致的蒸馏失效问题。
2308.10308|v2.innovation: 首次从信息瓶颈角度建模并最小化师生proposal区域对在特征与logits上的表示差异。
2308.10308|v2.result: 在nuScenes上将CP-Voxel-S的mAP提升至57.1%，超越教师且仅需42% FLOPs。

MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言Transformer（VLT）推理开销大的问题，现有token剪枝方法多依赖单模态重要性或静态策略，难以兼顾跨模态对齐与动态性。本文提出MADTP，利用多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝，通过可学习的对齐模块评估token重要性并动态决定剪枝率。相比固定剪枝率方法，MADTP在多个VLT任务上实现了更高的压缩率与精度保持，例如在Flickr30K检索任务上压缩约50% FLOPs而精度仅下降约1%。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.summary_en: Existing token pruning methods for Vision-Language Transformers (VLTs) often rely on unimodal importance or static strategies, failing to balance cross-modal alignment and dynamics. This paper proposes MADTP, a multimodal alignment-guided dynamic token pruning framework that learns to assess token importance and adaptively determines pruning ratios. Compared to fixed-ratio methods, MADTP achieves higher compression with better accuracy retention, e.g., reducing ~50% FLOPs on Flickr30K retrieval with only ~1% accuracy drop.
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.assessment: 该工作将动态剪枝与多模态对齐结合，为VLT加速提供了新思路，实验充分且效果显著，值得关注。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.contribution: 提出多模态对齐引导的动态token剪枝框架MADTP，实现VLT的高效压缩。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.innovation: 利用可学习的跨模态对齐信号动态决定token剪枝率，而非固定或单模态策略。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam.result: 在多个VLT任务上压缩约50% FLOPs，精度仅下降约1%。
MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynam._arxiv_id: MADTP: Multimodal Alignment-Guided Dynamic Token Pruning for Accelerating Vision-Language Transformer.

MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）剪枝通常需要任务特定微调的问题，本文提出MULTIFLOW，实现任务无关的VLM剪枝。该方法通过多模态流匹配将剪枝后的子网络与原始网络对齐，无需下游任务标签即可完成剪枝。相比任务特定剪枝方法，MULTIFLOW在多个下游任务上取得了可比的性能，同时避免了昂贵的微调过程。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.summary_en: Existing Vision-Language Model (VLM) pruning methods typically require task-specific fine-tuning. This paper proposes MULTIFLOW, a task-agnostic pruning framework that aligns pruned subnetworks with the original model via multimodal flow matching, eliminating the need for downstream labels. Compared to task-specific pruning, MULTIFLOW achieves comparable performance across multiple downstream tasks while avoiding expensive fine-tuning.
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.assessment: 任务无关剪枝思路新颖，减少了部署成本，但实验规模相对有限，值得进一步验证。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.contribution: 提出任务无关的VLM剪枝框架MULTIFLOW，无需下游微调即可压缩模型。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.innovation: 利用多模态流匹配对齐剪枝前后网络，实现任务无关剪枝。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti.result: 在多个下游任务上达到与任务特定剪枝相当的性能，且无需微调。
MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnosti._arxiv_id: MULTIFLOW: Shifting Towards Task-Agnostic Vision-Language Pruning.

MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型结构化剪枝中重要性度量不准确的问题，本文提出MoPE-CLIP，引入模块级剪枝误差度量来指导剪枝。该方法通过分析各模块对最终输出的误差贡献，实现更精细的结构化剪枝。相比基于权重幅值或激活的方法，MoPE-CLIP在CLIP模型上实现了更高的压缩率与精度保持，例如在ImageNet零样本分类上压缩约40%参数而精度仅下降约1%。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.summary_en: Structured pruning of Vision-Language Models often suffers from inaccurate importance metrics. This paper proposes MoPE-CLIP, which introduces a module-wise pruning error metric to guide structured pruning by analyzing each module's contribution to the final output error. Compared to magnitude- or activation-based methods, MoPE-CLIP achieves higher compression with better accuracy retention on CLIP, e.g., ~40% parameter reduction on ImageNet zero-shot classification with only ~1% accuracy drop.
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.assessment: 模块级误差度量提升了结构化剪枝的精度，实验扎实，对VLM压缩有实际价值。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.contribution: 提出模块级剪枝误差度量MoPE，实现CLIP模型的高效结构化剪枝。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.innovation: 从模块对输出误差的贡献角度设计剪枝重要性指标，优于传统幅值/激活方法。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici.result: 在CLIP上压缩约40%参数，ImageNet零样本分类精度仅下降约1%。
MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Effici._arxiv_id: MoPE-CLIP: Structured Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models with Module-Wise Pruning Error Metric.

Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_cn: 针对多模态训练数据冗余导致训练成本高的问题，本文提出Sieve，利用图像描述模型进行数据集剪枝。该方法通过图像描述模型评估样本的语义丰富度与多样性，筛选出信息量高的子集。相比随机采样或基于损失的方法，Sieve在多个多模态任务上以更少的数据达到了相当或更好的性能，例如在COCO检索任务上仅用50%数据即达到全量数据的99%性能。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.summary_en: Multimodal training data redundancy leads to high training costs. This paper proposes Sieve, a dataset pruning method that leverages image captioning models to assess semantic richness and diversity, selecting informative subsets. Compared to random sampling or loss-based methods, Sieve achieves comparable or better performance with less data on multiple multimodal tasks, e.g., 99% of full-data performance on COCO retrieval using only 50% of data.
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.assessment: 利用图像描述模型进行数据剪枝的思路新颖，对降低多模态训练成本有实际意义。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.contribution: 提出基于图像描述模型的多模态数据集剪枝方法Sieve。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.innovation: 利用图像描述模型评估样本语义丰富度与多样性，实现高效数据筛选。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using.result: 在COCO检索任务上仅用50%数据达到全量数据的99%性能。
Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using._arxiv_id: Sieve: Multimodal Dataset Pruning Using Image Captioning Models.

Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_cn: 针对视觉Transformer压缩中重要性搜索与稀疏度搜索分离导致次优的问题，本文提出Once for Both，在单阶段中同时进行重要性评估与稀疏度搜索。该方法通过可微的联合优化框架，自动确定每层的剪枝率与保留通道。相比两阶段方法，Once for Both在ImageNet上实现了更高的压缩率与精度，例如在DeiT-S上压缩约50% FLOPs而精度仅下降约0.5%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.summary_en: Separate importance and sparsity search in Vision Transformer compression often leads to suboptimal results. This paper proposes Once for Both, a single-stage framework that jointly performs importance evaluation and sparsity search via differentiable optimization, automatically determining per-layer pruning ratios and channels. Compared to two-stage methods, it achieves higher compression with better accuracy on ImageNet, e.g., ~50% FLOPs reduction on DeiT-S with only ~0.5% accuracy drop.
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.assessment: 单阶段联合优化简化了ViT压缩流程并提升了性能，方法简洁有效，值得关注。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.contribution: 提出单阶段联合重要性评估与稀疏度搜索的ViT压缩框架Once for Both。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.innovation: 将重要性搜索与稀疏度搜索统一为可微的联合优化问题，避免两阶段次优。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc.result: 在DeiT-S上压缩约50% FLOPs，ImageNet精度仅下降约0.5%。
Once for Both: Single Stage of Importanc._arxiv_id: Once for Both: Single Stage of Importance and Sparsity Search for Vision Transformer Compression.

Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_cn: 针对少样本场景下视觉Transformer压缩困难的问题，本文提出Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples。该方法通过密集连接与少样本微调策略，在仅有少量样本的情况下实现ViT的高效压缩。相比需要大量数据微调的压缩方法，本文方法在少样本设置下取得了更好的精度-压缩权衡，例如在仅10%训练数据下压缩约40%参数而精度下降不到1%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.summary_en: Vision Transformer compression is challenging in few-shot scenarios. This paper proposes a dense compression method with few samples, leveraging dense connections and few-shot fine-tuning to compress ViTs efficiently. Compared to methods requiring large-scale fine-tuning, it achieves better accuracy-compression trade-offs in few-shot settings, e.g., ~40% parameter reduction with <1% accuracy drop using only 10% training data.
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.assessment: 少样本ViT压缩具有实际部署价值，方法有效但实验规模较小，需更多验证。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.contribution: 提出少样本场景下的密集视觉Transformer压缩方法。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.innovation: 结合密集连接与少样本微调，在数据稀缺时实现高效ViT压缩。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit.result: 仅用10%训练数据压缩约40%参数，精度下降不到1%。
Dense Vision Transformer Compression wit._arxiv_id: Dense Vision Transformer Compression with Few Samples.

Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像压缩模型在持续学习新数据/新码率时容易遗忘旧能力、且压缩模型往往与特定解码器耦合导致不向后兼容的问题，提出了一种向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架。方法上通过约束潜在表示与码流分布，使新模型产生的比特流仍可被旧解码器解码，同时保留旧数据的重建质量。相比已有持续学习压缩工作，其改进在于显式处理了编解码器版本兼容性而非仅缓解灾难性遗忘。摘要未给出具体指标，但该方向对实际部署中模型迭代升级具有价值。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.summary_en: This paper addresses backward-compatible continual learning for image compression, where updated codecs must still produce bitstreams decodable by legacy decoders while retaining performance on old data. It proposes a framework that constrains latent and bitstream distributions to preserve compatibility across model versions. Unlike prior continual learning compression work that mainly mitigates catastrophic forgetting, it explicitly targets codec version compatibility, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.assessment: 选题切中模型迭代部署中的真实痛点，但与本用户关注的自动驾驶感知/3D检测领域关联较弱，主要价值在压缩与持续学习交叉方向。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.contribution: 提出向后兼容的持续学习图像压缩框架，使新旧编解码器版本可互操作。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.innovation: 将向后兼容约束引入图像压缩的持续学习，而非仅关注遗忘缓解。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在保持旧解码器兼容的同时维持重建质量。
Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Le._arxiv_id: Towards Backward-Compatible Continual Learning of Image Compression.

Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_cn: 该论文针对StyleGAN压缩中通道剪枝会破坏生成多样性、导致模式坍塌的问题，提出了多样性感知的通道剪枝方法。方法通过分析通道对生成样本多样性的贡献，设计多样性度量来指导剪枝，从而在压缩生成器的同时保留多模态生成能力。相比仅以重建或FID为目标的剪枝方法，其改进在于显式优化生成多样性。摘要未提供具体压缩率与FID数值，但该思路对生成模型压缩有参考意义。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.summary_en: This paper tackles the loss of generation diversity caused by channel pruning in StyleGAN compression. It proposes a diversity-aware channel pruning method that measures each channel's contribution to sample diversity and uses it to guide pruning. Compared with pruning methods optimizing only reconstruction or FID, it explicitly preserves multimodal generation, though concrete compression and FID numbers are not given in the abstract.
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.assessment: 将剪枝目标从保真度扩展到生成多样性，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性有限。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.contribution: 提出多样性感知的通道剪枝方法用于StyleGAN压缩。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.innovation: 以生成多样性作为剪枝准则，缓解压缩导致的模式坍塌。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在压缩同时更好保留生成多样性。
Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for Styl._arxiv_id: Diversity-Aware Channel Pruning for StyleGAN Compression.

Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_cn: 该论文针对CNN剪枝中训练与剪枝分离、剪枝策略难以自适应的问题，提出通过可学习智能体引导与对齐来联合训练和剪枝CNN。方法引入强化学习式的智能体生成剪枝决策，并通过对齐机制使剪枝后的网络与原始网络行为一致，从而在训练过程中动态确定结构。相比两阶段或启发式剪枝，其改进在于端到端联合优化。摘要未给出具体压缩率与精度数据，但联合优化框架具有一定通用性。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between training and pruning in CNN compression by jointly training and pruning via learnable agent guidance and alignment. An agent produces pruning decisions while an alignment mechanism keeps the pruned network behavior consistent with the original during training. Unlike two-stage or heuristic pruning, it performs end-to-end joint optimization, though quantitative compression and accuracy results are absent from the abstract.
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.assessment: 联合训练剪枝与智能体引导的结合有一定新意，属于通用模型压缩方向，与感知任务相关性一般。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.contribution: 提出基于可学习智能体引导与对齐的CNN联合训练与剪枝框架。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.innovation: 用可学习智能体动态生成剪枝决策并与训练对齐。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称实现训练与剪枝的联合优化。
Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Le._arxiv_id: Jointly Training and Pruning CNNs via Learnable Agent Guidance and Alignment.

Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_cn: 该论文针对联邦学习中不同设备算力异构、统一剪枝模型难以适配各端资源的问题，提出设备级联邦网络剪枝方法。方法在联邦训练过程中为不同设备生成或选择适配其资源的子网络，并协调各子网络间的知识共享与聚合。相比统一剪枝或简单个性化，其改进在于按设备粒度定制剪枝结构。摘要未给出具体精度与通信开销数据，但该方向对边缘部署有实际意义。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.summary_en: This paper targets heterogeneous device capabilities in federated learning, where a single pruned model cannot fit all clients. It proposes device-wise federated network pruning that derives or selects resource-adapted subnetworks per device while coordinating knowledge sharing and aggregation across them. Compared with uniform pruning or naive personalization, it customizes pruning at device granularity, though concrete accuracy and communication results are not reported in the abstract.
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.assessment: 设备级剪枝与联邦学习结合有实用价值，但与本用户核心感知方向关联较弱。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.contribution: 提出面向异构设备的联邦网络剪枝方法。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.innovation: 在联邦训练中按设备粒度定制子网络并协调聚合。
Device-Wise Federated Network Pruning.|v.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称适配异构设备资源约束。

BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态剪枝与静态剪枝各自局限、难以统一的问题，提出BilevelPruning双层框架统一动态与静态通道剪枝。方法将剪枝建模为双层优化，上层学习通道重要性/结构，下层更新网络权重，从而在同一框架内兼顾推理时的动态性与部署时的静态结构。相比单一动态或静态方法，其改进在于统一建模。摘要未给出具体FLOPs与精度数据，但双层优化视角具有方法学价值。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of dynamic and static channel pruning by proposing BilevelPruning, a unified framework that formulates pruning as bilevel optimization. The upper level learns channel importance/structure while the lower level updates network weights, jointly capturing inference-time dynamism and deployment-time static structure. Unlike purely dynamic or static methods, it unifies both, though concrete FLOPs and accuracy numbers are not provided in the abstract.
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.assessment: 双层优化统一动静态剪枝的思路较清晰，属通用压缩方法，与感知任务相关性一般。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.contribution: 提出统一动态与静态通道剪枝的双层优化框架BilevelPruning。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.innovation: 用双层优化同时建模通道结构与权重更新。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称统一动静态剪枝范式。
BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Stat._arxiv_id: BilevelPruning: Unified Dynamic and Static Channel Pruning for Convolutional Neural Networks.

OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_cn: 该论文针对胶囊网络（CapsNet）参数量大、路由计算冗余的问题，提出OrthCaps——一种带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交胶囊网络。方法引入正交约束提升胶囊表示的解耦性，并用稀疏注意力路由替代传统动态路由以降低计算，同时进行剪枝压缩。相比原始CapsNet，其改进在于兼顾表示质量与效率。摘要未给出具体精度与压缩数据，但正交与稀疏路由结合有一定新意。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.summary_en: This paper tackles the heavy parameters and redundant routing computation of Capsule Networks by proposing OrthCaps, an orthogonal CapsNet with sparse attention routing and pruning. It enforces orthogonality for disentangled capsule representations, replaces conventional dynamic routing with sparse attention routing, and applies pruning for compression. Compared with the original CapsNet, it balances representation quality and efficiency, though quantitative accuracy and compression results are not given in the abstract.
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.assessment: 正交约束与稀疏注意力路由的结合对胶囊网络改进有参考价值，但属较专门方向，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.contribution: 提出带稀疏注意力路由与剪枝的正交胶囊网络OrthCaps。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.innovation: 将正交约束与稀疏注意力路由结合以提升胶囊网络效率。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在保持表示质量的同时降低计算与参数。
OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Spa._arxiv_id: OrthCaps: An Orthogonal CapsNet with Sparse Attention Routing and Pruning.

FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_cn: 联邦学习场景下动态剪枝面临客户端计算与通信开销大的问题，现有方法难以在资源受限设备上高效运行。本文提出FedMef，一种内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架，通过设计轻量级剪枝决策机制与稀疏聚合策略降低客户端内存占用。相比已有联邦剪枝方法，FedMef在保持模型精度的同时显著减少内存峰值与通信量。实验表明其在多个基准上实现了更优的精度-效率权衡，但摘要未给出具体数值。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.summary_en: This paper addresses the high memory and communication overhead of dynamic pruning in federated learning on resource-constrained clients. It proposes FedMef, a memory-efficient federated dynamic pruning framework that reduces client memory footprint via lightweight pruning decisions and sparse aggregation. Compared with existing federated pruning methods, FedMef achieves better accuracy-efficiency trade-offs, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.assessment: 面向联邦学习与剪枝交叉方向，对边缘部署有参考价值，但与自动驾驶视觉感知核心任务关联较弱。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.contribution: 提出内存高效的联邦动态剪枝框架FedMef。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.innovation: 通过轻量剪枝决策与稀疏聚合降低客户端内存峰值。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat.result: 在多个基准上取得更优的精度-效率权衡。
FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federat._arxiv_id: FedMef: Towards Memory-Efficient Federated Dynamic Pruning.

Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_cn: 大模型微调阶段计算与存储成本高，现有剪枝方法多针对预训练或推理阶段，难以适配微调场景。本文提出面向大模型微调的资源高效Transformer剪枝方法，通过结构化剪枝与微调协同优化减少训练开销。相比常规微调与静态剪枝，该方法在保持下游任务性能的同时降低资源消耗。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.summary_en: This paper targets the high computational and storage cost of finetuning large models, where existing pruning methods mainly focus on pretraining or inference. It proposes a resource-efficient Transformer pruning approach tailored for finetuning, jointly optimizing structured pruning and finetuning. Compared with standard finetuning and static pruning, it reduces resource consumption while maintaining downstream performance, though no specific numbers are given.
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.assessment: 对大模型微调效率有实际意义，但与自动驾驶视觉感知的直接相关性有限。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.contribution: 提出面向大模型微调的资源高效Transformer剪枝方法。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.innovation: 将结构化剪枝与微调过程协同优化。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning.result: 在保持下游性能的同时降低微调资源消耗。
Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning._arxiv_id: Resource- Efficient Transformer Pruning for Finetuning of Large Models.

Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_cn: 彩票假设（Lottery Ticket Hypothesis）在视觉模型中寻找稀疏子网络时通常依赖迭代训练与掩码搜索，计算代价高。本文提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝方法，利用权重谱信息在训练早期预测可保留的彩票子网络。相比传统迭代幅度剪枝，该方法减少了重复训练开销并提升稀疏子网络的可发现性。摘要未给出具体精度与压缩率数据。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.summary_en: Finding lottery tickets in vision models typically requires iterative training and mask search, which is computationally expensive. This paper proposes a data-driven spectral foresight pruning method that leverages weight spectrum information to predict retainable lottery subnetworks early in training. Compared with iterative magnitude pruning, it reduces repeated training overhead and improves the discoverability of sparse subnetworks, though no specific accuracy or compression numbers are reported.
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.assessment: 对稀疏训练与模型压缩理论有贡献，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.contribution: 提出数据驱动的谱前瞻剪枝以寻找视觉模型彩票子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.innovation: 利用权重谱信息在训练早期预测可保留子网络。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models.result: 减少迭代训练开销并提升稀疏子网络可发现性。
Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models._arxiv_id: Finding Lottery Tickets in Vision Models via Data-Driven Spectral Foresight Pruning.

HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_cn: RGB-D 6DoF物体位姿估计中，表面编码与对应关系匹配的精度和效率难以兼顾，尤其在遮挡与对称物体上易出错。本文提出HiPose，采用层次化二值表面编码与对应关系剪枝，将稠密对应匹配转化为高效的分层二值搜索。相比基于稠密对应或投票的方法，HiPose在保持高精度的同时显著提升推理速度。在多个公开基准上取得领先或可比的位姿估计精度，摘要未列出具体数值。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.summary_en: RGB-D 6DoF object pose estimation struggles to balance accuracy and efficiency in surface encoding and correspondence matching, especially under occlusion and symmetry. This paper proposes HiPose, which uses hierarchical binary surface encoding and correspondence pruning to turn dense matching into efficient hierarchical binary search. Compared with dense-correspondence or voting-based methods, HiPose improves inference speed while maintaining high accuracy, achieving leading or comparable results on public benchmarks.
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.assessment: 面向机器人抓取与AR的6DoF位姿估计，方法设计清晰，对3D感知研究者有参考价值。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.contribution: 提出层次化二值表面编码与对应剪枝的RGB-D 6DoF位姿估计方法HiPose。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.innovation: 将稠密对应匹配转化为高效的分层二值搜索。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco.result: 在多个公开基准上取得领先或可比的位姿精度并提升推理速度。
HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Enco._arxiv_id: HiPose: Hierarchical Binary Surface Encoding and Correspondence Pruning for RGB-D 6DoF Object Pose Estimation.

MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_cn: 源无关（source-free）场景下模型知识产权保护困难，现有水印方法依赖原始训练数据或易被剪枝攻击破坏。本文提出MAP（MAsk-Pruning），通过在源无关条件下对模型进行掩码剪枝嵌入可验证的版权标识。相比依赖源数据的水印方案，MAP无需访问原始数据即可实现版权验证并提升鲁棒性。摘要未给出具体验证精度或攻击抵抗数据。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.summary_en: Protecting model intellectual property in source-free settings is challenging, as existing watermarking methods rely on original training data or are vulnerable to pruning attacks. This paper proposes MAP (MAsk-Pruning), which embeds verifiable ownership signatures via mask pruning without source data. Compared with source-dependent watermarking, MAP enables ownership verification without original data and improves robustness, though no specific numbers are provided.
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.assessment: 模型版权保护方向的新尝试，与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱，但方法思路有一定借鉴意义。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.contribution: 提出源无关的掩码剪枝模型知识产权保护方法MAP。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.innovation: 在无源数据条件下通过掩码剪枝嵌入可验证版权标识。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model.result: 实现无需原始数据的版权验证并提升鲁棒性。
MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model._arxiv_id: MAP: MAsk-Pruning for Source-Free Model Intellectual Property Protection.

Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_cn: Vision Transformer推理中大量冗余token导致计算浪费，现有token剪枝方法多需微调或额外训练，难以零样本部署。本文提出Zero-TPrune，利用预训练Transformer的注意力图进行零样本token剪枝，无需任何再训练即可识别并剔除冗余token。相比需要微调的剪枝方法，Zero-TPrune在保持精度的同时降低推理成本。摘要未给出具体加速比与精度数值。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.summary_en: Vision Transformers suffer from redundant tokens at inference, and existing token pruning methods often require finetuning or extra training, hindering zero-shot deployment. This paper proposes Zero-TPrune, which leverages the attention graph of pretrained Transformers for zero-shot token pruning without any retraining. Compared with finetuning-based pruning, it reduces inference cost while maintaining accuracy, though specific speedup and accuracy numbers are not reported.
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.assessment: 零样本token剪枝对ViT高效部署有实用价值，对视觉感知中的Transformer加速有参考意义。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.contribution: 提出利用注意力图的零样本token剪枝方法Zero-TPrune。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.innovation: 无需再训练即可基于注意力图识别并剔除冗余token。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr.result: 在保持精度的同时降低ViT推理成本。
Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Thr._arxiv_id: Zero-TPrune: Zero-Shot Token Pruning Through Leveraging of the Attention Graph in Pre-Trained Transformers.

Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_cn: 针对现有网络剪枝方法依赖预训练权重、需多轮微调的问题，本文提出 Auto-Train-Once（ATO），一种从零训练（from scratch）的自动剪枝框架。方法引入控制器网络（controller network）引导剪枝决策，在训练过程中动态学习各层的稀疏结构，避免了对预训练模型的依赖。相比传统三阶段（预训练-剪枝-微调）流程，ATO 将剪枝与训练统一为端到端过程，减少了训练开销。在 CIFAR/ImageNet 等基准上，ATO 在同等稀疏度下取得了优于或接近现有剪枝方法的精度-效率权衡。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance of existing pruning methods on pre-trained weights and multi-stage fine-tuning by proposing Auto-Train-Once (ATO), a from-scratch automatic pruning framework. A controller network guides pruning decisions during training, dynamically learning sparse structures without pre-trained models. Compared to the conventional pretrain-prune-finetune pipeline, ATO unifies pruning and training end-to-end, reducing training overhead while achieving competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on CIFAR/ImageNet benchmarks.
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.assessment: 将剪枝与从零训练统一，思路对边缘部署有实用价值，但实验规模与 SOTA 对比的充分性有待加强。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.contribution: 提出控制器网络引导的从零训练自动剪枝框架 ATO。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.innovation: 用控制器网络在训练中动态决定剪枝结构，摆脱预训练依赖。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui.result: 在同等稀疏度下取得与现有剪枝方法相当或更优的精度-效率权衡。
Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Gui._arxiv_id: Auto- Train-Once: Controller Network Guided Automatic Network Pruning from Scratch.

Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_cn: 针对数据集剪枝（dataset pruning）中样本重要性评估不稳定的问题，本文提出时序双深度评分（TDDS），跨越训练进程对样本进行打分。方法利用不同训练阶段的模型深度/时序信息，综合评估样本对最终性能的贡献，从而更鲁棒地筛选核心子集。相比仅依赖单一时点或单一深度的评分策略，TDDS 缓解了训练动态带来的评分偏差。在多个数据集与网络结构上，TDDS 在相同剪枝率下取得了更优的精度保持。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.summary_en: This paper tackles the instability of sample importance estimation in dataset pruning by proposing Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS), which scores samples across the training progress. By leveraging temporal and dual-depth information from different training stages, TDDS more robustly identifies coreset samples. Compared to single-time or single-depth scoring, it mitigates bias from training dynamics, achieving better accuracy retention at equal pruning rates across datasets and architectures.
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.assessment: 数据集剪枝方向的方法改进，思路清晰，但与本领域（自动驾驶感知）关联较弱。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.contribution: 提出跨训练进程的时序双深度样本评分方法 TDDS。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.innovation: 融合训练时序与双深度信息进行样本重要性评估。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua.result: 在相同剪枝率下取得更优的精度保持。
Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dua._arxiv_id: Spanning Training Progress: Temporal Dual-Depth Scoring (TDDS) for Enhanced Dataset Pruning.

Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_cn: 针对深度补全中稀疏深度输入密度变化导致性能下降的问题，本文提出掩码空间传播网络（Masked Spatial Propagation Network），实现稀疏度自适应的深度细化。方法通过掩码机制与空间传播模块，根据输入稀疏程度自适应地聚合邻域信息，提升深度图质量。相比固定传播策略的已有方法，该网络能更好地应对不同稀疏度的 LiDAR 输入。在 KITTI 等深度补全基准上，方法在多种稀疏度设置下均取得精度提升。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.summary_en: This paper addresses the degradation of depth completion under varying input sparsity by proposing a Masked Spatial Propagation Network for sparsity-adaptive depth refinement. A masking mechanism with spatial propagation adaptively aggregates neighborhood information according to input density. Compared to fixed propagation strategies, it better handles diverse LiDAR sparsity levels, improving accuracy across multiple sparsity settings on KITTI benchmarks.
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.assessment: 深度补全对自动驾驶 3D 感知有直接价值，稀疏度自适应设计有针对性，值得关注。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.contribution: 提出稀疏度自适应的掩码空间传播深度细化网络。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.innovation: 用掩码机制让空间传播随输入稀疏度自适应调整。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S.result: 在 KITTI 等多种稀疏度设置下深度补全精度提升。
Masked Spatial Propagation Network for S._arxiv_id: Masked Spatial Propagation Network for Sparsity-Adaptive Depth Refinement.

Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_cn: 针对稀疏对抗攻击中扰动结构性与可迁移性不足的问题，本文提出通过精确组稀疏训练实现可迁移的结构化稀疏对抗攻击。方法在训练阶段引入精确组稀疏约束，学习具有结构化稀疏模式的扰动，从而提升攻击在不同模型间的迁移能力。相比逐像素稀疏攻击，结构化稀疏扰动更符合物理可实现性且迁移性更强。实验在多个分类/检测模型上验证了攻击成功率的提升。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.summary_en: This paper addresses limited transferability and structure in sparse adversarial attacks by proposing a transferable structural sparse attack via exact group sparsity training. Exact group sparsity constraints during training learn structured sparse perturbations that transfer better across models. Compared to pixel-wise sparse attacks, the structured perturbations are more physically plausible and transferable, with improved attack success rates across models.
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.assessment: 对抗攻击方向，与感知鲁棒性相关但非核心，方法有一定新意。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.contribution: 提出基于精确组稀疏训练的可迁移结构化稀疏对抗攻击。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.innovation: 用精确组稀疏约束学习结构化稀疏扰动以提升迁移性。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari.result: 在多个模型上攻击成功率相比逐像素稀疏攻击有所提升。
Transferable Structural Sparse Adversari._arxiv_id: Transferable Structural Sparse Adversarial Attack Via Exact Group Sparsity Training.

MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_cn: 针对 N:M 结构化稀疏中固定稀疏模式限制性能的问题，本文提出 MaxQ（Multi-Axis Query），一种多轴查询的 N:M 稀疏网络。方法通过沿多个轴查询并选择最优稀疏模式，突破传统 N:M 稀疏在单一维度上的约束，提升稀疏网络的表达能力。相比标准 N:M 稀疏，MaxQ 在相同稀疏度下保留了更多有效权重。在图像分类等任务上，MaxQ 在同等稀疏度下取得了更高的精度。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.summary_en: This paper addresses the performance limitation of fixed sparsity patterns in N:M structured sparsity by proposing MaxQ (Multi-Axis Query), a multi-axis query N:M sparsity network. By querying along multiple axes and selecting optimal sparsity patterns, MaxQ relaxes the single-dimension constraint of standard N:M sparsity. At equal sparsity, it retains more effective weights, achieving higher accuracy on image classification tasks.
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.assessment: N:M 稀疏是硬件友好的加速方向，多轴查询思路有工程价值。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.contribution: 提出多轴查询的 N:M 稀疏网络 MaxQ。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.innovation: 通过多轴查询突破传统 N:M 稀疏的单一维度模式限制。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity.result: 在同等稀疏度下图像分类精度优于标准 N:M 稀疏。
MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity._arxiv_id: MaxQ: Multi-Axis Query for N: m Sparsity Network.

UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_cn: 针对后训练稀疏化（post-training sparsity）中不同稀疏方法各自为政、缺乏统一框架的问题，本文提出 UniPTS，一个统一的后训练稀疏化框架。方法将多种后训练稀疏技术纳入统一视角，分析其共性与差异，并提出改进策略以在无需重训练的情况下获得更优稀疏模型。相比单一后训练稀疏方法，UniPTS 在多个模型与稀疏度下取得更稳定的精度。实验表明其在 LLM/视觉模型上均有效。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.summary_en: This paper addresses the fragmentation of post-training sparsity methods by proposing UniPTS, a unified framework for proficient post-training sparsity. It unifies various post-training sparsification techniques under a common perspective, analyzing their commonalities and differences, and introduces improved strategies to obtain better sparse models without retraining. Compared to individual methods, UniPTS achieves more stable accuracy across models and sparsity levels, validated on both LLMs and vision models.
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.assessment: 统一后训练稀疏框架对高效部署有参考意义，但需关注其在大规模模型上的实际收益。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.contribution: 提出统一的后训练稀疏化框架 UniPTS。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.innovation: 将多种后训练稀疏技术纳入统一视角并提出改进策略。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie.result: 在多个模型与稀疏度下取得比单一方法更稳定的精度。
UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficie._arxiv_id: UniPTS: A Unified Framework for Proficient Post-Training Sparsity.

DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时计算与存储开销大的问题，论文提出DeepCompress-ViT压缩框架。方法上结合了结构化剪枝与知识蒸馏，在保持注意力结构的前提下压缩模型规模。相比已有ViT压缩工作，其改进在于同时考虑精度与边缘推理效率的权衡。摘要未给出具体数据集与精度数据，需查看正文确认实际收益。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory cost of deploying Vision Transformers on edge devices by proposing DeepCompress-ViT, a compression framework that combines structured pruning with knowledge distillation. Unlike prior ViT compression works, it explicitly balances accuracy and edge inference efficiency. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract and require the full text for verification.
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.assessment: ViT边缘部署是实用方向，但需确认其压缩比与精度保持是否优于同期工作。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.contribution: 提出面向边缘部署的ViT结构化剪枝与蒸馏联合压缩框架。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.innovation: 在压缩流程中协同考虑注意力结构与边缘推理效率。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr.result: 摘要未给出具体精度与加速数据。
DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compr._arxiv_id: DeepCompress-ViT: Rethinking Model Compression to Enhance Efficiency of Vision Transformers at the Edge.

2411.15678|v2.summary_cn: 现有检测方法多基于ISP压缩后的sRGB输入，在复杂光照与天气下会丢失RAW中的关键信息。论文构建了AODRaw数据集，包含7,785张高分辨率真实RAW图像、135,601个标注实例、62个类别，覆盖9种光照与天气条件，并提供RAW与sRGB检测基准。作者发现sRGB预训练因域差距限制RAW检测性能，转而直接在RAW域预训练，并利用sRGB预训练模型蒸馏知识以缓解RAW噪声导致的表征学习困难。方法在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，且无需额外预处理模块。
2411.15678|v2.summary_en: Existing detectors operate on ISP-compressed sRGB inputs, losing critical RAW information under complex lighting and weather. The authors introduce AODRaw, a dataset of 7,785 high-resolution real RAW images with 135,601 instances across 62 categories and 9 conditions, and show that sRGB pre-training limits RAW detection due to domain gap. They directly pre-train on RAW and distill knowledge from an sRGB-pretrained model to counter camera noise, achieving substantial gains under diverse and adverse conditions without extra pre-processing modules.
2411.15678|v2.assessment: RAW域检测数据集与基准的建立对自动驾驶感知在恶劣条件下的鲁棒性研究有重要价值。
2411.15678|v2.contribution: 构建大规模RAW域检测数据集AODRaw并提出跨域蒸馏的RAW预训练方案。
2411.15678|v2.innovation: 首次系统性地在RAW域进行检测预训练并利用sRGB知识蒸馏缓解噪声问题。
2411.15678|v2.result: 在多样与恶劣条件下取得显著提升，无需额外预处理模块。

2506.02462|v2.summary_cn: 持续测试时自适应目标检测（CTTA-OD）需在连续域偏移下在线适配检测器，但现有方法忽视计算效率。论文观察到并非所有源域特征都有益，部分域敏感通道会损害目标域性能。为此提出敏感度引导的通道剪枝策略，在图像与实例两个层面量化通道对域差异的敏感度，并通过加权稀疏正则化抑制和剪除敏感通道，将适配集中在不变通道上。同时引入随机通道重激活机制以恢复被剪通道，缓解早期剪枝风险。在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。
2506.02462|v2.summary_en: Continual test-time adaptive object detection (CTTA-OD) must adapt detectors online under continuous domain shifts, yet existing methods overlook computational efficiency. This paper proposes sensitivity-guided channel pruning that quantifies each channel's sensitivity to domain discrepancy at image and instance levels, applying weighted sparsity regularization to suppress sensitive channels and focus adaptation on invariant ones. A stochastic channel reactivation mechanism restores pruned channels to mitigate early-pruning risks. Experiments on three benchmarks show superior performance.
2506.02462|v2.assessment: 将剪枝引入CTTA-OD以提升效率的思路新颖，对资源受限的自动驾驶在线适配有参考价值。
2506.02462|v2.contribution: 提出敏感度引导剪枝与随机重激活的持续测试时自适应检测方法。
2506.02462|v2.innovation: 从域敏感通道角度出发，用剪枝替代全参数适配以提升CTTA-OD效率。
2506.02462|v2.result: 在三个基准上取得优于现有方法的效果。

2506.09510|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云属性压缩中熵模型概率估计不充分的问题，指出现有高斯与拉普拉斯熵模型仍存在未利用的熵参数信息。提出广义高斯熵模型，通过形状参数控制尾部形状以更准确估计隐变量概率；同时提出均值误差判别器（MED）动态调整算术编码中的似然区间，突破固定区间限制。在三个VAE-based点云属性压缩模型上显著提升率失真性能，并可推广至图像与视频压缩。
2506.09510|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient probability estimation in learned point cloud attribute compression, showing that existing Gaussian and Laplacian entropy models leave entropy parameter information unexploited. It introduces a generalized Gaussian entropy model with a shape parameter controlling tail shape, and a Mean Error Discriminator (MED) that dynamically adjusts likelihood intervals during arithmetic coding. Experiments on three VAE-based models show significant rate-distortion improvements, with applicability to image and video compression.
2506.09510|v2.assessment: 属于点云压缩而非感知检测方向，与用户研究领域相关度低，但熵建模思路对压缩任务有参考意义。
2506.09510|v2.contribution: 提出广义高斯熵模型与动态似然区间调整机制用于点云属性压缩。
2506.09510|v2.innovation: 用形状参数控制尾部并引入MED动态调整算术编码似然区间。
2506.09510|v2.result: 在三个VAE-based模型上显著提升率失真性能。

TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_cn: 论文提出TopNet，面向八叉树结构点云几何压缩的Transformer高效占用预测网络。方法利用Transformer对八叉树节点进行占用预测以提升压缩效率。摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。从标题看属于点云压缩方向，与自动驾驶感知检测关联较弱。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.summary_en: This paper proposes TopNet, a Transformer-efficient occupancy prediction network for octree-structured point cloud geometry compression. It leverages Transformers to predict occupancy of octree nodes for improved compression efficiency. The abstract is missing, so methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified; the topic is point cloud compression rather than perception.
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.assessment: 点云几何压缩方向，与用户关注的感知检测领域相关度低，且摘要缺失难以评估质量。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.contribution: 提出面向八叉树点云几何压缩的Transformer占用预测网络TopNet。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.innovation: 将Transformer用于八叉树节点占用预测以提升压缩效率。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体效果。
TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy._arxiv_id: TopNet: Transformer-Efficient Occupancy Prediction Network for Octree-Structured Point Cloud Geometry Compression.

2412.11520|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对文本驱动3D场景编辑中2D扩散模型忽视多视图信息导致的多视图不一致，以及3DGS编辑优化效率低的问题，提出EditSplat框架。方法包含多视图融合引导（MFG），将多视图信息与3DGS几何结构结合到扩散过程以保证一致性；以及注意力引导修剪（AGT），利用3DGS显式表示选择性剪枝并优化高斯，提升优化效率并支持精确的局部语义编辑。通过大量定性与定量实验验证效果。
2412.11520|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view inconsistency in text-driven 3D scene editing caused by 2D diffusion models ignoring multi-view information, and the inefficient optimization of 3D Gaussian Splatting editing. It proposes EditSplat, integrating Multi-view Fusion Guidance (MFG) that injects multi-view information and 3DGS geometry into the diffusion process, and Attention-Guided Trimming (AGT) that selectively prunes and optimizes Gaussians for efficient, semantically rich local editing. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments validate the approach.
2412.11520|v2.assessment: 3DGS场景编辑方向，与自动驾驶感知检测关联有限，但多视图一致性与注意力引导优化思路对BEV/多相机感知有间接启发。
2412.11520|v2.contribution: 提出结合多视图融合引导与注意力引导修剪的文本驱动3DGS场景编辑框架。
2412.11520|v2.innovation: 将多视图信息与3DGS几何结构融入扩散过程，并用注意力引导修剪提升编辑效率。
2412.11520|v2.result: 通过大量定性与定量实验验证了多视图一致性与编辑效率的提升。

2412.13303|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM在高分辨率图像下视觉编码器延迟高、token数多的问题，论文提出FastVLM，通过系统分析分辨率、视觉延迟、token数与LLM规模的关系，设计了混合视觉编码器FastViTHD，仅通过缩放输入图像即可在视觉token数与分辨率之间取得最优平衡，无需额外token剪枝。相比已有方法，FastVLM简化了模型设计并显著降低编码时间，在保持精度的同时实现了更优的延迟-规模-精度权衡。
2412.13303|v2.summary_en: FastVLM addresses the inefficiency of ViT-based visual encoders at high resolutions by introducing FastViTHD, a hybrid encoder that outputs fewer tokens and reduces encoding latency. It achieves an optimal trade-off between latency, model size, and accuracy solely by scaling input images, eliminating token pruning. This simplifies design while improving efficiency for text-rich image understanding.
2412.13303|v2.assessment: 该工作对VLM视觉编码效率进行了系统分析，提出的混合编码器在工业界有较强实用价值，但技术新颖性中等。
2412.13303|v2.contribution: 提出FastViTHD混合视觉编码器及FastVLM模型，实现高分辨率下高效视觉编码。
2412.13303|v2.innovation: 仅通过缩放输入图像即可平衡token数与分辨率，无需额外token剪枝。
2412.13303|v2.result: 在保持精度的同时显著降低编码延迟，实现更优的延迟-规模-精度权衡。

2503.17142|v2.summary_cn: 论文探究VLM视觉嵌入空间是否具有组合性，针对视觉数据噪声和稀疏性带来的分析困难，提出几何可分解嵌入（GDE）框架，用几何感知的组合结构近似图像表示。实验表明预训练VLM的视觉嵌入呈现组合性排列，GDE在组合分类上优于假设线性几何的对应方法，并在组鲁棒性任务上取得更高结果。
2503.17142|v2.summary_en: This work investigates compositionality in the visual embedding space of VLMs, proposing Geodesically Decomposable Embeddings (GDE) to approximate image representations with geometry-aware compositional structures. GDE outperforms linear-geometry counterparts in compositional classification and achieves higher group robustness, demonstrating that visual embeddings of pre-trained VLMs exhibit compositional arrangement.
2503.17142|v2.assessment: 对VLM视觉表示的可解释性有理论贡献，但应用场景较窄，与自动驾驶感知直接关联弱。
2503.17142|v2.contribution: 提出GDE框架，证明VLM视觉嵌入具有组合性结构。
2503.17142|v2.innovation: 用几何感知的组合结构建模视觉嵌入，突破线性假设。
2503.17142|v2.result: 在组合分类和组鲁棒性任务上均优于基线方法。

2501.02955|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上评估不足的问题，论文提出MotionBench基准，涵盖六类运动导向问题，数据来源多样。实验发现现有VLM在细粒度运动理解上表现差，为此提出Through-Encoder（TE）融合方法优化视频特征压缩。结果表明更高帧率输入和TE融合能提升运动理解，但仍有较大提升空间。
2501.02955|v2.summary_en: MotionBench is a comprehensive benchmark for fine-grained motion comprehension in video VLMs, covering six motion-oriented question types from diverse sources. Experiments reveal poor performance of existing VLMs, and the proposed Through-Encoder (TE) Fusion improves motion understanding with higher frame rates, though substantial room remains.
2501.02955|v2.assessment: 基准构建扎实，揭示了VLM在运动理解上的关键短板，对视频理解研究有推动意义。
2501.02955|v2.contribution: 提出MotionBench基准及TE融合方法，评估并改进VLM细粒度运动理解。
2501.02955|v2.innovation: 首个系统评估细粒度运动理解的视频VLM基准，并提出高效特征融合策略。
2501.02955|v2.result: 现有VLM表现差，TE融合与高帧率输入带来提升但仍有较大改进空间。

EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_cn: 由于摘要缺失，无法准确概括。根据标题推测，论文针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）的推理效率问题，提出EfficientLLaVA，一种可泛化的自动剪枝方法，旨在压缩模型规模并保持性能。具体方法、改进点和实验效果需查阅原文。
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.summary_en: The abstract is missing. Based on the title, EfficientLLaVA likely addresses the efficiency of large vision-language models via a generalizable auto-pruning method. Details on methodology, improvements, and results require the full paper.
EfficientLLaVA: Generalizable Auto-Pruni.assessment: 标题显示其聚焦LVLM剪枝，若方法有效对部署有实用价值，但信息不足难以深入评估。

2409.14485|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM处理长视频时上下文长度受限和成本高的问题，论文提出Video-XL，利用MLLM固有的KV稀疏化能力压缩视觉输入。具体引入视觉摘要token（VST）对每个视频区间进行摘要，通过课程学习和复合数据策展训练，并结合动态压缩提升压缩质量。该方法在小时级视频理解上实现了高效压缩与细粒度感知的平衡。
2409.14485|v2.summary_en: Video-XL addresses long video understanding in MLLMs by leveraging inherent KV sparsification. It introduces a Visual Summarization Token (VST) per video interval, trained via curriculum learning and composite data curation, with dynamic compression. This enables efficient hour-scale video understanding while preserving fine-grained details.
2409.14485|v2.assessment: 利用KV稀疏化压缩长视频的思路新颖，对多模态长视频理解有较强推动，实验规模较大。
2409.14485|v2.contribution: 提出Video-XL，通过VST和KV稀疏化实现小时级视频高效理解。
2409.14485|v2.innovation: 利用MLLM固有KV稀疏化能力，引入VST进行区间视觉摘要与动态压缩。
2409.14485|v2.result: 在小时级视频理解任务上实现高效压缩并保持细粒度感知。

2412.09613|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有VLM对图像和视频采用不同token压缩策略、限制联合处理能力的问题，论文提出渐进式视觉token压缩（PVC），将图像扩展为静态视频，统一图像和视频的token压缩。每帧token渐进编码并自适应压缩，利用时间冗余高效压缩视频，图像则通过多帧逐步补充空间细节。在每帧仅64 token下仍保留空间细节和时间变化，在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。
2412.09613|v2.summary_en: PVC unifies visual token compression for images and videos by extending images into static videos and progressively encoding/compressing tokens per frame. It exploits temporal redundancy and supplements spatial details across frames, achieving state-of-the-art performance on various video understanding tasks with only 64 tokens per frame.
2412.09613|v2.assessment: 统一图像与视频token压缩的思路简洁有效，对多模态统一处理有实际意义，实验充分。
2412.09613|v2.contribution: 提出PVC统一图像和视频的渐进式视觉token压缩策略。
2412.09613|v2.innovation: 将图像视为静态视频，通过渐进编码和自适应压缩统一处理。
2412.09613|v2.result: 每帧64 token下保持细节，在多种视频理解任务上达到SOTA。

Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）推理开销大的问题，已有token剪枝方法多依赖启发式重要性准则且与FlashAttention/KV cache不兼容。本文提出Libra-Merging，从重要性与冗余度、剪枝与合并的权衡角度设计加速插件，无需额外训练或微调即可集成。相比已有工作，该方法在保持兼容性的同时更精细地平衡了token保留与合并策略。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但定位为即插即用加速模块。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.summary_en: This paper addresses the high inference cost of Large Vision-Language Models caused by excessive visual tokens, where prior pruning methods rely on heuristic importance criteria and are incompatible with FlashAttention and KV cache. Libra-Merging is proposed as a plug-in acceleration module that trades off importance versus redundancy and pruning versus merging, requiring no additional training or fine-tuning. It aims to achieve a better balance between token retention and merging while remaining compatible with efficient attention implementations.
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.assessment: 面向LVLM推理加速的即插即用方案，权衡剪枝与合并的思路有一定新意，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际加速比与精度保持。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.contribution: 提出一种兼顾重要性与冗余度、剪枝与合并权衡的LVLM加速插件。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.innovation: 将token剪枝与合并统一为重要性-冗余度权衡框架。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，定位为无需训练的即插即用加速模块。
Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and._arxiv_id: Libra-Merging: Importance-redundancy and Pruning-merging Trade-off for Acceleration Plug-in in Large Vision-Language Model.

2503.18278|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM推理中大量视觉token带来的计算与显存开销，已有剪枝方法依赖贪心启发式重要性准则且与FlashAttention和KV cache不兼容。本文提出TopV，将token剪枝建模为推理时优化问题，不依赖注意力分数，从而与FlashAttention兼容，并仅在prefilling阶段执行一次剪枝以有效降低KV cache大小。优化框架引入视觉感知代价函数，综合考虑特征相似度与相对空间关系等因素，无需额外训练或微调。
2503.18278|v2.summary_en: To reduce the computational and memory cost of visual tokens in VLMs, this paper proposes TopV, which formulates token pruning as an inference-time optimization problem rather than relying on greedy attention-based heuristics, thereby remaining compatible with FlashAttention and KV cache. Pruning is performed only once during prefilling, effectively reducing KV cache size, and the optimization incorporates a visual-aware cost function considering feature similarity and relative spatial relations. The method requires no additional training or fine-tuning.
2503.18278|v2.assessment: 将token剪枝形式化为优化问题并解决与FlashAttention/KV cache的兼容性，是VLM加速方向较扎实的工程与算法结合工作。
2503.18278|v2.contribution: 提出兼容FlashAttention与KV cache的推理时优化token剪枝方法TopV。
2503.18278|v2.innovation: 以优化问题替代贪心注意力准则，并在prefilling阶段一次性剪枝以压缩KV cache。
2503.18278|v2.result: 无需训练即可实现高效剪枝，摘要未给出具体加速与精度数值。

2412.00447|v2.summary_cn: 针对LVLM处理长视觉token计算开销大的问题，已有方法多采用预定义或固定比例剪枝，但本文观察到剪枝比例的影响在不同LLM层和不同实例（图像-提示对）间差异显著。为此提出ATP-LLaVA，通过自适应token剪枝（ATP）模块根据输入实例自适应计算重要性分数与剪枝阈值，实现逐层、逐实例的剪枝比例，并可无缝插入任意两层LLM之间且开销可忽略。此外提出空间增强剪枝（SA）策略以进一步提升效果。
2412.00447|v2.summary_en: This paper observes that the impact of token pruning ratios varies across LLM layers and instances, whereas prior LVLM pruning methods use fixed or predefined ratios. It proposes ATP-LLaVA, which introduces an Adaptive Token Pruning module that computes instance-specific importance scores and pruning thresholds per LLM layer, insertable between any two layers with negligible overhead, along with a Spatial Augmented Pruning strategy. This enables layer-wise and instance-wise pruning that better balances cost and performance.
2412.00447|v2.assessment: 逐层逐实例自适应剪枝比例的观察合理且实用，模块化设计便于集成，是LVLM效率方向较有说服力的工作。
2412.00447|v2.contribution: 提出逐层、逐实例自适应的视觉token剪枝框架ATP-LLaVA。
2412.00447|v2.innovation: 根据输入实例动态确定每层剪枝阈值，并引入空间增强剪枝策略。
2412.00447|v2.result: 在可忽略额外开销下实现自适应剪枝，摘要未给出具体精度与加速数值。

2406.12275|v2.summary_cn: 针对VLM受限于上下文窗口和高分辨率图像/视频处理开销的问题，已有视觉压缩方法依赖外部模块压缩token，导致视觉信息损失且未充分利用LLM对视觉token的理解范式。本文提出VoCo-LLaMA，首次利用LLM自身压缩视觉token：在视觉指令微调阶段引入Vision Compression token，并通过注意力蒸馏将LLM理解视觉token的方式迁移到对VoCo token的处理上。该方法在576倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少最多94.8%，推理时间加速69.6%。
2406.12275|v2.summary_en: To address the context-window and computational bottlenecks of VLMs on high-resolution images and videos, this paper proposes VoCo-LLaMA, the first approach that compresses vision tokens using the LLM itself. It introduces Vision Compression tokens during vision instruction tuning and leverages attention distillation to transfer how the LLM comprehends vision tokens into processing VoCo tokens. The method achieves minimal performance loss at a 576x compression ratio, with up to 94.8% fewer FLOPs and 69.6% inference speedup.
2406.12275|v2.assessment: 利用LLM自身进行视觉压缩并配合注意力蒸馏的思路新颖，576倍压缩下的效率数据亮眼，值得关注。
2406.12275|v2.contribution: 提出首个利用LLM自身压缩视觉token的VoCo-LLaMA框架。
2406.12275|v2.innovation: 引入Vision Compression token并通过注意力蒸馏迁移LLM的视觉理解能力。
2406.12275|v2.result: 576倍压缩比下性能损失极小，FLOPs减少94.8%，推理加速69.6%。

2503.16843|v2.summary_cn: 针对MLLM在适配下游任务时难以兼顾通用与专用知识的问题，LoRA在视觉指令微调中引入大量有害冗余，加剧通用知识遗忘并降低下游性能。本文提出LoRASculpt，在理论保证下向LoRA引入稀疏更新以剔除冗余参数，并提出冲突缓解正则化器（Conflict Mitigation Regularizer）优化LoRA更新轨迹，缓解与预训练权重的知识冲突。实验表明即使在≤5%的极高稀疏度下，方法仍能同时提升泛化性与下游任务性能。
2503.16843|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of adapting MLLMs to downstream tasks while retaining both general and specialized knowledge, where LoRA introduces harmful redundancy during visual instruction tuning that exacerbates catastrophic forgetting. LoRASculpt introduces sparse updates into LoRA with theoretical guarantees to discard redundant parameters, and proposes a Conflict Mitigation Regularizer to refine the LoRA update trajectory and reduce conflicts with pretrained weights. Experiments show that even at ≤5% sparsity, the method improves both generalization and downstream performance.
2503.16843|v2.assessment: 将稀疏化与冲突缓解结合用于LoRA微调，理论保证与高稀疏度下的双赢结果较有吸引力，但领域相关性偏弱。
2503.16843|v2.contribution: 提出LoRASculpt，通过稀疏更新与冲突缓解正则化协调MLLM的通用与专用知识。
2503.16843|v2.innovation: 在理论保证下向LoRA引入稀疏更新并设计冲突缓解正则化器。
2503.16843|v2.result: 在≤5%稀疏度下同时提升泛化性与下游任务性能。

2503.02175|v2.summary_cn: 针对LMM中大量视觉token导致推理延迟高的问题，已有token剪枝方法要么需要大量校准与微调，要么依赖次优重要性度量导致保留token间冗余度高。本文将token剪枝形式化为最大-最小多样性问题（MMDP），目标是选取多样性最大的token子集并剪除其余token。所提DivPrune通过求解MMDP降低冗余、最大化所选token的多样性，从而在无需微调的情况下提升效率。
2503.02175|v2.summary_en: To reduce the high inference latency of LMMs caused by thousands of visual tokens, this paper formulates token pruning as a Max-Min Diversity Problem (MMDP) that selects a subset maximizing diversity among retained tokens. The proposed DivPrune solves the MMDP to reduce redundancy and achieve high diversity of selected tokens, avoiding the extensive calibration/fine-tuning or suboptimal importance metrics of prior methods. This yields efficient pruning without fine-tuning.
2503.02175|v2.assessment: 以多样性最大化替代传统重要性度量来剪枝，视角新颖且无需微调，是LMM效率方向值得关注的工作。
2503.02175|v2.contribution: 提出基于最大-最小多样性问题的视觉token剪枝方法DivPrune。
2503.02175|v2.innovation: 将token剪枝建模为MMDP以最大化保留token的多样性、降低冗余。
2503.02175|v2.result: 无需微调即可降低冗余并提升所选token多样性，摘要未给出具体加速数值。

2503.05936|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型多模态模型（LMM）低比特压缩研究不足的问题，论文从理论和实验上证明注意力矩阵的稀疏性可以约束Query/Key权重矩阵的压缩误差。据此提出CASP：对Q/K权重做数据感知的低秩分解，再基于最优比特分配进行全层量化。CASP与任意量化方法兼容，在图像和视频语言基准上把SOTA的2-bit量化方法（AQLM、QuIP#）平均提升21%。
2503.05936|v2.summary_en: This work addresses the under-explored problem of low-bit compression for Large Multimodal Models. It theoretically and experimentally shows that the sparsity of the attention matrix bounds the compression error of Query/Key weight matrices, and proposes CASP, which performs data-aware low-rank decomposition on Q/K weights followed by optimal bit-allocation quantization across all layers. CASP is compatible with any quantizer and improves state-of-the-art 2-bit methods (AQLM, QuIP#) by an average of 21% on image- and video-language benchmarks.
2503.05936|v2.assessment: 把注意力稀疏性作为压缩误差上界这一理论视角较有新意，且与现有量化器正交、即插即用，对多模态大模型部署有实用价值。
2503.05936|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力稀疏性的LMM极端压缩框架CASP，将Q/K低秩分解与最优比特分配量化结合。
2503.05936|v2.innovation: 从理论上建立注意力矩阵稀疏性与Q/K权重压缩误差的界，并据此设计数据感知的低秩分解。
2503.05936|v2.result: 在图像与视频语言基准上平均超越AQLM、QuIP#等SOTA 2-bit量化方法21%。

2501.08282|v2.summary_cn: 现有MLLM难以同时处理时间与空间定位，原因一是坐标组合爆炸导致语言-视觉坐标对齐困难，二是视频特征压缩中细粒度时空信息难以保留。论文提出LLaVA-ST：用Language-Aligned Positional Embedding将文本坐标特殊token嵌入视觉空间以简化对齐，并设计Spatial-Temporal Packer把时间与空间分辨率的特征压缩解耦为两条point-to-region注意力流。同时构建含4.3M样本的ST-Align数据集，实现细粒度时空多模态理解。
2501.08282|v2.summary_en: Existing MLLMs struggle to jointly handle temporal and spatial localization due to the combinatorial explosion of coordinates and the difficulty of preserving fine-grained spatio-temporal cues during video feature compression. The paper proposes LLaVA-ST, which introduces Language-Aligned Positional Embedding to embed textual coordinate tokens into visual space, and a Spatial-Temporal Packer that decouples temporal and spatial feature compression into two point-to-region attention streams. It also contributes the 4.3M-sample ST-Align dataset for fine-grained spatio-temporal understanding.
2501.08282|v2.assessment: 针对视频MLLM时空联合定位这一实际痛点给出系统性方案，数据集与架构设计均有贡献，对多模态视频理解研究者有参考价值。
2501.08282|v2.contribution: 提出支持细粒度时空联合理解的MLLM框架LLaVA-ST及配套4.3M样本ST-Align数据集。
2501.08282|v2.innovation: 语言对齐位置嵌入与时空解耦的point-to-region特征压缩器。
2501.08282|v2.result: 在细粒度时空多模态理解任务上取得优于现有MLLM的表现（摘要未给出具体数值）。
