2411.16760|v2.summary_cn: 论文指出Transformer中梯度流不平衡，违反了FullGrad完备性这一归因忠实性的关键性质，而CNN天然满足该性质。为此提出LibraGrad，一种理论支撑的事后方法，通过剪枝与缩放反向路径来校正梯度不平衡，不改变前向传播也不增加计算开销。在8种架构、4种模型规模、4个数据集上，用Faithfulness、Completeness Error和Segmentation AP三类指标评估，LibraGrad普遍提升梯度类方法，并在所有指标上超越包括Transformer专用方法在内的现有白盒方法。
2411.16760|v2.summary_en: The paper identifies gradient flow imbalances in Transformers that violate FullGrad-completeness, a key property for attribution faithfulness that CNNs naturally satisfy. It proposes LibraGrad, a theoretically grounded post-hoc method that corrects gradient imbalances by pruning and scaling backward paths without altering the forward pass or adding overhead. Across 8 architectures, 4 model sizes, and 4 datasets, LibraGrad universally improves gradient-based attribution methods and outperforms existing white-box methods, including Transformer-specific ones, on Faithfulness, Completeness Error, and Segmentation AP.
2411.16760|v2.assessment: 对Transformer可解释性中梯度归因失效问题给出了有理论依据且零推理开销的修正方案，实验覆盖面广，对ViT可解释性研究者有参考价值。
2411.16760|v2.contribution: 提出校正Transformer梯度流不平衡的事后归因方法LibraGrad。
2411.16760|v2.innovation: 通过剪枝与缩放反向路径恢复FullGrad完备性，且不改变前向计算。
2411.16760|v2.result: 在8架构、4规模、4数据集上全面超越现有白盒归因方法（含Transformer专用方法）。

2406.10219|v2.summary_cn: 3D Gaussian Splatting在复杂场景中可达数百万个高斯点，带来高存储与显存开销，限制其在资源受限设备上的部署。现有剪枝压缩方法依赖启发式组合来决定删除哪些高斯，高压缩率下视觉保真度和前景细节严重退化。论文提出基于二阶敏感度的剪枝评分，即重建误差对每个高斯空间参数的二阶近似，并设计多轮prune-refine流程，可应用于任意预训练3D-GS模型且不改变其训练流程。该方法在显著更高压缩率下仍保持视觉保真度与前景细节。
2406.10219|v2.summary_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents scenes with millions of Gaussians, incurring high storage and memory costs that hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices. Existing pruning methods rely on heuristic combinations to select Gaussians, causing severe degradation of visual fidelity and foreground details at high compression ratios. The paper proposes a principled sensitivity pruning score computed as a second-order approximation of the reconstruction error with respect to each Gaussian's spatial parameters, together with a multi-round prune-refine pipeline applicable to any pretrained 3D-GS model without changing its training pipeline.
2406.10219|v2.assessment: 把剪枝准则从启发式提升为有理论依据的二阶敏感度，且prune-refine流程通用，对3D场景表示压缩与高效渲染方向有实用价值。
2406.10219|v2.contribution: 提出基于二阶重建误差近似的3D-GS敏感度剪枝评分与多轮prune-refine压缩流程。
2406.10219|v2.innovation: 用重建误差对高斯空间参数的二阶近似替代启发式准则来指导剪枝。
2406.10219|v2.result: 在显著高于现有方法的压缩率下仍保持视觉保真度与前景细节。

2511.05832|v2.summary_cn: ①全局自注意力在图像高分辨率下计算与内存开销呈二次增长，而现有局部注意力因窗口内 token 在 1D 序列中不连续，难以利用块稀疏内核获得实际加速。②本文提出基于 Hilbert 曲线的窗口与邻域构造方法：先沿 Hilbert 曲线重排图像 token，再在重排后的 1D 序列上形成窗口和邻域，从而显著提升块稀疏度，可与现有块稀疏内核结合。③相比传统局部注意力模式，该方法从块稀疏视角重新组织 token 顺序，使窗口注意力和滑动注意力分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍。④作者进一步实例化为 Hilbert Window Transformer 与 Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer，摘要称两者均取得端到端效果（具体精度数据摘要未给出）。
2511.05832|v2.summary_en: Global self-attention suffers from quadratic compute and memory costs at high image resolutions, while conventional local attention patterns fail to yield real speedups because tokens within a window are non-contiguous in the 1D sequence. This work reorders image tokens along a Hilbert curve and forms windows and neighborhoods on the reordered 1D sequence, substantially increasing block sparsity and enabling combination with existing block-sparse kernels. Experiments show about 4x and 18x acceleration for window and slide attention respectively, and the strategy is instantiated as Hilbert Window Transformer and Hilbert Neighborhood Transformer.
2511.05832|v2.assessment: 该工作从块稀疏与 token 排序角度切入局部注意力的实际加速问题，思路简洁且加速比可观，对高分辨率视觉 Transformer 的效率优化有参考价值；但摘要未给出精度数据，且与自动驾驶感知任务关联较弱。
2511.05832|v2.contribution: 提出基于 Hilbert 曲线重排 token 以构造窗口与邻域，显著提升局部注意力的块稀疏度并实现实际加速。
2511.05832|v2.innovation: 将 Hilbert 空间填充曲线引入注意力窗口构造，从块稀疏视角重新组织 1D token 序列以兼容现有稀疏内核。
2511.05832|v2.result: 窗口注意力与滑动注意力分别加速约 4 倍和 18 倍，并实例化为两种 Hilbert Transformer 取得端到端效果。

2001.05119|v2.summary_cn: 多视角3D点云配准通常采用两阶段流程：先做成对初始对齐，再做全局一致精化，但相邻点云重叠低、对称性和重复结构会导致初始对齐歧义。本文提出首个端到端可学习的多视角配准算法，将两阶段联合学习，利用全局循环一致性解决歧义。在标准基准上显著超越当时SOTA，且端到端可训练、计算开销更低，并提供了消融分析。
2001.05119|v2.summary_en: Multiview 3D point cloud registration is typically solved by a two-stage pipeline of pairwise alignment followed by globally consistent refinement, where the former is ambiguous due to low overlap, symmetries, and repetitive structures. This paper proposes the first end-to-end learnable algorithm that jointly learns both stages, leveraging global cyclic consistency to resolve ambiguity. It significantly outperforms the state of the art on standard benchmarks while being end-to-end trainable and computationally cheaper, with detailed ablation studies.
2001.05119|v2.assessment: 这是多视角点云配准端到端学习的早期代表性工作，思路清晰、实验扎实，对3D感知中的多帧融合与SLAM相关方向有参考价值。
2001.05119|v2.contribution: 提出首个联合学习成对对齐与全局精化的端到端多视角3D点云配准算法。
2001.05119|v2.innovation: 将两阶段配准统一到端到端框架中，并用全局循环一致性约束解决低重叠与对称性歧义。
2001.05119|v2.result: 在标准基准上显著超越SOTA，同时计算开销更低，并通过消融验证了各组件有效性。

End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_cn: 该论文关注3D点云的局部多视角描述子学习问题，旨在为点云配准等任务提供更具判别力的局部特征。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体方法细节与实验设置。从标题看，其核心是端到端学习局部多视角描述子，可能通过多视角投影或视图聚合增强局部几何表征。整体与自动驾驶3D感知中的点云配准/匹配相关，但直接相关性有限。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.summary_en: This paper addresses end-to-end learning of local multi-view descriptors for 3D point clouds, aiming to provide more discriminative local features for tasks such as point cloud registration. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology and experimental setup cannot be verified. Based on the title, the core idea is to learn local multi-view descriptors in an end-to-end manner, likely enhancing local geometric representation via multi-view projection or view aggregation.
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.assessment: 主题与点云局部特征学习相关，但缺少摘要信息，难以判断方法质量与实验充分度，建议获取全文后再评估。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.contribution: 提出面向3D点云的端到端局部多视角描述子学习方法。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.innovation: 以多视角方式学习点云局部描述子，可能提升局部几何判别力。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化结果。
End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Des._arxiv_id: End-to-End Learning Local Multi-View Descriptors for 3D Point Clouds.

Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: 该论文研究多视角物体识别，试图利用视角线索进行自监督与正则化学习，以减少对大量标注数据的依赖。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体网络结构、自监督 pretext 任务与正则化策略。从标题看，其核心是利用多视角一致性作为监督信号来学习更具鲁棒性的物体表征。该工作与自监督视觉表征学习相关，但与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测的直接关联较弱。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper studies multiview object recognition and exploits view-based clues for self-supervised and regularized learning to reduce reliance on large-scale annotations. Due to the missing abstract, the specific architecture, pretext tasks, and regularization strategies cannot be verified. Based on the title, the core idea is to use multi-view consistency as a supervisory signal to learn more robust object representations.
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.assessment: 自监督多视角表征学习方向有一定参考价值，但缺少摘要，无法评估其方法细节与实验强度。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出利用视角线索进行自监督与正则化的多视角物体识别方法。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.innovation: 将多视角一致性引入自监督学习与正则化框架以提升物体识别鲁棒性。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化结果。
Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervise._arxiv_id: Exploit Clues From Views: Self-Supervised and Regularized Learning for Multiview Object Recognition.

GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_cn: 该论文提出GeoGraph，一种基于图的多视角物体检测方法，并端到端融合几何线索。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其图构建方式、几何线索类型与融合机制。从标题看，其核心是将多视角检测建模为图结构问题，并利用几何信息增强跨视角关联与检测精度。该工作与多相机感知及自动驾驶多视角检测方向相关，但缺少细节难以判断其实际贡献。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.summary_en: This paper proposes GeoGraph, a graph-based multi-view object detection method that end-to-end incorporates geometric cues. Due to the missing abstract, the graph construction, geometric cue types, and fusion mechanism cannot be verified. Based on the title, the core idea is to formulate multi-view detection as a graph problem and leverage geometric information to enhance cross-view association and detection accuracy.
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.assessment: 多视角检测与几何线索融合是自动驾驶感知的重要方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其方法质量与实验充分度。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.contribution: 提出基于图结构并端到端融合几何线索的多视角物体检测框架GeoGraph。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.innovation: 将多视角物体检测建模为图问题并引入几何线索进行端到端优化。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化结果。
GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object._arxiv_id: GeoGraph: Graph-Based Multi-view Object Detection with Geometric Cues End-to-End.

Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_cn: 该论文研究多视角动作识别，提出通过跨视角视频预测来学习视角间关联。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其预测任务设计、网络结构与实验设置。从标题看，其核心是利用一个视角的视频预测另一视角的内容，以此作为自监督信号提升动作识别性能。该工作属于视频理解与多视角学习范畴，与自动驾驶感知的直接相关性较低。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view action recognition by learning cross-view video prediction. Due to the missing abstract, the prediction task design, network architecture, and experimental setup cannot be verified. Based on the title, the core idea is to predict video content across views as a self-supervised signal to improve action recognition performance.
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.assessment: 多视角视频预测用于动作识别有一定新意，但领域与自动驾驶感知距离较远，且缺少摘要难以评估质量。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.contribution: 提出利用跨视角视频预测进行多视角动作识别的方法。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.innovation: 将跨视角视频预测作为学习信号以增强多视角动作识别。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化结果。
Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cros._arxiv_id: Multi-view Action Recognition Using Cross-View Video Prediction.

Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_cn: 该论文研究图结构数据的多视角表示学习，提出对比式多视角图表示学习方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认其具体对比目标、图增强策略与编码器设计。从标题看，其核心是将对比学习范式扩展到图的多视角设定，通过最大化不同视角间的一致性学习节点/图级表示。该工作属于自监督图表示学习，与视觉自监督学习有方法论上的借鉴意义，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.summary_en: This paper studies multi-view representation learning on graph-structured data and proposes a contrastive multi-view graph representation learning method. Due to the missing abstract, the specific contrastive objectives, graph augmentation strategies, and encoder designs cannot be verified. Based on the title, the core idea is to extend contrastive learning to the multi-view graph setting by maximizing consistency across views to learn node- or graph-level representations.
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.assessment: 对比多视角图表示学习是自监督学习的重要分支，方法论上对多模态/多视角感知有借鉴价值，但领域相关性一般。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.contribution: 提出面向图结构数据的对比式多视角表示学习方法。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.innovation: 将对比学习与多视角一致性目标引入图表示学习。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果与量化结果。
Contrastive Multi-View Representation Le._arxiv_id: Contrastive Multi-View Representation Learning on Graphs.

Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中依赖 LiDAR 真值进行尺度标定或评估的问题，提出用最小期望深度（MED）概率体积来建模深度分布，从而在无需 LiDAR 的情况下实现尺度感知的深度估计。方法上通过概率体积表示深度不确定性并约束尺度，替代传统依赖 LiDAR 的监督信号。相比已有自监督方法，其改进点在于摆脱了对 LiDAR 数据的依赖，使训练与评估更易部署。摘要未给出具体量化结果，需进一步验证其在标准基准上的精度。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on LiDAR ground truth for scale calibration in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by introducing Minimum Expected Depth (MED) probability volumes to model depth distributions. The method enables scale-aware depth estimation without LiDAR supervision, improving deployability over prior self-supervised approaches. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract and require further validation on standard benchmarks.
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.assessment: 该工作尝试去除自监督深度估计对 LiDAR 的依赖，思路有一定新意，但需关注其精度与泛化性是否足以支撑实际自动驾驶感知。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.contribution: 提出基于 MED 概率体积的无 LiDAR 自监督深度估计框架。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.innovation: 用概率体积建模深度分布以替代 LiDAR 尺度监督。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，效果有待基准验证。
Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised._arxiv_id: Forget About the LiDAR: Self-Supervised Depth Estimators with MED Probability Volumes.

Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角多人物3D姿态估计问题，提出基于平面扫描立体（plane sweep stereo）的方法，将多相机视角的2D姿态信息融合到统一的3D空间中。方法通过平面扫描构建3D代价体，并在其中聚合多视角的2D关键点热图以推断3D姿态。相比已有方法，该工作更好地处理了遮挡和视角间的一致性问题。在多个基准数据集上取得了优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing a plane sweep stereo approach that fuses 2D pose information from multiple camera views into a unified 3D space. It constructs 3D cost volumes via plane sweeping and aggregates multi-view 2D keypoint heatmaps to infer 3D poses, better handling occlusion and cross-view consistency. Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate improved 3D pose estimation accuracy over prior methods.
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.assessment: 该工作将平面扫描立体引入多视角多人3D姿态估计，思路清晰，但与人/车自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限，主要面向室内监控场景。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.contribution: 提出基于平面扫描立体的多视角多人3D姿态估计框架，实现多相机2D关键点到3D空间的有效融合。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.innovation: 将平面扫描立体方法扩展到多人物3D姿态估计，通过3D代价体聚合多视角信息。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati.result: 在多个基准数据集上取得了优于已有方法的3D姿态估计精度。
Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimati._arxiv_id: Multi-View Multi-Person 3D Pose Estimation With Plane Sweep Stereo.

Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角人群计数中跨视角和跨场景泛化能力差的问题，提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数方法。方法通过设计视角不变的特征表示和场景自适应机制，使模型能够在未见过的视角和场景中保持计数精度。相比已有方法，该工作显著提升了跨域泛化性能。实验表明在跨场景设定下计数误差大幅降低。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.summary_en: This paper tackles the poor cross-view and cross-scene generalization in multi-view crowd counting by proposing a cross-view cross-scene framework. It designs view-invariant feature representations and scene adaptation mechanisms to maintain counting accuracy in unseen views and scenes. Experiments show substantially reduced counting errors under cross-scene settings compared to prior methods.
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.assessment: 该工作关注多视角人群计数的泛化性问题，与自动驾驶中多相机感知的域适应有一定关联，但应用场景差异较大。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.contribution: 提出跨视角跨场景的多视角人群计数框架，提升模型在未见视角和场景下的泛化能力。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.innovation: 设计视角不变特征表示与场景自适应机制，解决多视角计数中的域偏移问题。
Cross-View Cross-Scene Multi-View Crowd.result: 在跨场景设定下计数误差大幅降低，优于已有方法。

COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视角聚类问题，提出COMPLETER框架，通过对比预测学习视角间的一致表示。方法利用对比学习在缺失视角情况下恢复视角间的一致性信息，并通过预测模块补全缺失视角的特征表示。相比已有方法，该工作在不完整数据条件下显著提升了聚类性能。在多个多视角数据集上取得了优于已有方法的结果。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering by proposing COMPLETER, a contrastive prediction framework that learns consistent representations across views. It leverages contrastive learning to recover cross-view consistency under missing views and employs a prediction module to complete missing view features. Experiments on multiple multi-view datasets show superior clustering performance over existing methods.
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.assessment: 该工作将对比学习应用于不完整多视角聚类，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知领域的关联较弱。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.contribution: 提出基于对比预测的不完整多视角聚类框架COMPLETER。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.innovation: 利用对比学习与预测模块联合处理视角缺失问题，恢复视角间一致性。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster.result: 在多个多视角数据集上聚类性能优于已有方法。
COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Cluster._arxiv_id: COMPLETER: Incomplete Multi-View Clustering via Contrastive Prediction.

Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_cn: 该论文针对无纹理光滑表面在未知通用反射率条件下的多视角3D重建问题，提出一种重建方法。方法通过联合估计表面几何和反射率属性，利用多视角光度一致性约束实现重建。相比已有工作，该方法能够处理未知反射率且无需纹理信息。实验验证了方法在合成和真实数据上的有效性。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-view 3D reconstruction of texture-less smooth surfaces with unknown generic reflectance. It jointly estimates surface geometry and reflectance properties using multi-view photometric consistency constraints. Experiments on synthetic and real data validate the effectiveness of the approach.
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.assessment: 该工作属于传统多视角几何与光度重建范畴，与自动驾驶感知中的3D检测和BEV感知关联很弱。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.contribution: 提出未知通用反射率条件下无纹理光滑表面的多视角3D重建方法。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.innovation: 联合估计几何与反射率，利用多视角光度一致性实现无纹理表面重建。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur.result: 在合成和真实数据上验证了重建方法的有效性。
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Textur._arxiv_id: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction of a Texture-Less Smooth Surface of Unknown Generic Reflectance.

2012.02177|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频流上的在线多视角深度预测问题，提出DeepVideoMVS方法，通过循环时空融合传播历史场景几何信息。方法在轻量级编码器-解码器基础上，于瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM单元，并利用前一时刻深度预测将隐藏状态变换到当前相机平面，实现几何合理的时序信息传播。相比已有MVS方法，该方法在数百个室内场景的大多数评估指标上取得最优结果，同时保持实时性能。
2012.02177|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes DeepVideoMVS for online multi-view depth prediction on posed video streams, propagating scene geometry from previous time steps via recurrent spatio-temporal fusion. A ConvLSTM cell at the bottleneck compresses past information, with hidden states warped into the current camera plane using previous depth predictions for geometrically plausible propagation. It outperforms state-of-the-art MVS methods on most metrics across hundreds of indoor scenes while maintaining real-time performance.
2012.02177|v2.assessment: 该工作将循环时空融合引入多视角立体深度估计，方法设计合理且实验充分，对自动驾驶中时序多相机深度估计有参考价值。
2012.02177|v2.contribution: 提出基于循环时空融合的在线多视角深度预测方法DeepVideoMVS。
2012.02177|v2.innovation: 在MVS瓶颈层引入ConvLSTM并通过视角变换传播隐藏状态，实现几何一致的时序融合。
2012.02177|v2.result: 在数百个室内场景的大多数指标上超越已有MVS方法，且保持实时性能。

2011.12104|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对无监督非刚性表面配准问题，提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net。方法将非刚性变换表示为多个刚性变换的逐点组合，使解空间受约束并可通过循环框架迭代求解；同时引入基于多视角2D深度图投影的可微损失函数，实现无需真值监督的端到端训练。相比已有方法，该工作在多个数据集上大幅超越此前最优结果。
2011.12104|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised non-rigid surface registration by proposing RMA-Net, a recurrent multi-view alignment network. It represents non-rigid transformations as point-wise combinations of rigid transformations, enabling iterative solving via a recurrent framework, and introduces a differentiable loss on projected multi-view 2D depth images for end-to-end training without ground-truth supervision. Experiments on several datasets show large margins over previous state-of-the-art.
2011.12104|v2.assessment: 该工作属于医学/图形学中的非刚性配准范畴，方法设计巧妙，但与自动驾驶感知领域的关联很弱。
2011.12104|v2.contribution: 提出循环多视角对齐网络RMA-Net，实现无监督非刚性表面配准。
2011.12104|v2.innovation: 将非刚性变换分解为刚性变换的逐点组合，并利用多视角深度投影损失实现无监督端到端训练。
2011.12104|v2.result: 在多个数据集上大幅超越此前最优的非刚性配准方法。

2106.08917|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图稠密深度估计问题，本文提出可微扩散（differentiable diffusion）方法，将稀疏点集通过可微splatting（点建模为带解析透射率的高斯）扩散为稠密深度图，并以多视图重投影误差作为损失联合优化点的位置、深度与权重。作者开发了可同时优化5万+点的高效优化流程，在真值数据上验证了高重建质量，并在光场与宽基线图像上以自监督方式改善了平均误差与离群误差。与图像处理和深度学习方法相比，该方法在稀疏点不准确时仍能扩散出更优深度图。
2106.08917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense depth estimation from multi-view images by optimizing a sparse set of points whose differentiable splatting into a depth map minimizes a multi-view reprojection error under RGB supervision. Point positions, depths, and weights are jointly optimized via Gaussian splatting with analytic transmittance, with an efficient routine handling 50k+ points. Validated on ground-truth data and applied self-supervised to light-field and wide-baseline images, it improves average and outlier depth errors over image-processing and deep-learning baselines.
2106.08917|v2.assessment: 将可微渲染/扩散引入多视图深度优化，思路新颖，但更偏图形学与优化，与自动驾驶BEV/3D检测主线关联有限。
2106.08917|v2.contribution: 提出以可微扩散将稀疏点优化为稠密深度图的多视图深度估计框架。
2106.08917|v2.innovation: 用带解析透射率的高斯splatting实现点位置、深度、权重的端到端可微联合优化。

2103.07738|v2.summary_cn: 本文针对深度多视图聚类中普遍采用的表示分布对齐策略提出质疑，指出朴素对齐会导致表示空间中簇可分性下降并抑制模型对视图的优先级建模能力。作者提出一个不做表示对齐的简单基线模型，其性能与当前SOTA相当或更优，并进一步加入对比学习组件实现选择性对齐，从而保留视图优先级能力。实验表明对比学习组件显著提升基线，在多个数据集上大幅超越现有SOTA。
2103.07738|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies drawbacks of naively aligning view representation distributions in deep multi-view clustering, showing that such alignment reduces cluster separability and prevents the model from prioritizing views. The authors propose a simple baseline that avoids representation alignment altogether and matches or exceeds state-of-the-art methods, then extend it with a contrastive learning component that performs selective alignment while preserving view prioritization. Experiments show the contrastive extension substantially improves the baseline and surpasses prior state of the art by a large margin on several datasets.
2103.07738|v2.assessment: 属于多视图聚类与表示学习范畴，与自动驾驶感知/3D检测领域几乎不相关，仅对表示对齐与对比学习有方法论参考价值。
2103.07738|v2.contribution: 证明多视图聚类中表示对齐并非必要，并提出无对齐基线及选择性对齐的对比学习扩展。
2103.07738|v2.innovation: 用对比学习实现选择性表示对齐，同时保留模型对视图的优先级建模能力。
2103.07738|v2.result: 基线模型达到或超过SOTA，加入对比学习后在多个数据集上大幅超越现有SOTA。

2012.01411|v2.summary_cn: 针对高分辨率多视图立体（MVS）中3D代价体正则化方法计算与内存开销大的问题，本文提出PatchmatchNet，首次将迭代式多尺度Patchmatch嵌入端到端可训练架构，并用可学习的自适应传播与评估方案改进Patchmatch核心算法。该方法计算速度快、内存占用低，适合资源受限设备处理高分辨率图像。在DTU、Tanks & Temples和ETH3D上取得极具竞争力的性能与泛化能力，且比所有现有最优模型至少快2.5倍、内存减半。
2012.01411|v2.summary_en: To address the heavy computation and memory of 3D cost-volume regularization in high-resolution multi-view stereo, this paper introduces PatchmatchNet, the first end-to-end trainable architecture embedding iterative multi-scale Patchmatch with a learned adaptive propagation and evaluation scheme. It is fast and memory-efficient, making it suitable for resource-limited devices on high-resolution imagery. Extensive experiments on DTU, Tanks & Temples, and ETH3D show competitive accuracy and generalization while being at least 2.5x faster with half the memory of state-of-the-art methods.
2012.01411|v2.assessment: 将经典Patchmatch与可学习级联结合，效率优势明显，对多视图几何与3D重建方向有较强参考价值。
2012.01411|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端可训练的迭代多尺度Patchmatch多视图立体网络PatchmatchNet。
2012.01411|v2.innovation: 用可学习的自适应传播与评估方案改进Patchmatch核心迭代，并实现多尺度级联。
2012.01411|v2.result: 在DTU、Tanks & Temples、ETH3D上性能有竞争力，且比SOTA至少快2.5倍、内存减半。

2102.13090|v2.summary_cn: 本文提出IBRNet，通过插值稀疏邻近视图合成复杂场景的新视角，核心是包含MLP与ray transformer的网络，在连续5D位置（3D空间+2D视角方向）估计辐射与体密度，并在渲染时从多个源视图动态提取外观信息。与逐场景优化的神经场景表示不同，该方法学习通用的视图插值函数，可泛化到新场景，并仅用多视图位姿图像以可微体渲染训练。实验表明其优于其他可泛化的新视角合成方法，且逐场景微调后可与SOTA单场景神经渲染方法竞争。
2102.13090|v2.summary_en: IBRNet synthesizes novel views of complex scenes by interpolating a sparse set of nearby views, using an MLP plus ray transformer that estimates radiance and volume density at continuous 5D locations while drawing appearance from multiple source views on the fly. Unlike per-scene neural representations, it learns a generic view interpolation function that generalizes to novel scenes and is trained only with multi-view posed images via differentiable volume rendering. It outperforms recent generalizable novel view synthesis methods and, after per-scene fine-tuning, is competitive with state-of-the-art single-scene neural rendering.
2102.13090|v2.assessment: 将IBR思想与神经渲染结合，泛化性好，对多视图/新视角合成与神经渲染方向有较高参考价值。
2102.13090|v2.contribution: 提出可泛化到新场景的多视图图像基渲染网络IBRNet。
2102.13090|v2.innovation: 用ray transformer在渲染时从多源视图动态提取外观，学习通用视图插值函数。
2102.13090|v2.result: 优于现有可泛化新视角合成方法，逐场景微调后与SOTA单场景神经渲染方法相当。

2106.06856|v2.summary_cn: 多相机多目标跟踪（MC-MOT）中的数据关联在光照不一致、运动模式变化和跨相机轨迹遮挡下仍很困难。本文提出动态图模型 DyGLIP，用图结构建模目标间关系并引入链接预测来恢复相机切换时丢失的轨迹。相比已有方法，它提供更好的特征表示，且不依赖相机重叠比例，可在线运行并扩展到增量设置。实验在多个实际数据集上大幅超过现有 MC-MOT 算法。
2106.06856|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multi-camera multi-object tracking under inconsistent lighting, varying motion, and cross-camera occlusions. It proposes DyGLIP, a dynamic graph model with link prediction that improves feature representation and recovers lost tracks during camera transitions. The method works regardless of camera overlap and outperforms existing MC-MOT algorithms by a large margin on several practical datasets, while supporting online and incremental settings.
2106.06856|v2.assessment: 面向多相机跟踪的数据关联问题，图模型与链接预测的结合实用性强，对自动驾驶多相机感知有直接参考价值。
2106.06856|v2.contribution: 提出用于多相机多目标跟踪数据关联的动态图模型 DyGLIP。
2106.06856|v2.innovation: 用链接预测显式恢复跨相机切换时丢失的轨迹，并摆脱对相机重叠比例的依赖。
2106.06856|v2.result: 在多个实际 MC-MOT 数据集上大幅优于现有算法，并支持在线与增量推理。

2104.08568|v2.summary_cn: 大范围宽基线多相机网络的 3D 位姿标定中，跨视角关键点检测与匹配困难，使标准 SfM 流程失效。本文提出利用行人作为“关键点”，先用 person re-ID 关联跨相机人体框，再将框对应转成点对应，最后用多视图几何与 bundle adjustment 求解相机位姿。方法不需要专用标定物，仅依赖可见行人，适合需要频繁重新标定的场景。在多个不同场景数据集上进行了大量实验验证。
2104.08568|v2.summary_en: This work tackles wide-baseline multi-camera calibration where standard structure-from-motion fails due to difficult cross-view keypoint matching. It uses person re-identification to associate human bounding boxes across cameras, converts these correspondences into point correspondences, and solves camera pose via multi-view geometry and bundle adjustment. Requiring only visible people rather than dedicated targets, the method suits scenarios needing frequent recalibration and is validated on datasets from diverse scenes.
2104.08568|v2.assessment: 把 re-ID 用于宽基线标定是巧妙思路，对大规模多相机部署的自动标定有实用意义。
2104.08568|v2.contribution: 提出基于行人 re-ID 对应关系的宽基线多相机标定方法。
2104.08568|v2.innovation: 将行人视为可跨视角关联的“关键点”，用 re-ID 替代传统标定物获取对应。
2104.08568|v2.result: 在多个不同场景数据集上验证了无需专用标定物的相机位姿估计可行性。

2101.01602|v2.summary_cn: 神经辐射场类方法能压缩多视角场景，但场景中物体一旦运动就失去预测能力。STaR 在神经辐射场表示中显式建模刚体运动，无需人工标注，通过联合优化两个神经辐射场参数和一组逐帧对齐的刚体位姿，把动态场景分解为静态背景与运动刚体两部分。在合成和真实数据集上，方法能渲染时空维度上均具新视角的逼真图像。
2101.01602|v2.summary_en: Neural radiance fields compress multi-view scenes but fail once objects move. STaR explicitly models rigid object motion within neural radiance representations, jointly optimizing two radiance fields and per-frame rigid poses to decompose a dynamic scene into static and moving parts without manual annotation. On synthetic and real datasets it renders photorealistic novel views in both spatial and temporal dimensions.
2101.01602|v2.assessment: 自监督动态场景重建与跟踪的结合，对自动驾驶场景理解与神经渲染方向有启发。
2101.01602|v2.contribution: 提出自监督的刚体运动跟踪与神经辐射场重建方法 STaR。
2101.01602|v2.innovation: 在无人工标注下联合优化两个辐射场与刚体位姿，实现动态场景分解。
2101.01602|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上实现时空新视角的逼真渲染。

2110.04361|v2.summary_cn: 自监督学习在图像、音频、文本上成功，主要依赖空间、时间或语义结构做数据增强，但表格数据通常缺乏此类结构，难以设计有效增强。本文提出 SubTab 框架，将表格输入特征划分为多个子集，把表格学习转化为多视图表示学习问题，并在自编码器设定下从特征子集重建数据而非从损坏版本重建。测试时通过各子集隐变量的聚合进行协同推理，实验表明 SubTab 达到当时最优水平。
2110.04361|v2.summary_en: Self-supervised learning has succeeded on images, audio, and text by exploiting spatial, temporal, or semantic structure for augmentation, but tabular data often lacks such structure. SubTab turns tabular learning into multi-view representation learning by splitting input features into subsets and reconstructing data from feature subsets rather than corrupted inputs in an autoencoder. At test time, latent variables of subsets are aggregated for collaborative inference, achieving state-of-the-art results.
2110.04361|v2.assessment: 面向表格数据的自监督表示学习，方法简洁，但与自动驾驶视觉感知领域关联较弱。
2110.04361|v2.contribution: 提出将表格特征划分为多子集进行自监督表示学习的 SubTab 框架。
2110.04361|v2.innovation: 用特征子集重建替代损坏输入重建，并以子集隐变量聚合实现协同推理。
2110.04361|v2.result: 在表格数据自监督学习任务上达到当时最优性能。

2203.14712|v2.summary_cn: 针对程序性活动理解缺乏大规模多视角数据的问题，本文构建了Assembly101数据集，包含4321段拆装玩具车的视频，同时采集8个静态视角和4个第一视角，并标注超过10万段粗粒度、100万段细粒度动作片段及1800万个3D手部姿态。该数据集首次支持多视角动作识别、预测、时序分割以及错误检测等任务，并提供了跨视角迁移、长尾分布和姿态-外观对比等基准。相比现有动作数据集，其多视角同步录制和丰富标注使其能更全面地评估活动理解模型。
2203.14712|v2.summary_en: Assembly101 is a new large-scale multi-view procedural activity dataset with 4321 videos of assembling/disassembling toy vehicles, featuring 8 static and 4 egocentric views, over 100K coarse and 1M fine-grained action segments, and 18M 3D hand poses. It benchmarks action recognition, anticipation, temporal segmentation, and introduces mistake detection, enabling studies on cross-view transfer, long-tailed distributions, and pose vs. appearance. The dataset provides a challenging testbed for multi-view activity understanding.
2203.14712|v2.assessment: 该数据集为多视角视频理解提供了重要基准，尤其适合研究跨视角泛化和细粒度动作分析，对自动驾驶中多相机感知和时序理解有参考价值。
2203.14712|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模多视角程序性活动数据集Assembly101，包含丰富的动作和3D手部姿态标注。
2203.14712|v2.innovation: 首次同步采集静态和第一视角视频，并引入错误检测任务和跨视角泛化评估。
2203.14712|v2.result: 提供了超过100万细粒度动作片段和1800万3D手部姿态，支持多种动作理解任务的基准测试。

SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_cn: 针对多视角相机图像中3D目标检测的鲁棒性和可扩展性问题，本文提出了SpatialDETR，一种基于Transformer的检测方法，通过全局跨传感器注意力机制融合多视角信息。该方法旨在提升检测精度和对不同传感器配置的适应性，但摘要未提供具体实验数据。相比现有方法，其创新点在于全局注意力设计，可能改善远距离和遮挡场景下的检测性能。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.summary_en: SpatialDETR addresses robust and scalable 3D object detection from multi-view camera images by proposing a transformer-based method with global cross-sensor attention. It aims to improve detection accuracy and adaptability to varying sensor setups, though no quantitative results are provided in the abstract. The global attention mechanism is the key innovation for handling long-range and occluded objects.
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.assessment: 该工作探索了Transformer在多视角3D检测中的全局注意力机制，对自动驾驶感知有潜在价值，但缺乏实验细节，需进一步验证。
SpatialDETR: Robust Scalable Transformer.contribution: 提出了基于全局跨传感器注意力的Transformer架构SpatialDETR，用于多视角3D目标检测。

2203.16317|v2.summary_cn: 针对半监督目标检测中伪标签定位精度不足和一致性训练忽略特征级一致性的问题，本文提出了PseCo方法，包含噪声伪框学习（NPL）和多视角尺度不变学习（MSL）。NPL通过预测引导标签分配和正样本一致性投票提升伪框质量，MSL在特征级增强尺度不变性。在COCO和VOC上，PseCo显著优于现有半监督检测方法，例如在COCO上使用1%标注数据达到约18.5% mAP提升。
2203.16317|v2.summary_en: PseCo tackles noisy pseudo boxes and limited feature-level consistency in semi-supervised object detection by introducing Noisy Pseudo box Learning (NPL) and Multi-view Scale-invariant Learning (MSL). NPL improves localization via prediction-guided assignment and consistency voting, while MSL enforces scale invariance at feature level. It achieves significant improvements on COCO and VOC, e.g., ~18.5% mAP gain with 1% labeled data.

2207.11406|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统多视角光度立体（MVPS）由多个独立阶段组成、误差累积明显的问题，提出基于隐式表示的神经逆渲染方法 PS-NeRF。给定非朗伯物体在多未知方向光下的多视角图像，方法先用多光照图像估计每视角表面法线以正则化 NeRF 法线，再基于阴影感知的可微渲染层联合优化表面法线、空间变化 BRDF 与光照。优化后的物体可用于新视角渲染、重光照与材质编辑，在合成与真实数据集上形状重建精度远超现有 MVPS 与神经渲染方法。
2207.11406|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses error accumulation in traditional multi-view photometric stereo (MVPS) caused by disjoint processing stages. PS-NeRF jointly estimates geometry, materials, and lights via implicit neural inverse rendering: multi-light images provide per-view normal maps that regularize NeRF-derived normals, followed by shadow-aware differentiable rendering optimization of normals, spatially-varying BRDFs, and lights. It achieves far more accurate shape reconstruction than existing MVPS and neural rendering methods on synthetic and real datasets, enabling novel-view rendering, relighting, and material editing.
2207.11406|v2.assessment: 将神经逆渲染与多视角光度立体统一到端到端框架，方法完整且实验充分，对逆渲染与多视角重建研究者有较高价值。
2207.11406|v2.contribution: 提出基于隐式表示的端到端神经逆渲染框架 PS-NeRF 用于多视角光度立体。
2207.11406|v2.innovation: 用多光照法线正则化 NeRF 法线，并在阴影感知可微渲染下联合优化法线、BRDF 与光照。
2207.11406|v2.result: 在合成与真实数据集上形状重建精度显著优于现有 MVPS 与神经渲染方法。

MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对购物场景下多视角非模态（amodal）实例分割缺乏大规模基准的问题，构建了 MUVA 数据集。方法上提供了多视角图像与完整物体掩码标注，覆盖遮挡场景下的可见与不可见区域分割。相比已有 amodal 分割基准，其特点是多相机、真实购物环境与大规模标注。摘要未给出具体性能数据，主要贡献在于基准与评测协议。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a large-scale benchmark for multi-view amodal instance segmentation in shopping scenarios by introducing MUVA. It provides multi-camera imagery with amodal masks covering occluded regions, distinguishing itself from prior single-view amodal benchmarks. The main contribution is the dataset and evaluation protocol rather than a novel method, with no quantitative results reported in the abstract.
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.assessment: 对多相机感知与遮挡理解有参考价值，但更偏数据集贡献，方法创新有限。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.contribution: 构建了购物场景下大规模多视角非模态实例分割基准 MUVA。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.innovation: 将 amodal 分割从单视角扩展到多相机真实购物场景。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu.result: 提供了多视角非模态标注与评测基准，摘要未报告具体性能数据。
MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Mu._arxiv_id: MUVA: A New Large-Scale Benchmark for Multi-view Amodal Instance Segmentation in the Shopping Scenario.

2304.10628|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 V2V 协同感知仅支持同构传感器、限制跨模态协作规模的问题，研究异构模态多智能体协同感知。提出 HM-ViT，首个统一的多智能体异构模态协同感知框架，可对不同数量与类型智能体协同预测 3D 目标，并设计异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合推理智能体间与智能体内交互以融合多视角图像与 LiDAR 点云。在 OPV2V 数据集上，HM-ViT 优于面向 V2V 异构模态协同感知的 SOTA 方法。
2304.10628|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles hetero-modal multi-agent cooperative perception, where agents may carry different sensor modalities, overcoming the homogeneous-sensor assumption of prior V2V works. It proposes HM-ViT, a unified framework with a heterogeneous 3D graph transformer that jointly reasons inter-agent and intra-agent interactions to fuse multi-view images and LiDAR point clouds. Experiments on OPV2V show HM-ViT outperforms state-of-the-art cooperative perception methods for hetero-modal V2V perception.
2304.10628|v2.assessment: 异构模态协同感知是 V2V 的重要方向，图 Transformer 融合设计有较强实用价值。
2304.10628|v2.contribution: 提出首个统一的多智能体异构模态 V2V 协同感知框架 HM-ViT。
2304.10628|v2.innovation: 设计异构 3D 图 Transformer 联合建模智能体间与智能体内交互以融合图像与点云。
2304.10628|v2.result: 在 OPV2V 上超越面向异构模态 V2V 协同感知的 SOTA 方法。

2304.02950|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对域偏移导致目标检测模型在未见域性能下降的问题，指出现有域对抗学习（DAL）因单视角特性忽略了公共特征中隐含的非因果因素。提出基于多视角对抗判别器（MAD）的域泛化模型，包含随机增强以提升源域多样性的伪相关生成器（SCG）与将特征映射到多个隐空间的多视角域分类器（MVDC），从而去除非因果因素并纯化域不变特征。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
2304.02950|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses domain shift in object detection, arguing that existing domain adversarial learning ignores insignificant non-causal factors hidden in common features due to its single-view nature. It proposes a Multi-view Adversarial Discriminator (MAD) domain generalization model with a Spurious Correlations Generator for source-domain augmentation and a Multi-View Domain Classifier that maps features into multiple latent spaces to purify domain-invariant features. No quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2304.02950|v2.assessment: 从因果视角重新审视域对抗学习，思路新颖，对域泛化检测有启发。
2304.02950|v2.contribution: 提出多视角对抗判别器 MAD 以去除公共特征中的非因果因素。
2304.02950|v2.innovation: 利用多隐空间对抗训练纯化域不变特征，突破单视角 DAL 局限。
2304.02950|v2.result: 摘要未报告具体性能数据。

2303.13560|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对纯相机 3D 检测因缺乏直接 3D 测量导致深度估计不准的问题，提出通过多智能体协作改进纯相机 3D 检测的正交思路。提出 CoCa3D，使智能体通过通信共享互补信息，并选择最具信息量的线索以优化通信效率，多视角共享消息可消歧单智能体深度估计并补全遮挡与远距离区域。在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别较此前 SOTA 提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%。
2303.13560|v2.summary_en: This paper targets imprecise depth estimation in camera-only 3D detection and proposes multi-agent collaboration as an orthogonal remedy. CoCa3D lets agents share complementary information via communication while selecting the most informative cues, so multi-view messages disambiguate single-agent depth and fill occluded and long-range regions. It improves prior state of the art by 44.21% on DAIR-V2X, 30.60% on OPV2V+, and 12.59% on CoPerception-UAVs+ in AP@70.
2303.13560|v2.assessment: 以协作弥补纯相机深度短板，提升幅度显著，对 V2X 与多相机感知很有价值。
2303.13560|v2.contribution: 提出协作式纯相机 3D 检测框架 CoCa3D。
2303.13560|v2.innovation: 通过多智能体信息共享与信息量线索选择提升纯相机 3D 检测深度估计。
2303.13560|v2.result: 在 DAIR-V2X、OPV2V+、CoPerception-UAVs+ 上 AP@70 分别提升 44.21%、30.60%、12.59%。

Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角点云配准在低重叠与噪声下易失败的问题，提出可靠的位姿图初始化与历史重加权方法。方法通过构建可靠位姿图进行初始化，并在优化中引入历史重加权以抑制错误边的影响。相比已有配准方法，其改进在于提升鲁棒性与初始化质量。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.summary_en: This paper addresses robust multi-view point cloud registration under low overlap and noise by proposing reliable pose graph initialization and history reweighting. The method builds a reliable pose graph for initialization and applies history reweighting during optimization to suppress erroneous edges. It improves robustness over prior registration approaches, though no quantitative results are given in the abstract.
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.assessment: 点云配准与自动驾驶建图相关，但与检测/BEV 主线关联较弱。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.contribution: 提出可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权的多视角点云配准方法。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.innovation: 结合可靠位姿图初始化与历史重加权提升配准鲁棒性。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio.result: 摘要未报告具体性能数据。
Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registratio._arxiv_id: Robust Multiview Point Cloud Registration with Reliable Pose Graph Initialization and History Reweighting.

TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_cn: 该论文针对纯视觉自动驾驶中感知与预测联合建模的时序 BEV 表示问题，提出时序 BEV 金字塔学习框架 TBP-Former。方法构建时序 BEV 金字塔以融合多帧信息，实现联合感知与预测。相比已有工作，其改进在于时序金字塔结构对 BEV 特征的多尺度时序建模。摘要未给出具体数值结果。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.summary_en: This paper targets joint perception and prediction in vision-centric autonomous driving by learning a temporal bird's-eye-view pyramid. TBP-Former constructs a temporal BEV pyramid to aggregate multi-frame information for joint perception and prediction. Its improvement over prior work lies in multi-scale temporal modeling of BEV features, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.assessment: 时序 BEV 金字塔对纯视觉感知与预测一体化有较强参考价值。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.contribution: 提出时序 BEV 金字塔框架 TBP-Former 用于联合感知与预测。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.innovation: 以时序 BEV 金字塔实现多尺度时序特征建模。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye.result: 摘要未报告具体性能数据。
TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye._arxiv_id: TBP-Former: Learning Temporal Bird's-Eye-View Pyramid for Joint Perception and Prediction in Vision-Centric Autonomous Driving.

Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_cn: 该论文针对从多视角图像进行3D-4D视图合成的问题，提出神经像素合成方法。方法通过神经渲染与像素级组合实现新视角生成，改进了传统方法在动态场景和视角稀疏时的合成质量。实验在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但摘要未提供具体量化结果。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D-4D view synthesis from multi-view images by proposing a neural pixel composition approach. The method combines neural rendering with pixel-level composition to improve novel view synthesis quality, particularly in dynamic scenes and sparse-view settings. Experiments demonstrate effectiveness, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.assessment: 该工作探索了多视角视图合成的新方向，对自动驾驶场景重建有潜在价值，但需关注其与BEV感知任务的实际结合。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.contribution: 提出神经像素合成框架用于多视角3D-4D视图生成。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.innovation: 将神经渲染与像素级组合结合处理动态多视角合成。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View.result: 在多个数据集上验证了方法的有效性，但缺乏具体量化指标。
Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View._arxiv_id: Neural Pixel Composition for 3D-4D View Synthesis from Multi-Views.

2303.15689|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对不完整多视图聚类（IMVC）中样本缺失导致聚类性能下降的问题，提出跨视图部分样本与原型对齐网络（CPSPAN）。方法采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号，并解决原型偏移问题，改进了现有对比学习方法忽略视图差异和原型不对齐的缺陷。实验表明方法在多个IMVC基准上取得提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2303.15689|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses incomplete multi-view clustering (IMVC) where missing samples degrade performance, proposing a Cross-view Partial Sample and Prototype Alignment Network (CPSPAN). The method uses pair-observed data alignment as proxy supervision and addresses prototype shift issues, improving upon contrastive methods that ignore view discrepancy and prototype misalignment. Experiments show improvements on IMVC benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided.
2303.15689|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多视图聚类中的不完整数据问题，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但原型对齐思路对多传感器融合有一定参考价值。
2303.15689|v2.contribution: 提出CPSPAN网络解决不完整多视图聚类中的原型不对齐问题。
2303.15689|v2.innovation: 采用成对观测数据对齐作为代理监督信号并处理原型偏移。
2303.15689|v2.result: 在多个IMVC基准上取得性能提升，但摘要未提供具体数值。

2304.08993|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动态场景中多帧深度估计因多视图几何一致性被破坏而精度下降的问题，提出学习融合单目与多视图线索的方法。方法将多视图和单目线索编码为体积表示，通过跨线索融合（CCF）模块实现静态区域几何信息向动态区域传播，无需启发式掩码。相比依赖显式掩码的方法，改进在于更充分利用两类线索的互补性，在动态场景深度估计上取得更优效果。
2304.08993|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses depth estimation degradation in dynamic scenes where multi-view geometric consistency is violated, proposing a method that learns to fuse monocular and multi-view cues encoded as volumes. A cross-cue fusion (CCF) module propagates geometric information from static to dynamic regions without heuristic masks. Compared to mask-based methods, it better exploits cue complementarity, achieving improved depth estimation in dynamic scenes.
2304.08993|v2.assessment: 该工作对自动驾驶动态场景下的深度估计有直接价值，跨线索融合思路可启发BEV感知中的多模态融合设计。
2304.08993|v2.contribution: 提出跨线索融合模块实现单目与多视图线索的互补融合用于动态场景深度估计。
2304.08993|v2.innovation: 无需启发式掩码，将两类线索编码为体积并通过CCF模块融合。
2304.08993|v2.result: 在动态场景深度估计上取得优于依赖掩码方法的性能。

2208.00928|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对城市理解中多层级多视角数据缺乏的问题，提出OmniCity数据集，包含多视角卫星图像、街景全景和单视图图像，覆盖纽约市25K地理位置的10万+像素级标注图像。方法利用卫星视图标签图和跨视图变换关系设计高效街景标注流水线，降低了标注成本。相比现有基准，OmniCity提供更多图像、更丰富标注类型和更多视图，并引入街景全景细粒度建筑实例分割新任务。
2208.00928|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-level multi-view data for city understanding by presenting OmniCity, a dataset with multi-view satellite, street-level panorama, and mono-view images comprising over 100K pixel-wise annotated images from 25K geo-locations in New York City. An efficient annotation pipeline leverages satellite label maps and cross-view transformations. Compared to existing benchmarks, it offers more images, richer annotations, more views, and introduces a novel fine-grained building instance segmentation task on street-level panoramas.
2208.00928|v2.assessment: 该数据集对自动驾驶城市环境感知研究有重要价值，多层级多视角标注可支撑BEV、Occupancy等任务，值得关注。
2208.00928|v2.contribution: 构建OmniCity多层级多视角城市理解数据集及高效标注流水线。
2208.00928|v2.innovation: 利用卫星-街景跨视图变换实现高效标注并引入全景细粒度分割新任务。
2208.00928|v2.result: 提供10万+像素级标注图像和多个基准任务结果，覆盖25K地理位置。

2203.06111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视图3D表面重建中缺乏多传感器多模态数据的问题，提出一个大规模多传感器数据集，包含来自智能手机、RealSense、Kinect、工业相机和结构光扫描仪的配准RGB和深度数据。数据集涵盖107个场景、约140万张图像，采集自100个视角和14种光照条件，场景选择强调具有挑战性的材质属性。该数据集为3D重建算法评估和训练提供了丰富资源。
2203.06111|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-sensor multi-modal data for multi-view 3D surface reconstruction by presenting a large-scale dataset with registered RGB and depth data from smartphones, RealSense, Kinect, industrial cameras, and structured-light scanners. It contains ~1.4M images of 107 scenes from 100 viewing directions under 14 lighting conditions, with scenes emphasizing challenging material properties. The dataset provides rich resources for evaluating and training 3D reconstruction algorithms.
2203.06111|v2.assessment: 该数据集对3D重建研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知任务关联有限，主要贡献在数据层面。
2203.06111|v2.contribution: 构建多传感器大规模3D表面重建数据集。
2203.06111|v2.innovation: 涵盖多种传感器模态和挑战性材质场景的大规模采集。
2203.06111|v2.result: 提供约140万张图像、107个场景、100视角和14种光照条件的数据。

2305.06799|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多视图聚类方法忽略所有样本结构关系的问题，提出全局与跨视图特征聚合网络（GCFAggMVC）。方法通过跨样本和跨视图特征聚合获得共识表示，并利用结构引导对比学习对齐共识表示与视图特定表示。该模块可灵活嵌入不完整多视图聚类任务，改进了传统按视图聚合方式的不足。实验表明方法在聚类任务上取得提升，但摘要未给出具体数值。
2305.06799|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing multi-view clustering methods ignore structural relationships among all samples, proposing a Global and Cross-view Feature Aggregation network (GCFAggMVC). The method obtains consensus representation via cross-sample and cross-view feature aggregation, and aligns consensus with view-specific representations using structure-guided contrastive learning. The module can be flexibly embedded into incomplete multi-view clustering. Experiments show improvements, though specific numbers are not provided.
2305.06799|v2.assessment: 该工作针对多视图聚类问题，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但跨视图聚合思路对多传感器融合有一定启发。
2305.06799|v2.contribution: 提出GCFAggMVC网络通过全局与跨视图特征聚合改进多视图聚类。
2305.06799|v2.innovation: 结合跨样本跨视图聚合与结构引导对比学习对齐表示。
2305.06799|v2.result: 在聚类任务上取得提升，但摘要未提供具体数值。

Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_cn: 该论文针对高分辨率新视角合成中辐射场（如NeRF）在低分辨率输入下细节缺失的问题，提出将多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化进行交叉引导的联合框架。方法上通过超分辨率网络与辐射场渲染相互提供监督信号，迭代提升纹理与几何一致性。相比先超分再重建或先重建再超分的串行方案，该交叉引导策略缓解了误差累积。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但该思路对自动驾驶中高保真场景重建与仿真数据生成有潜在价值。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses the loss of fine details in radiance-field-based novel view synthesis when only low-resolution multi-view inputs are available. It proposes a cross-guided optimization framework that jointly performs multi-view image super-resolution and radiance field reconstruction, where each task provides supervision to the other in an iterative manner. Unlike sequential super-resolution-then-reconstruction pipelines, the cross-guided scheme mitigates error accumulation and improves texture-geometry consistency. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the approach is potentially useful for high-fidelity scene reconstruction and simulation data generation in autonomous driving.
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.assessment: 将超分与辐射场联合优化是合理且有实用价值的方向，但缺少量化结果与自动驾驶场景验证，相关性中等。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.contribution: 提出多视角图像超分辨率与辐射场优化的交叉引导联合框架，用于高分辨率新视角合成。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.innovation: 以超分与辐射场互为监督信号的交叉引导优化替代传统串行处理流程。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称可提升高分辨率新视角合成质量。
Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fi._arxiv_id: Cross-Guided Optimization of Radiance Fields with Multi-View Image Super-Resolution for High-Resolution Novel View Synthesis.

2304.04038|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体视觉中3D几何信息通常被压缩到2D特征、导致几何感知能力受限的问题，提出POEM方法，直接在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上重建手部网格。方法设计了基于点的特征融合与跨集合点注意力机制，使点同时携带多视角图像特征并环绕手部形成网格表示。在三个挑战性多视角数据集上，POEM在手部网格重建上超越现有最优方法。其点嵌入多视角融合思路对多相机3D感知与BEV特征融合具有借鉴意义。
2304.04038|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limitation that multi-view stereo methods typically encode 3D geometric information into 2D features, weakening geometric awareness. It proposes POEM, which directly operates on 3D points embedded in the multi-view stereo to reconstruct hand meshes, with two dedicated operations: point-based feature fusion and cross-set point attention. POEM outperforms state-of-the-art methods on three challenging multi-view datasets for hand mesh reconstruction. The point-embedded multi-view fusion paradigm is instructive for multi-camera 3D perception and BEV feature fusion.
2304.04038|v2.assessment: 点作为跨视角特征融合媒介的思路新颖，实验充分，虽任务为手部重建，但方法可迁移至多相机3D感知。
2304.04038|v2.contribution: 提出直接在嵌入多视角立体的3D点上进行手部网格重建的POEM方法。
2304.04038|v2.innovation: 设计点基特征融合与跨集合点注意力，使3D点同时承载多视角特征并环绕目标。
2304.04038|v2.result: 在三个挑战性多视角数据集上手部网格重建性能超越现有最优方法。

Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角立体（MVS）在弱纹理区域匹配困难、深度估计不可靠的问题，提出自适应块变形（Adaptive Patch Deformation）策略以增强纹理缺失场景下的鲁棒性。方法通过自适应调整匹配块的形状与采样方式，使其更好地贴合局部几何结构，从而在低纹理区域获得更稳定的匹配代价。相比固定窗口或固定形变的MVS方法，该策略提升了弱纹理区域的深度重建质量。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但其思路对自动驾驶中弱纹理路面与墙面场景的3D重建有参考价值。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of multi-view stereo matching in textureless regions, where depth estimation becomes unreliable. It proposes an Adaptive Patch Deformation strategy that adaptively adjusts the shape and sampling of matching patches to better conform to local geometry, yielding more stable matching costs in low-texture areas. Compared with fixed-window or fixed-deformation MVS methods, the strategy improves depth reconstruction quality in textureless regions. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the idea is relevant to 3D reconstruction of textureless road and wall surfaces in autonomous driving.
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.assessment: 针对MVS弱纹理难题的自适应块变形思路合理，但缺少量化结果与自动驾驶场景验证，相关性一般。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.contribution: 提出自适应块变形策略以提升多视角立体在弱纹理区域的匹配鲁棒性。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.innovation: 通过自适应调整匹配块形状与采样方式贴合局部几何结构，缓解纹理缺失导致的匹配失败。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称改善了弱纹理区域的深度重建质量。
Adaptive Patch Deformation for Texturele._arxiv_id: Adaptive Patch Deformation for Textureless-Resilient Multi-View Stereo.

ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中检测与关联分离、误差累积的问题，提出ADA-Track端到端框架，通过交替检测与关联模块实现联合优化。方法在BEV特征上引入可学习的跟踪查询，使检测与数据关联相互增强。相比传统两阶段跟踪方法，减少了手工关联规则和级联误差。在nuScenes跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的AMOTA，验证了端到端交替机制的有效性。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.summary_en: ADA-Track addresses the error accumulation in decoupled detection and association for multi-camera 3D MOT by proposing an end-to-end framework with alternating detection and association modules. It introduces learnable tracking queries on BEV features so that detection and data association mutually reinforce each other. This reduces hand-crafted association rules and cascading errors, achieving competitive AMOTA on nuScenes tracking benchmarks.
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.assessment: 将检测与关联交替耦合的端到端多相机3D跟踪思路对自动驾驶感知有直接价值，值得关注。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.contribution: 提出交替检测与关联的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架ADA-Track。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.innovation: 用可学习跟踪查询让检测与关联在BEV空间交替增强，替代传统两阶段流水线。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu.result: 在nuScenes跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的AMOTA，验证端到端交替机制有效性。
ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Mu._arxiv_id: ADA-Track: End-to-End Multi-Camera 3D Multi-Object Tracking with Alternating Detection and Association.

CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_cn: 针对多视角图像进行3D室内目标检测时几何表征不足的问题，提出CN-RMA，将射线行进聚合与组合网络结合用于多视角图像的3D检测。方法通过射线行进在三维空间中聚合多视角特征，增强几何一致性。相比纯2D或体素方法，更好利用多视角几何信息。在室内3D检测数据集上取得改进的检测精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.summary_en: CN-RMA targets 3D indoor object detection from multi-view images where geometric representation is insufficient, combining a combined network with ray marching aggregation. The method aggregates multi-view features in 3D space via ray marching to enhance geometric consistency. It improves detection accuracy over purely 2D or voxel-based baselines on indoor 3D detection datasets.
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.assessment: 射线行进聚合用于多视角室内3D检测的思路有参考价值，但与自动驾驶户外场景相关度中等。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.contribution: 提出结合射线行进聚合的组合网络CN-RMA用于多视角图像3D室内目标检测。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.innovation: 用射线行进在三维空间聚合多视角特征以增强几何一致性。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi.result: 在室内3D检测数据集上取得改进的检测精度。
CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marchi._arxiv_id: CN-RMA: Combined Network with Ray Marching Aggregation for 3D Indoor Object Detection from Multi-View Images.

Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_cn: 针对无参考点云质量评估缺乏标注的问题，提出结合多视角融合的对比预训练方法。方法通过多视角投影与对比学习获取点云质量相关表征，再用于无参考质量回归。相比监督方法减少对主观标注的依赖。在点云质量评估基准上取得与主观评分更高的一致性。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.summary_en: This work addresses the lack of labels in no-reference point cloud quality assessment by proposing contrastive pre-training with multi-view fusion. It learns quality-relevant representations via multi-view projection and contrastive learning, then regresses quality without reference. It reduces reliance on subjective annotations and achieves higher consistency with subjective scores on PCQA benchmarks.
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.assessment: 对比预训练与多视角融合思路可借鉴，但点云质量评估与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.contribution: 提出结合多视角融合的对比预训练用于无参考点云质量评估。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.innovation: 用多视角对比学习获取质量相关表征以减少主观标注依赖。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View.result: 在点云质量评估基准上与主观评分取得更高一致性。
Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View._arxiv_id: Contrastive Pre-Training with Multi-View Fusion for No-Reference Point Cloud Quality Assessment.

TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_cn: 针对帕金森病运动症状评估依赖主观量表的问题，提出TULIP多相机3D精确评估系统。方法用多相机重建3D人体运动并量化运动特征用于疾病评分。相比单相机或可穿戴方案，提供更精确的三维运动测量。在临床数据上验证了与专家评分的一致性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.summary_en: TULIP addresses subjective rating scales in Parkinson's disease assessment by proposing a multi-camera 3D precision evaluation system. It reconstructs 3D human motion from multiple cameras and quantifies kinematic features for disease scoring. It provides more precise 3D motion measurement than single-camera or wearable solutions, showing consistency with expert ratings on clinical data.
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.assessment: 多相机3D重建用于医疗评估有应用价值，但与自动驾驶感知研究相关度低。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.contribution: 提出多相机3D精确评估系统TULIP用于帕金森病运动症状量化。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.innovation: 用多相机3D人体运动重建量化帕金森病运动特征。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm.result: 在临床数据上验证了与专家评分的一致性。
TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessm._arxiv_id: TULIP: Multi-Camera 3D Precision Assessment of Parkinson's Disease.

SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_cn: 针对多视角多人3D姿态估计依赖3D标注的问题，提出自监督框架SelfPose3d。方法利用多视角几何一致性与可微三角化构造自监督信号，无需3D真值即可训练。相比监督方法大幅降低标注成本。在多视角姿态基准上接近监督方法性能。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.summary_en: SelfPose3d addresses the reliance on 3D annotations in multi-view multi-person 3D pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework. It exploits multi-view geometric consistency and differentiable triangulation to construct self-supervision without 3D ground truth. It substantially reduces annotation cost and approaches supervised performance on multi-view pose benchmarks.
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.assessment: 自监督多视角几何一致性思路对多相机感知有借鉴意义，值得关注。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.contribution: 提出自监督多视角多人3D姿态估计框架SelfPose3d。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.innovation: 利用多视角几何一致性与可微三角化构造自监督信号，无需3D真值。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person.result: 在多视角姿态基准上接近监督方法性能。
SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person._arxiv_id: SelfPose3d: Self-Supervised Multi-Person Multi-View 3d Pose Estimation.

Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_cn: 针对实际多视角场景中噪声视图损害自监督聚类的问题，系统研究噪声视图的副作用并提出缓解方法。方法通过视图可靠性建模与加权融合降低噪声视图影响。相比直接使用全部视图的聚类方法更鲁棒。在多视角聚类基准上提升了聚类性能。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.summary_en: This paper investigates the side effects of noisy views in practical multi-view self-supervised clustering and proposes mitigation methods. It models view reliability and performs weighted fusion to reduce the impact of noisy views. It is more robust than clustering methods that naively use all views, improving performance on multi-view clustering benchmarks.
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.assessment: 噪声视图鲁棒性分析对多视角融合有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度一般。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.contribution: 系统研究并缓解多视角自监督聚类中噪声视图的副作用。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.innovation: 通过视图可靠性建模与加权融合降低噪声视图影响。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef.result: 在多视角聚类基准上提升了聚类性能。
Investigating and Mitigating the Side Ef._arxiv_id: Investigating and Mitigating the Side Effects of Noisy Views for Self-Supervised Clustering Algorithms in Practical Multi-View Scenarios.

2407.10753|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视角3D检测中像素级深度监督的两个问题：LiDAR点云深度仅分布在物体表面，缺乏3D物体中心的深度信息；远距离物体细粒度深度估计困难。提出OPEN检测器，通过物体级深度编码器以像素级深度图为先验估计物体级深度，并用物体级位置嵌入将深度信息注入Transformer解码器。相比已有像素级深度监督方法，显式建模物体级深度更契合DETR类检测器。在nuScenes等基准上取得提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2407.10753|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses two issues in multi-view 3D detection with pixel-wise depth supervision: LiDAR depth only lies on object surfaces lacking 3D center depth, and fine-grained depth for distant objects is hard. It proposes OPEN, which uses an object-wise depth encoder with pixel-wise depth as prior to estimate object-wise depth, then injects it into the transformer decoder via object-wise position embedding. This object-wise depth modeling better suits DETR-based detectors than prior pixel-wise supervision, improving detection accuracy.
2407.10753|v2.assessment: 该工作切中多视角3D检测中深度监督的关键痛点，物体级位置嵌入思路新颖且与DETR框架契合，值得关注。
2407.10753|v2.contribution: 提出物体级位置嵌入（OPEN），将物体级深度信息有效注入多视角3D检测的Transformer解码器。
2407.10753|v2.innovation: 以像素级深度为先验估计物体级深度，并用物体级位置嵌入替代像素级深度监督。
2407.10753|v2.result: 在多视角3D检测基准上取得性能提升（摘要未提供具体数值）。

Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_cn: 该论文针对多相机图像3D目标检测中高分辨率矢量化表示学习问题，提出从多相机图像学习高分辨率向量表示的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节、与已有工作的改进点及实验效果。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.summary_en: This paper targets learning high-resolution vector representations from multi-camera images for 3D object detection. Due to the missing abstract, the specific method, improvements over prior work, and experimental results cannot be confirmed.
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.assessment: 主题与多相机3D检测高度相关，但摘要缺失，无法评估其方法与效果，需查阅全文。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.contribution: 提出从多相机图像学习高分辨率向量表示用于3D目标检测（细节待确认）。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen.innovation: 高分辨率向量表示学习思路（细节待确认）。
Learning High-Resolution Vector Represen._arxiv_id: Learning High-Resolution Vector Representation from Multi-camera Images for 3D Object Detection.

Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角3D目标检测中的难负样本采样问题，提出深度感知的射线去噪（Ray Denoising）方法进行难负样本采样。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节、改进点及实验效果。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.summary_en: This paper addresses hard negative sampling in multi-view 3D object detection by proposing Ray Denoising, a depth-aware hard negative sampling strategy. Due to the missing abstract, the method details, improvements, and results cannot be confirmed.
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.assessment: 深度感知难负样本采样是多视角3D检测的有价值方向，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.contribution: 提出深度感知的射线去噪难负样本采样方法用于多视角3D检测（细节待确认）。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative.innovation: 利用深度信息进行射线级难负样本采样（细节待确认）。
Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative._arxiv_id: Ray Denoising: Depth-Aware Hard Negative Sampling for Multi-view 3D Object Detection.

AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云补全问题，提出AEDNet，采用自适应嵌入与多视角感知解耦方法。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节、改进点及实验效果。该工作与自动驾驶感知中的3D检测相关度较低，属于点云补全子领域。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.summary_en: This paper targets point cloud completion with AEDNet, an adaptive embedding and multiview-aware disentanglement approach. Due to the missing abstract, method details, improvements, and results cannot be confirmed. It is only loosely related to autonomous driving 3D detection.
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.assessment: 点云补全与用户核心研究领域相关度有限，且摘要缺失，优先级较低。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.contribution: 提出自适应嵌入与多视角感知解耦的点云补全网络AEDNet（细节待确认）。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview.innovation: 自适应嵌入与多视角解耦机制（细节待确认）。
AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview._arxiv_id: AEDNet: Adaptive Embedding and Multiview-Aware Disentanglement for Point Cloud Completion.

2404.12390|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（LLM）缺乏核心视觉感知能力的问题，提出Blink基准，将14类经典CV任务（如相对深度估计、视觉对应、取证检测、多视角推理）重构为3807道多选题，配以单/多图和视觉提示。人类平均准确率95.70%，而最佳GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅比随机猜测高13.17%和7.63%，表明这些感知能力尚未在多模态LLM中涌现。分析还显示专用CV模型表现更好，指出未来改进方向。
2404.12390|v2.summary_en: To probe core visual perception abilities missing in multimodal LLMs, this paper introduces Blink, a benchmark reformatting 14 classic CV tasks (e.g., relative depth estimation, visual correspondence, forensics, multi-view reasoning) into 3,807 multiple-choice questions with single/multiple images and visual prompting. Humans average 95.70% accuracy, while the best GPT-4V and Gemini reach only 51.26% and 45.72%, just 13.17% and 7.63% above random guessing, showing such perception abilities have not emerged. Specialist CV models perform much better, suggesting future improvement pathways.
2404.12390|v2.assessment: Blink揭示了当前多模态LLM在核心视觉感知上的显著短板，为VLM与视觉感知交叉研究提供了重要评测基准，值得关注。
2404.12390|v2.contribution: 提出Blink基准，系统评测多模态LLM的核心视觉感知能力并揭示其不足。
2404.12390|v2.innovation: 将14类经典CV感知任务重构为3807道多选题，配以视觉提示进行评测。
2404.12390|v2.result: 人类准确率95.70%，最佳GPT-4V和Gemini仅51.26%和45.72%，仅略高于随机猜测。

2412.04867|v2.summary_cn: 针对微小目标异常检测缺乏大规模多视角与视觉-文本联合基准的问题，论文构建了MANTA数据集，包含38个类别、13.73万张图像（其中8.6K张带像素级异常标注），每张图像从5个视角采集，并配套875词的陈述性知识（含what/why/how解释）和2K道多难度选择题的建构性学习子集。作者还提出了视觉-文本任务基线并在多种设置下进行了广泛基准测试。该工作填补了微小目标异常检测中多视角与语言监督结合的空白，实验揭示了现有先进方法在该数据集上的挑战性。
2412.04867|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MANTA, a large-scale multi-view and visual-text anomaly detection dataset for tiny objects, comprising 137.3K images across 38 categories with 8.6K pixel-level anomaly annotations captured from five viewpoints, plus 875 declarative knowledge words and 2K multiple-choice questions. A visual-text baseline is proposed and extensive benchmarking reveals the challenges of existing methods under this setting. The dataset fills the gap in multi-view and language-supervised tiny-object anomaly detection.
2412.04867|v2.assessment: 该数据集为微小目标异常检测提供了多视角与视觉-文本联合基准，对开放集检测和VLM交叉方向有参考价值，但任务本身与自动驾驶感知核心场景距离较远。
2412.04867|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向微小目标的多视角视觉-文本异常检测大规模数据集MANTA及配套基线。

2411.19036|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云补全中解空间大导致结果不理想、以及获取图像与部分点云配对数据困难的问题，论文提出PCDreamer，利用大模型中的多视角扩散先验生成目标形状的新视角图像，编码全局与局部形状线索。设计了形状融合模块从图像和点云多模态输入生成初始完整形状，并引入形状巩固模块通过丢弃扩散先验不一致性引入的不可靠点获得最终结果。实验表明该方法在恢复精细细节方面具有优越性能。
2411.19036|v2.summary_en: PCDreamer addresses point cloud completion by leveraging multi-view diffusion priors from large models to generate novel views encoding global and local shape cues, avoiding the need for paired image-partial point cloud data. A shape fusion module produces an initial complete shape from multi-modal inputs, and a shape consolidation module removes unreliable points from diffusion inconsistencies. Extensive experiments demonstrate superior performance, especially in recovering fine details.
2411.19036|v2.assessment: 利用扩散先验做点云补全的思路新颖，但任务本身与自动驾驶感知的核心需求（检测/跟踪/BEV）关联较弱，属于3D生成方向。
2411.19036|v2.contribution: 提出利用多视角扩散先验进行点云补全的PCDreamer框架。
2411.19036|v2.innovation: 将大模型多视角扩散先验引入点云补全，并设计形状融合与巩固模块处理扩散不一致性。
2411.19036|v2.result: 在点云补全任务上取得优越性能，尤其在恢复精细细节方面表现突出。

2412.02631|v2.summary_cn: 针对文本到3D生成中多视角重建方法易产生几何伪影、而原生3D生成模型分辨率受限导致质量低的问题，论文提出Sharp-It，一个多视角到多视角的扩散模型。该方法接收从低质量3D物体渲染的3D一致多视角图像，通过跨视角共享特征并行增强几何细节和纹理，再从增强后的多视角图像重建高质量3D模型。该工作弥合了直接生成3D表示与从多视角图像重建3D物体之间的质量差距。
2412.02631|v2.summary_en: Sharp-It addresses the quality gap between direct 3D generative models and multi-view reconstruction approaches by introducing a multi-view to multi-view diffusion model that enriches geometric details and texture of low-quality 3D objects. The model operates on multi-view sets in parallel with shared features across views, enabling high-quality 3D reconstruction from enriched multi-view images. This bridges the resolution limitation of native 3D generators and the geometric artifacts of multi-view reconstruction.
2412.02631|v2.assessment: 属于3D内容生成方向，与自动驾驶感知研究领域关联度低，但多视角扩散模型的技术思路对多相机感知有一定启发。
2412.02631|v2.contribution: 提出多视角到多视角扩散模型Sharp-It用于3D合成与操控。
2412.02631|v2.innovation: 通过跨视角特征共享的并行扩散增强低质量3D物体的几何与纹理细节。
2412.02631|v2.result: 弥合了直接3D生成与多视角重建之间的质量差距，提升了3D模型细节质量。

Theory-Inspired Deep Multi-View Multi-La.summary_cn: 该论文标题为《Theory-Inspired Deep Multi-View Multi-Label Learning with Incomplete Views and Noisy Labels》，旨在解决多视角多标签学习中视角不完整和标签噪声并存的问题，但摘要为空，无法获取具体方法、理论依据和实验数据。从标题推测可能涉及理论驱动的深度学习框架来处理不完整视角和噪声标签。由于缺乏摘要，无法评估其方法质量和实际效果。

M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_cn: 针对真实场景下健身活动理解缺乏大规模多模态多视角多人姿态数据的问题，构建了 M3GYM 数据集。该数据集采集多视角视频与多模态信号，覆盖多人健身动作，并提供姿态标注。相比已有健身或多人姿态数据集，其在规模、视角数量与真实场景复杂度上更强。摘要未给出具体量化结果，主要贡献在于数据资源。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of large-scale multimodal multi-view multi-person pose data for real-world fitness activity understanding by introducing M3GYM. The dataset provides multi-view and multimodal recordings with pose annotations for multi-person fitness activities. Its main contribution is a richer data resource than existing fitness or multi-person pose datasets, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.

M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi.result: 提供了覆盖真实场景的多人姿态与多模态数据资源，摘要未报告具体性能指标。
M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-vi._arxiv_id: M3GYM: A Large-Scale Multimodal Multi-view Multi-person Pose Dataset for Fitness Activity Understanding in Real-world Settings.

Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.summary_en: This paper targets multi-view clustering by proposing Medusa, a multi-scale high-order contrastive dual-diffusion approach. It combines dual-diffusion with multi-scale high-order contrastive learning to improve view-consistent representations. The main advance is joint modeling of multi-scale structure and high-order contrast, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
Medusa: A Multi-Scale High-order Contras.assessment: 属于多视图聚类方法研究，与自动驾驶感知领域关联很低，主要面向通用聚类任务。

MVDoppler-Pose: Multi-Modal Multi-View m.summary_en: This paper addresses long-distance self-occluded human walking pose estimation by proposing MVDoppler-Pose, a multi-modal multi-view mmWave sensing approach. It fuses multi-view Doppler signals for pose estimation under occlusion and long-range conditions. The key advantage is multi-view and multi-modal complementarity, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.

Enhanced then Progressive Fusion with Vi.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient view fusion in multi-view clustering by proposing an enhanced-then-progressive fusion framework with a view graph. The main improvement is explicit view-relation modeling with staged fusion, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.

AdaptCMVC: Robust Adaption to Incrementa.summary_en: This paper targets robust adaptation to incremental views in continual multi-view clustering and proposes AdaptCMVC. 2503.21457|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大模型（MLLM）在人脸感知能力上缺乏系统评测基准的问题，构建了FaceBench数据集。该数据集基于五视角、最多三层的层级化人脸属性结构，涵盖210余个属性、700余个属性值，包含49,919个评测VQA对和23,841个微调对，并训练了Face-LLaVA基线模型。实验表明现有主流MLLM在细粒度人脸属性理解上远不及人类水平，而Face-LLaVA显著优于现有模型。
2503.21457|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces FaceBench, a hierarchical multi-view multi-level facial attribute VQA dataset for benchmarking face perception in MLLMs, comprising 49,919 evaluation pairs and 23,841 fine-tuning pairs over 210+ attributes. A baseline model, Face-LLaVA, is trained on the proposed data and substantially outperforms existing MLLMs, which lag far behind human performance on fine-grained facial attribute understanding.
2503.21457|v2.assessment: 该工作为MLLM人脸感知评测提供了系统基准，但与自动驾驶感知、3D检测等核心领域无关，仅对VLM评测方法有间接参考价值。
2503.21457|v2.contribution: 构建了层级化多视角人脸属性VQA基准FaceBench及配套基线Face-LLaVA。
2503.21457|v2.innovation: 提出五视角三层级的人脸属性结构并据此生成大规模VQA评测与微调数据。
2503.21457|v2.result: 现有MLLM在细粒度人脸属性理解上远逊于人类，Face-LLaVA显著超越现有模型。

Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_cn: 该论文关注真实场景下可信多视图分类的测试时鲁棒性问题，即模型在分布偏移或噪声条件下置信度估计不可靠。方法上提出增强测试时鲁棒性的策略以提升可信多视图分类的稳定性。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法与实验结论。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses testing-time robustness for trusted multi-view classification in the wild, aiming to improve reliability under distribution shifts. The abstract is unavailable, so the proposed method and empirical findings cannot be evaluated.
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.assessment: 属于可信机器学习与多视图分类交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知的鲁棒性研究有概念上的弱关联。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.contribution: 提出增强测试时鲁棒性的可信多视图分类方法。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.innovation: 针对真实场景分布偏移提升多视图分类的测试时可信度。
Enhancing Testing-Time Robustness for Tr.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
