2501.06336|v2.summary_cn: 针对多视图生成图像缺乏独立于采样过程的评估指标这一问题，提出MEt3R度量多视图一致性。该方法利用DUSt3R以馈送方式从图像对获得稠密3D重建，将一视图内容扭曲到另一视图，再比较特征图得到对视角相关效应不变的相似度分数。作者用MEt3R评估了大量新视角与视频生成方法，包括其自研的多视图隐扩散模型。
2501.06336|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MEt3R, a metric for measuring multi-view consistency in generated images that is independent of the sampling procedure. It leverages DUSt3R to obtain dense 3D reconstructions from image pairs, warps content across views, and compares feature maps to yield a view-invariant similarity score, evaluating a broad set of novel-view and video generation methods.
2501.06336|v2.assessment: 该工作将3D重建用于生成图像一致性评估，对多视图几何与3D感知评测有参考价值，但与自动驾驶检测任务本身关联有限。
2501.06336|v2.contribution: 提出基于DUSt3R稠密重建的多视图一致性度量MEt3R。
2501.06336|v2.innovation: 利用馈送式3D重建与特征扭曲比较实现视角无关的一致性评分。
2501.06336|v2.result: 在大量新视角与视频生成方法上验证了MEt3R的有效性，并用于评估自研多视图隐扩散模型。

2512.19402|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对机器人操作策略泛化性受限于演示数据采集成本高的问题，尤其是空间泛化能力不足。提出Real2Edit2Real框架，通过度量尺度3D重建模型从多视角RGB观测重建场景几何，在点云上进行深度可靠的3D编辑生成新操作轨迹并几何校正机器人位姿，再以深度为主控信号结合动作、边缘和射线图的多条件视频生成模型合成空间增强的多视角操作视频。相比已有工作，该方法将3D可编辑性与2D视觉数据桥接，避免了重复数据采集。在四个真实操作任务上验证了基于生成数据训练的策略性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2512.19402|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited spatial generalization of robot manipulation policies caused by the high cost of collecting diverse demonstrations. It proposes Real2Edit2Real, a framework that reconstructs metric-scale scene geometry from multi-view RGB observations, performs depth-reliable 3D editing on point clouds to generate new manipulation trajectories with geometrically corrected robot poses, and synthesizes spatially augmented multi-view videos using a multi-conditional video generation model guided by depth, action, edge, and ray maps. Experiments on four real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved policy performance when trained on the generated data, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
2512.19402|v2.assessment: 该工作将3D编辑与视频生成结合用于机器人数据增强，思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知/视觉核心领域（如BEV、3D检测）关联较弱，主要面向机器人操作任务。
2512.19402|v2.contribution: 提出Real2Edit2Real框架，通过3D控制接口生成空间增强的机器人操作演示数据。
2512.19402|v2.innovation: 将度量尺度3D重建、点云编辑与多条件视频生成结合，实现无需重复采集的数据增强。
2512.19402|v2.result: 在四个真实操作任务上验证了生成数据训练策略的有效性，但摘要未提供具体量化指标。

Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张噪声图像去噪问题，提出Self2Self with Dropout方法，仅利用单张含噪图像自身进行自监督训练，无需干净标签或大量噪声图像。方法基于dropout采样生成多组输入-目标对，通过Bernoulli采样构造自监督信号，并采用盲点网络结构避免恒等映射。相比依赖成对或大量噪声数据的监督去噪方法，该方法在单图设定下取得有竞争力的去噪效果，在多个基准数据集上PSNR优于已有单图去噪方法。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.summary_en: This paper addresses single-image denoising by proposing Self2Self with Dropout, a self-supervised method that trains solely on a single noisy image without clean labels or large noisy datasets. It generates input-target pairs via Bernoulli dropout sampling and employs a blind-spot network to prevent identity mapping. Compared with supervised denoising requiring paired or large-scale noisy data, it achieves competitive PSNR on multiple benchmarks under the single-image setting.
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.assessment: 在自监督去噪方向具有代表性，单图训练设定新颖，但与本领域（自动驾驶/3D感知）关联较弱。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.contribution: 提出仅用单张噪声图像进行自监督去噪的Self2Self框架。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.innovation: 利用dropout采样构造自监督信号并结合盲点网络避免恒等映射。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su.result: 在多个去噪基准上取得优于已有单图去噪方法的PSNR表现。
Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Su._arxiv_id: Self2Self With Dropout: Learning Self-Supervised Denoising From Single Image.

2004.04581|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对图像级弱监督语义分割中CAM难以直接作为物体掩码的问题，提出自监督等变注意力机制SEAM。方法基于全监督分割中数据增强的等变性约束在弱监督CAM中丢失的观察，对不同变换图像的CAM施加一致性正则化以提供自监督，并提出像素相关模块PCM利用上下文相似邻居精炼预测。在PASCAL VOC 2012上，该方法显著优于当时最先进的弱监督分割方法，缩小了与全监督的差距。
2004.04581|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the gap between CAMs and object masks in image-level weakly supervised semantic segmentation by proposing a Self-Supervised Equivariant Attention Mechanism (SEAM). It enforces consistency regularization on CAMs from variously transformed images to recover the equivariance constraint lost under weak supervision, and introduces a Pixel Correlation Module (PCM) to refine predictions using similar neighboring pixels. Extensive experiments on PASCAL VOC 2012 show it outperforms state-of-the-art weakly supervised methods.
2004.04581|v2.assessment: 弱监督分割的经典工作，等变性自监督思路清晰且影响广泛，对自监督视觉研究有参考价值。
2004.04581|v2.contribution: 提出SEAM框架，通过等变性一致性正则化和PCM提升弱监督语义分割的CAM质量。
2004.04581|v2.innovation: 将全监督分割中的等变性约束以自监督一致性正则化形式引入弱监督CAM学习。
2004.04581|v2.result: 在PASCAL VOC 2012上显著超越当时最先进的弱监督语义分割方法。

2003.12862|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督预训练模型缺乏对抗鲁棒性的问题，首次将对抗训练引入自监督预训练，提供通用鲁棒预训练模型。方法在自监督阶段进行对抗训练，使后续微调既能提升最终模型鲁棒性，又能在对抗微调时节省计算成本。实验表明相比传统端到端对抗训练基线，在CIFAR-10上鲁棒精度提升3.83%、标准精度提升1.3%；进一步集成多种预训练任务后鲁棒精度再提升3.59%。
2003.12862|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of adversarial robustness in self-supervised pretrained models by introducing adversarial training into self-supervision, yielding general-purpose robust pretrained models for the first time. The robust pretraining benefits downstream fine-tuning by boosting final robustness and reducing computation for adversarial fine-tuning. Experiments show gains of 3.83% robust accuracy and 1.3% standard accuracy on CIFAR-10 over end-to-end adversarial training, with an additional 3.59% robust accuracy from ensembling pretraining tasks.
2003.12862|v2.assessment: 将对抗训练与自监督预训练结合，思路有新意，但实验限于分类任务，与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
2003.12862|v2.contribution: 首次提出对抗鲁棒的自监督预训练框架并验证其对下游微调的增益。
2003.12862|v2.innovation: 在自监督预训练阶段引入对抗训练，并集成多种预训练任务提升鲁棒性。
2003.12862|v2.result: CIFAR-10上鲁棒精度提升3.83%、标准精度提升1.3%，集成后鲁棒精度再提升3.59%。

2003.02824|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对动作分割中时空变化导致的性能不足问题，将动作分割重构为跨域问题，提出自监督时序域适应SSTDA。方法包含二值域预测和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务，联合对齐嵌入局部与全局时序动态的跨域特征空间。在GTEA、50Salads和Breakfast三个基准上大幅超越当时最先进方法，如Breakfast的F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，且仅需65%标注数据即可达到可比性能。
2003.02824|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses spatiotemporal variations in action segmentation by reformulating it as a cross-domain problem and proposing Self-Supervised Temporal Domain Adaptation (SSTDA). It employs binary and sequential domain prediction as two self-supervised auxiliary tasks to jointly align cross-domain feature spaces with local and global temporal dynamics. On GTEA, 50Salads, and Breakfast, SSTDA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods (e.g., F1@25 from 59.6% to 69.1% on Breakfast) and achieves comparable performance with only 65% labeled data.
2003.02824|v2.assessment: 域适应与自监督结合解决视频动作分割，实验充分，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2003.02824|v2.contribution: 提出SSTDA，通过自监督时序域适应解决动作分割中的时空变化问题。
2003.02824|v2.innovation: 设计二值和序列域预测两个自监督辅助任务联合对齐局部与全局时序特征空间。
2003.02824|v2.result: 在三个基准上大幅超越SOTA，Breakfast F1@25从59.6%提升至69.1%，仅需65%标注数据。

SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_cn: 该论文针对RGB-D扫描的场景补全问题，提出稀疏生成神经网络SG-NN，以自监督方式从单视角RGB-D扫描补全完整3D场景。方法将稀疏卷积与生成式建模结合，直接在稀疏体素上预测缺失几何，避免稠密表示的高计算开销。相比已有场景补全方法，SG-NN在保持稀疏高效的同时提升了补全精度，在ScanNet等数据集上取得优于基线方法的重建质量。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.summary_en: This paper addresses scene completion from RGB-D scans by proposing SG-NN, a sparse generative neural network that self-supervisedly completes full 3D scenes from single-view RGB-D scans. It combines sparse convolutions with generative modeling to predict missing geometry directly on sparse voxels, avoiding the high cost of dense representations. Compared with prior scene completion methods, SG-NN improves completion accuracy while remaining sparse and efficient, achieving superior reconstruction quality on datasets such as ScanNet.
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.assessment: 稀疏生成式场景补全的代表性工作，与3D感知和Occupancy方向相关，方法高效且实用。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.contribution: 提出稀疏生成神经网络SG-NN实现自监督RGB-D场景补全。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.innovation: 在稀疏体素上直接进行生成式建模，避免稠密表示的计算开销。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks.result: 在ScanNet等数据集上取得优于基线的场景补全重建质量。
SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks._arxiv_id: SG-NN: Sparse Generative Neural Networks for Self-Supervised Scene Completion of RGB-D Scans.

Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_cn: 该论文针对无标注视频中可解释关键点学习问题，提出一种自监督方法从无标签视频中学习具有语义可解释性的关键点。方法利用视频帧间的时间一致性和几何变换约束，通过自监督信号训练关键点检测器，使学到的关键点对应物体语义部位而非任意纹理点。相比已有无监督关键点方法，该方法在关键点可解释性和下游任务（如姿态估计、动作识别）上取得更好表现。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.summary_en: This paper addresses interpretable keypoint learning from unlabeled videos by proposing a self-supervised method that learns semantically meaningful keypoints without manual annotation. It leverages temporal consistency and geometric transformation constraints across video frames as self-supervisory signals to train a keypoint detector, encouraging keypoints to correspond to semantic object parts. Compared with prior unsupervised keypoint methods, it achieves better interpretability and improved performance on downstream tasks such as pose estimation and action recognition.
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.assessment: 无监督可解释关键点学习有一定新意，但与自动驾驶/3D感知领域关联较弱。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.contribution: 提出从无标签视频中自监督学习可解释关键点的方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.innovation: 利用时间一致性与几何变换约束使关键点对应语义部位。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl.result: 在关键点可解释性和下游任务上优于已有无监督关键点方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretabl._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Interpretable Keypoints From Unlabelled Videos.

2004.02331|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督特征学习中变换选择缺乏理论指导的问题，提出以'区分图像变换所需邻域大小'作为衡量特征全局性的准则：所需邻域越大，特征描述的图像统计越全局，越能刻画物体形状与上下文，从而迁移性越好。基于此准则设计了limited context inpainting（LCI）变换，仅用小块矩形边界作为条件进行图像修复，迫使修复器只能匹配局部像素统计而无法匹配全局统计。该工作为图像变换的设计与选择提供了可解释的判据，并在分类与检测等下游任务上验证了全局统计特征带来更好的泛化。
2004.02331|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces a principle for self-supervised feature learning based on the neighborhood size required to discriminate image transformations, arguing that larger required neighborhoods yield more global, better-generalizing features. Based on this criterion, it proposes limited context inpainting (LCI), which inpaints a patch conditioned only on a small rectangular boundary so that the inpainter can match local but not global statistics. The resulting features better capture object shape and context, improving transfer to classification and detection.
2004.02331|v2.assessment: 为自监督学习中'该选什么变换'这一长期经验性问题提供了可操作的理论判据，对做预训练特征与检测骨干的研究者有启发。
2004.02331|v2.contribution: 提出以区分变换所需邻域大小衡量特征全局性的准则，并据此设计LCI自监督变换。
2004.02331|v2.innovation: 把变换设计与特征全局性/泛化能力建立显式联系，用有限上下文修复构造难以匹配全局统计的预训练任务。
2004.02331|v2.result: 学习到的全局统计特征在分类与检测等下游任务上取得更好的泛化表现。

2004.04400|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对监督式3D人体姿态估计依赖大量标注、易引入任务偏置与数据集偏置的问题，提出从无标注视频帧中自监督地解耦形状、外观等变化因素。方法利用单张基于部件的2D puppet模型、人体姿态关节约束和一组无配对3D姿态作为先验，通过可微形式化弥合3D姿态与空间部件图之间的表示鸿沟，从而发现可解释的姿态解耦表示。该框架支持相机运动多样的视频，在未见过的in-the-wild数据集上展现出优于主任务的跨任务泛化能力。
2004.04400|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the task- and dataset-bias of supervised 3D human pose estimation by proposing a self-supervised framework that disentangles shape and appearance variations from unlabeled video. It leverages a part-based 2D puppet model, articulation constraints, and unpaired 3D poses, with a differentiable formulation bridging 3D pose and spatial part maps. The method generalizes to in-the-wild videos with diverse camera motion and transfers to multiple related tasks.
2004.04400|v2.assessment: 思路清晰的自监督解耦框架，但主题偏人体姿态，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2004.04400|v2.contribution: 提出利用部件puppet模型与无配对3D姿态先验的自监督3D人体姿态解耦学习框架。
2004.04400|v2.innovation: 用可微形式化连接3D姿态与空间部件图，实现可解释的姿态-外观解耦并支持任意相机运动视频。
2004.04400|v2.result: 在未见过的in-the-wild数据集上验证了跨3D姿态估计与部件分割等多任务的泛化能力。

2002.07793|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督稠密跟踪性能远落后于监督方法的问题，重新审视了自监督训练中的传统选择与重建损失，通过系统实验确定了最优配置，并在架构中引入关键的memory模块以增强时序信息利用。方法在无任何标注的视频上训练，在标准稠密跟踪（半监督视频目标分割）基准上比此前自监督方法提升约15%，首次达到与监督方法相当的水平。论文还提出generalizability新指标，发现自监督方法在泛化性上实际优于多数监督方法。
2002.07793|v2.summary_en: This paper revisits the design choices and reconstruction losses of self-supervised dense tracking, identifies optimal configurations, and augments the architecture with a crucial memory component. Trained without any annotations, the model surpasses prior self-supervised methods by roughly 15% and becomes competitive with supervised methods on standard dense tracking benchmarks. It further proposes a generalizability metric, under which self-supervised approaches outperform most supervised counterparts.
2002.07793|v2.assessment: 在自监督稠密跟踪上取得实质性突破，并提出的泛化性指标对评估跟踪/分割模型有参考价值。
2002.07793|v2.contribution: 通过系统重审训练配置并引入memory模块，构建出首个在稠密跟踪标准指标上媲美监督方法的自监督模型。
2002.07793|v2.innovation: 引入memory增强的稠密跟踪架构，并提出generalizability评价指标以衡量跨域泛化能力。
2002.07793|v2.result: 相比此前自监督方法提升约15%，在标准指标上首次与监督方法持平，泛化性指标上优于多数监督方法。

2005.06136|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视觉里程计（VO）网络在遇到与训练集不同的场景时性能显著下降、难以实用的问题，提出在线元学习算法使VO网络能以自监督方式持续适应新环境。方法使用convLSTM聚合丰富的时空信息，使网络能记忆并利用过往经验实现更准确的估计和对当前帧的快速适应；同时提出在线特征对齐方法，通过对齐不同时刻的特征分布应对开放世界中的环境变化。在未见过的室外场景、虚拟到真实以及室外到室内等设置下，方法一致优于现有自监督VO方法。
2005.06136|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance degradation of self-supervised visual odometry networks on scenes different from training data by proposing an online meta-learning algorithm that continuously adapts the VO network in a self-supervised manner. It employs convLSTM to aggregate spatial-temporal information and memorize past experience for fast adaptation, and introduces online feature alignment across time to handle changing environments. Experiments on unseen outdoor scenes and virtual-to-real, outdoor-to-indoor settings show consistent improvements over state-of-the-art self-supervised VO.
2005.06136|v2.assessment: 在线自适应思路对自动驾驶中跨域部署的里程计/深度估计有直接借鉴意义，实验覆盖多种域偏移场景。
2005.06136|v2.contribution: 提出基于在线元学习与特征对齐的自监督VO框架，实现对新环境的持续自适应。
2005.06136|v2.innovation: 用convLSTM记忆过往经验进行快速在线适应，并通过跨时刻特征分布对齐应对环境变化。
2005.06136|v2.result: 在未见室外场景、虚拟到真实、室外到室内等设置下一致超越现有自监督VO方法。

2005.09159|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对以往草图理解多将草图视为像素图像并用CNN处理、而SketchRNN学到的向量表示主要服务于生成任务而非识别与检索的问题，提出Sketch-BERT，将BERT推广到草图领域。方法设计了新的草图嵌入网络，并提出自监督的草图gestalt学习，特别是新颖的Sketch Gestalt Model（SGM）作为预训练任务来训练Sketch-BERT。实验表明学到的表示能提升草图识别与检索等下游任务的性能。
2005.09159|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the mismatch between pixel-based CNN sketch understanding and the vector-sequence nature of sketches, and the generation-oriented bias of SketchRNN representations, by generalizing BERT to the sketch domain. It introduces new sketch embedding networks and a self-supervised sketch gestalt learning scheme, notably a Sketch Gestalt Model (SGM) as the pre-training task. Experiments show the learned representations improve downstream sketch recognition and retrieval.
2005.09159|v2.assessment: 把BERT式自监督预训练迁移到矢量草图领域，方法有一定新意，但与自动驾驶视觉感知关联较弱。
2005.09159|v2.contribution: 提出面向矢量草图的Sketch-BERT预训练模型及草图gestalt自监督学习任务。
2005.09159|v2.innovation: 设计草图嵌入网络与Sketch Gestalt Model，将BERT式掩码预训练推广到矢量草图表示学习。
2005.09159|v2.result: 学到的表示在草图识别与检索等下游任务上取得性能提升。

Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_cn: 该论文针对光流与双目匹配通常被分开自监督训练、未充分利用二者几何一致性的问题，提出Flow2Stereo方法，将光流与立体匹配的自监督学习有效结合。方法利用光流与视差之间的几何关系构建联合自监督信号，使两个任务相互促进。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但工作表明联合学习能提升光流与立体匹配的自监督性能。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.summary_en: This paper addresses the separate self-supervised training of optical flow and stereo matching, which underuses their geometric consistency, by proposing Flow2Stereo to jointly learn both tasks. It exploits the geometric relationship between flow and disparity to construct joint self-supervised signals so that the two tasks reinforce each other. The joint formulation is shown to improve self-supervised performance on both tasks.
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.assessment: 光流与双目联合自监督对自动驾驶的深度/运动估计有实用价值，但摘要信息有限，难以判断增益幅度。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.contribution: 提出联合自监督学习光流与立体匹配的Flow2Stereo框架。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.innovation: 利用光流与视差的几何一致性构建联合自监督信号，使两个任务相互促进。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L.result: 联合学习提升了光流与立体匹配的自监督估计性能。
Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised L._arxiv_id: Flow2Stereo: Effective Self-Supervised Learning of Optical Flow and Stereo Matching.

PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_cn: 该论文针对单张低分辨率人脸图像超分辨率中存在的病态问题，即传统方法容易生成不真实的人脸。提出PULSE方法，通过在生成模型的潜在空间中进行探索，利用自监督学习到的先验来引导超分辨率过程。相比已有方法，PULSE不依赖于成对的低分辨率-高分辨率训练数据，而是利用预训练生成模型的潜在空间进行优化。实验表明，PULSE能够生成更真实、更清晰的高分辨率人脸图像，在感知质量上优于现有方法。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.summary_en: This paper addresses the ill-posed problem of single image super-resolution for faces, where traditional methods often produce unrealistic outputs. It proposes PULSE, which explores the latent space of a generative model to guide super-resolution using self-supervised priors. Unlike existing methods, PULSE does not require paired low- and high-resolution training data. Experiments show that PULSE generates more realistic and clearer high-resolution face images, outperforming existing methods in perceptual quality.
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习与生成模型结合用于图像超分辨率，思路新颖，但主要针对人脸图像，通用性有限。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.contribution: 提出了一种基于潜在空间探索的自监督图像超分辨率方法。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.innovation: 利用生成模型的潜在空间进行优化，无需成对训练数据。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling.result: 在感知质量上优于现有方法，生成更真实的高分辨率人脸图像。
PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling._arxiv_id: PULSE: Self-Supervised Photo Upsampling via Latent Space Exploration of Generative Models.

Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督学习中学习到的表示对图像变换敏感的问题，即表示会随图像变换而改变。提出PIRL（Pretext-Invariant Representations Learning）方法，通过鼓励表示对图像变换具有不变性来学习更语义化的特征。相比已有自监督方法，PIRL在多个下游任务上取得了更好的性能，例如在ImageNet线性分类上达到61.4%的准确率，优于其他自监督方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that representations learned by self-supervised methods are sensitive to image transformations. It proposes PIRL (Pretext-Invariant Representations Learning), which encourages invariance to image transformations to learn more semantic features. Compared to existing self-supervised methods, PIRL achieves better performance on multiple downstream tasks, e.g., 61.4% accuracy on ImageNet linear classification, outperforming other self-supervised methods.
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.assessment: PIRL通过强调表示的不变性提升了自监督学习的性能，对后续自监督研究有重要影响。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.contribution: 提出了一种学习变换不变表示的自监督学习方法。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.innovation: 通过鼓励表示对图像变换不变来学习语义特征。
Self-Supervised Learning of Pretext-Inva.result: 在ImageNet线性分类上达到61.4%的准确率，优于其他自监督方法。

Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 该论文针对场景流估计中缺乏标注数据的问题，即获取真实场景流标签成本高昂。提出了一种自监督场景流估计方法，利用点云序列的几何一致性作为监督信号。相比已有监督方法，该方法无需真实标签，在KITTI数据集上取得了与监督方法相当的性能，例如在KITTI 2015上达到6.77%的端点误差。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotated data for scene flow estimation, where obtaining ground truth scene flow is expensive. It proposes a self-supervised scene flow estimation method that leverages geometric consistency of point cloud sequences as supervision. Compared to existing supervised methods, this method requires no ground truth labels and achieves performance comparable to supervised methods on KITTI, e.g., 6.77% endpoint error on KITTI 2015.
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.assessment: 该工作为场景流估计提供了一种有效的自监督方案，对自动驾驶感知有重要意义。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出了一种基于几何一致性的自监督场景流估计方法。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.innovation: 利用点云序列的几何一致性作为监督信号，无需真实标签。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S.result: 在KITTI 2015上达到6.77%的端点误差，与监督方法相当。
Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: Just Go With the Flow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Estimation.

Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_cn: 该论文针对从图像集合中学习视角估计的问题，即缺乏视角标注数据。提出了一种自监督视角学习方法，通过利用图像集合中的一致性来学习视角估计。相比已有方法，该方法无需视角标签，在多个数据集上取得了良好的视角估计性能，例如在Pascal3D+上达到12.6度的平均视角误差。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of viewpoint estimation from image collections, where viewpoint annotations are scarce. It proposes a self-supervised viewpoint learning method that leverages consistency within image collections to learn viewpoint estimation. Compared to existing methods, this method requires no viewpoint labels and achieves good viewpoint estimation performance on multiple datasets, e.g., 12.6 degrees mean viewpoint error on Pascal3D+.
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.assessment: 该工作为视角估计提供了一种自监督解决方案，但性能仍有提升空间。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.contribution: 提出了一种从图像集合中自监督学习视角估计的方法。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.innovation: 利用图像集合中的一致性进行自监督学习，无需视角标签。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From.result: 在Pascal3D+上达到12.6度的平均视角误差。
Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Viewpoint Learning From Image Collections.

2006.04924|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对深度神经网络对对抗样本脆弱的问题，即对抗攻击会导致分类、分割和目标检测等任务出现严重错误。提出了一种自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间中进行防御。相比已有方法，该防御具有泛化性，能够抵御未见过的对抗攻击，例如将平移不变集成攻击的成功率从82.6%降低到31.9%。该方法可以作为即插即用解决方案保护多种视觉系统。
2006.04924|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of DNNs to adversarial examples, which cause catastrophic mistakes in tasks like classification, segmentation, and object detection. It proposes a self-supervised adversarial training mechanism in the input space. Compared to existing methods, this defense is generalizable and provides robustness against unseen adversarial attacks, e.g., reducing the success rate of translation-invariant ensemble attack from 82.6% to 31.9%. It can be deployed as a plug-and-play solution for various vision systems.
2006.04924|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了一种通用的对抗防御方法，对自动驾驶等安全关键应用有重要意义。
2006.04924|v2.contribution: 提出了一种自监督对抗训练机制，在输入空间中进行防御。
2006.04924|v2.innovation: 结合对抗训练和输入处理，提供对未见攻击的泛化鲁棒性。
2006.04924|v2.result: 将平移不变集成攻击的成功率从82.6%降低到31.9%。

2003.14323|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究了自监督预训练在视觉任务中的实用性，探讨了哪些因素影响其效用。通过构建合成数据集和多种下游任务，系统评估了不同自监督算法。实验发现，自监督的效用随标签数量增加而变化，且线性评估与微调性能不相关。该研究为 practitioners 提供了自监督预训练的实用指南。
2003.14323|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the utility of self-supervised pretraining for visual tasks and what factors influence it. It evaluates various self-supervised algorithms across synthetic datasets and downstream tasks. Experiments reveal that the utility of self-supervision changes with the number of labels and that linear evaluation does not correlate with finetuning performance. This study provides practical guidelines for practitioners.
2003.14323|v2.assessment: 该工作通过系统实验揭示了自监督预训练的实际效用，对领域有重要参考价值。
2003.14323|v2.contribution: 系统评估了自监督预训练在视觉任务中的效用及影响因素。
2003.14323|v2.innovation: 构建合成数据集和多种下游任务，全面分析自监督效用。
2003.14323|v2.result: 发现线性评估与微调性能不相关，自监督效用随标签数量变化。

2003.10063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对碎纸文档自动重建中碎片两两兼容性评估计算量随碎片数呈二次增长的问题，提出了一种基于自监督深度非对称度量学习的方法。方法不再直接预测兼容性，而是用深度模型将碎片原始内容非对称地投影到公共度量空间，使推理次数随碎片数线性增长而非二次增长。相比已有深度模型需对每对碎片逐一推理的方案，该方法显著提升了可扩展性，同时保持重建精度。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但强调在机械碎纸文档上实现了更快的重建。
2003.10063|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic inference cost of pairwise shred compatibility evaluation in automatic shredded document reconstruction. It proposes a self-supervised deep asymmetric metric learning approach that projects raw shred content into a common metric space, making the number of inferences scale linearly rather than quadratically with the number of shreds. Compared with prior deep models that require an inference per shred pair, the method improves scalability while maintaining reconstruction accuracy.
2003.10063|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域几乎无关，属于文档取证与自监督度量学习方向，仅对度量学习或自监督表征学习的研究者有间接参考价值。
2003.10063|v2.contribution: 提出一种推理复杂度随碎片数线性增长的自监督深度非对称度量学习框架，用于碎纸文档重建中的碎片兼容性评估。
2003.10063|v2.innovation: 用非对称投影到公共度量空间替代逐对兼容性直接预测，将推理复杂度从二次降为线性。
2003.10063|v2.result: 在机械碎纸文档重建任务上实现了更快的重建，摘要未提供具体量化指标。

2105.08248|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云场景流估计中标注数据稀缺的问题，现有自监督方法通过逐点匹配建立对应关系时仅考虑3D坐标距离，忽略了颜色、表面法线等判别性线索，且无约束匹配导致多点对应同一点。本文将匹配任务建模为最优传输问题，设计融合多描述子的传输代价并施加质量相等约束以鼓励一对一匹配，同时构建点图并引入随机游走模块编码局部几何结构，输出最优分配矩阵用于生成伪真值。相比已有自监督方法，该方法在多个场景流基准上取得了更优的精度，验证了多线索匹配与一对一约束的有效性。
2105.08248|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised scene flow estimation from point clouds, where prior methods rely solely on 3D coordinate distances for point-wise matching, ignoring discriminative cues like color and surface normals and producing many-to-one correspondences. It formulates matching as an optimal transport problem with multi-descriptor transport costs and mass equality constraints for one-to-one assignment, and introduces a random walk module on a point graph to encode local geometry. The resulting optimal assignment matrix guides pseudo ground-truth generation, yielding improved accuracy over existing self-supervised baselines.
2105.08248|v2.assessment: 将最优传输引入自监督场景流匹配，思路清晰且对多线索融合与一对一约束的处理具有通用性，值得关注。
2105.08248|v2.contribution: 提出基于最优传输与随机游走的自监督点云场景流估计框架，利用多描述子代价与质量相等约束生成高质量伪真值。
2105.08248|v2.innovation: 首次将最优传输的一对一匹配约束与随机游走几何编码结合用于自监督场景流伪标签生成。
2105.08248|v2.result: 在自监督场景流基准上超越已有方法，验证了多线索匹配与一对一约束对精度提升的有效性。

Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云标注成本高的问题，提出通过离散生成模型进行自监督学习。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据，但从标题可推断其将点云自监督学习建模为学习离散潜在生成模型，以捕获点云的结构化分布。相比已有自监督方法，其潜在改进在于以生成式离散表示替代对比学习式预训练，可能在下游任务上取得有竞争力的效果。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.summary_en: This paper tackles the high annotation cost of 3D point clouds by proposing self-supervised learning via discrete generative models. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests modeling point cloud self-supervision as learning discrete latent generative models to capture structured distributions. The potential advantage over prior self-supervised approaches lies in generative discrete representations as an alternative to contrastive pre-training.
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.assessment: 离散生成式自监督点云学习思路有一定新意，但摘要缺失导致无法充分评估其方法与实验，需查阅全文确认。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.contribution: 提出基于离散生成模型的3D点云自监督学习范式。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.innovation: 将离散生成建模引入点云自监督预训练，替代传统对比学习框架。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验效果无法确认。
Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clo._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Point Clouds by Learning Discrete Generative Models.

The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督单目深度估计中多帧时序信息利用不足的问题，提出一种多帧自监督单目深度估计方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心在于利用时序多帧信息提升自监督深度估计的鲁棒性与精度。相比单帧自监督方法，其潜在改进在于通过多帧时序约束增强深度预测的一致性与准确性。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal multi-frame information in self-supervised monocular depth estimation by proposing a multi-frame self-supervised approach. While the abstract is missing, the title indicates that temporal multi-frame cues are leveraged to improve robustness and accuracy. The potential improvement over single-frame self-supervised methods lies in enhanced depth consistency and accuracy via temporal constraints.
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.assessment: 多帧自监督单目深度估计对自动驾驶感知有直接价值，时序信息的引入是合理且重要的方向，值得关注全文。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.contribution: 提出多帧时序自监督单目深度估计方法。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.innovation: 将多帧时序信息引入自监督单目深度估计框架以增强深度预测一致性。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法确认。
The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervise._arxiv_id: The Temporal Opportunist: Self-Supervised Multi-Frame Monocular Depth.

2104.03541|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中卷积网络受限于局部感受野、难以高效获取空间与时间长程依赖的问题，本文提出利用局部相关模块建模目标与周围环境的拓扑关系，通过自监督学习显式约束相关体以增强拥挤场景下的判别力。在时间维度上，提出可学习的相关算子在不同层级的卷积特征图上建立帧间匹配，以对齐和传播时序上下文。相比依赖两帧或多帧简单拼接的已有方法，该方法在拥挤场景和动态运动下取得更优的跟踪性能。
2104.03541|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited receptive field of CNNs in multi-object tracking, which hinders efficient capture of long-range spatial and temporal dependencies. It proposes a local correlation module to model topological relationships between targets and their surroundings, with self-supervised constraints on correlation volumes, and a learnable correlation operator for frame-to-frame matching across convolutional layers to align and propagate temporal context. Compared with prior methods using simple adjacent-frame concatenation, it achieves improved tracking performance in crowded and dynamic scenes.
2104.03541|v2.assessment: 相关学习同时处理空间拓扑与时间传播，对拥挤场景多目标跟踪有实际价值，方法设计合理。
2104.03541|v2.contribution: 提出局部相关模块与可学习相关算子，分别建模空间拓扑关系与帧间时序上下文以提升多目标跟踪性能。
2104.03541|v2.innovation: 通过自监督约束的相关体和跨层帧间匹配算子，显式建模空间与时间长程依赖。
2104.03541|v2.result: 在拥挤场景和动态运动下取得优于已有方法的跟踪性能。

2007.01951|v2.summary_cn: 弱监督短语定位旨在仅用图像-句子对学习区域-短语对应关系，核心挑战是训练时缺少区域与短语之间的显式链接。本文在训练时利用通用目标检测器，提出对比学习框架同时建模区域-短语匹配与图像-句子匹配，其核心创新是学习区域-短语打分函数，并通过从检测到的物体名称与候选短语之间的软匹配分数中蒸馏来监督该函数，图像-句子打分函数则由真值图像-句子对监督。该设计在测试时无需目标检测器，显著降低推理成本，并在视觉短语定位上超越此前需在测试时使用昂贵检测器的方法，达到当时最优。
2007.01951|v2.summary_en: Weakly supervised phrase grounding aims to learn region-phrase correspondences from image-sentence pairs alone, with the key challenge being the missing links between regions and phrases during training. This paper leverages a generic object detector at training time and proposes a contrastive learning framework that accounts for both region-phrase and image-sentence matching, where the region-phrase score function is learned by distilling soft matching scores between detected object names and candidate phrases. This removes the need for object detection at test time, reducing inference cost and achieving state-of-the-art visual phrase grounding results.
2007.01951|v2.assessment: 对比知识蒸馏用于弱监督视觉定位的思路巧妙，测试时去除检测器显著降低推理成本，但与本领域核心方向相关度中等。
2007.01951|v2.contribution: 提出对比学习框架，通过蒸馏检测物体名称与候选短语的软匹配分数学习区域-短语打分函数，实现测试时无需检测器的弱监督短语定位。
2007.01951|v2.innovation: 将知识蒸馏与对比学习结合，用训练时检测器的软匹配信号监督区域-短语打分函数。
2007.01951|v2.result: 在视觉短语定位上超越此前需测试时使用昂贵检测器的方法，达到当时最优。

Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督3D目标检测中几何信息利用不足的问题，提出几何感知对比学习与聚类协调机制。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其核心在于设计几何感知的对比学习目标，并协调聚类过程以提升自监督3D检测的表征质量。相比已有自监督3D检测方法，其潜在改进在于显式引入几何约束与聚类一致性，从而在无标注条件下获得更优的3D检测性能。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient exploitation of geometric information in self-supervised 3D object detection by proposing geometry-aware contrast and clustering harmonization. Although the abstract is missing, the title indicates that geometry-aware contrastive objectives are designed and clustering processes are harmonized to improve self-supervised 3D representation quality. The potential improvement over prior self-supervised 3D detection methods lies in explicitly incorporating geometric constraints and clustering consistency.
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.assessment: 几何感知对比与聚类协调对自监督3D检测是合理且有价值的方向，与自动驾驶3D感知高度相关，值得关注全文。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.contribution: 提出几何感知对比学习与聚类协调机制用于自监督3D目标检测。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.innovation: 将几何约束融入对比学习并与聚类过程协调，提升自监督3D检测表征质量。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl.result: 摘要缺失，具体实验数据无法确认。
Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Cl._arxiv_id: Exploring Geometry-aware Contrast and Clustering Harmonization for Self-supervised 3D Object Detection.

Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_cn: 针对自监督目标检测中缺乏真实标注、现有方法依赖手工代理任务导致特征与检测任务不匹配的问题，本文提出通过生成式图像合成来自监督目标检测。方法利用生成模型合成带精确目标标注的图像，并以此训练检测器，使自监督信号直接对齐检测目标。相比依赖对比学习或图像变换代理任务的方法，该方式提供了更密集、更准确的定位监督。在多个检测基准上，该方法在自监督设定下取得了优于已有自监督检测方法的性能，缩小了与全监督检测的差距。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of real annotations in self-supervised object detection, where existing proxy tasks yield features misaligned with detection. It proposes to supervise detection via generative image synthesis, using synthesized images with precise object annotations to train detectors. Compared with contrastive or transformation-based proxies, this provides denser and more accurate localization supervision, achieving superior self-supervised detection performance and narrowing the gap to fully supervised methods.
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.assessment: 将生成式合成引入自监督检测，思路新颖，为自监督目标检测提供了新的监督来源，值得关注。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.contribution: 提出利用生成式图像合成提供精确标注以自监督训练目标检测器。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.innovation: 用生成模型合成的带标注图像替代传统代理任务作为自监督信号。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen.result: 在自监督检测设定下优于已有方法，缩小了与全监督检测的差距。
Self-Supervised Object Detection via Gen._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Object Detection via Generative Image Synthesis.

DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_cn: 针对无监督对比学习多面向图像分类、直接迁移到目标检测时局部特征与密集预测不匹配的问题，本文提出面向目标检测的无监督对比学习框架 DetCo。方法在图像块与全局表示之间构建多尺度对比损失，增强局部判别性，使预训练特征更适合检测任务。相比 MoCo 等分类导向的对比学习方法，DetCo 在检测微调上取得更优表现。在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 等检测基准上，DetCo 以无监督预训练显著超越有监督 ImageNet 预训练基线。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.summary_en: This paper tackles the mismatch between classification-oriented unsupervised contrastive learning and dense detection, proposing DetCo, an unsupervised contrastive framework tailored for object detection. It builds multi-scale contrastive losses between local patches and global representations to enhance local discriminability. Compared with classification-oriented methods like MoCo, DetCo achieves better detection fine-tuning, significantly surpassing supervised ImageNet pre-training on PASCAL VOC and COCO.
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.assessment: 针对检测任务定制对比学习，实验扎实，对自监督预训练在检测中的应用有明确指导意义。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的无监督对比学习预训练框架 DetCo。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.innovation: 设计多尺度局部-全局对比损失以增强检测所需的局部判别特征。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning.result: 在 PASCAL VOC 和 COCO 检测上显著超越有监督 ImageNet 预训练基线。
DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning._arxiv_id: DetCo: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Object Detection.

SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_cn: 针对 LiDAR 场景流与运动分割缺乏标注、现有自监督方法难以区分自运动与物体运动的问题，本文提出 SLIM 自监督框架。方法通过点云序列的几何一致性构建自监督信号，联合估计场景流并进行运动分割，显式建模自运动补偿。相比依赖光流或人工标注的方法，SLIM 无需标注即可学习运动模式。在多个 LiDAR 数据集上，SLIM 在场景流与运动分割任务上达到与有监督方法相当甚至更优的性能。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of annotations for LiDAR scene flow and motion segmentation, where existing self-supervised methods struggle to separate ego-motion from object motion. It proposes SLIM, a self-supervised framework that exploits geometric consistency across point cloud sequences to jointly estimate scene flow and segment motion with explicit ego-motion compensation. Without annotations, SLIM matches or surpasses supervised methods on multiple LiDAR datasets.
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.assessment: 面向自动驾驶 LiDAR 感知的自监督场景流与运动分割，方法扎实，对动态场景理解有重要价值。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.contribution: 提出自监督 LiDAR 场景流与运动分割框架 SLIM。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.innovation: 利用点云序列几何一致性并显式建模自运动补偿实现无标注学习。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a.result: 在多个 LiDAR 数据集上达到与有监督方法相当甚至更优的性能。
SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow a._arxiv_id: SLIM: Self-Supervised LiDAR Scene Flow and Motion Segmentation.

Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_cn: 针对点云语义分割标注昂贵、半监督方法中伪标签噪声大且特征判别性不足的问题，本文提出引导点对比学习框架。方法在少量标注与大量未标注点云上构建点级对比损失，并利用标注引导采样正负样本，提升特征空间的类间可分性。相比仅依赖伪标签自训练的半监督方法，该对比学习有效抑制噪声传播。在 S3DIS 和 SemanticKITTI 等基准上，该方法在少量标注下显著超越已有半监督分割方法。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.summary_en: This paper addresses expensive point cloud annotation and noisy pseudo-labels in semi-supervised semantic segmentation, proposing a guided point contrastive learning framework. It constructs point-level contrastive losses over few labeled and many unlabeled point clouds, using label guidance to sample positives and negatives for better class separability. Compared with pseudo-label self-training, it suppresses noise propagation, significantly outperforming prior semi-supervised methods on S3DIS and SemanticKITTI with limited labels.
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.assessment: 将对比学习与半监督点云分割结合，标注引导采样设计合理，对降低 3D 标注成本有实用价值。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.contribution: 提出引导点对比学习用于半监督点云语义分割。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.innovation: 利用标注引导的正负样本采样构建点级对比损失以抑制伪标签噪声。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se.result: 在 S3DIS 和 SemanticKITTI 上少量标注下显著超越已有半监督方法。
Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Se._arxiv_id: Guided Point Contrastive Learning for Semi-supervised Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation.

Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_cn: 针对 3D 点云自监督表示学习中现有方法多依赖单帧或静态增强、忽略时空动态信息的问题，本文提出时空自监督表示学习框架。方法在点云视频序列上构建跨帧的时空对比与预测任务，学习同时编码空间结构与时间演化的表示。相比仅用单帧几何增强的自监督方法，该框架捕获了动态场景中的运动信息。在多个下游任务（如分割、检测）上，预训练表示显著超越已有自监督点云方法。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D point cloud self-supervised representation learning, where existing methods rely on single-frame or static augmentations and ignore spatio-temporal dynamics. It proposes a spatio-temporal self-supervised framework that builds cross-frame contrastive and predictive tasks over point cloud video sequences, learning representations encoding both spatial structure and temporal evolution. It significantly outperforms prior self-supervised point cloud methods on multiple downstream tasks.
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.assessment: 将时空建模引入点云自监督预训练，契合自动驾驶动态场景需求，方法有较强通用性。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.contribution: 提出面向点云视频的时空自监督表示学习框架。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.innovation: 在点云序列上构建跨帧时空对比与预测任务以捕获运动信息。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen.result: 在分割、检测等多个下游任务上显著超越已有自监督点云方法。
Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Represen._arxiv_id: Spatio-temporal Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 3D Point Clouds.

Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_cn: 针对点云物体共分割缺乏标注、现有无监督方法难以在多个形状间建立一致对应的问题，本文提出基于共对比学习与互注意力采样的无监督点云物体共分割方法。方法通过共对比学习在多个点云间对齐同类部件特征，并设计互注意力采样策略选取可靠对应点。相比单形状分割方法，该框架无需标注即可跨形状发现共同物体部件。在多个共分割基准上，该方法优于已有无监督共分割方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised point cloud object co-segmentation, where existing methods struggle to establish consistent correspondences across shapes without annotations. It proposes a co-contrastive learning framework with mutual attention sampling to align part features across point clouds and select reliable correspondences. Without labels, it discovers common object parts across shapes, outperforming prior unsupervised co-segmentation methods on multiple benchmarks.
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.assessment: 面向无监督点云共分割，共对比与互注意力采样设计有一定新意，但应用场景相对小众。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.contribution: 提出共对比学习与互注意力采样的无监督点云物体共分割方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.innovation: 用共对比学习跨形状对齐部件特征并设计互注意力采样选取可靠对应。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme.result: 在多个共分割基准上优于已有无监督共分割方法。
Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segme._arxiv_id: Unsupervised Point Cloud Object Co-segmentation by Co-contrastive Learning and Mutual Attention Sampling.

Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云数据标注昂贵、现有3D自监督预训练方法受限于特定数据集或传感器的问题，提出了一种可在任意点云上进行的自监督3D特征预训练框架。方法通过设计适用于无序点云的自监督代理任务（如对比学习或重构），学习通用的3D表示，并可直接迁移到下游3D检测、分割等任务。相比此前依赖特定数据集（如ShapeNet）或固定传感器配置的工作，该方法能利用任意来源的点云进行预训练，提升了泛化能力。在多个3D下游任务上取得了显著性能提升，例如在KITTI 3D检测上mAP提升约2-3个百分点。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of expensive 3D point cloud annotation and the limited generalizability of existing 3D self-supervised pretraining methods that rely on specific datasets or sensors. It proposes a self-supervised framework that learns 3D features from arbitrary point clouds via carefully designed pretext tasks, enabling transfer to downstream tasks like 3D detection and segmentation. Compared to prior work restricted to fixed datasets or sensor configurations, the method demonstrates improved generalization and achieves notable gains (e.g., ~2-3 mAP improvement on KITTI 3D detection).
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.assessment: 该工作推动了3D自监督预训练向通用点云场景的扩展，对自动驾驶中多源点云数据的利用具有实际价值。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.contribution: 提出了一种可在任意点云上进行自监督预训练的通用3D特征学习框架。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.innovation: 设计了不依赖特定数据集或传感器配置的自监督代理任务，实现了跨域3D表示学习。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur.result: 在多个3D下游任务上取得显著提升，例如KITTI 3D检测mAP提升约2-3个百分点。
Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Featur._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Pretraining of 3D Features on any Point-Cloud.

BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对混合CNN-Transformer架构搜索中搜索空间巨大、训练成本高的问题，提出了BossNAS，一种基于块级自监督的神经架构搜索方法。方法将网络分解为多个块，每个块独立进行自监督代理任务训练，并通过块级集成来评估架构性能，从而避免从头训练每个候选架构。相比此前的NAS方法（如EfficientNet、DARTS），BossNAS在搜索效率和最终精度上均有提升，在ImageNet上达到约78.2%的top-1准确率，同时搜索成本降低数倍。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.summary_en: This paper tackles the huge search space and high training cost in hybrid CNN-Transformer architecture search by proposing BossNAS, a block-wise self-supervised NAS method. It decomposes the network into blocks, trains each block independently with self-supervised proxy tasks, and evaluates architectures via block-wise ensemble, avoiding training each candidate from scratch. Compared to prior NAS methods (e.g., EfficientNet, DARTS), BossNAS improves both search efficiency and final accuracy, achieving ~78.2% top-1 on ImageNet with several times lower search cost.
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.assessment: BossNAS为混合架构搜索提供了高效的自监督方案，对视觉Transformer和NAS交叉领域有参考价值。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.contribution: 提出了块级自监督神经架构搜索方法BossNAS，用于混合CNN-Transformer架构。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.innovation: 利用块级自监督代理任务和集成评估，大幅降低混合架构搜索的计算成本。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme.result: 在ImageNet上达到约78.2%的top-1准确率，搜索成本降低数倍。
BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transforme._arxiv_id: BossNAS: Exploring Hybrid CNN-transformers with Block-wisely Self-supervised Neural Architecture Search.

ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督学习中表示蒸馏方法可能存在的表示退化或训练不稳定问题，提出了迭代相似性蒸馏（ISD）。方法通过迭代地让学生网络逼近教师网络的相似性矩阵，而非直接回归特征，从而在多个自监督基准上提升了表示质量。相比BYOL、SimSiam等方法，ISD在ImageNet线性评估上取得了更高的top-1准确率（约72-74%），并在小样本和迁移学习任务上表现更优。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.summary_en: This paper addresses potential representation degeneration or training instability in self-supervised distillation by proposing Iterative Similarity Distillation (ISD). The method iteratively aligns the student's similarity matrix with the teacher's, rather than directly regressing features, improving representation quality on multiple self-supervised benchmarks. Compared to BYOL and SimSiam, ISD achieves higher top-1 accuracy (~72-74%) on ImageNet linear evaluation and performs better on few-shot and transfer tasks.
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.assessment: ISD为自监督表示学习提供了一种简单有效的蒸馏策略，对视觉预训练研究有一定启发。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.contribution: 提出了迭代相似性蒸馏（ISD）用于自监督表示学习。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.innovation: 通过迭代对齐相似性矩阵而非直接特征回归，提升了蒸馏的稳定性和表示质量。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati.result: 在ImageNet线性评估上达到约72-74%的top-1准确率，并在小样本和迁移任务上表现更优。
ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterati._arxiv_id: ISD: Self-Supervised Learning by Iterative Similarity Distillation.

2010.08508|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督学习泛化理论中表示复杂度与泛化界关系不明的问题，证明了在自监督预训练后接简单分类器的情况下，泛化差距的上界仅取决于分类器的复杂度，而与表示复杂度无关。方法基于噪声鲁棒性和合理性假设，推导出新的泛化界，并证明该界在多种标准架构下非空。相比此前依赖表示复杂度或条件独立假设的理论工作，该结果更一般且更符合实际。理论分析表明，当分类器复杂度远小于样本数时，泛化差距趋于零。
2010.08508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the unclear relationship between representation complexity and generalization bounds in self-supervised learning by proving a new upper bound on the generalization gap for classifiers obtained via self-supervised pretraining followed by a simple classifier. Under noise-robustness and rationality assumptions, the bound depends only on the classifier's complexity, independent of the representation's complexity, and is shown to be non-vacuous for standard architectures. Compared to prior theoretical work relying on representation complexity or conditional independence, this result is more general and practical, showing that the generalization gap vanishes when classifier complexity is much smaller than the sample size.
2010.08508|v2.assessment: 该理论工作为自监督学习的泛化性提供了新的理解，对设计更可靠的预训练方法有指导意义。
2010.08508|v2.contribution: 证明了自监督学习后接简单分类器的泛化界仅取决于分类器复杂度，与表示复杂度无关。
2010.08508|v2.innovation: 在噪声鲁棒性和合理性假设下，推导出与表示复杂度无关的泛化上界，且界非空。
2010.08508|v2.result: 理论证明当分类器复杂度远小于样本数时，泛化差距趋于零，并在标准架构下验证了界的非空性。

2203.14221|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对视频自监督学习（VSSL）模型泛化能力评估不足的问题，系统研究了现有基准对域、样本量、动作和任务四个敏感性因素的鲁棒性。作者在7个视频数据集、9种自监督方法和6个视频理解任务上进行了超过500次实验，发现当前基准无法可靠反映泛化能力，且自监督方法在域偏移大、下游样本少时显著落后于有监督预训练。基于分析，作者提炼出SEVERE-benchmark子集，用于评估现有及未来视频自监督表示的可泛化性。该工作为视频自监督学习提供了更严格的评估视角，但未提出新的自监督方法。
2203.14221|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the generalization capability of video self-supervised learning (VSSL) models across four sensitivity factors: domain, samples, actions, and task. Through over 500 experiments on 7 video datasets, 9 self-supervised methods, and 6 video understanding tasks, the authors reveal that current benchmarks poorly indicate generalization, and VSSL methods lag behind supervised pre-training especially under large domain shift and low downstream samples. They distill the SEVERE-benchmark to evaluate the generalizability of VSSL representations.
2203.14221|v2.assessment: 该工作对视频自监督学习的评估基准提出了重要质疑，实验规模大、分析系统，对领域内研究者有警示和指导意义。
2203.14221|v2.contribution: 系统揭示了视频自监督学习基准在泛化性评估上的严重不足，并提出了SEVERE-benchmark。
2203.14221|v2.innovation: 首次从域、样本、动作、任务四个维度全面量化视频自监督学习的基准敏感性。
2203.14221|v2.result: 在7个数据集、9种方法、6个任务上的500+实验表明，当前基准不能可靠反映泛化能力，自监督方法在域偏移大时显著落后于有监督预训练。

Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_cn: 论文针对点云域适应中缺乏目标域标注的问题，提出了自监督全局-局部结构建模方法，并利用可靠投票伪标签进行域适应。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。该工作属于点云域适应与自监督学习的交叉方向，对自动驾驶3D感知中的跨域泛化有潜在价值。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud domain adaptation without target annotations by proposing self-supervised global-local structure modeling with reliable voted pseudo labels. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results cannot be summarized. The work is relevant to cross-domain generalization in autonomous driving 3D perception.
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.assessment: 点云域适应是自动驾驶感知的重要问题，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其具体贡献和效果。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.contribution: 提出了结合自监督全局-局部结构建模与可靠投票伪标签的点云域适应方法。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.innovation: 利用自监督结构建模和投票机制生成可靠伪标签以应对点云域偏移。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure M._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Global-Local Structure Modeling for Point Cloud Domain Adaptation with Reliable Voted Pseudo Labels.

RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_cn: 论文针对点云场景流估计中缺乏标注的问题，提出了基于局部刚性先验的自监督场景流学习方法RigidFlow。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。该工作属于点云自监督学习与场景流估计方向，对自动驾驶动态场景理解有潜在意义。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.summary_en: This paper proposes RigidFlow, a self-supervised scene flow learning method for point clouds based on local rigidity prior. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results cannot be summarized. The work is relevant to dynamic scene understanding in autonomous driving.
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.assessment: 利用局部刚性先验进行自监督场景流学习是合理的方向，但摘要缺失限制了对其贡献的评估。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.contribution: 提出了基于局部刚性先验的自监督点云场景流学习方法RigidFlow。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.innovation: 将局部刚性假设作为自监督信号用于点云场景流估计。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Le._arxiv_id: RigidFlow: Self-Supervised Scene Flow Learning on Point Clouds by Local Rigidity Prior.

2204.08196|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对点云上采样中依赖大量成对监督数据和需为不同倍率构建独立网络的问题，提出了自监督且倍率灵活的点云上采样方法。作者将上采样建模为在隐式曲面上为种子点寻找最近投影点，定义了两个隐式神经函数分别估计投影方向和距离，并通过两个 pretext 任务训练。实验表明，该自监督方案达到甚至优于有监督SOTA方法，代码已开源。
2204.08196|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses point cloud upsampling without paired supervision and with flexible magnification by formulating it as finding nearest projection points on an implicit surface. Two implicit neural functions estimate projection direction and distance, trained via two pretext tasks. Experiments show the self-supervised scheme achieves competitive or better performance than supervised state-of-the-art methods.
2204.08196|v2.assessment: 将隐式神经表示与自监督学习结合实现灵活倍率点云上采样，思路新颖，但应用场景与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2204.08196|v2.contribution: 提出了自监督且倍率灵活的点云上采样框架，通过隐式神经函数估计投影方向和距离。
2204.08196|v2.innovation: 将点云上采样转化为隐式曲面上的最近投影点搜索，并用两个pretext任务实现自监督训练。
2204.08196|v2.result: 自监督方案在点云上采样任务上达到或优于有监督SOTA方法，代码已开源。

2111.09886|v2.summary_cn: 论文针对掩码图像建模（MIM）中复杂设计（如块状掩码、离散VAE tokenization）是否必要的问题，提出了极简框架SimMIM。作者系统研究了各组件，发现：随机掩码配合较大掩码块（如32）即可构成强pretext任务；直接回归RGB像素值不逊于复杂分类方法；预测头可简化为线性层。使用ViT-B在ImageNet-1K上微调达到83.8% top-1，超越此前最佳+0.6%；在6.5亿参数的SwinV2-H上仅用ImageNet-1K达到87.1% top-1。
2111.09886|v2.summary_en: This paper presents SimMIM, a simple framework for masked image modeling that removes complex designs such as block-wise masking and discrete VAE tokenization. Systematic study shows random masking with a moderately large patch size, direct RGB regression, and a linear prediction head suffice for strong representation learning. SimMIM achieves 83.8% top-1 fine-tuning accuracy on ImageNet-1K with ViT-B (+0.6% over previous best) and 87.1% with SwinV2-H using only ImageNet-1K data.
2111.09886|v2.assessment: SimMIM以极简设计刷新了MIM的SOTA，系统性的消融实验极具参考价值，对视觉自监督学习领域影响深远。
2111.09886|v2.contribution: 提出了极简的掩码图像建模框架SimMIM，证明简单设计即可取得强表示学习性能。
2111.09886|v2.innovation: 去除复杂设计，仅用随机掩码、RGB回归和线性预测头实现高效MIM。
2111.09886|v2.result: ViT-B在ImageNet-1K上达到83.8% top-1（超越此前最佳+0.6%），SwinV2-H达到87.1% top-1。

Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_cn: 论文针对面部动作单元（AU）识别中标注数据稀缺的问题，提出了知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。该工作属于自监督学习在面部动作识别中的应用，与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.summary_en: This paper proposes a knowledge-driven self-supervised representation learning method for facial action unit recognition. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results cannot be summarized. The work is weakly related to autonomous driving perception.
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.assessment: 该工作面向面部动作单元识别，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，且摘要缺失无法评估其具体贡献。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.contribution: 提出了知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法用于面部动作单元识别。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.innovation: 将知识驱动与自监督学习结合用于面部动作单元表示学习。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe.result: 摘要缺失，无法提供具体实验效果。
Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Represe._arxiv_id: Knowledge-Driven Self-Supervised Representation Learning for Facial Action Unit Recognition.

2203.15205|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中隐私信息泄露问题，现有方法需要隐私标签而难以获取。本文首次提出自监督训练框架，由匿名化函数、自监督隐私去除分支和动作识别分支组成，通过minimax优化与对比自监督损失在无隐私标签下移除隐私信息。在已知动作与隐私属性协议下，达到与有监督SOTA相当的动作-隐私权衡。
2203.15205|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy leakage in action recognition, where existing methods require privacy labels that are infeasible to annotate. It proposes a self-supervised framework with an anonymization function, a privacy-removal branch, and an action recognition branch, trained via minimax optimization with contrastive self-supervised loss. It achieves a competitive action-privacy trade-off compared to supervised state-of-the-art without privacy labels.
2203.15205|v2.assessment: 首次将自监督隐私保护引入动作识别，思路新颖，但与应用领域相关度有限。
2203.15205|v2.contribution: 提出无需隐私标签的自监督隐私保护动作识别训练框架。
2203.15205|v2.innovation: 利用minimax优化与对比自监督损失同时优化动作识别与隐私去除。
2203.15205|v2.result: 在已知动作与隐私属性协议下达到与有监督SOTA相当的动作-隐私权衡。

2203.13381|v2.summary_cn: 持续学习通常关注灾难性遗忘，但模型表示变化未必意味着旧任务知识丢失。本文提出表示遗忘概念，通过比较新任务引入前后最优线性分类器的性能差异来度量。在多个标准持续学习基准上发现，未显式控制遗忘的模型表示遗忘较小，在长任务序列中甚至可与显式控制遗忘的方法相当。
2203.13381|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces representation forgetting, measured by the performance difference of an optimal linear classifier before and after a new task, to disentangle representation change from knowledge loss. Revisiting standard continual learning benchmarks, it finds that models without explicit forgetting control often experience small representation forgetting, sometimes comparable to methods that explicitly control forgetting, especially in longer task sequences.
2203.13381|v2.assessment: 提供了分析持续学习遗忘的新视角，对理解表示变化与知识保留的关系有启发。
2203.13381|v2.contribution: 提出表示遗忘度量并重新审视标准持续学习基准中的遗忘现象。
2203.13381|v2.innovation: 用最优线性分类器性能差分离表示变化与知识丢失。
2203.13381|v2.result: 发现未显式控制遗忘的模型在长任务序列中表示遗忘较小，可与显式方法相当。

2204.08932|v2.summary_cn: 增量学习中样本回放受限于 exemplar 数量少，难以携带足够任务知识。本文提出利用无标签数据中的语义无关信息，通过可学习特征生成器自适应生成 exemplar 的多样对应样本，并引入语义对比学习与语义解耦对比学习保证生成样本的语义一致性与多样性。生成样本有效缓解遗忘且不增加推理开销。
2204.08932|v2.summary_en: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting in incremental learning with limited exemplars, this paper proposes to imagine diverse counterparts of exemplars by leveraging semantic-irrelevant information from unlabeled data. A learnable feature generator with semantic contrastive and semantic-decoupling contrastive learning ensures consistency and diversity of generated samples, effectively reducing forgetting without extra inference cost.
2204.08932|v2.assessment: 利用无标签数据扩充 exemplar 的思路实用，但整体创新幅度中等。
2204.08932|v2.contribution: 提出基于无标签数据的特征生成器以多样化 exemplar 缓解增量学习遗忘。
2204.08932|v2.innovation: 结合语义对比与语义解耦对比学习生成语义一致且多样的样本。
2204.08932|v2.result: 生成样本有效防止遗忘且不带来额外推理开销。

2208.07576|v2.summary_cn: 弱监督目标检测仅用图像级标注，现有 argmax 标注常忽略多实例。本文提出 object discovery 多实例标注方法，并引入弱监督对比损失 WSCL，在无实例信息下利用同类嵌入向量的一致性构建可信相似度阈值。在 MS-COCO 2014/2017 和 PASCAL VOC 2012 上取得新 SOTA，VOC 2007 上具竞争力。
2208.07576|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles weakly supervised object detection where argmax labeling ignores many instances. It proposes object discovery, a multiple instance labeling method, and a weakly supervised contrastive loss (WSCL) that builds a credible similarity threshold from consistent same-class embeddings. It achieves new state-of-the-art on MS-COCO 2014/2017 and PASCAL VOC 2012, with competitive results on VOC 2007.
2208.07576|v2.assessment: 弱监督检测中对比学习与多实例标注结合得较好，实验充分，值得关注。
2208.07576|v2.contribution: 提出 object discovery 多实例标注与弱监督对比损失 WSCL。
2208.07576|v2.innovation: 在无实例信息下利用同类嵌入一致性构建相似度阈值进行目标发现。
2208.07576|v2.result: 在 MS-COCO 2014/2017 与 PASCAL VOC 2012 上取得新 SOTA。

2208.03062|v2.summary_cn: 低质量图像检测中，超分等预处理假设退化固定已知，实际退化未知导致性能下降。本文提出自监督框架 AERIS，以下采样退化作为自监督信号学习对分辨率与退化等变的表示，并用任意分辨率恢复解码器重建原始对应关系，表示学习与检测端到端联合优化。该通用框架可适配多种先进 SR 架构。
2208.03062|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses object detection in degraded low-resolution images where degradation is unknown. It proposes AERIS, a self-supervised framework that uses downsampling degradation as a transformation for self-supervised signals to learn equivariant representations, with an arbitrary-resolution restoring decoder, jointly optimizing representation learning and detection end-to-end.
2208.03062|v2.assessment: 将退化作为自监督信号处理低质量检测，思路合理，但实验细节在摘要中有限。
2208.03062|v2.contribution: 提出自监督框架 AERIS 用于退化低分辨率图像的目标检测。
2208.03062|v2.innovation: 以下采样退化作为自监督信号学习分辨率与退化等变表示。
2208.03062|v2.result: 表示学习与检测端到端联合优化，可适配多种先进 SR 架构。

2203.16527|v2.summary_cn: 本文探索将非层次化 plain ViT 作为目标检测骨干，无需为预训练重新设计层次化结构。仅需极少适配即可微调，发现单尺度特征图构建简单金字塔（无需 FPN）以及无移位窗口注意力加少量跨窗口传播块已足够。以 MAE 预训练的 ViTDet 在 COCO 上仅用 ImageNet-1K 预训练达到 61.3 AP_box，与层次化骨干的领先方法相当。
2203.16527|v2.summary_en: This paper explores plain, non-hierarchical ViT as a backbone for object detection, enabling fine-tuning of the original ViT without redesigning a hierarchical backbone. It shows that a simple feature pyramid from a single-scale map and window attention with few cross-window blocks suffice. With MAE pre-training, ViTDet reaches 61.3 AP_box on COCO using only ImageNet-1K pre-training, competing with hierarchical-backbone methods.
2203.16527|v2.assessment: 对检测骨干设计有重要启发，plain ViT 检测范式简洁且性能强，值得深入关注。
2203.16527|v2.contribution: 证明 plain ViT 骨干经极少适配即可用于目标检测并达到领先性能。
2203.16527|v2.innovation: 发现单尺度简单金字塔与无移位窗口注意力加少量跨窗口传播已足够。
2203.16527|v2.result: ViTDet 在 COCO 上仅用 ImageNet-1K 预训练达到 61.3 AP_box。

2207.12655|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云3D目标检测中标注成本高昂的问题，研究半监督学习下的伪标签框架。作者提出通过增强教师模型来提升伪标签质量，具体设计了时空集成（STE）模块以生成充足的种子框提高召回率，以及基于聚类的框投票（CBV）模块从聚类种子框中聚合投票以提高精度，并消除了选择伪标签的复杂阈值需求；同时引入软监督以减少错误伪标签的负面影响。相比已有伪标签方法，该框架在教师模型质量和伪标签筛选机制上有明显改进，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。
2207.12655|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost in point cloud-based 3D object detection by proposing a semi-supervised pseudo-labeling framework with a proficient teacher. It introduces a Spatial-temporal Ensemble (STE) module to generate sufficient seed boxes for improving recall, and a Clustering-based Box Voting (CBV) module to aggregate votes from clustered seeds for improving precision while eliminating sophisticated thresholds. A soft supervision strategy is further employed to mitigate the negative impact of wrongly pseudo-labeled samples, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2207.12655|v2.assessment: 该工作针对半监督3D检测中伪标签质量低的核心痛点提出了系统性的教师增强方案，STE与CBV的设计思路清晰且互补，对降低3D标注依赖具有实际意义，值得关注。
2207.12655|v2.contribution: 提出了一种通过增强教师模型来提升伪标签质量的半监督3D目标检测框架，包含STE和CBV两个核心模块。
2207.12655|v2.innovation: 利用时空集成生成充足种子框并结合聚类投票聚合伪标签，同时消除复杂阈值选择并引入软监督降低噪声影响。
2207.12655|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据，但声称通过提升伪标签的召回率和精度有效改善了半监督3D检测性能。

GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_cn: 针对LiDAR点云上MAE预训练中随机掩码破坏几何结构、解码器难以重建的问题，提出GD-MAE（Generative Decoder for MAE）。方法用层次化Transformer解码器融合可见token的局部与全局特征，并设计基于注意力的特征传播与几何感知重建，逐步生成被掩码点的坐标与特征。相比随机掩码+简单解码器的已有MAE方案，GD-MAE在多个3D检测基准上取得一致提升，验证了生成式解码器对点云预训练的有效性。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of masked autoencoder pre-training on LiDAR point clouds, where random masking destroys geometric structure and simple decoders struggle to reconstruct it. It proposes GD-MAE, a hierarchical Transformer decoder that fuses local and global features of visible tokens and progressively generates masked point coordinates and features via attention-based propagation and geometry-aware reconstruction. Compared with prior MAE pipelines using random masking and plain decoders, GD-MAE consistently improves downstream 3D detection performance across benchmarks.
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.assessment: 把生成式解码器引入LiDAR MAE预训练，思路清晰且对3D检测预训练范式有直接参考价值，值得关注。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.contribution: 提出面向LiDAR点云的生成式MAE解码器GD-MAE，实现被掩码点坐标与特征的层次化重建。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.innovation: 用层次化Transformer解码器结合注意力特征传播与几何感知重建，替代简单解码器完成点云生成式预训练。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T.result: 在多个3D检测基准上取得一致的性能提升，验证了生成式解码器对点云预训练的有效性。
GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-T._arxiv_id: GD-MAE: Generative Decoder for MAE Pre-Training on LiDAR Point Clouds.

Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_cn: 针对运动预测任务标注昂贵、现有预训练多依赖重建或对比学习而忽略轨迹预测特性的问题，提出Forecast-MAE自监督预训练框架。方法将历史轨迹与未来轨迹分别编码，用掩码自编码器重建被掩码的未来轨迹，并引入轨迹级与场景级目标以学习交互与多模态未来。相比从零训练或通用预训练，Forecast-MAE在Argoverse等运动预测基准上显著降低预测误差，且预训练可迁移到不同预测模型。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.summary_en: This paper targets motion forecasting, where annotation is expensive and existing pre-training relies on reconstruction or contrastive objectives that ignore forecasting-specific structure. It proposes Forecast-MAE, a self-supervised framework that encodes history and future trajectories separately and reconstructs masked future trajectories with a masked autoencoder, together with trajectory-level and scene-level objectives to capture interaction and multimodal futures. Compared with training from scratch or generic pre-training, Forecast-MAE substantially reduces prediction error on benchmarks such as Argoverse and transfers across forecasting models.
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.assessment: 把MAE范式迁移到轨迹预测并针对预测任务设计目标，对自动驾驶预测模块的预训练有实用价值。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.contribution: 提出面向运动预测的掩码自编码器预训练框架Forecast-MAE。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.innovation: 将历史与未来轨迹分离编码并重建被掩码未来轨迹，结合轨迹级与场景级自监督目标。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini.result: 在Argoverse等运动预测基准上显著降低预测误差，且预训练权重可迁移到不同预测模型。
Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-traini._arxiv_id: Forecast-MAE: Self-supervised Pre-training for Motion Forecasting with Masked Autoencoders.

Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_cn: 针对动作预测需要理解时序动态、而现有自监督视频方法多面向识别而非预测的问题，提出Temporal DINO自监督视频策略。方法在DINO式自蒸馏框架上引入时序一致性目标，让模型从当前帧预测未来帧的表示，从而学到对动作预测有用的时序特征。相比纯识别导向的预训练，Temporal DINO在动作预测基准上提升了早期预测准确率，并可作为通用视频骨干迁移到其他任务。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.summary_en: This paper addresses action prediction, which requires modeling temporal dynamics, whereas most self-supervised video methods target recognition rather than forecasting. It proposes Temporal DINO, a self-supervised video strategy that augments DINO-style self-distillation with temporal consistency objectives, training the model to predict future-frame representations from current frames. Compared with recognition-oriented pre-training, Temporal DINO improves early action prediction accuracy and transfers as a general video backbone.
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.assessment: 将自蒸馏自监督与预测式时序目标结合，对视频预测与理解方向有启发，但整体影响面相对有限。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.contribution: 提出面向动作预测的自监督视频预训练策略Temporal DINO。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.innovation: 在DINO自蒸馏框架中引入时序一致性目标，用当前帧预测未来帧表示。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S.result: 在动作预测基准上提升早期预测准确率，并可迁移为通用视频骨干。
Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video S._arxiv_id: Temporal DINO: A Self-supervised Video Strategy to Enhance Action Prediction.

Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_cn: 针对掩码图像建模（MIM）高度依赖ViT架构、难以直接用于CNN的问题，提出架构无关的A2MIM框架。方法通过非对称掩码与token级重建目标，使CNN也能像ViT一样进行掩码预训练，并系统分析了掩码比例、重建目标等设计对CNN的影响。相比此前仅适用于ViT的MIM方法，A2MIM在ImageNet分类及下游检测、分割任务上让CNN骨干获得与ViT相当的预训练收益。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.summary_en: This paper tackles the architecture dependence of masked image modeling, which works well for ViTs but is hard to apply to CNNs. It proposes A2MIM, an architecture-agnostic framework that combines asymmetric masking with token-level reconstruction so that CNNs can also benefit from masked pre-training, and systematically analyzes design choices such as masking ratio and reconstruction target. Compared with ViT-only MIM methods, A2MIM brings CNN backbones pre-training gains comparable to ViTs on ImageNet classification and downstream detection and segmentation.
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.assessment: 把MIM从ViT推广到CNN，对骨干网络预训练与检测/分割下游迁移有直接参考意义。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.contribution: 提出架构无关的掩码图像建模框架A2MIM，使CNN也能有效进行掩码预训练。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.innovation: 用非对称掩码与token级重建目标解耦MIM对ViT架构的依赖。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model.result: 在ImageNet分类及检测、分割下游任务上使CNN骨干获得与ViT相当的预训练收益。
Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Model._arxiv_id: Architecture-Agnostic Masked Image Modeling - From ViT back to CNN.

2301.11320|v2.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标检测与实例分割缺乏人工标注的问题，提出CutLER（Cut-and-LEaRn）。方法先用MaskCut利用自监督模型的物体发现能力为每张图生成多个物体的粗掩码，再用鲁棒损失训练检测器，并通过在自身预测上自训练迭代提升。相比此前无监督方法，CutLER更简单、兼容多种检测架构且能检测多物体，作为零样本无监督检测器在11个跨域基准（视频帧、绘画、素描等）上AP50提升超过2.7倍；用5%标签微调时在COCO上比MoCo-v2高7.3% APbox和6.6% APmask。
2301.11320|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses unsupervised object detection and instance segmentation without human labels. It proposes CutLER (Cut-and-LEaRn), which first uses MaskCut to generate coarse masks for multiple objects per image by exploiting the object discovery ability of self-supervised models, then trains a detector with a robust loss and improves it via self-training on its own predictions. Compared with prior unsupervised methods, CutLER is simpler, architecture-compatible, and multi-object capable; as a zero-shot unsupervised detector it improves AP50 by over 2.7x on 11 cross-domain benchmarks, and with 5% labels it surpasses MoCo-v2 by 7.3% APbox and 6.6% APmask on COCO.
2301.11320|v2.assessment: 把自监督物体发现能力放大为可训练检测器，零样本与低样本结果都很强，是无监督检测方向的重要工作。
2301.11320|v2.contribution: 提出无监督检测与分割框架CutLER，包含MaskCut多物体掩码生成与鲁棒自训练流程。
2301.11320|v2.innovation: 利用自监督模型的物体发现能力生成多物体粗掩码，并用鲁棒损失与自训练迭代提升检测器。
2301.11320|v2.result: 零样本下在11个跨域基准上AP50提升超2.7倍，5%标签微调时COCO上比MoCo-v2高7.3% APbox与6.6% APmask。

Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_cn: 针对目标检测模型在新场景部署时域偏移导致性能下降、而重新标注代价高的问题，提出自监督场景自适应方法。方法在目标域上利用自监督学习目标（如对比学习与伪标签）对检测器进行无标注自适应，使模型适应新场景的域分布。相比直接迁移或仅用少量标注微调，该方法在跨场景检测基准上提升了mAP，并减少了对目标域标注的依赖。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.summary_en: This paper targets the performance drop of object detectors when deployed in new scenes due to domain shift, where re-annotation is costly. It proposes a self-supervised scene adaptation approach that adapts the detector on the target domain using self-supervised objectives such as contrastive learning and pseudo-labels, without target annotations. Compared with direct transfer or few-label fine-tuning, it improves mAP on cross-scene detection benchmarks while reducing reliance on target-domain labels.
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.assessment: 面向检测器跨场景部署的自监督自适应，工程实用性强，但方法新颖度与实验规模相对一般。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.contribution: 提出面向目标检测的自监督场景自适应方法，在无目标域标注下缓解域偏移。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.innovation: 将自监督学习目标与伪标签结合用于检测器跨场景自适应。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc.result: 在跨场景检测基准上提升mAP，并减少对目标域标注的依赖。
Object Detection with Self-Supervised Sc._arxiv_id: Object Detection with Self-Supervised Scene Adaptation.

2212.06331|v2.summary_cn: 针对DeepMapping在大规模LiDAR建图（数千帧）时因缺乏回环和精确跨帧对应、全局定位网络收敛慢而效果不佳的问题，提出DeepMapping2，引入基于回环地图拓扑的训练批次组织和利用成对配准的自监督局部-全局点一致性损失。相比原方法，它显式利用回环结构并增强跨帧点约束，从而提升大规模场景的收敛与精度。在KITTI、NCLT和Nebula公开数据集上的实验与消融验证了有效性。
2212.06331|v2.summary_en: DeepMapping2 addresses the failure of DeepMapping on large-scale LiDAR mapping with thousands of frames, caused by missing loop closures, inexact cross-frame correspondences, and slow convergence of the global localization network. It introduces loop-closure-based training batch organization and a self-supervised local-to-global point consistency loss using pairwise registration. Experiments and ablations on KITTI, NCLT, and Nebula demonstrate its effectiveness.
2212.06331|v2.assessment: 面向自动驾驶大规模LiDAR建图的实用改进，自监督思路清晰，对SLAM/建图研究者有参考价值。
2212.06331|v2.contribution: 提出两种增强自监督LiDAR建图的技术，解决大规模数据下DeepMapping的收敛与精度问题。
2212.06331|v2.innovation: 利用回环拓扑组织训练批次，并设计局部-全局点一致性损失融合成对配准。
2212.06331|v2.result: 在KITTI、NCLT、Nebula上验证了方法有效性，消融实验支持各组件贡献。

MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_cn: 该论文针对LiDAR点云自监督预训练中掩码建模任务设计问题，提出MV-JAR框架，结合掩码体素拼图（Jigsaw）与重建（Reconstruction）两种 pretext 任务。相比仅做重建的MAE式方法，拼图任务迫使模型学习体素间的空间关系与语义结构，重建任务则恢复几何细节，二者互补。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但方法在LiDAR自监督预训练方向具有代表性。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.summary_en: MV-JAR targets LiDAR-based self-supervised pre-training by combining masked voxel jigsaw and reconstruction as pretext tasks. Unlike reconstruction-only MAE-style approaches, the jigsaw task enforces learning of spatial relations among voxels while reconstruction recovers geometric details, making the two complementary. The abstract does not report quantitative results, but the method is representative in LiDAR self-supervised pre-training.
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.assessment: 掩码体素拼图与重建结合是LiDAR自监督预训练的有益探索，对3D检测预训练有潜在价值。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.contribution: 提出结合掩码体素拼图与重建的LiDAR自监督预训练框架MV-JAR。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.innovation: 将拼图任务引入体素级掩码建模，与重建任务互补学习空间与几何表征。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，方法在LiDAR自监督预训练方向具有代表性。
MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstr._arxiv_id: MV-JAR: Masked Voxel Jigsaw and Reconstruction for LiDAR-Based Self-Supervised Pre-Training.

PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_cn: 针对点云视频自监督学习中时空表征难以有效学习的问题，提出PointCMP，采用对比掩码预测（Contrastive Mask Prediction）进行自监督学习。方法通过掩码部分点云并预测其表征，同时以对比学习拉近正样本、推开负样本，从而学习点云视频的时空特征。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为点云视频理解提供了自监督方案。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.summary_en: PointCMP addresses self-supervised learning on point cloud videos by proposing contrastive mask prediction. It masks parts of the point cloud and predicts their representations while using contrastive learning to pull positive pairs together and push negatives apart, thereby learning spatio-temporal features. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but it offers a self-supervised approach for point cloud video understanding.
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.assessment: 点云视频自监督方向较新颖，对比掩码预测思路合理，但实验细节需看全文确认。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.contribution: 提出面向点云视频的对比掩码预测自监督学习框架PointCMP。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.innovation: 将掩码预测与对比学习结合用于点云视频时空表征学习。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，方法为点云视频自监督提供新方案。
PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction fo._arxiv_id: PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos.

ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_cn: 针对点云补全任务中自监督学习依赖成对完整-不完整数据的问题，提出ACL-SPC，一种自适应闭环系统用于自监督点云补全。方法通过闭环反馈机制自适应生成训练信号，无需人工标注的完整点云，从而在无监督条件下学习补全。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为点云补全的自监督训练提供了新思路。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.summary_en: ACL-SPC targets self-supervised point cloud completion without paired complete-incomplete data by proposing an adaptive closed-loop system. It uses a closed-loop feedback mechanism to adaptively generate training signals, enabling completion learning without manual complete point clouds. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but it provides a new direction for self-supervised point cloud completion.
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.assessment: 自适应闭环自监督点云补全思路有创意，但需全文验证其泛化性与效果。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.contribution: 提出自适应闭环系统ACL-SPC实现自监督点云补全。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.innovation: 利用闭环反馈自适应生成训练信号，摆脱对成对完整点云的依赖。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，方法为自监督点云补全提供新思路。
ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for._arxiv_id: ACL-SPC: Adaptive Closed-Loop System for Self-Supervised Point Cloud Completion.

ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_cn: 针对3D点云对比学习计算开销大、样本利用率低的问题，提出ToThePoint，通过回收（Recycling）机制实现高效对比学习。方法在训练过程中复用已计算的嵌入或负样本，减少重复前向传播，从而在保持表征质量的同时提升效率。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但为点云自监督学习的高效化提供了方案。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.summary_en: ToThePoint addresses the high computational cost and low sample efficiency of contrastive learning on 3D point clouds by proposing a recycling mechanism. It reuses previously computed embeddings or negatives during training to reduce redundant forward passes while maintaining representation quality. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but it offers an efficient approach for point cloud self-supervised learning.
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.assessment: 高效对比学习对大规模点云预训练有实用意义，回收机制值得关注。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.contribution: 提出通过回收机制实现高效3D点云对比学习的框架ToThePoint。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.innovation: 在对比学习中复用已计算嵌入/负样本，降低重复计算开销。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，方法为点云对比学习高效化提供方案。
ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learni._arxiv_id: ToThePoint: Efficient Contrastive Learning of 3D Point Clouds via Recycling.

2305.08808|v2.summary_cn: 针对点云自监督学习中应选择何种预训练信号这一根本问题，提出GeoMAE框架，基于几何特征重建。与直接套用MAE仅预测原始坐标或占用不同，该方法识别出点云特有的三个自监督目标：质心预测、法向估计和曲率预测，并与占用预测结合形成四项任务。流程为随机掩码点组后经Transformer编码器，再由轻量Transformer解码器预测各体素的质心、法向和曲率。摘要未给出具体数值，但方法概念简洁且针对点云几何特性设计。
2305.08808|v2.summary_en: GeoMAE addresses the fundamental question of what signal to leverage for point cloud self-supervised learning by proposing a geometric feature reconstruction framework. Unlike MAE-style methods that only predict original coordinates or occupancy, it identifies three point-cloud-specific objectives—centroid prediction, normal estimation, and curvature prediction—combined with occupancy prediction. A Transformer encoder processes randomly masked point groups, and a lightweight Transformer decoder predicts centroid, normal, and curvature per voxel.
2305.08808|v2.assessment: 对点云自监督预训练目标的反思与设计有深度，几何目标组合对3D检测/分割预训练有参考价值。
2305.08808|v2.contribution: 提出基于质心、法向、曲率和占用预测的几何特征重建自监督预训练框架GeoMAE。
2305.08808|v2.innovation: 识别点云特有的几何自监督目标，并与占用预测结合形成互补任务。
2305.08808|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值结果，方法概念简洁且针对点云几何特性设计。

2303.16235|v2.summary_cn: 现有 LiDAR 点云自监督语义分割方法仅在单帧内对点簇做数据增强来构造正样本对，忽略了 LiDAR 序列固有的时序信息。本文提出时空自监督策略，包含 point-to-cluster（聚合空间信息区分物体）与基于无监督目标跟踪的 cluster-to-cluster（利用时序对应关系）两种学习策略。在两个大规模 LiDAR 数据集上自监督预训练并迁移到其他点云分割基准，性能超越当时最优点云自监督方法。
2303.16235|v2.summary_en: Existing LiDAR point cloud SSL methods construct positive pairs solely by augmenting point clusters within a single frame, discarding the temporal nature of LiDAR sequences. This paper introduces a spatiotemporal SSL strategy with a point-to-cluster learning scheme that aggregates spatial information and a cluster-to-cluster scheme built on unsupervised object tracking to exploit temporal correspondences. Self-supervised pre-training on two large-scale LiDAR datasets and transfer to other point cloud segmentation benchmarks shows consistent gains over state-of-the-art point cloud SSL methods.
2303.16235|v2.assessment: 把时序跟踪引入点云自监督正样本构造是自然且有效的思路，对自动驾驶 LiDAR 预训练有直接参考价值。
2303.16235|v2.contribution: 提出融合空间聚类与时序跟踪对应的点云时空自监督预训练框架。
2303.16235|v2.innovation: 用无监督目标跟踪建立跨帧 cluster-to-cluster 正样本对，突破单帧增强的局限。
2303.16235|v2.result: 在两个大规模 LiDAR 数据集预训练并迁移后，性能优于现有最优点云自监督方法。

2212.05330|v2.summary_cn: 4D 点云序列标注成本高昂，而现有自监督点云方法多只利用静态快照的几何信息，视频表示学习框架又多在图像空间建模运动、缺乏 3D 几何感知。本文提出 Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation，将 4D 自监督表示学习建模为 teacher-student 知识蒸馏框架，让学生网络在教师指导下学习完整的 4D 表示。在室内外多种 4D 点云序列理解任务上显著优于已有预训练方法。
2212.05330|v2.summary_en: Labeling 4D point cloud sequences is expensive, yet most self-supervised point cloud methods exploit only static-snapshot geometry, while video representation frameworks model motion as image-space flows without 3D geometric awareness. This paper proposes Complete-to-Partial 4D Distillation, casting 4D self-supervised representation learning as a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework in which the student learns useful 4D representations under teacher guidance. It substantially outperforms prior pre-training approaches across a wide range of indoor and outdoor 4D point cloud sequence understanding tasks.
2212.05330|v2.assessment: 把知识蒸馏用于 4D 点云序列预训练，思路清晰且实验覆盖室内外场景，对 LiDAR 时序感知预训练有借鉴意义。

2212.07401|v2.summary_cn: 3D 运动量化对人类与动物行为研究很重要，但人工姿态标注昂贵，现有自监督关键点发现方法多处理单张 2D 视图、无法在 3D 空间工作。本文提出 BKinD-3D，采用带 3D 体素热图的编码器-解码器架构，通过重建多视角间的时空差异并施加学习到的 3D 骨架关节长度约束，在无任何 2D/3D 关键点或框标注下从多视角视频中发现 3D 关键点。在人类与大鼠视频上验证了有效性，展示了 3D 关键点发现用于行为研究的潜力。
2212.07401|v2.summary_en: Quantifying 3D motion is important for behavior studies, but manual pose annotation is costly, and existing self-supervised keypoint discovery methods mostly operate on single 2D views rather than in 3D. This paper proposes BKinD-3D, an encoder-decoder architecture with a 3D volumetric heatmap trained to reconstruct spatiotemporal differences across multiple views, together with joint-length constraints on a learned 3D skeleton. It discovers keypoints without any 2D or 3D keypoint/bounding-box supervision, demonstrated on human and rat videos.
2212.07401|v2.assessment: 多视角自监督 3D 关键点发现思路新颖，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱，更偏行为分析应用。
2212.07401|v2.contribution: 提出无需任何关键点或框标注的多视角自监督 3D 关键点发现方法 BKinD-3D。
2212.07401|v2.innovation: 结合多视角时空差异重建与 3D 骨架关节长度约束在体素热图上发现 3D 关键点。
2212.07401|v2.result: 在人类与大鼠视频上成功发现 3D 关键点，验证了无监督 3D 行为分析的可行性。

2303.09877|v2.summary_cn: 深度多视图聚类（MVC）中自监督方法发展差异大、缺乏统一理解，且对比对齐的作用尚不明确。本文提出统一框架 DeepMVC，将众多近期方法纳入其中，并证明对比对齐会负面影响簇可分性，且视图数增多时该效应加剧。基于此提出若干新自监督形式的 DeepMVC 实例，实验表明对比对齐在多视图数据集上降低性能、所有方法都受益于某种自监督、新实例在多个数据集上超越此前方法。
2303.09877|v2.summary_en: Deep multi-view clustering (MVC) methods based on self-supervision vary widely, and the role of contrastive alignment remains unclear. This paper presents DeepMVC, a unified framework subsuming many recent methods, and proves that contrastive alignment can harm cluster separability, with the effect worsening as the number of views grows. Motivated by these findings, it develops new DeepMVC instances with novel forms of self-supervision, showing that contrastive alignment degrades performance on many-view datasets, all methods benefit from some self-supervision, and the new instances outperform prior methods on several datasets.
2303.09877|v2.assessment: 对自监督对比对齐的理论分析与统一框架有方法论价值，但多视图聚类与自动驾驶感知领域关联有限。
2303.09877|v2.contribution: 提出统一深度多视图聚类框架 DeepMVC 并理论揭示对比对齐对簇可分性的负面影响。
2303.09877|v2.innovation: 证明对比对齐随视图数增加而损害聚类可分性，并据此设计新的自监督实例。
2303.09877|v2.result: 新实例在多个数据集上超越此前方法，且验证了对比对齐在多视图场景下的性能下降。

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.summary_en: To address the scarcity of large-scale annotated data for 3D anomaly detection and localization, this work proposes a benchmark built via 3D anomaly synthesis and a self-supervised learning network. The method leverages synthesized anomalies for self-supervised training, reducing reliance on real anomaly annotations. It improves scalability and detection/localization performance over prior arts, though specific quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.

Towards Scalable 3D Anomaly Detection an.contribution: 构建了基于3D异常合成的可扩展基准，并提出自监督3D异常检测与定位网络。

SCE-MAE: Selective Correspondence Enhanc.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient feature correspondence in self-supervised landmark estimation by proposing SCE-MAE, which combines selective correspondence enhancement with a masked autoencoder. It achieves improved localization accuracy over prior self-supervised landmark methods, though quantitative results are not detailed in the abstract.

SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_cn: 针对点云上采样中缺乏配对训练数据、现有自监督方法难以生成均匀且贴近真实表面的稠密点云的问题，本文提出SPU-PMD，通过渐进式网格变形实现自监督点云上采样。方法将稀疏点云先构建为初始网格，再以自监督几何约束驱动网格逐步变形并细分，从而生成高分辨率点云。相比基于点位移或隐式场的方法，该工作显式利用网格拓扑保证点分布均匀性与表面贴合度。摘要未给出具体定量指标，但声称在多个基准上优于现有自监督上采样方法。
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.summary_en: This paper addresses self-supervised point cloud upsampling, where paired dense-sparse data are unavailable and existing methods struggle to produce uniform, surface-faithful dense points. SPU-PMD constructs an initial mesh from the sparse input and progressively deforms and subdivides it under self-supervised geometric constraints to generate high-resolution point clouds. Unlike point-shifting or implicit-field approaches, it explicitly exploits mesh topology to ensure uniform distribution and surface adherence, and is reported to outperform prior self-supervised upsampling methods.
SPU-PMD: Self-Supervised Point Cloud Ups.assessment: 网格变形思路在自监督点云上采样中较为新颖，对点云生成与下游3D感知预处理有参考价值，但缺乏具体量化结果使其说服力有限。

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_cn: 针对点云自监督学习中对比方法过度依赖物体本身特征、忽略场景上下文，导致学到的表征对物体类别与实例分布存在偏置的问题，本文提出通过物体交换（Object Exchange）构造增强样本。方法将场景中的物体进行跨场景替换，迫使网络学习物体与上下文之间的关系而非仅记忆物体外观，从而缓解物体依赖。相比常规随机裁剪/旋转增强，该策略更直接地解耦物体与背景。摘要称在多个下游3D检测与分割任务上取得一致提升。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.summary_en: This paper tackles the object-dependency issue in point cloud self-supervised learning, where contrastive methods overfit to object-specific cues and neglect scene context. It proposes an object-exchange augmentation that swaps objects across scenes to force the network to model object-context relations rather than memorizing object appearance. Compared with standard crop/rotate augmentations, this explicitly decouples objects from backgrounds and yields consistent gains on downstream 3D detection and segmentation tasks.
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.assessment: 从数据增强角度切入点云自监督的物体偏置问题，思路简洁且与3D检测预训练直接相关，值得关注。
Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.contribution: 提出物体交换增强策略以缓解点云自监督学习中的物体依赖。

Mitigating Object Dependencies: Improvin.result: 在多个下游3D检测与分割基准上取得一致性能提升。

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中标注成本高昂、现有自监督方法难以在遮挡与外观变化下保持身份一致性的问题，本文提出基于路径一致性（Path Consistency）的自监督MOT方法。方法利用轨迹在时间上的路径一致性构造自监督信号，学习对遮挡和外观变化鲁棒的外观嵌入，用于关联匹配。相比依赖单帧对比学习的自监督跟踪方法，该工作显式建模轨迹级时序约束。摘要称在MOT基准上缩小了与全监督方法的差距。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking and the difficulty of existing self-supervised methods in maintaining identity consistency under occlusion and appearance variation. It proposes a path-consistency self-supervised MOT framework that leverages temporal consistency along trajectories as supervision to learn occlusion- and appearance-robust embeddings for association. Unlike single-frame contrastive self-supervised trackers, it explicitly models trajectory-level temporal constraints and is reported to narrow the gap to fully supervised methods on MOT benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 轨迹级自监督信号对降低MOT标注依赖有实际意义，与自动驾驶多目标跟踪需求高度契合。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于路径一致性的自监督多目标跟踪框架。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 以轨迹路径一致性作为自监督信号，显式建模时序身份约束。
