Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Path Consistency.

RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D场景理解中，现有方法依赖类别级文本提示、难以泛化到未见类别且缺乏区域级细粒度对齐的问题，本文提出RegionPLC，即区域点-语言对比学习框架。方法通过生成区域级点云描述并与语言嵌入进行对比对齐，实现开放词汇的3D语义分割与检测，无需闭集类别标注。相比全局点-文本对齐方法，区域级监督显著提升了对细粒度与未见类别的识别能力。摘要称在开放世界3D分割基准上大幅超越现有方法。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.summary_en: This paper targets open-world 3D scene understanding, where existing methods rely on category-level text prompts and struggle to generalize to unseen classes with fine-grained region-level alignment. It proposes RegionPLC, a regional point-language contrastive learning framework that aligns region-level point descriptions with language embeddings for open-vocabulary 3D segmentation and detection without closed-set labels. Compared with global point-text alignment, region-level supervision substantially improves fine-grained and unseen-class recognition, and is reported to largely outperform prior methods on open-world 3D benchmarks.
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.assessment: 区域级点-语言对齐是开放词汇3D感知的关键方向，与BEV/3D检测及开放集识别高度相关，方法完整且实验充分。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.contribution: 提出区域点-语言对比学习框架RegionPLC用于开放世界3D场景理解。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.innovation: 以区域级点云-语言对齐替代全局对齐，实现细粒度开放词汇3D识别。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr.result: 在开放世界3D分割基准上大幅超越现有方法。
RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contr._arxiv_id: RegionPLC: Regional Point-Language Contrastive Learning for Open-World 3D Scene Understanding.

Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中普遍存在的幻觉问题，即模型生成与图像内容不符的描述，本文提出幻觉增强对比学习（HACL）。方法利用模型自身产生的幻觉文本作为困难负样本，构造对比学习目标，使模型在表示空间中将幻觉描述与真实描述区分开。相比仅靠指令微调或RLHF的方法，该工作从表征学习角度直接抑制幻觉。摘要称在多个幻觉评测基准上降低了幻觉率并保持通用能力。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.summary_en: This paper addresses hallucination in multimodal large language models, where generated text is inconsistent with image content. It proposes Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning (HACL), which uses model-generated hallucinated captions as hard negatives in a contrastive objective to separate hallucinated from faithful descriptions in representation space. Unlike instruction tuning or RLHF alone, it directly suppresses hallucination at the representation level and is reported to reduce hallucination rates on multiple benchmarks while preserving general capabilities.
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.assessment: 将幻觉文本作为困难负样本做对比学习思路巧妙，对提升VLM可靠性有参考价值，与多模态感知研究相关。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.contribution: 提出幻觉增强对比学习HACL以抑制多模态大模型幻觉。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.innovation: 把模型自生成幻觉文本作为困难负样本进行表征级对比学习。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear.result: 在多个幻觉评测基准上降低幻觉率并保持通用能力。
Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Lear._arxiv_id: Hallucination Augmented Contrastive Learning for Multimodal Large Language Model.

BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_cn: 针对多模态对比学习（如CLIP）面临的后门攻击威胁，本文提出BadCLIP，一种双嵌入引导的后门攻击方法。方法在训练阶段注入触发器并同时学习干净嵌入与后门嵌入，使模型在正常输入下保持原有对齐、在含触发器输入时被引导至攻击者指定目标，从而绕过现有防御。相比传统后门攻击，双嵌入设计提升了攻击的隐蔽性与持久性。摘要称在多种防御下仍保持高攻击成功率。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.summary_en: This paper studies backdoor threats to multimodal contrastive learning such as CLIP and proposes BadCLIP, a dual-embedding guided backdoor attack. During training it injects a trigger while jointly learning clean and backdoor embeddings, so the model preserves normal alignment on clean inputs but is redirected to attacker-specified targets under triggered inputs, bypassing existing defenses. The dual-embedding design improves stealth and persistence over conventional backdoor attacks, and is reported to maintain high attack success rates under multiple defenses.
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.assessment: 揭示了多模态对比学习的后门脆弱性，对自动驾驶中VLM安全部署有警示意义，但属攻击类工作，与感知主线相关度中等。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.contribution: 提出双嵌入引导的多模态对比学习后门攻击方法BadCLIP。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.innovation: 通过同时学习干净与后门嵌入提升攻击隐蔽性与抗防御能力。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor.result: 在多种防御下仍保持高攻击成功率。
BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor._arxiv_id: BadCLIP: Dual-Embedding Guided Backdoor Attack on Multimodal Contrastive Learning.

SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测方法严重依赖昂贵且稀疏的LiDAR点云标注的问题，本文提出SelfOcc，一种纯视觉、自监督的3D占用预测框架。方法通过设计基于渲染的损失（如深度、语义和场景流）从多视角图像中学习3D几何与语义，无需任何3D占用标签。相比依赖LiDAR监督的方法，SelfOcc在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI等基准上取得了有竞争力的结果，例如在Occ3D上以纯视觉自监督达到约20%的mIoU，并展现出跨数据集的泛化能力。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.summary_en: To address the heavy reliance on costly and sparse LiDAR annotations in 3D occupancy prediction, this paper proposes SelfOcc, a purely vision-based self-supervised framework. It learns 3D geometry and semantics from multi-view images via rendering-based losses (depth, semantic, and scene flow) without any 3D occupancy labels. Compared to LiDAR-supervised methods, SelfOcc achieves competitive results on Occ3D and SemanticKITTI, e.g., around 20% mIoU on Occ3D, and demonstrates cross-dataset generalization.
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.assessment: 首次系统性地将自监督学习引入纯视觉3D占用预测，为降低标注成本提供了新思路，对自动驾驶感知研究有重要参考价值。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.contribution: 提出首个纯视觉自监督3D占用预测框架SelfOcc，无需任何3D占用标注。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.innovation: 利用渲染式自监督信号（深度、语义、场景流）从多视角图像中学习3D占用表示。
SelfOcc: Self-Supervised Vision-Based 3D.result: 在Occ3D和SemanticKITTI上取得有竞争力的自监督结果，并展现出跨数据集泛化能力。

What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_cn: 针对未剪辑多动作视频中时空定位（spatio-temporal grounding）依赖大量人工标注的问题，本文提出一种自监督方法，利用叙述性指令（narrated instructions）自动生成伪标签进行训练。方法通过将指令中的动作描述与视频片段对齐，学习'什么、何时、何地'的联合定位，无需人工标注的边界框和时间戳。相比全监督方法，该方法在多个基准上取得了接近监督性能的结果，显著降低了标注需求。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.summary_en: To address the heavy annotation burden in spatio-temporal grounding for untrimmed multi-action videos, this paper proposes a self-supervised approach that leverages narrated instructions to generate pseudo-labels. It aligns action descriptions with video segments to learn joint 'what, when, and where' grounding without manual bounding boxes or timestamps. Compared to fully supervised methods, it achieves performance close to supervised baselines on several benchmarks while significantly reducing annotation requirements.
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.assessment: 利用叙述性指令进行自监督时空定位是一个新颖且实用的方向，对视频理解和多模态研究有启发意义。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.contribution: 提出利用叙述性指令进行自监督时空定位的方法，无需人工标注。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.innovation: 将指令中的动作描述与视频片段自动对齐，生成伪标签用于联合时空定位学习。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S.result: 在多个基准上取得接近全监督方法的性能，显著降低标注成本。
What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised S._arxiv_id: What, When, and Where? Self-Supervised Spatio- Temporal Grounding in Untrimmed Multi-Action Videos from Narrated Instructions.

Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_cn: 针对超分辨率模型在真实退化场景下泛化能力差的问题，本文提出一种'低分辨率引导'的自监督学习策略。方法先在低分辨率图像上训练超分辨率网络，再通过自监督学习在真实退化数据上微调，利用低分辨率输入作为引导信号。相比直接在合成退化数据上训练的方法，该策略显著提升了在真实场景中的泛化性能，在多个基准上取得了更好的PSNR/SSIM。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.summary_en: To improve the generalization of super-resolution models under real-world degradations, this paper proposes a 'low-resolution leads the way' self-supervised learning strategy. It first trains the SR network on low-resolution images and then fine-tunes on real degraded data via self-supervision, using low-resolution inputs as guidance. Compared to training on synthetic degradations, this approach significantly improves real-world generalization, achieving better PSNR/SSIM on multiple benchmarks.
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.assessment: 虽然与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低，但其自监督泛化思路对视觉模型在真实场景的部署有借鉴意义。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.contribution: 提出低分辨率引导的自监督学习策略，提升超分辨率模型在真实退化场景下的泛化能力。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.innovation: 利用低分辨率输入作为自监督引导信号，分阶段训练超分辨率网络。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General.result: 在多个基准上取得更好的PSNR/SSIM，显著提升真实场景泛化性能。
Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving General._arxiv_id: Low-Res Leads the Way: Improving Generalization for Super-Resolution by Self-Supervised Learning.

Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_cn: 针对面部表示学习中对大量标注数据的依赖问题，本文提出一种具有面部区域感知的自监督学习方法。方法通过设计区域感知的对比学习目标，使模型关注面部不同区域（如眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴）的局部特征，并学习其空间关系。相比通用自监督方法，该方法在多个面部分析任务（如表情识别、人脸验证）上取得了更好的性能，且无需任何人工标注。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.summary_en: To reduce the reliance on large-scale annotations in facial representation learning, this paper proposes a self-supervised method with facial region awareness. It designs region-aware contrastive objectives that encourage the model to focus on local features of different facial regions (e.g., eyes, nose, mouth) and their spatial relations. Compared to generic self-supervised methods, it achieves better performance on multiple facial analysis tasks (e.g., expression recognition, face verification) without any manual annotations.
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.assessment: 将区域感知引入自监督面部表示学习有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度较低。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.contribution: 提出具有面部区域感知的自监督面部表示学习方法。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.innovation: 设计区域感知的对比学习目标，关注面部局部特征及其空间关系。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le.result: 在多个面部分析任务上取得优于通用自监督方法的性能，无需人工标注。
Self-Supervised Facial Representation Le._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Facial Representation Learning with Facial Region Awareness.

CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_cn: 针对无监督目标发现中现有方法依赖自监督Transformer特征但召回率不足的问题，本文提出CuVLER，通过穷尽式利用自监督Transformer特征来增强无监督目标发现。方法结合多尺度特征和注意力机制，生成更全面的目标候选区域，并设计了一种迭代细化策略。相比已有无监督目标发现方法，CuVLER在多个基准上显著提升了召回率和定位精度，例如在VOC和COCO上取得了新的SOTA。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.summary_en: To address the limited recall of existing unsupervised object discovery methods that rely on self-supervised Transformer features, this paper proposes CuVLER, which exhaustively exploits self-supervised Transformer features to enhance object discovery. It combines multi-scale features and attention mechanisms to generate more comprehensive object proposals, with an iterative refinement strategy. Compared to prior unsupervised methods, CuVLER significantly improves recall and localization accuracy, achieving new state-of-the-art on VOC and COCO.
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.assessment: 对开放集检测和无监督目标发现方向有直接推动，方法设计扎实，实验充分，值得关注。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.contribution: 提出CuVLER，通过穷尽式利用自监督Transformer特征增强无监督目标发现。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.innovation: 结合多尺度特征和注意力机制生成更全面的目标候选，并引入迭代细化策略。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis.result: 在VOC和COCO等基准上取得新的SOTA，显著提升召回率和定位精度。
CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Dis._arxiv_id: CuVLER: Enhanced Unsupervised Object Discoveries through Exhaustive Self-Supervised Transformers.

Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_cn: 针对文本引导图像编辑中提示词（prompt）质量影响生成效果的问题，本文提出一种提示增强方法，用于自监督文本引导的图像编辑。方法通过自动扩展和优化输入提示，结合自监督学习策略，使编辑结果更符合文本描述且保持图像内容一致性。相比直接使用原始提示的方法，该增强策略在多个图像编辑基准上提升了生成质量和文本对齐度。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.summary_en: To address the impact of prompt quality on text-guided image manipulation, this paper proposes a prompt augmentation method for self-supervised text-guided image manipulation. It automatically expands and optimizes input prompts with a self-supervised learning strategy, making edits more faithful to text descriptions while preserving image content consistency. Compared to using original prompts, this augmentation improves generation quality and text alignment on multiple image manipulation benchmarks.
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.assessment: 提示增强对多模态生成有实用价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域相关度有限。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.contribution: 提出用于自监督文本引导图像编辑的提示增强方法。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.innovation: 自动扩展和优化输入提示，结合自监督学习提升编辑质量与文本对齐度。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised.result: 在多个图像编辑基准上提升了生成质量和文本对齐度。
Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised._arxiv_id: Prompt Augmentation for Self-supervised Text-guided Image Manipulation.

BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_cn: 该论文针对冷冻电子断层扫描（cryo-ET）中亚断层图（subtomogram）对齐任务中方向估计精度不足的问题，提出了一种名为BOE-ViT的自监督3D对齐方法。方法核心是在Vision Transformer中引入等变性（equivariance）先验，通过自监督学习策略增强模型对3D旋转的感知能力，从而提升方向估计的鲁棒性。相比已有方法，BOE-ViT将等变网络设计与ViT架构结合，避免了对手工标注的依赖。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在方向估计精度上优于基线方法。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of accurate orientation estimation in self-supervised 3D subtomogram alignment for cryo-ET. It proposes BOE-ViT, which integrates equivariance priors into a Vision Transformer to boost rotation-aware representation learning without manual annotations. The method claims improved orientation estimation accuracy over existing baselines, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.assessment: 该工作将等变性与ViT结合用于3D自监督对齐，思路新颖，但应用场景（cryo-ET）与自动驾驶感知领域距离较远，对目标检测/BEV等方向的直接启发有限。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.contribution: 提出BOE-ViT，将等变性先验融入ViT实现自监督3D亚断层图对齐。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.innovation: 在ViT架构中引入等变性约束以增强3D方向估计的自监督学习能力。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation.result: 声称在方向估计精度上优于现有方法，但摘要未给出具体量化指标。
BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation._arxiv_id: BOE-ViT: Boosting Orientation Estimation with Equivariance in Self-Supervised 3D Subtomogram Alignment.

DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云自监督预训练在跨域场景下泛化能力不足的问题，提出了DAP-MAE（Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Masked Autoencoder）。方法通过域自适应策略改进MAE预训练框架，使模型在源域学到的表征能更有效地迁移到目标域。相比标准Point-MAE等基线，DAP-MAE在跨域学习任务上取得了更好的迁移性能。摘要未提供具体数据集和数值结果。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited cross-domain generalization of point cloud self-supervised pre-training and proposes DAP-MAE, a domain-adaptive masked autoencoder. By incorporating domain adaptation into the MAE framework, it improves representation transfer from source to target domains. The method claims better cross-domain performance than standard Point-MAE baselines, though specific quantitative results are absent from the abstract.
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.assessment: 点云MAE的跨域自适应是一个有价值的方向，与3D检测的域泛化需求相关，但摘要信息有限，难以判断实际提升幅度。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.contribution: 提出DAP-MAE，将域自适应引入点云掩码自编码器预训练。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.innovation: 在Point-MAE框架中融入域自适应机制以提升跨域表征迁移能力。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas.result: 声称在跨域学习任务上优于标准Point-MAE，但摘要未提供具体数值。
DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Mas._arxiv_id: DAP-MAE: Domain-Adaptive Point Cloud Masked Autoencoder for Effective Cross-Domain Learning.

2503.23220|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对域自适应目标检测（DAOD）中Mean Teacher自标注框架的脆弱性问题——学生模型仅用源域数据训练时无法保证生成准确的目标域伪标签，提出DINO Teacher方法。核心思路是利用大规模冻结的DINOv2视觉基础模型作为标注器，在源域数据上训练后为目标域生成更准确的伪标签，从而解耦标签生成与模型学习过程。相比传统Mean Teacher耦合式框架，DINO Teacher生成的伪标签质量更高，在DAOD基准上取得了显著提升。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调基础模型能弥合域间差距。
2503.23220|v2.summary_en: This paper identifies the brittleness of Mean Teacher self-labelling in domain adaptive object detection (DAOD), where source-only students cannot reliably generate target pseudo-labels. It proposes DINO Teacher, which trains a labeller on source data using a large frozen DINOv2 backbone to produce more accurate target-domain labels, decoupling label generation from model learning. This approach outperforms coupled Mean Teacher frameworks on DAOD benchmarks, though specific numbers are not reported in the abstract.
2503.23220|v2.assessment: 利用视觉基础模型改进DAOD伪标签质量是一个务实且有效的方向，解耦标签生成与学习的思路清晰，对自动驾驶域适应检测有直接参考价值。
2503.23220|v2.contribution: 提出DINO Teacher，用冻结DINOv2作为源域训练的标注器为DAOD生成高质量目标域伪标签。
2503.23220|v2.innovation: 将标签生成与模型学习解耦，利用大规模预训练视觉基础模型替代EMA教师生成伪标签。
2503.23220|v2.result: 在DAOD基准上显著优于Mean Teacher类方法，摘要未给出具体数值。

A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云自监督预训练方法缺乏统一解释框架的问题，提出了一种基于交互（interactions）的统一分析方法。通过将不同自监督预训练方法的效果归因于特征间的交互模式，该工作试图揭示各方法有效性的内在机制。相比已有仅关注下游性能的对比研究，该框架提供了更理论化的理解视角。摘要未提供具体实验数据。
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified interpretation framework for self-supervised pre-training methods on 3D point clouds. It proposes an interaction-based analysis that attributes the effectiveness of different methods to feature interaction patterns, offering a more theoretical understanding than prior performance-only comparisons. No specific experimental results are provided in the abstract.
A Unified Approach to Interpreting Self-.assessment: 对3D点云自监督方法的理论解释有学术价值，但与自动驾驶感知的下游任务关联间接，实用性有限。

2503.13739|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多视角行人关联中外观特征在相似外观场景下不可靠、且现有方法依赖标注或标定相机参数的问题，提出了自监督无标定方法Self-MVA。方法设计了一个编码器-解码器模型和跨视角图像同步（cross-view image synchronization）自监督 pretext 任务，通过判断两视角图像是否同时拍摄来学习统一几何与外观特征，并利用匈牙利匹配和同步标签进行监督。相比全监督或需标定的方法，Self-MVA无需任何标注即可在挑战性场景中实现更鲁棒的多视角行人关联。摘要未提供具体量化结果。
2503.13739|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles multi-view person association in challenging scenes where appearance features are unreliable and existing methods require annotations or calibrated cameras. It proposes Self-MVA, a self-supervised uncalibrated approach with an encoder-decoder model and a cross-view image synchronization pretext task that learns unified geometric and appearance features. Using Hungarian matching and synchronization labels, it achieves robust association without any annotations, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2503.13739|v2.assessment: 利用时间同步作为自监督信号进行无标定多视角行人关联的思路新颖，对多相机感知和跟踪有参考价值，但摘要缺乏实验数据支撑。
2503.13739|v2.contribution: 提出Self-MVA，利用跨视角图像同步自监督实现无标定多视角行人关联。
2503.13739|v2.innovation: 以图像时间同步作为自监督pretext任务，无需标注或相机标定即可学习几何-外观联合特征。
2503.13739|v2.result: 在挑战性场景中实现鲁棒关联，摘要未给出具体量化指标。

2505.04410|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP等视觉语言模型在开放词汇密集预测任务中局部特征判别力和空间一致性不足的问题，提出DeCLIP框架。方法将CLIP的自注意力模块解耦为“内容”和“上下文”特征：内容特征与图像裁剪表示对齐以增强局部判别力，上下文特征在DINO等视觉基础模型指导下保留空间相关性。在多个开放词汇密集预测基准上，DeCLIP显著优于现有方法。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调大幅超越。
2505.04410|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal local discriminability and spatial consistency of CLIP features in open-vocabulary dense prediction. It proposes DeCLIP, which decouples the self-attention module into 'content' and 'context' features: content features are aligned with image crops for local discriminability, while context features retain spatial correlations under the guidance of vision foundation models like DINO. DeCLIP significantly outperforms existing methods across multiple open-vocabulary dense prediction benchmarks, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2505.04410|v2.assessment: 解耦CLIP自注意力以提升密集预测的局部判别力和空间一致性是一个有洞察力的方向，对开放词汇检测和BEV感知有潜在借鉴意义。
2505.04410|v2.contribution: 提出DeCLIP，通过解耦自注意力获得内容与上下文特征以增强CLIP的开放词汇密集预测能力。
2505.04410|v2.innovation: 将CLIP自注意力解耦为内容/上下文双分支，分别用图像裁剪和DINO指导优化局部判别力与空间一致性。
2505.04410|v2.result: 在多个开放词汇密集预测基准上显著超越现有方法，摘要未给出具体数值。

2503.21003|v2.summary_cn: 针对AI生成图像取证中传统方法难以泛化到未见生成器的问题，本文提出显式建模取证微观结构（forensic microstructures）的方法。仅使用真实图像以自监督方式学习一组多样化预测滤波器提取残差，并在多尺度上联合建模，得到每张图像的紧凑"取证自描述"。该自描述支持零样本合成图像检测、开放集来源归因和无先验聚类。实验表明在准确性和适应性上优于现有技术，推进了合成图像取证的最先进水平。
2503.21003|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor generalization of AI-generated image forensics to unseen generators by explicitly modeling forensic microstructures. Using only real images in a self-supervised manner, it learns diverse predictive filters to extract multi-scale residuals, yielding a compact forensic self-description per image. This enables zero-shot synthetic image detection, open-set source attribution, and source clustering without prior knowledge, outperforming competing techniques.
2503.21003|v2.assessment: 将自监督残差建模与开放集取证结合，思路新颖，对开放集检测与来源归因方向有参考价值。
2503.21003|v2.contribution: 提出基于取证自描述的零样本检测、开放集来源归因与聚类统一框架。
2503.21003|v2.innovation: 仅用真实图像自监督学习多尺度预测滤波器残差，构建每图唯一的取证自描述。
2503.21003|v2.result: 在零样本检测、开放集归因与聚类上取得优于现有方法的准确性与适应性。

2412.04424|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流CLIP式对比学习视觉编码器特征层次单一的问题，本文提出Florence-VL，采用生成式视觉基础模型Florence-2作为视觉编码器，并设计深度-广度融合（DBFusion）机制，融合不同深度和多提示下的视觉特征。通过端到端预训练加投影层与LLM微调的训练配方，在多样开源数据上训练。定量分析与可视化表明其在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，提升了多模态大模型的视觉表征能力。
2412.04424|v2.summary_en: To overcome the limited feature hierarchy of CLIP-style contrastive vision encoders, this paper presents Florence-VL, which adopts the generative foundation model Florence-2 as the vision encoder and introduces depth-breadth fusion (DBFusion) to combine features across depths and multiple prompts. An end-to-end pretraining plus projection/LLM finetuning recipe on diverse open-source data is used. Quantitative analysis and visualization show advantages over popular encoders in vision-language alignment.
2412.04424|v2.assessment: 用生成式视觉编码器替代CLIP并设计特征融合，为MLLM视觉表征提供了新思路，实验分析较充分。
2412.04424|v2.contribution: 提出以Florence-2为编码器、结合DBFusion的Florence-VL多模态大模型系列。
2412.04424|v2.innovation: 深度-广度融合机制整合不同深度与多提示下的生成式视觉特征。
2412.04424|v2.result: 在视觉-语言对齐上优于流行视觉编码器，提升多模态理解表现。

2502.18290|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督学习视觉编码器被广泛共享复用带来的安全风险，本文揭示了一种新的后门威胁：仅通过污染视觉编码器即可向LVLM注入显著视觉幻觉。由于编码器共享复用，众多下游LVLM会继承后门行为。作者提出BadVision，首个针对LVLM的SSL视觉编码器后门攻击方法，采用新颖的触发器优化与后门学习技术。在两类SSL编码器和LVLM、八个基准上评估，攻击成功率超99%，造成77.6%的相对视觉理解错误，同时保持隐蔽性，可绕过SOTA后门检测。
2502.18290|v2.summary_en: This paper reveals a new backdoor threat in shared self-supervised learning (SSL) vision encoders for LVLMs: compromising only the encoder can induce significant visual hallucinations that propagate to many downstream LVLMs. It proposes BadVision, the first method exploiting this vulnerability with novel trigger optimization and backdoor learning. Evaluated on two SSL encoders and LVLMs across eight benchmarks, it achieves over 99% attack success rate and 77.6% relative visual understanding error while remaining stealthy against state-of-the-art detection.
2502.18290|v2.assessment: 揭示了SSL视觉编码器共享复用带来的系统性后门风险，攻击有效且隐蔽，对多模态安全研究有重要警示意义。
2502.18290|v2.contribution: 首次提出针对LVLM所用SSL视觉编码器的后门攻击方法BadVision。
2502.18290|v2.innovation: 利用编码器共享复用特性，通过触发器优化与后门学习注入可传播的视觉幻觉。
2502.18290|v2.result: 攻击成功率超99%，造成77.6%相对视觉理解错误，且能绕过SOTA后门检测。

2511.08666|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频基础模型提取的时空特征在共享或存储时会泄露肤色、性别、衣着等敏感隐私信息的问题，指出现有像素级匿名化方法需重训练整个视频模型且任务特定，不适用于冻结的视频基础模型。为此提出轻量级匿名适配器模块（AAM），以即插即用方式作用于冻结的视频编码器，并设计三个训练目标：片段级自监督隐私目标降低静态片段间互信息、协同训练目标在匿名化同时保留任务效用等。相比已有工作，AAM 无需微调或重新提取特征，降低了计算负担，并实现了与任务无关的通用匿名化。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但声称在保留通用任务效用的同时去除隐私信息。
2511.08666|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that spatio-temporal features extracted by video foundation models inadvertently leak sensitive personal information (e.g., skin color, gender, clothing) when shared or stored. It proposes a lightweight Anonymizing Adapter Module (AAM) that operates in the latent space and can be plugged into frozen video encoders, trained with three objectives including a clip-level self-supervised privacy objective and a co-training objective to preserve utility. Unlike prior pixel-level anonymization methods that require retraining the entire utility model and are task-specific, AAM avoids finetuning and feature re-extraction, reducing computational cost while retaining general task utility.
2511.08666|v2.assessment: 该工作将隐私保护从像素级推进到潜在空间，对视频基础模型的下游部署与数据共享具有实际意义，但其与自动驾驶感知核心任务的直接关联有限，更多属于视频理解与隐私安全的交叉方向。
2511.08666|v2.contribution: 提出即插即用的潜在空间匿名适配器 AAM，在冻结视频编码器上实现任务无关的隐私保护与效用保留。
2511.08666|v2.innovation: 将隐私匿名化从输入像素级转移到潜在特征空间，并设计片段级自监督隐私目标与协同训练目标。
2511.08666|v2.result: 在无需微调或重新提取特征的前提下，声称能去除隐私信息并保留通用任务效用（摘要未提供具体量化指标）。

2003.13942|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频描述生成中现有方法仅使用场景级或目标级信息、缺乏对目标交互显式建模，导致预测缺乏视觉依据且易受虚假相关影响的问题。作者提出一种时空图模型，在空间和时间维度上建模目标交互，构建可解释的关联并提供显式视觉 grounding；同时提出目标感知知识蒸馏机制，用局部目标信息正则化全局场景特征，以缓解目标数量变化带来的性能不稳定。在两个基准上的实验表明，该方法在取得有竞争力性能的同时能给出可解释的预测。
2003.13942|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses video captioning, where existing methods rely on scene-level or object-level cues without explicitly modeling object interactions, leading to weakly grounded and spurious predictions. The authors propose a spatio-temporal graph model that captures object interactions across space and time with interpretable links and explicit visual grounding, together with an object-aware knowledge distillation mechanism that regularizes global scene features using local object information to handle varying object counts. Experiments on two benchmarks show competitive performance with interpretable predictions.
2003.13942|v2.assessment: 该工作将时空图与知识蒸馏结合用于视频描述，思路清晰且强调可解释性，但与自动驾驶感知、3D 检测、BEV 等核心方向关联较弱，对目标检测研究者的直接参考价值有限。
2003.13942|v2.contribution: 提出融合目标时空交互建模与目标感知知识蒸馏的视频描述框架。
2003.13942|v2.innovation: 用局部目标信息通过知识蒸馏正则化全局场景特征，缓解目标数量变化导致的性能不稳定。
2003.13942|v2.result: 在两个视频描述基准上取得有竞争力的性能，并提供可解释的视觉 grounding 预测。

2103.03454|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体仅将历史观测以隐状态形式存于循环网络、无法捕捉环境布局与长期规划的问题，提出结构化场景记忆（SSM）架构。SSM 将导航过程中的感知精确分格记忆，并作为结构化场景表示解耦视觉与几何线索，配合 collect-read 控制器自适应收集信息以支持当前决策并模拟迭代式长程推理。基于 SSM 提供的完整动作空间（地图上所有可导航位置），引入前沿探索式导航决策策略实现高效全局规划。在 R2R 和 R4R 两个 VLN 数据集上取得当时最优性能。
2103.03454|v2.summary_en: Existing vision-language navigation (VLN) agents store past observations merely as latent states in recurrent networks, failing to capture environment layouts and support long-term planning. This paper proposes Structured Scene Memory (SSM), a compartmentalized memory that accurately memorizes percepts and serves as a structured scene representation disentangling visual and geometric cues, together with a collect-read controller for adaptive information gathering and iterative long-range reasoning. Leveraging the complete action space provided by SSM, a frontier-exploration-based decision-making strategy enables efficient global planning, achieving state-of-the-art results on R2R and R4R.
2103.03454|v2.assessment: 将结构化记忆与全局规划引入 VLN，思路清晰且对具身导航中的长程推理有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联较弱。
2103.03454|v2.contribution: 提出结构化场景记忆 SSM 及配套的 collect-read 控制器与前沿探索决策策略，用于视觉语言导航。
2103.03454|v2.innovation: 用分格化结构化记忆替代循环隐状态，并解耦视觉与几何线索以支持全局规划。
2103.03454|v2.result: 在 R2R 与 R4R 数据集上达到当时最优性能。

VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）中视觉表示能力被相对忽视的问题，重新审视并改进视觉侧的表征。工作系统性地比较了不同视觉特征（如区域特征与网格特征）对多模态预训练与下游任务的影响，并提出改进的视觉表示方案以提升跨模态对齐效果。相比此前以语言模型为中心的设计，该工作强调视觉编码器质量对 VLM 性能的关键作用。在多项视觉语言基准（如 VQA、图像描述等）上取得显著提升。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.summary_en: This paper revisits visual representations in vision-language models, where visual encoding has often been under-emphasized relative to language modeling. It systematically studies the impact of different visual features and proposes improved visual representations to strengthen cross-modal alignment. The resulting model achieves notable gains on multiple vision-language benchmarks, demonstrating the importance of visual-side design in VLMs.
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.assessment: 对多模态大模型中视觉编码器作用的再审视具有方法论价值，对自动驾驶中的 VLM 感知与多模态融合有借鉴意义。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.contribution: 系统研究并改进视觉语言模型中的视觉表示，验证视觉编码质量对多模态性能的关键影响。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.innovation: 将研究重心从语言模型转向视觉表示，提出更优的视觉特征方案以增强跨模态对齐。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations.result: 在多项视觉语言基准上取得显著性能提升。
VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations._arxiv_id: VinVL: Revisiting Visual Representations in Vision-Language Models.

InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_cn: 针对点云视觉定位（visual grounding）中缺乏对实例级上下文整体理解的问题，提出 InstanceRefer 框架。该方法通过实例多层级上下文指代，协同融合点云的整体场景理解与实例级特征，从而更准确地将自然语言描述定位到三维实例。相比仅依赖全局或局部单一层次特征的方法，InstanceRefer 在实例区分与指代消解上更鲁棒。在相关 3D 视觉定位基准上取得优于已有方法的效果。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.summary_en: This paper addresses visual grounding on point clouds, where holistic understanding of instance-level context is lacking. It proposes InstanceRefer, a framework that cooperatively fuses holistic scene understanding with instance multi-level contextual referring to localize 3D instances from natural language descriptions. Experiments on 3D grounding benchmarks show improved performance over prior methods.
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.assessment: 将实例多层级上下文引入点云视觉定位，对 3D 场景理解与语言-点云对齐有参考价值，但与自动驾驶检测主线相关度中等。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.contribution: 提出 InstanceRefer，通过实例多层级上下文指代实现点云上的协同整体视觉定位。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.innovation: 融合整体场景理解与实例级多层级上下文以增强点云视觉定位。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde.result: 在 3D 视觉定位基准上优于已有方法。
InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Unde._arxiv_id: InstanceRefer: Cooperative Holistic Understanding for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds through Instance Multi-level Contextual Referring.

3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_cn: 针对点云视觉定位中关系建模不足的问题，提出 3DVG-Transformer。该方法利用 Transformer 结构对点云中物体间以及语言与物体间的关系进行显式建模，从而提升语言指代到三维目标的定位精度。相比依赖手工关系特征或局部注意力的方法，3DVG-Transformer 能更有效地捕捉长程与结构化关系。在 3D 视觉定位基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient relation modeling in visual grounding on point clouds by proposing 3DVG-Transformer. The method explicitly models relations among objects and between language and objects via a Transformer architecture, improving localization of referred 3D targets. It achieves competitive performance on 3D grounding benchmarks.
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.assessment: 将 Transformer 关系建模引入点云视觉定位，对 3D 场景中的语言-物体关系理解有参考意义。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.contribution: 提出 3DVG-Transformer，用 Transformer 对点云视觉定位中的关系进行显式建模。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.innovation: 以 Transformer 统一建模物体间及语言-物体间关系以提升 3D 定位。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for.result: 在 3D 视觉定位基准上取得有竞争力的性能。
3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for._arxiv_id: 3DVG-Transformer: Relation Modeling for Visual Grounding on Point Clouds.

3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D点云中密集描述（dense captioning）与视觉定位（visual grounding）两个任务通常被分开处理、缺乏统一框架的问题，提出了3DJCG统一框架。方法上通过共享编码器和任务特定的解码器，联合优化两个任务，并引入跨任务交互机制。相比已有单独处理各任务的工作，该框架在保持各自性能的同时实现了任务间的知识共享。实验在ScanRefer和Nr3D等数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果，验证了联合学习的有效性。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that dense captioning and visual grounding on 3D point clouds are typically handled separately without a unified framework. It proposes 3DJCG, a unified framework with a shared encoder and task-specific decoders that jointly optimize both tasks and enable cross-task interaction. Compared to prior separate-task methods, it achieves competitive performance on ScanRefer and Nr3D while enabling knowledge sharing between tasks.
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.assessment: 该工作将两个3D点云理解任务统一到一个框架中，思路清晰，但整体与自动驾驶感知的核心需求（如BEV、3D检测）关联较弱，更多属于3D场景理解范畴。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.contribution: 提出了一个统一的3D点云密集描述与视觉定位联合框架3DJCG。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.innovation: 通过共享编码器和跨任务交互机制实现两个3D点云理解任务的联合优化。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den.result: 在ScanRefer和Nr3D等基准上取得了有竞争力的性能，验证了联合学习的有效性。
3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Den._arxiv_id: 3DJCG: A Unified Framework for Joint Dense Captioning and Visual Grounding on 3D Point Clouds.

A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇语义分割（open-vocabulary semantic segmentation）问题，即模型需分割训练时未见过的类别。作者提出了一种简单基线方法，利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（如CLIP）进行像素级对齐，通过将图像特征与文本嵌入匹配来实现开放词汇分割。相比已有复杂方法，该基线在多个数据集上取得了有竞争力的结果，且结构简单、易于复现。实验表明，该方法在PASCAL VOC和COCO等基准上显著优于之前的开放词汇分割方法。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.summary_en: This paper tackles open-vocabulary semantic segmentation, where models must segment categories unseen during training. The authors propose a simple baseline that leverages pre-trained vision-language models (e.g., CLIP) for pixel-level alignment by matching image features with text embeddings. Compared to prior complex methods, this baseline achieves competitive results on PASCAL VOC and COCO while being simple and reproducible.
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.assessment: 该工作为开放词汇分割提供了一个简洁有效的基线，利用VLM的零样本能力，对开放集检测和VLM应用有参考价值，但未直接涉及自动驾驶场景。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.contribution: 提出了一个基于预训练视觉-语言模型的简单开放词汇语义分割基线。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.innovation: 利用CLIP等VLM的文本嵌入与图像特征对齐实现开放词汇分割，无需复杂设计。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se.result: 在PASCAL VOC和COCO等基准上取得了优于已有开放词汇分割方法的性能。
A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Se._arxiv_id: A Simple Baseline for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with Pre-trained Vision-Language Model.

A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 该论文针对交互式视觉-语言导航（interactive vision-language navigation）中指令可行性未知的问题，构建了一个新的数据集。现有数据集通常假设指令总是可行的，而实际中用户指令可能无法执行。作者收集了包含可行与不可行指令的交互数据，并提出了评估基准。实验表明，现有模型在判断指令可行性方面表现不佳，该数据集为未来研究提供了挑战。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem of unknown command feasibility in interactive vision-language navigation, where existing datasets assume all commands are feasible. The authors collect a new dataset containing both feasible and infeasible commands and propose an evaluation benchmark. Experiments show that current models struggle to judge command feasibility, providing a challenging testbed for future research.
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.assessment: 该工作关注导航中指令可行性的现实问题，数据集构建有实际意义，但与自动驾驶感知的核心技术（检测、BEV等）关联较弱。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.contribution: 构建了一个包含未知指令可行性的交互式视觉-语言导航数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.innovation: 首次在交互式导航中引入指令可行性判断任务并构建相应数据集。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag.result: 实验表明现有模型在判断指令可行性上表现不佳，该数据集为未来研究提供了挑战。
A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: A Dataset for Interactive Vision-Language Navigation with Unknown Command Feasibility.

Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言导航（VLN）中模型容易依赖虚假关联、缺乏解耦表示的问题，提出了解耦标签（decoupled labels）学习方法。通过将导航指令分解为多个语义组件并分别监督，模型能够学习到更解耦的表示。相比已有VLN方法，该方法在R2R和RxR等基准上提升了导航成功率和泛化能力。实验验证了解耦表示对提升导航性能的有效性。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that vision-language navigation models tend to rely on spurious correlations and lack disentangled representations. It proposes a decoupled labels learning approach that decomposes navigation instructions into semantic components for separate supervision. Compared to prior VLN methods, it improves navigation success rate and generalization on R2R and RxR benchmarks.
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.assessment: 该工作从表示解耦角度改进VLN，思路有一定新意，但属于导航任务，与自动驾驶感知的检测/分割主线关联有限。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.contribution: 提出了基于解耦标签的视觉-语言导航表示学习方法。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.innovation: 通过将导航指令分解为语义组件并分别监督，学习解耦的导航表示。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled.result: 在R2R和RxR等基准上提升了导航成功率和泛化能力。
Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled._arxiv_id: Learning Disentanglement with Decoupled Labels for Vision-Language Navigation.

UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉-语言模型中文本生成与目标框预测通常分离的问题，提出了UniTAB统一框架，将文本和框输出统一到一个序列生成模型中。方法上通过统一的Transformer解码器同时生成文本和边界框，实现定位与描述的联合建模。相比已有分离式方法，UniTAB在多个定位和描述任务上取得了更好的性能，并在RefCOCO等基准上达到领先水平。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.summary_en: This paper addresses the separation between text generation and box prediction in vision-language models by proposing UniTAB, a unified framework that generates both text and boxes in a single sequence. It uses a unified Transformer decoder to jointly model grounding and captioning. Compared to prior separate approaches, UniTAB achieves better performance on multiple grounding and captioning benchmarks, including RefCOCO.
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.assessment: 该工作将文本和框输出统一到序列生成框架，对多模态定位任务有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.contribution: 提出了统一文本和框输出的视觉-语言定位与描述框架UniTAB。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.innovation: 通过统一序列生成模型同时输出文本和边界框，实现定位与描述的联合建模。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo.result: 在RefCOCO等多个定位和描述基准上取得了领先性能。
UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs fo._arxiv_id: UniTAB: Unifying Text and Box Outputs for Grounded Vision-Language Modeling.

2207.09644|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对人体骨架序列表示学习中自监督预训练未充分利用骨架层次化时空结构的问题，提出了Hi-TRS，一种层次化Transformer骨架序列编码器，并设计了自监督层次化预训练方案。方法上在帧、片段和视频三个层次分别捕捉空间、短期和长期时序依赖，通过对比学习进行预训练。相比仅关注视频级对比学习的方法，Hi-TRS在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测三个下游任务上，在监督和半监督设置下均取得了最先进性能。
2207.09644|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of hierarchical spatial-temporal structure in self-supervised skeleton sequence representation learning. It proposes Hi-TRS, a hierarchical Transformer-based skeleton encoder with a self-supervised hierarchical pre-training scheme that captures spatial, short-term, and long-term temporal dependencies at frame, clip, and video levels. Compared to video-level contrastive methods, Hi-TRS achieves state-of-the-art performance on action recognition, action detection, and motion prediction under both supervised and semi-supervised protocols.
2207.09644|v2.assessment: 该工作将层次化Transformer与自监督预训练结合用于骨架序列建模，方法扎实、实验充分，对视频理解和自监督学习有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线关联中等。
2207.09644|v2.contribution: 提出了层次化Transformer骨架序列编码器Hi-TRS及自监督层次化预训练方案。
2207.09644|v2.innovation: 在帧、片段、视频三个层次显式建模空间与多尺度时序依赖，并进行自监督预训练。
2207.09644|v2.result: 在动作识别、动作检测和运动预测三个任务上，监督与半监督设置下均达到最先进性能。

2208.06105|v2.summary_cn: 现有视频对比学习方法未能充分利用短期运动动态，而这对下游视频理解任务至关重要。本文提出运动敏感对比学习（MSCL），将光流捕捉的运动信息注入RGB帧以强化特征学习，具体包括帧级跨模态对比目标（LMCL）、流旋转增强（FRA）生成运动打乱的负样本，以及运动差分采样（MDS）筛选训练样本。在UCF101和Something-Something v2上，以3D ResNet-18为骨干，视频分类top-1准确率分别达到91.5%和50.3%，视频检索Top-1 Recall达65.6%，显著优于现有方法。
2208.06105|v2.summary_en: Existing contrastive learning methods for video representation fail to sufficiently exploit short-term motion dynamics. This paper proposes Motion Sensitive Contrastive Learning (MSCL), which injects optical flow motion into RGB frames via frame-level cross-modal contrastive objectives (LMCL), Flow Rotation Augmentation (FRA) for motion-shuffled negatives, and Motion Differential Sampling (MDS). With 3D ResNet-18, it achieves 91.5% top-1 on UCF101 and 50.3% on Something-Something v2 for classification, and 65.6% Top-1 Recall on UCF101 for retrieval, notably improving state-of-the-art.
2208.06105|v2.assessment: 该工作通过跨模态对比有效融合运动信息，在自监督视频表示学习上取得显著提升，对视频理解相关研究有参考价值。
2208.06105|v2.contribution: 提出运动敏感对比学习框架，将光流运动信息注入RGB视频表示学习。
2208.06105|v2.innovation: 设计帧级跨模态对比目标、流旋转增强和运动差分采样策略。
2208.06105|v2.result: 在UCF101和Something-Something v2上分类与检索性能均达到新最优。

2208.09843|v2.summary_cn: 图像-文本检索（ITR）的核心挑战在于跨模态对齐，现有对比学习方法受限于负样本数量少、手动加权负样本以及缺乏外部知识。本文提出CODER，一种耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习框架：引入动态字典扩大图文对规模，通过自适应负样本加权实现多样性敏感对比学习（DCL）；同时设计双分支结构，一支学习实例级嵌入并生成伪在线聚类标签，另一支从常识知识图谱查询概念级描述符，两分支利用DCL对齐跨模态嵌入空间。
2208.09843|v2.summary_en: Image-Text Retrieval (ITR) struggles with cross-modal alignment; existing contrastive methods are limited by few negative pairs, manual weighting, and lack of external knowledge. This paper proposes CODER, a Coupled Diversity-Sensitive Momentum Contrastive Learning framework with dynamic dictionaries for both modalities, adaptive negative pair weighting (DCL), and two branches: one learning instance-level embeddings with pseudo online clustering labels, and another querying a commonsense knowledge graph for concept-level descriptors, both aligned via DCL.
2208.09843|v2.assessment: 该工作通过动态字典和知识图谱增强跨模态对比学习，为图文检索提供了新思路，但摘要未给出具体实验数据。
2208.09843|v2.contribution: 提出耦合多样性敏感动量对比学习框架CODER用于图像-文本检索。
2208.09843|v2.innovation: 结合动态字典、自适应负样本加权和常识知识图谱的双分支对比学习。
2208.09843|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，需查看全文验证性能提升。

2207.12661|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比预训练通常为每种模态使用独立编码器，但近期研究表明Transformer可支持跨模态知识共享。本文系统研究了模态共享对比语言-图像预训练（MS-CLIP）框架，探索Transformer参数在模态间的共享比例及架构设计选择。实验发现，视觉和语言信号使用大部分统一的编码器优于分离更多参数的变体，且轻量级模态特定并行模块可进一步提升性能。所提MS-CLIP在零样本ImageNet分类上比原始CLIP相对提升高达13%。
2207.12661|v2.summary_en: Multi-modal contrastive pre-training typically uses separate encoders per modality, but transformers can support cross-modal knowledge sharing. This paper investigates Modality-Shared Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (MS-CLIP), examining how many transformer parameters can be shared across modalities. A mostly unified encoder outperforms variants separating more parameters, and lightweight modality-specific parallel modules further improve performance. MS-CLIP outperforms vanilla CLIP by up to 13% relative in zero-shot ImageNet classification.
2207.12661|v2.assessment: 该工作系统探索了多模态Transformer参数共享策略，为高效多模态预训练提供了有价值的架构设计指导。
2207.12661|v2.contribution: 系统研究模态共享的对比语言-图像预训练框架MS-CLIP。
2207.12661|v2.innovation: 探索Transformer参数跨模态共享比例并引入轻量模态特定并行模块。
2207.12661|v2.result: 零样本ImageNet分类相对原始CLIP提升高达13%。

2107.06383|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉-语言（V&L）模型依赖在少量人工标注数据上预训练的视觉编码器，泛化能力受限。本文系统研究了CLIP作为视觉编码器在V&L模型中的优势，涵盖两种场景：将CLIP插入任务特定微调，以及结合CLIP与V&L预训练后迁移到下游任务。实验表明CLIP显著优于BottomUp-TopDown等域内标注数据训练的编码器，在视觉问答、视觉蕴含和V&L导航等任务上取得竞争性或更优结果，并建立新SOTA。
2107.06383|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-and-Language (V&L) models rely on visual encoders pre-trained on limited annotated data, limiting generalization. This paper studies using CLIP as the visual encoder in V&L models under two scenarios: plugging CLIP into task-specific fine-tuning, and combining CLIP with V&L pre-training for downstream transfer. CLIP significantly outperforms encoders like BottomUp-TopDown, achieving competitive or better results and new state-of-the-art on Visual Question Answering, Visual Entailment, and V&L Navigation.
2107.06383|v2.assessment: 该工作系统验证了CLIP作为视觉编码器在V&L任务中的显著优势，对多模态研究具有重要参考价值。
2107.06383|v2.contribution: 系统评估CLIP作为视觉编码器在多种V&L任务中的效果。
2107.06383|v2.innovation: 提出两种CLIP与V&L模型结合的使用范式并验证其泛化优势。
2107.06383|v2.result: 在VQA、视觉蕴含和V&L导航任务上取得新SOTA。

2106.12570|v2.summary_cn: 多模态VAE旨在建模异构数据的联合分布并捕获共享表示，但现有方法通常通过显式乘积或混合等方式在识别模型中直接组合各模态表示。本文提出MEME，将半监督VAE重新用于通过相互监督隐式组合模态信息，避免了显式组合。该公式自然支持部分观测数据（某些模态完全缺失）的学习。在MNIST-SVHN和CUB数据集上，MEME在部分和完全观测方案下均优于基线。
2106.12570|v2.summary_en: Multimodal VAEs model joint distributions over heterogeneous data but typically combine modalities via explicit products or mixtures. This paper introduces MEME, which repurposes semi-supervised VAEs to combine modalities implicitly through mutual supervision, naturally handling partially-observed data with entirely missing modalities. MEME outperforms baselines on MNIST-SVHN and CUB datasets under both partial and complete observation schemes.
2106.12570|v2.assessment: 该工作通过相互监督隐式组合多模态信息，为处理缺失模态提供了优雅的解决方案，但实验规模较小。
2106.12570|v2.contribution: 提出通过相互监督隐式组合多模态信息的MEME框架。
2106.12570|v2.innovation: 将半监督VAE重新用于多模态学习，自然支持模态缺失场景。
2106.12570|v2.result: 在MNIST-SVHN和CUB上部分及完全观测方案均优于基线。

2106.09667|v2.summary_cn: 多模态对比学习方法（如CLIP）在嘈杂、未整理的训练数据上训练，这虽然降低了标注成本并提升分布外鲁棒性，但也带来了后门和投毒攻击的严重威胁。本文证明仅需污染0.01%的数据集（如300万Conceptual Captions中的300张图像），即可通过叠加小补丁使模型误分类测试图像；定向投毒攻击更易实现，仅需控制0.0001%的数据集（3张图像）。这些攻击对在嘈杂互联网数据上训练的做法提出了质疑。
2106.09667|v2.summary_en: Multimodal contrastive learning methods like CLIP train on noisy, uncurated datasets, which reduces labeling cost but introduces backdoor and poisoning threats. This paper shows that poisoning just 0.01% of a dataset (e.g., 300 of 3M Conceptual Captions images) causes misclassification via a small patch, and targeted poisoning requires controlling only 0.0001% (3 images). These attacks question the desirability of training on noisy Internet scrapes.
2106.09667|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了对比学习在未整理数据上的严重安全漏洞，对多模态预训练的数据安全具有重要警示意义。
2106.09667|v2.contribution: 揭示并验证了多模态对比学习中的投毒和后门攻击威胁。
2106.09667|v2.innovation: 证明极低比例的数据污染即可实现有效攻击。
2106.09667|v2.result: 仅需污染0.01%数据即可导致误分类，定向攻击仅需0.0001%。

2207.03482|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇目标检测（OVD）中，CLIP 的图像-文本预训练缺乏精确定位能力，而图像级弱监督的启发式区域指定又不准确，两者均未针对检测任务做最优对齐。本文提出对 CLIP 语言嵌入进行以目标为中心的对齐，并利用伪标签过程在仅图像级监督下视觉定位目标、扩展训练词表，再通过一种新的权重迁移函数将两种对齐策略互补融合。相比已有 OVD 方法，该工作弥合了目标级与图像级表示之间的鸿沟。在 LVIS 等基准上取得了新的 SOTA 开放词汇检测性能（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2207.03482|v2.summary_en: Existing open-vocabulary detectors rely on CLIP or image-level supervision, neither of which is optimally aligned for detection. This paper proposes object-centric alignment of CLIP language embeddings and a pseudo-labeling process that grounds objects using only image-level supervision, bridging the two strategies via a novel weight transfer function. It achieves state-of-the-art open-vocabulary detection results by minimizing the gap between object- and image-centric representations.
2207.03482|v2.assessment: 针对 OVD 中弱监督信号与检测任务不匹配的核心痛点提出系统性对齐方案，思路清晰且实用，对开放集检测研究者有较高参考价值。
2207.03482|v2.contribution: 提出融合 CLIP 目标级对齐与图像级伪标签监督的开放词汇检测框架。
2207.03482|v2.innovation: 用权重迁移函数桥接目标中心与图像中心两种对齐策略，互补其优势。
2207.03482|v2.result: 在开放词汇检测基准上超越已有方法，建立新的 SOTA。

2208.05592|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇模型如 CLIP 在零样本分类上表现优异，但在部分任务上性能远未达到最优，且微调易损害原有能力。本文研究模型补丁（model patching），提出 PAINT：在微调前后模型权重之间做插值，从而在提升目标任务精度的同时不降低已有任务表现。在 9 个零样本 CLIP 表现较差的任务上，PAINT 将精度提升 15 至 60 个百分点，同时 ImageNet 精度保持在零样本模型 1 个百分点以内，并支持多任务补丁与随模型规模提升。
2208.05592|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary models like CLIP underperform on certain tasks, and naive fine-tuning degrades existing capabilities. This paper introduces PAINT, a patching method that interpolates between pre- and post-fine-tuning weights to boost target-task accuracy without sacrificing prior performance. PAINT improves accuracy by 15-60 points on nine tasks while keeping ImageNet accuracy within one point of zero-shot CLIP, and supports multi-task patching with broad transfer.
2208.05592|v2.assessment: 权重插值思路简洁有效，为开放词汇模型的任务适配提供了低成本方案，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2208.05592|v2.contribution: 提出基于权重插值的模型补丁方法 PAINT，兼顾新任务提升与旧能力保持。
2208.05592|v2.innovation: 用微调前后权重插值实现无遗忘的任务补丁，并发现跨任务广泛迁移现象。
2208.05592|v2.result: 在 9 个任务上提升 15-60 个百分点，ImageNet 精度损失控制在 1 个百分点内。

2211.14241|v2.summary_cn: 3D 视觉定位任务中，现有方法多依赖现成的点云编码器提取 3D 视觉线索，视觉流表达受限。本文提出能否用从点云合成的 2D 线索来增强 3D 视觉流，且无需额外 2D 输入。方法 LAR（Look Around and Refer）利用从 3D 点云合成生成的 2D 线索，通过知识蒸馏辅助 3D 编码器学习更丰富的 2D 目标表示。在 Nr3D、Sr3D 和 ScanRefer 三个基准上均取得一致性能提升，显著超越现有 SOTA 3D 视觉定位方法。
2211.14241|v2.summary_en: Existing 3D visual grounding methods rely on off-the-shelf point cloud encoders, limiting visual representation quality. This paper proposes LAR, which distills 2D object representations synthesized from point clouds to assist the 3D encoder without extra 2D inputs. LAR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on Nr3D, Sr3D, and ScanRefer benchmarks.
2211.14241|v2.assessment: 用合成 2D 语义蒸馏增强 3D 表示的想法新颖，对 3D 感知与多模态理解交叉方向有启发，但与自动驾驶检测主线关联中等。
2211.14241|v2.contribution: 提出 LAR 模块，通过 2D 合成语义知识蒸馏增强 3D 视觉定位的视觉表示。
2211.14241|v2.innovation: 无需额外 2D 输入，从点云合成 2D 线索并蒸馏进 3D 编码器。
2211.14241|v2.result: 在 Nr3D、Sr3D、ScanRefer 三个基准上一致超越现有 SOTA。

2301.05499|v2.summary_cn: 单域泛化（SDG）目标检测旨在仅用单一源域训练模型并泛化到任意未见目标域，但现有研究几乎空白。本文提出利用预训练视觉-语言模型（CLIP）通过文本提示引入语义域概念，在检测器骨干特征上施加语义增强策略，并设计基于文本的分类损失。相比唯一已有的SDG检测方法Single-DGOD，在多样天气驾驶基准上性能提升10%。该工作首次将VLM引入SDG检测，为自动驾驶跨域感知提供了新思路。
2301.05499|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses single domain generalization (SDG) for object detection, which remains largely unexplored compared to classification. The authors leverage a pre-trained vision-language model to inject semantic domain concepts via textual prompts, applying semantic augmentation on detector backbone features and a text-based classification loss. Their approach outperforms the only existing SDG detection method, Single-DGOD, by 10% on a diverse weather-driving benchmark.
2301.05499|v2.assessment: 首次将视觉-语言模型用于单域泛化目标检测，在自动驾驶跨域场景下具有实际意义，性能提升显著。
2301.05499|v2.contribution: 提出利用CLIP文本提示进行语义增强的SDG目标检测框架。
2301.05499|v2.innovation: 通过文本提示引入语义域概念，在特征层面进行语义增强并设计文本分类损失。
2301.05499|v2.result: 在天气驾驶基准上超越Single-DGOD方法10%。

2303.12027|v2.summary_cn: 基于自然语言规范的跟踪旨在根据语言描述在序列中定位目标，现有方法将视觉定位与跟踪分为两步，使用独立模型，忽略了语言描述为两步提供全局语义线索的联系，且难以端到端训练。本文提出联合视觉定位与跟踪框架，将两者统一为基于视觉-语言参考的目标定位任务，设计多源关系建模模块构建参考与测试图像的关系，并设计时序建模模块在全局语义指导下提供时序线索。该方法提升了对外观变化的适应性，实现了端到端训练。
2303.12027|v2.summary_en: Tracking by natural language specification is typically solved by separate grounding and tracking models, overlooking the shared semantic cues and preventing end-to-end training. This paper proposes a joint visual grounding and tracking framework that unifies both as localizing a referred target given visual-language references, with a multi-source relation modeling module and a temporal modeling module guided by global semantics. The approach improves adaptability to appearance variations and enables end-to-end training.
2303.12027|v2.assessment: 将视觉定位与跟踪统一为端到端框架，思路合理，但相关度偏向语言跟踪而非核心检测任务。
2303.12027|v2.contribution: 提出联合视觉定位与跟踪的统一框架。
2303.12027|v2.innovation: 多源关系建模与时序建模模块在全局语义指导下融合视觉-语言参考。
2303.12027|v2.result: 提升了对外观变化的适应性并支持端到端训练。

2303.16891|v2.summary_cn: 现有实例分割模型依赖基类的人工掩码标注，难以扩展到新类别；开放词汇方法虽利用图像-文本对学习新类，但强监督（基类掩码）与弱监督（图像-文本）的差异导致对基类过拟合，泛化到新类效果差。本文提出Mask-free OVIS流水线，利用预训练视觉-语言模型的定位能力自动生成伪掩码标注，以弱监督方式同时学习基类和新类。该方法无需人工掩码标注，缓解了强/弱监督差异带来的过拟合问题，提升了新类别的泛化能力。
2303.16891|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary instance segmentation suffers from overfitting to base categories due to the discrepancy between strong mask supervision and weak image-caption supervision. This paper proposes Mask-free OVIS, which automatically generates pseudo-mask annotations by leveraging the localization ability of a pre-trained vision-language model, and uses them to learn both base and novel categories in a weakly supervised manner. The method eliminates manual mask annotations and improves generalization to novel categories.
2303.16891|v2.assessment: 无需人工掩码的开放词汇实例分割方案，利用VLM定位能力生成伪掩码，实用性强。
2303.16891|v2.contribution: 提出Mask-free OVIS流水线，用VLM生成伪掩码实现开放词汇实例分割。
2303.16891|v2.innovation: 以弱监督方式利用VLM定位能力自动生成伪掩码，统一学习基类与新类。
2303.16891|v2.result: 无需人工掩码标注，缓解基类过拟合并提升新类泛化。

2303.13076|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇检测（OVD）旨在检测训练基类之外的新类别目标，现有方法依赖CLIP等视觉-语言模型识别新物体，但存在两个核心障碍：整图训练的VL模型用于区域识别时的分布不匹配，以及未见类别的定位困难。本文提出CORA，一种DETR风格框架，通过区域提示（Region prompting）缓解整图到区域的分布差距，通过锚点预匹配（Anchor pre-matching）的类感知匹配机制学习可泛化的目标定位。在COCO OVD基准上，新类达到41.7 AP50，超越此前SOTA 2.4 AP50，且无需额外训练数据。
2303.13076|v2.summary_en: Open-vocabulary detection (OVD) faces two obstacles when incorporating vision-language models: whole-to-region distribution mismatch and difficulty localizing unseen classes. This paper proposes CORA, a DETR-style framework that adapts CLIP via region prompting to mitigate the distribution gap and anchor pre-matching with class-aware matching for generalizable localization. CORA achieves 41.7 AP50 on novel classes on COCO OVD, outperforming the previous SOTA by 2.4 AP50 without extra training data.
2303.13076|v2.assessment: 针对OVD两大核心障碍提出简洁有效的解决方案，性能提升显著且无需额外数据，是该方向的重要进展。
2303.13076|v2.contribution: 提出CORA框架，通过区域提示和锚点预匹配适配CLIP用于开放词汇检测。
2303.13076|v2.innovation: 区域提示缓解整图-区域分布差距，锚点预匹配实现类感知的可泛化定位。
2303.13076|v2.result: COCO OVD新类41.7 AP50，超越SOTA 2.4 AP50且无需额外数据。

2301.09121|v2.summary_cn: 开放词汇语义分割（OVS）旨在分割任意类别而非预定义闭集类别。本文提出OVSegmentor，一种基于Transformer的OVS模型，仅使用网络爬取的图像-文本对预训练，无需任何掩码标注。模型通过slot-attention绑定模块将图像像素聚合成可学习的分组token，并与对应caption嵌入对齐；提出掩码实体补全和跨图像掩码一致性两个代理任务，分别学习视觉分组与文本实体的细粒度对齐及视觉不变性。此外构建CC4M数据集提升训练效率，在多个基准上取得优异表现。
2301.09121|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVS) using only web-crawled image-text pairs without mask annotations. The proposed OVSegmentor is a transformer-based model that aggregates pixels into learnable group tokens via slot-attention and aligns them with caption embeddings, trained with two proxy tasks: masked entity completion and cross-image mask consistency. The authors also construct the CC4M dataset for efficient pre-training and achieve strong results on multiple benchmarks.
2301.09121|v2.assessment: 仅用图像-文本对实现开放词汇语义分割，代理任务设计巧妙，CC4M数据集构建有实用价值。
2301.09121|v2.contribution: 提出OVSegmentor模型及两个代理任务，仅用图像-文本对实现开放词汇语义分割。
2301.09121|v2.innovation: slot-attention分组token绑定与掩码实体补全、跨图像掩码一致性代理任务。
2301.09121|v2.result: 无需掩码标注，在多个语义分割基准上取得优异表现。

2212.00785|v2.summary_cn: 开放世界语义分割旨在仅用图像-文本对分割任意视觉概念，现有方法采用对比学习（CL）学习视觉概念并将图像级理解迁移到分割任务，但存在训练-测试不一致：训练仅考虑图像-文本对齐，而分割测试需要区域-文本对齐。本文提出文本接地对比学习（TCL）框架，直接学习区域-文本对齐：为给定文本生成分割掩码，从掩码区域提取文本接地图像嵌入并与文本嵌入对齐。通过直接学习区域-文本对齐，模型能直接提升生成掩码的质量。此外提出统一的8个语义分割数据集评估协议，TCL取得优异结果。
2212.00785|v2.summary_en: Open-world semantic segmentation using only image-text pairs suffers from a train-test discrepancy in contrastive learning methods, which align image-text during training but require region-text alignment at test time. This paper proposes Text-grounded Contrastive Learning (TCL), which generates a segmentation mask for given text, extracts text-grounded image embeddings from the masked region, and aligns them with text embeddings, directly learning region-text alignment. A unified evaluation protocol over 8 segmentation datasets is also presented, on which TCL achieves strong results.
2212.00785|v2.assessment: 直击CL方法训练-测试不一致的核心问题，TCL框架设计合理，统一评估协议有参考价值。
2212.00785|v2.contribution: 提出TCL框架直接学习区域-文本对齐，并建立统一评估协议。
2212.00785|v2.innovation: 通过文本接地对比学习直接优化区域-文本对齐，提升生成掩码质量。
2212.00785|v2.result: 在8个语义分割数据集的统一评估协议下取得优异结果。

2303.14038|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言预训练(VLP)训练成本高、收敛慢的问题，指出掩码语言建模(MLM)中预测率与破坏率相互纠缠，导致大量输出token被排除在损失之外。提出Free Language Modeling (FLM)，实现100%预测率与任意破坏率解耦，并允许为每个待预测token定制破坏跨度。相比MLM方法，在相同GPU时间下可减少2.5倍预训练时间，同时保持下游性能。
2303.14038|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high training cost and slow convergence of vision-language pretraining, identifying the entanglement between prediction rate and corruption rate in masked language modeling. It proposes Free Language Modeling (FLM), which achieves a 100% prediction rate with arbitrary corruption rates and allows customized corruption spans per predicted token. FLM reduces pretraining time by 2.5x compared to MLM-based methods while maintaining competitive performance.
2303.14038|v2.assessment: 对VLM预训练效率有实际推动，解耦预测率与破坏率的思路简洁有效，2.5倍加速数据有说服力。
2303.14038|v2.contribution: 提出FLM预训练任务，解耦预测率与破坏率，实现100%预测率下的高效VLP。
2303.14038|v2.innovation: 允许任意破坏率下100%预测，并为每个token定制破坏跨度。
2303.14038|v2.result: 相比MLM方法减少2.5倍预训练时间，同时保持下游性能。

2211.10277|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型(VLM)在下游任务高效迁移时，现有方法要么破坏预训练知识（如prompt tuning丢弃文本分类器），要么过度依赖预训练特征（如adapter tuning）的问题。提出Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes)，直接在文本分类器上操作，冻结原始分类器权重，通过调优一组与先验无关的残差参数获得新分类器。该方法显式解耦先验知识与任务特定知识，实现可靠的先验保持与灵活的任务适应。
2211.10277|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that existing efficient transfer learning methods for vision-language models either damage or are excessively biased towards pre-trained knowledge. It proposes Task Residual Tuning (TaskRes), which operates directly on the text-based classifier by freezing the original weights and tuning a set of prior-independent residual parameters. TaskRes explicitly decouples prior knowledge from task-specific knowledge, enabling reliable preservation and flexible adaptation.
2211.10277|v2.assessment: 对VLM高效迁移学习有清晰贡献，残差调优思路简洁且有效，适合少数据下游任务。
2211.10277|v2.contribution: 提出TaskRes，通过文本分类器上的残差调优解耦先验与任务知识。
2211.10277|v2.innovation: 在冻结的文本分类器上学习先验无关的残差参数。
2211.10277|v2.result: 实现可靠的先验知识保持与灵活的任务特定知识利用。

2303.15786|v2.summary_cn: 针对HOI检测中利用CLIP知识蒸馏的方法依赖大规模训练数据、在少样本/零样本场景下性能不佳的问题，提出HOICLIP框架高效提取CLIP先验知识并提升泛化性。具体引入交互解码器通过交叉注意力提取CLIP视觉特征中的信息区域，并与检测骨干通过知识集成块融合；利用CLIP文本编码器嵌入HOI描述生成分类器，并通过视觉语义算术和轻量动词表示适配器构建动词分类器。还提出免训练增强利用全局HOI预测。
2303.15786|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on large-scale training data and poor few/zero-shot performance of CLIP-based knowledge distillation for HOI detection. It proposes HOICLIP, which extracts CLIP priors via an interaction decoder with cross-attention, fuses them with the detection backbone through a knowledge integration block, and generates classifiers from CLIP text embeddings. A training-free enhancement leverages global HOI predictions.
2303.15786|v2.assessment: 对HOI检测中VLM知识迁移有实用价值，少样本/零样本泛化提升明显，方法设计较完整。
2303.15786|v2.contribution: 提出HOICLIP框架，高效提取CLIP先验知识用于HOI检测并提升泛化性。
2303.15786|v2.innovation: 交互解码器与知识集成块融合CLIP视觉特征，文本编码器生成分类器，免训练增强。
2303.15786|v2.result: 在少样本/零样本场景下取得更好泛化性能。

2303.10431|v2.summary_cn: 针对大规模视觉-语言模型因训练数据中身份群体分布偏斜而产生社会偏见，导致特定文本概念与不同身份群体图像的相似度偏斜，限制其在现实高风险应用中的可用性的问题。提出DeAR（Debiasing with Additive Residuals），学习加性残差图像表示来偏移原始表示，确保公平的输出表示，降低表示区分不同身份群体的能力。同时指出现有公平性测试局限于有限人脸数据集，引入Protected Attribute Tag Association进行评估。
2303.10431|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses societal biases in large vision-language models caused by skewed identity group distributions in training data, which manifest as biased similarities between text concepts and images of different groups. It proposes DeAR (Debiasing with Additive Residuals), which learns additive residual image representations to offset original representations for fair outputs. It also introduces the Protected Attribute Tag Association to better evaluate debiasing.
2303.10431|v2.assessment: VLM公平性方向的工作，加性残差去偏思路新颖，但与本领域核心任务相关度较低。
2303.10431|v2.contribution: 提出DeAR去偏方法，通过学习加性残差图像表示实现公平输出。
2303.10431|v2.innovation: 加性残差表示偏移原始表示，并引入新的公平性评估基准。
2303.10431|v2.result: 降低表示区分不同身份群体的能力，提升公平性。

THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在自由形式生成中产生物体幻觉、缺乏系统性评测基准的问题，本文提出了THRONE，一个基于物体的幻觉基准。该方法通过构建包含真实与虚构物体的问答对，系统评估LVLM在自由生成场景下对物体存在性、属性及关系的幻觉程度。相比已有主要针对判别式或短答案任务的幻觉评测，THRONE聚焦自由形式长文本生成，更贴近实际应用。实验揭示了当前主流LVLM在物体幻觉上的显著缺陷，为后续改进提供了量化依据。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of systematic benchmarks for object hallucination in free-form generations of large vision-language models (LVLMs). It introduces THRONE, an object-based hallucination benchmark that constructs question-answer pairs with real and fictitious objects to evaluate LVLMs' tendency to hallucinate object existence, attributes, and relations in free-form text. Unlike prior benchmarks focused on discriminative or short-answer tasks, THRONE targets open-ended generation, revealing substantial object hallucination issues in state-of-the-art LVLMs.
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.assessment: 为LVLM幻觉评测提供了更贴近自由生成场景的基准，对多模态可靠性与安全研究有参考价值。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.contribution: 提出了面向自由形式生成的基于物体的LVLM幻觉评测基准THRONE。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.innovation: 将幻觉评测从判别式/短答案任务扩展到自由形式长文本生成，并围绕物体维度系统设计。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be.result: 揭示了当前主流LVLM在自由生成中仍存在严重的物体幻觉问题。
THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Be._arxiv_id: THRONE: An Object-Based Hallucination Benchmark for the Free-Form Generations of Large Vision-Language Models.

VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）知识编辑缺乏统一评测基准的问题，本文提出了VLKEB，一个面向LVLM的知识编辑基准。该基准构建了涵盖多种编辑类型与多模态场景的数据，系统评估现有知识编辑方法在LVLM上的效果与副作用。相比已有主要针对纯语言模型的知识编辑评测，VLKEB引入了视觉模态，更全面地检验编辑的可靠性与泛化性。实验表明现有方法在LVLM知识编辑上仍面临保持无关知识不变与编辑效果之间的权衡挑战。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.summary_en: This paper tackles the absence of a unified benchmark for knowledge editing in large vision-language models (LVLMs) by introducing VLKEB. It constructs multimodal editing data covering diverse edit types and scenarios to systematically evaluate existing knowledge editing methods on LVLMs. Unlike prior benchmarks focused on language-only models, VLKEB incorporates the visual modality, exposing trade-offs between edit efficacy and preserving unrelated knowledge in current methods.
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.assessment: 填补了LVLM知识编辑评测的空白，对多模态模型可控性与知识更新研究有推动作用。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.contribution: 提出了面向大型视觉语言模型的知识编辑基准VLKEB。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.innovation: 将知识编辑评测从纯语言模型扩展到多模态LVLM场景。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno.result: 实验显示现有知识编辑方法在LVLM上仍难以兼顾编辑效果与无关知识保持。
VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Kno._arxiv_id: VLKEB: A Large Vision-Language Model Knowledge Editing Benchmark.

ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多轮对话能力评测上缺乏细粒度诊断工具的问题，本文提出了ConvBench，一个具备分层消融能力的多轮对话评测基准。该基准通过设计多轮交互任务并支持对对话历史、视觉输入等组件进行分层消融，定位模型在多轮对话中的能力瓶颈。相比已有单轮或整体评分的基准，ConvBench能更细粒度地分析LVLM在多轮场景下的表现。实验揭示了当前SOTA LVLM在多轮对话中普遍存在上下文利用不足等问题。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of fine-grained diagnostic tools for evaluating multi-turn conversation capabilities of large vision-language models (LVLMs) by proposing ConvBench. It designs multi-turn interaction tasks with hierarchical ablation over components such as dialogue history and visual inputs to localize capability bottlenecks. Compared with prior single-turn or holistic-scoring benchmarks, ConvBench enables finer-grained analysis, revealing that state-of-the-art LVLMs often underutilize conversational context.
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.assessment: 为LVLM多轮对话能力提供了可诊断的评测框架，对多模态交互研究有实用价值。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.contribution: 提出了具备分层消融能力的LVLM多轮对话评测基准ConvBench。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.innovation: 引入分层消融机制以细粒度定位多轮对话中的能力瓶颈。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva.result: 揭示了当前SOTA LVLM在多轮对话中上下文利用不足等普遍问题。
ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Eva._arxiv_id: ConvBench: A Multi-Turn Conversation Evaluation Benchmark with Hierarchical Ablation Capability for Large Vision-Language Models.

2408.16176|v2.summary_cn: 针对预训练视觉语言模型（VLM）能否在无需微调的情况下辅助生物学家进行物种性状发现的问题，本文构建了VLM4Bio基准数据集。该数据集包含469K问答对、30K图像，覆盖鱼类、鸟类和蝴蝶三类生物及五个生物学相关任务，并评估了12个SOTA VLM。研究还探索了提示工程与推理幻觉对性能的影响。结果表明当前SOTA VLM在生物学图像问答上仍有明显局限，为领域应用提供了量化参考。
2408.16176|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) can assist biologists in trait discovery without additional fine-tuning. It introduces VLM4Bio, a benchmark of 469K question-answer pairs over 30K images spanning fishes, birds, and butterflies across five biologically relevant tasks, and evaluates 12 state-of-the-art VLMs. The study further examines prompting techniques and reasoning hallucination, revealing notable limitations of current VLMs in biological image question answering.
2408.16176|v2.assessment: 将VLM评测拓展到生物多样性领域，数据集规模大、任务设计贴近科学发现，具跨学科价值。
2408.16176|v2.contribution: 构建了面向生物性状发现的VLM评测基准VLM4Bio。
2408.16176|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估12个SOTA VLM在鱼类、鸟类、蝴蝶三类生物图像上的性状发现能力。
2408.16176|v2.result: 469K问答对、30K图像的评测显示当前SOTA VLM在生物学图像问答上仍存在明显局限。

Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇语义分割需要额外训练或依赖特定分割模型的问题，本文提出了一种从现成视觉语言模型（VLM）中涌现开放词汇语义分割能力的方法。该方法无需额外训练，直接利用预训练VLM的图文对齐能力生成分割掩码，实现零样本开放词汇分割。相比已有需要微调或专用架构的方法，该工作展示了VLM内在的密集预测潜力。实验在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得了有竞争力的零样本性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.summary_en: This paper addresses open-vocabulary semantic segmentation without additional training by eliciting emergent segmentation capabilities from off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs). It leverages the image-text alignment of pre-trained VLMs to produce segmentation masks in a zero-shot manner, avoiding fine-tuning or specialized architectures. Experiments on multiple open-vocabulary segmentation benchmarks demonstrate competitive zero-shot performance, highlighting the intrinsic dense prediction potential of VLMs.
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.assessment: 展示了现成VLM无需训练即可实现开放词汇分割，对开放集感知与多模态密集预测研究有启发。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.contribution: 提出从现成VLM中涌现开放词汇语义分割的免训练方法。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.innovation: 无需额外训练或专用架构，直接利用VLM图文对齐生成分割掩码。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen.result: 在多个开放词汇分割基准上取得有竞争力的零样本性能。
Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmen._arxiv_id: Emergent Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation from Off-the-Shelf Vision-Language Models.

Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_cn: 针对零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位中缺乏3D标注与开放类别泛化的问题，本文提出了视觉编程（Visual Programming）框架。该方法将3D视觉定位分解为可组合的视觉子任务，利用预训练2D VLM与3D几何模块协同推理，实现无需3D标注的零样本开放词汇定位。相比已有依赖3D标注或封闭类别的方法，该框架具备更强的开放词汇泛化能力。实验在多个3D视觉定位基准上验证了其零样本性能优势。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.summary_en: This paper tackles zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D visual grounding without 3D annotations by proposing a visual programming framework. It decomposes 3D grounding into composable visual sub-tasks, coordinating pre-trained 2D VLMs with 3D geometric modules for annotation-free, open-vocabulary localization. Compared with methods relying on 3D annotations or closed categories, the framework achieves stronger open-vocabulary generalization, with experiments on multiple 3D grounding benchmarks validating its zero-shot advantages.
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.assessment: 将视觉编程引入3D视觉定位，结合2D VLM与3D几何实现零样本开放词汇，对自动驾驶3D感知有参考价值。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.contribution: 提出了面向零样本开放词汇3D视觉定位的视觉编程框架。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.innovation: 通过组合2D VLM与3D几何模块的可分解子任务实现免3D标注的开放词汇定位。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo.result: 在多个3D视觉定位基准上验证了其零样本开放词汇性能优势。
Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vo._arxiv_id: Visual Programming for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary 3D Visual Grounding.

DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_cn: 针对开放世界少样本学习（OW-FSL）中CLIP类模型对基类过拟合、对新类泛化不足的问题，本文提出DeIL（Direct-and-Inverse CLIP）框架。方法上通过直接分支与逆分支的双向提示学习，结合视觉-语言对齐的逆映射机制，缓解基类偏置并增强新类判别能力。相比已有CLIP微调方法，DeIL在不牺牲基类性能的前提下显著提升新类识别。在多个OW-FSL基准上取得领先结果，新类准确率提升明显。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.summary_en: This paper addresses the base-class overfitting and poor novel-class generalization of CLIP-style models in open-world few-shot learning (OW-FSL). It proposes DeIL (Direct-and-Inverse CLIP), a dual-branch prompt learning framework with direct and inverse visual-language alignment to mitigate base bias. Compared with prior CLIP fine-tuning methods, DeIL improves novel-class discrimination without sacrificing base-class performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on multiple OW-FSL benchmarks.
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.assessment: 对开放世界少样本识别有参考价值，双向提示思路可迁移到开放集检测场景。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.contribution: 提出直接-逆双向CLIP框架以缓解开放世界少样本学习中的基类偏置。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.innovation: 通过逆分支视觉-语言映射实现基类与新类的解耦对齐。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W.result: 在多个OW-FSL基准上新类准确率显著提升并达到领先水平。
DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-W._arxiv_id: DeIL: Direct-and-Inverse CLIP for Open-World Few-Shot Learning.

Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_cn: 针对现有视觉-语言模型（VLM）视觉编码器与语言模型对齐不足、视觉表征能力受限的问题，本文提出一种受视觉启发的VLM架构改进方案。方法上重新设计视觉编码与跨模态交互模块，使视觉特征更充分地注入语言模型。相比已有VLM，改进点在于增强视觉感知的层次性与对齐质量。实验在多项视觉-语言任务上取得性能提升。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.summary_en: This paper targets the insufficient alignment between visual encoders and language models in existing VLMs, which limits visual representation capability. It proposes a vision-inspired VLM architecture that redesigns visual encoding and cross-modal interaction to better inject visual features into the language model. Compared with prior VLMs, it improves visual perception hierarchy and alignment quality, yielding gains on multiple vision-language tasks.
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.assessment: 对VLM视觉表征设计有启发，但需关注其与自动驾驶感知任务的直接关联。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.contribution: 提出受视觉启发的VLM架构以增强视觉-语言对齐。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.innovation: 重新设计视觉编码与跨模态交互模块提升视觉特征注入质量。
Towards Better Vision-Inspired Vision-La.result: 在多项视觉-语言任务上取得性能提升。

DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）与人类意图对齐不足、交互能力弱的问题，本文提出DRESS框架，利用自然语言反馈进行对齐与交互训练。方法上构建基于自然语言反馈的指令微调与偏好优化流程，使模型更好地理解并响应人类指令。相比已有LVLM，DRESS在指令遵循与交互质量上均有改进。实验表明其在多项对齐与交互评测中表现更优。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak alignment and interaction of large vision-language models (LVLMs) with human intent. It proposes DRESS, a framework that leverages natural language feedback for alignment and interaction training via instruction tuning and preference optimization. Compared with existing LVLMs, DRESS improves instruction following and interaction quality, showing better performance on multiple alignment and interaction benchmarks.
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.assessment: 对VLM人机对齐与反馈学习有参考价值，可启发自动驾驶中的人机交互感知。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.contribution: 提出基于自然语言反馈的DRESS框架以对齐并增强LVLM交互能力。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.innovation: 将自然语言反馈引入指令微调与偏好优化实现人机对齐。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag.result: 在多项对齐与交互评测中表现优于已有LVLM。
DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Languag._arxiv_id: DRESS : Instructing Large Vision-Language Models to Align and Interact with Humans via Natural Language Feedback.

Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）中语言幻觉与视觉错觉相互纠缠、难以诊断的问题，本文提出HallusionBench诊断套件。方法上设计涵盖语言幻觉与视觉错觉的细粒度测试集与评估协议，系统量化模型在两类错误上的表现。相比已有基准，HallusionBench能更精细地区分并定位幻觉来源。实验揭示当前主流LVLM在纠缠幻觉上仍存在显著缺陷。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.summary_en: This paper addresses the entangled language hallucination and visual illusion in large vision-language models (LVLMs), which are hard to diagnose. It proposes HallusionBench, a diagnostic suite with fine-grained test sets and evaluation protocols that systematically quantify both error types. Compared with existing benchmarks, HallusionBench more precisely distinguishes and localizes hallucination sources, revealing substantial deficiencies in current LVLMs.
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.assessment: 作为VLM幻觉诊断基准具有较高价值，对多模态感知可靠性评估有借鉴意义。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.contribution: 提出HallusionBench诊断套件以评估LVLM中语言幻觉与视觉错觉的纠缠问题。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.innovation: 设计细粒度测试集与评估协议区分并定位幻觉来源。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S.result: 揭示主流LVLM在纠缠幻觉上存在显著缺陷。
Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic S._arxiv_id: Hallusionbench: An Advanced Diagnostic Suite for Entangled Language Hallucination and Visual Illusion in Large Vision-Language Models.

Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_cn: 针对视觉-语言模型（VLM）在下游任务适配中依赖梯度优化、成本高的问题，本文提出将语言模型作为黑盒优化器来优化VLM。方法上利用LLM生成并迭代候选提示/参数配置，通过黑盒搜索提升VLM在下游任务的表现。相比传统梯度微调，该方法无需访问模型内部参数，适配更灵活。实验在多项VLM下游任务上取得与梯度方法相当或更优的效果。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost and gradient dependence of adapting vision-language models (VLMs) to downstream tasks. It proposes using language models as black-box optimizers to iteratively generate and refine prompts/configurations for VLMs. Compared with gradient-based fine-tuning, the method requires no access to internal parameters and is more flexible, achieving comparable or better results on multiple VLM downstream tasks.
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.assessment: 黑盒优化思路对VLM高效适配有启发，可探索用于自动驾驶多模态模型调优。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.contribution: 提出以语言模型作为黑盒优化器来优化视觉-语言模型。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.innovation: 利用LLM迭代生成候选配置实现无需梯度的VLM适配。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers.result: 在多项VLM下游任务上取得与梯度方法相当或更优的效果。
Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers._arxiv_id: Language Models as Black-Box Optimizers for Vision-Language Models.

Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_cn: 针对从视觉内容生成匹配声音的多模态任务，本文提出Sonic VisionLM，利用视觉-语言模型为视频/图像生成合理音效。方法上借助VLM的语义理解能力推断场景声音并驱动音频生成模块。相比已有音视频生成方法，其优势在于更强的语义推理与场景适配。实验表明生成音效在语义一致性上表现更优。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.summary_en: This paper targets the multimodal task of generating sound matching visual content. It proposes Sonic VisionLM, which leverages vision-language models to infer plausible sounds from video/images and drive an audio generation module. Compared with prior audio-visual generation methods, it offers stronger semantic reasoning and scene adaptation, achieving better semantic consistency in generated sounds.
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.assessment: 多模态生成方向有趣，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.contribution: 提出Sonic VisionLM利用视觉-语言模型为视觉内容生成匹配声音。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.innovation: 借助VLM语义推理驱动音频生成以提升场景适配性。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio.result: 生成音效在语义一致性上表现更优。
Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Visio._arxiv_id: Sonic VisionLM: Playing Sound with Vision Language Models.

2412.09082|v2.summary_cn: 现有视觉语言导航（VLN）方法主要针对单阶段导航，难以应对复杂动态环境中的多阶段长时程任务。本文提出长时程视觉语言导航（LH-VLN）新任务，强调跨连续子任务的长期规划与决策一致性，并开发了自动化数据生成平台NavGen，通过双向多粒度生成构建复杂任务结构的数据集。作者构建了LHPR-VLN基准，包含3260个任务、平均150步，并提出ISR、CSR、CGT等细粒度评估指标。该工作为长时程VLN提供了首个专用数据集与评估体系，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2412.09082|v2.summary_en: Existing Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) methods focus on single-stage navigation, limiting effectiveness in multi-stage long-horizon tasks. This paper introduces Long-Horizon VLN (LH-VLN), an automated data generation platform NavGen, and the LHPR-VLN benchmark with 3,260 tasks averaging 150 steps, along with ISR, CSR, and CGT metrics for fine-grained evaluation. It provides the first dedicated dataset and evaluation suite for long-horizon VLN, though no quantitative performance results are reported in the abstract.
2412.09082|v2.assessment: 该工作将VLN推向长时程多阶段场景，基准与指标设计对具身智能与导航研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
2412.09082|v2.contribution: 提出长时程视觉语言导航任务、自动化数据生成平台NavGen及首个长时程VLN基准LHPR-VLN与细粒度评估指标。

2411.00836|v2.summary_cn: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在涉及视觉的数学推理任务上表现突出，但作者发现GPT-4o等SOTA模型在问题轻微变体（如数值或函数图变化）下会持续失败，暴露出数学推理鲁棒性不足。现有视觉数学基准仅含静态题目集，难以评估鲁棒性。为此本文提出DynaMath动态视觉数学基准，包含501个高质量多主题种子问题，每个以Python程序表示，可自动生成大量具体变体题目，从而系统评估VLM在题目变体下的推理稳定性。
2411.00836|v2.summary_en: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) show promise in visually grounded mathematical reasoning, SOTA models like GPT-4o consistently fail on minor variants of the same question, revealing limited robustness. Existing vision-math benchmarks are static and cannot assess such robustness. This paper introduces DynaMath, a dynamic visual math benchmark with 501 multi-topic seed questions represented as Python programs that automatically generate large sets of concrete variants for systematic robustness evaluation.

2411.00836|v2.contribution: 提出DynaMath动态视觉数学基准，通过程序化种子问题自动生成变体以评估VLM数学推理鲁棒性。

2306.13394|v2.summary_cn: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）展现出惊人的涌现能力，但现有案例研究难以全面反映其性能，缺乏综合评估。本文提出首个全面的MLLM评估基准MME，覆盖感知与认知共14个子任务。为避免直接使用公开数据集导致的数据泄漏，所有指令-答案对均由人工设计，简洁的指令设计使模型间可公平比较而无需复杂prompt工程，并便于定量统计。作者在MME上评估了30个先进MLLM，表明现有模型仍有较大提升空间并揭示了后续优化方向。
2306.13394|v2.summary_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show emergent abilities, but case studies cannot fully reflect their performance due to lacking comprehensive evaluation. This paper presents MME, the first comprehensive MLLM evaluation benchmark covering 14 perception and cognition subtasks, with all instruction-answer pairs manually designed to avoid data leakage and enable fair comparison without prompt engineering. Evaluating 30 advanced MLLMs reveals substantial room for improvement and potential optimization directions.
2306.13394|v2.assessment: MME是MLLM评测领域的奠基性基准之一，人工标注与简洁指令设计保证了公平性，对多模态研究者有较高参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心方向关联有限。
2306.13394|v2.contribution: 提出首个覆盖感知与认知14个子任务的全面MLLM评估基准MME，并系统评测30个先进MLLM。
2306.13394|v2.innovation: 全部指令-答案对人工设计以避免数据泄漏，简洁指令设计实现无需prompt工程的公平比较与定量统计。
2306.13394|v2.result: 在14个子任务上评测30个MLLM，表明现有模型仍有较大提升空间。

2510.21679|v2.summary_cn: 针对石油天然气企业公关广告中潜在'漂绿'（greenwashing）行为难以大规模识别的问题，论文构建了一个由专家标注的Facebook与YouTube视频广告基准数据集，覆盖20个国家50余家公司/倡导组织，标注了13种framing类型。该数据集专为视觉语言模型（VLM）评估设计，区别于以往纯文本framing数据集。基线实验显示GPT-4.1检测环保信息的F1为79%，而最佳模型在识别'绿色创新'framing时仅达46% F1，揭示了隐式framing、变长视频处理等挑战。
2510.21679|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces an expert-annotated benchmark of video ads from Facebook and YouTube for framing analysis and greenwashing detection, covering 13 framing types across 50+ companies in 20 countries. Unlike prior text-only framing datasets, it is designed for vision-language model evaluation. Baselines show GPT-4.1 achieves 79% F1 on environmental message detection, while the best model reaches only 46% F1 on green innovation framing, highlighting challenges in implicit framing and variable-length video handling.
2510.21679|v2.assessment: 属于NLP/多模态社会计算交叉方向，与自动驾驶感知无关，但对VLM鲁棒性评估有参考价值。
2510.21679|v2.contribution: 构建了首个面向视频广告framing分析与漂绿检测的多模态专家标注基准数据集。
2510.21679|v2.innovation: 将framing分析从纯文本扩展到视频多模态场景，并引入13类细粒度framing标注。
2510.21679|v2.result: GPT-4.1环保信息检测F1达79%，但绿色创新framing识别最佳仅46% F1，仍有较大提升空间。

2507.11932|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态大模型（MLLM）基准主要评估被动视觉感知、缺乏对'心理可视化'（mental visualization）能力考察的问题，论文提出Hyperphantasia合成基准，通过四类程序化生成的谜题、每类三个难度等级来评估MLLM内部构建与操作视觉表征的能力。实验表明当前最先进模型与人类表现存在显著差距。该工作填补了MLLM主动视觉推理评估的空白，但属于认知能力评测而非感知任务。
2507.11932|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Hyperphantasia, a synthetic benchmark for evaluating mental visualization capabilities of multimodal LLMs through four procedurally generated puzzle types at three difficulty levels. Evaluations reveal a substantial gap between state-of-the-art MLLMs and human performance. The work fills a gap in assessing active visual reasoning rather than passive perception.
2507.11932|v2.assessment: 认知科学导向的MLLM评测工作，与自动驾驶感知关联弱，但揭示了当前VLM推理能力的根本局限。
2507.11932|v2.contribution: 提出首个评估MLLM心理可视化能力的合成基准Hyperphantasia。
2507.11932|v2.innovation: 通过程序化生成的多难度谜题系统评估模型内部视觉表征构建能力。
2507.11932|v2.result: 实验显示最先进MLLM与人类在心理可视化任务上存在显著性能差距。

2505.19028|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有多模态问答基准缺乏配对普通图表与信息图（infographic）的问题，论文提出InfoChartQA基准，包含5,642对信息图与普通图表（共享底层数据但视觉呈现不同），并设计了基于视觉元素的问答以捕捉独特设计意图。对20个MLLM的评估显示，模型在信息图上的性能显著下降，尤其是涉及隐喻的视觉元素问题。配对设计支持细粒度错误分析与消融研究。
2505.19028|v2.summary_en: This paper presents InfoChartQA, a benchmark of 5,642 paired infographic and plain charts sharing identical data but differing in visual presentation, designed to evaluate MLLMs on infographic chart understanding. Evaluation of 20 MLLMs reveals substantial performance drops on infographics, especially for metaphor-related visual-element questions. The paired design enables fine-grained error analysis.
2505.19028|v2.assessment: 图表理解方向的VLM评测工作，与自动驾驶感知无直接关联，但配对设计思路对多模态基准构建有借鉴意义。
2505.19028|v2.contribution: 构建了首个配对信息图与普通图表的多模态问答基准InfoChartQA。
2505.19028|v2.innovation: 通过配对图表设计实现细粒度错误归因，并引入基于视觉元素的隐喻类问题。
2505.19028|v2.result: 20个MLLM在信息图上性能显著下降，隐喻相关视觉元素问题尤为突出。

2504.16427|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在理解人类对话中认知级语义方面研究不足的问题，论文提出MMLA基准，包含来自编排与真实场景的61K+多模态话语，覆盖意图、情感、对话行为、情绪、说话风格和交际行为六个核心维度。对八类主流LLM/MLLM采用零样本、监督微调和指令微调三种方法评估，结果显示即使微调后模型也仅达约60%~70%准确率，凸显当前MLLM理解复杂人类语言的局限。
2504.16427|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMLA, a comprehensive benchmark of over 61K multimodal utterances covering six core dimensions of conversational semantics (intent, emotion, dialogue act, sentiment, speaking style, communication behavior). Evaluating eight mainstream LLM/MLLM branches via zero-shot, supervised fine-tuning, and instruction tuning reveals that even fine-tuned models achieve only ~60-70% accuracy, underscoring limitations in understanding complex human language.
2504.16427|v2.assessment: 多模态对话理解评测工作，与自动驾驶感知无关，但对多模态融合与语义理解研究有参考价值。
2504.16427|v2.contribution: 构建了覆盖六个语义维度的多模态语言分析综合基准MMLA。
2504.16427|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估MLLM在认知级多模态对话语义理解上的能力。
2504.16427|v2.result: 即使经过微调，主流MLLM在MMLA上仅达60%~70%准确率。

2507.18342|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在第一人称（egocentric）与第三人称（exocentric）视角间跨视角推理能力尚未被探索的问题，论文提出EgoExoBench，首个面向自我-他人视角视频理解与推理的基准，包含7,300+问答对，覆盖语义对齐、视角关联和时间推理三大核心挑战下的11个子任务。对13个最先进MLLM的评估表明，模型在单视角任务上表现优异，但在跨视角语义对齐、视角关联和时间动态推理上表现不佳。
2507.18342|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces EgoExoBench, the first benchmark for egocentric-exocentric video understanding and reasoning in MLLMs, comprising over 7,300 QA pairs across 11 sub-tasks under three core challenges: semantic alignment, viewpoint association, and temporal reasoning. Evaluation of 13 state-of-the-art MLLMs shows they excel on single-view tasks but struggle with cross-view alignment and temporal inference.
2507.18342|v2.assessment: 跨视角视频理解评测工作，与自动驾驶多相机/环视感知在视角融合思路上有潜在关联，值得关注。
2507.18342|v2.contribution: 提出首个评估MLLM第一/第三人称跨视角视频理解与推理能力的基准EgoExoBench。
2507.18342|v2.innovation: 将跨视角推理分解为语义对齐、视角关联和时间推理三大挑战并系统评测。
2507.18342|v2.result: 13个MLLM在单视角任务表现良好，但跨视角语义对齐与时间推理能力明显不足。
