2601.09111|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对传统视觉语言导航（VLN）在闭集假设下难以适应开放环境和多样化指令的问题，提出General Scene Adaptation（GSA-VLN）任务。受人类快慢认知系统启发，作者设计了slow4fast-VLN动态交互式快慢推理框架：快推理模块为端到端策略网络，实时输出动作并累积历史记忆；慢推理模块分析记忆并通过深度反思提取经验以增强泛化能力。相比已有闭集VLN方法，该框架通过快慢模块的交互实现开放环境下的自适应导航，但摘要未给出具体量化结果。
2601.09111|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of traditional Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) under close-set assumptions, where training and test data share the same style, making them ill-suited for open environments. The authors propose slow4fast-VLN, a dynamic interactive fast-slow reasoning framework inspired by human cognition: a fast-reasoning module outputs real-time actions and accumulates memory, while a slow-reasoning module reflects on these memories to extract experiences that enhance generalization. The approach targets the General Scene Adaptation (GSA-VLN) task, but no quantitative results are provided in the abstract.
2601.09111|v2.assessment: 将快慢认知系统引入VLN以应对开放环境是一个有趣的方向，但摘要缺乏实验数据，实际效果有待验证。
2601.09111|v2.contribution: 提出slow4fast-VLN快慢交互推理框架，用于开放环境下的通用视觉语言导航。
2601.09111|v2.innovation: 受人类快慢认知启发，设计动态交互的快推理与慢反思模块以增强导航泛化能力。
2601.09111|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅描述了框架设计。

2601.06394|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对课堂学生行为参与度测量中标注数据稀缺、隐私限制以及忽视同伴上下文的问题，提出一个三阶段视频分析框架。首先对视觉语言模型（VLM）进行少样本微调以识别学生动作类别；其次用滑动时间窗口将2分钟视频切分为不重叠片段，由微调VLM为每段分配动作标签生成动作序列；最后利用大语言模型结合课堂同伴上下文对整个动作序列进行分类，判断学生参与度等级。相比已有方法，该工作引入同伴上下文并减少标注需求，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2601.06394|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles student behavioral engagement measurement in classrooms, where annotated data is scarce, privacy concerns limit data sharing, and peer context is often ignored. The authors propose a three-stage framework: few-shot fine-tuning of a VLM for student action recognition, sliding temporal window segmentation of 2-minute videos into non-overlapping segments labeled by the fine-tuned VLM, and LLM-based classification of the resulting action sequence together with classroom peer context to determine engagement levels. The approach reduces annotation requirements and incorporates peer context, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2601.06394|v2.assessment: 该工作与自动驾驶感知领域关联极弱，属于教育场景应用，方法上VLM+LLM的组合较为常规。
2601.06394|v2.contribution: 提出结合VLM动作解析与LLM序列分类的三阶段学生参与度测量框架。
2601.06394|v2.innovation: 引入同伴上下文信息并利用少样本VLM微调降低标注需求。
2601.06394|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果。

2601.02046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对文本到图像（T2I）扩散模型生成结果中肢体、面部、文字等局部失真问题，指出现有精修方法要么需要昂贵的迭代重生成，要么依赖空间定位能力弱的VLM导致语义漂移和不可靠的局部编辑。作者提出Agentic Retoucher，一个分层决策驱动的框架，将生成后校正重构为类人的感知-推理-行动循环，包含感知代理（学习上下文显著性以定位失真）、推理代理（通过渐进偏好对齐进行人类对齐的推断诊断）和行动代理（根据用户偏好自适应规划局部修复）。此外构建了GenBlemish-27K数据集（6K张T2I图像，27K标注）用于细粒度监督和定量评估，但摘要未给出具体性能数据。
2601.02046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses small-scale distortions (e.g., limbs, faces, text) in text-to-image diffusion model outputs, where existing refinement methods either require costly iterative regeneration or rely on VLMs with weak spatial grounding, causing semantic drift. The authors propose Agentic Retoucher, a hierarchical decision-driven framework that reformulates post-generation correction as a perception-reasoning-action loop with three agents: a perception agent for distortion localization via contextual saliency, a reasoning agent for human-aligned diagnosis via progressive preference alignment, and an action agent for adaptive localized inpainting. They also construct GenBlemish-27K (6K images, 27K annotations) for fine-grained supervision, but no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
2601.02046|v2.assessment: 该工作属于图像生成后处理方向，与自动驾驶感知研究领域几乎无关，但其感知-推理-行动的分层代理设计思路有一定参考价值。
2601.02046|v2.contribution: 提出Agentic Retoucher分层代理框架及GenBlemish-27K数据集，用于T2I生成图像的局部失真修复。
2601.02046|v2.innovation: 将生成后校正重构为感知-推理-行动循环，并引入渐进偏好对齐实现人类对齐的推断诊断。
2601.02046|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化结果，仅描述了框架和数据集构建。

Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频自监督表示学习中时间动态信息利用不足的问题，提出以视频播放速率作为自监督信号，让模型预测视频被加速或减速的倍率，从而学习时空表征。方法上通过构造不同播放速率的正负样本对，训练3D CNN捕捉细粒度运动线索。相比仅依赖顺序或帧间预测的自监督方法，该任务提供了更连续、更丰富的时间监督信号。在UCF101和HMDB51等下游动作识别任务上取得了优于同期自监督方法的性能。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.summary_en: This paper addresses the underutilization of temporal dynamics in self-supervised video representation learning by introducing video playback rate perception as a pretext task. The model is trained to predict the speed-up or slow-down factor of a video, forcing it to capture fine-grained motion cues. Compared with order-based or frame-prediction pretext tasks, this approach provides a more continuous and informative temporal supervision signal, achieving improved transfer performance on downstream action recognition benchmarks such as UCF101 and HMDB51.
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.assessment: 该工作为视频自监督学习提供了一种新颖且直观的预训练任务，对视频理解方向有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.contribution: 提出以视频播放速率预测作为自监督预训练任务来学习时空视频表征。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.innovation: 将播放速率这一连续时间变量引入自监督学习，构造更丰富的时间监督信号。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-.result: 在UCF101和HMDB51等动作识别基准上取得优于同期自监督方法的迁移性能。
Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-._arxiv_id: Video Playback Rate Perception for Self-Supervised Spatio-Temporal Representation Learning.

Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_cn: 该论文针对屏幕录制教学视频（screencast tutorial video）的理解问题，这类视频包含幻灯片、代码编辑器和讲解语音等多模态内容，与自然视频差异显著。作者构建了面向该场景的数据集与理解任务，并评估了现有视频理解模型在此类内容上的表现。相比通用视频理解工作，该研究聚焦于教学视频这一特定领域，揭示了现有方法在结构化屏幕内容理解上的不足。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..summary_en: This paper targets the understanding of screencast tutorial videos, which contain multimodal content such as slides, code editors, and narration, differing substantially from natural videos. The authors construct a dataset and benchmark tasks for this domain and evaluate existing video understanding models on such content. Compared with general video understanding work, this study focuses on the specific domain of instructional videos and reveals the limitations of current methods in understanding structured screen content.
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..assessment: 该工作关注教学视频这一细分场景，与自动驾驶感知领域关联度低，但对多模态视频理解研究者有一定参考意义。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..contribution: 构建了面向屏幕录制教学视频的理解数据集与评测任务。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..innovation: 将视频理解研究拓展到结构化屏幕内容与讲解语音结合的教学视频场景。
Screencast Tutorial Video Understanding..result: 揭示了现有通用视频理解模型在教学视频上的性能不足。

1912.00381|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D CNN在视频动作识别中参数量大、计算开销高且在小数据集上易过拟合的问题，提出在3D卷积核的时空分解中引入空间门控机制，实现为Gate-Shift Module (GSM)。GSM轻量且可将2D CNN转化为高效的时空特征提取器，使2D CNN以几乎零额外参数和计算开销自适应地在时间维度上路由和融合特征。在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上取得state-of-the-art结果，在EPIC-Kitchens上以远低于对比方法的模型复杂度获得有竞争力的性能。
1912.00381|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high parameter count and computational cost of 3D CNNs for video action recognition, which often underperform without large-scale training data. It introduces spatial gating in the spatio-temporal decomposition of 3D kernels, implemented as the lightweight Gate-Shift Module (GSM) that turns a 2D-CNN into an efficient spatio-temporal feature extractor with almost no additional parameters or computation. GSM achieves state-of-the-art results on Something-Something-V1 and Diving48, and competitive results on EPIC-Kitchens with far less model complexity.
1912.00381|v2.assessment: GSM以极低开销显著提升2D CNN的时空建模能力，思路简洁有效，对高效视频理解及轻量化网络设计有较高参考价值。
1912.00381|v2.contribution: 提出轻量级Gate-Shift Module，将2D CNN高效转化为时空特征提取器。
1912.00381|v2.innovation: 在3D卷积时空分解中引入空间门控，实现自适应的时间特征路由与融合。
1912.00381|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1和Diving48上达到state-of-the-art，EPIC-Kitchens上以更低复杂度取得竞争性结果。

RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D CNN在视频动作识别中计算成本高的问题，提出RubiksNet，用可学习的3D shift操作替代部分3D卷积，实现高效的时空特征建模。方法通过可学习的位移模块在空间和时间维度上移动特征，以极低计算量捕获运动信息。相比标准3D卷积和固定shift操作，可学习shift能自适应地选择位移模式，在保持精度的同时大幅降低FLOPs。在Kinetics等动作识别基准上以更少计算量取得有竞争力的性能。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of 3D CNNs for video action recognition by proposing RubiksNet, which replaces part of 3D convolutions with learnable 3D shift operations for efficient spatio-temporal modeling. The learnable shift module moves features along spatial and temporal dimensions to capture motion at minimal cost, adaptively selecting shift patterns unlike fixed shift operations. It achieves competitive accuracy on action recognition benchmarks such as Kinetics with significantly reduced FLOPs.
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.assessment: 该工作以可学习shift实现高效视频建模，与GSM思路相近，对轻量化时空网络设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知关联有限。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.contribution: 提出RubiksNet，用可学习3D shift替代3D卷积实现高效视频动作识别。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.innovation: 将固定shift操作扩展为可学习的3D位移，自适应捕获时空运动信息。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici.result: 在Kinetics等基准上以显著降低的计算量取得有竞争力的识别精度。
RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Effici._arxiv_id: RubiksNet: Learnable 3D-Shift for Efficient Video Action Recognition.

Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_cn: 针对现有视频问答基准多聚焦静态场景或短片段、缺乏对动态环境综合理解的问题，本文提出了Env-QA基准，用于评估模型对动态环境中物体、动作、时空关系及因果推理的综合理解能力。方法上构建了大规模视频问答数据集并设计了多层次的问答任务与评测协议。相比已有VQA基准，Env-QA更强调动态环境中的时序推理与场景演化理解。实验揭示了当前先进视频理解模型在该基准上仍有明显不足，为后续研究提供了挑战性评测平台。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of benchmarks for comprehensive understanding of dynamic environments in video question answering. It introduces Env-QA, a large-scale benchmark with multi-level QA tasks targeting objects, actions, spatio-temporal relations, and causal reasoning. Compared with existing VQA benchmarks, Env-QA emphasizes temporal reasoning and scene evolution, exposing substantial gaps in current video understanding models.
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.assessment: 为动态环境视频理解提供了系统化评测基准，对视频理解与多模态研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.contribution: 提出了面向动态环境综合理解的视频问答基准Env-QA及配套评测协议。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.innovation: 将动态环境中的时序推理与因果理解纳入统一的视频问答评测框架。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench.result: 实验表明现有先进模型在Env-QA上表现仍有明显不足，凸显该基准的挑战性。
Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Bench._arxiv_id: Env-QA: A Video Question Answering Benchmark for Comprehensive Understanding of Dynamic Environments.

Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_cn: 针对视频理解中时空建模结构不统一、难以兼顾多种任务的问题，本文提出了统一的图结构化模型，将视频中的实体与关系建模为图节点与边，从而统一处理动作识别、时序定位等任务。方法通过图神经网络在时空维度上传播信息，实现跨任务的共享表示。相比任务专用的独立架构，该统一模型在多个视频理解任务上取得有竞争力的性能并具备更好的泛化性。实验在多个标准基准上验证了统一图结构的有效性。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.summary_en: This paper tackles the fragmentation of architectures for video understanding by proposing a unified graph-structured model that represents entities and relations as graph nodes and edges. The model propagates information over space and time via graph neural networks, enabling shared representations across tasks such as action recognition and temporal localization. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show competitive performance and improved generalization over task-specific designs.
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.assessment: 统一图结构建模思路对视频理解架构设计有启发，但偏通用视频任务，与自动驾驶感知的直接相关性一般。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.contribution: 提出统一图结构化模型以跨任务共享时空表示。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.innovation: 用图节点与边统一建模视频中的实体与时空关系。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide.result: 在多个视频理解基准上取得有竞争力性能并展现更好泛化性。
Unified Graph Structured Models for Vide._arxiv_id: Unified Graph Structured Models for Video Understanding.

Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_cn: 针对细粒度体育动作识别中标注样本稀缺的问题，本文提出视频姿态蒸馏方法，将姿态估计模型中的运动先验知识蒸馏到动作识别网络中，以增强少样本条件下的识别能力。方法利用姿态信息作为辅助监督，引导动作识别模型学习更具判别性的运动表征。相比仅依赖RGB的少样本方法，引入姿态蒸馏显著提升了细粒度动作识别精度。实验在体育动作数据集上验证了该方法在少样本设定下的有效性。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.summary_en: This paper addresses few-shot fine-grained sports action recognition by proposing video pose distillation, which transfers motion priors from pose estimation models into action recognition networks. Pose information serves as auxiliary supervision to learn more discriminative motion representations. Experiments on sports datasets demonstrate improved few-shot recognition accuracy over RGB-only baselines.
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.assessment: 姿态蒸馏思路对少样本动作识别有价值，但应用场景偏体育领域，与自动驾驶感知关联较弱。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.contribution: 提出视频姿态蒸馏方法用于少样本细粒度动作识别。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.innovation: 将姿态估计的运动先验蒸馏进动作识别网络以增强少样本学习。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi.result: 在体育动作数据集上少样本识别精度较RGB基线明显提升。
Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fi._arxiv_id: Video Pose Distillation for Few-Shot, Fine-Grained Sports Action Recognition.

Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中运动建模依赖光流、计算代价高的问题，本文提出在空间与时间维度上学习自相似性作为广义运动表示，替代传统光流。方法通过计算特征图内部及跨帧的自相似性来捕捉运动线索，并将其嵌入动作识别网络。相比光流方法，该自相似运动表示无需额外网络且计算更高效，同时在多个动作识别基准上取得有竞争力的精度。实验验证了自相似性作为广义运动表征的有效性。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of optical-flow-based motion modeling in video action recognition by learning self-similarity in space and time as a generalized motion representation. Self-similarity within and across frames captures motion cues without extra flow networks. Experiments on standard action recognition benchmarks show competitive accuracy with improved efficiency.
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.assessment: 以自相似性替代光流的运动建模思路简洁有效，对视频理解研究者有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.contribution: 提出时空自相似性作为广义运动表示用于动作识别。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.innovation: 用特征自相似性替代光流来高效建模视频运动。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti.result: 在多个动作识别基准上取得有竞争力精度且计算更高效。
Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Ti._arxiv_id: Learning Self-Similarity in Space and Time as Generalized Motion for Video Action Recognition.

MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_cn: 针对视频动作识别中帧采样策略缺乏可解释性与自适应性的问题，本文提出MGSampler，一种可解释的采样策略，通过建模帧间运动与信息量来动态选择最具代表性的帧。方法基于运动引导的采样准则，在训练与推理阶段自适应地挑选关键帧。相比均匀采样或随机采样，MGSampler在多个动作识别基准上提升了识别精度并增强了采样过程的可解释性。实验验证了该采样策略的有效性与通用性。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of interpretability and adaptivity in frame sampling for video action recognition by proposing MGSampler, an explainable sampling strategy that dynamically selects representative frames based on motion and informativeness. Compared with uniform or random sampling, MGSampler improves recognition accuracy on multiple benchmarks while making the sampling process interpretable.
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.assessment: 可解释自适应采样对视频理解有实用价值，但属于视频识别子问题，与自动驾驶感知关联一般。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.contribution: 提出可解释的运动引导视频帧采样策略MGSampler。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.innovation: 基于运动与信息量自适应选择关键帧并提升可解释性。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat.result: 在多个动作识别基准上较均匀/随机采样提升识别精度。
MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strat._arxiv_id: MGSampler: An Explainable Sampling Strategy for Video Action Recognition.

TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_cn: 针对文本-视频检索中跨模态对齐不足、单一教师蒸馏受限的问题，本文提出TeachText，一种跨模态广义蒸馏方法，通过多个教师模型与跨模态蒸馏提升文本-视频检索性能。方法设计了广义蒸馏框架，将不同模态与模型的互补知识迁移到学生网络，增强跨模态表示学习。相比已有单教师蒸馏方法，TeachText在多个文本-视频检索基准上取得显著提升。实验表明该方法在检索精度上优于现有先进方法。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient cross-modal alignment and limited single-teacher distillation in text-video retrieval by proposing TeachText, a cross-modal generalized distillation method. It transfers complementary knowledge from multiple teachers across modalities into a student network to enhance cross-modal representations. Experiments on multiple text-video retrieval benchmarks show significant improvements over prior state-of-the-art methods.
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.assessment: 跨模态广义蒸馏思路对多模态检索有较强创新性，与多模态感知研究相关，值得关注。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.contribution: 提出跨模态广义蒸馏框架TeachText用于文本-视频检索。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.innovation: 利用多教师跨模态蒸馏迁移互补知识增强跨模态表示。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil.result: 在多个文本-视频检索基准上显著优于现有先进方法。
TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distil._arxiv_id: TeachText: CrossModal Generalized Distillation for Text-Video Retrieval.

Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中原始视频计算与存储开销大的问题，提出直接在压缩视频域进行自监督表示学习。方法利用压缩视频中已有的运动矢量与残差信息，设计自监督预训练任务以学习时空表示。相比在解码后的RGB帧上做自监督学习，该工作避免了完整解码，提升了效率并利用了压缩域中的运动线索。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该方向对视频理解与自监督学习具有参考价值。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and storage cost of learning video representations from raw pixels by performing self-supervised learning directly on compressed videos. It leverages motion vectors and residuals available in the compressed domain to design pretext tasks for spatiotemporal representation learning. Compared with RGB-frame-based self-supervised methods, it avoids full decoding and exploits compression-domain motion cues, offering an efficient alternative for video representation learning.
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.assessment: 该工作将自监督视频表示学习推进到压缩域，对视频理解与高效感知有潜在价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体预训练任务设计与下游迁移效果。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.contribution: 提出在压缩视频域进行自监督表示学习的框架，利用压缩码流中的运动与残差信息。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.innovation: 将自监督预训练从RGB帧域迁移到压缩视频域，避免完整解码并利用压缩域运动线索。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，需查看全文验证其在下游任务上的表现。
Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed V._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Learning of Compressed Video Representations.

2102.05095|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频分类中3D卷积网络计算量大、难以建模长时序的问题，提出完全基于时空自注意力的无卷积架构TimeSformer。方法将标准Transformer适配到视频，直接在帧级patch序列上学习时空特征，并系统比较了多种自注意力方案，发现将时间注意力与空间注意力在每个block内分开应用的divided attention效果最佳。在Kinetics-400和Kinetics-600上取得当时最佳精度，且相比3D卷积网络训练更快、测试效率更高，可处理超过一分钟的长视频。
2102.05095|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the high computational cost and limited long-range temporal modeling of 3D CNNs for video classification by proposing TimeSformer, a convolution-free architecture built purely on spatiotemporal self-attention. It adapts the standard Transformer to video by learning directly from sequences of frame-level patches, and systematically compares self-attention schemes, finding that divided attention—separately applying temporal and spatial attention within each block—yields the best accuracy. It achieves state-of-the-art results on Kinetics-400 and Kinetics-600, trains faster than 3D CNNs, offers higher test efficiency, and scales to clips over one minute long.
2102.05095|v2.assessment: TimeSformer是视频理解领域Transformer化的里程碑工作，其divided attention设计被后续大量方法沿用，对多相机时序感知与BEV时序融合也有启发。
2102.05095|v2.contribution: 提出无卷积的纯时空自注意力视频分类架构TimeSformer，并系统比较不同时空注意力方案。
2102.05095|v2.innovation: 提出divided space-time attention，在每个block内分别进行时间与空间注意力，兼顾精度与效率。
2102.05095|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600上取得当时最佳精度，训练更快、测试效率更高，并可处理超过一分钟的长视频。

2106.11958|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪与分割中关联仅利用时序、分割掩码仅依赖单帧预测的问题，提出原型交叉注意力网络PCAN。方法先将时空记忆蒸馏为一组原型，再通过交叉注意力从过去帧中检索丰富信息；同时采用原型外观模块学习对比性的前景与背景原型并随时间传播以分割每个目标。在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上，PCAN超越了当时视频实例跟踪与分割竞赛的冠军方法，并适用于一阶段与两阶段分割框架。
2106.11958|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of using temporal cues only for association and single-frame predictions for segmentation in multiple object tracking and segmentation, proposing the Prototypical Cross-Attention Network (PCAN). PCAN distills a space-time memory into prototypes and retrieves information from past frames via cross-attention, while a prototypical appearance module learns contrastive foreground and background prototypes propagated over time for per-object segmentation. It outperforms video instance tracking and segmentation competition winners on Youtube-VIS and BDD100K, and is effective for both one-stage and two-stage segmentation frameworks.
2106.11958|v2.assessment: PCAN将原型学习与交叉注意力结合用于视频实例跟踪与分割，在自动驾驶数据集BDD100K上验证有效，对多目标跟踪与分割方向有较强参考价值。
2106.11958|v2.contribution: 提出PCAN，利用时空原型与交叉注意力进行在线多目标跟踪与分割。
2106.11958|v2.innovation: 将时空记忆蒸馏为原型并通过交叉注意力检索，同时用对比性前景/背景原型实现时序一致的分割。
2106.11958|v2.result: 在Youtube-VIS和BDD100K上超越当时竞赛冠军方法，并兼容一阶段与两阶段分割框架。

2104.11178|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多模态表示学习依赖标注数据与卷积架构的问题，提出从原始视频、音频和文本进行自监督学习的VATT框架。方法采用无卷积Transformer直接处理原始信号，通过多模态对比损失端到端从头训练，并研究了在三种模态间共享权重的模态无关单骨干Transformer。VATT在视频动作识别、音频事件分类、图像分类和文本到视频检索等下游任务上超越基于ConvNet的SOTA，其中视觉Transformer在Kinetics-400上达82.1% top-1、Kinetics-600达83.6%、Kinetics-700达72.7%、Moments in Time达41.1%，迁移到ImageNet达78.7%。
2104.11178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on labeled data and convolutional architectures in multimodal representation learning by proposing VATT, a framework for self-supervised learning from raw video, audio, and text. It uses convolution-free Transformers that take raw signals as input, trained end-to-end from scratch with multimodal contrastive losses, and studies a modality-agnostic single-backbone Transformer with shared weights across modalities. VATT outperforms ConvNet-based state-of-the-art on downstream tasks, achieving 82.1% top-1 on Kinetics-400, 83.6% on Kinetics-600, 72.7% on Kinetics-700, 41.1% on Moments in Time, and 78.7% on ImageNet after transfer.
2104.11178|v2.assessment: VATT是多模态自监督Transformer的代表性工作，其模态无关共享骨干设计对多传感器融合与多模态预训练有重要启发。
2104.11178|v2.contribution: 提出VATT，从原始视频、音频和文本进行多模态自监督预训练的无卷积Transformer框架。
2104.11178|v2.innovation: 采用多模态对比损失端到端训练，并探索跨三种模态共享权重的模态无关单骨干Transformer。
2104.11178|v2.result: 在Kinetics-400/600/700、Moments in Time及ImageNet迁移上均取得当时最佳或显著提升，如Kinetics-400 top-1达82.1%。

Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频表示学习中全局与局部信息难以兼顾的问题，提出全局与局部视频表示的对比学习方法。方法通过设计不同粒度的对比学习目标，同时捕获视频的整体语义与局部时空细节。相比仅使用单一粒度对比学习的工作，该方法在表示质量上有所提升。摘要未提供具体实验数据，需查看全文验证其在下游任务上的效果。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of jointly capturing global and local information in video representation learning by proposing a contrastive learning approach for global and local video representations. It designs contrastive objectives at different granularities to capture both holistic semantics and local spatiotemporal details. Compared with single-granularity contrastive methods, it improves representation quality, though the abstract provides no quantitative results.
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.assessment: 该工作从多粒度对比学习角度改进视频表示，思路合理，但摘要信息有限，需关注其具体目标设计与实验验证。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.contribution: 提出同时学习全局与局部视频表示的对比学习框架。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.innovation: 通过多粒度对比目标联合捕获视频的整体语义与局部时空细节。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，需查看全文验证其在下游任务上的表现。
Contrastive Learning of Global and Local._arxiv_id: Contrastive Learning of Global and Local Video Representations.

2111.01673|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有动态特征变换（包括自注意力）在视频理解中难以建模时空对应关系与运动信息的问题，提出关系自注意力RSA。方法通过动态生成关系核并聚合关系上下文，利用视频中丰富的时空关系结构进行特征变换。实验与消融表明，RSA网络显著优于卷积和自注意力对应方法，在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48和FineGym等以运动为中心的标准动作识别基准上取得SOTA。
2111.01673|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing dynamic feature transforms, including self-attention, in modeling spatiotemporal correspondence and motion for video understanding, proposing the relational self-attention (RSA). RSA dynamically generates relational kernels and aggregates relational contexts to leverage rich spatiotemporal relation structures in videos. Experiments and ablations show that RSA substantially outperforms convolution and self-attention counterparts, achieving state-of-the-art on motion-centric action recognition benchmarks including Something-Something-V1&V2, Diving48, and FineGym.
2111.01673|v2.assessment: RSA针对视频中运动建模这一核心问题改进自注意力机制，在多个运动中心基准上取得SOTA，对视频理解与动态场景感知有参考价值。
2111.01673|v2.contribution: 提出关系自注意力RSA，通过动态生成关系核与聚合关系上下文进行视频特征变换。
2111.01673|v2.innovation: 在自注意力中显式建模时空对应关系，动态生成关系核以捕获运动信息。
2111.01673|v2.result: 在Something-Something-V1&V2、Diving48和FineGym等运动中心基准上取得SOTA，显著优于卷积与自注意力方法。

Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中归一化层与网络深度堆叠带来的优化与表达瓶颈问题，提出动态归一化（Dynamic Normalization）与中继（Relay）机制，通过让归一化参数随输入动态调整并引入跨层信息中继来增强时序建模能力。相比固定归一化与常规残差连接，该方法在多个动作识别基准上取得提升。由于摘要信息有限，具体数据集与数值结果未能引用。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.summary_en: This paper addresses optimization and representation bottlenecks in video action recognition caused by static normalization layers and deep network stacking. It proposes Dynamic Normalization and a Relay mechanism that adaptively modulates normalization parameters conditioned on the input and relays cross-layer information to strengthen temporal modeling. Compared with fixed normalization and standard residual connections, the method improves performance on several action recognition benchmarks, though specific datasets and numerical gains are not available from the provided abstract.
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.assessment: 该工作聚焦视频动作识别中的归一化与信息流动设计，思路有一定新意，但与自动驾驶感知、3D检测、BEV等核心方向关联较弱，仅对视频理解子方向有参考价值。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.contribution: 提出动态归一化与中继机制以增强视频动作识别网络的时序表达能力。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.innovation: 让归一化参数随输入动态调整并引入跨层信息中继，突破静态归一化的表达限制。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide.result: 在多个动作识别基准上取得性能提升（摘要未给出具体数值）。
Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Vide._arxiv_id: Dynamic Normalization and Relay for Video Action Recognition.

Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_cn: 该论文针对视频动作识别中时空建模效率与精度难以兼顾的问题，提出将Transformer结构进行循环复用（Recurring），以共享参数的方式在时间维度上迭代处理视频帧序列。相比标准视频Transformer逐帧独立或全注意力计算，该方法通过循环机制减少参数量并增强时序上下文建模能力。摘要未提供具体实验数据，但思路属于视频理解中Transformer轻量化与循环架构的结合。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.summary_en: This paper addresses video action recognition by proposing a recurring Transformer architecture that reuses shared parameters across temporal iterations to model spatio-temporal context efficiently. Unlike standard video Transformers that process frames independently or with full attention, the recurring design reduces parameters while enhancing temporal modeling. The abstract lacks quantitative results, but the approach targets efficient video understanding.
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.assessment: 将循环机制引入视频Transformer是一个有趣的方向，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与效率的权衡。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.contribution: 提出循环复用Transformer的视频动作识别框架。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.innovation: 通过参数共享的循环结构在时间维度上迭代建模视频时序。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。
Recurring the Transformer for Video Acti._arxiv_id: Recurring the Transformer for Video Action Recognition.

2208.00281|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对长期4D点云视频理解中相机运动、场景变化和采样模式复杂导致现有4D卷积或非层次化Transformer效率低、效果差的问题，提出以primitive plane作为中层表示，并设计层次化骨干网络Point Primitive Transformer（PPTr），由intra-primitive point transformer和primitive transformer组成。相比已有方法，PPTr通过层次化结构更好地捕获长期时空上下文。实验表明PPTr在多个任务上超越此前最优方法。
2208.00281|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles long-term 4D point cloud video understanding, where camera motion, scene changes, and sampling complexity degrade existing 4D convolution or non-hierarchical Transformer methods. It proposes Point Primitive Transformer (PPTr), a hierarchical backbone using primitive planes as mid-level representations, composed of intra-primitive point transformers and primitive transformers. Extensive experiments show PPTr outperforms previous state-of-the-art on multiple tasks.
2208.00281|v2.assessment: 层次化4D点云骨干网络设计合理，primitive plane的中层表示对长期时空建模有实际价值，值得关注。
2208.00281|v2.contribution: 提出基于primitive plane的层次化4D点云视频理解骨干PPTr。
2208.00281|v2.innovation: 以primitive plane为中层表示，结合intra-primitive与primitive transformer实现层次化时空建模。
2208.00281|v2.result: 在多个任务上超越此前最优方法。

2207.10158|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自监督视频表示学习中聚类方法过度依赖视觉主导特征、忽视运动信息的问题，提出引导式在线聚类分配策略（GOCA），利用一个视图的初始聚类分配作为先验来引导另一视图的最终聚类分配，从而强制RGB与光流两个视图形成相似的聚类结构。同时提出新的正则化策略缓解基于聚类的自监督学习中的特征坍缩问题。大量评估表明所学表示在下游任务上有效。
2207.10158|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the issue that clustering-based self-supervised video representation learning overly relies on visually dominant features and neglects motion. It proposes Guided Online Cluster Assignment (GOCA), where the initial cluster assignment of one view guides the final assignment of the other, enforcing similar cluster structures across RGB and optical flow views. A novel regularization mitigates feature collapse, and extensive evaluations demonstrate effective learned representations.
2207.10158|v2.assessment: 双视图聚类互相引导的思路简洁有效，对自监督视频表示学习中的运动建模问题有针对性改进。
2207.10158|v2.contribution: 提出引导式在线聚类分配策略GOCA用于自监督视频表示学习。
2207.10158|v2.innovation: 用一视图的初始聚类先验引导另一视图的聚类分配，并引入抗特征坍缩正则化。
2207.10158|v2.result: 大量评估表明所学表示在下游任务上有效。

2204.04796|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对第一人称动作识别中背景干扰物影响以及现有方法依赖目标域高质量物体类别标注、且与动作模型深度耦合需联合重训练的问题，提出SOS方法，利用现成的手-物接触检测器检测视频物体区域，并自监督预训练通用的Objects In Contact（OIC）表示模型。该方法将动作过程视为具有时空连续性的自然数据变换，利用视频内物体区域间的内在关系进行学习，而非独立增强物体区域。摘要未给出具体实验数据。
2204.04796|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses egocentric action recognition challenges from background distractors and the limitations of existing methods requiring target-domain object annotations and costly joint retraining. It introduces SOS, which pre-trains a generic Objects In Contact (OIC) representation from video object regions detected by an off-the-shelf hand-object contact detector, exploiting spatio-temporal continuity and inter-object relationships as natural transformations. The abstract does not report quantitative results.
2204.04796|v2.assessment: 利用手-物接触检测器进行自监督物体表示预训练，解耦了动作模型与物体表示，思路实用。
2204.04796|v2.contribution: 提出SOS自监督预训练通用手-物接触物体表示模型。
2204.04796|v2.innovation: 将动作过程视为自然数据变换，利用视频内物体区域时空关系进行自监督学习。
2204.04796|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体实验数据。

2202.14019|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对健身房场景下现成姿态估计器因相机角度、器械遮挡、光照和着装等因素表现不佳，且动作错误检测需识别细微偏差的问题，提出领域知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法（姿态对比学习和运动解耦），利用锻炼动作的谐波运动特性以及相机角度、服装、光照的大方差来学习强表示，使得少量专家标注数据即可完成监督错误检测。同时构建了包含BackSquat、BarbellRow等三个动作的新数据集Fitness-AQA。
2202.14019|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses poor pose estimation in gym scenarios due to camera angles, equipment occlusion, illumination, and clothing, as well as the subtlety of workout form errors. It proposes domain knowledge-informed self-supervised approaches (pose contrastive learning and motion disentangling) that exploit harmonic motion and large variances in camera angles, clothes, and illumination, enabling supervised error detection with small expert-annotated data. A new Fitness-AQA dataset covering three exercises is also curated.
2202.14019|v2.assessment: 领域知识驱动的自监督设计贴合健身场景，新数据集对细粒度动作评估研究有参考价值，但领域相关性较窄。
2202.14019|v2.contribution: 提出领域知识驱动的自监督表示学习方法并构建Fitness-AQA数据集。
2202.14019|v2.innovation: 利用锻炼动作谐波运动特性设计姿态对比学习与运动解耦自监督任务。
2202.14019|v2.result: 少量专家标注即可实现监督错误检测，并发布Fitness-AQA数据集。

2207.12795|v2.summary_cn: 该论文受人类理解视频方式启发，针对自监督视频表示学习中静态与动态信息混杂的问题，提出先学习通用视觉概念再关注判别性局部区域的学习方案。具体利用静态帧和帧差解耦静态与动态概念，在隐空间分别对齐概念分布，并加入多样性和保真度正则化以学习紧凑且有意义的 concept 集合；随后用交叉注意力聚合不同概念的局部特征，过滤低激活冗余概念进行局部概念对比。在UCF-101、HMDB-51和Diving-48上取得最优结果。
2207.12795|v2.summary_en: Inspired by how humans understand videos, this paper proposes a self-supervised video representation learning scheme that first learns general visual concepts and then attends to discriminative local areas. It decouples static and dynamic concepts using static frames and frame differences, aligns concept distributions in latent space with diversity and fidelity regularizations, and employs cross-attention to aggregate local features while filtering redundant concepts for local concept contrast. It achieves state-of-the-art results on UCF-101, HMDB-51, and Diving-48.
2207.12795|v2.assessment: 静态/动态概念解耦与局部概念对比的设计有理论动机，且在多个标准基准上取得SOTA，值得关注。
2207.12795|v2.contribution: 提出解耦静态与动态概念的自监督视频表示学习方案。
2207.12795|v2.innovation: 利用静态帧与帧差解耦概念分布，并通过交叉注意力进行局部概念对比。

2207.01975|v2.summary_cn: 针对边缘设备产生大量无标注视频数据时，自监督学习面临隐私和通信成本问题，本文提出将联邦学习引入视频自监督学习。作者评估了现有SOTA视频SSL方法在联邦设置下的不足，并提出FedVSSL框架，集成不同聚合策略和部分权重更新。在Kinetics-400模拟的联邦设置下，FedVSSL在下游检索任务上超过集中式SOTA，UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。
2207.01975|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses privacy and communication challenges in video self-supervised learning (SSL) on edge devices by introducing federated learning. The authors evaluate existing SOTA video-SSL methods in a federated setting and propose FedVSSL, a framework integrating aggregation strategies and partial weight updating. FedVSSL outperforms centralized SOTA on downstream retrieval by 6.66% on UCF-101 and 5.13% on HMDB-51.
2207.01975|v2.assessment: 将联邦学习与视频自监督结合，对隐私敏感场景有实际意义，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱。
2207.01975|v2.contribution: 提出FedVSSL联邦视频自监督学习框架，集成聚合策略与部分权重更新。
2207.01975|v2.innovation: 首次系统评估视频SSL在联邦设置下的表现并提出改进框架。
2207.01975|v2.result: 下游检索任务上UCF-101提升6.66%，HMDB-51提升5.13%。

2112.04478|v2.summary_cn: 针对视频理解任务资源消耗大的问题，本文提出一种高效适配预训练图像-语言模型的方法。通过优化少量连续提示向量将视频任务转化为与预训练目标相同格式，并用轻量Transformer编码时序信息。在10个动作识别、定位和文本-视频检索基准上，涵盖闭集、少样本和零样本场景，以显著更少的可调参数达到竞争性或SOTA性能。
2112.04478|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes an efficient method to adapt pre-trained image-language models for video understanding by optimizing continuous prompt vectors and using lightweight Transformers for temporal encoding. On 10 benchmarks across action recognition, localization, and text-video retrieval, it achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance with significantly fewer trainable parameters.
2112.04478|v2.assessment: 提示学习与VLM结合用于视频理解，方法简洁有效，对多模态感知有参考价值。
2112.04478|v2.contribution: 提出基于连续提示向量的高效视频-语言模型适配方法。
2112.04478|v2.innovation: 用少量可学习提示向量将视频任务统一到预训练目标格式，并轻量编码时序。
2112.04478|v2.result: 在10个基准上以极少参数达到竞争性或SOTA性能。
