2101.12159|v2.summary_cn: 现有多目标跟踪方法通常独立建模每个目标，缺乏利用场景中所有目标联合更新记忆的能力，在相似外观目标共存时易产生匹配错误。本文提出一种新颖的多轨迹池化（multi-track pooling）模块，以极小的空间开销在记忆更新时同时考虑所有轨迹，并设计了适配该模块的在线困难跟踪片段训练策略。结合这些创新形成了强判别性外观模型，使得仅用贪心数据关联即可实现在线跟踪，在公开MOT数据集上取得了实时、最先进的性能。
2101.12159|v2.summary_en: Existing MOT methods typically model each target in isolation and cannot jointly update memory using all targets in the scene, causing errors with similar-looking objects. This paper proposes a novel multi-track pooling module that simultaneously considers all tracks during memory updating with minimal spatial overhead, along with an online hard tracking episode training strategy. The resulting discriminative appearance model enables greedy data association to achieve real-time state-of-the-art performance on public MOT datasets.
2101.12159|v2.assessment: 多轨迹池化思路简洁有效，训练策略与模块设计匹配良好，实时性和精度兼顾，对MOT外观建模有实际参考价值。
2101.12159|v2.contribution: 提出多轨迹池化模块及配套训练策略，实现联合记忆更新的强判别外观模型。
2101.12159|v2.innovation: 以极小空间开销同时利用所有轨迹进行记忆更新，并生成在线困难跟踪片段训练。
2101.12159|v2.result: 在公开MOT数据集上以贪心数据关联实现实时、最先进的跟踪性能。

2012.08197|v2.summary_cn: RGB-D视频序列中的多目标跟踪面临视角变化、运动和遮挡等挑战。本文观察到完整物体几何有助于跟踪，提出联合推断物体完整几何与跟踪刚体运动目标的方法：从RGB-D帧序列中检测物体，学习预测其完整几何及到规范空间的稠密对应映射，从而推导每帧6DoF位姿和帧间对应关系。通过幻觉物体不可见区域获得额外对应，在强外观变化下仍能鲁棒跟踪，在合成和真实RGB-D数据上达到动态目标跟踪的最先进性能。
2012.08197|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking from RGB-D sequences is challenging due to changing viewpoints, motion, and occlusions. This paper proposes to jointly infer complete object geometry and track rigidly moving objects, learning to predict full geometry and dense correspondence mapping into a canonical space from RGB-D frames, thereby deriving 6DoF poses and frame correspondences. Hallucinating unseen regions provides additional correspondences for robust tracking under strong appearance changes, achieving state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic and real-world RGB-D data.
2012.08197|v2.assessment: 将物体几何补全与跟踪联合建模的思路新颖，利用不可见区域幻觉增强对应关系，对遮挡场景下的3D跟踪有重要启发。
2012.08197|v2.contribution: 提出联合推断完整物体几何与6DoF位姿的RGB-D多目标跟踪框架。
2012.08197|v2.innovation: 通过幻觉物体不可见区域获取额外帧间对应，实现强外观变化下的鲁棒跟踪。
2012.08197|v2.result: 在合成和真实RGB-D数据上取得动态目标跟踪的最先进性能。

2103.07889|v2.summary_cn: MOT中数据关联问题难以端到端求解。本文提出基于候选框的可学习框架，将MOT建模为亲和图上的候选生成、候选评分和轨迹推断范式，类似两阶段检测器Faster RCNN。候选生成采用迭代图聚类降低计算成本并保持质量；候选评分部署可训练图卷积网络学习结构模式并按质量排序；轨迹推断采用简单去重叠策略满足无检测被分配给多条轨迹的约束。实验表明该方法在MOTA和IDF1上均有明显提升。
2103.07889|v2.summary_en: Data association in MOT is difficult to solve end-to-end. This paper proposes a proposal-based learnable framework modeling MOT as proposal generation, proposal scoring, and trajectory inference on an affinity graph, analogous to Faster RCNN. It uses iterative graph clustering for proposal generation, a trainable GCN for proposal scoring, and a de-overlapping strategy for trajectory inference. Experiments show clear improvements in both MOTA and IDF1.
2103.07889|v2.assessment: 将两阶段检测范式迁移到MOT数据关联的设计思路清晰，GCN评分与图聚类结合合理，对端到端MOT研究有参考价值。
2103.07889|v2.contribution: 提出基于候选框的MOT可学习框架，将跟踪建模为亲和图上的生成-评分-推断范式。
2103.07889|v2.innovation: 用迭代图聚类生成候选、GCN学习候选结构模式并评分，实现数据驱动的数据关联。
2103.07889|v2.result: 在MOTA和IDF1指标上均取得明显性能提升。

2104.00380|v2.summary_cn: 现代在线MOT方法通常分别关注位置预测或判别性身份嵌入生成，部分工作虽将两者结合在同一框架内却作为独立任务处理，互益有限。本文提出统一模型，通过时序感知目标注意力、干扰物注意力和身份感知记忆聚合模型，将位置预测与嵌入关联协同起来：注意力模块使预测更聚焦目标、更少受干扰物影响，从而提取更可靠嵌入；可靠嵌入又通过记忆聚合增强身份感知，强化注意力并抑制漂移。该协同机制对遮挡具有强鲁棒性。
2104.00380|v2.summary_en: Modern online MOT methods usually focus separately on position prediction or discriminative identity embedding, and prior combined frameworks treat them as independent tasks with little mutual benefit. This paper proposes a unified model synergizing position prediction and embedding association via temporal-aware target attention, distractor attention, and identity-aware memory aggregation. The attention modules improve prediction focus and embedding reliability, which in turn enhances identity-awareness and suppresses drifts, yielding strong robustness to occlusions.
2104.00380|v2.assessment: 位置预测与嵌入关联的协同设计思路清晰，注意力与记忆聚合的闭环机制合理，对遮挡场景下的在线MOT有实用价值。
2104.00380|v2.contribution: 提出统一模型实现位置预测与嵌入关联的跨任务协同。
2104.00380|v2.innovation: 通过时序感知目标/干扰物注意力和身份感知记忆聚合形成预测与关联的互益闭环。
2104.00380|v2.result: 在遮挡场景下展现出强鲁棒性，提升了在线跟踪性能。

2103.16178|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联问题，现有方法忽略轨迹片段与帧内检测间的上下文信息，端到端关联方法未利用优化分配优势，且基于图的优化方法使用独立网络提取特征导致训练与推理不一致。本文提出可学习图匹配方法，将轨迹片段与帧内检测的关系建模为无向图，关联问题转化为轨迹图与检测图之间的图匹配，并实现端到端优化。相比已有工作，该方法结合了深度特征学习与图划分优化，提升了严重遮挡等挑战场景下的跟踪鲁棒性。在MOT基准上取得了优于现有方法的关联性能。
2103.16178|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses data association in multiple object tracking, where existing methods ignore context among tracklets and detections, end-to-end methods neglect optimization-based assignment, and graph-based methods suffer from training-inference inconsistency. It proposes a learnable graph matching method that models tracklet-detection relationships as an undirected graph and transforms association into graph matching between tracklet and detection graphs, enabling end-to-end optimization. The method combines deep feature learning with graph partitioning, improving robustness under severe occlusion and achieving superior association performance on MOT benchmarks.
2103.16178|v2.assessment: 将图匹配与深度特征学习统一到端到端框架，对MOT数据关联有实质推进，值得关注。
2103.16178|v2.contribution: 提出可学习图匹配框架，将轨迹与检测关联建模为图匹配问题并实现端到端训练。
2103.16178|v2.innovation: 融合图划分优化与深度特征学习，解决训练推理不一致问题。
2103.16178|v2.result: 在MOT基准上提升了严重遮挡场景下的关联鲁棒性，性能优于现有方法。

Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联依赖稀疏采样导致相似度学习不充分的问题，本文提出准稠密相似度学习方法。该方法在大量无标注的准稠密区域上学习实例相似度，而非仅依赖稀疏的检测框对，从而增强关联的判别能力。相比已有工作，通过准稠密采样显著提升了相似度学习的覆盖度和鲁棒性。在MOT基准上取得了当时领先的跟踪性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.summary_en: This paper tackles insufficient similarity learning in multiple object tracking caused by sparse sampling in data association. It proposes quasi-dense similarity learning that learns instance similarity over numerous unlabeled quasi-dense regions rather than sparse detection pairs, enhancing association discriminability. The approach improves coverage and robustness of similarity learning, achieving state-of-the-art tracking performance on MOT benchmarks.
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.assessment: 准稠密相似度学习思路简洁有效，对MOT关联学习有启发意义。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.contribution: 提出准稠密相似度学习方法用于多目标跟踪的数据关联。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.innovation: 在大量无标注准稠密区域上学习实例相似度，替代稀疏采样。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult.result: 在MOT基准上取得领先的跟踪性能。
Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Mult._arxiv_id: Quasi-Dense Similarity Learning for Multiple Object Tracking.

2012.02337|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中长期遮挡导致轨迹中断的难题，现有联合检测跟踪方法忽略长期运动信息。本文提出概率自回归运动模型，通过学习自然轨迹片段的潜在分布来直接度量轨迹提议的似然，从而不仅可将新检测分配给现有轨迹，还能在目标长时间丢失时通过采样轨迹片段进行修复填补检测空缺。相比已有工作，该方法显式建模长期运动信息并支持轨迹修复。在MOT16、MOT17和MOT20上大多数标准指标超越当时最优方法。
2012.02337|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses long-term occlusion in multiple object tracking, where joint detection and tracking methods ignore long-term motion information. It introduces a probabilistic autoregressive motion model that scores tracklet proposals by directly measuring their likelihood, learned from the underlying distribution of natural tracklets. The model assigns new detections to existing tracklets and inpaints tracklets during long occlusions by sampling to fill detection gaps. It outperforms state-of-the-art on most standard metrics across MOT16, MOT17, and MOT20.
2012.02337|v2.assessment: 概率自回归轨迹修复思路新颖，对长期遮挡场景的MOT有重要价值。
2012.02337|v2.contribution: 提出概率自回归运动模型用于轨迹评分与修复。
2012.02337|v2.innovation: 通过学习自然轨迹分布实现轨迹似然评分和遮挡期轨迹修复。
2012.02337|v2.result: 在MOT16/17/20上大多数标准指标超越当时最优方法。

2105.11595|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中运动建模对跟踪能力影响不明确的问题，本文提出基于区域的孪生多目标跟踪网络SiamMOT。该网络包含运动模型，用于估计实例在相邻帧间的位移以关联检测实例，并提供隐式与显式两种运动建模变体进行对比。相比已有工作，系统验证了运动建模对MOT的重要性。在MOT17、TAO-person和Caltech Roadside Pedestrians上大幅超越当时最优方法，并在HiEve数据集上超过ACM MM'20挑战赛冠军，单GPU上720P视频达17 FPS。
2105.11595|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates the impact of motion modeling on online multi-object tracking and proposes SiamMOT, a region-based Siamese MOT network with a motion model estimating instance movement between frames for association. It presents implicit and explicit motion modeling variants to study their effects. SiamMOT substantially outperforms state-of-the-art on MOT17, TAO-person, and Caltech Roadside Pedestrians, surpasses the ACM MM'20 HiEve Challenge winner, and runs at 17 FPS on 720P video with a single GPU.
2105.11595|v2.assessment: 系统研究运动建模并给出高效实用的MOT方案，工程与学术价值兼具。
2105.11595|v2.contribution: 提出SiamMOT孪生多目标跟踪网络并系统研究运动建模的影响。
2105.11595|v2.innovation: 提供隐式与显式两种运动建模变体，验证运动建模对MOT的关键作用。
2105.11595|v2.result: 在多个MOT数据集上大幅超越SOTA，HiEve上超过挑战赛冠军，720P达17 FPS。

2103.11681|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉目标跟踪中连续帧间丰富时序上下文被忽视的问题，本文提出通过Transformer架构桥接各视频帧并挖掘时序上下文。与NLP中经典用法不同，将编码器和解码器分离为两个并行分支并嵌入类孪生跟踪流程：编码器通过注意力特征增强提升目标模板质量，解码器将历史模板的跟踪线索传播到当前帧以辅助目标搜索。相比已有工作，该框架简洁且端到端训练，简单孪生匹配即可超越当时最优跟踪器，结合判别式跟踪流程后在多个基准上刷新SOTA记录。
2103.11681|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the overlooked temporal context across successive frames in visual object tracking by bridging frames via a transformer architecture. Unlike classic NLP usage, the encoder and decoder are separated into two parallel branches within Siamese-like tracking pipelines: the encoder reinforces target templates via attention, and the decoder propagates tracking cues from previous templates to the current frame. The neat end-to-end framework enables a simple Siamese matcher to outperform top trackers and sets new state-of-the-art records on prevalent benchmarks when combined with discriminative tracking.
2103.11681|v2.assessment: 将Transformer时序建模引入跟踪的早期代表性工作，设计简洁且效果显著。
2103.11681|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的时序上下文建模框架用于鲁棒视觉跟踪。
2103.11681|v2.innovation: 将Transformer编解码器分离为并行分支嵌入孪生跟踪流程，挖掘帧间时序上下文。
2103.11681|v2.result: 简单孪生匹配即超越当时最优跟踪器，多个基准刷新SOTA。

2104.00324|v2.summary_cn: 针对离线训练孪生跟踪器因固定首帧模板信息挖掘殆尽而难以应对目标外观变化的问题，现有模板更新机制依赖耗时数值优化和复杂手工策略，阻碍实时应用。本文提出基于时空记忆网络的免模板跟踪框架STMTrack，引入记忆机制存储目标历史信息以引导跟踪器关注当前帧最具信息量的区域，并利用记忆网络的像素级相似度计算生成更精确的目标边界框。相比已有工作，无需模板更新即可适应外观变化。在OTB等大规模挑战性基准上优于众多竞争跟踪器。
2104.00324|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adaptability of offline-trained Siamese trackers to target appearance changes due to fixed first-frame templates, while existing template-update mechanisms rely on time-consuming optimization and hand-crafted strategies. It proposes STMTrack, a template-free tracking framework built on a space-time memory network that stores historical target information to guide focus on informative regions and uses pixel-level similarity for accurate bounding boxes. Without template updating, it outperforms many competitive trackers on challenging large-scale benchmarks such as OTB.
2104.00324|v2.assessment: 时空记忆网络实现免模板跟踪，兼顾精度与实时性，思路实用。
2104.00324|v2.contribution: 提出基于时空记忆网络的免模板视觉跟踪框架STMTrack。
2104.00324|v2.innovation: 利用记忆机制存储历史目标信息并做像素级相似度计算，无需模板更新。
2104.00324|v2.result: 在OTB等大规模基准上优于众多竞争跟踪器。

TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_cn: 该论文针对多人物关节式3D姿态跟踪问题，提出TesseTrack端到端可学习方法。方法将人体姿态跟踪建模为时空图上的可学习问题，联合优化检测、姿态估计与身份关联。相比传统分阶段流水线方法，TesseTrack实现了端到端训练，减少了误差累积。在多个多人姿态跟踪基准上取得了优于分阶段方法的跟踪精度。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.summary_en: This paper addresses multi-person articulated 3D pose tracking by proposing TesseTrack, an end-to-end learnable approach. It formulates pose tracking as a spatio-temporal graph learning problem, jointly optimizing detection, pose estimation, and identity association. Compared to traditional staged pipelines, TesseTrack reduces error accumulation and achieves improved tracking accuracy on multiple benchmarks.
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.assessment: 该工作将端到端学习引入多人3D姿态跟踪，思路清晰，但与应用领域（自动驾驶感知）的直接关联有限。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.contribution: 提出端到端可学习的多人关节式3D姿态跟踪框架TesseTrack。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.innovation: 将姿态跟踪建模为时空图上的联合优化问题，避免分阶段流水线的误差累积。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P.result: 在多人姿态跟踪基准上取得优于分阶段方法的跟踪精度。
TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-P._arxiv_id: TesseTrack: End-to-End Learnable Multi-Person Articulated 3D Pose Tracking.

CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云中刚性和关节式物体的类别级姿态跟踪问题，提出CAPTRA方法。方法利用类别级先验知识，通过点云配准和姿态优化实现连续帧间的物体姿态跟踪。相比实例级方法，CAPTRA无需针对特定实例训练，具有更好的泛化能力。在类别级姿态跟踪基准上取得了较好的跟踪精度。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level pose tracking for rigid and articulated objects from point clouds, proposing CAPTRA. The method leverages category-level priors and performs point cloud registration and pose optimization for continuous frame tracking. Compared to instance-level methods, CAPTRA generalizes better without instance-specific training and achieves competitive tracking accuracy on category-level benchmarks.
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.assessment: 该工作关注类别级姿态跟踪，对机器人操作有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联度一般。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.contribution: 提出类别级刚性和关节式物体点云姿态跟踪方法CAPTRA。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.innovation: 利用类别级先验实现无需实例特定训练的连续姿态跟踪。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for.result: 在类别级姿态跟踪基准上取得较好的跟踪精度。
CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for._arxiv_id: CAPTRA: CAtegory-level Pose Tracking for Rigid and Articulated Objects from Point Clouds.

Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_cn: 该论文针对点云单目标跟踪问题，提出Box-Aware特征增强方法。方法利用3D边界框先验信息增强目标特征表示，通过框内和框外特征的分层聚合提升跟踪鲁棒性。相比仅依赖点云特征的方法，该方法显式建模了目标的空间范围。在KITTI等点云跟踪基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪性能。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.summary_en: This paper addresses single object tracking on point clouds by proposing a box-aware feature enhancement method. It leverages 3D bounding box priors to enhance target feature representation through hierarchical aggregation of intra-box and extra-box features. Compared to methods relying solely on point cloud features, it explicitly models the spatial extent of targets and achieves competitive tracking performance on KITTI and other benchmarks.
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.assessment: 该工作将边界框先验引入点云单目标跟踪，对自动驾驶中的目标跟踪有参考价值。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.contribution: 提出基于边界框感知特征增强的点云单目标跟踪方法。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.innovation: 利用3D边界框先验分层聚合框内和框外特征以增强目标表示。
Box-Aware Feature Enhancement for Single.result: 在KITTI等点云跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。

Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪标注成本高的问题，提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法。方法通过构造同一视频的不同输入视图，利用跨视图预测一致性作为自监督信号训练跟踪模型。相比依赖大量人工标注的监督方法，该方法显著降低了标注需求。在MOT基准上取得了接近监督方法的跟踪性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high annotation cost of multi-object tracking by proposing a self-supervised approach based on cross-input consistency. It constructs different input views of the same video and uses cross-view prediction consistency as a self-supervised signal to train the tracking model. Compared to supervised methods requiring extensive manual annotations, it significantly reduces annotation needs and achieves tracking performance close to supervised methods on MOT benchmarks.
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.assessment: 该工作将自监督学习引入多目标跟踪，思路新颖，对降低自动驾驶感知标注成本有启发意义。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.contribution: 提出基于跨输入一致性的自监督多目标跟踪方法。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.innovation: 利用同一视频不同输入视图间的预测一致性作为自监督训练信号。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi.result: 在MOT基准上取得接近监督方法的跟踪性能。
Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking wi._arxiv_id: Self-Supervised Multi-Object Tracking with Cross-input Consistency.

Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_cn: 现有3D跟踪研究多集中于LiDAR点云，缺乏RGBD视频下的通用3D跟踪基准与方法。本文构建了首个面向RGBD视频的通用3D跟踪基准，涵盖多种场景与目标类别，并提出一个基于RGBD融合的基线方法。相比已有仅针对点云或单模态的跟踪工作，该基准统一了评估协议并揭示了RGBD模态互补性对3D跟踪的价值。基线方法在构建的基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度，为后续RGBD 3D跟踪研究提供了参考。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.summary_en: Existing 3D tracking research predominantly focuses on LiDAR point clouds, lacking a generic benchmark and baseline for RGBD videos. This paper constructs the first benchmark for generic 3D tracking in RGBD videos, covering diverse scenes and object categories, and proposes an RGBD-fusion baseline. Compared with prior point-cloud-only or single-modality tracking works, it unifies evaluation protocols and reveals the complementarity of RGBD modalities. The baseline achieves competitive tracking accuracy, providing a reference for future RGBD 3D tracking research.
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.assessment: 该工作填补了RGBD视频3D跟踪基准的空白，对多模态感知与跟踪研究者有参考价值，但方法创新性有限。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.contribution: 构建了首个RGBD视频通用3D跟踪基准并提出基线方法。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.innovation: 将3D跟踪从纯点云扩展到RGBD视频并统一评估协议。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide.result: 基线在自建基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪精度。
Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Vide._arxiv_id: Towards Generic 3D Tracking in RGBD Videos: Benchmark and Baseline.

2110.06864|v2.summary_cn: 多数MOT方法仅关联高分检测框，导致遮挡目标丢失和轨迹碎片化。本文提出ByteTrack，通过关联几乎所有检测框（包括低分框），利用低分框与轨迹的相似度恢复真实目标并过滤背景。该方法可即插即用地应用于9种SOTA跟踪器，IDF1一致提升1-10个点。在MOT17测试集上首次达到80.3 MOTA、77.3 IDF1和63.1 HOTA，单V100 GPU上30 FPS，并在MOT20、HiEve、BDD100K上取得SOTA。
2110.06864|v2.summary_en: Most MOT methods associate only high-score detection boxes, causing missed occluded objects and fragmented trajectories. This paper proposes ByteTrack, which associates almost every detection box, using low-score boxes' similarity with tracklets to recover true objects and filter background. It consistently improves IDF1 by 1-10 points across 9 state-of-the-art trackers. ByteTrack achieves 80.3 MOTA, 77.3 IDF1, and 63.1 HOTA on MOT17 test at 30 FPS on a single V100 GPU, and state-of-the-art on MOT20, HiEve, and BDD100K.
2110.06864|v2.assessment: ByteTrack以极简设计取得显著且通用的提升，是MOT领域的里程碑工作，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪极具参考价值。
2110.06864|v2.contribution: 提出关联几乎所有检测框的通用MOT关联方法ByteTrack。
2110.06864|v2.innovation: 利用低分检测框与轨迹相似度恢复遮挡目标并过滤背景。
2110.06864|v2.result: MOT17上达80.3 MOTA/77.3 IDF1/63.1 HOTA，30 FPS，多基准SOTA。

CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_cn: 点云3D跟踪中模板与搜索区域的外观变化大，现有方法难以学习鲁棒的跨帧匹配。本文提出CMT（Context-Matching-Guided Transformer），利用上下文匹配引导的Transformer建模模板与搜索区域间的关联。相比已有Siamese或相关滤波方法，CMT通过上下文匹配增强了对形状变化和背景干扰的鲁棒性。在KITTI等3D跟踪基准上取得了有竞争力的跟踪精度，验证了上下文匹配引导的有效性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.summary_en: In point-cloud 3D tracking, large appearance variation between template and search area makes robust cross-frame matching difficult. This paper proposes CMT (Context-Matching-Guided Transformer) to model template-search association via context-matching guidance. Compared with existing Siamese or correlation-filter methods, CMT enhances robustness to shape variation and background clutter. It achieves competitive tracking accuracy on KITTI and other 3D tracking benchmarks, validating the effectiveness of context-matching guidance.
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.assessment: CMT将上下文匹配与Transformer结合用于点云3D跟踪，思路合理，但需更多实验验证其泛化性。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.contribution: 提出上下文匹配引导的Transformer用于点云3D跟踪。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.innovation: 利用上下文匹配引导Transformer建模模板与搜索区域关联。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer.result: 在KITTI等3D跟踪基准上取得有竞争力的精度。
CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer._arxiv_id: CMT: Context-Matching-Guided Transformer for 3D Tracking in Point Clouds.

2207.11995|v2.summary_cn: 基于Siamese网络的3D单目标跟踪将跟踪建模为模板与搜索区域的互相关学习，但两者外观差异大导致鲁棒性不足。本文提出3D Siamese Transformer网络，用自注意力编码点云形状上下文，用交叉注意力上采样判别性点特征，并设计迭代式由粗到细的相关网络进行跨特征增强。相比已有Siamese方法，该方法通过Transformer显式建模非局部形状信息与鲁棒互相关。在KITTI等基准上取得了优于已有方法的跟踪精度。
2207.11995|v2.summary_en: Siamese-based 3D single object tracking formulates tracking as cross-correlation learning between template and search area, but large appearance variation limits robustness. This paper proposes a 3D Siamese Transformer network that uses self-attention to encode shape context and cross-attention to upsample discriminative point features, with an iterative coarse-to-fine correlation network for cross-feature augmentation. Compared with existing Siamese methods, it explicitly models non-local shape information and robust cross-correlation via Transformer. It achieves superior tracking accuracy on KITTI and other benchmarks.
2207.11995|v2.assessment: 该工作将Transformer引入点云单目标跟踪，方法设计较完整，对3D跟踪研究者有参考意义。
2207.11995|v2.contribution: 提出用于点云单目标跟踪的3D Siamese Transformer网络。
2207.11995|v2.innovation: 结合自注意力形状编码与交叉注意力由粗到细互相关学习。
2207.11995|v2.result: 在KITTI等基准上取得优于已有方法的跟踪精度。

2208.01957|v2.summary_cn: 多数3D多目标跟踪方法依赖外观线索进行数据关联，本文探究仅用3D空间几何关系能达到何种程度。PolarMOT将3D检测编码为图节点，边采用局部极坐标编码空间与时间成对关系，使几何关系对全局变换和非完整约束运动具有不变性。图神经网络据此学习时空交互，将数据关联建模为边分类。在nuScenes上取得新SOTA，并在Boston、Singapore、Karlsruhe及KITTI上展现出优异的跨地点、跨数据集泛化能力。
2208.01957|v2.summary_en: Most 3D multi-object tracking methods rely on appearance cues for data association; this paper investigates how far purely geometric relations in 3D space can go. PolarMOT encodes 3D detections as graph nodes with localized polar coordinates on edges, making geometric relations invariant to global transformations and non-holonomic motion. A graph neural network learns spatio-temporal interactions and poses data association as edge classification. It sets a new state-of-the-art on nuScenes and generalizes remarkably well across locations (Boston, Singapore, Karlsruhe) and datasets (nuScenes, KITTI).
2208.01957|v2.assessment: PolarMOT证明纯几何关系在3D MOT中已足够强大且泛化性极佳，对自动驾驶跟踪研究有重要启发。
2208.01957|v2.contribution: 提出仅用几何关系的图神经网络3D多目标跟踪方法PolarMOT。
2208.01957|v2.innovation: 用局部极坐标编码图边实现变换不变的空间时间几何关系建模。
2208.01957|v2.result: nuScenes新SOTA，并在多地点多数据集上展现优异泛化。

2207.10031|v2.summary_cn: MOT序列缺乏描述其复杂度的综合指标，导致可解释性差、数据集难以比较、跟踪器评估沦为排行榜排名。本文提出MOTCOM复杂度指标，由遮挡、运动突变和视觉相似性三个子指标组合而成，灵感来自MOT核心难题。在MOT17、MOT20和MOTSynth上评估表明，MOTCOM比传统密度和轨迹数量指标更能刻画MOT序列复杂度。该指标有助于更细致地讨论跟踪器性能并推动针对子问题的研究。
2207.10031|v2.summary_en: There is no comprehensive metric for describing MOT sequence complexity, reducing explainability and comparison of datasets to leaderboard rankings. This paper proposes MOTCOM, a complexity metric combining three sub-metrics inspired by key MOT challenges: occlusion, erratic motion, and visual similarity. Evaluated on MOT17, MOT20, and MOTSynth, MOTCOM describes MOT sequence complexity far better than conventional density and number-of-tracks metrics. It enables nuanced discussion of tracker performance and encourages research on sub-problems.
2207.10031|v2.assessment: MOTCOM为MOT数据集与跟踪器评估提供了新的复杂度视角，对跟踪领域基准分析有辅助价值。
2207.10031|v2.contribution: 提出综合遮挡、运动突变与视觉相似性的MOT数据集复杂度指标MOTCOM。
2207.10031|v2.innovation: 将MOT核心难题量化为可组合的序列复杂度子指标。
2207.10031|v2.result: 在MOT17/MOT20/MOTSynth上优于传统密度与轨迹数量指标。

2208.03727|v2.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中相邻帧对象的一对一分配通常依赖Re-ID特征距离阈值来剔除不可能匹配对，但不同视频的特征距离分布差异显著，不存在通用最优阈值。本文提出实时计算每对对象的边际概率（marginal probability），将其作为归一化距离，比原始特征距离更稳定，从而可用单一阈值处理所有视频。该方法通用，可集成到现有跟踪器中，在IDF1指标上约提升1个点，在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的结果，且概率更具可解释性，便于后续后处理。
2208.03727|v2.summary_en: Multi-object tracking requires one-to-one assignment between objects in adjacent frames, typically addressed by discarding impossible pairs via a feature distance threshold followed by Hungarian matching. However, the distribution of Re-ID feature distances varies across videos, so no single optimal threshold exists. This paper proposes an efficient method to compute a marginal probability for each object pair in real time, which serves as a normalized and more stable distance measure, enabling a single threshold for all videos. The approach is general, improves existing trackers by about one IDF1 point, achieves competitive results on MOT17 and MOT20, and provides more interpretable probabilities for post-processing.
2208.03727|v2.assessment: 该工作揭示了多目标跟踪中阈值选择的根本问题，提出的边际概率方法通用且实用，能即插即用地提升现有跟踪器性能，对MOT领域有实际价值。
2208.03727|v2.contribution: 提出基于边际概率的归一化距离度量，解决了Re-ID特征距离分布不一致导致的阈值选择难题。
2208.03727|v2.innovation: 将边际概率引入多目标跟踪的数据关联，实现单一阈值跨视频通用，并提升可解释性。
2208.03727|v2.result: 在现有跟踪器上IDF1约提升1个点，在MOT17和MOT20上取得有竞争力的结果。

2207.09603|v2.summary_cn: Transformer跟踪器中的注意力机制独立计算相关性，容易产生噪声和模糊的注意力权重，限制性能提升。本文提出注意力中的注意力（AiA）模块，通过在所有相关向量间寻求共识来增强正确关联并抑制错误关联，可同时应用于自注意力和交叉注意力块。基于此构建了简洁的Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack，引入高效特征重用和目标-背景嵌入以充分利用时序参考。在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA，且保持实时速度。
2207.09603|v2.summary_en: Transformer trackers rely on attention mechanisms, but independent correlation computation can yield noisy and ambiguous attention weights, hindering performance. This paper proposes an attention in attention (AiA) module that enhances appropriate correlations and suppresses erroneous ones by seeking consensus among all correlation vectors, applicable to both self- and cross-attention blocks. Built upon this, AiATrack introduces efficient feature reuse and target-background embeddings to exploit temporal references. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on six tracking benchmarks while running in real time.
2207.09603|v2.assessment: 该工作针对Transformer跟踪器中注意力权重的噪声问题提出了有效的改进模块，并在多个基准上验证了其通用性和实时性，对视觉跟踪领域有较高参考价值。
2207.09603|v2.contribution: 提出AiA模块增强注意力一致性，并构建了高效的Transformer跟踪框架AiATrack。
2207.09603|v2.innovation: 通过共识机制优化注意力权重，结合特征重用和目标-背景嵌入提升跟踪性能。
2207.09603|v2.result: 在六个跟踪基准上达到SOTA，同时保持实时运行速度。

2207.13784|v2.summary_cn: 混合现实头显通常仅跟踪头部和手部姿态，导致虚拟化身只有上半身，现有全身姿态估计方法需要额外传感器，增加了设置复杂度。本文提出AvatarPoser，首个仅利用头部和手部运动输入预测世界坐标系下全身姿态的学习方法。方法基于Transformer编码器提取深层特征，将全局运动与局部关节朝向解耦以引导姿态估计，并通过逆运动学优化细化手臂关节位置。实验表明能获得类似动作捕捉的准确全身运动。
2207.13784|v2.summary_en: Mixed reality headsets typically track only head and hand poses, limiting avatars to upper bodies, while prior full-body estimation methods require additional sensors. This paper presents AvatarPoser, the first learning-based method that predicts full-body poses in world coordinates using only head and hand motion input. It builds on a Transformer encoder to extract deep features, decouples global motion from local joint orientations, and refines arm joint positions via inverse kinematics optimization. Experiments show accurate full-body motions resembling motion capture animations.
2207.13784|v2.assessment: 该工作解决了混合现实中仅凭稀疏输入估计全身姿态的难题，方法设计合理，但应用场景偏向VR/AR，与自动驾驶感知领域相关性较低。
2207.13784|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅用头部和手部运动输入预测全身姿态的学习方法AvatarPoser。
2207.13784|v2.innovation: 利用Transformer解耦全局与局部运动，并结合逆运动学优化细化手臂姿态。
2207.13784|v2.result: 能够从稀疏输入生成准确的全身运动，效果接近动作捕捉动画。

2208.05810|v2.summary_cn: 视觉跟踪本质上是序列级任务，但现有学习方法大多采用帧级训练，导致训练与测试在数据分布和任务目标上不一致。本文引入基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，讨论了序列级的数据采样、学习目标和数据增强设计如何提升跟踪算法的准确性和鲁棒性。在LaSOT、TrackingNet和GOT-10k等标准基准上，四种代表性跟踪模型（SiamRPN++、SiamAttn、TransT、TrDiMP）在不修改架构的情况下通过所提训练方法均获得一致提升。
2208.05810|v2.summary_en: Visual tracking is inherently a sequence-level task, yet recent learning-based approaches largely rely on frame-level training, causing inconsistency between training and testing in data distribution and objectives. This work introduces a sequence-level training strategy based on reinforcement learning, discussing how sequence-level design of data sampling, learning objectives, and data augmentation improves tracking accuracy and robustness. Experiments on LaSOT, TrackingNet, and GOT-10k show that four representative trackers (SiamRPN++, SiamAttn, TransT, TrDiMP) consistently improve without architecture modifications.
2208.05810|v2.assessment: 该工作从训练范式角度切入，提出了通用的序列级训练策略，能即插即用地提升多种跟踪模型，对跟踪领域有重要启发意义。
2208.05810|v2.contribution: 提出基于强化学习的序列级训练策略，解决帧级训练与序列级任务不匹配的问题。
2208.05810|v2.innovation: 将序列级设计引入数据采样、学习目标和数据增强，无需修改架构即可提升多种跟踪器。
2208.05810|v2.result: 在LaSOT、TrackingNet、GOT-10k上，四种代表性跟踪模型均获得一致性能提升。

2203.11191|v2.summary_cn: 视觉跟踪中目标通常由边界框定义，但物体形状复杂且不与图像轴对齐时，边界框包含大量背景像素，无法准确描述目标。本文提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，内部使用分割掩码而非边界框，从而学习更好区分目标与背景的表示。为增强鲁棒性，引入独立的实例定位组件来条件化分割解码器。从分割掩码推断边界框，在LaSOT上取得69.7%的AUC成功率，达到新SOTA。
2203.11191|v2.summary_en: In visual tracking, targets are typically defined by bounding boxes, which poorly describe complex, non-axis-aligned objects and include much background. This paper proposes a segmentation-centric tracking pipeline that internally works with segmentation masks instead of boxes, enabling a target representation that better distinguishes foreground from background. A separate instance localization component conditions the segmentation decoder for robustness. Inferring bounding boxes from masks, the tracker achieves a new state of the art on LaSOT with a success AUC of 69.7%.
2203.11191|v2.assessment: 该工作将分割引入跟踪流程，解决了边界框表示的局限性，在LaSOT上取得显著提升，对跟踪领域有较高参考价值。
2203.11191|v2.contribution: 提出以分割为中心的跟踪流程，用分割掩码替代边界框进行目标表示和定位。
2203.11191|v2.innovation: 引入独立实例定位组件条件化分割解码器，提升复杂场景下的跟踪鲁棒性。
2203.11191|v2.result: 在LaSOT上取得69.7%的AUC成功率，达到新SOTA。

2204.12489|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对立体声音频中双耳时间差（ITD）估计问题，即通过两路麦克风信号的对应关系推断声源方向。作者借鉴视觉跟踪中的对比随机游走（contrastive random walk）方法，提出自监督学习框架，从无标注立体声中学习循环一致的表示，并进一步提出多模态对比学习模型，利用人脸视觉表示引导多说话人混合场景下特定人物的时延估计。相比监督方法，该方法在野外互联网录音上达到相当性能，且无需人工标注。实验表明自监督模型在真实录音上与监督基线持平，多模态模型能有效完成视觉引导的声源定位任务。
2204.12489|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses interaural time delay (ITD) estimation for sound localization by finding correspondences between stereo microphone signals. It adapts the contrastive random walk from visual tracking to learn cycle-consistent representations from unlabeled stereo audio, and proposes a multimodal contrastive model for visually-guided localization of a target speaker using face representations. The self-supervised model performs on par with supervised methods on in-the-wild internet recordings, and the multimodal model successfully estimates time delays for a specific person in multi-speaker mixtures.
2204.12489|v2.assessment: 该工作将视觉自监督跟踪技术迁移到音频领域，思路新颖，但主题与自动驾驶视觉感知（目标检测、BEV、3D检测等）几乎无关，仅对多模态自监督学习有间接参考价值。
2204.12489|v2.contribution: 提出基于对比随机游走的自监督立体声时延估计方法，并扩展为视觉引导的多说话人定位模型。
2204.12489|v2.innovation: 将视觉跟踪中的循环一致对比学习引入音频对应学习，并实现跨模态（人脸-声音）的时延估计。
2204.12489|v2.result: 自监督模型在野外录音上达到与监督方法相当的性能，多模态模型能准确估计混合语音中特定人物的时延。

CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_cn: 针对3D点云单目标跟踪中现有方法仅依赖目标自身特征、忽略场景上下文导致在稀疏点云和相似干扰物下易漂移的问题，本文提出CXTrack。方法上引入上下文信息：通过局部上下文聚合模块融合目标邻域点特征，并设计全局上下文建模以区分相似物体，同时结合运动线索进行时序关联。相比此前仅用目标模板匹配的3D跟踪器，CXTrack在KITTI和nuScenes跟踪基准上显著提升了成功率与精度，尤其在遮挡和稀疏场景下鲁棒性更强。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.summary_en: This paper addresses 3D point cloud tracking where existing methods rely solely on target-specific features and ignore scene context, causing drift under sparse points and similar distractors. CXTrack introduces contextual information via local context aggregation and global context modeling to discriminate similar objects, combined with motion cues for temporal association. It outperforms prior target-only 3D trackers on KITTI and nuScenes tracking benchmarks, achieving notable gains in success and precision, especially under occlusion and sparsity.
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.assessment: 将2D跟踪中的上下文建模思想系统迁移到3D点云跟踪，思路清晰且实验扎实，对点云跟踪方向有参考价值。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.contribution: 提出融合局部与全局上下文的3D点云跟踪框架CXTrack。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.innovation: 在3D点云跟踪中显式引入场景上下文以区分相似干扰物。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes跟踪基准上成功率和精度均优于现有方法。
CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracki._arxiv_id: CXTrack: Improving 3D Point Cloud Tracking with Contextual Information.

2302.03802|v2.summary_cn: 针对多相机3D多目标跟踪中长期遮挡导致目标丢失和ID切换频繁的问题，本文提出端到端框架PF-Track。方法基于tracking-by-attention，用object query在时间上一致地表示目标，并设计Past Reasoning模块通过交叉注意力融合历史帧和其他目标的query来精炼轨迹，Future Reasoning模块预测未来轨迹以在遮挡时维持目标位置并支持重关联。在nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches相比此前方法减少90%，达到数量级的改善。
2302.03802|v2.summary_en: This work tackles long-term occlusion in multi-camera 3D multi-object tracking, which causes track loss and frequent ID switches. PF-Track is an end-to-end framework built on tracking-by-attention with object queries, featuring a Past Reasoning module that cross-attends to previous-frame and other-object queries to refine tracks, and a Future Reasoning module that predicts trajectories to maintain object positions and enable re-association under occlusion. On nuScenes it improves AMOTA by a large margin and reduces ID-Switches by 90% versus prior methods.
2302.03802|v2.assessment: 同时建模过去与未来推理的多相机3D MOT工作，ID切换降低一个数量级，是该方向的重要进展。
2302.03802|v2.contribution: 提出融合过去与未来推理的端到端多相机3D多目标跟踪框架PF-Track。
2302.03802|v2.innovation: 用Future Reasoning预测轨迹以在长期遮挡下维持目标并重关联。
2302.03802|v2.result: nuScenes上AMOTA大幅提升，ID-Switches较此前方法减少90%。

MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_cn: 针对MOTR等端到端多目标跟踪方法因缺乏目标检测先验、query语义弱导致检测性能不足的问题，本文提出MOTRv2。方法将预训练目标检测器（如YOLOX）的检测query注入MOTR的track query机制，用检测结果引导跟踪query的初始化与更新，从而在保持端到端关联的同时获得强检测能力。在DanceTrack和MOT17等基准上取得当时最优的HOTA/MOTA，且无需额外关联后处理，验证了检测先验对端到端跟踪的关键作用。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.summary_en: This paper addresses the weak detection capability of end-to-end MOT methods like MOTR, caused by the lack of object detection priors and semantically weak queries. MOTRv2 bootstraps MOTR with a pretrained object detector (e.g., YOLOX) by injecting detection queries to guide track query initialization and updates, retaining end-to-end association while gaining strong detection. It achieves state-of-the-art HOTA/MOTA on DanceTrack and MOT17 without extra association post-processing, demonstrating the importance of detection priors for end-to-end tracking.
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.assessment: 以简洁有效的检测先验注入方式显著提升端到端跟踪性能，工程价值与影响力兼备。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.contribution: 提出用预训练检测器引导端到端多目标跟踪的MOTRv2框架。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O.innovation: 将检测query注入track query机制以弥补端到端跟踪的检测短板。
MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-O._arxiv_id: MOTRv2: Bootstrapping End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Pretrained Object Detectors.

Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_cn: 针对SORT类方法在遮挡和低帧率下因卡尔曼滤波噪声累积和状态估计误差导致跟踪失败的问题，本文提出OC-SORT。方法引入以观测为中心的在线平滑（OCM）和观测中心动量（OCM/OCR）来修正卡尔曼滤波的噪声方向，并设计观测中心的恢复策略在目标重新出现时进行重关联。在MOT17、MOT20和DanceTrack上，OC-SORT在保持SORT简洁高效的同时显著降低ID切换并提升HOTA/AssA，尤其在非线性运动场景下优势明显。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.summary_en: This paper revisits SORT-style tracking, where Kalman filter noise accumulation and state estimation errors under occlusion and low frame rates cause failures. OC-SORT introduces observation-centric online smoothing and momentum to correct the noise direction of the Kalman filter, plus an observation-centric recovery strategy for re-association when objects reappear. On MOT17, MOT20, and DanceTrack it substantially reduces ID switches and improves HOTA/AssA while retaining SORT's simplicity and efficiency, especially under non-linear motion.
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.assessment: 对经典SORT的深刻反思与轻量改进，方法简单却效果显著，是跟踪领域高引用工作。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.contribution: 提出以观测为中心的OC-SORT，修正卡尔曼滤波在遮挡下的噪声累积。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR.innovation: 用观测中心动量和在线平滑替代纯预测驱动的状态估计。
Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SOR._arxiv_id: Observation-Centric SORT: Rethinking SORT for Robust Multi-Object Tracking.

MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中目标被遮挡或发生非线性运动时运动预测不准导致关联失败的问题，本文提出MotionTrack。方法设计交互式运动模块学习短时运动以增强相邻帧间的特征交互，并构建细化模块捕捉长时运动以在遮挡后恢复目标轨迹，二者结合提升关联鲁棒性。在MOT17和MOT20上，MotionTrack在HOTA、MOTA和IDF1等指标上优于多数现有方法，尤其在遮挡频繁场景下ID切换明显减少。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.summary_en: This paper targets MOT failures caused by inaccurate motion prediction under occlusion and non-linear motion. MotionTrack learns short-term motion via an interactive motion module that enhances inter-frame feature interaction, and captures long-term motion with a refinement module to recover tracks after occlusion. On MOT17 and MOT20 it outperforms most existing methods in HOTA, MOTA, and IDF1, with notably fewer ID switches in occlusion-heavy scenes.
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.assessment: 短时与长时运动建模的结合合理，实验较充分，对遮挡场景跟踪有实用价值。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.contribution: 提出联合短时与长时运动学习的多目标跟踪框架MotionTrack。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.innovation: 用交互式短时运动模块与长时运动细化模块协同提升关联鲁棒性。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term.result: 在MOT17/MOT20上HOTA、MOTA、IDF1优于多数现有方法。
MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term._arxiv_id: MotionTrack: Learning Robust Short-Term and Long-Term Motions for Multi-Object Tracking.

Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_cn: 针对在线多目标跟踪中外观特征粒度不足、难以区分相似目标导致关联错误的问题，本文提出细粒度表示方法。方法通过多分支网络提取多样化的细粒度特征（如局部区域、不同尺度），并设计特征融合与选择机制以增强目标判别力，同时保持在线跟踪效率。在MOT16/MOT17等基准上，该方法在MOTA和IDF1上取得有竞争力的结果，ID切换减少，验证了细粒度表示对在线跟踪关联的有效性。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient appearance granularity in online MOT, which hampers discrimination of similar objects and causes association errors. It proposes diverse fine-grained representations extracted by a multi-branch network (local regions, multiple scales) with a feature fusion and selection mechanism to boost discriminability while maintaining online efficiency. On MOT16/MOT17 it achieves competitive MOTA and IDF1 with fewer ID switches, validating fine-grained representations for online association.
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.assessment: 从特征表示粒度切入解决在线跟踪关联问题，思路直观，实验有竞争力但创新幅度中等。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.contribution: 提出面向在线多目标跟踪的多样化细粒度特征表示方法。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.innovation: 用多分支细粒度特征融合与选择增强相似目标的判别力。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr.result: 在MOT16/MOT17上MOTA和IDF1具竞争力且ID切换减少。
Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tr._arxiv_id: Focus On Details: Online Multi-Object Tracking with Diverse Fine-Grained Representation.

Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中仅依赖视觉外观、缺乏语言指令引导的问题，提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking（RMOT）新任务，即根据自然语言描述跟踪特定目标。作者构建了Refer-KITTI数据集，包含视频序列及对应的指代性语言标注，并提出了一个基于Transformer的基线方法。相比传统MOT仅跟踪所有目标，该方法能根据语言查询选择性跟踪，在Refer-KITTI上取得了有竞争力的性能，为语言引导的跟踪研究提供了基准。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces Referring Multi-Object Tracking (RMOT), a new task that tracks targets specified by natural language descriptions rather than tracking all objects. The authors construct the Refer-KITTI dataset with language annotations and propose a Transformer-based baseline. The method achieves competitive performance on Refer-KITTI, establishing a benchmark for language-guided tracking.
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该工作开辟了语言引导多目标跟踪的新方向，数据集和基线方法为后续研究提供了重要基础，值得关注。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了Referring Multi-Object Tracking新任务并构建了Refer-KITTI数据集及基线方法。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.innovation: 将自然语言指代引入多目标跟踪，实现基于语言描述的选择性目标跟踪。
Referring Multi-Object Tracking.|v2.result: 在Refer-KITTI数据集上取得了有竞争力的跟踪性能，为后续研究提供了基准。

UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_cn: 该论文针对多目标跟踪中身份特征利用不充分、检测与重识别任务耦合导致性能受限的问题，提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM。该方法通过身份感知特征增强模块，将身份信息融入检测和关联过程，实现检测与重识别的联合优化。相比分离式跟踪范式，UTM在多个MOT基准上取得了更优的跟踪精度和身份保持能力，验证了统一建模的有效性。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.summary_en: This paper proposes UTM, a unified multiple object tracking model that enhances identity-aware features to jointly optimize detection and re-identification. By integrating identity information into both detection and association, UTM improves tracking accuracy and identity preservation. Experiments on multiple MOT benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the unified paradigm.
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.assessment: 该工作通过统一建模和身份感知特征增强提升了MOT性能，思路清晰，实验充分，对跟踪领域有参考价值。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.contribution: 提出了统一的多目标跟踪模型UTM，通过身份感知特征增强实现检测与重识别的联合优化。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.innovation: 将身份信息深度融合到检测和关联过程中，实现端到端的统一多目标跟踪。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking.result: 在多个MOT基准上取得了优于分离式方法的跟踪精度和身份保持性能。
UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking._arxiv_id: UTM: A Unified Multiple Object Tracking Model with Identity-Aware Feature Enhancement.

3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_cn: 该论文针对自由移动鸟类2D-3D无标记跟踪中标注困难的问题，提出了3D-POP自动化标注方法。该方法利用基于标记的运动捕捉数据自动生成无标记跟踪的标注，从而免去人工标注成本。相比传统手动标注，3D-POP大幅提升了标注效率，并支持大规模鸟类行为分析，为生物行为研究提供了高效工具。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.summary_en: This paper presents 3D-POP, an automated annotation approach for markerless 2D-3D tracking of freely moving birds using marker-based motion capture data. The method eliminates manual annotation by leveraging motion capture to generate ground truth. It enables efficient large-scale behavioral analysis, providing a valuable tool for biological research.
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.assessment: 该工作将运动捕捉与无标记跟踪结合，解决了生物行为分析中的标注瓶颈，虽与自动驾驶领域相关度较低，但方法有借鉴意义。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.contribution: 提出了利用标记运动捕捉数据自动生成无标记2D-3D跟踪标注的3D-POP方法。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.innovation: 将基于标记的运动捕捉数据用于自动化标注无标记跟踪任务，大幅降低标注成本。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac.result: 实现了高效的自动化标注，支持大规模自由移动鸟类的2D-3D跟踪。
3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approac._arxiv_id: 3D-POP - An Automated Annotation Approach to Facilitate Markerless 2D-3D Tracking of Freely Moving Birds with Marker-Based Motion Capture.

Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对视觉跟踪中传统判别式方法依赖手工设计或固定模板、难以适应目标外观变化的问题，提出了自回归视觉跟踪方法。该方法将跟踪建模为自回归序列生成过程，利用历史帧信息逐步预测目标状态，从而更好地捕捉时序依赖。相比现有跟踪器，自回归框架在多个基准上取得了更优的跟踪精度和鲁棒性，为跟踪任务提供了新的建模范式。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Autoregressive Visual Tracking, which models tracking as an autoregressive sequence generation process to better capture temporal dependencies. By leveraging historical frames to progressively predict target states, the method improves tracking accuracy and robustness. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate superior performance over existing trackers.
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.assessment: 该工作将自回归建模引入视觉跟踪，思路新颖，为跟踪任务提供了新的视角，值得关注。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.contribution: 提出了自回归视觉跟踪框架，将跟踪建模为序列生成过程。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.innovation: 利用自回归机制逐步预测目标状态，有效捕捉时序依赖。
Autoregressive Visual Tracking.|v2.result: 在多个跟踪基准上取得了优于现有方法的精度和鲁棒性。

2303.13913|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对类别级衣物姿态跟踪任务，提出了完整的解决方案。作者构建了VR-Garment记录系统和VR-Folding大规模数据集，并提出了端到端在线跟踪框架GarmentTracking，能够从点云序列中预测衣物在规范空间和任务空间中的完整姿态。实验表明，GarmentTracking在衣物大形变情况下仍能保持良好性能，在速度和精度上均优于基线方法。
2303.13913|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses category-level garment pose tracking by presenting a complete solution: a VR-based recording system, a large-scale dataset VR-Folding, and an end-to-end online tracking framework GarmentTracking. The method predicts complete garment pose in both canonical and task spaces from point cloud sequences. Experiments show it outperforms the baseline in speed and accuracy even under large non-rigid deformation.
2303.13913|v2.assessment: 该工作为衣物姿态跟踪提供了完整的数据集和框架，虽与自动驾驶领域相关度较低，但在非刚体跟踪方面有参考价值。
2303.13913|v2.contribution: 提出了完整的类别级衣物姿态跟踪方案，包括VR记录系统、大规模数据集和端到端跟踪框架。
2303.13913|v2.innovation: 结合VR数据采集与点云序列在线跟踪，实现大形变下的衣物姿态估计。
2303.13913|v2.result: 在速度和精度上均优于基线方法，即使衣物发生大形变也能保持良好性能。

2303.05071|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D单目标跟踪中因遮挡和目标尺寸差异导致的外观变化问题，提出了MBPTrack方法。该方法采用记忆网络利用历史帧信息，并基于首帧提供的框先验以由粗到细的方式定位目标：首先通过Hough投票预测目标中心，再自适应采样参考点覆盖不同尺寸目标，最后聚合点特征进行精确定位。在KITTI、nuScenes和Waymo Open Dataset上取得了最先进的性能。
2303.05071|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes MBPTrack for 3D single object tracking, addressing appearance variations caused by occlusion and size differences. It employs a memory network to leverage past frames and uses box priors from the first frame in a coarse-to-fine scheme: Hough voting predicts the target center, then reference points are adaptively sampled to cover targets of different sizes for precise localization. MBPTrack achieves state-of-the-art performance on KITTI, nuScenes, and Waymo Open Dataset.
2303.05071|v2.assessment: 该工作通过记忆机制和框先验有效解决了3D跟踪中的遮挡和尺寸变化问题，在多个大规模数据集上达到SOTA，对自动驾驶感知有重要价值。
2303.05071|v2.contribution: 提出了结合记忆网络和框先验的MBPTrack方法，用于3D单目标跟踪。

2309.14491|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中闭集3D感知模型无法处理部署后出现的新类别物体的问题，本文提出一种多模态自动标注流水线，无需3D人工标注即可生成开放集类别的amodal 3D边界框和轨迹。该方法利用点云序列中的运动线索与免费获取的2D图像-文本对，识别并跟踪所有交通参与者，并通过视觉-语言知识蒸馏输出开放词汇语义标签。相比此前只能提供限于运动物体的类别无关自动标注的工作，本方法以无监督方式同时处理静态和运动物体。在Waymo Open Dataset上，该方法在多项无监督3D感知任务上显著超越先前工作。
2309.14491|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inadequacy of closed-set 3D perception models for autonomous driving, where novel object categories may appear after deployment. It presents a multi-modal auto-labeling pipeline that generates amodal 3D bounding boxes and tracklets for open-set categories without 3D human labels, exploiting motion cues in point cloud sequences and freely available 2D image-text pairs, with vision-language knowledge distillation enabling open-vocabulary semantic labels. Unlike prior work limited to class-agnostic labels for moving objects, the method handles both static and moving objects in an unsupervised manner. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset show significant margins over prior work on various unsupervised 3D perception tasks.
2309.14491|v2.assessment: 该工作将2D视觉-语言蒸馏与点云运动线索结合，解决了开放集3D感知标注的关键瓶颈，对自动驾驶感知的开放世界泛化具有重要参考价值。
2309.14491|v2.contribution: 提出一种无需3D人工标注、可生成开放词汇amodal 3D框与轨迹的多模态自动标注流水线。
2309.14491|v2.innovation: 利用2D图像-文本对进行视觉-语言知识蒸馏，并结合点云运动线索实现静态与运动物体的无监督开放集3D感知。
2309.14491|v2.result: 在Waymo Open Dataset上多项无监督3D感知任务显著超越先前工作。

2308.06904|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有基于Transformer的视觉跟踪器速度慢、难以部署在算力受限设备上的问题，本文提出HiT，一族可在不同设备上高速运行且保持高性能的高效跟踪模型。其核心是Bridge Module，将深层特征的高层信息融入浅层大分辨率特征，为跟踪头生成更好的特征，并提出同时编码搜索区域与模板图像位置信息的双图像位置编码。HiT在Nvidia Jetson AGX边缘设备上达到61 FPS，在LaSOT基准上取得64.6% AUC，超越所有先前的轻量级跟踪器。
2308.06904|v2.summary_en: To address the low speed of Transformer-based visual trackers that limits deployment on computationally constrained devices, this paper proposes HiT, a family of efficient tracking models that run at high speed while retaining high performance. Its central component is the Bridge Module, which incorporates high-level information from deep features into shallow large-resolution features to produce better features for the tracking head, along with a dual-image position encoding that jointly encodes the positions of the search region and template. HiT runs at 61 FPS on the Nvidia Jetson AGX edge device and attains 64.6% AUC on LaSOT, surpassing all previous efficient trackers.
2308.06904|v2.assessment: 该工作聚焦轻量级层次化ViT在跟踪中的效率-性能权衡，边缘设备上的实时性与精度表现对实际部署有直接价值。
2308.06904|v2.contribution: 提出高效跟踪模型族HiT，通过Bridge Module与双图像位置编码在边缘设备上实现高速高精度跟踪。
2308.06904|v2.innovation: Bridge Module将深层高层信息注入浅层大分辨率特征，并设计同时编码搜索区域与模板位置的双图像位置编码。
2308.06904|v2.result: 在Jetson AGX上达61 FPS，LaSOT上64.6% AUC，超越所有先前高效跟踪器。

2309.00942|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中缺乏标签监督、且易受目标相互干扰与遮挡影响的问题，本文探索跨视频帧样本特征的潜在一致性，提出无监督对比相似性学习方法UCSL，包含自对比、交叉对比和歧义对比三个模块。自对比通过帧内直接与帧间间接对比最大化自相似性以获得判别性表示；交叉对比对齐跨帧与连续帧匹配结果，缓解遮挡带来的持续负面影响；歧义对比让歧义目标相互匹配，以隐式方式提升后续目标关联的确定性。在现有基准上，该方法仅借助有限的ReID头帮助即超越现有无监督方法，甚至比许多全监督方法精度更高。
2309.00942|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles unsupervised multiple object tracking, which suffers from the absence of labels and from mutual object interference and occlusion. It explores the latent consistency of sample features across video frames and proposes UCSL, an unsupervised contrastive similarity learning method with three contrast modules: self-contrast, cross-contrast, and ambiguity contrast. Self-contrast uses intra-frame direct and inter-frame indirect contrast to learn discriminative representations, cross-contrast aligns cross- and continuous-frame matching to mitigate occlusion effects, and ambiguity contrast matches ambiguous objects to implicitly increase association certainty. On existing benchmarks, UCSL outperforms existing unsupervised methods with only limited ReID head help and even exceeds many fully supervised methods in accuracy.
2309.00942|v2.assessment: 该工作从特征一致性角度切入无监督MOT，三模块对比设计针对遮挡与歧义问题有明确动机，结果超越部分全监督方法值得关注。
2309.00942|v2.contribution: 提出包含自对比、交叉对比与歧义对比的无监督对比相似性学习框架UCSL用于多目标跟踪。
2309.00942|v2.innovation: 通过帧内/帧间对比、跨帧匹配对齐与歧义目标隐式匹配三种对比机制挖掘跨帧特征一致性。
2309.00942|v2.result: 在现有基准上仅借助有限ReID头帮助即超越现有无监督方法，精度甚至高于许多全监督方法。

2407.04926|v2.summary_cn: 基于注意力的跟踪（TBA）在长遮挡和困难检测场景下潜力大，但性能长期落后于tracking-by-detection（TBD）。本文提出基于LiDAR的联合检测跟踪器JDT3D，分析TBA落后原因，并提出track sampling augmentation与confidence-based query propagation两种通用方法弥合差距。在nuScenes测试集上AMOTA达0.574，超越所有现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上，并进一步讨论了现有TBA建模的潜在挑战。
2407.04926|v2.summary_en: Tracking-by-attention (TBA) has potential for long occlusions and challenging detection but lags behind tracking-by-detection (TBD). This paper proposes JDT3D, a LiDAR-based joint detector and tracker, analyzing the performance gap and introducing track sampling augmentation and confidence-based query propagation. It achieves 0.574 AMOTA on the nuScenes test set, outperforming all existing LiDAR-based TBA approaches by over 6%, and further discusses challenges in current TBA formulations.
2407.04926|v2.assessment: 系统分析TBA与TBD差距并给出有效改进，nuScenes上显著领先，对3D跟踪研究价值高。
2407.04926|v2.contribution: 提出LiDAR联合检测跟踪器JDT3D及两种弥合TBA与TBD差距的通用方法。
2407.04926|v2.result: nuScenes测试集AMOTA 0.574，超越现有LiDAR TBA方法6%以上。

2409.17221|v2.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪（MOT）中全帧边界框与实例ID标注成本极高的问题，本文提出首个自监督跟踪器Walker，仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需任何跟踪标签。方法上构建准稠密时序物体外观图，设计多正样本对比目标优化图上随机游走以学习实例相似度，并引入互斥连通性约束优化图拓扑；推理时基于运动约束双向游走的最大似然转移状态将检测关联到轨迹片段。在MOT17、DanceTrack和BDD100K上达到与监督方法可竞争的性能，且标注需求最多减少400倍仍超越此前自监督跟踪器。
2409.17221|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the prohibitive annotation cost of multiple object tracking by introducing Walker, the first self-supervised tracker that learns from videos with only sparse bounding box annotations and no tracking labels. It constructs a quasi-dense temporal object appearance graph, optimizes random walks on it via a multi-positive contrastive objective, and enforces mutually-exclusive connectivity across instances; inference associates detections to tracklets via max-likelihood transitions under motion-constrained bidirectional walks. Walker achieves competitive performance on MOT17, DanceTrack, and BDD100K, outperforming prior self-supervised trackers while reducing annotation requirements by up to 400x.
2409.17221|v2.assessment: 首次将自监督学习成功扩展到MOT并达到与监督方法竞争的水平，标注效率提升显著，对降低自动驾驶感知数据成本有重要价值。
2409.17221|v2.contribution: 提出首个仅需稀疏边界框标注、无需跟踪标签的自监督多目标跟踪框架Walker。
2409.17221|v2.innovation: 设计准稠密时序外观图上的多正样本对比随机游走目标与互斥连通性约束，实现无需跟踪标签的实例相似度学习。
2409.17221|v2.result: 在MOT17、DanceTrack、BDD100K上达到竞争性性能，标注需求最多减少400倍仍超越已有自监督跟踪器。

Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_cn: 本文针对3D单目标跟踪（3D SOT）中标注数据稀缺、模型预训练不足的问题，提出利用2D匹配蒸馏与3D预训练来提升跟踪性能。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题可推断其通过将2D匹配知识蒸馏到3D跟踪器，并结合3D点云预训练来增强特征表示。该工作有望缓解3D SOT中数据不足导致的性能瓶颈，为点云跟踪提供更有效的训练范式。
Boosting 3D Single Object Tracking with.summary_en: This paper targets the data scarcity and weak pretraining problem in 3D single object tracking (3D SOT) by proposing 2D matching distillation and 3D pre-training. Although the abstract is missing, the title suggests distilling 2D matching knowledge into the 3D tracker and leveraging 3D point cloud pre-training to strengthen feature representations. The work aims to alleviate the performance bottleneck caused by limited 3D SOT data and provide a more effective training paradigm for point cloud tracking.

2401.11204|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D单目标跟踪（SOT）中类别专用模型参数冗余、难以跨类别泛化的问题，本文首次提出统一模型，用共享参数的单网络同时跟踪所有类别目标。方法上显式编码不同类别的属性差异，发现点云目标的属性差异主要来自尺寸与形状（如大而方的车辆 vs 小而细长的人），据此设计继承Transformer架构的AdaFormer点集表示学习网络，自适应编码跨类别动态变化的形状与尺寸信息，并将已知模板目标的尺寸形状先验融入模型输入与学习目标。该工作实现了跨类别统一跟踪，减少了参数冗余并提升了泛化性。
2401.11204|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the parameter redundancy and limited cross-category applicability of category-specific 3D single object tracking (SOT) models by introducing the first unified model that tracks all categories with a single shared-parameter network. It explicitly encodes category-specific attributes, observing that point cloud object variance mainly stems from size and shape, and designs AdaFormer, a transformer-based point set representation learning network that adaptively encodes dynamically varying shape and size across categories, incorporating template-derived size/shape priors into inputs and objectives. This enables unified cross-category tracking with reduced redundancy and improved generalization.
2401.11204|v2.assessment: 首次系统性地解决3D SOT的类别统一问题，AdaFormer对形状尺寸的自适应编码设计有针对性，对点云跟踪的通用化部署有实际意义。
2401.11204|v2.contribution: 提出首个跨类别统一的3D单目标跟踪模型，用共享参数网络同时跟踪所有类别目标。
2401.11204|v2.innovation: 设计AdaFormer自适应编码跨类别形状与尺寸信息，并融入模板尺寸形状先验。
2401.11204|v2.result: 实现跨类别统一跟踪，减少参数冗余并提升跨类别泛化能力。

BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_cn: 本文针对野生动物多目标跟踪与重识别缺乏专用数据集的问题，构建了BuckTales——一个基于多无人机（multi-UAV）的野生羚羊多目标跟踪与重识别数据集。由于摘要缺失，具体规模、标注类型与基准实验无法确认，但该数据集有望为多无人机视角下的MOT与ReID研究提供真实场景基准。该工作对生态监测与多视角跟踪算法评估具有数据贡献价值。
BuckTales: A multi-UAV dataset for multi.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of dedicated datasets for wildlife multi-object tracking and re-identification by constructing BuckTales, a multi-UAV dataset for MOT and re-ID of wild antelopes. Although the abstract is missing, the dataset is expected to provide a real-world benchmark for multi-UAV-view MOT and ReID research. 2411.00553|v2.summary_cn: 针对端到端Transformer跟踪器在异构场景训练时出现的负干扰（学习到冲突的场景特定参数）与域泛化能力有限（需昂贵微调）问题，本文提出PASTA框架，结合参数高效微调（PEFT）与模块化深度学习（MDL）。方法上定义关键场景属性（如相机视角、光照条件），为每个属性训练专用PEFT专家模块，并在参数空间组合这些模块，从而无需增加推理时间即可系统泛化到新域。在MOTSynth上大量实验及MOT17、PersonPath22零样本评估表明，由精心选择模块构建的神经跟踪器超越单体模型。
2411.00553|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles negative interference and limited domain generalization in end-to-end transformer trackers trained on heterogeneous scenarios by proposing PASTA, a framework combining Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) and Modular Deep Learning (MDL). It defines key scenario attributes (e.g., camera viewpoint, lighting) and trains specialized PEFT expert modules per attribute, combining them in parameter space to enable systematic generalization to new domains without increasing inference time. Extensive experiments on MOTSynth and zero-shot evaluations on MOT17 and PersonPath22 show that a tracker built from carefully selected modules surpasses its monolithic counterpart.
2411.00553|v2.assessment: 将PEFT与模块化学习引入MOT以解决异构场景负干扰与域泛化问题，思路新颖且零样本迁移验证充分，对自动驾驶多场景跟踪部署有参考价值。
2411.00553|v2.contribution: 提出结合PEFT与模块化深度学习的PASTA框架，实现异构场景下跟踪器的参数高效泛化。
2411.00553|v2.innovation: 按场景属性训练专用PEFT专家模块并在参数空间组合，无需增加推理时间即可泛化到新域。
2411.00553|v2.result: 在MOTSynth上超越单体模型，并在MOT17、PersonPath22零样本评估中验证泛化能力。

2411.01756|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉语言（VL）跟踪器因依赖人工文本标注（常含模糊描述）而性能逊于SoTA纯视觉跟踪器的问题，本文提出ChatTracker，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的世界知识生成高质量语言描述以增强跟踪。方法上提出基于反思的提示优化模块，结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊不准确的目标描述，并设计简单有效的VL跟踪框架，可作为即插即用模块同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器性能。实验表明该方法有效提升了跟踪性能。
2411.01756|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inferiority of Vision-Language (VL) trackers relative to SoTA visual trackers, which stems from their reliance on manual textual annotations often containing ambiguous descriptions. It proposes ChatTracker, which leverages the world knowledge of a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to generate high-quality language descriptions, featuring a reflection-based prompt optimization module that iteratively refines ambiguous target descriptions with tracking feedback. A simple yet effective VL tracking framework is proposed as a plug-and-play module to boost both VL and visual trackers, with experiments demonstrating improved tracking performance.
2411.01756|v2.assessment: 利用MLLM自动生成高质量文本描述替代人工标注，切中VL跟踪器性能瓶颈，即插即用设计对现有跟踪器有实用增益。
2411.01756|v2.contribution: 提出ChatTracker，利用MLLM生成高质量语言描述并设计即插即用VL跟踪框架提升跟踪性能。
2411.01756|v2.innovation: 提出基于反思的提示优化模块，结合跟踪反馈迭代精炼模糊的目标语言描述。
2411.01756|v2.result: 实验表明该方法可同时提升VL与纯视觉跟踪器的性能。

2510.12565|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机多目标跟踪中目标小、遮挡严重、背景杂乱，且RGB外观线索在航拍视角下退化的问题，论文提出首个无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT。该基准包含125段视频、48.8万+标注、8个类别，覆盖极小目标、高密度、严重遮挡和复杂运动等挑战，并提供精确的旋转框标注。作者进一步提出多光谱跟踪方法以提取光谱特征并利用旋转标注。相比现有RGB跟踪基准，MMOT通过像素级光谱反射信息提升退化空间条件下的目标可判别性。
2510.12565|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MMOT, the first benchmark for drone-based multispectral multi-object tracking, addressing the degradation of RGB appearance cues in aerial views. It contains 125 video sequences with over 488.8K oriented annotations across eight categories, covering extreme small targets, high density, severe occlusion, and complex motion. A multispectral tracking approach is further presented to exploit spectral features and oriented annotations, improving discriminability under degraded spatial conditions.
2510.12565|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了无人机多光谱多目标跟踪数据集的空白，规模大、挑战全面，对多模态跟踪与航拍感知研究有较高参考价值。
2510.12565|v2.contribution: 构建了首个大规模无人机多光谱多目标跟踪基准MMOT，并提出配套的多光谱跟踪方法。
2510.12565|v2.innovation: 将像素级光谱反射信息引入无人机多目标跟踪，并结合旋转框标注提升航拍定位精度。
2510.12565|v2.result: MMOT包含125段视频、48.8万+标注、8类目标，覆盖极小目标、高密度与严重遮挡等挑战。

2503.04565|v2.summary_cn: 针对全景图像360°视场下多目标跟踪中现有针孔相机算法难以适应、以及分辨率损失、几何形变和不均匀光照等全景畸变问题，论文提出OmniTrack全景MOT框架。该框架包含Tracklet Management引入时序线索、FlexiTrack Instances用于目标定位与关联、以及CircularStatE模块缓解图像与几何畸变，从而支持快速传感器运动下的全景跟踪。为弥补全景MOT数据集缺失，作者构建了四足机器人采集的QuadTrack数据集，覆盖全景视场、剧烈运动和复杂环境等挑战。
2503.04565|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes OmniTrack, an omnidirectional MOT framework addressing the limited applicability of pinhole-based MOT algorithms and panoramic distortions such as resolution loss, geometric deformation, and uneven lighting. It incorporates Tracklet Management for temporal cues, FlexiTrack Instances for localization and association, and the CircularStatE module to alleviate image and geometric distortions. The authors also introduce QuadTrack, a panoramic MOT dataset collected by a quadruped robot with diverse challenges.
2503.04565|v2.assessment: 该工作将MOT拓展到全景视场并配套新数据集，对全景感知与机器人跟踪研究有较高参考价值。
2503.04565|v2.contribution: 提出全景多目标跟踪框架OmniTrack，并构建四足机器人全景MOT数据集QuadTrack。
2503.04565|v2.innovation: 通过Tracklet Management、FlexiTrack Instances和CircularStatE模块协同缓解全景畸变并引入时序线索。
2503.04565|v2.result: 在快速传感器运动的全景场景下实现跟踪，并提供了覆盖剧烈运动与复杂环境的QuadTrack数据集。

2503.17699|v2.summary_cn: 针对无人机单目标跟踪中小目标和遮挡导致RGB跟踪器性能受限的问题，论文提出首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST和统一跟踪框架UNTrack。MUST包含250段视频序列，覆盖多样环境与挑战；UNTrack从光谱提示、初始模板和序列搜索中编码统一的光谱、空间与时间特征，采用非对称Transformer和光谱背景消除机制进行关系建模，并通过持续更新光谱提示的编码器细化跟踪。实验表明UNTrack优于现有无人机跟踪器，兼顾精度与效率。
2503.17699|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces MUST, the first large-scale multispectral UAV single object tracking dataset with 250 video sequences, and proposes UNTrack, a unified tracking framework encoding spectral, spatial, and temporal features from spectrum prompts, initial templates, and sequential searches. UNTrack employs an asymmetric transformer with a spectral background elimination mechanism and a continuously updated spectrum prompt encoder to refine tracking. Extensive experiments show UNTrack outperforms state-of-the-art UAV trackers in both accuracy and efficiency.
2503.17699|v2.assessment: 该工作同时贡献数据集与统一多光谱跟踪框架，对无人机多光谱感知与跟踪研究有较高价值。
2503.17699|v2.contribution: 构建首个大规模多光谱无人机单目标跟踪数据集MUST，并提出统一跟踪框架UNTrack。
2503.17699|v2.innovation: 通过光谱提示、非对称Transformer和光谱背景消除机制统一建模光谱、空间与时间特征。
2503.17699|v2.result: UNTrack在MUST上优于现有最先进无人机跟踪器，并提升精度与效率。

2503.18338|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有one-stream视觉跟踪器中单一ViT难以同时处理多样化关系建模（如背景区域需减少注意力、前景边界需加强）的问题，提出了基于混合专家（TMoE）的SPMTrack跟踪器。TMoE组合多个专家灵活处理不同类型的关系建模，并将关系建模从图像对扩展到时空上下文，同时作为参数高效微调方法大幅减少可训练参数。该方法在保持预训练模型泛化能力的同时，以极小的参数增量提升了跟踪精度，支持不同规模模型的高效训练。
2503.18338|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of single ViT models in one-stream trackers, which struggle to handle diverse relation modeling patterns such as suppressing background attention while emphasizing foreground boundaries. It proposes SPMTrack with a Tracking Mixture-of-Experts (TMoE) that combines multiple experts for flexible relation modeling, extends relation modeling from image pairs to spatio-temporal context, and serves as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method. This enables efficient training of SPMTrack at varying scales with minimal parameter increase while preserving pretrained model generalization.
2503.18338|v2.assessment: 将Mixture-of-Experts引入视觉跟踪的关系建模是一个有新意的方向，参数高效微调与时空上下文扩展的结合对跟踪领域研究者有参考价值。
2503.18338|v2.contribution: 提出基于混合专家的SPMTrack跟踪器，实现灵活关系建模与参数高效微调。
2503.18338|v2.innovation: 设计TMoE将多专家机制用于跟踪关系建模，并扩展至时空上下文。
2503.18338|v2.result: 以极小参数增量提升跟踪精度，同时大幅减少可训练参数并保持泛化能力。

2412.02129|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D单目标跟踪（SOT）数据集规模小、类别少、模态单一的问题，本文提出了GSOT3D基准，包含620个序列、123K帧、54个物体类别，每个序列提供点云、RGB图像和深度三种模态。所有序列经过多轮人工标注与精修，支持单模态点云跟踪及RGB-PC/RGB-D多模态跟踪任务。作者评估了8种代表性点云跟踪模型，发现这些模型在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明通用鲁棒3D跟踪仍有很大提升空间。该基准是目前面向多种通用3D跟踪任务的最大规模数据集。
2412.02129|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces GSOT3D, a large-scale benchmark for generic 3D single object tracking in the wild, comprising 620 sequences with 123K frames across 54 object categories, each with point cloud, RGB, and depth modalities. All sequences are manually annotated with multi-round inspection, supporting single-modal and multi-modal 3D tracking tasks. Evaluation of eight representative point cloud-based trackers reveals severe performance degradation, highlighting the need for more robust and generic 3D tracking methods.
2412.02129|v2.assessment: 该工作填补了通用3D单目标跟踪基准的空白，多模态标注和大规模类别覆盖对推动鲁棒3D跟踪研究具有重要价值。
2412.02129|v2.contribution: 构建了目前最大规模、多模态、多类别的通用3D单目标跟踪基准GSOT3D，并系统评估了现有方法。
2412.02129|v2.innovation: 首次提供同时包含点云、RGB和深度的多模态3D跟踪基准，覆盖54个类别和123K帧。
2412.02129|v2.result: 现有8种点云跟踪模型在GSOT3D上性能严重下降，表明通用3D跟踪仍面临巨大挑战。

2503.08145|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中现有方法过度依赖实例级检测与关联、忽略轨迹信息的问题，本文提出TRACT跟踪器，利用轨迹信息同时提升关联稳定性和分类准确率。具体引入轨迹一致性强化（TCR）策略改善目标身份与类别一致性，并提出即插即用的轨迹分类模块TraCLIP，集成轨迹特征聚合（TFA）和轨迹语义丰富（TSE）策略。该方法在遮挡和类别模糊场景下对新颖类别的适应能力更强，提升了开放词汇跟踪的整体性能。
2503.08145|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitation of existing Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking (OV-MOT) methods that rely primarily on instance-level detection and association while overlooking trajectory information. It proposes TRACT, a tracker that leverages trajectory information via a Trajectory Consistency Reinforcement (TCR) strategy and a plug-and-play trajectory classification module TraCLIP with Trajectory Feature Aggregation and Trajectory Semantic Enrichment. The method improves association stability and classification accuracy, especially under occlusion and category ambiguity, enhancing adaptability to novel classes.
2503.08145|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统性地将轨迹信息引入开放词汇多目标跟踪，TCR和TraCLIP设计合理，对提升开放场景跟踪鲁棒性有参考价值。
2503.08145|v2.contribution: 提出利用轨迹信息增强关联与分类的开放词汇多目标跟踪器TRACT及即插即用模块TraCLIP。
2503.08145|v2.innovation: 通过轨迹一致性强化和轨迹语义丰富策略，将轨迹信息显式用于开放词汇跟踪的关联与分类。
2503.08145|v2.result: 在遮挡和类别模糊场景下提升了关联稳定性和分类准确率，增强了对新颖类别的适应能力。

Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_cn: 本文针对指代多目标跟踪（Referring Multi-Object Tracking）中语言与视觉特征耦合过紧、细粒度知识利用不足的问题，提出了语言解耦与细粒度知识引导的方法。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体方法细节和实验数据。从标题推断，该方法旨在通过解耦语言表示并引入细粒度知识来提升指代跟踪的准确性。
Language Decoupling with Fine-Grained Kn.summary_en: This paper targets Referring Multi-Object Tracking, addressing the issue of tightly coupled language-visual features and insufficient use of fine-grained knowledge. It proposes a language decoupling approach with fine-grained knowledge guidance. Due to the missing abstract, specific methodological details and experimental results cannot be summarized.

VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_cn: 本文针对开放词汇多目标跟踪（OV-MOT）中标注数据依赖强、原始视频潜力未被充分挖掘的问题，提出VOVTrack方法，探索直接从原始视频中学习开放词汇跟踪能力。由于摘要缺失，无法获取具体技术方案和实验数据。从标题推断，该方法可能利用自监督或弱监督方式从无标注视频中提取跟踪所需的语义和运动信息。
VOVTrack: Exploring the Potentiality in.summary_en: This paper explores the potential of raw videos for Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Tracking (OV-MOT), proposing VOVTrack to reduce reliance on annotated data. Due to the missing abstract, specific methods and experimental results cannot be summarized. The title suggests leveraging raw videos, possibly via self-supervised or weakly-supervised learning, for open-vocabulary tracking.
