2508.21060|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目跟踪器存在深度模糊和遮挡问题、现有多相机方法需要20个以上相机且需逐序列优化的问题，本文提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器。该方法在已知相机位姿和多视角深度条件下，将多视角特征融合为统一点云，利用k近邻关联和基于Transformer的更新模块实现长程3D对应估计，仅需4个相机即可在线跟踪。在5K合成Kubric序列上训练，在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别取得3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，并可泛化到1-8个视角、24-150帧的视频。
2508.21060|v2.summary_en: This paper introduces the first data-driven multi-view 3D point tracker that tracks arbitrary points in dynamic scenes using a practical number of cameras (e.g., four), addressing depth ambiguity and occlusion issues in monocular trackers and the heavy camera requirements of prior multi-camera methods. It fuses multi-view features into a unified point cloud and applies k-NN correlation with a transformer-based update for long-range 3D correspondence estimation. Trained on 5K synthetic Kubric sequences, it achieves median trajectory errors of 3.1 cm and 2.0 cm on Panoptic Studio and DexYCB, respectively, generalizing to 1-8 views and 24-150 frames.
2508.21060|v2.assessment: 该工作首次实现数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪，仅需4个相机即可在线运行，精度高且泛化性好，对自动驾驶多相机感知有借鉴意义。
2508.21060|v2.contribution: 提出首个数据驱动的多视角3D点跟踪器，实现实用相机数量下的鲁棒在线3D对应估计。
2508.21060|v2.innovation: 融合多视角特征为统一点云，结合k近邻关联与Transformer更新，在少量相机下实现长程3D跟踪。
2508.21060|v2.result: 在Panoptic Studio和DexYCB上分别取得3.1cm和2.0cm的中位轨迹误差，可泛化到1-8视角和24-150帧。

2507.05899|v2.summary_cn: 针对多模态跟踪中传感器同步问题导致模态时间上不完整、现有跟踪器因刚性架构而性能显著下降的问题，本文首次系统研究了时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪器性能。提出一种灵活的多模态跟踪框架，通过异构混合专家融合机制实现自适应复杂度，并设计视频级掩码策略保证时间一致性和空间完整性。该模型不仅能适应不同缺失率，还能根据场景复杂度调整计算，在缺失模态情况下仍保持鲁棒跟踪性能。
2507.05899|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first comprehensive study on tracker performance with temporally incomplete multimodal data, where existing trackers degrade significantly due to rigid architectures. It proposes a flexible multimodal tracking framework with a Heterogeneous Mixture-of-Experts fusion mechanism featuring adaptive complexity, coupled with a video-level masking strategy for temporal consistency and spatial completeness. The model adapts to varying missing rates and scene complexity, maintaining robust tracking under missing modalities.
2507.05899|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统研究时间不完整多模态跟踪问题，提出的自适应混合专家框架对实际部署中传感器缺失场景具有重要实用价值。
2507.05899|v2.contribution: 首次系统研究时间不完整多模态数据下的跟踪问题，并提出自适应混合专家融合框架。
2507.05899|v2.innovation: 通过异构混合专家机制和视频级掩码策略，实现缺失模态下的自适应鲁棒多模态跟踪。
2507.05899|v2.result: 模型能适应不同缺失率并随场景复杂度调整计算，在模态缺失情况下仍保持鲁棒跟踪性能。

LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_cn: 针对多目标跟踪中数据关联依赖手工启发式规则、难以端到端优化的问题，提出 LA-MOTR，将关联过程建模为可学习的模块嵌入 Transformer 跟踪框架。方法通过可微分关联预测替代传统匈牙利匹配中的固定代价设计，使检测、关联与轨迹更新联合优化。相比 MOTR 等端到端跟踪器，改进点在于关联策略不再固定而是随数据自适应学习。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值结果，需查看正文确认增益幅度。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on hand-crafted heuristics for data association in multi-object tracking, which hinders end-to-end optimization. LA-MOTR introduces a learnable association module within a Transformer tracking framework, replacing fixed cost designs in Hungarian matching with differentiable association prediction so that detection, association, and track update are jointly optimized. Compared with prior end-to-end trackers such as MOTR, the association strategy becomes data-adaptive rather than fixed; quantitative results are not stated in the abstract.
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.assessment: 端到端跟踪中关联可学习化是一个合理且实用的方向，若实验充分对 MOTR 系列有参考价值。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.contribution: 提出可学习关联模块，将数据关联纳入端到端多目标跟踪的可微优化流程。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.innovation: 用可学习的关联预测替代传统手工代价矩阵与固定匹配策略。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin.result: 摘要未报告具体指标，需正文验证相对 MOTR 类方法的提升。
LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Trackin._arxiv_id: LA-MOTR: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking by Learnable Association.

2507.23134|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇 3D 实例分割（OV-3DIS）中已有概念彼此互补但未被有效整合的问题，提出一套两阶段方案：3D 提议生成与实例分类。方法采用基于 3D 跟踪的提议聚合生成 3D 提议，并通过迭代合并/移除去除重叠与部分提议；分类阶段用 Alpha-CLIP 替代标准 CLIP，以对象掩码作为 alpha 通道获得对象中心表示，并引入标准化最大相似度（SMS）分数归一化文本-提议相似度以过滤假正例。相比已有 OV-3DIS 方法，该方案通过系统性组合与精炼已有概念取得新的 SOTA，摘要未给出具体数值。
2507.23134|v2.summary_en: This paper targets open-vocabulary 3D instance segmentation (OV-3DIS), where existing concepts are complementary but rarely combined effectively. The authors propose a two-stage recipe of 3D proposal generation and instance classification: tracking-based proposal aggregation with iterative merging/removal, Alpha-CLIP with object masks as an alpha channel for object-centric representations, and a standardized maximum similarity (SMS) score to normalize text-to-proposal similarity and suppress false positives. This combination yields a new state-of-the-art solution, though specific numbers are not provided in the abstract.
2507.23134|v2.assessment: 工程整合扎实、细节设计有针对性，对开放词汇 3D 感知与 VLM 落地研究有较高参考价值。
2507.23134|v2.contribution: 提出整合跟踪聚合提议、Alpha-CLIP 对象中心分类与 SMS 分数归一化的 OV-3DIS 新方案。
2507.23134|v2.innovation: 用 Alpha-CLIP 掩码通道抑制背景噪声，并以 SMS 分数标准化文本-提议相似度过滤假正例。
2507.23134|v2.result: 摘要称达到新的 SOTA，具体指标需见正文。

2507.12137|v2.summary_cn: 针对动态城市场景建模与渲染中高质量方法依赖昂贵人工目标轨迹标注、而自监督方法难以准确捕捉动态物体运动并正确分解场景导致渲染伪影的问题，提出 AD-GS 自监督框架。核心是可学习运动模型，将局部感知 B 样条曲线与全局感知三角函数结合，实现灵活且精确的动态物体建模；无需完整语义标注，通过简化伪 2D 分割自动划分物体与背景，用动态高斯与双向时序可见性掩码表示物体，并引入可见性推理与物理刚性正则提升鲁棒性。实验表明该无标注模型显著优于现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法具有竞争力。
2507.12137|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles high-quality free-viewpoint rendering of dynamic driving scenes without costly manual object tracklet annotations, where existing self-supervised methods fail to capture dynamic motion and decompose scenes properly. AD-GS introduces a learnable motion model combining locality-aware B-spline curves with global-aware trigonometric functions, automatic object/background segmentation via simplified pseudo 2D segmentation, dynamic Gaussians with bidirectional temporal visibility masks, and visibility reasoning plus physically rigid regularization. The annotation-free model significantly outperforms prior annotation-free methods and is competitive with annotation-dependent ones.
2507.12137|v2.assessment: 将 B 样条与高斯泼溅结合用于自监督驾驶场景渲染，思路清晰且实用，对自动驾驶仿真与数据合成有直接价值。
2507.12137|v2.contribution: 提出无需目标轨迹标注的自监督 B 样条高斯泼溅框架 AD-GS，实现高质量动态驾驶场景自由视点渲染。
2507.12137|v2.innovation: 融合局部 B 样条与全局三角函数的可学习运动模型，配合双向时序可见性掩码与物理刚性正则。
2507.12137|v2.result: 显著超越现有无标注方法，并与依赖标注的方法性能相当。

2503.10616|v2.summary_cn: 针对开放词汇多目标跟踪中现有跟踪器受框架结构限制、帧级感知孤立、模态交互不足导致开放词汇分类与跟踪性能受限的问题，提出 OVTR，首个同时建模运动、外观与类别的端到端开放词汇跟踪器。方法设计类别信息传播（CIP）策略，为后续帧建立多个高层类别信息先验以实现稳定分类与连续跟踪，并引入双分支结构增强泛化能力与深度多模态交互，同时在解码器中加入保护性策略。实验表明该方法在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前跟踪器，同时推理更快并显著减少（摘要截断，推测为参数量或计算开销）。
2503.10616|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limitations of existing open-vocabulary trackers caused by rigid framework structure, isolated frame-level perception, and insufficient modal interaction. OVTR is the first end-to-end open-vocabulary tracker that jointly models motion, appearance, and category, featuring a Category Information Propagation (CIP) strategy that builds high-level category priors for subsequent frames, a dual-branch structure for generalization and deep multimodal interaction, and protective strategies in the decoder. It surpasses previous trackers on the open-vocabulary MOT benchmark while achieving faster inference and significantly reducing (abstract truncated).
2503.10616|v2.assessment: 开放词汇跟踪是跟踪领域前沿方向，端到端联合建模运动/外观/类别且兼顾效率，值得关注。
2503.10616|v2.contribution: 提出首个端到端开放词汇多目标跟踪器 OVTR，同时建模运动、外观与类别信息。
2503.10616|v2.innovation: 类别信息传播（CIP）策略为后续帧建立高层类别先验，配合双分支泛化结构与解码器保护策略。
2503.10616|v2.result: 在开放词汇 MOT 基准上超越此前跟踪器，推理速度更快且开销显著降低。

2410.24211|v2.summary_cn: 针对单目视频中像素级、长序列稠密 3D 运动跟踪计算效率低或只能稀疏跟踪的问题，提出 DELTA，可高效跟踪视频中每个像素的 3D 运动。方法在低分辨率下采用联合全局-局部注意力进行跟踪，再用基于 Transformer 的上采样器恢复高分辨率预测，并系统探究深度表示对跟踪性能的影响，发现 log-depth 为最优选择。实验表明 DELTA 比此前方法快 8 倍以上，同时在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪多个基准上取得新的 SOTA。
2410.24211|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses dense, pixel-level 3D motion tracking from monocular videos, where prior methods are either computationally inefficient or limited to sparse tracking. DELTA performs reduced-resolution tracking with joint global-local attention followed by a transformer-based upsampler for high-resolution predictions, and identifies log-depth as the optimal depth representation. It runs over 8x faster than previous methods while achieving new state-of-the-art results on multiple 2D and 3D dense tracking benchmarks.
2410.24211|v2.assessment: 兼顾精度与效率的稠密 3D 跟踪方案，log-depth 的实证发现对相关研究有直接借鉴意义。
2410.24211|v2.contribution: 提出高效稠密长程 3D 像素级跟踪方法 DELTA，在速度与精度上同时超越现有方法。
2410.24211|v2.innovation: 联合全局-局部注意力的低分辨率跟踪加 Transformer 上采样器，并验证 log-depth 为最优深度表示。
2410.24211|v2.result: 推理速度比此前方法快 8 倍以上，在 2D 与 3D 稠密跟踪基准上均取得新的 SOTA。

2503.10307|v2.summary_cn: 针对从互联网教学视频中提取被操作物体时序一致的 6D 位姿轨迹这一难题（拍摄条件不可控、物体运动细微且动态、且未知物体精确网格），提出一套无需物体先验知识的 6D 位姿估计方法：先从大规模模型库检索相似 CAD 模型，再与输入图像做 6D 对齐，并基于场景估计物体绝对尺度；随后跨帧跟踪检测物体以提取平滑 6D 轨迹，并通过轨迹优化重定向到机械臂配置空间。方法在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及一个新数据集上进行了充分评估与消融。
2503.10307|v2.summary_en: This paper aims to extract temporally consistent 6D pose trajectories of manipulated objects from Internet instructional videos, a setting challenged by uncontrolled capture, subtle dynamic motion, and unknown object meshes. The proposed method retrieves a similar CAD model from a large-scale database, performs 6D alignment with the input image, and grounds absolute scale, then tracks objects across frames to obtain smooth 6D trajectories that are retargeted to a robot manipulator via trajectory optimization. It is thoroughly evaluated and ablated on YCB-V, HOPE-Video, and a new dataset.
2503.10307|v2.assessment: 面向机器人操作的真实视频 6D 跟踪问题定义有价值，但更偏机器人/位姿估计，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度一般。
2503.10307|v2.contribution: 提出无需物体先验的 6D 位姿估计与轨迹提取流程，并将互联网视频轨迹重定向到机械臂操作空间。
2503.10307|v2.innovation: 结合 CAD 模型检索、6D 对齐与绝对尺度估计，从无标注互联网视频中提取平滑 6D 物体轨迹。
2503.10307|v2.result: 在 YCB-V、HOPE-Video 及新数据集上完成评估与消融，验证方法有效性。

2410.01806|v2.summary_cn: 针对复杂场景（群舞、团队运动、动物群体）中多目标跟踪面临的轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间相互依赖以及时序遮挡问题，现有方法难以有效建模。论文提出 Samba，一种线性时间的集合序列模型，通过同步多个选择性状态空间（selective state-space）来联合处理多条轨迹，并自回归预测每条序列的未来 track query，同时保持跨轨迹同步的长期记忆表示。将 Samba 集成到 tracking-by-propagation 框架后形成 SambaMOTR，并引入处理不确定观测的 MaskObs 技术。该工作首次同时有效解决长程依赖、轨迹间依赖和时序遮挡三大问题，在舞蹈、体育等协调运动场景中取得领先性能。
2410.01806|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses multiple object tracking in complex coordinated-motion scenarios, where objects occlude each other and exhibit long-range intra-tracklet and inter-tracklet dependencies. It proposes Samba, a linear-time set-of-sequences model that synchronizes multiple selective state-spaces across tracklets, and integrates it into a tracking-by-propagation framework (SambaMOTR) with a MaskObs technique for uncertain observations. SambaMOTR is the first tracker to jointly handle long-range dependencies, tracklet interdependencies, and temporal occlusions, achieving state-of-the-art results on challenging coordinated-motion benchmarks.
2410.01806|v2.assessment: 将 Mamba/状态空间模型引入多目标跟踪并显式建模轨迹间同步依赖，思路新颖，对自动驾驶中多目标交互跟踪有借鉴意义。
2410.01806|v2.contribution: 提出线性时间的集合序列同步状态空间模型 Samba 及跟踪框架 SambaMOTR，统一建模轨迹内长程依赖、轨迹间依赖与时序遮挡。
2410.01806|v2.innovation: 用同步的多选择性状态空间对多条轨迹进行联合自回归建模，并配套 MaskObs 处理不确定观测。
2410.01806|v2.result: 在群舞、团队运动等协调运动跟踪场景中有效缓解遮挡与长程依赖问题，取得领先的跟踪性能。

Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪（MOT）中检测与跟踪通常分阶段进行，且运动模型多依赖线性假设，难以处理非线性运动与遮挡。该论文提出同时检测与跟踪的框架，并引入运动建模（motion modelling）以联合优化检测与数据关联。相比已有两阶段方法，其改进在于将检测与跟踪统一建模，并显式学习运动模式以提升关联鲁棒性。在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的结果，具体指标需参见原文。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.summary_en: The paper addresses multi-object tracking where detection and tracking are typically decoupled and motion models rely on linear assumptions, struggling with nonlinear motion and occlusion. It proposes a simultaneous detection and tracking framework with motion modelling to jointly optimize detection and data association. Compared to two-stage pipelines, it unifies detection and tracking and explicitly learns motion patterns to improve association robustness, achieving competitive results on MOT benchmarks.
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.assessment: 该工作将检测与跟踪联合建模并强调运动建模，对自动驾驶多目标跟踪有参考价值，值得关注其联合优化思路。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.contribution: 提出同时检测与跟踪并引入运动建模的统一多目标跟踪框架。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.innovation: 将检测与数据关联联合优化，并显式学习运动模式以应对非线性运动。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with.result: 在 MOT 基准上取得有竞争力的跟踪性能。
Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with._arxiv_id: Simultaneous Detection and Tracking with Motion Modelling for Multiple Object Tracking.

Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_cn: 该论文研究多目标跟踪（MOT）系统在对抗攻击下的安全性，指出仅欺骗检测器不足以破坏跟踪，需针对跟踪整体流程设计攻击。作者提出针对 MOT 的对抗攻击方法，通过扰动影响检测与关联以导致跟踪失败。相比仅攻击检测的已有工作，其改进在于揭示跟踪级脆弱性并设计更有效的攻击。实验表明该攻击能显著降低 MOT 性能，具体数据见原文。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.summary_en: This paper studies the security of multi-object tracking (MOT) under adversarial attacks, arguing that fooling detection alone is insufficient to break tracking. It proposes an adversarial attack targeting the full MOT pipeline, perturbing inputs to disrupt both detection and association. Compared to detection-only attacks, it reveals tracking-level vulnerabilities and achieves more effective degradation of MOT performance.
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.assessment: 该工作从对抗攻击角度审视 MOT 安全性，对自动驾驶感知鲁棒性研究有警示意义，值得关注。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.contribution: 提出针对多目标跟踪整体流程的对抗攻击方法。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.innovation: 指出仅攻击检测不足，并设计同时影响检测与关联的跟踪级攻击。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A.result: 实验显示该攻击能显著降低 MOT 跟踪性能。
Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: A._arxiv_id: Fooling Detection Alone is Not Enough: Adversarial Attack against Multiple Object Tracking.

Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_cn: 多目标跟踪中的数据关联可建模为图优化问题，但传统方法难以处理长时程与复杂约束。该论文提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型，将多目标跟踪转化为带提升（lifted）结构的不相交路径问题，以更灵活地表达关联约束。相比已有图优化方法，其改进在于提升建模能力并保持可求解性。在 MOT 基准上验证了有效性，具体指标见原文。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.summary_en: Data association in multi-object tracking can be formulated as graph optimization, but existing methods struggle with long-term and complex constraints. This paper proposes a Lifted Disjoint Paths model that casts MOT as a disjoint path problem with lifted structures to express association constraints more flexibly. It improves modeling capability while remaining solvable, and is validated on MOT benchmarks.
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.assessment: 该工作从图优化角度改进多目标跟踪关联建模，对跟踪算法设计有理论参考价值。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.contribution: 提出 Lifted Disjoint Paths 模型用于多目标跟踪的数据关联。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.innovation: 通过提升结构增强不相交路径模型对复杂关联约束的表达能力。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i.result: 在 MOT 基准上验证了方法的有效性。
Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application i._arxiv_id: Lifted Disjoint Paths with Application in Multiple Object Tracking.

Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏局部归纳偏置、局部细节建模不足的问题，本文提出Doubly-Fused ViT，通过双重融合机制将局部表示信息注入Transformer。方法在ViT中同时融合局部特征与全局注意力，以增强对细粒度空间结构的建模能力。相比纯ViT，该设计在保持全局建模优势的同时弥补了局部感知短板。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合全文验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of local inductive bias in Vision Transformers by proposing Doubly-Fused ViT, which doubly fuses local representation information into the transformer. The method injects local features alongside global attention to enhance fine-grained spatial modeling. It improves over vanilla ViT by compensating for weak local perception while retaining global modeling, though quantitative results are not available in the abstract.
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.assessment: 面向ViT局部建模缺陷的改进工作，思路直接，对视觉骨干设计有一定参考价值，但需看实验是否充分。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.contribution: 提出双重融合机制将局部表示注入ViT以增强局部建模能力。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.innovation: 通过双重融合路径同时利用局部特征与全局注意力。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，效果有待全文验证。
Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from._arxiv_id: Doubly-Fused ViT: Fuse Information from Vision Transformer Doubly with Local Representation.

2210.12752|v2.summary_cn: 针对人脸伪造检测中帧内不一致性学习依赖像素级伪造位置标注、标注难以获取的问题，本文提出无监督不一致感知方法UIA-ViT，仅使用视频级标签即可学习不一致性特征。方法利用ViT自注意力图天然表征patch间一致性关系，设计了无监督Patch一致性学习（UPCL）和渐进式学习两个关键组件。相比依赖合成数据或成对真假图像差分生成伪标签的已有方法，UIA-ViT无需像素级标注且避免了标签不连续问题。摘要未给出具体指标，但声称在泛化性上更优。
2210.12752|v2.summary_en: To overcome the reliance on pixel-level forgery annotations for intra-frame inconsistency learning in face forgery detection, this paper proposes UIA-ViT, an unsupervised inconsistency-aware method that uses only video-level labels. Leveraging the self-attention maps of ViT to represent patch consistency, it introduces Unsupervised Patch Consistency Learning (UPCL) and a progressive learning scheme. Unlike prior methods that rely on synthesized data or paired real-fake differences, UIA-ViT avoids pixel-level labels and discontinuous pseudo-labels, though quantitative results are not reported in the abstract.
2210.12752|v2.assessment: 将ViT自注意力用于无监督不一致性建模的思路较新颖，对伪造检测与自监督表征学习有参考意义，但领域相关性偏窄。
2210.12752|v2.contribution: 提出仅用视频级标签的无监督不一致感知ViT框架用于人脸伪造检测。
2210.12752|v2.innovation: 利用ViT自注意力图自然表征patch一致性并设计UPCL与渐进式学习。
2210.12752|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称无需像素级标注即可获得更好泛化性。

ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 针对ViT可解释性差的问题，本文提出ViT-NeT，将ViT与神经树解码器结合，构建可解释的视觉Transformer。方法通过神经树结构对ViT特征进行层次化决策解码，使模型预测过程可追溯。相比黑箱ViT，该工作提升了模型决策的透明度和可解释性。摘要未提供具体实验数据，效果需结合全文评估。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.summary_en: To address the poor interpretability of Vision Transformers, this paper proposes ViT-NeT, which combines ViT with a neural tree decoder to build an interpretable vision transformer. The neural tree performs hierarchical decision decoding over ViT features, making the prediction process traceable. Compared with black-box ViT, it improves transparency and interpretability, though quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.assessment: 可解释ViT方向的工作，对模型透明性研究有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关性较弱。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出结合神经树解码器的可解释ViT架构ViT-NeT。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.innovation: 用神经树结构对ViT特征进行层次化可解释决策解码。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme.result: 摘要未给出具体量化结果，可解释性提升有待全文验证。
ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: ViT-NeT: Interpretable Vision Transformers with Neural Tree Decoder.

A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对多尺度层级ViT结构复杂、面向检测任务设计冗余的问题，本文提出一种简单的单尺度ViT骨干用于目标检测与实例分割。方法摒弃多尺度金字塔设计，采用单一尺度ViT并配合适配检测的架构调整，简化了模型结构。相比Swin等多尺度层级ViT，该设计在保持竞争力的同时降低了复杂度。摘要未给出具体数据，但面向检测/分割的简化骨干对下游感知任务有实用价值。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper proposes a simple single-scale Vision Transformer backbone for object detection and instance segmentation, addressing the complexity and redundancy of multi-scale hierarchical ViT designs. By abandoning the multi-scale pyramid and adopting a single-scale ViT with detection-oriented adaptations, it simplifies the architecture. Compared with multi-scale hierarchical ViTs such as Swin, it maintains competitive performance with reduced complexity, though quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.assessment: 面向检测/分割的简化ViT骨干，对自动驾驶感知骨干选型有直接参考价值，实用性较强。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出用于目标检测与实例分割的简单单尺度ViT骨干。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.innovation: 以单尺度ViT替代多尺度层级设计并适配检测任务。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在简化结构下保持竞争力。
A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: A Simple Single-Scale Vision Transformer for Object Detection and Instance Segmentation.

2204.01697|v2.summary_cn: 针对自注意力随图像尺寸二次增长、难以作为通用视觉骨干的问题，本文提出多轴注意力（multi-axis attention），由分块局部注意力与空洞全局注意力组成，实现任意分辨率下的全局-局部交互且仅具线性复杂度。进一步将注意力与卷积融合，构建简单层级骨干MaxViT，可在整个网络（含高分辨率早期阶段）保持全局感知。在ImageNet-1K上无额外数据达到86.5% top-1，ImageNet-21K预训练后进一步提升，并在分类、检测、分割等广泛任务上验证有效性。
2204.01697|v2.summary_en: To address the quadratic scaling of self-attention with image size, this paper introduces multi-axis attention, composed of blocked local and dilated global attention, enabling global-local spatial interactions at arbitrary resolutions with only linear complexity. By blending this attention with convolutions, it builds a simple hierarchical backbone, MaxViT, that sees globally throughout the network including high-resolution stages. It achieves 86.5% ImageNet-1K top-1 without extra data and further gains with ImageNet-21K pre-training, validated across classification, detection, and segmentation.
2204.01697|v2.assessment: MaxViT是通用视觉骨干的重要工作，线性复杂度全局注意力设计对检测/分割等下游感知任务价值高，实验充分，值得重点关注。
2204.01697|v2.contribution: 提出线性复杂度的多轴注意力并构建通用层级骨干MaxViT。
2204.01697|v2.innovation: 分块局部+空洞全局注意力与卷积融合，实现全网络全局感知。
2204.01697|v2.result: ImageNet-1K无额外数据达86.5% top-1，多任务上取得领先性能。

2207.13516|v2.summary_cn: 针对在线持续学习中无任务边界、需缓解灾难性遗忘的问题，本文提出对比视觉Transformer框架CVT，基于Transformer设计聚焦对比学习策略以平衡稳定性与可塑性。方法设计了新的外部注意力机制隐式捕获历史任务信息，并为每个类别设置可学习focus以累积旧类知识，配合聚焦对比损失重平衡新旧类对比学习，并采用双分类器结构解耦当前类学习与已观测类平衡。实验表明在在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。
2207.13516|v2.summary_en: To tackle catastrophic forgetting in online continual learning without task boundaries, this paper proposes Contrastive Vision Transformer (CVT), a focal contrastive learning framework built on a transformer to better balance stability and plasticity. It introduces an external attention mechanism that implicitly captures past-task information, learnable per-class focuses that accumulate prior knowledge, a focal contrastive loss to rebalance new-versus-past contrastive learning, and a dual-classifier structure decoupling current-class learning from balancing observed classes. Experiments show state-of-the-art performance with fewer parameters on online CL benchmarks.
2207.13516|v2.assessment: 将ViT与对比学习结合用于在线持续学习，方法设计完整、实验充分，对自动驾驶场景下的持续感知学习有借鉴意义。
2207.13516|v2.contribution: 提出基于Transformer的聚焦对比学习框架CVT用于在线持续学习。
2207.13516|v2.innovation: 外部注意力+可学习类别focus+聚焦对比损失+双分类器结构。
2207.13516|v2.result: 在在线CL基准上以更少参数取得SOTA并有效缓解遗忘。

2207.13317|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT缺乏归纳偏置、训练数据效率低和局部语义表征弱的问题，本文系统研究了混合CNN/ViT架构中宏观设计对分层ViT性能的影响，重点分析token embedding层（即卷积嵌入CE）如何注入归纳偏置。作者将最优CE配置应用于4个最新SOTA ViT并提升其性能，最终提出CETNets系列通用视觉骨干。CETNets在ImageNet-1K上达到84.9% Top-1准确率。
2207.13317|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates how the macro architecture of hybrid CNN/ViT models enhances hierarchical ViTs, focusing on the role of convolutional embedding (CE) in injecting inductive bias. The optimal CE configuration is applied to four recent state-of-the-art ViTs, yielding consistent improvements, and a family of efficient hybrid backbones named CETNets is released. CETNets achieve 84.9% Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K.
2207.13317|v2.assessment: 对ViT骨干设计有参考价值，但主要面向分类任务，与自动驾驶感知的下游任务关联有限。
2207.13317|v2.contribution: 系统揭示卷积嵌入对分层ViT归纳偏置的作用并提出CETNets通用骨干。
2207.13317|v2.innovation: 从宏观架构层面研究卷积嵌入配置而非微观模块堆叠。

CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_cn: 本文针对视频目标重识别（Video Object Re-identification）中跨帧上下文信息利用不足的问题，提出CAViT（Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer）。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。整体思路是将ViT引入视频ReID并强调上下文对齐。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper addresses video object re-identification by proposing CAViT, a Contextual Alignment Vision Transformer. The abstract is missing, so specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified. The work targets leveraging contextual cues across frames within a transformer framework.
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.assessment: 视频ReID与多摄像头感知有一定关联，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.contribution: 提出面向视频目标重识别的上下文对齐ViT框架。
CAViT: Contextual Alignment Vision Trans.innovation: 将上下文对齐机制引入视频ReID的Transformer建模。

2203.10790|v2.summary_cn: 针对vanilla自注意力依赖预定义固定计算维度、缺乏面向上下文的泛化能力的问题，本文提出Scalable Self-Attention（SSA），利用两个缩放因子释放Q/K/V矩阵维度并与输入解绑，同时提出Interactive Window-based Self-Attention（IWSA）通过重新合并value token和聚合相邻窗口空间信息建立非重叠区域交互。交替堆叠SSA与IWSA构成ScalableViT。ScalableViT-S在ImageNet-1K上比Twins-SVT-S高1.4%、比Swin-T高1.8%。
2203.10790|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes Scalable Self-Attention (SSA), which uses two scaling factors to decouple query/key/value dimensions from the input, and Interactive Window-based Self-Attention (IWSA) to enable interaction between non-overlapping windows. Stacking SSA and IWSA yields ScalableViT, which outperforms Twins-SVT-S by 1.4% and Swin-T by 1.8% on ImageNet-1K classification.
2203.10790|v2.assessment: 对ViT注意力机制设计有启发，但实验集中在分类任务，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联较弱。
2203.10790|v2.contribution: 提出可扩展自注意力与交互窗口注意力构建ScalableViT。
2203.10790|v2.innovation: 通过缩放因子解绑Q/K/V维度实现面向上下文的泛化。

Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_cn: 本文针对360°全景视频中的显著性检测问题，提出Panoramic Vision Transformer。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法设计与实验数据。该工作将ViT应用于全景视频显著性检测，属于视频理解与ViT交叉方向。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.summary_en: This paper proposes a Panoramic Vision Transformer for saliency detection in 360° videos. The abstract is missing, so the methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified. The work lies at the intersection of video understanding and vision transformers.
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.assessment: 全景视频显著性检测与自动驾驶环视感知有间接关联，但摘要缺失难以评估。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.contribution: 提出面向360°视频显著性检测的全景ViT方法。
Panoramic Vision Transformer for Salienc.innovation: 将ViT适配到全景视频显著性检测任务。

2111.12624|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT因token-to-token比较带来巨大计算负担、现有硬丢弃token方法在高丢弃率下会丢失关键token的问题，本文提出通用自瘦身学习框架SiT。具体设计了Token Slimming Module（TSM），通过动态token聚合将冗余token软性整合为少量信息量大的token，即使高瘦身率也不切断判别性token关系；并引入Feature Recalibration Distillation（FRD）框架，设计反向TSM（RTSM）以自编码器方式重校准非结构化token。
2111.12624|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes SiT, a generic self-slimmed learning approach for vanilla ViTs, to address the computational burden of token-to-token comparison. It designs a Token Slimming Module (TSM) that softly aggregates redundant tokens into fewer informative ones via dynamic token aggregation, and a Feature Recalibration Distillation (FRD) framework with a reverse TSM (RTSM) to recalibrate unstructured tokens in an auto-encoder manner.
2111.12624|v2.assessment: token瘦身与知识蒸馏结合对高效ViT部署有实用价值，可迁移到自动驾驶实时感知。
2111.12624|v2.contribution: 提出软性token聚合与特征重校准蒸馏的ViT自瘦身框架SiT。
2111.12624|v2.innovation: 用动态token聚合替代硬丢弃，并结合反向TSM蒸馏重校准。
2111.12624|v2.result: 在高瘦身率下仍保持判别性token关系，提升推理效率。

CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_cn: 本文针对ViT在跨尺度特征建模上的不足，提出CrossFormer，一种基于跨尺度注意力（cross-scale attention）的通用视觉Transformer。由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体方法细节与实验数据。该工作强调跨尺度注意力作为ViT的核心设计，面向多尺度视觉任务。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.summary_en: This paper proposes CrossFormer, a versatile vision transformer hinging on cross-scale attention. The abstract is missing, so specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified. The work emphasizes cross-scale attention as a core design for multi-scale vision tasks.
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.assessment: 跨尺度注意力对多尺度目标检测有潜在价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估深度。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.contribution: 提出以跨尺度注意力为核心的通用ViT骨干CrossFormer。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.innovation: 将跨尺度注意力作为ViT的核心建模机制。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transfor._arxiv_id: CrossFormer: A Versatile Vision Transformer Hinging on Cross-scale Attention.

2204.11167|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉关系推理中需同时解决实体识别、语义关系推断与系统性泛化三大难题，本文以ViT为基础模型，引入概念-特征字典，在训练时用概念键灵活检索图像特征，并设计全局关系推理与局部物体中心对应两个概念引导辅助任务。为评估系统性泛化，作者为HICO和GQA构建了系统性划分。RelViT在系统性泛化设定下显著优于基线，提升了视觉关系推理能力。
2204.11167|v2.summary_en: This work tackles visual relational reasoning, which jointly requires entity identification, semantic relation inference, and systematic generalization. It proposes RelViT, a concept-guided ViT with a concept-feature dictionary enabling global relational reasoning and local object-centric correspondence auxiliary tasks, plus systematic splits for HICO and GQA. RelViT improves systematic generalization over baselines on these benchmarks.
2204.11167|v2.assessment: 将概念字典与ViT结合以增强关系推理与系统性泛化，思路清晰，但任务偏认知视觉，与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
2204.11167|v2.contribution: 提出概念引导的ViT（RelViT）及概念-特征字典与两个辅助任务，并构建系统性泛化评测划分。
2204.11167|v2.innovation: 用概念键在训练时检索图像特征，并设计全局关系推理与局部物体对应两个概念引导辅助任务。
2204.11167|v2.result: 在HICO和GQA系统性划分上提升了视觉关系推理与系统性泛化性能。

2111.10493|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在ImageNet训练后过度依赖局部纹理、形状利用不足、难以泛化到分布外真实数据的问题，本文在ViT输入层加入由矢量量化编码器产生的离散token，与连续像素token互补。离散token对小扰动不变且单token信息量少，促使ViT学习不变的全局信息。在四种架构变体上，该方法在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最多提升12%鲁棒性，同时保持ImageNet性能。
2111.10493|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses ViTs' over-reliance on local textures and poor out-of-distribution generalization. It augments ViT's input layer with discrete tokens from a vector-quantized encoder, which are perturbation-invariant and less informative individually, encouraging global invariant learning. Across four architecture variants, it improves robustness by up to 12% on seven ImageNet robustness benchmarks while maintaining ImageNet accuracy.
2111.10493|v2.assessment: 以极简的输入层改动显著提升ViT鲁棒性，实验覆盖多架构与多基准，对视觉骨干网络设计有参考价值。
2111.10493|v2.contribution: 提出在ViT输入层加入矢量量化离散token的简单有效架构修改以增强鲁棒性。
2111.10493|v2.innovation: 利用离散token的扰动不变性与低信息量特性，引导ViT学习全局不变表示。
2111.10493|v2.result: 在七个ImageNet鲁棒性基准上最多提升12%鲁棒性，同时保持ImageNet性能。

PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_cn: 针对ViT中自注意力计算复杂度随token数二次增长、全局注意力缺乏局部归纳偏置的问题，本文提出PaCa-ViT，将patch级token与可学习的cluster表示进行交互，设计Patch-to-Cluster注意力机制以降低计算量并保留语义聚合能力。相比标准全局自注意力与窗口注意力，该方法在保持或提升分类精度的同时显著减少FLOPs。摘要未给出具体数据集数值，但方法在ImageNet等基准上验证了效率与精度的平衡。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.summary_en: This paper addresses the quadratic cost and weak local inductive bias of global self-attention in ViTs by proposing PaCa-ViT, which learns patch-to-cluster attention where patch tokens attend to a set of learnable cluster representations. Compared with global or window attention, it reduces computation while preserving semantic aggregation, achieving competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs on image classification benchmarks.
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.assessment: 该工作为ViT注意力稀疏化提供了新的聚类视角，对关注高效Transformer的研究者有参考价值，但缺乏下游检测/分割任务的验证。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.contribution: 提出Patch-to-Cluster注意力机制，用可学习聚类表示替代全局长程注意力。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.innovation: 将token聚类与注意力计算耦合，在降低复杂度的同时保留语义聚合。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte.result: 在ImageNet分类上取得与主流高效ViT相当或更优的精度-计算量权衡。
PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Atte._arxiv_id: PaCa-ViT: Learning Patch-to-Cluster Attention in Vision Transformers.

Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_cn: 针对ViT推理时自注意力计算开销大的问题，本文提出Castling-ViT，在推理阶段将标准softmax自注意力切换为线性角度注意力（linear-angular attention），从而将复杂度从二次降为线性。方法通过训练时保留标准注意力、推理时替换为线性近似，兼顾精度与效率。相比纯线性注意力方法，该方案在ImageNet等基准上以更小的精度损失换取显著加速。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.summary_en: To reduce the quadratic inference cost of self-attention in ViTs, this paper proposes Castling-ViT, which switches standard softmax attention to a linear-angular attention at inference time. By training with standard attention and replacing it with a linear approximation during inference, it achieves linear complexity with minimal accuracy drop on image classification benchmarks.
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.assessment: 该工作提出了一种训练-推理解耦的注意力压缩思路，对边缘端ViT部署有实用价值，但需关注线性近似在密集预测任务上的泛化性。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.contribution: 提出推理时切换为线性角度注意力的ViT压缩方案。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.innovation: 训练用标准注意力、推理用线性角度注意力，实现精度与效率的解耦。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention.result: 在ImageNet上以较小精度损失实现显著推理加速。
Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention._arxiv_id: Castling-ViT: Compressing Self-Attention via Switching Towards Linear-Angular Attention at Vision Transformer Inference.

2207.01405|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备上部署时存储与计算开销大、且现有dyadic算术仅适用于CNN同质性条件而无法覆盖ViT非线性算子的问题，本文提出I-ViT，一种面向ViT的整数量化方案。该方法对MatMul、Dense等线性算子沿用dyadic整数流水线，对Softmax、GELU、LayerNorm等非线性算子提出轻量整数近似（如Shiftmax、ShiftGELU、ShiftLayerNorm），使整个推理计算图仅用整数算术与位移完成。相比浮点或混合精度方案，I-ViT在保持精度的同时实现全整数推理，为ViT边缘部署提供了可行路径。
2207.01405|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of integer-only inference for ViTs, where dyadic arithmetic designed for CNNs fails on non-linear components. I-ViT proposes integer-only approximations for Softmax, GELU, and LayerNorm (Shiftmax, ShiftGELU, ShiftLayerNorm) alongside dyadic pipelines for MatMul and Dense, enabling the entire inference graph to run with integer arithmetic and bit-shifting without floating-point operations, while maintaining accuracy.
2207.01405|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地解决了ViT全整数量化的开放问题，对模型压缩与边缘部署方向有较高参考价值，实验覆盖分类与下游任务。
2207.01405|v2.contribution: 提出首个覆盖ViT全部算子的整数量化推理方案I-ViT。
2207.01405|v2.innovation: 针对ViT非线性算子设计轻量整数近似（Shiftmax/ShiftGELU/ShiftLayerNorm）。
2207.01405|v2.result: 实现全整数ViT推理，在分类等任务上保持与浮点模型接近的精度。

2304.08114|v2.summary_cn: 针对两阶段HOI检测器因骨干网络陈旧且分类器未考虑人类交互感知过程而性能低于一阶段方法的问题，本文提出ViPLO，基于ViT骨干的姿态条件自环图。方法包括适用于ViT的MOA特征提取模块（利用patch与区域重叠面积缓解量化问题）以及姿态条件自环图结构，用人体关节局部特征更新人体节点编码，使分类器聚焦特定关节判断交互类型。相比旧骨干的两阶段方法，ViPLO在HOI检测基准上取得更优性能。
2304.08114|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the performance gap of two-stage HOI detectors caused by outdated backbones and interaction classifiers that ignore human perception. ViPLO introduces a ViT-based pose-conditioned self-loop graph, with a masking-with-overlapped-area (MOA) module to handle patch quantization and a self-loop structure that updates human node encodings using local joint features, improving interaction classification on HOI benchmarks.
2304.08114|v2.assessment: 该工作将ViT与姿态先验结合用于HOI检测，思路清晰，但领域相关性对自动驾驶感知较间接。
2304.08114|v2.contribution: 提出基于ViT的姿态条件自环图HOI检测框架ViPLO。
2304.08114|v2.innovation: MOA模块解决ViT patch量化问题，姿态自环图引导分类器关注人体关节。
2304.08114|v2.result: 在HOI检测基准上超越基于旧骨干的两阶段方法。

2301.10222|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于距离投影的LiDAR点云3D语义分割方法长期依赖2D CNN、未充分利用ViT进展的问题，本文提出RangeViT，探索ViT在距离图像上的3D语义分割能力。方法保留与RGB图像相同的ViT骨干以利用大规模图像预训练知识，并通过定制卷积补偿ViT缺乏的归纳偏置，同时结合点云其他表示。相比基于CNN的投影方法，RangeViT在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes等基准上取得领先或可比的mIoU，验证了ViT在自动驾驶3D感知中的潜力。
2301.10222|v2.summary_en: This paper investigates whether projection-based 3D semantic segmentation of LiDAR point clouds can benefit from ViTs. RangeViT preserves the RGB ViT backbone to exploit large-scale image pre-training, compensates for ViTs' lack of inductive bias with tailored convolutions, and combines multiple point cloud representations, achieving state-of-the-art or competitive mIoU on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes.
2301.10222|v2.assessment: 该工作将ViT成功迁移到自动驾驶LiDAR语义分割，实验扎实、基准权威，对BEV/3D感知方向研究者高度相关且值得关注。
2301.10222|v2.contribution: 提出面向LiDAR距离图像的ViT分割框架RangeViT。
2301.10222|v2.innovation: 复用RGB预训练ViT骨干并用定制卷积补偿归纳偏置。
2301.10222|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上取得领先或可比的3D语义分割性能。

2304.04237|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT自注意力要么采用稀疏全局注意力、要么采用窗口注意力，导致局部特征学习受损或依赖手工设计，而现有局部注意力模块使用低效Im2Col或难以泛化的CUDA核的问题，本文提出Slide Attention，用通用卷积操作实现高效、灵活、可泛化的局部注意力。方法从行视角重新解释基于列的Im2Col函数，用深度卷积高效替代，并提出变形移位模块。相比依赖专用CUDA核的局部注意力，该方法在无CUDA设备上也能高效运行，在分类与下游任务上取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡。
2304.04237|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the inefficiency and poor generalizability of existing local attention modules, which rely on Im2Col or device-specific CUDA kernels. Slide-Transformer proposes Slide Attention, reinterpreting column-based Im2Col from a row perspective and substituting it with depthwise convolution, plus a deformed shifting module, achieving efficient, flexible, and generalizable local attention with competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs.
2304.04237|v2.assessment: 该工作以卷积算子重构局部注意力，兼顾效率与硬件通用性，对高效ViT及下游密集预测任务有实用价值。
2304.04237|v2.contribution: 提出基于深度卷积实现的Slide Attention局部注意力模块。
2304.04237|v2.innovation: 从行视角重解释Im2Col并用深度卷积替代，摆脱专用CUDA核依赖。
2304.04237|v2.result: 在分类与下游任务上取得有竞争力的精度-效率权衡，且硬件通用性强。

SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_cn: 针对语义分割中像素级标注昂贵、纯卷积或纯Transformer半监督方法各有局限的问题，本文提出SemiCVT，将卷积与Vision Transformer结合用于半监督语义分割。方法通过卷积捕获局部细节、Transformer建模长程依赖，并在半监督框架下联合利用少量标注与大量无标注数据。相比已有单架构半监督方法，其在标注稀缺场景下取得更优的分割精度。摘要未给出具体数值，但作者报告在标准分割基准上优于现有半监督方法。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.summary_en: This paper addresses semi-supervised semantic segmentation where pixel-level annotations are scarce, proposing SemiCVT, a hybrid convolutional vision transformer architecture. It combines convolution for local detail with transformer attention for long-range context, and leverages both labeled and unlabeled data in a semi-supervised pipeline. Experiments show improved segmentation accuracy over prior semi-supervised methods, particularly under limited annotation budgets.
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.assessment: 将CNN与ViT混合用于半监督分割的思路合理，对标注受限的感知任务有一定参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际增益与效率。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.contribution: 提出卷积-Transformer混合的半监督语义分割框架SemiCVT。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.innovation: 在半监督分割中融合卷积的局部建模与ViT的全局注意力。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V.result: 在标准分割基准上优于现有半监督方法，标注稀缺时增益更明显。
SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional V._arxiv_id: SemiCVT: Semi-Supervised Convolutional Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation.

2307.03407|v2.summary_cn: 针对弱监督小样本分类与分割中缺乏像素级标注的问题，本文利用自监督预训练的ViT，取其token表示并通过自注意力相关性分别经任务头输出分类与分割结果。方法用自监督ViT生成的注意力图作为像素级伪标签，无需训练时像素标注；在混合监督设置下，进一步用少量真值像素标签训练伪标签增强器提升伪标签质量。在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i上，多种监督设置下均取得显著性能提升，尤其当像素级标签极少或没有时。
2307.03407|v2.summary_en: This work tackles weakly-supervised few-shot classification and segmentation by exploiting a self-supervised ViT, using token correlations via self-attention to drive separate task heads. Attention maps from the ViT serve as pixel-level pseudo-labels, and a pseudo-label enhancer trained on scarce ground-truth pixels improves them in mixed-supervision settings. Experiments on Pascal-5i and COCO-20i show substantial gains across supervision regimes, especially with little-to-no pixel-level labels.
2307.03407|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT的注意力先验用于弱监督小样本分割，思路新颖且实验扎实，对开放集/少样本感知有借鉴意义。
2307.03407|v2.contribution: 提出利用自监督ViT注意力图作为伪标签的弱监督小样本分类与分割方法。
2307.03407|v2.innovation: 用自监督ViT token相关性与注意力图替代像素级标注，并引入伪标签增强器。
2307.03407|v2.result: 在Pascal-5i和COCO-20i多种监督设置下显著超越已有方法。

DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer中注意力机制易过拟合、训练正则化不足的问题，本文提出DropKey，将注意力权重中的key进行随机丢弃作为结构化正则。方法在softmax前对key施加dropout式掩码，等价于对注意力图进行随机遮挡，从而提升模型泛化能力。相比标准dropout与DropPath，DropKey在分类等任务上带来稳定提升。摘要未提供具体数值，但作者报告在多个ViT骨干上取得一致改进。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses overfitting in Vision Transformer attention by proposing DropKey, a structured regularization that randomly drops keys in the attention weights before softmax. This acts as stochastic masking of attention maps, improving generalization over standard dropout and DropPath. Consistent gains are reported across ViT backbones on classification and related tasks.
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.assessment: DropKey是一种简单通用的注意力正则化技巧，易于集成到现有ViT中，对视觉骨干训练有实用价值。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.contribution: 提出对注意力key进行随机丢弃的正则化方法DropKey。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.innovation: 将dropout思想作用于注意力key，形成结构化注意力遮挡正则。
DropKey for Vision Transformer.|v2.result: 在多个ViT骨干与任务上取得一致的性能提升。

2212.07983|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有音视频方法依赖昂贵音频预训练或外部音频编码器、且需微调视觉骨干的问题，本文研究冻结的纯视觉预训练ViT能否泛化到音视频任务。提出LAVISH适配器，在冻结ViT每层注入少量可训练参数，并用一小组latent token构成注意力瓶颈来高效融合视觉与音频，避免标准交叉注意力的二次开销。在多种音视频任务上达到与模态专用方法相当甚至更好的性能，同时可调参数更少，且无需音频预训练或外部音频编码器。
2212.07983|v2.summary_en: This work studies whether frozen visually-pretrained ViTs can generalize to audio-visual tasks without finetuning original parameters, proposing the LAVISH adapter that injects few trainable parameters per layer. A small set of latent tokens forms an attention bottleneck for efficient audio-visual fusion, avoiding quadratic cross-attention cost. LAVISH matches or surpasses modality-specific methods on several audio-visual tasks with fewer tunable parameters and no audio pretraining or external audio encoders.
2212.07983|v2.assessment: 参数高效适配冻结ViT到多模态的思路对多传感器/多模态感知有启发，注意力瓶颈设计兼顾效率与性能。
2212.07983|v2.contribution: 提出参数高效的音视频适配器LAVISH，将冻结ViT迁移到音视频任务。
2212.07983|v2.innovation: 用latent token注意力瓶颈实现高效音视频融合，无需音频预训练。
2212.07983|v2.result: 在多种音视频任务上以更少可调参数达到或超越模态专用方法。

2305.07027|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有ViT推理速度受内存低效操作（如MHSA中的张量重排与逐元素函数）限制、难以实时应用的问题，本文提出高效ViT系列EfficientViT。方法设计三明治结构模块，在高效FFN之间放置单个内存受限的MHSA以提升内存效率并增强通道通信；同时发现注意力图在多头间高度相似造成冗余，提出级联组注意力，将完整特征的不同分片喂给不同注意力头，既省算力又提升注意力多样性。实验表明EfficientViT在速度与精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，如EfficientViT-M5在相近精度下取得更高吞吐。
2305.07027|v2.summary_en: This paper targets the memory-bound operations (e.g., tensor reshaping and element-wise functions in MHSA) that limit ViT inference speed, proposing the EfficientViT family. It introduces a sandwich-layout block with a single memory-bound MHSA between efficient FFN layers, and a cascaded group attention that feeds different feature splits to different heads to reduce redundancy and increase attention diversity. Experiments show EfficientViT achieves a better speed-accuracy trade-off than existing efficient models, e.g., EfficientViT-M5 delivering higher throughput at comparable accuracy.
2305.07027|v2.assessment: 从内存效率角度优化ViT推理，级联组注意力设计实用，对自动驾驶实时感知骨干选型有直接参考价值。
2305.07027|v2.contribution: 提出内存高效、带级联组注意力的高速ViT系列EfficientViT。
2305.07027|v2.innovation: 三明治布局减少内存受限MHSA，级联组注意力降低多头冗余并提升多样性。
2305.07027|v2.result: 在速度-精度权衡上优于现有高效模型，EfficientViT-M5实现更高吞吐。

HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_cn: 针对标准Vision Transformer在欧几里得平面上建模、难以有效处理球面信号（如全景/鱼眼图像）的问题，本文提出HEAL-Swin，将Swin Transformer的层次化窗口注意力机制推广到球面（HEALPix像素化）上。方法通过球面窗口划分与移位机制，使注意力在球面几何上保持等距性与无畸变。相比直接在平面投影上运行的ViT，该方法在球面信号任务上减少了投影畸变带来的性能损失。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of standard Vision Transformers in modeling spherical signals, which arise in panoramic and fisheye imagery. It proposes HEAL-Swin, a hierarchical Swin-style transformer operating on the sphere via HEALPix pixelization with spherical window partitioning and shifting. Compared with planar-projection ViTs, it avoids projection distortion and better respects spherical geometry, though the abstract reports no quantitative numbers.
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.assessment: 将层次化窗口注意力推广到球面几何是一个有价值的方向，对全景/鱼眼感知有潜在意义，但摘要信息有限，需看实验细节。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.contribution: 提出了在球面（HEALPix）上运行的层次化Swin式Vision Transformer。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.innovation: 将Swin的窗口划分与移位注意力机制适配到球面几何，保持等距性。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，仅声称在球面信号任务上优于平面投影方法。
HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the S._arxiv_id: HEAL-SWIN: A Vision Transformer on the Sphere.

H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_cn: 针对医学图像可变形配准中卷积网络感受野受限、难以捕捉长程对应关系的问题，本文提出H-ViT，一种层次化Vision Transformer用于可变形图像配准。方法通过层次化结构在多个尺度上建模形变场，兼顾全局上下文与局部细节。相比纯卷积配准网络，H-ViT能更好地捕捉大位移形变。摘要未给出具体量化结果。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.summary_en: This paper targets deformable image registration, where convolutional networks struggle with long-range correspondences due to limited receptive fields. It proposes H-ViT, a hierarchical Vision Transformer that estimates deformation fields across multiple scales, combining global context with local detail. Compared with purely convolutional registration networks, it better handles large displacements, though no quantitative results are reported in the abstract.
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.assessment: 将层次化ViT用于可变形配准思路合理，但领域偏医学影像，与自动驾驶感知相关度有限。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.contribution: 提出了用于可变形图像配准的层次化Vision Transformer（H-ViT）。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.innovation: 以多尺度层次化Transformer建模形变场，兼顾全局与局部对应。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标。
H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer._arxiv_id: H-ViT: A Hierarchical Vision Transformer for Deformable Image Registration.

DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_cn: 针对Vision Transformer在长尾数据集上训练时尾部类别性能差的问题，本文提出DeiT-LT，重新审视知识蒸馏在长尾ViT训练中的作用。方法通过从卷积网络教师（在长尾数据上训练）蒸馏，并设计针对性的蒸馏策略（如区分头部与尾部类别的蒸馏信号），缓解ViT对数据量的依赖与长尾偏置。相比直接在长尾数据上训练ViT，DeiT-LT显著提升了尾部类别精度。摘要未给出具体数值。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.summary_en: This paper addresses the poor tail-class performance of Vision Transformers trained on long-tailed datasets. It proposes DeiT-LT, which revisits knowledge distillation by distilling from a convolutional teacher trained on long-tailed data with tailored distillation strategies for head and tail classes. Compared with directly training ViTs on long-tailed data, it substantially improves tail-class accuracy, though the abstract omits specific numbers.
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.assessment: 将知识蒸馏与长尾ViT训练结合，思路清晰且实用，对数据不均衡场景下的Transformer训练有参考价值。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.contribution: 提出DeiT-LT，通过知识蒸馏改善长尾数据集上的ViT训练。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.innovation: 针对长尾分布设计区分头尾类别的蒸馏策略，缓解ViT的数据依赖与长尾偏置。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，声称显著提升尾部类别精度。
DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for V._arxiv_id: DeiT-LT: Distillation Strikes Back for Vision Transformer Training on Long-Tailed Datasets.

ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_cn: 针对ViT在密集预测任务（检测、分割）中缺乏多尺度特征与局部交互能力的问题，本文提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度特征交互与ViT结合。方法通过卷积多尺度特征金字塔与双向特征交互模块，增强ViT对多尺度目标的建模能力，同时保持ViT的全局注意力优势。相比纯ViT或纯卷积骨干，ViT-CoMer在密集预测任务上取得更优性能。摘要未给出具体数值。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of multi-scale features and local interaction in ViTs for dense prediction tasks such as detection and segmentation. It proposes ViT-CoMer, which integrates convolutional multi-scale feature interaction with a ViT backbone via a multi-scale feature pyramid and bidirectional interaction module. Compared with pure ViT or convolutional backbones, it achieves better dense-prediction performance, though no specific numbers are given in the abstract.
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.assessment: 面向密集预测的ViT-卷积混合骨干，与检测/分割感知任务高度相关，工程实用性强。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.contribution: 提出ViT-CoMer，将卷积多尺度特征交互融入ViT以提升密集预测性能。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.innovation: 通过卷积多尺度特征金字塔与双向交互模块增强ViT的多尺度与局部建模能力。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，声称在密集预测任务上优于纯ViT与卷积骨干。
ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convo._arxiv_id: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions.

CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_cn: 针对ViT后训练量化（PTQ）在无数据场景下校准困难、量化误差大的问题，本文提出CLAMP-ViT，一种无数据对比学习驱动的自适应后训练量化方法。方法通过对比学习合成具有判别性的校准样本，并自适应地为不同层分配量化位宽，从而在无原始数据条件下完成ViT量化。相比现有无数据量化方法，CLAMP-ViT在保持精度的同时实现更高压缩率。摘要未给出具体数值。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.summary_en: This paper tackles the difficulty of calibrating post-training quantization (PTQ) for ViTs in data-free settings. It proposes CLAMP-ViT, a contrastive data-free learning approach for adaptive PTQ that synthesizes discriminative calibration samples via contrastive learning and adaptively allocates bit-widths across layers. Compared with existing data-free quantization methods, it achieves higher compression while preserving accuracy, though the abstract provides no specific numbers.
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.assessment: 无数据ViT量化对隐私敏感或数据受限部署有实际价值，对比学习合成校准样本的思路有新意。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.contribution: 提出CLAMP-ViT，实现无数据条件下的ViT自适应后训练量化。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.innovation: 用对比学习合成判别性校准样本并自适应分配逐层量化位宽。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin.result: 摘要未给出具体量化指标，声称在保持精度的同时实现更高压缩率。
CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learnin._arxiv_id: CLAMP-ViT: Contrastive Data-Free Learning for Adaptive Post-training Quantization of ViTs.

2403.01412|v2.summary_cn: 针对高光谱等信号采集带宽受限、数据量庞大阻碍实时检测的问题，本文提出LUM-ViT，一种带可学习欠采样掩码的Vision Transformer，用于采集前调制以降低采集数据量。方法核心是可学习欠采样掩码，配合核级权值二值化与三阶段微调策略以适配光学计算。实验表明仅采样原图10%像素时，ImageNet分类精度损失控制在1.8%以内，并在真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。
2403.01412|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses bandwidth-limited signal acquisition, where large data volumes (e.g., hyperspectral) hinder real-time detection. It proposes LUM-ViT, a Vision Transformer with a learnable under-sampling mask for pre-acquisition modulation, combined with kernel-level weight binarization and a three-stage fine-tuning strategy for optical computation. Sampling only 10% of image pixels keeps ImageNet accuracy loss within 1.8%, and near-original accuracy is maintained on real optical hardware.
2403.01412|v2.assessment: 将可学习欠采样掩码与ViT结合用于采集前调制，思路新颖且有真实硬件验证，对带宽受限感知场景有启发。
2403.01412|v2.contribution: 提出LUM-ViT，通过可学习欠采样掩码在采集前降低数据量。
2403.01412|v2.innovation: 可学习欠采样掩码配合核级权值二值化与三阶段微调，适配光学计算。
2403.01412|v2.result: 仅采样10%像素时ImageNet精度损失≤1.8%，真实光学硬件上保持接近原始精度。

Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有多模态大模型在视觉编码阶段缺乏问题感知能力、视觉特征与文本问题交互不足的问题，提出了一种问题感知的视觉Transformer（Question Aware Vision Transformer），让视觉编码过程直接以文本问题为条件进行特征提取。方法上通过在ViT中引入问题引导的注意力或调制机制，使视觉token在编码时即与问题语义对齐，而非仅在后续融合阶段交互。相比先独立编码图像再与文本拼接的常规VLM流程，该方法提升了视觉表征对下游问答任务的相关性。摘要未提供具体数据集与数值结果，需查阅正文确认其相对基线的提升幅度。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of question-awareness in the visual encoding stage of multimodal large models, where visual features are extracted independently of the textual query. It proposes a Question Aware Vision Transformer that conditions visual token encoding on the input question, enabling question-guided feature extraction rather than late fusion only. Compared with conventional pipelines that encode images independently and fuse text afterwards, this design yields more task-relevant visual representations. No quantitative results are available in the abstract.
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.assessment: 将问题条件注入视觉编码器的思路对VLM与多模态感知有参考价值，但需正文验证其实际增益与计算开销。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.contribution: 提出以文本问题为条件的问题感知视觉Transformer编码框架。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.innovation: 把问题语义提前注入视觉编码阶段而非仅在融合阶段交互。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集与量化指标，效果需以正文实验为准。
Question Aware Vision Transformer for Mu._arxiv_id: Question Aware Vision Transformer for Multimodal Reasoning.

Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_cn: 该论文针对零样本学习（ZSL）中视觉特征与语义属性对齐不充分、类间语义混淆的问题，提出了渐进式语义引导的视觉Transformer（Progressive Semantic-Guided ViT）。方法通过多阶段渐进地引入类语义信息来引导ViT的注意力与特征学习，使视觉表征逐步向语义空间靠拢，从而增强对未见类的泛化。相比传统基于CNN或单阶段语义嵌入的ZSL方法，该框架利用ViT的全局建模能力并分阶段注入语义监督。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，需正文确认其在CUB、AWA等标准ZSL基准上的提升。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.summary_en: This paper targets insufficient visual-semantic alignment and inter-class ambiguity in zero-shot learning. It proposes a Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer that injects class semantics into ViT attention and feature learning in multiple progressive stages, gradually aligning visual representations with the semantic space. Compared with CNN-based or single-stage semantic embedding ZSL methods, it exploits ViT's global modeling with staged semantic supervision. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.assessment: 将ViT与渐进语义引导结合用于ZSL是合理方向，但ZSL与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.contribution: 提出渐进式语义引导的ViT零样本学习框架。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.innovation: 分阶段将类语义注入ViT特征学习以强化视觉-语义对齐。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans.result: 摘要未提供具体基准与数值结果。
Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Trans._arxiv_id: Progressive Semantic-Guided Vision Transformer for Zero-Shot Learning.

Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在下游任务微调时全参数微调代价高、现有低秩适配方法（如LoRA）秩分配与缩放策略次优的问题，提出了一种基于残差设计视角的低秩重缩放微调方法。作者从残差连接的角度分析低秩更新的作用，推导出重缩放因子与秩之间的设计准则，从而在固定或自适应秩下提升微调效率与精度。相比LoRA等固定缩放的低秩方法，该方法在参数效率与下游精度之间取得更好平衡。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，需正文验证其在分类/检测等下游任务上的表现。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of full fine-tuning ViT and the suboptimal rank allocation and scaling in existing low-rank adaptation methods such as LoRA. From a residual design perspective, it analyzes low-rank updates and derives design principles relating rescaling factors to rank, improving fine-tuning efficiency and accuracy. Compared with fixed-scaling low-rank baselines, it achieves a better parameter-accuracy trade-off. Quantitative results are not given in the abstract.
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.assessment: 低秩微调是当前大模型适配的热点，残差视角的分析对参数高效迁移有实用价值。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.contribution: 提出基于残差设计视角的低秩重缩放ViT微调方法。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.innovation: 从残差连接角度推导低秩更新的重缩放与秩设计准则。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与量化结果。
Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fin._arxiv_id: Low-Rank Rescaled Vision Transformer Fine-Tuning: A Residual Design Approach.

Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT在对抗攻击下鲁棒性不足的问题，提出随机纠缠token（Random Entangled Tokens）机制以增强ViT的对抗鲁棒性。方法通过在token层面引入随机纠缠/混合操作，破坏对抗扰动在token间的可迁移结构，从而提升模型对对抗样本的防御能力。相比传统对抗训练或输入变换防御，该方法在保持干净精度方面可能更具优势。摘要未给出具体攻击设置与数值，需正文确认其在ImageNet等基准上的鲁棒精度与干净精度权衡。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited adversarial robustness of Vision Transformers. It proposes Random Entangled Tokens, a mechanism that randomly entangles or mixes tokens to disrupt the transferable structure of adversarial perturbations across tokens. Compared with adversarial training or input-transformation defenses, it may better preserve clean accuracy. Quantitative robustness results are not provided in the abstract.
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.assessment: token级随机化防御思路新颖，但对抗鲁棒性与自动驾驶感知安全的结合仍需验证。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.contribution: 提出随机纠缠token机制以提升ViT对抗鲁棒性。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.innovation: 在token层面引入随机纠缠破坏对抗扰动的可迁移结构。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall.result: 摘要未给出具体攻击设置与鲁棒性数值。
Random Entangled Tokens for Adversariall._arxiv_id: Random Entangled Tokens for Adversarially Robust Vision Transformer.

SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）在视觉任务中难以兼顾ResNet式残差结构与Transformer全局建模能力的问题，提出了SpikingResformer，将ResNet与ViT的设计融合进SNN框架。方法上设计了脉冲化的残差结构与多头自注意力模块，在保持事件驱动低功耗特性的同时提升表征能力。相比纯SNN卷积网络或纯脉冲Transformer，该结构在精度-能耗权衡上更优。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，需正文确认其在ImageNet等分类基准上的精度与能耗表现。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.summary_en: This paper addresses the difficulty of combining ResNet-style residual structures with Transformer global modeling in spiking neural networks. It proposes SpikingResformer, integrating residual and multi-head self-attention designs into an SNN while preserving event-driven low-power computation. Compared with pure spiking CNNs or spiking Transformers, it achieves a better accuracy-energy trade-off. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.assessment: SNN与ViT结合对低功耗视觉感知（含车载/边缘部署）有潜在价值，架构设计值得关注。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.contribution: 提出融合ResNet与ViT思想的脉冲神经网络架构SpikingResformer。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.innovation: 在SNN中同时引入脉冲残差结构与多头自注意力。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集与精度/能耗数值。
SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vi._arxiv_id: SpikingResformer: Bridging ResNet and Vision Transformer in Spiking Neural Networks.

Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_cn: 该论文针对ViT事后解释方法（如注意力图、梯度类方法）忠实性不足、解释与模型真实决策不一致的问题，提出以token变换（Token Transformation）为核心的事后解释方法。作者指出token在ViT各层间的变换过程对解释忠实性至关重要，并据此设计解释机制以更准确反映模型决策依据。相比仅依赖注意力权重或梯度的解释方法，该方法在忠实性指标上应更优。摘要未给出具体数据集与数值，需正文确认其在忠实性评测上的提升。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited faithfulness of post-hoc explanations for Vision Transformers, such as attention maps and gradient-based methods. It proposes a token-transformation-centric post-hoc explanation that highlights how token transformations across layers determine model decisions, yielding more faithful explanations. Compared with attention- or gradient-only methods, it should improve faithfulness metrics. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract.
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.assessment: 可解释性对自动驾驶感知的验证与安全认证有实际意义，token变换视角具有一定新意。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.contribution: 提出以token变换为核心的可忠实反映ViT决策的事后解释方法。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.innovation: 将解释依据从注意力/梯度转向层间token变换过程。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa.result: 摘要未提供具体忠实性评测数值。
Token Transformation Matters: Towards Fa._arxiv_id: Token Transformation Matters: Towards Faithful Post-Hoc Explanation for Vision Transformer.

On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer（ViT）解释方法的忠实度（faithfulness）问题展开研究，即现有解释方法生成的显著性图是否真实反映模型决策依据。作者系统评估了多种ViT解释方法，并提出新的忠实度度量与改进方案。相比已有工作，本文更严格地定义了忠实度标准并揭示了现有方法的不足。实验表明所提方法在多个基准上提升了忠实度指标，为ViT可解释性研究提供了更可靠的评估框架。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.summary_en: This paper investigates the faithfulness of Vision Transformer explanations, questioning whether saliency maps truly reflect model decisions. The authors systematically evaluate existing ViT explanation methods and propose new faithfulness metrics and improvements. Experiments show enhanced faithfulness across benchmarks, providing a more reliable evaluation framework for ViT interpretability.
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.assessment: 为ViT可解释性提供了更严格的忠实度评估视角，对理解模型决策有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知的直接关联有限。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.contribution: 提出了针对ViT解释方法的忠实度评估框架与改进方案。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.innovation: 重新定义并量化了ViT解释的忠实度标准，揭示了现有方法的系统性缺陷。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme.result: 在多个基准上提升了ViT解释方法的忠实度指标。
On the Faithfulness of Vision Transforme._arxiv_id: On the Faithfulness of Vision Transformer Explanations.

SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer计算量大、内存占用高的问题，提出了SHViT（Single-Head Vision Transformer），采用单头注意力机制与内存高效的宏观设计。相比多头注意力和复杂宏观架构，SHViT在保持精度的同时显著降低了计算与内存开销。实验表明其在ImageNet等基准上以更低的FLOPs和内存占用达到竞争性精度，适合部署于资源受限场景。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational and memory costs of Vision Transformers by proposing SHViT, a single-head ViT with a memory-efficient macro design. Compared to multi-head attention and complex architectures, SHViT achieves competitive accuracy with significantly reduced FLOPs and memory. Experiments on ImageNet demonstrate its efficiency for resource-constrained deployment.
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.assessment: 单头注意力与内存高效设计的结合对边缘部署有实际意义，对自动驾驶中高效骨干网络设计有借鉴价值。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.contribution: 提出了单头注意力与内存高效宏观设计相结合的SHViT架构。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.innovation: 通过单头注意力机制和宏观设计优化，大幅降低ViT的计算与内存开销。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi.result: 在ImageNet上以更低FLOPs和内存占用达到竞争性精度。
SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer wi._arxiv_id: SHViT: Single-Head Vision Transformer with Memory Efficient Macro Design.

2402.03094|v2.summary_cn: 该论文研究跨域少样本目标检测（CD-FSOD），旨在用极少标注样本在新域上训练准确检测器。作者通过风格、类间方差（ICV）和模糊边界（IB）度量域差距，建立了CD-FSOD基准，发现现有开放集检测器（如DE-ViT）跨域泛化能力不足。为此提出可学习实例特征对齐和实例重加权模块，显著提升了跨域少样本检测性能。
2402.03094|v2.summary_en: This paper studies cross-domain few-shot object detection (CD-FSOD), aiming to train accurate detectors with minimal labeled examples in novel domains. The authors establish a CD-FSOD benchmark using style, inter-class variance (ICV), and indefinable boundaries (IB) to measure domain gaps, revealing poor generalization of open-set detectors like DE-ViT. They propose learnable instance feature alignment and instance reweighting modules, significantly improving cross-domain few-shot detection.
2402.03094|v2.assessment: 建立了CD-FSOD基准并揭示开放集检测器跨域泛化瓶颈，对自动驾驶中少样本跨域检测有重要参考价值。
2402.03094|v2.contribution: 建立了CD-FSOD基准并提出可学习实例特征对齐与实例重加权模块。
2402.03094|v2.innovation: 用风格、ICV和IB量化域差距，并针对性设计模块解决跨域少样本检测问题。
2402.03094|v2.result: 显著提升了开放集检测器在跨域少样本场景下的检测性能。

2403.13298|v2.summary_cn: 该论文系统分析了旋转位置编码（RoPE）在Vision Transformer中的应用，针对ViT在图像分辨率变化时的外推能力不足问题。作者将RoPE适配到2D视觉数据，发现其能保持推理时分辨率增加下的精度，并在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上带来性能提升。相比传统位置编码，RoPE以极小额外计算开销提升了骨干网络性能。
2403.13298|v2.summary_en: This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) for Vision Transformers, addressing ViT's limited extrapolation when image resolution changes. The authors adapt RoPE to 2D vision data and show it maintains precision under increased inference resolution, improving performance on ImageNet-1k, COCO detection, and ADE-20k segmentation with minimal extra computation.
2403.13298|v2.assessment: 为ViT位置编码提供了实用指南，RoPE在检测和分割上的提升对自动驾驶感知骨干网络有直接价值。
2403.13298|v2.contribution: 系统分析了RoPE在ViT中的应用并验证其在检测与分割任务上的有效性。
2403.13298|v2.innovation: 将RoPE适配到2D视觉数据，实现分辨率外推下的精度保持。
2403.13298|v2.result: 在ImageNet-1k、COCO检测和ADE-20k分割上均取得性能提升。

2402.03317|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer易受对抗攻击的问题，提出了SpecFormer，通过最大奇异值惩罚（MSVP）增强鲁棒性。作者建立了自注意力层的局部Lipschitz界，并据此精确控制这些界。相比现有经验性训练调整方法，SpecFormer具有理论支撑且不牺牲训练效率。在CIFAR和ImageNet上的实验表明其防御性能优于现有最先进方法。
2402.03317|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the vulnerability of Vision Transformers to adversarial attacks by proposing SpecFormer, which uses Maximum Singular Value Penalization (MSVP) for robustness. The authors establish local Lipschitz bounds for self-attention layers and precisely control them. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet show SpecFormer outperforms state-of-the-art defenses without compromising training efficiency.
2402.03317|v2.assessment: 为ViT对抗鲁棒性提供了理论支撑，对自动驾驶安全感知有潜在价值，但实验限于分类任务。
2402.03317|v2.contribution: 提出了基于最大奇异值惩罚的SpecFormer以增强ViT对抗鲁棒性。
2402.03317|v2.innovation: 建立自注意力层局部Lipschitz界并据此设计MSVP进行精确控制。
2402.03317|v2.result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet上防御性能优于现有最先进方法。

Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer推理成本调整需重新调优的问题，提出了Token Compensator，可在不重新训练的情况下改变ViT的推理成本。作者通过token补偿机制在推理时动态调整计算量，适应不同资源约束。相比需要微调的方法，Token Compensator无需重新调优即可灵活调整推理开销，在保持精度的同时实现计算资源的按需分配。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.summary_en: This paper addresses the need for re-tuning when altering Vision Transformer inference cost by proposing Token Compensator, which changes ViT inference cost without re-tuning. The authors introduce a token compensation mechanism to dynamically adjust computation at inference time. Compared to fine-tuning-based methods, it flexibly adjusts inference overhead while maintaining accuracy.
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.assessment: 无需重调的推理成本调整对实际部署有实用价值，对自动驾驶中动态资源分配有参考意义。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.contribution: 提出了无需重新调优即可改变ViT推理成本的Token Compensator。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.innovation: 通过token补偿机制在推理时动态调整计算量，避免重新训练。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co.result: 在保持精度的同时实现推理成本的灵活调整。
Token Compensator: Altering Inference Co._arxiv_id: Token Compensator: Altering Inference Cost of Vision Transformer Without Re-tuning.

2403.19638|v2.summary_cn: ①传统音视频方法依赖独立的音频和视觉骨干网络，参数开销大且难以扩展。②本文提出AVSiam，用单个共享ViT骨干同时处理音频和视觉输入，并采用对比音视频匹配目标与多比例随机掩码策略进行预训练。③相比已有音视频方法，AVSiam参数效率更高、GPU显存占用更低，且能用同一骨干鲁棒处理音频、视觉及音视频三种输入。④在AudioSet和VGGSound的音视频分类与检索任务上取得与先前方法相当甚至更好的结果。
2403.19638|v2.summary_en: Traditional audio-visual methods rely on independent audio and visual backbones, which is costly and not scalable. This work proposes AVSiam, an audio-visual siamese network that uses a single shared ViT backbone with a contrastive audio-visual matching objective and multi-ratio random masking. It achieves competitive or better results than prior methods on AudioSet and VGGSound for audio-visual classification and retrieval while improving parameter efficiency.
2403.19638|v2.assessment: 该工作展示了共享ViT骨干在音视频预训练中的可扩展性，对多模态Transformer设计有参考价值，但与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱。
2403.19638|v2.contribution: 提出用单一共享ViT骨干统一处理音频与视觉输入的可扩展音视频预训练框架AVSiam。
2403.19638|v2.innovation: 通过共享骨干与多比例随机掩码实现参数高效且可处理三种模态输入的对比音视频预训练。
2403.19638|v2.result: 在AudioSet和VGGSound的分类与检索任务上达到与独立骨干方法相当或更优的性能。

Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_cn: ①该论文关注Vision Transformer中的公平性问题，针对模型在不同人口统计群体上可能存在的偏见。②提出通过去偏自注意力机制（Debiased Self-Attention）来构建公平性感知的ViT。③相比已有公平性方法，该方法在注意力层面进行去偏，可能更直接地缓解表征偏见。④由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验数据与效果。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.summary_en: This paper addresses fairness in Vision Transformers by proposing a debiased self-attention mechanism to build a fairness-aware ViT. The approach aims to mitigate demographic biases at the attention level, though the abstract is missing and specific experimental results cannot be verified.
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.assessment: 公平性ViT是一个有价值但相对小众的方向，与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联有限，且摘要缺失难以评估其实际贡献。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.contribution: 提出通过去偏自注意力机制实现公平性感知的Vision Transformer。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.innovation: 在自注意力层面引入去偏机制以缓解ViT的群体偏见。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via De._arxiv_id: Fairness-Aware Vision Transformer via Debiased Self-Attention.

Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_cn: ①该论文针对ViT在密集预测任务中计算开销大的问题，探索无需重训练即可加速的方法。②提出移除ViT中部分token的行和列，以减少计算量同时保持密集预测性能。③相比需要重训练或微调的剪枝方法，该方法无需重训练即可直接应用，部署成本低。④由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体加速比与精度损失数据。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.summary_en: This paper targets the high computational cost of Vision Transformers in dense prediction tasks by removing rows and columns of tokens without retraining. The method aims to accelerate inference while preserving dense prediction performance, offering a low-deployment-cost alternative to retraining-based pruning. Specific speedup and accuracy figures cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.assessment: 无需重训练的token剪枝思路对实际部署有吸引力，若效果可靠则对BEV/分割等密集预测任务有参考价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.contribution: 提出一种无需重训练、通过移除token行列来加速ViT密集预测的方法。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.innovation: 在不需要重训练的前提下对ViT token进行结构化行列移除以实现加速。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体加速比与精度保持情况。
Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in V._arxiv_id: Removing Rows and Columns of Tokens in Vision Transformer Enables Faster Dense Prediction Without Retraining.

FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_cn: ①该论文关注Vision Transformer的公平性问题，针对ViT可能放大训练数据中的偏见。②提出FairViT，通过自适应掩码（Adaptive Masking）机制提升模型公平性。③相比固定掩码或后处理去偏方法，自适应掩码可能更灵活地平衡公平性与准确性。④由于摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验数据与效果。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.summary_en: This paper addresses fairness in Vision Transformers by proposing FairViT, which employs an adaptive masking mechanism to improve model fairness. The approach aims to flexibly balance fairness and accuracy compared to fixed masking or post-hoc debiasing methods. Specific experimental results cannot be verified due to the missing abstract.
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.assessment: 公平性ViT方向与自动驾驶感知核心任务关联较弱，且摘要缺失，难以判断其方法质量与实际贡献。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.contribution: 提出通过自适应掩码机制提升公平性的Vision Transformer框架FairViT。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.innovation: 利用自适应掩码在训练中动态平衡公平性与准确性。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Ada._arxiv_id: FairViT: Fair Vision Transformer via Adaptive Masking.

2504.02508|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在超低比特后训练量化(PTQ)下精度大幅下降的问题，现有基于重建的PTQ方法在ViT上因输出重要性估计不准和post-GELU激活量化困难而失效。本文提出APHQ-ViT，通过改进的平均扰动Hessian(APH)损失进行重要性估计，并设计MLP重建(MR)方法，将MLP中的GELU替换为ReLU并在小型无标签校准集上用APH损失重建。实验表明该方法在极低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，缓解了ViT量化精度损失。
2504.02508|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the significant accuracy degradation of Vision Transformers under ultra-low-bit post-training quantization, where existing reconstruction-based PTQ methods fail due to inaccurate output importance estimation and difficulty in quantizing post-GELU activations. The authors propose APHQ-ViT, which introduces an improved Average Perturbation Hessian (APH) loss for importance estimation and an MLP Reconstruction (MR) method that replaces GELU with ReLU and reconstructs via APH loss on a small unlabeled calibration set. Extensive experiments show that APHQ-ViT with linear quantization substantially outperforms prior PTQ methods at ultra-low bits.
2504.02508|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT量化部署的实际痛点提出针对性改进，方法设计有理论分析支撑，对边缘部署ViT的研究者有参考价值。
2504.02508|v2.contribution: 提出基于平均扰动Hessian的PTQ方法APHQ-ViT，解决了ViT在超低比特量化下的精度下降问题。
2504.02508|v2.innovation: 改进的平均扰动Hessian损失与MLP重建策略，专门应对post-GELU激活量化难题。
2504.02508|v2.result: 在超低比特线性量化下显著优于现有PTQ方法，有效缓解ViT量化精度损失。

ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer集成模型对抗迁移性不足的问题，提出ViT-EnsembleAttack方法以增强集成模型的对抗迁移性。由于摘要缺失，具体方法细节无法确认，但从标题推断其通过增强集成策略提升ViT对抗样本的跨模型迁移能力。该工作对ViT鲁棒性研究有潜在价值，但缺乏摘要信息难以全面评估。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.summary_en: This paper targets the limited adversarial transferability of ensemble models for Vision Transformers and proposes ViT-EnsembleAttack to augment ensemble models for stronger transferability. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology cannot be confirmed, but the title suggests an ensemble augmentation strategy to improve cross-model adversarial transferability for ViTs.
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.assessment: 主题涉及ViT对抗鲁棒性，与感知安全相关，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法质量与实验充分度。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.contribution: 提出ViT-EnsembleAttack以增强ViT集成模型的对抗迁移性。
ViT-EnsembleAttack: Augmenting Ensemble.innovation: 针对ViT集成模型的对抗迁移性增强策略。

EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_cn: 该论文针对Vision Transformer在部署时难以适应不同计算资源的问题，提出EA-Vit高效弹性适配方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法无法确认，但从标题推断其通过弹性架构实现ViT在不同资源约束下的高效适配。该工作对ViT高效部署与NAS相关研究有潜在参考价值。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.summary_en: This paper addresses the challenge of efficiently adapting Vision Transformers to varying computational budgets and proposes EA-Vit for efficient elastic adaptation. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology cannot be confirmed, but the title suggests an elastic architecture enabling efficient ViT adaptation under different resource constraints.
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.assessment: 弹性ViT适配与高效部署相关，对边缘端视觉感知有潜在价值，但摘要缺失限制了评估深度。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.contribution: 提出EA-Vit实现Vision Transformer的高效弹性适配。
EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic.innovation: 面向ViT的弹性高效适配机制。
