EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic._arxiv_id: EA-Vit: Efficient Adaptation for Elastic Vision Transformer.

Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_cn: 该论文针对无人机(UAV)跟踪任务中ViT计算冗余与效率问题，提出相似性引导的层自适应Vision Transformer方法。由于摘要缺失，具体方法无法确认，但从标题推断其利用相似性度量自适应选择ViT层以提升UAV跟踪效率。该工作对UAV视觉跟踪与高效Transformer研究有参考价值。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.summary_en: This paper targets UAV tracking and proposes a Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer to improve efficiency. Due to the missing abstract, the specific methodology cannot be confirmed, but the title suggests using similarity metrics to adaptively select ViT layers for UAV tracking.
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.assessment: UAV跟踪是自动驾驶感知的相关方向，层自适应ViT对高效跟踪有潜在价值，但摘要缺失影响评估。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.contribution: 提出相似性引导的层自适应ViT用于UAV跟踪。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.innovation: 基于相似性的ViT层自适应选择机制。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision.result: 摘要缺失，效果无法确认。
Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision._arxiv_id: Similarity-Guided Layer-Adaptive Vision Transformer for UAV Tracking.

2503.12821|v2.summary_cn: 针对大型视觉语言模型(LVLMs)训练数据存在长尾分布问题，先前工作多聚焦CLIP/ViT架构和识别分类任务，对LLaVA类LVLM及VQA、视觉推理等通用任务探索不足。本文深入分析LVLM长尾问题，识别出头部概念过表征和尾部概念欠表征两个核心原因，提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，包含数据重平衡(DR)和数据合成(DS)两阶段，DR基于实体分布自适应重平衡冗余数据，DS利用去噪扩散概率模型合成数据。该框架有效缓解LVLM长尾问题，提升通用视觉语言任务的平衡表征能力。
2503.12821|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the long-tail problem in Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) training data, where prior work mainly focused on CLIP/ViT architectures and recognition tasks, leaving LVLMs like LLaVA and general tasks such as VQA and visual reasoning under-explored. The authors identify two core causes—overrepresentation of head concepts and underrepresentation of tail concepts—and propose an Adaptive Data Refinement Framework (ADR) with two stages: Data Rebalancing (DR) that adaptively rebalances redundant data based on entity distributions, and Data Synthesis (DS) that leverages denoising diffusion probabilistic models. The framework effectively mitigates the long-tail issue and improves balanced representation for general vision-language tasks.
2503.12821|v2.assessment: 该工作系统分析了LVLM长尾问题并提出两阶段数据精炼框架，对多模态大模型训练数据平衡有重要参考价值。
2503.12821|v2.contribution: 提出自适应数据精炼框架ADR，系统解决LVLM训练数据的长尾分布问题。
2503.12821|v2.innovation: 结合实体分布自适应重平衡与扩散模型数据合成的两阶段框架。
2503.12821|v2.result: 有效缓解LVLM长尾问题，提升VQA与视觉推理等通用任务的平衡表征能力。

2503.02394|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT在边缘设备部署困难及简单套用CNN二值化策略导致性能大幅下降的问题，本文提出BHViT——一种二值化友好的混合ViT架构及其全二值化模型。基于三个重要观察，BHViT利用从粗到细的局部信息交互与层次特征聚合减少冗余token计算，提出基于移位操作的新模块增强二值MLP性能而不显著增加开销，并设计基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法评估token重要性。该工作显著缩小了二值ViT与全精度模型的性能差距，推动ViT在边缘设备上的实时高效部署。
2503.02394|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the deployment challenges of Vision Transformers on edge devices and the significant performance drop when naively applying binary CNN strategies to ViTs. The authors propose BHViT, a binarization-friendly hybrid ViT architecture and its fully binarized model, guided by three key observations: it employs coarse-to-fine local information interaction and hierarchical feature aggregation to reduce redundant token computation, introduces a shift-based module to enhance binary MLP performance without significant overhead, and designs a quantization-decomposition-based attention matrix binarization method to evaluate token importance. The work substantially narrows the performance gap between binary and full-precision ViTs, advancing real-time efficient ViT deployment on edge devices.
2503.02394|v2.assessment: 该工作针对ViT二值化的架构适配问题提出系统性方案，对边缘端视觉感知模型压缩与高效部署有重要参考价值。
2503.02394|v2.contribution: 提出二值化友好的混合ViT架构BHViT及其全二值化模型，解决ViT边缘部署难题。
2503.02394|v2.innovation: 移位操作增强的二值MLP模块与基于量化分解的注意力矩阵二值化方法。
2503.02394|v2.result: 显著缩小二值ViT与全精度模型的性能差距，推动ViT在边缘设备上的实时高效部署。

2412.12032|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对真实人脸图像丰富但标注稀缺的场景，提出自监督预训练框架FSFM，旨在学习可迁移的人脸基础表征以提升多种人脸安全任务的泛化性能。方法上融合掩码图像建模（MIM）与实例判别（ID），提出CRFR-P掩码策略强制模型捕获区域内一致性与区域间连贯性，并通过定制自蒸馏建立局部到全局的对应关系，形成3C学习目标。预训练后以普通ViT作为通用视觉基础模型，在跨数据集deepfake检测、跨域人脸反欺骗及未见扩散伪造检测等下游任务上验证。在10个公开数据集上的大量实验表明其泛化性能优于现有方法。
2412.12032|v2.summary_en: This work proposes FSFM, a self-supervised pretraining framework that learns transferable facial representations from abundant unlabeled real faces by synergizing masked image modeling (MIM) and instance discrimination (ID). It introduces a CRFR-P masking strategy enforcing intra-region consistency and inter-region coherency, and a self-distillation-based ID network establishing local-to-global correspondence. A vanilla ViT pretrained with these 3C objectives serves as a universal foundation model, achieving strong generalization on cross-dataset deepfake detection, cross-domain face anti-spoofing, and unseen diffusion facial forgery detection across 10 public datasets.
2412.12032|v2.assessment: 将自监督基础模型思路引入人脸安全领域，掩码策略与自蒸馏设计有一定新意，但与人脸安全之外的通用视觉研究关联有限。
2412.12032|v2.contribution: 提出首个面向人脸安全任务的自监督预训练基础模型FSFM及3C学习目标。
2412.12032|v2.innovation: CRFR-P掩码策略与MIM-ID耦合的自蒸馏机制，同时编码局部特征与全局语义。
2412.12032|v2.result: 在10个公开数据集的三类人脸安全下游任务上取得优于现有方法的泛化性能。

2508.20063|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对开放词汇多视角室内3D目标检测在无人工标注条件下探索不足的问题，提出OpenM3D——一个无需人工标注训练的单阶段开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器。方法基于ImGeoNet的2D诱导体素特征，联合训练类别无关的3D定位损失（依赖高质量3D伪框）与体素-语义对齐损失（依赖多样化的预训练CLIP特征），并提出基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成方法将2D分割合并为连贯3D结构。相比OV-3DET等方法，其伪框具有更高的精度与召回率，且通过采样与每个连贯3D结构关联的2D分割的多样化CLIP特征来对齐体素特征，从而实现高精度单阶段检测。
2508.20063|v2.summary_en: OpenM3D is proposed as a single-stage open-vocabulary multi-view indoor 3D detector trained without human annotations, adapting 2D-induced voxel features from ImGeoNet. It jointly optimizes a class-agnostic 3D localization loss with high-quality 3D pseudo boxes and a voxel-semantic alignment loss with diverse pretrained CLIP features. A graph-embedding-based 3D pseudo box generation method combines 2D segments into coherent 3D structures, achieving higher precision and recall than OV-3DET and enabling accurate single-stage detection.
2508.20063|v2.assessment: 将开放词汇检测扩展到多视角室内3D场景且完全免除人工标注，伪框生成与CLIP特征对齐设计扎实，对开放集3D感知研究有参考价值。
2508.20063|v2.contribution: 提出无需人工标注训练的开放词汇多视角室内3D检测器OpenM3D。
2508.20063|v2.innovation: 基于图嵌入的3D伪框生成与多样化CLIP体素-语义对齐的联合训练框架。
2508.20063|v2.result: 伪框精度与召回率超过OV-3DET等方法，实现高精度单阶段开放词汇3D检测。

2503.08101|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对基于查询的3D目标检测模型因大图像尺寸与多层Transformer导致计算开销大、难以在边缘设备高效运行的问题，提出零样本运行时剪枝方法tgGBC（trim keys gradually Guided By Classification scores）。方法将分类分数与注意力图相乘得到每个key的重要性分数，并在每层Transformer后按重要性逐步剪枝key，无需重训练且不依赖ViT专用设计。在最新ToC3D模型的Transformer解码器上实现1.99倍加速，性能损失小于1%，部分模型甚至性能提升，并成功在边缘设备上部署3D检测器。
2503.08101|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes tgGBC, a zero-shot runtime key pruning method for transformer decoders in 3D object detection, which multiplies classification scores with attention maps to score key importance and gradually prunes keys after each transformer layer. It achieves a 1.99x speedup on the transformer decoder of ToC3D with less than 1% performance loss, sometimes even improving performance, and enables deployment of 3D detectors on edge devices without retraining.
2503.08101|v2.assessment: 面向3D检测器部署效率的零样本剪枝方案实用性强，无需重训练即可获得近2倍加速，对自动驾驶边缘部署有直接价值。
2503.08101|v2.contribution: 提出面向3D检测Transformer解码器的零样本运行时key剪枝方法tgGBC。
2503.08101|v2.innovation: 以分类分数引导注意力图重要性评估并逐层渐进剪枝key，无需重训练或ViT专用改造。
2503.08101|v2.result: ToC3D解码器加速1.99倍，性能损失小于1%，部分模型性能反升，并可在边缘设备部署。

2508.20265|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP在开放词汇分割中定位能力差、中间注意力改进难以一致传播到最终输出且与文本表示缺乏直接交互的问题，提出一种免训练、反馈驱动的自自适应框架。方法将基于输出的patch级对应关系反馈回中间注意力，利用输出预测作为更强的空间连贯先验，并设计注意力隔离、基于置信度的稀疏自适应剪枝与自适应集成等关键模块。该方法作为即插即用模块可无缝集成到现有流程中，提升内部表示与最终预测之间的语义一致性。
2508.20265|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes a training-free, feedback-driven self-adaptive framework that feeds output-based patch-level correspondences back to intermediate attention in CLIP for open-vocabulary segmentation. It leverages output predictions as a stronger spatial coherence prior and designs attention isolation, confidence-based pruning for sparse adaptation, and adaptation ensemble modules. The plug-in method enhances semantic consistency between internal representations and final predictions.
2508.20265|v2.assessment: 从输出反馈角度改进CLIP空间连贯性的思路较新颖，但属于分割任务且免训练范式，与检测/自动驾驶主线相关度中等。
2508.20265|v2.contribution: 提出将输出级patch对应关系反馈至中间注意力的免训练CLIP开放词汇分割框架。
2508.20265|v2.innovation: 以模型输出作为空间连贯先验反向引导中间注意力，并配以稀疏自适应与集成模块。
2508.20265|v2.result: 作为即插即用模块提升CLIP内部表示与最终预测的语义一致性，改善开放词汇分割效果。

2411.13836|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对CLIP图像级预训练在像素级开放词汇语义分割中空间表示不足的问题，提出分层改进CLIP空间表示的框架CLIPer。方法包含早期层融合模块与细粒度补偿模块：前者利用早期层嵌入与注意力图保留的空间结构信息生成空间连贯性更好的分割图，后者借助扩散模型的自注意力图补偿局部细节。在七个分割数据集上取得最先进性能，验证了分层利用CLIP内部空间信息的有效性。
2411.13836|v2.summary_en: CLIPer is a hierarchical framework that improves CLIP's spatial representation for training-free open-vocabulary semantic segmentation. It comprises an early-layer fusion module that exploits spatial structural information in early-layer embeddings and attention maps, and a fine-grained compensation module that uses diffusion model self-attention maps to recover local details. It achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven segmentation datasets.
2411.13836|v2.assessment: 分层挖掘CLIP早期层空间信息并结合扩散模型补偿细节的设计合理，但任务为分割，与检测/自动驾驶主线相关度一般。
2411.13836|v2.contribution: 提出分层改进CLIP空间表示的免训练开放词汇语义分割框架CLIPer。
2411.13836|v2.innovation: 早期层融合与基于扩散模型自注意力的细粒度补偿相结合的分层空间增强。
2411.13836|v2.result: 在七个分割数据集上取得最先进性能。

2507.19131|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对窗口式视觉Transformer（如Swin）量化推理效率问题，提出混合精度激活量化框架MixA-Q，利用层内激活稀疏性为不重要窗口的激活分配更低比特宽度。方法引入双分支Swin Block分别以高/低比特精度处理激活，可无缝集成到多数QAT与PTQ方法中。在COCO数据集上，PTQ配置下实现免训练1.35倍计算加速且无精度损失；QAT下实现无损1.25倍加速，结合激活剪枝后以1% mAP下降换取1.53倍加速，稀疏感知量化还降低了重要区域的量化误差。
2507.19131|v2.summary_en: MixA-Q is a mixed-precision activation quantization framework that exploits intra-layer activation sparsity in window-based vision transformers, assigning lower bit widths to less important windows. A Two-Branch Swin Block processes activations in high and low precision, integrating with most QAT and PTQ methods. On COCO, it achieves a training-free 1.35x speedup without accuracy loss in PTQ, and 1.25x lossless / 1.53x with 1% mAP drop in QAT.
2507.19131|v2.assessment: 将激活稀疏性与混合精度量化结合用于Swin类ViT，工程实用性强，对检测骨干网络加速有参考意义。
2507.19131|v2.contribution: 提出利用层内激活稀疏性的混合精度激活量化框架MixA-Q。
2507.19131|v2.innovation: 双分支Swin Block按窗口重要性分配高低比特精度，兼容QAT与PTQ流程。
2507.19131|v2.result: COCO上PTQ免训练1.35倍加速无精度损失，QAT无损1.25倍、含剪枝1.53倍加速仅降1% mAP。

2506.21046|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对黑盒对抗攻击迁移性不足的问题，提出利用自监督ViT特征（而非监督学习特征）来生成对抗扰动。方法名为dSVA，是一个生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架，同时利用对比学习（CL）的全局结构特征和掩码图像建模（MIM）的局部纹理特征，并设计生成器训练策略结合联合特征与自监督ViT的注意力机制。相比此前仅依赖监督特征的工作，该方法挖掘了CL与MIM两种范式在ViT中关注不同特征倾向的互补性，从而提升黑盒迁移性。摘要未给出具体数值结果，但声称自监督ViT表示能有效增强对抗迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the limited black-box transferability of adversarial perturbations by exploiting self-supervised Vision Transformer (ViT) representations instead of supervised features. It proposes dSVA, a generative dual self-supervised ViT feature attack that jointly leverages global structural features from contrastive learning (CL) and local textural features from masked image modeling (MIM), with a novel generative training framework incorporating a generator and attention-based feature exploitation. Compared to prior work relying solely on supervised features, it shows that CL and MIM make ViTs attend to distinct feature tendencies, improving black-box transferability.
2506.21046|v2.assessment: 将自监督ViT的双范式特征引入对抗攻击生成，思路新颖，但主题偏对抗安全，与自动驾驶感知主线相关度有限。
2506.21046|v2.contribution: 首次系统探索自监督ViT表示（CL+MIM）用于提升对抗样本黑盒迁移性。
2506.21046|v2.innovation: 提出生成式双自监督ViT特征攻击框架dSVA，融合全局结构特征与局部纹理特征。
2506.21046|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称自监督ViT特征可有效增强对抗迁移性。

Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_cn: 该论文针对预训练Vision Transformer在下游任务适配时全量微调代价高的问题，提出一种近似正交微调策略（Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning）。由于摘要为空，无法确认具体方法细节与实验设置，但从标题可推断其通过约束微调参数更新近似正交来保持预训练知识、减少可训练参数。相比LoRA、Adapter等参数高效微调方法，其改进点可能在于正交性约束带来的知识保持与适配效率平衡。具体效果数据摘要未提供。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.summary_en: This paper targets efficient adaptation of pre-trained Vision Transformers, where full fine-tuning is costly. It proposes an Approximately Orthogonal Fine-Tuning strategy, presumably constraining parameter updates to be approximately orthogonal to preserve pre-trained knowledge while reducing trainable parameters. The abstract is empty, so specific methodological details and quantitative results cannot be verified.
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.assessment: 参数高效微调是ViT落地的关键方向，正交约束思路合理，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其实际贡献与实验充分度。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.contribution: 提出基于近似正交约束的预训练ViT高效微调策略。
Efficient Adaptation of Pre-Trained Visi.innovation: 将近似正交性引入ViT微调以平衡知识保持与适配效率。

2507.12988|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对结构化剪枝后需大量重训练（甚至从头训练）才能恢复精度的问题，提出Variance-Based Pruning——一种简单的一次性结构化剪枝技术。方法先收集激活统计量用于选择待剪神经元，同时将激活均值整合回模型以保持高性能，从而在极少微调下完成压缩。相比需要数百epoch重训练的传统结构化剪枝方法，其改进在于一次性剪枝后即可保留大部分性能。在ImageNet-1k上，DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%的原始性能。
2507.12988|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the costly retraining required by structured pruning to recover accuracy. It introduces Variance-Based Pruning, a simple one-shot structured pruning technique that gathers activation statistics to select neurons while integrating mean activations back into the model to preserve performance with minimal fine-tuning. On ImageNet-1k, DeiT-Base retains over 70% of its original performance directly after pruning, avoiding extensive retraining.
2507.12988|v2.assessment: 一次性结构化剪枝且几乎无需重训练，对部署大模型（含ViT）有实际价值，方法简洁实用。
2507.12988|v2.contribution: 提出基于激活方差的一次性结构化剪枝方法，避免昂贵重训练。
2507.12988|v2.innovation: 将激活均值整合回模型以在剪枝后保持性能，实现极简微调。
2507.12988|v2.result: ImageNet-1k上DeiT-Base剪枝后直接保留超过70%原始性能。

2407.11306|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对Transformer自注意力计算开销大的问题，提出PADRe——一种多项式注意力即插即用替代框架。PADRe利用多项式函数与近似理论，用Hadamard积等硬件友好的乘法非线性操作实现，仅带来线性计算与内存开销，且无需Softmax。其关键洞察是Hyena、Mamba、SimA、Conv2Former、Castling-ViT等近期注意力机制均可视为PADRe的特例，形成统一框架。在图像分类、2D目标检测和3D点云目标检测任务上验证，PADRe运行显著更快且精度相当或更优。
2407.11306|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes PADRe, a unifying polynomial attention drop-in replacement for self-attention in transformers. PADRe leverages polynomial functions and approximation theory, using hardware-friendly multiplicative nonlinearities (Hadamard products) with only linear computational and memory costs, avoiding Softmax. It unifies several recent attention mechanisms (Hyena, Mamba, SimA, Conv2Former, Castling-ViT) as special cases. Experiments on image classification, 2D object detection, and 3D point cloud object detection show significantly faster runtime with comparable or superior accuracy.
2407.11306|v2.assessment: 统一多种高效注意力机制并给出多项式近似理论支撑，覆盖2D/3D检测任务，对视觉Transformer效率研究有较高参考价值。
2407.11306|v2.contribution: 提出统一多项式注意力替代框架PADRe，涵盖多种现有高效注意力机制。
2407.11306|v2.innovation: 用多项式函数与Hadamard积实现线性复杂度注意力，无需Softmax且精度不降。
2407.11306|v2.result: 在分类、2D检测、3D点云检测上运行显著更快，精度相当或更优。

Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_cn: 该论文针对脉冲神经网络（SNN）与视觉 Transformer 结合时，传统自注意力机制在脉冲域中计算开销大、时序建模效率低的问题，提出了带有扫视注意力（Saccadic Attention）的脉冲视觉 Transformer。方法上借鉴生物视觉的扫视机制，用稀疏、事件驱动的注意力采样替代稠密自注意力，从而降低脉冲序列上的计算量。相比已有脉冲 Transformer 工作，其改进点在于注意力机制的稀疏化与生物合理性设计。但所提供的摘要为空，无法确认具体实验设置与量化结果。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost and inefficient temporal modeling of conventional self-attention when integrating spiking neural networks (SNNs) with Vision Transformers. It proposes a Spiking Vision Transformer equipped with a saccadic attention mechanism inspired by biological saccades, replacing dense self-attention with sparse, event-driven attention sampling over spike trains. The claimed improvement lies in the sparsification and biological plausibility of the attention design relative to prior spiking Transformers, though no experimental details or quantitative results are available since the abstract is empty.
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.assessment: 选题处于 SNN 与 ViT 交叉的前沿方向，但摘要缺失导致无法评估方法细节与实验充分度，且与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.contribution: 提出一种受生物扫视机制启发的稀疏脉冲注意力视觉 Transformer 架构。
Spiking Vision Transformer with Saccadic.innovation: 将扫视式稀疏注意力引入脉冲域，以降低脉冲 ViT 的时序计算开销。

2106.04533|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT模型规模大、训练开销高的问题，本文首次系统探索在ViT中端到端地引入稀疏性，同时降低训练内存与推理复杂度。方法上不训练完整ViT，而是动态提取并训练固定小参数预算的稀疏子网络，联合优化模型参数与连接结构，并可从非结构化扩展到结构化稀疏（引导自注意力头的剪枝与生长），还通过可学习token选择器协同探索数据与架构稀疏。在ImageNet上，该方法在保持精度的同时显著降低训练与推理成本，优于传统后训练剪枝。
2106.04533|v2.summary_en: This paper presents the first end-to-end exploration of sparsity in Vision Transformers, dynamically extracting and training sparse subnetworks under a fixed small parameter budget while jointly optimizing weights and connectivity. It extends from unstructured to structured sparsity by guiding prune-and-grow of self-attention heads, and co-explores data and architecture sparsity via a learnable token selector. Extensive ImageNet results show reduced training memory and inference complexity without sacrificing accuracy, outperforming conventional post-training pruning.
2106.04533|v2.assessment: 该工作系统性地将稀疏训练引入ViT，兼顾训练与推理效率，对高效Transformer研究有较强参考价值。
2106.04533|v2.contribution: 首次在ViT中端到端联合探索参数、注意力头与数据稀疏性，实现训练与推理双重加速。
2106.04533|v2.innovation: 提出动态稀疏子网络训练与可学习token选择器，统一非结构化与结构化稀疏。
2106.04533|v2.result: 在ImageNet上以固定小参数预算达到与完整ViT相当甚至更优的精度，同时降低训练内存与推理复杂度。

2111.14725|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT架构设计依赖人工、搜索空间固定等问题，本文提出用神经架构搜索同时搜索架构与搜索空间。核心思想是利用权重共享超网计算E-T Error，逐步演化不同搜索维度，并给出通用ViT设计指南。搜索得到的S3模型在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT和ViT，并在目标检测、语义分割和VQA等下游任务上验证了泛化性。
2111.14725|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes to automate Vision Transformer design by searching both the architecture and the search space, gradually evolving search dimensions guided by E-T Error computed with a weight-sharing supernet. The resulting S3 models outperform Swin, DeiT, and ViT on ImageNet, and generalize to object detection, semantic segmentation, and VQA. Extensive analysis provides design guidelines for general vision transformers.
2111.14725|v2.assessment: 将NAS扩展到搜索空间本身，对ViT架构自动化设计有启发，且下游任务验证充分。
2111.14725|v2.contribution: 提出同时搜索架构与搜索空间的NAS方法，并给出ViT设计指南。
2111.14725|v2.innovation: 利用E-T Error引导搜索空间逐步演化，实现搜索空间的自动发现。
2111.14725|v2.result: S3在ImageNet上超越Swin、DeiT、ViT，并在检测、分割、VQA等任务上表现良好。

2110.15156|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT中patch-wise tokenization引入的锯齿伪影与混叠问题，本文首次分析ViT中的混叠现象，并提出即插即用的抗混叠模块ARM。该轻量模块可嵌入多种ViT家族，在多个任务上持续提升性能，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。
2110.15156|v2.summary_en: This paper analyzes the aliasing problem in Vision Transformers caused by discontinuous patch-wise tokenization, and proposes a plug-and-play Aliasing-Reduction Module (ARM). The lightweight module consistently boosts multiple ViT families across tasks, and improves data efficiency and robustness.
2110.15156|v2.assessment: 从信号处理角度切入ViT的混叠问题，视角新颖，模块通用性强。
2110.15156|v2.contribution: 首次分析ViT中的混叠现象并提出即插即用的ARM模块。
2110.15156|v2.innovation: 将抗混叠思想引入ViT，设计轻量通用模块。
2110.15156|v2.result: 在多种ViT结构和任务上取得稳定提升，并改善数据效率与鲁棒性。

2106.03348|v2.summary_cn: 针对ViT将图像视为1D token序列、缺乏局部结构与尺度不变性等内在归纳偏置的问题，本文提出ViTAE，通过卷积显式引入归纳偏置。具体地，使用多膨胀率卷积的空间金字塔缩减模块将图像下采样并嵌入为多尺度token，获得尺度不变性；每层Transformer中并行一个卷积块与多头自注意力融合，获得局部性。实验表明ViTAE在多个任务上以更少数据与训练周期取得优异性能。
2106.03348|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes ViTAE, a Vision Transformer that explicitly incorporates intrinsic inductive biases from convolutions. It uses spatial pyramid reduction modules with multiple dilation rates to embed multi-scale context, and a parallel convolution block fused with multi-head self-attention in each layer to capture locality. ViTAE achieves strong performance with less data and shorter training schedules.
2106.03348|v2.assessment: 通过卷积显式注入归纳偏置，缓解ViT对大数据依赖，思路清晰且实验扎实。
2106.03348|v2.contribution: 提出ViTAE，用卷积显式引入尺度不变性与局部性归纳偏置。
2106.03348|v2.innovation: 空间金字塔缩减模块与并行卷积-注意力融合结构。
2106.03348|v2.result: 在多个视觉任务上以更少数据和训练周期取得优异性能。

2106.02277|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉 Transformer 自注意力对高分辨率特征图计算与内存开销呈二次增长、难以用于密集预测的问题，提出 Glance-and-Gaze Transformer（GG-Transformer）。方法受人类识别物体时"扫视+凝视"行为启发，设计两条并行分支：Glance 分支在自适应膨胀划分上做自注意力以高效建模长程依赖，Gaze 分支用深度卷积捕捉局部上下文。相比标准 ViT 在密集预测任务上更高效，在分割/检测等任务上以更小模型取得有竞争力的精度。
2106.02277|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the quadratic complexity of self-attention that hinders vision Transformers on high-resolution dense prediction. It proposes GG-Transformer, inspired by human glance-and-gaze behavior, with a Glance branch performing self-attention on adaptively-dilated partitions for long-range modeling and a Gaze branch using depth-wise convolution for local context. This yields an efficient Transformer that achieves competitive accuracy on dense prediction tasks with a compact model size.
2106.02277|v2.assessment: 思路直观、工程实现合理，对密集预测场景下的 Transformer 效率问题有参考价值，但创新偏组合式，缺乏与自动驾驶感知任务的直接验证。
2106.02277|v2.contribution: 提出 Glance-and-Gaze 双分支视觉 Transformer，兼顾长程依赖与局部上下文并降低自注意力开销。
2106.02277|v2.innovation: 用自适应膨胀划分的自注意力与深度卷积并行分支模拟人类扫视-凝视机制。
2106.02277|v2.result: 在密集预测任务上以更紧凑模型取得有竞争力的精度，缓解高分辨率下的计算与内存瓶颈。

HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_cn: 针对视觉 Transformer 在高分辨率密集预测任务（如分割、姿态估计、检测）中因自注意力二次复杂度而难以保持高分辨率表征的问题，提出 HRFormer。方法将高分辨率卷积网络的多分辨率并行结构与 Transformer 结合，在保持高分辨率特征的同时用局部窗口自注意力与卷积增强表征，并设计高效的多分辨率交互。相比 Swin 等分层 Transformer，在高分辨率密集预测任务上以更少参数和计算取得更优精度。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.summary_en: This work targets the difficulty of vision Transformers in maintaining high-resolution representations for dense prediction due to quadratic self-attention. HRFormer combines the multi-resolution parallel design of high-resolution CNNs with Transformers, using local-window self-attention and convolutions to preserve high-resolution features with efficient multi-resolution interaction. It achieves better accuracy than hierarchical Transformers such as Swin with fewer parameters and FLOPs on dense prediction benchmarks.
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.assessment: 高分辨率 Transformer 的代表性工作，结构设计对 BEV/分割等密集预测骨干选型有直接借鉴意义，实验充分。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.contribution: 提出高分辨率视觉 Transformer 骨干 HRFormer，用于高分辨率密集预测。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.innovation: 将多分辨率并行架构与局部窗口自注意力、卷积结合，兼顾高分辨率与效率。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo.result: 在分割、姿态估计等密集预测任务上以更少参数和计算量超越 Swin 等分层 Transformer。
HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transfo._arxiv_id: HRFormer: High-Resolution Vision Transformer for Dense Predict.

2112.13528|v2.summary_cn: 针对显著性目标检测中潜变量先验表达能力不足的问题，提出带能量基先验的生成式视觉 Transformer。方法将视觉 Transformer 与能量基先验模型联合训练，通过基于 MCMC 的最大似然估计，用 Langevin 动力学从难解的后验与先验中采样，并可由生成模型导出像素级不确定性图。相比将潜变量先验设为各向同性高斯分布的生成模型，能量基信息先验更能刻画数据潜空间，在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著性检测上取得更准确的预测。
2112.13528|v2.summary_en: The paper addresses the limited expressiveness of latent priors in generative models for salient object detection. It proposes a generative vision Transformer with an energy-based informative prior, jointly trained via MCMC-based maximum likelihood estimation with Langevin dynamics for sampling, and derives pixel-wise uncertainty maps. Compared with Gaussian-prior generative models, it achieves more accurate saliency prediction on both RGB and RGB-D benchmarks.
2112.13528|v2.assessment: 生成式建模与不确定性估计思路有新意，但与自动驾驶感知主线相关度较低，实用性有限。
2112.13528|v2.contribution: 提出能量基先验的生成式视觉 Transformer 框架用于显著性检测并提供像素级不确定性。
2112.13528|v2.innovation: 用能量基信息先验替代各向同性高斯先验，并以 MCMC/Langevin 动力学联合训练。
2112.13528|v2.result: 在 RGB 与 RGB-D 显著性检测任务上取得更准确的预测并输出不确定性图。

2106.05656|v2.summary_cn: 针对视觉自监督学习中 Transformer 预训练探索不足、且已有方法仅关注全局高层特征而难以迁移到密集预测任务的问题，提出 MST（Masked Self-supervised Transformer）。方法借鉴 NLP 的掩码语言建模，基于多头自注意力图动态掩码部分局部 patch token，同时不破坏关键结构，并用全局图像解码器恢复被掩码 token 与其余 token，从而保留空间信息。相比仅做全局表征学习的方法，MST 显式捕捉局部上下文，在多个数据集上验证了对下游密集预测任务更友好。
2106.05656|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the underexplored use of Transformers in visual self-supervised learning and the poor transferability of global-only representations to dense prediction. It proposes MST, which dynamically masks local patch tokens based on multi-head self-attention maps, akin to masked language modeling, and recovers them with a global image decoder that preserves spatial information. Experiments on multiple datasets show improved transfer to downstream dense prediction tasks.
2106.05656|v2.assessment: 掩码自监督思路与 MAE 同期，对自监督预训练骨干在检测/分割等下游任务的应用有参考价值，但方法相对朴素。
2106.05656|v2.contribution: 提出基于注意力图动态掩码 token 的自监督 Transformer 预训练方法 MST。
2106.05656|v2.innovation: 利用多头自注意力图动态选择掩码 token，并用全局解码器保留空间信息以适配密集预测。
2106.05656|v2.result: 在多个数据集上验证了表征学习效果，对下游密集预测任务的迁移性优于仅学全局特征的方法。

2303.01788|v2.summary_cn: ①针对自动驾驶多任务感知缺乏统一评测基准、且现有多任务方法相比单任务基线仍有明显性能差距的问题；②论文在大规模驾驶数据集上系统评测了主流多任务学习方法，覆盖目标检测、语义分割、可行驶区域分割和车道线检测四项任务，并提出 VE-Prompt 框架，通过任务特定的提示引入视觉样例（visual exemplars）来引导模型学习高质量的任务特定表征；③相比现有多任务方法，其改进在于用视觉样例驱动的任务提示替代通用共享表征学习，缓解任务间干扰；④摘要指出已有方法虽有进步但与单任务基线差距仍大，VE-Prompt 被提出以缓解这一困境（摘要未给出具体数值）。
2303.01788|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the lack of a unified benchmark for multi-task perception in autonomous driving and the persistent performance gap between multi-task methods and single-task baselines. It extensively evaluates popular multi-task learning methods on a large-scale driving dataset across object detection, semantic segmentation, drivable area segmentation, and lane detection, and proposes VE-Prompt, a framework that introduces visual exemplars via task-specific prompting to guide learning of high-quality task-specific representations. The key improvement is replacing generic shared-representation learning with exemplar-driven task prompting to mitigate inter-task interference.
2303.01788|v2.assessment: 该工作为自动驾驶多任务感知提供了较系统的评测分析，并给出一个思路清晰的提示式多任务框架，对关注多任务/多相机感知的研究者有参考价值，但摘要未披露量化提升，需看正文验证。
2303.01788|v2.contribution: 构建了自动驾驶四项感知任务的统一多任务评测，并提出视觉样例驱动的任务提示框架 VE-Prompt。
2303.01788|v2.innovation: 用任务特定的视觉样例提示（visual exemplar prompting）引导多任务模型学习任务特定表征。
2303.01788|v2.result: 揭示了现有多任务方法与单任务基线仍存在较大性能差距，并给出缓解该问题的 VE-Prompt 框架。

Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中道路异常检测（road anomaly detection）问题，即识别训练集中未出现的未知障碍物。作者提出了一种基于部分图像重建（partial image reconstruction）的方法，并与语义分割耦合（segmentation coupling），利用分割网络提供的先验来约束重建过程，从而更准确地定位异常区域。相比已有仅依赖重建误差或仅依赖分割不确定性的方法，该方法通过耦合两者提升了异常检测的鲁棒性。摘要中未提供具体量化结果，但该思路在道路异常检测任务中具有较好的应用潜力。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.summary_en: This paper addresses road anomaly detection for autonomous driving, aiming to identify unknown obstacles absent from training data. The authors propose a partial image reconstruction method coupled with semantic segmentation, where segmentation priors constrain the reconstruction to better localize anomalies. Compared with methods relying solely on reconstruction error or segmentation uncertainty, the proposed coupling improves robustness. Quantitative results are not provided in the abstract, but the approach shows promise for road anomaly detection.
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.assessment: 该工作将重建与分割耦合用于开放集道路异常检测，思路新颖，对自动驾驶安全感知有实际意义，但需关注其定量实验与实时性。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.contribution: 提出了一种将部分图像重建与语义分割耦合的道路异常检测框架。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.innovation: 利用分割先验约束重建过程，实现更鲁棒的未知异常定位。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但方法在道路异常检测任务上展现出潜力。
Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image._arxiv_id: Road Anomaly Detection by Partial Image Reconstruction with Segmentation Coupling.

OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶环视语义占据感知缺乏大规模基准的问题，本文提出了OpenOccupancy，一个大规模环视语义占据感知基准数据集。该基准包含密集的语义占据标注，覆盖车辆周围360度范围，并提供了标准化的评估协议和基线方法。相比现有占据感知数据集，OpenOccupancy在规模、标注密度和场景多样性上均有显著提升，为环视占据感知研究提供了统一的评测平台。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.summary_en: This paper introduces OpenOccupancy, a large-scale benchmark for surrounding semantic occupancy perception in autonomous driving. It provides dense semantic occupancy annotations covering 360-degree surroundings, along with standardized evaluation protocols and baseline methods. Compared to existing occupancy datasets, OpenOccupancy significantly improves scale, annotation density, and scene diversity, offering a unified platform for surrounding occupancy perception research.
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.assessment: 该基准填补了环视语义占据感知领域大规模评测的空白，对推动自动驾驶3D场景理解研究具有重要价值。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.contribution: 提出了首个大规模环视语义占据感知基准OpenOccupancy，包含密集标注和标准化评测协议。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.innovation: 构建了覆盖360度环视的大规模密集语义占据标注数据集，并建立了统一的评测基准。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f.result: 为环视占据感知提供了大规模基准和基线方法，推动了该领域的标准化评测。
OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark f._arxiv_id: OpenOccupancy: A Large Scale Benchmark for Surrounding Semantic Occupancy Perception.

2308.01471|v2.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中感知与预测分离导致的安全性和计算效率问题，本文提出了隐式占据流场方法，用单一神经网络隐式表示随时间变化的占据和流场。该方法可被运动规划器在连续时空位置直接查询，避免了不必要的计算，并通过改进架构克服了显式占据预测方法感受野受限的问题。相比传统检测加预测的两阶段方法和稠密占据网格方法，该统一方法在保持感知召回率的同时提升了计算效率。
2308.01471|v2.summary_en: This paper proposes implicit occupancy flow fields to unify perception and future prediction in self-driving with a single neural network that implicitly represents occupancy and flow over time. The method can be directly queried by the motion planner at continuous spatio-temporal locations, avoiding unnecessary computation, and overcomes the limited receptive field of explicit occupancy prediction methods. Compared to detection-then-forecasting and dense occupancy grid approaches, it improves computational efficiency while maintaining perception recall.
2308.01471|v2.assessment: 该工作提出了感知与预测统一的新范式，隐式表示的思想对自动驾驶系统设计具有启发意义。
2308.01471|v2.contribution: 提出了隐式占据流场方法，用单一网络统一感知与未来预测，支持连续时空查询。
2308.01471|v2.innovation: 通过隐式神经表示避免稠密网格计算，并设计架构克服显式占据预测的感受野限制。
2308.01471|v2.result: 在避免不必要计算的同时保持了感知召回率，提升了感知预测联合任务的效率。

ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_cn: 针对3D点云上采样中任意尺度放大和细化的问题，本文提出了ASUR3D方法，利用局部占据场实现点云的任意尺度上采样与细化。该方法通过学习局部占据表示来指导点云的上采样过程，能够生成高质量、高密度的点云。相比固定尺度的上采样方法，ASUR3D支持任意尺度上采样，并在点云细化方面取得了更好的效果。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.summary_en: This paper proposes ASUR3D, a method for arbitrary scale upsampling and refinement of 3D point clouds using local occupancy fields. It learns local occupancy representations to guide the upsampling process, generating high-quality and dense point clouds. Compared to fixed-scale upsampling methods, ASUR3D supports arbitrary scale upsampling and achieves better refinement results.
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.assessment: 该工作将占据场引入点云上采样，思路新颖，但应用场景相对窄，对自动驾驶核心感知任务影响有限。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.contribution: 提出了基于局部占据场的3D点云任意尺度上采样与细化方法ASUR3D。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.innovation: 利用局部占据场指导点云上采样，支持任意尺度放大并提升细化质量。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R.result: 实现了任意尺度的点云上采样，在点云细化方面取得了优于固定尺度方法的效果。
ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and R._arxiv_id: ASUR3D: Arbitrary Scale Upsampling and Refinement of 3D Point Clouds using Local Occupancy Fields.

Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_cn: 针对图像匹配中遮挡区域难以处理的问题，本文提出了Occ2Net，基于3D占据估计实现遮挡区域的鲁棒图像匹配。该方法通过估计场景的3D占据结构来推断遮挡区域的特征对应关系，从而提升匹配的鲁棒性。相比传统2D图像匹配方法，Occ2Net利用3D占据信息有效解决了遮挡导致的匹配失败问题。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.summary_en: This paper proposes Occ2Net, a robust image matching method based on 3D occupancy estimation for occluded regions. It estimates the 3D occupancy structure of the scene to infer feature correspondences in occluded areas, improving matching robustness. Compared to traditional 2D image matching methods, Occ2Net effectively addresses matching failures caused by occlusion using 3D occupancy information.
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.assessment: 该工作将3D占据估计引入图像匹配以解决遮挡问题，思路有创新性，但与自动驾驶核心感知任务的关联度中等。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.contribution: 提出了基于3D占据估计的鲁棒图像匹配方法Occ2Net，专门处理遮挡区域。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.innovation: 利用3D占据结构推断遮挡区域的特征对应关系，提升图像匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on.result: 有效解决了遮挡导致的图像匹配失败问题，提升了匹配鲁棒性。
Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on._arxiv_id: Occ2Net: Robust Image Matching Based on 3D Occupancy Estimation for Occluded Regions.

SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中多相机3D占据预测的问题，本文提出了SurroundOcc，一种基于多相机输入的3D语义占据预测方法。该方法通过多相机图像特征提取和3D空间重建，生成周围环境的密集语义占据表示。相比基于BEV平面的方法，SurroundOcc提供了垂直方向的3D结构信息，在占据预测精度和场景理解能力上取得了显著提升。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.summary_en: This paper proposes SurroundOcc, a multi-camera 3D occupancy prediction method for autonomous driving. It extracts multi-camera image features and reconstructs 3D space to generate dense semantic occupancy representations of the surrounding environment. Compared to BEV-based methods, SurroundOcc provides vertical 3D structural information, achieving significant improvements in occupancy prediction accuracy and scene understanding.
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.assessment: 该工作是纯视觉多相机3D占据预测的代表性工作，对自动驾驶感知从BEV向3D占据的范式转变具有重要推动作用。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.contribution: 提出了基于多相机输入的3D语义占据预测方法SurroundOcc，生成周围环境的密集占据表示。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.innovation: 通过多相机图像特征实现3D空间重建，提供垂直方向的3D结构信息。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P.result: 在3D占据预测精度和场景理解能力上显著优于基于BEV平面的方法。
SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy P._arxiv_id: SurroundOcc: Multi-Camera 3D Occupancy Prediction for Autonomous Driving.

2304.05316|v2.summary_cn: 针对基于视觉的3D语义占据预测中3D体素处理计算量大的问题，本文提出了OccFormer，一种双路径Transformer网络用于高效处理3D体素。该方法将繁重的3D处理分解为沿水平面的局部和全局Transformer路径，实现长距离、动态且高效的编码，并在占据解码器中提出preserve-pooling和class-guided sampling来缓解稀疏性和类别不平衡。在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割任务上显著优于现有方法。
2304.05316|v2.summary_en: This paper presents OccFormer, a dual-path transformer network for vision-based 3D semantic occupancy prediction. It decomposes heavy 3D processing into local and global transformer pathways along the horizontal plane for long-range, dynamic, and efficient encoding, and proposes preserve-pooling and class-guided sampling in the occupancy decoder to mitigate sparsity and class imbalance. It significantly outperforms existing methods on SemanticKITTI semantic scene completion and nuScenes LiDAR semantic segmentation.
2304.05316|v2.assessment: 该工作通过双路径Transformer高效处理3D体素，在多个基准上取得显著提升，是3D占据预测领域的重要进展。
2304.05316|v2.contribution: 提出了双路径Transformer网络OccFormer，高效处理3D体素用于语义占据预测。
2304.05316|v2.innovation: 将3D处理分解为局部和全局Transformer路径，并提出preserve-pooling和class-guided sampling解决稀疏性和类别不平衡。
2304.05316|v2.result: 在SemanticKITTI语义场景补全和nuScenes LiDAR语义分割上显著优于现有方法。

POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_cn: 该论文针对现有 3D 占据预测方法依赖闭集语义标签、无法识别开放词汇类别的问题，提出 POP-3D，一种仅从多视角图像输入即可进行开放词汇 3D 占据预测的方法。其核心思路是将 2D 视觉-语言模型（如 CLIP）的特征通过可微渲染蒸馏到 3D 占据场中，使每个体素获得与文本对齐的语义嵌入，从而支持任意文本查询的零样本语义分割。相比已有闭集占据预测工作，POP-3D 无需 3D 标注即可泛化到未见类别，在 nuScenes 等数据集上对开放词汇类别的占据预测取得显著提升，同时保持对标准类别的竞争性精度。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.summary_en: The paper addresses the limitation of closed-set 3D occupancy prediction by proposing POP-3D, which performs open-vocabulary occupancy prediction purely from multi-view images. It distills 2D vision-language features (e.g., CLIP) into a 3D occupancy field via differentiable rendering, enabling zero-shot semantic querying with arbitrary text. Compared to prior closed-set methods, POP-3D generalizes to unseen categories without 3D labels and achieves strong open-vocabulary performance on nuScenes while remaining competitive on standard classes.
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.assessment: 该工作将开放词汇能力引入 3D 占据预测，对自动驾驶中长尾/未知障碍物感知具有实际价值，方法简洁且与现有占据框架兼容，值得关注。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.contribution: 提出首个仅用图像输入、通过 2D 视觉-语言蒸馏实现开放词汇 3D 占据预测的框架 POP-3D。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.innovation: 利用可微渲染将 CLIP 语义嵌入蒸馏到 3D 占据场，实现文本驱动的零样本体素语义查询。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre.result: 在 nuScenes 上对开放词汇类别实现有效占据预测，并保持对标准类别的竞争性精度。
POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Pre._arxiv_id: POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images.

COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_cn: 针对视觉BEV/占用预测中稠密3D体素表示计算开销大、难以兼顾效率与精度的问题，本文提出紧凑占用Transformer（COTR）。方法通过设计紧凑的占用表示与查询机制，减少冗余体素计算，同时保留场景几何与语义信息。相比已有稠密网格方法，COTR在保持预测精度的同时显著降低计算量。摘要未给出具体数值，但强调其在视觉3D占用预测上的效率-精度权衡改进。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational cost of dense 3D voxel representations in vision-based occupancy prediction. It proposes COTR, a Compact Occupancy TRansformer that reduces redundant voxel computation while preserving geometric and semantic scene information. Compared with dense-grid methods, COTR improves the efficiency-accuracy trade-off for vision-based 3D occupancy prediction.
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.assessment: 面向视觉占用预测的效率问题，思路直接且与BEV/占用方向高度相关，但摘要信息有限，需关注其实际精度与泛化性。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.contribution: 提出紧凑占用Transformer以降低视觉3D占用预测的冗余计算。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.innovation: 通过紧凑占用表示与查询机制平衡效率与精度。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for.result: 在视觉占用预测上实现更优的效率-精度权衡（摘要未给出具体数值）。
COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for._arxiv_id: COTR: Compact Occupancy TRansformer for Vision-Based 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2412.05154|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D目标检测中边界框表示无法刻画物体精细几何的问题，本文提出以物体为中心的占用（object-centric occupancy）作为边界框的补充表示。数据方面，构建了首个物体中心占用数据集；算法方面，提出带隐式形状解码器的占用补全网络，可处理动态尺寸的占用生成，为不准确的检测框预测完整占用体。该表示在提供精细几何细节的同时支持更高体素分辨率，有望提升3D检测的几何感知能力。
2412.05154|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the limited geometric detail of bounding-box representations in 3D object detection by introducing object-centric occupancy as a supplement to object bboxes. It constructs the first object-centric occupancy dataset via an automated pipeline and proposes an occupancy completion network with an implicit shape decoder for dynamic-size occupancy generation. The representation provides fine-grained geometry and enables higher voxel resolution for detected objects.
2412.05154|v2.assessment: 将占用表示与3D检测结合，数据与算法双贡献，对自动驾驶感知中几何精细建模有启发，值得关注。
2412.05154|v2.contribution: 提出物体中心占用表示及配套数据集与占用补全网络，增强3D检测的几何细节。
2412.05154|v2.innovation: 用隐式形状解码器实现动态尺寸的物体中心占用补全。
2412.05154|v2.result: 构建首个物体中心占用数据集，并为检测框预测完整占用体以提升几何感知。

2405.14014|v2.summary_cn: 针对现有3D占用预测依赖LiDAR或相机、在恶劣天气下鲁棒性不足的问题，本文提出利用4D成像雷达进行占用预测的RadarOcc。方法直接处理4D雷达张量以保留场景细节，采用多普勒bin描述子、旁瓣感知空间稀疏化和距离维自注意力应对数据量大与噪声问题，并设计球面特征编码与球面到笛卡尔特征聚合以减少坐标变换插值误差。该工作为全天候占用感知提供了新范式，并在基准上进行了验证。
2405.14014|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the weather sensitivity of LiDAR- and camera-based 3D occupancy prediction by proposing RadarOcc, which uses 4D imaging radar for occupancy prediction. It directly processes the 4D radar tensor with Doppler bin descriptors, sidelobe-aware spatial sparsification, and range-wise self-attention, plus spherical feature encoding and spherical-to-Cartesian aggregation to reduce interpolation errors. The method enables all-weather occupancy perception and is benchmarked accordingly.
2405.14014|v2.assessment: 将4D成像雷达引入占用预测，针对恶劣天气鲁棒性痛点，技术设计细致，对多传感器占用感知有较高参考价值。
2405.14014|v2.contribution: 提出基于4D成像雷达的3D占用预测方法RadarOcc。
2405.14014|v2.innovation: 直接处理4D雷达张量并结合多普勒描述子、旁瓣感知稀疏化与球面特征聚合。
2405.14014|v2.result: 在基准上验证了4D雷达占用预测的可行性，提升恶劣天气下的感知鲁棒性。

2312.03774|v2.summary_cn: 针对传统占用预测使用稠密规则网格导致计算开销大且小物体空间细节丢失的问题，本文提出基于八叉树表示的OctreeOcc框架。方法利用八叉树自适应捕获3D信息，提供可变粒度以适配不同大小和复杂度的物体与语义区域，并引入图像语义信息改进初始八叉树结构，设计迭代修正机制精炼结构。实验表明其不仅超越现有占用预测方法，还比稠密网格方法降低15%-24%计算开销。
2312.03774|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the excessive computation and loss of spatial detail for small objects in dense-grid occupancy prediction by proposing OctreeOcc, an octree-based 3D occupancy prediction framework. It adaptively captures 3D information with variable granularity, incorporates image semantics to improve the initial octree structure, and uses an iterative rectification mechanism. It surpasses state-of-the-art occupancy methods while reducing computational overhead by 15%-24% compared to dense-grid approaches.
2312.03774|v2.assessment: 八叉树自适应表示在占用预测中兼顾精度与效率，实验数据明确，对高效3D场景感知有较强参考价值。
2312.03774|v2.contribution: 提出基于八叉树查询的多粒度高效3D占用预测框架OctreeOcc。
2312.03774|v2.innovation: 利用图像语义初始化八叉树并迭代修正，实现可变粒度占用表示。
2312.03774|v2.result: 超越现有占用预测方法，并比稠密网格方法降低15%-24%计算开销。

2409.09350|v2.summary_cn: 针对主流占用预测先离散化3D环境再对稠密网格分类、而绝大多数体素为空导致计算资源分配次优的问题，本文提出将占用预测视为集合预测范式的OPUS框架。方法采用Transformer编码器-解码器，用一组可学习查询同时预测占用位置与类别，无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化；引入Chamfer距离损失将集合间比较扩展到大规模训练，并通过最近邻自适应分配语义类别。该工作为占用预测提供了简洁高效的端到端新视角。
2409.09350|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the suboptimal computation of dense-grid occupancy prediction, where most voxels are empty, by formulating occupancy prediction as a streamlined set prediction paradigm. OPUS uses a transformer encoder-decoder with learnable queries to jointly predict occupied locations and classes, employs Chamfer distance loss for large-scale set-to-set training, and adaptively assigns semantic classes via nearest neighbors. It offers a simple, end-to-end alternative without explicit space modeling or complex sparsification.
2409.09350|v2.assessment: 将占用预测重构为集合预测，思路新颖且与BEV/占用方向高度相关，有望简化流程并提升效率，值得关注。
2409.09350|v2.contribution: 提出基于集合预测范式的占用预测框架OPUS。
2409.09350|v2.innovation: 用可学习查询同时预测占用位置与类别，并以Chamfer距离损失实现端到端训练。
2409.09350|v2.result: 无需显式空间建模或复杂稀疏化即可完成占用预测，简化流程并优化计算资源分配。

GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测中高斯表示存在冗余、重叠高斯导致渲染效率低的问题，本文提出GaussianFormer-2，将场景建模为概率高斯混合模型，通过概率叠加而非简单加权求和来聚合高斯贡献，并引入基于概率的剪枝策略去除冗余高斯。相比GaussianFormer，该方法在保持精度的同时显著减少了高斯数量，提升了推理效率。在nuScenes占用预测基准上取得了与密集方法相当甚至更优的mIoU，同时大幅降低计算开销。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.summary_en: This paper addresses redundancy and overlapping issues in Gaussian-based 3D occupancy prediction by proposing GaussianFormer-2, which models scenes as probabilistic Gaussian mixtures and aggregates contributions via probabilistic superposition rather than weighted summation. A probability-based pruning strategy removes redundant Gaussians, improving efficiency while maintaining accuracy. Experiments on nuScenes show competitive mIoU with significantly reduced computational cost compared to dense methods.
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.assessment: 该工作有效解决了高斯表示在占用预测中的冗余问题，概率建模思路清晰，对实时自动驾驶感知有实际价值。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.contribution: 提出概率高斯叠加与剪枝机制，实现高效3D占用预测。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.innovation: 将高斯混合概率模型引入占用预测，替代传统加权求和聚合。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian.result: 在nuScenes上以更少高斯数量达到与密集方法相当或更优的mIoU。
GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian._arxiv_id: GaussianFormer-2: Probabilistic Gaussian Superposition for Efficient 3D Occupancy Prediction.

EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_cn: 针对自动驾驶中语义占用预测的不确定性建模问题，本文提出EvOcc，基于证据理论（Dempster-Shafer理论）对体素级语义预测进行不确定性估计，将每个体素的语义分布建模为证据分配而非简单的softmax概率。该方法能够区分认知不确定性与偶然不确定性，提升了对遮挡和稀疏观测区域的预测鲁棒性。在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI占用基准上，EvOcc在mIoU和不确定性校准指标上均优于基线方法。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.summary_en: This paper tackles uncertainty modeling in semantic occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing EvOcc, which leverages evidence theory (Dempster-Shafer) to model voxel-wise semantic predictions as evidence assignments rather than softmax probabilities. The method distinguishes epistemic from aleatoric uncertainty, improving robustness in occluded and sparsely observed regions. Experiments on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI show improvements in both mIoU and uncertainty calibration over baselines.
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.assessment: 将证据理论引入占用预测的不确定性建模，思路新颖，对安全关键的自动驾驶感知有重要意义。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.contribution: 提出基于证据理论的语义占用预测框架，实现体素级不确定性估计。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.innovation: 首次将Dempster-Shafer证据理论用于3D语义占用预测的不确定性建模。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A.result: 在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上mIoU与不确定性校准指标均优于基线。
EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for A._arxiv_id: EvOcc: Accurate Semantic Occupancy for Automated Driving Using Evidence Theory.

OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_cn: 针对现有3D语义占用预测方法计算复杂度高、难以处理长序列输入的问题，本文提出OccMamba，首次将状态空间模型（Mamba）引入占用预测任务，设计了3D空间Mamba模块以线性复杂度建模体素间的长程依赖关系。该方法在保持全局感受野的同时将计算复杂度从二次降低到线性。在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上，OccMamba以更低的计算量取得了与基于Transformer的方法相当或更优的占用预测精度。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.summary_en: This paper addresses the high computational complexity of existing 3D semantic occupancy prediction methods by proposing OccMamba, the first to introduce state space models (Mamba) into occupancy prediction. A 3D spatial Mamba module models long-range voxel dependencies with linear complexity, reducing computation from quadratic to linear while maintaining global receptive field. Experiments on nuScenes and SemanticKITTI show comparable or superior accuracy to Transformer-based methods with lower computational cost.
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.assessment: 首次将Mamba引入占用预测，线性复杂度设计对大规模场景部署有吸引力，值得关注。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.contribution: 提出基于Mamba的3D占用预测框架OccMamba，实现线性复杂度长程建模。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.innovation: 首次将状态空间模型应用于3D语义占用预测，设计3D空间Mamba模块。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction.result: 在nuScenes和SemanticKITTI上以更低计算量达到与Transformer方法相当或更优精度。
OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction._arxiv_id: OccMamba: Semantic Occupancy Prediction with State Space Models.

STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_cn: 针对3D占用预测与场景流估计中时空信息利用不充分、稀疏表示效率低的问题，本文提出STCOcc，通过稀疏空间-时间级联更新机制，在稀疏体素表示上逐步融合时序信息，实现占用预测与场景流的联合估计。该方法设计了级联式时空注意力模块，在保持稀疏计算效率的同时有效捕捉动态场景的时序演化。在nuScenes和Occ3D基准上，STCOcc在占用预测和场景流估计两个任务上均取得了领先性能。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient spatio-temporal information utilization and low efficiency of sparse representations in joint 3D occupancy and scene flow prediction by proposing STCOcc, which employs sparse spatial-temporal cascade renovation to progressively fuse temporal information on sparse voxel representations. A cascaded spatio-temporal attention module captures dynamic scene evolution while maintaining sparse computational efficiency. Experiments on nuScenes and Occ3D show leading performance on both occupancy prediction and scene flow estimation.
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.assessment: 联合占用与场景流预测的稀疏时空级联设计实用性强，对动态场景理解有重要价值。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.contribution: 提出稀疏时空级联更新框架，实现占用预测与场景流的联合估计。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.innovation: 设计级联式时空注意力模块，在稀疏体素上高效融合时序信息。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade.result: 在nuScenes和Occ3D上占用预测与场景流估计均取得领先性能。
STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade._arxiv_id: STCOcc: Sparse Spatial-Temporal Cascade Renovation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction.

2412.13193|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D语义占用预测依赖大量标注数据和密集体素表示导致的可扩展性与泛化性差的问题，本文提出GaussTR，一种基于高斯表示的Transformer框架，通过前馈方式预测稀疏高斯集合来表示3D场景，将高斯泼溅到2D视图后与基础模型对齐，实现自监督3D表示学习和开放词汇语义占用预测。该方法无需显式标注即可进行训练，在Occ3D-nuScenes数据集上取得12.27 mIoU的零样本性能，同时训练时间减少40%。
2412.13193|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses scalability and generalization challenges in 3D semantic occupancy prediction caused by reliance on extensive labeled data and dense voxel representations by proposing GaussTR, a Gaussian-based Transformer that predicts sparse Gaussian sets and aligns rendered features with foundation models for self-supervised 3D representation learning and open-vocabulary occupancy prediction. Without explicit annotations, GaussTR achieves 12.27 mIoU zero-shot on Occ3D-nuScenes with 40% training time reduction.
2412.13193|v2.assessment: 将高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现自监督开放词汇占用预测，零样本性能突出，是该方向的重要突破。
2412.13193|v2.contribution: 提出GaussTR框架，通过高斯表示与基础模型对齐实现自监督开放词汇3D占用预测。
2412.13193|v2.innovation: 利用高斯泼溅将3D场景渲染到2D并与基础模型对齐，实现无需标注的自监督学习。
2412.13193|v2.result: 在Occ3D-nuScenes上取得12.27 mIoU零样本性能，训练时间减少40%。

2503.19576|v2.summary_cn: 针对隐式神经表示（INR）压缩中现有方法依赖量化与熵编码方案、性能受限的问题，本文提出SINR，利用INR权重向量空间中的模式，通过高维稀疏编码在字典中压缩权重向量空间。分析发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可成功恢复INR权重，因此该方法可与任何现有INR压缩技术集成。实验表明SINR在多种配置下显著降低了INR的存储需求。
2503.19576|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses limitations of existing implicit neural representation (INR) compression methods that depend on quantization and entropy coding by proposing SINR, which exploits patterns in INR weight vector spaces via high-dimensional sparse coding within a dictionary. Analysis reveals dictionary atoms need not be learned or transmitted to recover INR weights, enabling integration with any existing INR compression technique. Experiments show substantial storage reduction across various configurations.
2503.19576|v2.assessment: INR压缩与自动驾驶感知领域关联较弱，但稀疏编码思路对模型压缩方向有一定参考价值。
2503.19576|v2.contribution: 提出SINR压缩算法，利用稀疏字典编码压缩INR权重向量空间。
2503.19576|v2.innovation: 发现字典原子无需学习或传输即可恢复INR权重，实现与现有压缩技术的即插即用集成。
2503.19576|v2.result: 在多种配置下显著降低INR存储需求。

MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_cn: 针对不同激光雷达（Lidar）传感器之间因线束、安装角度、点云密度差异导致的域间隙问题，本文提出MergeOcc，旨在实现跨Lidar配置的鲁棒占据预测。方法上通过域对齐/融合策略桥接不同Lidar数据分布，使模型在未见过的Lidar配置下仍能保持稳定性能。相比已有仅在单一Lidar域内训练的占据预测方法，MergeOcc提升了跨传感器泛化能力。摘要未提供具体数值，但该问题对自动驾驶多车型部署具有实际价值。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.summary_en: This paper addresses the domain gap between different LiDAR sensors (e.g., beam count, mounting angle, point density) that degrades occupancy prediction robustness. MergeOcc bridges these domains via a fusion/alignment strategy to enable robust cross-LiDAR occupancy prediction. Compared with prior single-domain occupancy methods, it improves generalization across heterogeneous LiDAR configurations, which is practically important for multi-vehicle autonomous driving deployment.
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.assessment: 跨Lidar域间隙是占据预测落地中的关键痛点，该工作切中实际部署需求，值得关注。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.contribution: 提出MergeOcc以桥接不同Lidar配置间的域间隙，实现鲁棒占据预测。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.innovation: 针对异构Lidar传感器设计域对齐/融合机制以提升跨域泛化。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between.result: 在跨Lidar配置下提升了占据预测的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between._arxiv_id: MergeOcc: Bridge the Domain Gap between Different Lidars for Robust Occupancy Prediction.

AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_cn: 针对开放世界3D占据预测中模型难以泛化到未见类别/场景的问题，本文提出AGO（Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction）。方法通过自适应grounding机制将开放词汇/开放世界语义与3D占据表示对齐，从而在无闭集类别约束下进行占据预测。相比传统闭集占据预测方法，AGO增强了开放世界场景下的语义泛化能力。摘要未给出具体数值，但开放世界占据预测是当前重要前沿方向。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.summary_en: This paper tackles open-world 3D occupancy prediction, where models must generalize to unseen categories and scenes. AGO introduces an adaptive grounding mechanism that aligns open-vocabulary/open-world semantics with 3D occupancy representations. Compared with closed-set occupancy methods, it improves semantic generalization in open-world settings, addressing a key frontier in autonomous driving perception.
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.assessment: 开放世界占据预测是新兴且重要的方向，AGO的自适应grounding思路具有探索价值。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.contribution: 提出AGO自适应grounding框架用于开放世界3D占据预测。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.innovation: 将开放词汇语义与3D占据表示自适应对齐以支持开放世界预测。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3.result: 提升了开放世界场景下3D占据预测的语义泛化能力。
AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3._arxiv_id: AGO: Adaptive Grounding for Open World 3D Occupancy Prediction.

2408.11447|v2.summary_cn: 针对自监督3D占据估计仍依赖传感器真值6D位姿、且体渲染耗时且效果有限的问题，本文提出GaussianOcc，系统研究高斯泼溅在环视3D占据估计中的两种用法。方法包含GSP模块，通过相邻视角投影提供准确尺度信息以实现完全自监督训练；以及GSV模块，从体素空间进行高斯泼溅以利用其快速渲染特性。相比已有方法，GaussianOcc实现了无需真值位姿的完全自监督占据估计，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能仍具竞争力。
2408.11447|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the reliance on ground-truth 6D poses and the inefficiency of volume rendering in self-supervised 3D occupancy estimation. GaussianOcc proposes GSP to provide scale information from adjacent-view projection for fully self-supervised training, and GSV to render from voxel space using Gaussian splatting. It achieves fully self-supervised (no GT pose) occupancy estimation with competitive performance, being 2.7x faster in training and 5x faster in rendering.
2408.11447|v2.assessment: 完全自监督且高效的高斯泼溅占据估计方案，兼顾性能与效率，是该方向的重要进展。
2408.11447|v2.contribution: 提出GaussianOcc实现完全自监督且高效的环视3D占据估计。
2408.11447|v2.innovation: GSP提供尺度信息摆脱位姿依赖，GSV从体素空间高斯泼溅加速渲染。
2408.11447|v2.result: 无需真值位姿，训练快2.7倍、渲染快5倍，性能具竞争力。

2502.07309|v2.summary_cn: 针对3D占据世界模型仍依赖昂贵3D占据标注的问题，本文提出半监督视觉中心3D占据世界模型PreWorld，利用2D标签潜力。方法采用两阶段训练：自监督预训练阶段用属性投影头生成RGB、密度、语义等属性场，通过体渲染实现2D标签的时序监督；并引入状态条件预测模块递归预测未来占据与自车轨迹。在nuScenes上验证了有效性与可扩展性，取得具竞争力的性能。
2502.07309|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the high cost of 3D occupancy labels for occupancy world models by proposing PreWorld, a semi-supervised vision-centric 3D occupancy world model. It uses a two-stage paradigm: self-supervised pre-training with an attribute projection head generating RGB/density/semantic fields for temporal 2D supervision via volume rendering, and a state-conditioned forecasting module for recursive future occupancy and ego-trajectory prediction. Experiments on nuScenes validate effectiveness and scalability with competitive performance.
2502.07309|v2.assessment: 半监督世界模型降低3D标注依赖，兼顾预测与规划，具有较强实用价值。
2502.07309|v2.contribution: 提出半监督视觉中心3D占据世界模型PreWorld。
2502.07309|v2.innovation: 两阶段训练结合属性投影头与状态条件递归预测模块。
2502.07309|v2.result: 在nuScenes上取得具竞争力的性能并验证可扩展性。

CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_cn: 针对占据预测中多帧时序信息利用不足与对齐困难的问题，本文提出CSV-Occ，融合多帧对齐进行占据预测。方法引入时序跨状态空间模型（Temporal Cross State Space Model）与中心投票机制（Central Voting Mechanism）来建模时序依赖并聚合空间信息。相比已有单帧或简单时序融合方法，CSV-Occ增强了时序一致性与占据预测精度。摘要未提供具体数值。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.summary_en: This paper addresses insufficient temporal fusion and alignment in occupancy prediction by proposing CSV-Occ. It introduces a Temporal Cross State Space Model and a Central Voting Mechanism to model temporal dependencies and aggregate spatial information for multi-frame aligned occupancy prediction. Compared with single-frame or naive temporal fusion methods, it improves temporal consistency and occupancy accuracy.
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.assessment: 将状态空间模型引入占据预测时序建模，思路较新，但需更多实验验证其优势。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.contribution: 提出CSV-Occ融合多帧对齐的占据预测框架。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.innovation: 结合时序跨状态空间模型与中心投票机制进行时序融合。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo.result: 提升了多帧占据预测的时序一致性与精度。
CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment fo._arxiv_id: CSV-Occ: Fusing Multi-frame Alignment for Occupancy Prediction with Temporal Cross State Space Model and Central Voting Mechanism.

ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_cn: 针对3D占据预测中表示效率与几何/语义建模的平衡问题，本文提出ODG（Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians），采用双重高斯表示进行占据预测。方法通过两组高斯（可能分别建模几何与语义或不同粒度）来高效表达3D场景占据。相比基于稠密体素或单一表示的方法，ODG在保持预测精度的同时提升表示效率。摘要未给出具体数值。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.summary_en: This paper addresses the trade-off between representation efficiency and geometric/semantic modeling in 3D occupancy prediction by proposing ODG, which uses dual Gaussians. The dual Gaussian representation efficiently encodes scene occupancy, likely separating geometry and semantics or different granularities. Compared with dense voxel or single-representation methods, ODG improves representation efficiency while maintaining accuracy.
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.assessment: 双重高斯表示在占据预测中兼顾效率与精度，是高斯类方法的有益探索。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.contribution: 提出基于双重高斯表示的3D占据预测方法ODG。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.innovation: 采用双高斯表示高效建模3D场景占据。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau.result: 在保持预测精度的同时提升表示效率。
ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gau._arxiv_id: ODG: Occupancy Prediction Using Dual Gaussians.

Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶中自回归式占据预测（autoregressive occupancy prediction）的效率与聚焦问题，提出了一种动态聚焦掩码（Dynamic Focused Masking）机制。由于摘要为空，无法确认具体技术细节，但从标题推断，其核心是在自回归占据预测过程中动态选择需要关注的空间区域，以减少冗余计算并提升预测精度。相比已有工作，该方法可能通过动态掩码策略替代均匀或静态的预测顺序，从而更高效地建模场景演化。由于缺乏摘要，无法引用具体实验数据。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.summary_en: This paper addresses the efficiency and focus issue in autoregressive occupancy prediction for autonomous driving by proposing a Dynamic Focused Masking mechanism. The method likely dynamically selects spatial regions of interest during autoregressive prediction to reduce redundant computation and improve accuracy. Compared with prior work, it may replace uniform or static prediction orders with a dynamic masking strategy for more efficient scene evolution modeling. Specific experimental results cannot be cited due to the missing abstract.
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.assessment: 自回归占据预测是Occupancy方向的新兴趋势，动态聚焦掩码思路有潜力，但摘要缺失导致无法评估其实际效果，建议关注后续完整版本。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.contribution: 提出动态聚焦掩码机制用于自回归占据预测，以提升效率与聚焦能力。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.innovation: 将动态掩码策略引入自回归占据预测，动态选择预测区域。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi.result: 摘要缺失，无法确认具体实验效果。
Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressi._arxiv_id: Dynamic Focused Masking for Autoregressive Embodied Occupancy Prediction.

2506.10977|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对3D语义占据预测中现有方法效率低下的问题：稠密体素表示忽略驾驶场景稀疏性，而基于稀疏高斯的物体中心表示受椭球形状先验限制，难以建模多样几何结构。为此，作者提出以超二次曲面（superquadrics）作为场景基元，利用其固有形状多样性以更少基元高效表示复杂结构，并构建了概率超二次混合模型，将每个超二次曲面解释为带几何先验的占据概率分布，通过概率混合计算语义。基于此提出QuadricFormer模型。相比高斯椭球表示，该方法能更高效地建模长方体、圆柱体及不规则形状，减少基元数量并提升表示效率。
2506.10977|v2.summary_en: This paper tackles the inefficiency of 3D semantic occupancy prediction, where dense voxel representations ignore scene sparsity and sparse Gaussian-based object-centric representations are limited by ellipsoidal shape priors. The authors propose using superquadrics as scene primitives, leveraging their inherent shape diversity to represent complex structures with fewer primitives, and develop a probabilistic superquadric mixture model that treats each superquadric as an occupancy probability distribution with a geometry prior. Building on this, they present QuadricFormer. Compared with Gaussian ellipsoid representations, the method efficiently models cuboids, cylinders, and irregular shapes with fewer primitives.
2506.10977|v2.assessment: 该工作将超二次曲面引入占据预测，几何表达能力强且表示高效，是Occupancy方向值得关注的新范式，有望推动稀疏表示的发展。
2506.10977|v2.contribution: 提出基于超二次曲面的概率混合模型与QuadricFormer，实现高效3D语义占据预测。
2506.10977|v2.innovation: 以超二次曲面替代高斯椭球作为场景基元，利用形状多样性减少基元数量。
2506.10977|v2.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但声称能以更少基元高效表示复杂结构。

2509.16500|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶视频生成模型虽视觉逼真但存在细微几何畸变、限制下游感知任务可用性的问题，量化了合成数据与真实数据在3D目标检测上的显著性能差距。为此提出RLGF（Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback），通过引入专用隐空间AD感知模型的奖励来精炼视频扩散模型，核心包括隐空间窗口优化技术（用于扩散过程中的定向反馈）和分层几何奖励（HGR）系统（提供点-线-面对齐及场景占据一致性的多级奖励），并提出GeoScores量化畸变。在nuScenes上应用于DiVE等模型，RLGF将几何误差显著降低（消失点误差降21%，深度误差降57%），3D目标检测mAP提升12.7%，缩小了与真实数据的差距。
2509.16500|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the subtle geometric distortions in autonomous driving video generation models that limit their utility for downstream perception, quantifying a significant performance gap in 3D object detection between synthetic and real data. The authors propose RLGF (Reinforcement Learning with Geometric Feedback), which refines video diffusion models using rewards from specialized latent-space AD perception models, featuring a Latent-Space Windowing Optimization technique and a Hierarchical Geometric Reward (HGR) system for point-line-plane alignment and scene occupancy coherence, along with GeoScores for quantification. Applied to DiVE on nuScenes, RLGF reduces geometric errors (VP error by 21%, depth error by 57%) and improves 3D detection mAP by 12.7%.
2509.16500|v2.assessment: 该工作首次系统量化并解决生成视频的几何畸变问题，RLGF即插即用且效果显著，对自动驾驶合成数据与感知任务结合有重要价值。
2509.16500|v2.contribution: 提出RLGF框架，利用几何反馈强化学习精炼视频扩散模型，提升合成数据几何一致性。
2509.16500|v2.innovation: 将隐空间感知模型奖励与分层几何奖励结合，用于扩散模型后训练以校正几何畸变。
2509.16500|v2.result: 在nuScenes上消失点误差降21%、深度误差降57%，3D检测mAP提升12.7%。

2210.01917|v2.summary_cn: 该论文针对自动驾驶运动规划中环境时序演化预测的问题，指出以自车为中心的freespace表示混淆了环境自身运动与自车运动，难以用于下游规划器。作者提出以几何occupancy作为替代表示，并利用可微raycasting将未来occupancy预测渲染为未来LiDAR扫描，从而与真实扫描进行自监督对比学习。相比已有依赖显式3D占用标注或视图相关表示的工作，该方法无需占用真值即可让occupancy作为预测网络的内部表示自然涌现。摘要未给出具体量化结果，但展示了自监督占用预测的可行性。
2210.01917|v2.summary_en: This paper addresses the problem that ego-centric representations such as freespace confound environment motion with ego-motion, hindering downstream motion planning. It proposes geometric occupancy as a disentangled alternative and uses differentiable raycasting to render predicted future occupancy into future LiDAR sweeps for self-supervised learning against ground-truth sweeps. Unlike prior work requiring explicit 3D occupancy labels, occupancy emerges as an internal representation without direct supervision, though the abstract does not report quantitative results.
2210.01917|v2.assessment: 将可微渲染与自监督占用预测结合，为无需占用标注的时序场景演化建模提供了新思路，对占用预测与规划方向的研究者有参考价值。
2210.01917|v2.contribution: 提出用可微raycasting将未来占用预测渲染为LiDAR扫描以实现自监督占用预测。
2210.01917|v2.innovation: 以可微raycasting作为桥梁，使occupancy在无占用真值监督下作为网络内部表示自然涌现。
2210.01917|v2.result: 摘要未提供具体量化指标，但验证了自监督占用预测框架的可行性。

SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_cn: 该论文针对卷积占用网络（Convolutional Occupancy Networks）在三维重建中依赖准确符号（内外方向）监督、对噪声和初始化敏感的问题，提出了符号无关优化框架 SA-ConvONet。方法上通过设计符号无关的损失与优化策略，使网络无需显式区分内外即可学习连续占用场，从而提升对不完整或含噪点云的鲁棒性。相比原始 ConvONet，改进点在于去除了对符号标注的依赖并增强了优化稳定性。摘要未提供具体量化结果，但声称在多个重建基准上取得更优或相当的精度。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.summary_en: This paper addresses the sign-dependence issue of Convolutional Occupancy Networks for 3D reconstruction, where accurate inside/outside labels are required. It proposes SA-ConvONet, a sign-agnostic optimization framework that learns continuous occupancy fields without explicit sign supervision, improving robustness to noisy or incomplete point clouds. Compared with the original ConvONet, it removes the reliance on sign annotations and stabilizes optimization, though the abstract does not report specific quantitative gains.
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.assessment: 该工作对三维占用场学习中的符号监督问题提出了实用改进，对基于占用网络的三维感知与重建有参考价值，但摘要信息有限，需关注其定量实验与在自动驾驶场景中的泛化性。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.contribution: 提出符号无关的卷积占用网络优化框架，消除对内外符号标注的依赖。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.innovation: 通过符号无关损失与优化策略，使占用场学习无需显式符号监督。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization.result: 摘要未给出具体数值，声称在重建基准上取得更优或相当的精度。
SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization._arxiv_id: SA-ConvONet: Sign-Agnostic Optimization of Convolutional Occupancy Networks.

Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_cn: 该论文针对三维表面感知图像合成中几何与外观解耦困难、生成质量受限的问题，提出了生成式占用场（Generative Occupancy Fields）方法。方法上利用占用场表示三维表面，并结合生成模型实现表面感知的图像合成，从而在保持几何一致性的同时提升渲染真实感。相比已有基于神经辐射场或体素的方法，改进点在于显式建模表面占用以增强几何约束。摘要未提供具体量化指标，但声称在合成质量与几何一致性上优于基线。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.summary_en: This paper tackles the challenge of geometry-appearance disentanglement in 3D surface-aware image synthesis by proposing Generative Occupancy Fields. The method represents 3D surfaces via occupancy fields and integrates a generative model to synthesize images with improved geometric consistency and realism. Compared with NeRF- or voxel-based approaches, it explicitly models surface occupancy for stronger geometric constraints, though the abstract lacks specific quantitative results.
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.assessment: 该工作将占用场引入生成式图像合成，对三维场景理解与神经渲染有交叉参考价值，但摘要未给出定量结果，需进一步验证其在自动驾驶感知中的实用性。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.contribution: 提出生成式占用场用于三维表面感知的图像合成。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.innovation: 利用占用场显式建模表面几何，增强生成图像的几何一致性。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa.result: 摘要未提供具体数值，声称在合成质量与几何一致性上优于基线。
Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surfa._arxiv_id: Generative Occupancy Fields for 3D Surface-Aware Image Synthesis.
